papers.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
papers.abstract_en: Continuous self-improvement requires an ever-expanding pool of self-generated, diverse, adaptive goals. For language agents, existing training environment pools (hand-curated, statically synthesized, or frozen-verifier) keep the goal distribution fixed as the learner scales. We introduce SPADE (Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments), a self-play RL framework in which a single LLM plays two roles: an Environment Designer that writes complete, long-horizon training environments as executable code with an OpenAI Gym-style reset()/step() interface, and a Reasoning Agent that learns to act in them. Each is a stateful, multi-turn environment (state transitions, reward functions, and verification code), so one interface spans reasoning problems and multi-step agentic tool use. The Reasoning Agent's regret is estimated using the gap between its reward with and without privileged hints; in optimizing this regret signal the Environment Designer learns to target environments at the edge of the agent's capabilities while keeping them feasible. Through extensive experimentation, we find several components critical to success: grounding the Environment Designer on documents sampled from a large pretraining corpus, and giving it an accumulated environment memory. Scaling to 30B-parameter models, SPADE improves over the strongest fixed-environment baseline by +5.3 on average across eight held-out math, science, code, and reasoning benchmarks, and lifts the tool-use setting by +5.7 on BFCL-v4 multi-turn and +13.9 on ACEBench-Agent; on the games setting, the margin over the strongest baseline grows with model scale. By making environment design itself a learnable component, SPADE takes a concrete step toward open-ended self-improvement.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPADE（Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments），一个自博弈强化学习框架：同一个 LLM 同时扮演 Environment Designer（用 OpenAI Gym 风格 reset()/step() 接口编写可执行的长程训练环境）和 Reasoning Agent（在该环境中学习行动）。Agent 的遗憾（regret）通过有无特权提示（privileged hints）的奖励差估计，Designer 优化该信号以生成位于 Agent 能力边界附近且可行的环境。实验显示，在 30B 参数规模下，SPADE 在八个留出基准上平均比最强的固定环境基线高 +5.3，工具使用场景在 BFCL-v4 multi-turn 上 +5.7、在 ACEBench-Agent 上 +13.9，游戏场景的优势随模型规模增大。
Motivation: 现有语言智能体的训练环境池（人工筛选、静态合成或冻结验证器）在学习者规模扩展时保持目标分布固定，限制了持续自我改进所需的多样化、适应性目标生成。
Method: SPADE 让单个 LLM 通过自博弈扮演两个角色：Environment Designer 以代码形式生成完整的可执行多轮环境（包含状态转移、奖励函数与验证代码），Reasoning Agent 在其中学习。Designer 通过最小化 Agent 的遗憾信号（有无特权提示的奖励差）来生成恰好处于能力边界且可行的环境；作者还发现将 Designer 锚定在来自大规模预训练语料的文档上并赋予其累积环境记忆是成功的关键组件。
Result: 在 30B 参数模型上，SPADE 在八个留出的数学、科学、代码与推理基准上平均比最强固定环境基线高 +5.3；工具使用场景中 BFCL-v4 multi-turn 提升 +5.7，ACEBench-Agent 提升 +13.9；游戏场景中相比最强基线的优势随模型规模增长而扩大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过把环境设计本身变成可学习组件，SPADE 为开放式自我改进（open-ended self-improvement）迈出具体一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ADEPT: Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training and Post-Training using Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training (ADEPT), a large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) framework for learning sim-to-real transferable dexterity across high degree-of-freedom (DoF) robot embodiments that can solve long-horizon tasks directly from raw visuo-tactile perception. ADEPT pretrains a dexterous policy on a generic object reposing task, then post-trains downstream policies with this pretrained behavior as a prior. ADEPT enables learning new behaviors that are otherwise difficult to discover from scratch on multi-fingered robots and avoids learning the same set of skills over again for every new downstream task. The pretrained policy zero-shots the reposing phase of downstream tasks, but naïve RL fine-tuning rapidly degrades this capability during transfer. We address this with a stable post-training recipe combining behavior-cloning distillation, critic warm-up, and conservative on-policy updates. To safely exploit the full kinematic dexterity, we introduce a joint-space Geometric Fabric that mediates between the RL policy and the robot. We distill post-trained teachers into perceptive students that zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on two embodiments: a 23 DoF Kuka-Allegro with two RGB cameras, and a 29 DoF Flexiv-Sharpa with two RGB cameras and five vision-based tactile sensors, and can solve long-horizon tasks from challenging initial states with dexterity at human-level speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADEPT，一个用于高自由度机器人手的大规模强化学习框架，从原始视觉-触觉感知学习可模拟到真实迁移的灵巧操作，并能解决长时程任务。ADEPT 先在通用物体重排任务上预训练策略，再以后训练方式将该行为作为先验用于下游任务，避免每个新任务都从头学习相同的技能。
Motivation: 多指机器人直接从零学习灵巧操作技能非常困难，且每个下游任务都需要重新学习一组技能，缺乏跨任务复用机制。
Method: ADEPT 采用预训练-后训练框架：预训练一个通用物体重排策略，后训练时结合行为克隆蒸馏、critic 预热和保守的 on-policy 更新来保持预训练能力；同时在关节空间引入 Geometric Fabric 作为强化学习策略与机器人之间的中介，并将后训练教师蒸馏为基于感知的学生策略。
Result: 在 23 DoF 的 Kuka-Allegro（两个 RGB 相机）和 29 DoF 的 Flexiv-Sharpa（两个 RGB 相机和五个视觉触觉传感器）两种实体上，蒸馏后的感知策略能够零样本模拟到真实迁移，从困难的初始状态以人类速度解决长时程灵巧任务。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该预训练-后训练配方能稳定迁移预训练的重排能力，并安全利用完整运动学灵巧性，减少了多指机器人学习新任务时的重复训练成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Teacher Likelihood: Group-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses using dense token-level guidance from a stronger teacher. In long-context tasks, however, token-level teacher support can favor locally plausible responses that omit evidence distributed across the input or violate global task constraints. Task-specific verifiers, in contrast, evaluate task completion at the response level and may return graded rewards that reflect partial success. We diagnose this mismatch on fixed responses from two representative long-context evidence-aggregation tasks. Across longer input ranges, trajectory-level OPD scores become progressively less aligned with verifier rewards, indicating teacher-verifier disagreement. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Group-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (GC-OPD). GC-OPD separately normalizes verifier rewards and trajectory-level OPD scores within each rollout group and uses their difference as a signed teacher-verifier disagreement residual. Relative-advantage-based credit assignment (RACA) distributes this trajectory-level residual across tokens according to their relative OPD advantages while preserving the original OPD signal. Across five long-context benchmarks, post-training with GC-OPD raises the five-benchmark averages of the official Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B checkpoints from 29.08 to 40.47 and from 35.12 to 44.65, respectively. Vanilla OPD reaches 39.31 and 43.56 under the same setup. Controlled ablations show that the signed residual is more effective than either an additional OPD-derived term or direct group-normalized verifier reward addition, while RACA further improves over uniform token allocation. Together, these results demonstrate that group-relative residual calibration can incorporate verifier outcomes without discarding dense token-level guidance. Code is available at https://github.com/SolereZhang/GC-OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在长上下文任务中，on-policy distillation (OPD) 的 token 级教师信号可能与任务级 verifier 奖励不一致，并据此提出 Group-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (GC-OPD)。GC-OPD 在每个 rollout 组内分别归一化 verifier 奖励与轨迹级 OPD 分数，用二者差值作为带符号的 teacher-verifier 分歧残差，再通过 relative-advantage-based credit assignment (RACA) 将残差分配到各 token。在五个长上下文基准上，用该方法对官方 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 进行 post-training 后，五基准平均分分别从 29.08 提升到 40.47、从 35.12 提升到 44.65，优于 vanilla OPD 的 39.31 与 43.56。
Motivation: 长上下文任务中，token 级教师支持可能偏向局部合理但遗漏分布证据或违反全局约束的响应，而任务专用 verifier 在响应级评估任务完成度并提供反映部分成功的分级奖励。作者在两类代表性的长上下文证据聚合任务上诊断出这种不匹配：输入范围越长，轨迹级 OPD 分数与 verifier 奖励的越不对齐。
Method: 提出 GC-OPD：在每个 rollout 组内分别归一化 verifier 奖励和轨迹级 OPD 分数，将两者之差作为带符号的 teacher-verifier 分歧残差；RACA 依据各 token 的相对 OPD 优势（relative advantage）把该轨迹级残差分配到 token，同时保留原始 OPD 信号。
Result: 在五个长上下文基准上，post-training 将官方 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的五基准平均值分别从 29.08 提升到 40.47、从 35.12 提升到 44.65；相同设置下 vanilla OPD 分别达到 39.31 和 43.56。受控消融表明，带符号残差比额外 OPD 衍生项或直接加组归一化 verifier 奖励更有效，RACA 也优于均匀 token 分配。
Conclusion: 作者认为，组相对残差校准能够在保留 dense token 级指导的同时纳入 verifier 结果，从而缓解教师信号与任务级验证之间的不匹配。代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Image-Guided Pavement Defect Recognition in GPR Data with novel 3D Deep Learning Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) is a widely adopted non-destructive sensing technology for subsurface inspection in civil and transportation engineering. Despite its potential for pavement condition assessment, the large-scale application of GPR in automated inspection has two key challenges: the scarcity of annotated real-world datasets and the lack of deep learning models designed for the unique characteristics of 3-Dimensional (3D) GPR data. This study addresses these limitations by firstly introducing a cost-effective data preparation pipeline that integrates orthomosaic Red Green Blue (RGB) imagery with 3D GPR scans to generate annotated 3D GPR datasets. The proposed method uses the aligned segments of RGB and GPR data, using pavement surface images as a reference to transfer labels of surface-visible defects to corresponding GPR segments, enabling efficient large-scale annotation in a real-world dataset collected on a highway section under operation. In addition to the dataset contribution, we propose a specialised 3D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture incorporating residual connections, mixed convolutional kernel sizes, and both depthwise and channelwise attention mechanisms to enhance feature representation and defect classification. The model is evaluated on binary classification tasks for detecting patch and crack defects in pavement structures. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed network outperforms baseline architectures across multiple evaluation metrics. Ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of the designed architectural components. This work contributes a scalable and practical method for real-world dataset generation, along with a novel deep learning framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合正射 RGB 影像与三维 GPR 扫描的标注流水线，利用对齐的影像段将表面可见缺陷标签迁移至对应 GPR 段，从而低成本生成大规模真实标注数据集；同时设计了一种包含残差连接、混合卷积核大小以及 depthwise 与 channelwise 注意力机制的 3D CNN 架构，用于路面 patch 与 crack 缺陷的二分类。在运营中高速公路路段采集的真实数据上，该网络在多个评估指标上优于基线架构，消融实验验证了各设计组件的有效性。
Motivation: GPR 是土木与交通工程中广泛采用的无损检测技术，但其在自动化路面检测中的大规模应用面临两大挑战：带标注的真实世界数据集稀缺，以及缺乏针对三维 GPR 数据独特特性设计的深度学习模型。
Method: 提出一条经济高效的数据准备流水线：将正射 RGB 影像与 3D GPR 扫描对齐，以路面表面图像为参考，把表面可见缺陷的标签迁移到对应 GPR 段，实现大规模标注；并设计专门的 3D CNN，包含残差连接、混合卷积核大小、depthwise 与 channelwise 注意力机制以增强特征表示与缺陷分类。
Result: 在运营中高速公路路段采集的真实数据集上，针对 patch 与 crack 缺陷的二分类任务，所提网络在多个评估指标上优于基线架构；消融实验进一步确认了所设计架构组件的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者将其贡献总结为一种可扩展且实用的真实世界数据集生成方法，以及一个新的深度学习框架；摘要未报告具体数值或讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Finetuning Strategies for Querying Sounds by Vocal Imitation
papers.abstract_en: This technical report describes our winning submission to the AES AIMLA 2025 Challenge on querying sound effects by vocal imitation. We investigate two complementary fine-tuning strategies: contrastive learning with a frozen, pretrained CED encoder, and joint contrastive-triplet learning with semi-hard negatives using a MobileNetV3 encoder. This report has been updated for posterity to include details released after the challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是作者提交至 AES AIMLA 2025 声音效果语音模仿检索挑战赛的优胜技术报告。报告研究了两种互补的微调策略：使用冻结的预训练 CED 编码器进行对比学习 (contrastive learning)，以及使用 MobileNetV3 编码器结合半硬负样本 (semi-hard negatives) 进行对比-三元组联合学习。报告为存档目的补充了挑战赛后公开的细节。
Motivation: 声音效果常通过人声模仿来查询，但如何有效地对音频编码器进行微调以匹配这种查询方式仍缺乏系统研究；该工作以挑战赛为背景探索可行微调策略。
Method: 提出并比较两种微调路线：一是冻结预训练 CED 编码器并加入对比学习目标；二是基于 MobileNetV3 编码器，在对比学习基础上联合三元组损失，并使用半硬负样本挖掘。
Result: 该方案在 AES AIMLA 2025 声音效果语音模仿检索挑战赛中获胜，成为优胜提交。
Conclusion: 报告强调两种微调策略相互补充，并指出这是面向特定挑战赛的技术报告，而非完整方法论文。

papers.title: Lévy Attention: Single-Pass Predictive Uncertainty for Continuous-Time Attention
papers.abstract_en: Deep models for irregularly-sampled time series answer queries at arbitrary continuous timestamps, yet report nothing about how far each answer should be trusted. We show the attention layer itself can close that gap: with the right stochastic formulation, the pass that makes each prediction also reports, in closed form and at no extra cost, how far it should be trusted. We introduce Lévy Attention, a cross-attention operator whose output is a stochastic integral against an inhomogeneous Poisson random measure: query-key compatibilities assemble an intensity over a continuous (time x channel) index space, the measure scatters atoms under it, and the output averages an interpolated value field at those atoms. In expectation it reduces to a mollified cosine-kernel attention, so it replaces a softmax layer and trains with exact gradients. What softmax discards, the Poisson construction preserves in closed form: the evidence $Λ_q$ (total compatibility mass) and the disagreement $\mathrm{tr}\,Σ_V(q)$ (value spread). An exact variance identity makes their combination $\hatσ(q)=\sqrt{\mathrm{tr}\,Σ_V(q)\,\varphi(Λ_q)}$ the root-mean-square deviation of the sampled operator, emitted by the deterministic pass with no trained head. Empirically, disagreement carries the signal, while the evidence factor swings from uninformative on dense data to strongly informative on sparse. On t-PatchGNN the operator swap costs at most 5.6% accuracy against a matched control and nothing on the sparsest dataset. The free disagreement signal improves on 20-pass MC dropout across matched five-seed suites, and $\hatσ$ scales a calibrated Gaussian whose zero-sample CRPS beats a fifty-draw sampler; a split-conformal wrapper reaches nominal coverage at every level, and one pass ranks 3,383 unseen patients by trust in 1.4 seconds.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 2 figures. Under review at TMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lévy Attention，一种基于随机积分的交叉注意力算子，用于不规则采样时间序列的任意连续时间戳预测，并同时给出闭式的不确定性估计。该算子的输出是对非齐次 Poisson 随机测度的随机积分，期望等价于 mollified cosine-kernel attention，可替换 softmax 层并以精确梯度训练。确定性前向过程即可输出证据量 Λ_q 与值分歧 tr Σ_V(q)，两者组合得到均方根偏差 σ̂(q)，无需额外训练头。实验显示分歧信号携带主要不确定性信息，证据因子在稀疏数据上更具信息量，并在 t-PatchGNN、MC dropout 对比及分位回归校准中展现优势。
Motivation: 面向不规则采样时间序列的深度模型能在任意连续时间戳作答，却不报告答案的置信程度。作者希望让注意力层自身承担不确定性量化，使预测过程在同一次前向中同时给出可信度，而无需额外开销或训练头。
Method: 引入 Lévy Attention：查询-键兼容性在连续 (时间 × 通道) 索引空间上构造强度，Poisson 随机测度在其下散布原子，输出对这些原子处的插值值场取平均。期望形式约化为 mollified cosine-kernel attention，因此可替换 softmax 层并支持精确梯度训练；Poisson 构造保留 softmax 丢弃的证据量 Λ_q 与值协方差迹 tr Σ_V(q)，通过方差恒等式组合出 σ̂(q)。
Result: 摘要报告：在 t-PatchGNN 上算子替换相比匹配对照最多损失 5.6% 准确率，而在最稀疏数据集上无损失；免费的分歧信号在五个种子的匹配套件上优于 20 次 MC dropout；σ̂ 缩放的校准高斯分布其零采样 CRPS 优于 50 次采样器；split-conformal 包装达到名义覆盖率；单次前向可在 1.4 秒内对 3,383 名未见患者按信任度排序。
Conclusion: 作者强调注意力层本身可以在预测的同时以闭式、零额外成本方式提供不确定性估计，且分歧 (disagreement) 信号是不确定性的主要载体，证据因子在数据稀疏时更具信息量。所述实验涉及患者排序等应用，未提及与降水或气象领域的直接关联。

papers.title: Learned, Then Lost: A Measured Single-Example Counterfactual in Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: A single training example's contribution to a finished model is normally estimated rather than measured, because measuring it takes two expensive full pre-training runs that differ in one row of one batch. We ran that counterfactual 24 times at a small scale. We trained 32 GPT-2 models at 124M parameters from scratch on OpenWebText, over four conditions and eight seeds. At step 200 of 9,536, at peak learning rate, we replaced one row of a 256-row batch with a fixed context injection carrying a 194-token passage. The three injected conditions are: 1. fluent prose with a corpus-attested subject, 2. fluent prose with a fabricated subject matched to it within 0.14% on full-batch gradient delta, and 3. random keyboard characters. The fourth condition is an uninjected twin. The passage is learned from one exposure and then decays. Fifty steps after injection, the arm that saw a passage predicts it better than the arm that did not by 0.039 and 0.044 nats of cross-entropy on the passage, at eight of eight seeds with p < $10^{-4}$. At the final step we do not detect that difference for either passage, at p = 0.25 and p = 0.71, against minimum detectable effects of 0.025 and 0.079 nats, nor between the two passages, at p=0.54. Every geometric measure we report is taken after that decay. Our pre-registered contrast on interpolation loss barrier is +0.0068 with p = 0.509, against a minimum detectable effect of 0.032 barrier units. Held-out cross-entropy is $-0.00044$ with p = 0.310. Per-layer centered kernel alignment does not detectably separate any condition at any layer. Weight displacement reaches 44.1% of the seed-to-seed Euclidean distance and is 92% settled by the midpoint of training, while the barrier reaches 3.0% of the seed-to-seed barrier. Those two figures sit roughly 15 times apart, and that is a lower bound. The injection relocates the model within its basin without moving it out.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过 24 次小规模反事实预训练实验，直接测量单个训练样本对最终模型的贡献，而不是估计。作者用 32 个 124M 参数的 GPT-2 模型在 OpenWebText 上从零训练，并在训练第 200 步将一个 194-token 的段落注入单个 batch 行。结果表明段落在一次暴露后被学习，但随后衰减；到训练结束时，模型对段落的预测能力不再可检测，但模型在参数空间中的位置已被改变。
Motivation: 单个训练样本对最终模型的贡献通常只能被估计，因为精确测量需要两次完整的预训练运行，且两次运行仅在一个 batch 的一行上不同，代价过高。作者希望通过多次小规模反事实实验来直接测量这种贡献。
Method: 训练 32 个 GPT-2 124M 模型（四种条件、八个种子），在第 200 步（共 9,536 步，处于峰值学习率）将 256 行 batch 中的一行替换为携带 194-token 段落的固定上下文注入。三种注入条件为：流畅散文且主题在语料中有据可查；流畅散文但主题为虚构，且与前一条件在全 batch 梯度 delta 上匹配到 0.14% 以内；随机键盘字符。第四种条件是未注入的孪生模型。
Result: 注入后 50 步，看到段落的训练分支在段落上的交叉熵 (cross-entropy) 比未注入分支低 0.039 和 0.044 nats，八个种子全部显著（p < 10^-4）。在最终步，两种段落均无检测到的差异（p = 0.25 和 p = 0.71，最小可检测效应分别为 0.025 和 0.079 nats），两个段落之间也无差异（p = 0.54）。预注册的插值损失势垒 (interpolation loss barrier) 对比为 +0.0068，p = 0.509；留出交叉熵为 -0.00044，p = 0.310；逐层 centered kernel alignment 在任何层都无法区分条件。权重位移达到种子间欧氏距离的 44.1%，且在训练中点已稳定 92%；势垒达到种子间势垒的 3.0%。
Conclusion: 注入将模型在其 basin 内重新定位而未使其移出 basin；段落内容最终衰减到不可检测，而几何上的位移仍然存在。作者指出权重位移与势垒这两个数字相差约 15 倍，且这是一个下界。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Interpretable AI predicts a 2026 summer dry anomaly in central China
papers.abstract_en: Seasonal precipitation anomalies are largely regulated by atmospheric circulation, which dynamical models predict with greater reliability than precipitation itself. Here, we employ a deep learning model that translates dynamical circulation predictions into precipitation estimates. Predictions initialized from March to May consistently indicate a dry anomaly over central China in summer 2026. Retrospective evaluations revealed higher predictive skill in the analogue years, which also tended to feature central equatorial Pacific warming persisting from the preceding winter into summer. This warming favors an anomalous cyclonic circulation over the western North Pacific-South China Sea-South China region, which induces northerly winds and moisture divergence that jointly suppress rainfall over central China. Supporting this mechanism, layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) independently identifies these northerly winds as the dominant driver of the prediction among all model inputs. Perturbation tests supported this attribution: removing LRP-identified features effectively eliminates the dry anomaly. Our framework thus provides physically interpretable explanations for AI-derived regional climate projections, facilitating evidence-based assessment before observational data become available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个深度学习模型，将动力模式对大气环流的预测转化为降水估计，并用于夏季中国中部降水异常的预报。模型在2026年3-5月初始化的预测一致显示该区域夏季出现干旱异常。作者通过回溯评估、层相关性传播（LRP）和扰动测试，给出物理解释：中赤道太平洋增暖经由西北太平洋-南海-华南上空的异常气旋环流，产生北风与辐散，抑制降水。
Motivation: 季节降水异常主要受大气环流调控，而动力模式对环流的预测可靠性高于对降水本身的预测；因此需要一种能将可靠的环流预测转换为降水估计的可解释框架。
Method: 采用深度学习模型把动力环流预测翻译为降水估计，并用层相关性传播（LRP）对模型输入进行归因，再通过扰动测试（去除LRP识别的主要特征）验证归因结果。
Result: 从3月到5月初始化的预测一致指出2026年夏季中国中部存在干旱异常；回溯评估显示在相似年份（analogue years）预测技巧更高，这些年份通常伴随前冬持续到夏季的中赤道太平洋增暖，增暖导致西北太平洋-南海-华南区域异常气旋环流，产生北风和水汽辐散从而抑制降水。LRP独立识别出北风为主要驱动因子，扰动测试中去除这些特征后干旱异常消失。
Conclusion: 该框架为AI驱动的区域气候预测提供物理上可解释的依据，有助于在观测数据尚不可得时进行基于证据的评估。
Relevance: 87

papers.title: Beyond the Transcript: Detecting Covert Co ordination in Latent Multi-Agent Communication
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents can communicate through continuous hidden states that are invisible in public transcripts, creating opportunities for covert harmful coordination. We introduce Verifiable Latent Alignments (VLA), an activation-aware framework for monitoring and steering these private communication channels. For every monitored decision, VLA links the private latent-state record and channel status to the resulting public action using a shared event identifier, enabling matched causal analysis. Our first contribution is a neutral-only three-layer monitor combining representation anomaly detection, counterfactual action-distribution influence, and sparse-autoencoder interpretation support. Our second contribution is a steerability framework spanning black-box behavioral instructions and white-box matched-neutral counterfactuals. Our third contribution is an evaluation on a controlled multi-agent auction benchmark covering homogeneous and heterogeneous model pairs, many-agent scalability, and intervention effectiveness. The sequential monitor achieves mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.993 for homogeneous agents and 0.854 for heterogeneous pairs when text- and latent-collusion rows are pooled as positives. In Qwen3-0.6B auctions with 25-100 bidders, monitoring requires only a small normalized load relative to all possible directed pairs, while full white-box steering achieves 100% bid-distribution recovery and reduces collusive low-bid behavior by 47.3 percentage points. Because full white-box steering replays the matched neutral counterfactual, its exact recovery is a sanity check by construction. Overall, the controlled study shows that the evaluated private channel attacks can be monitored without training the primary monitor on attack examples and mitigated when matched counterfactual access is available.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Verifiable Latent Alignments (VLA)，一种基于激活的监控与操控框架，用于检测和引导语言模型智能体在连续隐状态中的隐蔽协调通信。框架包含仅用中性数据训练的三层监控器、黑盒/白盒操控机制，并在多智能体拍卖基准上验证。顺序监控器在同质智能体上平均 AUROC 达 0.993，异质对为 0.854；白盒操控实现 100% 出价分布恢复，并将合谋低出价行为降低 47.3 个百分点。
Motivation: 语言模型智能体可通过公开转录中不可见的连续隐状态进行通信，形成隐蔽的有害协调机会；现有基于公开文本的方法难以监控此类私有通信通道。
Method: 引入 VLA 框架，用共享事件标识符将私有隐状态记录、通道状态与最终公共行为关联，支持匹配的因果分析。监控部分为仅含中性样本的三层结构：表示异常检测、反事实行动分布影响、稀疏自编码器解释；操控部分覆盖黑盒行为指令与白盒匹配中性反事实。
Result: 在受控多智能体拍卖基准上，顺序监控器对同质智能体平均 AUROC 为 0.993，异质对为 0.854（文本与隐状态合谋行合并为阳性）；Qwen3-0.6B 拍卖中 25–100 个投标者时监控负载相对全部有向对较小；完全白盒操控达到 100% 出价分布恢复，并减少 47.3 个百分点的合谋低出价行为。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，所评估的私有通道攻击可在不将攻击示例用于训练主监控器的情况下被监控，并在具备匹配中性反事实访问时得到缓解；完全白盒操控的精确恢复被视为构造上的健全性检查。

papers.title: Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning for Controlled Hawkes Jump-Diffusions
papers.abstract_en: We study stochastic control of multivariate Hawkes-driven stochastic differential equations with machine learning algorithms in a non-Markovian setting. Due to the path dependence of the memory of the Hawkes intensity, this problem does not fall within classical stochastic control theory outside particular Markovian kernels. We first develop a finite-dimensional Markovianization procedure and algorithm to approximate multivariate Hawkes processes with mixtures of exponential kernels. We prove the convergence of the Markovianized approximation of the Hawkes process, its intensity, and the value of the problem to the original non-Markovian processes and the value of the primal problem. We then formulate continuous-time deterministic policy gradient learning on the Markovianized approximation of the problem, called Hawkes-CT DDPG. We propose a model-free algorithm to solve the non-Markovian Hawkes-driven optimization by observing only the event times of the process, the realization of the solution to the SDE, and a chosen set of decay filters, while the Hawkes kernel coefficients remain unknown. We compare our continuous time reinforcement learning Hawkes-CT DDPG method with discrete time reinforcement learning techniques under three different types of kernels: simple exponential, Erlang, and power-law kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非马尔可夫设定下由多变量 Hawkes 过程驱动的随机微分方程的最优控制问题，并提出机器学习求解方案。作者先建立有限维马尔可夫化过程，用混合指数核逼近多变量 Hawkes 过程，并证明逼近后的 Hawkes 过程、强度以及问题值收敛到原始非马尔可夫对象。随后在该逼近问题上提出连续时间确定性策略梯度算法 Hawkes-CT DDPG，并在简单指数、Erlang 与幂律三类核下与离散时间强化学习技术进行比较。
Motivation: Hawkes 强度的记忆具有路径依赖性，除特殊马尔可夫核外，该控制问题不属于经典随机控制理论的框架，因而需要新的建模与求解手段。
Method: 开发有限维马尔可夫化流程与算法，用指数核混合近似多变量 Hawkes 过程；证明马尔可夫化逼近在过程、强度及问题值层面收敛到原始非马尔可夫情形。基于该逼近提出模型无关的连续时间确定性策略梯度算法 Hawkes-CT DDPG，仅需观测事件时间、SDE 解的轨迹以及一组选定的衰减滤波器，无需知道 Hawkes 核系数。
Result: 摘要在三种核设定（简单指数、Erlang、幂律）下将 Hawkes-CT DDPG 与离散时间强化学习技术进行了比较，但未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调所提方法可以在不知道 Hawkes 核系数的前提下，仅利用事件时间和衰减滤波器观测来求解非马尔可夫 Hawkes 驱动优化问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Pre-Compiled Pipeline Shards for Distributed LLM Inference on Intel AI PC Fleets
papers.abstract_en: Modern Intel AI PCs ship capable integrated GPUs and NPUs with 16+ GB of unified memory, and they spend considerable time idle. That is not enough memory to fit a large model such as a 70B-parameter LLM. We show that a handful of AIPCs, working together over an ordinary network, can serve models beyond the capability of any single one. We use pipeline parallelism: a model is split by layer into per-stage shards, each pre-compiled into an OpenVINO graph, so that every machine runs one shard and passes activations to the next. Three techniques make this fast enough to be useful. First, we recover the speed of the unsplit model: a naive per-stage export runs well below monolithic inference because it misses an OpenVINO GPU optimization, and injecting a beam_idx Gather into each shard triggers that optimization (the IndirectKVCache fusion) and brings the shards to parity. Second, we leverage speculative decoding on stateful OpenVINO models. Third, the pipeline serves several users at once by interleaving their requests across the stages, each request carrying its own cache (micro-batching). Together, a two-node Llama 3.1 8B INT4 pipeline serves two concurrent users at 1.79x the single-user throughput of the unsplit model on the same hardware, and the gap widens under simulated wide-area latency. The same design scales to a 70B model that no single fleet member can hold: a four-node deployment of Lunar Lake AI PCs on Intel Tiber Cloud serves a single user at interactive speed, with output token-for-token identical to the same four-node pipeline decoding without speculation. Code, raw benchmark logs, and reproduction scripts ship as a self-contained package at https://github.com/labscommunity/pipeline-sharded-inference-paper (in the top-level reproduction/ directory).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用多台 Intel AI PC 组成的普通网络集群，通过流水线并行 (pipeline parallelism) 推理超过单机显存容量的 LLM。作者将模型按层切分为预编译的 OpenVINO 分片 (shards)，并采用 beam_idx Gather 注入、投机解码 (speculative decoding) 和微批处理 (micro-batching) 三项技术。实验显示，两节点 Llama 3.1 8B INT4 流水线可为两个并发用户提供相当于单用户未拆分模型 1.79 倍的吞吐，四节点部署可交互式推理单机无法容纳的 70B 模型。
Motivation: 现代 Intel AI PC 拥有 16GB 以上统一内存的 GPU/NPU，但单机内存不足以容纳 70B 参数级大模型，且这些设备大量时间处于空闲；论文旨在利用多台空闲 AIPC 通过普通网络协同服务超单机能力的模型。
Method: 将模型按层切分为每个阶段 (stage) 的分片并预编译为 OpenVINO 图，每台机器运行一个分片并传递激活值；通过向每个分片注入 beam_idx Gather 触发 OpenVINO 的 IndirectKVCache 融合优化以恢复未拆分模型的速度；在带状态的 OpenVINO 模型上使用投机解码；通过跨阶段交错多个请求、每个请求携带独立缓存 (micro-batching) 来服务多个用户。
Result: 两节点 Llama 3.1 8B INT4 流水线在相同硬件上为两个并发用户提供 1.79 倍于未拆分模型单用户吞吐的服务速率，且在模拟广域网延迟下差距进一步扩大；四节点 Lunar Lake AI PC (Intel Tiber Cloud) 可部署 70B 模型，单用户输出达到交互速度，且输出与无投机解码的四节点流水线逐 token 一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为预编译的分片式流水线能够使多台 AIPC 协作服务超出任何单机能力的模型，并附带代码、基准日志和复现脚本的完整发布包。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Geometric Iterative Retrieval for Neural Audio Codec Resynthesis
papers.abstract_en: Neural audio codecs based on Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ) have become the dominant discrete representation for token-based general audio generation, yet resynthesizing high-quality audio from coarse codec tokens remains an open problem and bounds the fidelity of every system that generates them. Prior work has framed resynthesis as a choice between discrete token prediction and continuous regression. We argue that this dichotomy is incomplete and introduce geometric iterative retrieval, a paradigm that uses the RVQ layer hierarchy itself as a natural iterative decomposition in continuous codebook space. Rather than classifying over discrete vocabularies or regressing to a single target vector, our method performs contrastive retrieval in the codebook's geometric space. We evaluate our method on codec restoration tasks across speech and music, and show improvements over both single-pass token prediction and one-step regression baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于残差向量量化 (Residual Vector Quantization, RVQ) 的神经音频编解码器在从粗粒度 codec token 重建高质量音频时的保真度瓶颈，提出几何迭代检索 (geometric iterative retrieval) 范式。该方法将 RVQ 层层次本身视为连续码本空间中的自然迭代分解，通过对比检索 (contrastive retrieval) 而非离散 token 分类或一步连续回归来完成重建。在语音和音乐上的 codec 重建任务中，作者报告该方法优于单遍 token 预测和一步回归基线。
Motivation: 基于 RVQ 的神经音频编解码器已成为通用音频生成的离散表示主流，但从粗 codec token 重建高质量音频仍是一个开放问题，制约了所有生成系统保真度的上限。既有工作把重建问题局限于离散 token 预测与连续回归二选一，这种二分法并不完整。
Method: 提出几何迭代检索，利用 RVQ 层层次结构作为连续码本空间中的自然迭代分解；不在离散词表上分类，也不回归到单一目标向量，而是在码本的几何空间中执行对比检索以逐层重建。
Result: 在语音和音乐上的 codec 重建任务中，该方法相对单遍 token 预测和一步回归基线均取得改进。
Conclusion: 摘要表明把 RVQ 层层次用作连续码本空间的迭代分解，并以几何检索替代离散分类与连续回归，可以提升 codec token 重建质量。

papers.title: Grouping the Stochastic Machine: Precision, Not Capability, as the Frontier Metric for AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Frontier language models are compared, marketed, and benchmarked on capability -- what their best or average output can achieve. I argue this measures the wrong axis. The models have saturated accuracy: their mean output lands on the target. What now separates one system from another in practice is precision: how tightly concentrated their outputs are around that target across repeated, identical requests. Borrowing the marksman's distinction, capability is where the average shot lands; reliability is the size of the group. I make three claims. First, precision, not capability, is the frontier differentiator between systems, and benchmark culture systematically fails to measure it, reporting central tendency rather than spread. Second, precision is measurable, cheaply and without circularity, by running a fixed suite of deterministically scored tasks many times at fixed temperature and computing the per-task consistency of outcomes -- no model-in-the-loop grader required. Third, the measurement is not merely descriptive but decision-guiding: it separates consistent failures (a tight group off-centre, correctable by the operating discipline of Paper 1 -- a sight adjustment) from scattered failures (a wide group, correctable only by changing the model or its sampling -- a rifle problem). I define a grouping metric, specify a harness, and show how tracking a human-AI pair's grouping over time yields the compounding signal that Paper 1's field study requires. A first real run, since replicated, illustrates both the method and its most important limit: one measured gap was closed completely by a single rule (0/5 -> 5/5), while a suite of tasks authored from the rules themselves found no value, because a frontier model already embodies explicit good practice -- establishing that a discipline's worth is found by measurement on real work, not constructed from its own rulebook.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Companion to "Tuning the Stochastic Machine", submitted concurrently
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证前沿语言模型的比较基准应转向精度 (precision) 而非能力 (capability)：在平均输出已命中目标之后，系统间的实际差异在于输出围绕目标的集中程度。作者提出一个分组度量 (grouping metric) 与测量框架，通过固定温度下重复运行确定性评分任务来计算每任务结果一致性，并区分可纠正的一致失败与需更换模型或采样策略的分散失败。初步实测显示，单条规则即可完全弥合一个测量差距 (0/5 -> 5/5)，而由规则自身构造的任务套件未发现价值。
Motivation: 现有前沿模型在能力维度已饱和并使基准文化只报告集中趋势而不报告离散度，导致系统间真正的实践差异——精度——被系统性忽视。
Method: 提出以精度为前沿区分指标，采用固定温度下对确定性评分任务多次重复运行并计算每任务结果一致性的测量方式，无需模型参与打分；同时定义分组度量并以跟踪人机配对的分组随时间变化作为复利信号。
Result: 首个真实运行（已复现）表明：一条单一规则将某差距从 0/5 完全提升至 5/5；而依据这些规则本身编写的任务套件未发现额外价值，说明前沿模型已内化显式良好实践。

papers.title: SCORE: Subject Coordinate Recovery for Label-Free Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Accurate visual decoding can reveal how the brain represents visual information and recover perceived content from neural signals such as electroencephalography (EEG), with potential for neural communication. However, current EEG-to-image retrieval methods perform far below their within-subject counterparts for new users without labeled calibration, limiting real-world deployment. To understand this gap, we analyze EEG features across subjects and find that different subjects preserve similar relationships among concepts but express them along different coordinate directions. We therefore propose Subject Coordinate Recovery (SCORE), a target label-free framework combining recovery-aware source training with coordinate alignment at deployment. During training, SCORE aligns source subject EEG with a common image space and simulates unseen-subject recovery through source-only episodes. At deployment, with both encoders frozen, SCORE selects reliable EEG-image landmarks through hubness-corrected matching and estimates an orthogonal transformation to recover target EEG coordinates without source data or target labels. In 200-way retrieval on two public benchmarks, SCORE outperforms the unadapted baseline for every target subject and achieves the best overall accuracy. It reaches 53.23%/83.55% and 12.01%/32.16% Top-1/Top-5 on THINGS-EEG2 and Alljoined-1.6M, respectively, surpassing the strongest baselines by 17.45/15.70 and 3.08/4.62 percentage points. Without target labels or encoder updates, SCORE brings brain-based visual decoding closer to robust, practical, low-latency deployment across users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Subject Coordinate Recovery (SCORE)，一个面向无标签跨被试 EEG-to-Image 检索的框架。作者发现不同被试在 EEG 特征空间中保持相似的概念关系但沿不同坐标方向表达，因此 SCORE 在训练阶段采用恢复感知的源训练，并在部署阶段通过正交变换对齐目标被试的坐标。在 200-way 检索任务上，SCORE 在 THINGS-EEG2 和 Alljoined-1.6M 两个基准上均取得最佳精度，且对每个目标被试都超过未适应的基线。
Motivation: 现有 EEG-to-Image 检索方法在面对没有标定数据的新用户时，性能远低于被试内（within-subject）场景，限制了实际部署。作者通过跨被试 EEG 特征分析，指出主要瓶颈在于不同被试的特征沿不同坐标方向表达，而非概念结构本身不同。
Method: SCORE 是一个目标标签无关的框架，结合恢复感知的源训练（recovery-aware source training）与部署时的坐标对齐。训练时，SCORE 将源被试 EEG 与公共图像空间对齐，并通过仅使用源数据的 episode 模拟未见被试的恢复过程；部署时冻结两个编码器，利用 hubness-corrected matching 选择可靠的 EEG-图像地标，估计一个正交变换来恢复目标 EEG 坐标，无需源数据或目标标签。
Result: 在 200-way 检索中，SCORE 对每个目标被试都优于未适应基线，并在两个公开基准上达到最佳平均精度：THINGS-EEG2 上 Top-1/Top-5 为 53.23%/83.55%，Alljoined-1.6M 上为 12.01%/32.16%，分别超过最强基线 17.45/15.70 和 3.08/4.62 个百分点。
Conclusion: SCORE 在无需目标标签或编码器更新的情况下显著提升跨被试视觉解码性能，使基于大脑信号的视觉解码向稳健、实用、低延迟的跨用户部署迈进。

papers.title: Beyond Trial Averaging: Anchoring Neural and Visual Representations for Few-Repetition Brain-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Decoding visual information from brain signals probes neural representations and enables neuro-rehabilitation and dream decoding. Recent brain-to-image retrieval approaches have achieved promising performance, typically by averaging many (up to 80) neural trials per image, requiring repeated stimulus presentation that increases latency, cost, and user burden. When only one or a few repetitions are available, the retrieval accuracy drops sharply. This drop is commonly attributed to query noise because averaging suppresses noise and increases signal stability. However, we find a non-transitive alignment pattern: the low-repetition query signal and the image representation each align with the high-repetition center, but not directly with each other. This pattern shows that query noise is only part of the problem and that gallery placement also affects retrieval. We therefore propose a neural-anchor-based retrieval (NEAR) framework that treats the high-repetition center as an anchor and approaches it from both sides: a denoiser pulls the noisy query toward the true anchor, and a small network predicts each candidate's pseudo anchor from its image and pulls the image toward it. Across four datasets spanning EEG, MEG and fMRI, NEAR consistently improved retrieval in the few-repetition regime. On THINGS-EEG2, it improved 200-way Top-1 accuracy by 5.7 and 9.3 percentage points respectively, when averaging one and four repetitions. By anchoring neural and visual representations, NEAR reduces reliance on repeated acquisition and brings neural retrieval closer to real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对脑信号到图像检索（brain-to-image retrieval）在低重复次数（few-repetition）下准确率骤降的问题，发现低重复次数的查询信号与图像表征各自都能与高重复次数中心对齐，但彼此不能直接对齐，表明查询噪声只是问题的一部分，图库放置（gallery placement）也起作用。作者提出基于神经锚点的检索框架 NEAR，把高重复次数中心当作锚点，从查询侧和图像侧同时逼近锚点。在 EEG、MEG 和 fMRI 四个数据集上，NEAR 持续提升了低重复次数的检索性能，其中在 THINGS-EEG2 上，平均 1 次和 4 次重复时的 200-way Top-1 准确率分别提升 5.7 和 9.3 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有脑到图像检索通常对每张图片平均多达 80 次神经试验，重复刺激带来延迟、成本和用户负担；当只有一次或少数几次重复时，检索准确率显著下降。作者指出现有解释将下降归因于查询噪声，但他们发现查询噪声只解释了部分问题，低重复查询与图像表征之间的非传递对齐模式说明图库侧表示也影响检索。
Method: 提出 NEAR（neural-anchor-based retrieval）框架，将高重复次数中心视为锚点，并从两侧逼近：一个去噪器（denoiser）把带噪查询拉向真实锚点，另一个小型网络根据图像预测该候选的伪锚点（pseudo anchor），并把图像表征拉向该伪锚点。
Result: 在 EEG、MEG 和 fMRI 共四个数据集上，NEAR 在低重复次数区间一致提升检索性能；在 THINGS-EEG2 上，平均 1 次和 4 次重复时 200-way Top-1 准确率分别提高 5.7 和 9.3 个百分点。
Conclusion: 通过同时锚定神经表征和视觉表征，NEAR 降低了对重复采集的依赖，使神经检索更接近实际部署场景；论文主要面向低重复次数下的检索改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Leaf Values as Coordinates: Exact Contrastive Explanation for Gradient-Boosted Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: A gradient-boosted ensemble predicts by summing one leaf value per tree. Read those values as coordinates rather than as intermediate results, and every instance becomes a point in R^M on which the model acts linearly: the score is the sum of the coordinates. This small change of view makes contrastive explanation exact. The difference between two instances is a vector that is identically zero wherever they share a leaf, so the gap between a rejected applicant and an accepted one is carried by a handful of coordinates, each traceable to a real split in a real tree. Nothing is fitted, sampled, or assumed additive in features -- the additivity is already there, in the right space. We build a recourse method on this representation and evaluate it on five tabular datasets under repeated cross-validation. Its recommendation reconstructs the model's own decision to 6.2 x 10^-15, so an auditor can re-check the arithmetic without the model. On the credit datasets it is Pareto-non-dominated on effort against realism. And when recommendations are restricted to changes the subject could actually make -- not their age, not a settled delinquency -- it retains 58% of its validity where the strongest baseline retains 41%, a distinction the standard evaluation cannot see because it never asks whether a recommendation can be carried out.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对梯度提升集成模型提出一种精确的对比解释视角：把每棵树的叶值读作坐标，而不是中间结果，则每个实例成为 R^M 中的点，模型在其上线性作用（得分为坐标之和）。两个实例的差异向量在共享叶子的坐标处为零，因而被拒绝者与获准者之间的差距由少数可追溯到真实分裂的坐标承载。作者在此表示上构建了一个 recourse 方法，并在五个表格数据集上做重复交叉验证：推荐结果能以 6.2×10^-15 的精度重建模型自身决策，且在信贷数据集上努力程度与真实性之间 Pareto 非支配；当限制为可执行的改动时保留 58% 的有效性，而最强基线为 41%。
Motivation: 现有对比解释和反事实推荐常常依赖拟合、采样或假设特征可加性，且标准评估不检查推荐是否真的能被用户执行。作者指出，在叶值坐标空间中可加性本就存在，因而对比解释可以做到精确且可审计。
Method: 改变读法：将梯度提升集成中每个实例的叶值视为坐标，模型得分即坐标之和；实例间差异成为仅在分叉叶子处非零的向量，每个非零坐标都对应真实树中的真实分裂。基于该表示构建 recourse 推荐方法，无需额外拟合、采样或可加性假设。
Result: 在五个表格数据集上的重复交叉验证中，推荐重构模型自身决策的精度达到 6.2×10^-15；在信贷数据集上，推荐在努力程度与真实性方面 Pareto 非支配。当推荐被限定为用户实际可执行的改动（如不能改年龄或已定罪的 delinquency）时，方法保留 58% 的有效性，而最强基线保留 41%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将叶值视为坐标可使梯度提升集成的对比解释成为精确且可复核的计算，并强调标准评估因不询问推荐能否被执行而看不见行动性差异；论文篇幅较短（5 页），实验限于表格数据。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Tuning the Stochastic Machine: A Systems Engineer's Operating Model for Human-AI Engineering
papers.abstract_en: When an expert corrects an LLM assistant's error, the correction usually dies with the session, and the error class returns. I argue this is an operations problem, not a tooling problem: mechanisms for persisting corrections exist and are shipping, but the discipline for governing them -- versioning with provenance, recurrence monitoring, counter-metrics, retirement of stale rules -- does not. Writing as a systems engineer of thirty years, I map the LLM stack onto the machines my profession already operates (frozen silicon, firmware, loadable modules, persistent configuration, volatile memory), identify where the mapping fails (stochastic generation, configuration that binds only probabilistically, no general-purpose retirement (verification) stage by default), and derive from the failures a seven-principle operating discipline with an error loop at its core. Three cases from my own practice illustrate the mechanism, among them a control that silently became the exact harm it was built to prevent. I close with the measurement framework this view implies and the lab study required to test it.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Experience report and operating model
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份经验报告，作者以三十年系统工程师的视角，将带 LLM 助手的系统视为需要运维的随机机器。作者认为专家对 LLM 错误的纠正通常随会话消失、同类错误反复出现，并提出将 LLM 堆栈映射到传统机器组件（固件、可加载模块、持久配置、易失内存等）的操作模型，由此推导出以错误循环为核心的七原则运维纪律。
Motivation: 现有机制已经可以持久化对 LLM 的纠正，但缺乏治理纪律：没有版本化与溯源、复发监控、反指标（counter-metrics）以及陈旧规则的退役管理，导致纠正常常只对当次会话失效。
Method: 作者把 LLM 堆栈映射到系统工程师已经熟悉的机器组件，并定位映射失效之处，包括随机生成、只以概率方式绑定的配置以及默认缺少通用退役（verification）阶段；在此基础上提出包含错误循环的七原则运维操作模型，并用三个亲身实践案例加以说明。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验数据，只给出三个实践案例，其中一个控制机制静默地变成了它本应防止的危害；作者还提出相应的测量框架，并指出需要实验室研究来检验该框架。
Conclusion: 本文是经验报告和操作模型，核心主张是把 LLM 错误纠正当作运维问题而非工具问题来治理；作者明确表示所提出的测量框架尚需实验室研究验证，目前支撑证据仅限于作者自身的实践案例。

papers.title: PGFS++: Molecular Property Improvement under Synthesis and Diversity Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Improving molecular properties, such as drug-likeness or binding affinity, is a recurring task in early-stage drug discovery. However, molecules optimized in an unconstrained chemical space have limited practical value if they cannot be synthesized. Policy Gradient for Forward Synthesis (PGFS) is a synthesis-aware reinforcement learning method for molecular improvement, but its use of reactant embedding prediction makes reactant selection indirect, which, as we show, limits learning effectiveness. We first develop PGFS+, in which reaction templates and second reactants are represented by trainable embedding lookup tables. Combined with a more effective scoring function and RL algorithm, PGFS+ significantly improves the desired property. However, it exposes a reward-hacking failure mode: a powerful reactant search can map diverse input molecules to the same high-reward magnet molecule, improving the reward while collapsing the output diversity. We therefore introduce PGFS++, a synthesis-aware reinforcement learning framework for input-specific molecular improvement. Given an input molecule, PGFS++ treats it as the start of a forward-synthesis trajectory, applies learned reaction templates with compatible in-stock building blocks, and produces a molecule with improved target properties, an explicit synthesis route, and structural similarity to the input. Experiments on molecular improvement tasks show that PGFS++ improves target properties while preserving high output diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PGFS++，一个合成感知的强化学习框架，用于在分子性质改进任务中同时保持输出多样性和与输入分子的结构相似性。作者先指出 PGFS 的反应物嵌入预测使反应物选择间接、限制学习效果，并开发了使用可训练嵌入查找表的 PGFS+；随后发现 PGFS+ 出现奖励黑客（reward hacking）导致输出多样性崩溃，因此引入 PGFS++，将输入分子视为前向合成轨迹起点，生成性质改进、具有显式合成路线且与输入结构相似的分子。
Motivation: 无约束化学空间中优化的分子可能无法被合成，实用价值有限；PGFS 作为合成感知的强化学习方法，其反应物选择是间接的，并且强大的反应物搜索会引发奖励黑客失败模式，在提升奖励的同时使输出多样性崩溃。
Method: PGFS++ 将输入分子作为前向合成轨迹的起点，使用可训练嵌入查找表表示反应模板和第二反应物，并结合更有效的评分函数与强化学习算法，应用与库存构建块兼容的学习反应模板，生成目标性质改进、带有显式合成路线且与输入结构相似的分子。
Result: 实验表明，PGFS+ 能显著改善目标性质，但暴露出输出多样性崩溃的奖励黑客问题；PGFS++ 在分子改进任务上提升目标性质的同时保持高输出多样性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，合成感知且输入特定的分子改进可以同时提升目标性质并保持输出多样性，PGFS++ 是该思路下的强化学习框架。

papers.title: Discretizing Continuous Time Series for Imputation with Masked Diffusion Training
papers.abstract_en: Time series imputation is a crucial area for reliable time series analysis, yet it remains challenging due to the complex temporal dynamics and noise of real-world data. Existing approaches, however, exhibit two limitations: missing and observed values are embedded within the same representation space without explicit structural separation, and continuous diffusion-based methods are trained to predict added noise rather than the original signal. To address these, we propose the Masked Diffusion Time-series Imputation Model (MDTIM), which leverages the training paradigm of masked diffusion model for imputation tasks. The MASK token is structurally orthogonal to valid observations, and the model directly predicts the original values, naturally aligning both the representation and the learning objective with the imputation task. To bridge the gap between discrete masked diffusion and the continuous, ordinal nature of time series, we further introduce Stochastic Discretization, which maps continuous values to ordinal-aware tokens while preserving continuous dynamics. Our experiments on diverse benchmarks confirm that MDTIM achieves superior robustness and scalability, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art deterministic and generative baselines across various missing scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Masked Diffusion Time-series Imputation Model (MDTIM)，将掩码扩散模型 (masked diffusion model) 的训练范式用于时间序列插补。针对现有方法的两点不足，MDTIM 让 MASK token 与有效观测在表示空间上结构正交，并让模型直接预测原始值而非预测噪声；为弥合离散掩码扩散与连续时序的差距，引入 Stochastic Discretization 将连续值映射为具有序数感知的 token。实验表明该方法在多种缺失场景下优于现有确定性与生成式基线。
Motivation: 现有时间序列插补方法存在两个局限：缺失值与观测值被嵌入同一表示空间、缺乏显式结构区分；基于连续扩散的方法训练目标是预测添加的噪声而非原始信号，与插补任务不对齐。
Method: 提出 MDTIM，采用掩码扩散模型的训练范式：MASK token 在表示空间上与有效观测正交，模型直接预测原始观测值；并引入 Stochastic Discretization，将连续时间序列映射为保留序数关系 (ordinal-aware) 的离散 token，从而桥接离散 masked diffusion 与连续数据之间的差距。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验显示，MDTIM 在各类缺失场景下一致优于现有的最先进确定性与生成式基线，并展现出更好的鲁棒性与可扩展性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过结构正交的 MASK 表示和直接预测原始值的设计，可以使表示空间与学习目标都与插补任务自然对齐；Stochastic Discretization 则使离散扩散框架能够适用于连续的时序数据。

papers.title: Enhancing EBSD throughput of battery electrode materials using super-resolution generative adversarial networks
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative microstructural characterization of Li-ion battery electrode materials using electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) has been proven as a critical method for optimizing cell performance. However, the inherently slow nature of EBSD can hinder the throughput of analyses needed for statistical representation of a material microstructure being developed. This work demonstrates a machine learning super-resolution framework using a generative adversarial network (SRGAN) to significantly increase EBSD throughput. The SRGAN model was trained on EBSD data of LiNixMnyCozO2 (NMC) cathode particles to computationally enhance low-resolution datasets and its performance is compared against classical interpolation methods across various upscaling factors (2x to 12x). Both qualitative image metrics and quantitative microstructural analysis verified that the SRGAN systematically outperformed classical methods, particularly in preserving small grains and maintaining realistic grain boundaries. We demonstrate that a 5x upscaling factor, corresponding to a 25x speed-up in acquisition time or a 25x larger field of view, is practical while maintaining acceptable accuracy in key metrics like grain size and shape. For instance, at 5x upscaling, relative errors were +5.7%, +8.2%, and -14.6% on grain area-equivalent diameter, grain maximum sphere-inscribed diameter, and grain boundary length, respectively. The SRGAN methodology developed in this work significantly enhances the efficiency of EBSD acquisition for more statistically robust microstructural dataset, enabling EBSD as a high-throughput characterization tool for materials research and industrial process development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用生成对抗网络（SRGAN）对 Li-ion 电池正极材料 NMC 的电子背散射衍射（EBSD）低分辨率采集结果做超分辨率重建，以提升 EBSD 的吞吐效率。作者将 SRGAN 与经典插值方法在 2x 到 12x 的放大因子下对比，发现 SRGAN 在保持小晶粒和真实晶界方面更优，并验证 5x 放大（对应 25x 采集加速或 25x 视场扩大）可以在关键晶粒指标上保持可接受的精度。
Motivation: EBSD 是定量表征锂电池电极材料微观结构、优化电池性能的关键手段，但其采集速度慢，难以获得统计上足够代表性的微观结构数据集，阻碍了高通量分析。
Method: 采用基于生成对抗网络的超分辨率框架（SRGAN），在 LiNixMnyCozO2（NMC）正极颗粒的 EBSD 数据上训练模型，将低分辨率 EBSD 数据集计算增强为高分辨率数据，并与经典插值方法在 2x 至 12x 放大因子下进行性能比较。
Result: 在 5x 放大下，晶粒面积等效直径、晶粒最大内切球直径和晶界长度的相对误差分别为 +5.7%、+8.2% 和 -14.6%；SRGAN 在定性图像指标和定量微观结构分析上均系统性优于经典插值方法，尤其擅长保留小晶粒和真实晶界。
Conclusion: 该 SRGAN 方法能显著提升 EBSD 采集效率，支持获取统计上更稳健的微观结构数据，使 EBSD 成为材料研究与工业过程开发中的高通量表征工具。

papers.title: Pretraining Reusable Inference Across Views with Synthetic Task Priors
papers.abstract_en: Modern pretrained encoders make representations from heterogeneous views increasingly reusable, but the procedure that determines view utility and combines evidence is still relearned for each downstream task. Consequently, knowledge about view relevance, complementarity, reliability, and missingness is repeatedly discarded rather than transferred across tasks. We therefore reformulate multi-view learning as learning a reusable, task-conditioned inference procedure rather than a fixed fusion function. Based on this perspective, we propose SIMPLE, a prior-fitted multi-view in-context learner that predicts query labels by conditioning on a small labeled support set. Since existing real-world datasets cover only a limited range of view configurations and task structures, we construct a controllable synthetic task prior in embedding space. It generates diverse support-query episodes with varying class structures, shared and view-specific factors, representation geometries, cross-view dependencies, reliability levels, missingness patterns, and distribution shifts. A hierarchical inference architecture then performs reasoning within views, across views, and across support and query samples. Experiments on multi-view and multi-omics benchmarks demonstrate that the frozen variant of SIMPLE achieves competitive performance without updating the inference backbone, while lightweight adapter calibration attains leading performance on most evaluated datasets. Together, the results under frozen, one-shot, and missing-view settings support the central hypothesis that multi-view reasoning itself can be pretrained and reused, while lightweight adapter calibration provides task-specific alignment when needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把多视图学习 (multi-view learning) 重新定义为学习一种可复用、任务条件化的推理过程，而非固定的融合函数，并提出 SIMPLE，一种基于先验拟合的多视图上下文学习器 (in-context learner)，通过在少量标注支持集上做条件化来预测查询标签。由于真实数据集覆盖的视图配置和任务结构有限，作者在嵌入空间中构造可控的合成任务先验，生成支持-查询 episodes，并用层级推理结构在视图内、视图间以及支持与查询样本间进行推理。实验表明冻结版 SIMPLE 无需更新推理主干即可达到有竞争力的性能，轻量适配器校准 (adapter calibration) 在多数多视图和多组学基准上取得领先结果。
Motivation: 现代预训练编码器使异构视图的表征日益可复用，但决定视图效用并融合证据的过程仍然会针对每个下游任务重新学习，导致视图相关性、互补性、可靠性和缺失性 (missingness) 的知识被反复丢弃，而不是跨任务迁移。
Method: 提出 SIMPLE，即先验拟合的多视图上下文学习器；核心是构造嵌入空间中的可控合成任务先验，生成包含多样类别结构、共享/视图特有因子、表征几何、跨视图依赖、可靠性水平、缺失模式和分布偏移的 episodes，并采用层级推理架构分别在视图内、跨视图以及支持-查询样本间进行推理。
Result: 在多变和多组学基准上，冻结版 SIMPLE 不更新推理主干即取得有竞争力的性能；加入轻量适配器校准后在大多数评估数据集上达到领先性能。冻结、one-shot 和缺失视图设置下的结果共同支持多视图推理本身可以被预训练并复用的核心假设。
Conclusion: 作者认为多视图推理可以像表征一样被预训练和复用，轻量适配器校准可在需要时提供任务特定的对齐。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for consolidating domain-specialized reinforcement learning (RL) experts into a single generalist student via dense, token-level reward supervision. Despite its practical success, the optimization dynamics governing multi-teacher capability integration remain poorly understood, and open, rigorously reproducible recipes are conspicuously lacking. In this work, we establish a controlled M-OPD benchmark on SmolLM3-3B-Base with oracle routing, isolating capability integration from routing ambiguity. Our investigation reveals a pronounced capability integration gap: standard M-OPD captures only 35.6% of the available headroom relative to a domain-routed oracle ensemble, with concise tasks such as instruction following suffering severe degradation and premature stagnation. Crucially, we show that this failure stems not from gradient conflict, but from a severe misallocation of the token-level optimization budget. This pathology is driven by three orthogonal factors: structural sequence-length disparities across domains, dynamic convergence drift due to non-uniform learning rates, and multi-step reward staleness from asynchronous policy updates. To resolve these imbalances, we introduce Open-MOPD, a principled framework incorporating token-share balancing, gap-aware dynamic budget allocation, and student reward refresh. Together, these mechanisms systematically restore cross-domain balance, elevating headroom recovery from 35.6% to 83.4% in a single deployable student. We fully open-source our end-to-end post-training recipe, training trajectories, and evaluation suites on an academically accessible hardware budget.

Motivation: 现有 M-OPD 虽能把多个领域专家整合为单一通用学生模型，但其能力整合的优化动力学仍缺乏理解，也缺少开放、可复现的配方。标准 M-OPD 存在显著的能力整合缺口，指令跟随等简洁任务严重退化并过早停滞。

papers.title: Detecting Backdoors in Object Detection via Pre-NMS Prediction Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Object detection models deployed in safety-critical applications remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks that cause targeted misbehaviors when a hidden trigger is present. Existing detection methods either rely on trigger inversion or exploit architecture-specific assumptions, and critically, representative existing methods fail to generalize reliably to scene-level attacks, where a single trigger induces anomalous behavior across all objects in the scene simultaneously. We present DistScan, a backdoor detection framework based on a simple but previously unexploited observation: backdoor injection systematically shifts a model's pre-NMS prediction class distribution away from its training class frequencies, even on clean inputs without any trigger present. DistScan aggregates intermediate class predictions over a clean validation set and flags a model as backdoored if the resulting distribution deviates significantly from the training class frequencies, requiring no model weight access, no trigger knowledge, and no additional training. Extensive experiments on MS-COCO and PASCAL VOC across two architectures and three scene-level attack scenarios demonstrate that DistScan substantially outperforms existing methods, improving average detection accuracy over the best-performing applicable baseline by 27.32 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DistScan，一种基于预 NMS 预测类别分布偏移的目标检测后门检测框架。核心观察是后门注入会系统性改变模型在 NMS 之前的类别预测分布，即使输入是干净样本，该分布也会偏离训练类别频率。DistScan 仅在干净验证集上聚合中间类别预测即可判定模型是否被植入后门，无需模型权重访问、触发器知识或额外训练。
Motivation: 现有目标检测后门检测方法依赖触发器反演或架构特定假设，难以可靠泛化到场景级攻击——即单个触发器同时使场景中所有对象产生异常行为的攻击模式，这对安全关键部署构成威胁。
Method: 利用后门注入导致模型预 NMS 预测类别分布偏离训练类别频率这一观察，在干净验证集上聚合中间类别预测，并检测该分布是否显著偏离训练类别频率；方法不需要模型权重访问、触发器知识或额外训练。
Result: 在 MS-COCO 和 PASCAL VOC 上，跨越两种架构和三种场景级攻击场景的实验显示，DistScan 显著优于现有方法，平均检测准确率比最优适用基线提升 27.32 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要指出预 NMS 预测分布偏移可作为无需触发器反演和权重访问的后门检测信号，并强调 DistScan 在场景级攻击下的有效性与跨架构、跨数据集的泛化能力。

papers.title: DA-WAM: Decision-Aligned Future Latents for Driving World Models
papers.abstract_en: Anticipating how scenes evolve under ego actions is fundamental to safe autonomous driving, yet the full potential of world models for decision-making remains unrealized. The critical challenge lies in ensuring that future modeling is not merely predictive, but decision-informative: the predicted future must directly shape which trajectory is selected. Existing approaches decouple future representation learning from planning optimization, or share predicted states across trajectory candidates, thereby diluting the action-specific consequences that ought to guide selection. To bridge this gap, we propose DA-WAM, a framework that unifies predictive representation learning, action-conditioned future modeling, and trajectory scoring under a single decision-making objective. DA-WAM maintains predictive supervision throughout planner optimization via an online encoder and a stable momentum target, allowing future representations to co-evolve with the driving task. An action-conditioned predictor generates a distinct future latent state per trajectory candidate, which is then evaluated by a future-latent-conditioned factorized scorer. For the expert-matched trajectory, the predicted future latent is supervised by the observed future representation, while safety-critical hard negatives provide additional supervision near planning boundaries. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while ablations and diagnostic analyses validate the key components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DA-WAM，一个面向自动驾驶的决策对齐世界模型框架，将预测表示学习、动作条件未来建模与轨迹评分统一到单一决策目标下。框架通过在线编码器和稳定动量目标在规划优化中保持预测监督，每个轨迹候选获得独立的未来潜在状态，并由未来潜在条件因子化评分器评估。作者在 NAVSIM-v1 和 NAVSIM-v2 上报告了 SOTA 性能，并通过消融和诊断分析验证关键组件。
Motivation: 现有世界模型对未来建模的潜力未充分用于决策，预测结果未必对轨迹选择有直接信息量。已有方法要么将未来表示学习与规划优化解耦，要么在轨迹候选间共享预测状态，从而稀释了应当指导选择的任务相关后果。
Method: DA-WAM 统一预测表示学习、动作条件未来建模和轨迹评分；在线编码器配合稳定动量目标使未来表示与驾驶任务协同演化。动作条件预测器为每个轨迹候选生成不同的未来潜在状态，未来潜在条件因子化评分器评估这些状态；专家匹配轨迹用观测到的未来表示监督，并在规划边界附近引入安全关键难负样本。
Result: 在 NAVSIM-v1 与 NAVSIM-v2 上，DA-WAM 取得最先进性能；消融与诊断分析验证了关键组件的作用。
Conclusion: 作者强调让未来建模直接对齐决策目标、保留动作特定的未来后果，可以更好地支持安全驾驶中的轨迹选择。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Does Mapping Non-Maximal Probabilities to GMM Components Matter for S-JEPA Encoder Representations?
papers.abstract_en: S-JEPA uses soft Gaussian mixture model (GMM) posteriors instead of hard cluster labels to preserve uncertainty. It remains unclear whether the probability values alone are sufficient, or whether it also matters which GMM components receive the non-maximal probabilities. We test this with two matched controls. FIXED-RANDPERM keeps the top-1 component and probability together with the multiset of non-maximal probability values, but reassigns those non-maximal values using a mapping fixed for each physical frame. UNIFORM-TAIL keeps the top-1 component, its probability, and total non-maximal mass but distributes that mass uniformly. Across three independent seeds, REAL SOFT outperforms both controls on two frozen Encoder readouts. It provides better recovery of the original GMM tail and greater accessibility of spectral dynamics over short time scales after controlling for the complete spectrum of the current frame. In two exposure experiments, both readouts improved overall as more frames retained the original mapping. We also descriptively follow one Phase 2 trajectory after the switch to the online GMM. These results show that the numerical probability structure of the soft target does not fully determine the learned Encoder representation. The mapping of non-maximal probabilities to GMM components also matters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 S-JEPA 编码器在软高斯混合模型 (GMM) 后验下，非最大概率值被分配到哪些 GMM 分量是否影响学到的表示。作者设计了两个匹配对照：FIXED-RANDPERM 保留 top-1 分量与概率并将非最大概率按固定映射重排，UNIFORM-TAIL 则将非最大质量均匀分布。三个独立随机种子下，REAL SOFT 在两个冻结 Encoder 读头上优于两个对照，表明软目标的数值概率结构本身并不能完全决定学到的表示，非最大概率到 GMM 分量的映射也有影响。
Motivation: S-JEPA 使用软 GMM 后验而非硬聚类标签以保留不确定性，但尚不清楚仅依赖概率值是否足够，还是需要关注非最大概率具体落在哪些 GMM 分量上。
Method: 通过两个匹配对照实验检验问题：FIXED-RANDPERM 固定每个物理帧的映射来重排非最大概率值，UNIFORM-TAIL 保持 top-1 分量、其概率及非最大总质量但均匀分配该质量；并在两个暴露实验（exposure experiments）中让更多帧保留原始映射，另对切换到在线 GMM 后的 Phase 2 轨迹做描述性分析。
Result: 在三个独立种子上，REAL SOFT 在两个冻结 Encoder 读头上均优于两个对照，能更好地恢复原始 GMM 尾部，并在控制当前帧完整频谱后更好地访问短时间尺度的频谱动态；两个读头随保留原始映射的帧数增加而整体提升。
Conclusion: 结果表明软目标中非最大概率到 GMM 分量的映射确实影响 S-JEPA 学到的表示，概率数值结构本身不足以完全决定表示内容。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning Random Geometric Graphs Drawn in Probabilistic Metric Spaces
papers.abstract_en: We present a new data-driven learning of a Random Geometric Graph (RGG) of a multivariate dataset, where the graph is drawn in a probabilistic metric space. This graph learning works for generic datasets, irrespective of the type of the observables; their probability distributions; or size of the data. We identify a metric of the space that the graph is drawn in, as a probability distribution of a random variable that we introduce, namely, a variable that represents the disparity between the connectedness of two vertices of the graph, and the correlation between the two random variables that are attached to the respective vertex. It is the closed-form {\it{cdf}} of this disparity variable that we advance as the distance function of the host space of the learnt RGG, such that the edge exists between any two nodes, if this inter-nodal distance falls short of a chosen cutoff probability. Drawing the RGG in this probabilistic space leads to the graph being an Soft RGG, such that any edge - if it exists - exists with an identified probability. We forward a simple Rejection Sampling-based technique for learning the probability of any edge. The expected degree distribution of a vertex of this RGG is identified as local, and dependent on the inter-observable correlation matrix. If said correlation matrix is not known, it can be learnt given the data, using its closed-form posterior probability density function, that we forward. We illustrate our graph learning method by learning multiple RGGs of highly multivariate real datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的随机几何图 (Random Geometric Graph, RGG) 学习方法，在概率度量空间中为多元数据集构图。作者引入一个表示图顶点连通性与顶点所附随机变量之间相关性差异的随机变量，以其闭式累积分布函数 (cdf) 作为宿主空间的度量；图在此概率空间中构建为 Soft RGG，每条边存在时具有可辨识的概率。边概率通过拒绝采样 (Rejection Sampling) 学习，期望度分布被刻画为局部的且依赖于观测间相关矩阵。作者用高度多元的真实数据集演示了该方法。
Motivation: 现有 RGG 学习可能受限于观测类型、概率分布或数据规模；本文的目标是提出一种适用于通用数据集的图学习方法，不依赖这些条件，并显式刻画图所在空间的概率度量，以支持带概率的边存在性。
Method: 引入“差异变量”(disparity variable) 来度量两顶点连通性与顶点关联随机变量之间的相关性差异，用该变量的闭式 cdf 作为宿主空间的距离函数；若两节点间距离小于给定截止概率则连边，从而得到 Soft RGG。边概率用拒绝采样学习；当相关矩阵未知时，可利用其闭式后验概率密度函数从数据中学习。

papers.title: SPK: Eliciting Structured Prior Knowledge for Interpretable Out-of-Distribution Detection in Real-Time Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Object detectors often produce over-confident predictions for objects outside their training categories, leading to so-called out-of-distribution (OoD) hallucinations. Existing approaches for detecting or mitigating such hallucinations typically either construct scoring functions directly over learned object detector representations or modify the object detector itself to suppress hallucination emergence. However, the latent priors implicitly encoded in these representations remain largely unexplored and have not been explicitly decoded for OoD detection. To uncover and exploit these latent priors, we propose Structured Prior Knowledge (SPK), a hallucination-oriented framework that explicitly elicits OoD-relevant priors from pretrained object detectors. Specifically, SPK leverages in-distribution data and hallucination-inducing samples as diagnostic supervision to elicit part-level semantic concepts underlying object detector decision-making, rather than using them merely for rejection or object detector adaptation. The elicited semantic priors are further integrated with geometric and contextual priors to form a compact five-dimensional SPK representation for OoD detection. Extensive experiments across diverse object detector architectures and multiple OoD benchmarks demonstrate that SPK achieves state-of-the-art OoD detection. Our findings reveal that pretrained object detectors already encode substantially richer latent knowledge than is typically exploited for OoD detection. More importantly, this knowledge can be explicitly elicited and organized into a compact, structured, and interpretable knowledge space for prediction reliability analysis. This suggests a promising proactive route for improving object detector reliability by explicitly uncovering and leveraging latent priors. Code and data are available at: https://gricad-gitlab.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/dnn-safety/spk
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Structured Prior Knowledge (SPK) 框架，用于实时目标检测中的可解释分布外 (OoD) 检测。SPK 利用分布内数据和幻觉诱导样本作为诊断监督，显式地从预训练目标检测器中 eliciting 与 OoD 相关的潜在先验，并将语义、几何和上下文先验整合为紧凑的五维 SPK 表示。实验表明该方法在多种检测器架构和多个 OoD 基准上达到 state-of-the-art，并揭示预训练检测器中编码了比通常被利用的更丰富的潜在知识。
Motivation: 目标检测器会对训练类别之外的物体产生过自信预测，导致 OoD 幻觉；现有方法要么直接在检测器表示上构造评分函数，要么修改检测器以抑制幻觉，但表示中隐式编码的潜在先验尚未被显式解码用于 OoD 检测。
Method: SPK 是一个面向幻觉的框架，通过分布内数据与幻觉诱导样本作为诊断监督，显式 eliciting 目标检测器决策背后的部件级语义概念，而非仅用于拒绝或检测器适配；随后将这些语义先验与几何和上下文先验整合，构成紧凑的五维 SPK 表示用于 OoD 检测。
Result: 摘要报告在多种目标检测器架构和多个 OoD 基准上的大量实验表明，SPK 达到了 state-of-the-art 的 OoD 检测性能；并发现预训练检测器编码的潜在知识比通常用于 OoD 检测的更为丰富。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些潜在知识可以被显式 eliciting 并组织成紧凑、结构化、可解释的知识空间，用于预测可靠性分析，为通过显式挖掘潜在先验来提升目标检测器可靠性提供了一条主动路径；代码和数据已公开。

papers.title: Subgroup performance analysis of adaptation strategies for chest X-ray foundation models
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly adapted for downstream medical imaging tasks, yet the influence of the chosen adaptation strategy on subgroup fairness remains poorly understood. We investigate how three parameter-efficient adaptation techniques, including linear heads on the raw CLS token, an MLP, and an attention-pooling module over multi-layer patch features, affect both pathology classification performance and subgroup disparities when applied to the frozen Rad-DINO chest X-ray encoder. Using MIMIC-CXR, we evaluate eight pathologies across race, sex, and imaging-view subgroups on a prevalence-preserving, demographically balanced test set, and additionally probe how strongly each adapter encodes protected attributes. We find that attention pooling achieves the strongest overall discriminative performance and encodes attributes, particularly race, most strongly, but that improved overall performance does not consistently reduce subgroup disparities. Notably, stronger attribute encoding did not correspond to larger disparities: early network layers encoded race most weakly yet produced the largest subgroup performance gaps. Exploring different attention-pooling layer combinations further revealed no consistent relationship between the layers pooled, attribute encoding strength, and subgroup fairness. Our results indicate that richer, more expressive representations can improve accuracy while leaving fairness implications task-dependent and unpredictable, which must be assessed directly and per-task rather than inferred from encoding strength or overall performance alone.
papers.comment: Accepted at MICCAI Workshop on Fairness of AI in Medical Imaging (FAIMI) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不同参数高效适配策略（在冻结的 Rad-DINO 胸部 X 光编码器上使用线性头、MLP 和注意力池化模块）如何影响病理分类性能与亚组公平性。基于 MIMIC-CXR 数据集，在按人口统计学平衡且保持患病率分布的测试集上评估八种病理在种族、性别和影像视图亚组上的表现，并探测各适配器对受保护属性的编码强度。结果表明注意力池化整体判别性能最强且编码属性（尤其种族）最强，但更好的整体性能并不稳定地降低亚组差异；更强的属性编码也不对应更大的差异，早期网络层编码种族最弱却产生最大的亚组性能差距。
Motivation: 基础模型越来越多地被适配到下游医学影像任务，但所选的适配策略对亚组公平性的影响仍不清楚，作者希望弄清不同适配策略是否会改变病理分类性能和亚组差距。
Method: 在冻结的 Rad-DINO 胸部 X 光编码器上比较三种参数高效适配技术：基于原始 CLS token 的线性头、MLP、以及作用于多层 patch 特征的注意力池化模块；使用 MIMIC-CXR 按种族、性别和影像视图亚组评估八种病理，并额外探测每个适配器对受保护属性的编码强度。
Result: 注意力池化取得最强的整体判别性能，并最强烈地编码属性尤其是种族；但改进的整体性能并未一致地减少亚组差异，且更强的属性编码并不对应更大的差异，早期网络层编码种族最弱却产生最大亚组性能差距；不同注意力池化层组合下，池化层、属性编码强度与亚组公平性之间没有一致关系。
Conclusion: 更丰富、更具表达力的表征可以提高准确性，同时使公平性影响成为任务相关且难以预测的问题，必须直接且按任务进行评估，而不能仅从编码强度或整体性能推断。

papers.title: ReWEIGH the Evidence: Calibrating Token-Level Ordinal Visual Evidence to Mitigate Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate, generating content that the input image does not support. Preventing such content during decoding calls for a candidate-specific measure of how strongly the image supports the token under consideration. The model's visual-token states offer a natural source of this evidence because projecting each state through the output head reveals which vocabulary items that position favors. These position-wise readouts cannot be pooled directly because their probability magnitudes are not comparable across visual positions. Vocabulary ranks provide a scale-invariant basis for pooling, but tokens still differ systematically in their typical rank-based evidence. We propose ReWEIGH, a training-free decoding intervention that aggregates these ranks across visual positions and compares each candidate with a token-specific reference estimated from unlabeled images. At inference, ReWEIGH caches the image evidence during prefill and applies a bounded penalty only to candidates that fall below their reference. On four 7B backbones, ReWEIGH reduces hallucinated object mentions by up to 21.3% while largely preserving or improving descriptive and general performance. With evidence cached, the average added latency is 1.33% per token, and the reductions extend across six architecture families to 32B parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReWEIGH，一种无需训练的 decoding 干预方法，用于缓解大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）的幻觉。其核心是将视觉位置上的词汇表排名（vocabulary ranks）作为尺度不变的证据进行聚合，并与从无标注图像估计的 token 专属参考值比较，仅对低于参考值的候选 token 施加有界惩罚。在四个 7B 主干模型上，幻觉物体提及最多降低 21.3%，在缓存证据后每个 token 的平均额外延迟为 1.33%，并且在六种架构族上可扩展到 32B 参数。
Motivation: LVLM 经常生成输入图像不支持的内容，而解码时缺乏候选 token 级别的图像支持度量；视觉 token 状态的逐位置读出在概率幅度上不可直接比较，且不同 token 的典型排名证据存在系统性差异。
Method: ReWEIGH 是一种训练自由的解码干预：在 prefill 阶段缓存图像证据，将视觉位置上的词汇表排名聚合，基于无标注图像估计每个 token 的参考证据，并在解码时仅对低于参考值的候选施加有界惩罚。
Result: 在四个 7B 主干上，幻觉物体提及最多减少 21.3%，同时大体保持或改善描述性与通用性能；证据缓存后平均每个 token 增加 1.33% 延迟，且减少效果在六种架构族上持续到 32B 参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需训练、依赖 token 专属参考校准，并具有低延迟与跨架构的通用性，适用于缓解 LVLM 解码阶段的幻觉。

papers.title: Robust Risk Under Evolving Uncertainty: A Wasserstein Counterpart of the Entropic Value-at-Risk
papers.abstract_en: An agent still learning its environment should be cautious while ignorant and bold once confident. The entropic value-at-risk captures this through a robust-optimization identity---a confidence level fixes the radius of a relative-entropy ball of alternative models---but that ball cannot reach catastrophes the nominal deems impossible, precisely what a safe agent must hedge. We instead use an optimal-transport ball and study the coherent risk measure it induces, the Wasserstein entropic value-at-risk. It has a variational dual mirroring the entropic formula (an inverse temperature becomes a transport price), occupies a definite place in the risk hierarchy, and provably accounts for the reachable catastrophes the entropic measure ignores; we verify both dualities numerically. Driving the transport radius by belief entropy then yields a closed-form robust dynamic-programming operator whose caution contracts as the belief sharpens, with a certified safety sandwich and a sharp safety switch.
papers.comment: Best Paper Award at the 2nd Workshop on Safe AI at UAI (SafeAI@UAI 2026, non-archival), Amsterdam
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在环境不确定性下学习过程中的稳健风险度量，提出 Wasserstein 熵值风险 (Wasserstein entropic value-at-risk) 作为熵值风险 (entropic value-at-risk) 的替代。作者用最优传输球 (optimal-transport ball) 替换相对熵球，使风险度量能够覆盖名义模型认为不可能但实际可达的灾难场景，并给出变分对偶、风险层级位置以及由信念熵驱动的稳健动态规划算子。摘要报告数值验证了两种对偶性，并给出安全夹逼 (safety sandwich) 与安全开关 (safety switch) 的理论性质。
Motivation: 熵值风险通过相对熵球实现稳健优化，但该球无法覆盖名义模型视为不可能的灾难情形，而这正是安全智能体需要对冲的。论文旨在弥补这一缺陷。
Method: 使用最优传输球替代相对熵球，研究由此诱导的稳健风险度量 Wasserstein 熵值风险；建立其变分对偶（逆温度对应传输价格），并通过信念熵驱动传输半径，导出闭式稳健动态规划算子。
Result: 摘要称数值实验验证了两种对偶性；该风险度量在风险层级中有确定位置，并能证明地覆盖熵值度量忽略的可达灾难；由信念熵驱动的算子在信念变清晰时谨慎度收缩，同时具备认证的安全夹逼与安全开关性质。

papers.title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can now post-train an LLM end-to-end. They can write code, launch training, evaluate checkpoints, and improve downstream performance, raising the prospect of AI-for-AI. We argue that this picture conflates two distinct capabilities: execution-level capability, iterating within a selected training strategy; and strategy-level capability, revising the high-level judgment as experimental evidence accumulates. Analyzing a large corpus of publicly released post-training trajectories, we find that across different tasks, the agent's training strategy is locked in at the very beginning, and the entire remaining budget is spent on local adjustments within the selected strategy. We then examine three natural explanations--missing experience, missing guidance, and insufficient reasoning--with escalating interventions. Extensive experiments show that (1) an experience-driven scaffold improves execution across the board (+12.6 points on GSM8K and +40.8 on HumanEval) but leaves the strategy static; (2) human guidance effectively redirects the initial strategy, yet the agent falls back into local adjustment loops once training starts; and (3) additional inference compute pays off on easier tasks but yields almost no gain on the hardest one. In conclusion, what agents lack is neither experience, guidance, nor reasoning compute, but a mechanism for spontaneously reevaluating their strategy during execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能够端到端对 LLM 进行后训练 (post-training) 的智能体，指出这一能力可拆分为执行级能力（在选定训练策略内迭代）与策略级能力（随实验证据累积修正高层判断）。作者分析公开后训练轨迹语料，发现智能体的训练策略在一开始就被锁定，剩余预算全部用于所选策略内的局部调整；随后通过三种递增干预进行实验验证。
Motivation: 现有研究常把 AI-for-AI 的执行能力与策略能力混为一谈，忽略了智能体在训练过程中缺乏对高层策略的自发重估这一关键缺口。
Method: 先对大量公开的后训练轨迹进行实证分析，识别策略锁定的现象；再考察三种自然解释——缺失经验、缺失引导、推理不足——并设计递增干预实验，包括经验驱动的脚手架 (experience-driven scaffold)、人类引导，以及额外推理计算。
Result: 经验驱动的脚手架将执行能力全面提升（GSM8K 上 +12.6，HumanEval 上 +40.8），但策略保持静态；人类引导能有效重定向初始策略，但训练开始后智能体仍退回局部调整循环；额外推理计算在较易任务上有收益，在最难任务上几乎无提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为智能体欠缺的既不是经验、引导也不是推理算力，而是一种在执行过程中自发重新评估策略的机制。

papers.title: Function-On-Function Regression Through Separable Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the estimation of the regression operator in function-on-function regression models. While traditional research has predominantly focused on linear models or their immediate nonlinear extensions, we propose a neural operator approach to accommodate general regression operators under mild smoothness assumptions. Operator learning has emerged as an active area of machine learning, particularly for solving physical models governed by partial differential equations. Using this paradigm, our methodology introduces the separable neural operator, a neural-operator architecture that represents the regression operator through input-dependent coefficient functions and output-dependent basis functions. Beyond adapting this architecture to the regression operator estimation problem, we establish the consistency of the estimator under relatively mild smoothness and sampling conditions, allowing functional data to be observed on dense, possibly irregular, discrete grids. We also apply the proposed approach to the BGC Argo data and demonstrate its potential for oceanographic research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究函数对函数回归中的回归算子估计，提出可分离神经算子（separable neural operator）架构，用输入相关的系数函数和输出相关的基函数表示回归算子，并在温和光滑性与采样条件下证明了估计量的一致性，允许函数数据在密集且可能不规则的离散网格上观测。最后将该方法应用于BGC Argo海洋数据，展示其在海洋学研究中的潜力。
Motivation: 传统函数对函数回归研究主要集中于线性模型或其直接非线性扩展，难以覆盖一般回归算子；作者引入算子学习（operator learning）范式，目标是在较温和的假设下估计一般回归算子。
Method: 提出可分离神经算子，将回归算子表示为输入相关的系数函数与输出相关的基函数，并将该架构适配到回归算子估计问题，同时建立估计量的一致性理论。
Result: 在相对温和的光滑性和采样条件下建立了估计量的一致性，支持在密集、可能不规则的离散网格上观测的函数数据；在BGC Argo数据上的应用显示了对海洋学研究的潜在价值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可分离神经算子为函数型回归提供了一种灵活且理论上可靠的估计途径，并指出该方法有望拓展到海洋学等应用领域。

papers.title: Diffusion Models for High-Dimensional Clustered Data: Intrinsic-Dimension Adaptivity via Bayesian Classification
papers.abstract_en: The empirical success of diffusion models in generative modelling has motivated theoretical work, including quantitative error bounds and qualitative analyses that characterise the different phases of denoising. We bring these two areas together by studying the adaptivity of diffusion models to the structured geometry of multimodal high-dimensional data that consists of multiple clusters in $\mathbb{R}^D$, each with its own low-dimensional structure, and inter-cluster separation depending on $D$. We employ $K$-mixture Gaussian distributions as a canonical framework to capture this geometry and establish two theoretical results. First, we interpret denoising as a dynamical Bayesian classifier: the mixture score is a posterior-weighted average of cluster-wise scores, and we show that, with high probability, the posterior class probabilities concentrate on a single cluster once the signal-to-noise ratio reaches the scale $Θ(\log (KD)/D)$. Second, by separately analysing the denoising process in its mixing and cluster-commitment phases, we prove that the KL error bound depends linearly on the maximum intrinsic dimension of a cluster, up to a logarithmic factor, even when $K$ grows polynomially with $D$. This improves on ambient-dimensional bounds and extends existing low-dimensional adaptivity analyses to multimodal distributions with heterogeneous, approximately low-rank covariances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论角度研究扩散模型对高维多模态聚类数据的自适应性，以 K 个高斯混合分布为规范框架刻画每个簇具有低维结构、簇间分离度随 D 变化的数据几何。作者证明去噪过程可解释为动态贝叶斯分类器，并给出了与簇最大内在维数 (intrinsic dimension) 线性相关的 KL 误差界；该结果将已有的低维自适应性分析推广到具有异质、近似低秩协方差的多峰分布。
Motivation: 扩散模型的理论研究分为定量误差界和刻画去噪不同阶段的定性分析两条线，但缺乏对多模态高维数据中结构化几何（多个低维簇）适应性的统一理解。
Method: 采用 K-混合高斯分布作为规范框架，将混合分数 (mixture score) 视为簇分数 (cluster-wise scores) 的后验加权平均；分别分析去噪过程中的混合 (mixing) 阶段与簇承诺 (cluster-commitment) 阶段，进而证明 KL 误差界。
Result: 摘要给出两个理论结果：当信噪比达到 Θ(log(KD)/D) 量级时，后验类别概率以高概率集中到单一簇；KL 误差界线性依赖于簇的最大内在维数（至多相差对数因子），且允许 K 随 D 多项式增长。
Conclusion: 该分析改善了对环境维度 (ambient dimension) 的依赖，将低维自适应性结论扩展到具有异质、近似低秩协方差的多峰分布。

papers.title: GS-VLA: Plug-and-Play Viewpoint Canonicalization for Frozen VLA Policies via Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a lightweight, plug-and-play framework that improves robustness to viewpoint shifts in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies without policy retraining. To our knowledge, this is the first approach to directly leverage 3D Gaussian-based novel-view synthesis for observation-space adaptation in VLA policies. Current VLA performance relies on the implicit assumption that training and deployment camera configurations are identical. Our experiments show that even a small displacement of the camera mount can reduce the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark from about 90% to about 10% in the worst case. Prior approaches, such as large-scale fine-tuning or generative data augmentation, are computationally expensive and risk catastrophic forgetting. To address this, viewpoint shifts are reformulated as a localized novel-view synthesis problem. Under a Locality assumption, that camera perturbations remain within a small bounded region relative to the workspace, viewpoint normalization reduces to a scene- and policy-independent disocclusion task. Our work implements this idea with a 4M-parameter 3D-Gaussian canonicalizer prepended to a frozen VLA policy. Without modifying policy weights, GS-VLA improves performance across three orthogonal axes: (1) Policy architectures, (2) Unseen task suites, and (3) Perturbation scales. These results show that a lightweight visual module can recover a large fraction of the performance lost under viewpoint shift, without policy retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GS-VLA，一种即插即用的轻量级视角规范化框架，通过在冻结的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略前添加一个 4M 参数的 3D 高斯泼溅 (3D Gaussian Splatting) 规范化器，将视角偏移重定义为局部新视角合成问题。实验显示相机安装的小位移可使 LIBERO 基准成功率从约 90% 降至约 10%，而 GS-VLA 无需策略重训练即能恢复视角偏移造成的大部分性能损失。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略隐含假设训练与部署时的相机配置一致，视角偏移会严重降低性能；大规模微调或生成式数据增强计算成本高且存在灾难性遗忘风险。
Method: 提出在冻结的 VLA 策略前添加一个 4M 参数的 3D-Gaussian canonicalizer，将视角偏移视为局部新视角合成问题；在 Locality 假设（相机扰动被限制在工作空间附近的小有界区域）下，视角归一化可简化为与场景和策略无关的消遮挡 (disocclusion) 任务。
Result: 在不修改策略权重的情况下，GS-VLA 沿策略架构、未见任务套件和扰动规模三个正交方向提升性能，能够恢复视角偏移下丢失的大部分成功率。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，一个轻量级视觉模块可以在不重训练策略的前提下，大幅补偿视角偏移带来的性能下降。
Relevance: 0
