papers.title: When Two Tracers Disagree: An Investigation of Multimodal Fusion for Clinical PET/CT Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: PSMA and FDG PET/CT visualise complementary biological information in prostate cancer. Combining both tracers could capture heterogeneous tumour phenotypes that may be missed by either alone, yet there is no consensus on effective deep learning architectures for fusing these modalities. We evaluated multimodal image-fusion strategies for automatic whole-body PET/CT lesion segmentation to estimate total tumour burden. Using the public DEEP-PSMA Challenge dataset, we trained tracer-specific 3D nnU-Net baselines and compared (i) early fusion with a single encoder and one decoder (OEOD) or two decoders (OETD), and (ii) intermediate fusion via a dual-encoder cross-attention U-Net (DECA-UNet). Tracer-specific baselines performed strongly (PSMA Dice = 0.93; FDG = 0.81). Fusion yielded mixed results: OEOD produced a combined Dice of 0.90 (on an easier, non-tracer-specific task), whilst the tracer-specific fusion models reached PSMA/FDG = 0.69/0.64 (OETD) and 0.76/0.57 (DECA-UNet). Whilst fusion often provided reasonable PSMA segmentation, FDG performance degraded and no strategy consistently exceeded the single-tracer baselines. Under the evaluated setting, tracer-specific models remain the stronger baseline; clinically useful gains from multimodal fusion will likely require architectures that better preserve tracer specific representations. Our code is available at: https://github.com/JackJ3636/DEEP_PSMA_code

TL;DR: 本文针对前列腺癌 PSMA 与 FDG PET/CT 的多模态融合分割问题，在公开 DEEP-PSMA Challenge 数据集上比较了多种深度学习融合策略。作者训练了示踪剂特定的 3D nnU-Net 基线，并评估早期融合（OEOD、OETD）与基于双编码器交叉注意力的中间融合（DECA-UNet）。结果显示单示踪剂基线表现强劲（PSMA Dice 0.93，FDG 0.81），而融合策略结果不一，FDG 分割性能普遍下降，没有一种策略能一致超越单示踪剂基线。
Motivation: PSMA 和 FDG PET/CT 在前列腺癌中提供互补的生物学信息，融合两种示踪剂可能捕捉单一示踪剂遗漏的异质性肿瘤表型，但目前缺乏有效的深度学习融合架构共识。
Method: 使用 DEEP-PSMA Challenge 数据集，训练示踪剂特定的 3D nnU-Net 基线，并比较 (i) 早期融合：单编码器单解码器（OEOD）与单编码器双解码器（OETD），以及 (ii) 中间融合：双编码器交叉注意力 U-Net（DECA-UNet），用于全身 PET/CT 病灶分割以估计总肿瘤负荷。
Result: 单示踪剂基线 Dice 为 PSMA 0.93、FDG 0.81；融合模型方面，OEOD 在较易的非示踪剂特定任务上取得组合 Dice 0.90，OETD 达到 PSMA/FDG 0.69/0.64，DECA-UNet 达到 0.76/0.57。融合虽常能提供合理的 PSMA 分割，但 FDG 性能下降，且没有任何策略持续超过单示踪剂基线。
Conclusion: 在该评估设置下，示踪剂特定模型仍是更强的基线；要获得临床上可用的多模态融合收益，可能需要在架构上更好地保留示踪剂特定的表示。

papers.title: LT-Mem: Volatility-Aware Spatio-Temporal Memory for Lifelong Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-term robot operation in evolving environments requires object-level understanding that persists across repeated revisits. Existing systems either overwrite history to maintain an up-to-date map or store semantic snapshots without consistent cross-session object identity, resulting in temporal amnesia: the systematic loss of object history that prevents answering queries such as "Where has the green chair been across all sessions?" We propose LT-Mem, a volatility-aware memory evolution framework that unifies spatially aligned instance-level 3D perception with volatility-conditioned temporal reasoning. First, a multi-session SLAM backbone provides spatially aligned per-object observations across sessions. Second, a reasoning layer governs how object memory evolves: deterministic evidence scoring preserves cross-session identity, and a volatility-aware policy selects among overwrite, hold, and multi-hypothesis actions based on each object's dynamics. Third, the resulting Tri-Memory structure (Live, Delta, Meta) preserves both current states and event histories, enabling longitudinal object-centric reasoning. We further introduce LT-VQA, a dataset and evaluation suite comprising multi-session recordings, persistent identity annotations, and temporal QA pairs. Experiments show that LT-Mem consistently outperforms baselines across all metrics while consuming an order of magnitude fewer tokens, and ablations confirm that gains are driven by the structured memory architecture rather than LLM capacity.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长期机器人运行中跨会话对象历史丢失的问题，提出 LT-Mem，一个 volatility-aware 的记忆演化框架，统一空间对齐的实例级 3D 感知与波动条件的时间推理。系统包含多会话 SLAM 骨干、确定性证据评分与波动感知策略，以及由 Live、Delta、Meta 组成的 Tri-Memory 结构。作者还提出 LT-VQA 数据集与评测套件，实验显示 LT-Mem 在所有指标上优于基线，并显著减少 token 消耗。
Motivation: 现有系统要么覆盖历史以保持地图最新，要么存储语义快照但缺乏跨会话一致的对象身份，导致 temporal amnesia，即对象历史的系统性丢失，无法回答诸如“绿色椅子在历次会话中出现在哪里”这类查询。
Method: 提出三层架构：多会话 SLAM 骨干提供空间对齐的逐对象观测；推理层通过确定性证据评分保持跨会话身份，并用波动感知策略在 overwrite、hold 与 multi-hypothesis 动作间选择；Tri-Memory（Live, Delta, Meta）同时保存当前状态与事件历史，支持纵向对象中心推理。
Result: 在 LT-VQA 数据集上的实验表明，LT-Mem 在所有指标上持续优于基线，同时消耗约一个数量级更少的 token；消融实验确认收益来自结构化记忆架构而非 LLM 容量。
Conclusion: 作者强调波动感知的记忆演化与 Tri-Memory 结构是长期场景理解中时间推理的关键，并指出该工作被 IROS 2026 接收。

papers.title: Generalized Audio-Driven Synthesis of Precise Drummer Motion
papers.abstract_en: Music-driven character animation enables and enhances transformative applications in entertainment and interactive education. However, synthesizing realistic drumming motion from audio remains challenging due to the inherent tension between high-acceleration dynamics and the need for extreme spatial-temporal precision. Existing approaches, often reliant on motion matching or MIDI input, struggle with generalizing to diverse real-world audio. Moreover, the field lacks standardized evaluation metrics capable of distinguishing precise drumming from noisy motion. In this paper, we introduce a generative diffusion framework featuring a dual-objective loss function that decouples skeletal integrity from drumstick precision, thus enabling centimeter-level stick precision without sacrificing natural body dynamics. Additionally, leveraging our own dataset and data augmentation strategy, the model generalizes to non-curated, in-the-wild audio. To rigorously evaluate performance, we propose two novel metrics: an impact-to-target distance to quantify spatial precision and an audio-motion correlation score to assess temporal alignment. Our quantitative analysis and user studies demonstrate that our system generates high-quality motion that is often indistinguishable from ground-truth performances.
papers.comment: Best Paper Award at the 25th ACM SIGGRAPH / Eurographics Symposium on Computer Animation (SCA 2026). For Supplementary Video, see https://studios.disneyresearch.com/2026/08/18/generalized-audio-driven-synthesis-of-precise-drummer-motion/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于扩散模型 (diffusion) 的音频驱动架子鼓演奏动作生成框架，针对高加速度动态与厘米级时空精度之间的冲突，设计双目标损失将骨骼完整性与鼓棒精度解耦。作者还引入专用数据集与数据增强策略使模型泛化到非 curated 的真实世界音频，并提出了两个新评估指标：impact-to-target distance 与 audio-motion correlation score。定量分析与用户研究显示生成的运动常与真实表演难以区分；该工作在 SCA 2026 获得最佳论文奖。
Motivation: 现有基于动作匹配 (motion matching) 或 MIDI 输入的方法难以泛化到多样化的真实音频，且该领域缺乏能区分精确击鼓与噪声运动的标准评估指标。
Method: 提出生成式扩散框架，使用双目标损失函数解耦骨骼完整性与鼓棒精度，从而实现厘米级鼓棒精度而不牺牲自然身体动力学；结合自有数据集与数据增强策略，使模型能处理非 curated 的真实世界音频，并引入 impact-to-target distance 和 audio-motion correlation score 两个新指标。
Result: 定量分析和用户研究表明，系统生成的运动质量高，且常常与真实表演难以区分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能生成精确且自然的鼓手动作，并通过新提出的评估指标来严格评价空间精度与时间对齐。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Off-Policy Deep Reinforcement Learning for Smart Campus Coverage
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has recently gained a great attention due to its real-time adaptation and effectiveness in complex optimization problems. This paper investigates the optimal deployment of millimeter-wave (mmWave) base stations (BSs) in a realistic, non-convex campus topology. The optimization problem is NP-hard, due to the non-convex, non-smooth nature of the max-min fairness objective. To overcome these constraints, we formulate the BS placement as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and systematically benchmark four DRL schemes: a discrete single-agent Deep Q-Network (DQN), a spatially partitioned Multi-Agent DQN, a continuous single-agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG), and a geographically partitioned multi-agent DDPG framework. Numerical evaluations reveal that the multi-agent DDPG approach substantially outperforms single-agent in dense scenarios. Additionally full coverage is achieved, and a fairness Jain's index of 0.94 is obtained. Finally, the multi-agent demonstrates highly efficient computational convergence of dense scenarios with $400$ users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在现实非凸校园拓扑中利用深度强化学习 (DRL) 优化毫米波 (mmWave) 基站部署。作者将基站布置建模为马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP)，系统比较了离散单智能体 DQN、空间划分多智能体 DQN、连续单智能体 DDPG 和地理划分多智能体 DDPG 四种方案。数值评估表明，在密集场景（400 个用户）下多智能体 DDPG 显著优于单智能体，实现全覆盖，公平性 Jain 指数达到 0.94，且计算收敛高效。
Motivation: mmWave 基站在现实非凸校园拓扑中的最优部署是一个 NP-hard 问题，原因是 max-min 公平性目标函数非凸、非光滑；同时需要具备实时自适应能力的优化方法。
Method: 将基站放置问题表述为 MDP，并系统基准测试四种 DRL 方案：离散单智能体 Deep Q-Network (DQN)、空间分区多智能体 DQN、连续单智能体 Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) 以及地理分区多智能体 DDPG 框架。
Result: 数值评估显示，多智能体 DDPG 在密集场景中显著优于单智能体方案；实现了全部覆盖，并取得 0.94 的公平性 Jain 指数；在包含 400 个用户的密集场景中，多智能体方法表现出很高的计算收敛效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多智能体 DDPG 框架在密集场景下相较单智能体的性能优势和高效收敛，为校园场景下的 mmWave 基站部署提供了一种基于 DRL 的可行求解途径。

papers.title: Eureka: Task-Conditioned Meta-Agent Orchestration for Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: We present Eureka, a task-conditioned Meta-Agent architecture that compiles long-horizon tasks into dynamic obligation graphs with explicit acceptance semantics. During execution, Eureka forms Macro-Agents with specialized state, memory, operators, tools, verifiers, and local topology via receding-horizon planning, architecture promotion, and minimal-sufficient compilation. When bottlenecks recur, cost-benefit-gated evolution updates the local architecture under constraints. Theoretically, we establish results on regret, planning invalidation, amortization, subtree interfaces, serializability, and verification. Experimentally, Eureka completes 170/170 recursive tasks and generates 3,948 certificates with no false acceptances. Active context compresses median input from 9,490 to 4,005 tokens; incremental processing avoids 65.38% recomputation across 12,000 tasks; 16,000 concurrent executions serialize consistently. The same Meta-Agent instantiates a Theory-Discovery Agent and a Math/Conjecture Agent. The former yields structural results in quantum-process and spacetime theory. The latter identifies bottlenecks in Riemann Hypothesis research and advances a positivity certificate for Suzuki's localized Weil quadratic form to 0 < a <= 69/200 = 0.345, reaching ~99.55% of (log 2)/2. These results suggest that scientific-agent capability depends not only on the base model but on whether an architecture can be formed to match the task's cognitive structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Eureka，一种任务条件化的 Meta-Agent 架构，将长时程任务编译为带显式接受语义的动态义务图（obligation graphs）。执行时通过递减时域规划（receding-horizon planning）、架构提升和最小充分编译形成具有专门状态、记忆、算子、工具、验证器与局部拓扑的 Macro-Agents；瓶颈复现时，在成本-收益门控下更新局部架构。理论部分给出关于遗憾、规划失效、摊销、子树接口、可串行化和验证的结果；实验中完成 170/170 个递归任务并生成 3,948 份无假接受证书，活动上下文将中位输入从 9,490 tokens 压缩至 4,005 tokens，增量处理在 12,000 个任务上避免 65.38% 的重计算，16,000 个并发执行保持一致串行化。同一 Meta-Agent 还实例化了理论发现智能体与数学/猜想智能体，后者将 Suzuki 局部 Weil 二次型的正性证书推进到 0 < a <= 69/200 = 0.345，达到 (log 2)/2 的约 99.55%。
Motivation: 该论文针对科学发现中长时程、需要持续架构调整的复杂任务，指出智能体能力不仅取决于基础模型，还取决于是否能形成与任务认知结构匹配的架构。
Method: 提出任务条件化的 Meta-Agent 编排架构：将任务编译为动态义务图，通过递减时域规划、架构提升和最小充分编译形成 Macro-Agents，并以成本-收益门控的演化机制在约束下更新局部架构。
Result: 摘要报告 Eureka 在递归任务和证书生成上实现零假接受；上下文压缩近半，重计算减少 65.38%，大规模并发执行保持串行一致；在量子过程与时空理论中获得结构性结果，并在 Riemann 猜想相关瓶颈分析及 Suzuki 局部 Weil 二次型正性证书上取得定量进展。
Conclusion: 作者认为科学智能体的实际能力依赖于能否形成匹配任务认知结构的架构，而不仅是基础模型本身；该结论来自理论分析与跨任务实验的共同支撑。

papers.title: Bernstein-Vazirani Networks: Quantum Machine Learning by Interference
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Bernstein-Vazirani Networks (BVNs), a non-variational quantum machine learning framework that leverages quantum interference for supervised learning, demonstrated on vision and representation learning tasks. In their standard form, BVNs follow the principle of quantum Fourier sampling: labelled data are placed in superposition and interfered in the Fourier basis to extract globally informative features. We then define generalised BVNs that enable interference in problem-adapted bases, yielding more expressive models under the same measurement budget as in the standard setting. BVNs achieve universal function approximation through (over)complete interference bases, while training of BVNs is gradient-free. Experiments on synthetic and real-world classification tasks, as well as implicit image representation, show strong generalisation capabilities and competitive performance with classical and quantum baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bernstein-Vazirani Networks (BVNs)，一种非变分 (non-variational) 的量子机器学习框架，通过量子干涉进行监督学习，并在视觉与表征学习任务上验证。标准形式遵循量子傅里叶采样：将有标签数据置于叠加态，在傅里叶基下干涉以提取全局信息；广义 BVNs 允许在问题自适应基下干涉，在相同测量预算下获得更强表达力。
Motivation: 现有量子机器学习多依赖变分线路与梯度优化，作者希望探索一种直接利用量子干涉、无需梯度的学习范式，并提升在固定测量预算下的模型表达能力。
Method: 提出 BVNs 框架：标准型基于量子傅里叶采样，将标签数据叠加并在傅里叶基中干涉；广义型允许在问题自适应基中干涉，通过 (over)complete 干涉基实现通用函数逼近，且训练过程为无梯度 (gradient-free)。
Result: 在合成与真实分类任务以及隐式图像表示 (implicit image representation) 上的实验表明，BVNs 具有较强的泛化能力，并与经典和量子基线性能相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为 BVNs 提供了一种无梯度、非变分的量子监督学习途径，具备通用逼近能力，并在视觉与表征学习任务上展现出竞争力；摘要未提及具体局限。

papers.title: USR-Drive: Unified Driving Scene Representation via Joint Denoising of 3D Gaussians and Boxes
papers.abstract_en: Spatial representation learning for autonomous driving aims to map raw visual signals into structured 3D scene representations, where object-centric bounding boxes and rendering-oriented 3D primitives (\eg, 3D Gaussians) serve as two distinct yet highly complementary levels for scene understanding. Existing methods typically treat dynamic reconstruction and instance-level perception as separate tasks, despite their shared goal of estimating the underlying 3D world state. As a result, dynamic reconstruction is under-constrained while 3D detection lacks geometric grounding. To address this gap, we propose USR-Drive, a unified conditional generative framework that, given only posed multi-view driving videos, jointly recovers dense dynamic geometry and instance-level object layouts within a shared scene representation. Specifically, USR-Drive represents dense Gaussian primitives and sparse 3D bounding boxes as two aligned latent token streams and jointly denoises them with a unified multi-modal diffusion Transformer. Unlike prior paradigms that use boxes as external conditions or predict them with detached modules, USR-Drive treats them as mutually constrained state variables with a Unified Positional Encoding (UPE) that aligns heterogeneous tokens within a shared metric spatiotemporal coordinate. Via such unified representation and generative framework, the two modalities reinforce each other: geometry supplies dense metric evidence for box prediction, while boxes provide instance-level structural priors that help preserve spatial consistency and reduce ambiguity in sequential 3D geometric representation. Our approach successfully delivers state-of-the-art results for both dynamic reconstruction and 3D detection on the nuScenes and VKitti datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 USR-Drive，一个统一的条件生成框架，仅凭带位姿的多视角驾驶视频，在共享场景表示中联合恢复稠密动态几何与实例级物体布局。方法将稠密 3D 高斯原语（3D Gaussians）与稀疏 3D 边界框建模为两条对齐的潜在 token 流，并用统一的多模态扩散 Transformer 联合去噪。摘要报告该方法在 nuScenes 和 VKitti 数据集上同时取得动态重建与 3D 检测的 state-of-the-art 结果。
Motivation: 现有方法通常把动态重建与实例级感知当作分离任务处理，尽管二者都在估计底层 3D 世界状态；这导致动态重建约束不足，3D 检测也缺乏几何支撑。作者希望用统一表示让两类信息互为约束，而不是各做各的。
Method: 将稠密高斯原语与稀疏 3D 边界框表示为两条对齐的 latent token 流，由一个统一的多模态扩散 Transformer 联合去噪；通过 Unified Positional Encoding (UPE) 把异质 token 对齐到共享的度量时空坐标系，使边界框作为相互约束的状态变量参与生成，而非外部条件或分离模块。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 nuScenes 和 VKitti 数据集上同时刷新动态重建与 3D 检测的 state-of-the-art 结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调两种模态相互增强：几何为边界框预测提供稠密度量证据，边界框为几何提供实例级结构先验，有助于保持空间一致性并降低序列 3D 几何表示的歧义。

papers.title: Counterfactual Contrastive Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Visual Counterfactual Explanations (VCEs) aim to explain image classifiers by generating minimally edited and realistic versions of an input image that change the classifier's prediction. Existing VCE methods are inherently classifier-dependent and therefore susceptible to classifier biases and failure modes, such as sensitivity to shortcut features and calibration errors. In this paper, we propose a classifier-free approach for visual counterfactual generation based on Contrastive Analysis (CA). Given two datasets corresponding to different classes (e.g., healthy and patients), we disentangle the generative factors that are common across the two datasets from those that are salient to each dataset, and generate counterfactual images by swapping only the salient factors. By operating directly on data distributions rather than decision boundaries, our method provides model-agnostic VCEs that are less sensitive to classifier biases. Our approach leverages the high-quality synthesis and well-structured latent space of StyleGAN2. We use the feature space F, instead than the usual W-space, to improve detail preservation. Unlike conventional CA approaches, which typically assume salient factors in only one dataset, we introduce an adapted framework and loss functions for VCE that allow multiple salient factors in each dataset. We evaluate our method on three medical imaging datasets and demonstrate superior counterfactual generation quality compared to existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无分类器（classifier-free）的视觉反事实解释（Visual Counterfactual Explanations, VCE）生成方法，基于对比分析（Contrastive Analysis）直接在数据分布上操作，而非决策边界。方法使用 StyleGAN2 的特征空间 F 以改进细节保留，并允许多个显著因子（salient factors）出现在每个数据集中。作者在三个医学影像数据集上评估，声称生成质量优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 VCE 方法依赖于分类器，因而容易受到分类器偏差和失败模式的影响，例如对捷径特征（shortcut features）的敏感性和校准误差。
Method: 给定两类数据集（如健康与患者），解耦两个数据集之间的公共生成因子与各自显著的生成因子，并通过仅交换显著因子来生成反事实图像。方法基于 StyleGAN2，使用特征空间 F 而非通常的 W-space，并针对 VCE 调整了对比分析框架与损失函数，支持每个数据集存在多个显著因子。
Result: 摘要报告在三个医学影像数据集上的评估显示，该方法相比现有方法具有更优的反事实生成质量。
Conclusion: 由于直接在数据分布而非分类器边界上操作，该方法提供模型无关（model-agnostic）的 VCE，对分类器偏差较不敏感。

papers.title: Adaptive Memory and Reflection Multi-Agent System for Medical Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and responsible medical question answering (QA) is important in healthcare, where complex cases require factual knowledge and nuanced reasoning. Existing medical QA systems, typically based on single-agent architectures and static retrieval, often lack adaptability, persistent memory, and structured decision-making. This work introduces an adaptive memory and reflection (AMR) agentic system, a multi-agent framework in which specialized agents use dedicated memory and reflection-based feedback to retrieve relevant prior cases and improve subsequent reasoning. Complexity assessment routes questions through solo, collaborative, or escalated workflows, while consensus and ethical overseer modules support reasoning consolidation and output review. Evaluation on MedQA and MedMCQA demonstrates strong performance compared with several baselines. Ablation studies show that combining agent-specific memory, reflection, and external retrieval yields the strongest performance. These findings highlight the potential of structured memory and feedback for developing more trustworthy medical agents. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/mm-air/AMR-Agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应记忆与反思 (adaptive memory and reflection, AMR) 多智能体系统，用于医学问答。系统由多个专用智能体组成，每个智能体配备独立记忆与反思反馈机制，用于检索相关历史病例并改进后续推理；复杂度评估会将问题路由到单独、协作或升级式工作流，并配有共识与伦理监督模块。在 MedQA 和 MedMCQA 上的评估显示其性能优于若干基线，消融实验表明智能体专属记忆、反思与外部检索的组合效果最强。
Motivation: 现有医学问答系统多基于单智能体架构和静态检索，缺乏适应性、持久记忆和结构化决策，难以应对需要事实知识与细致推理的复杂病例。
Method: 提出 AMR 多智能体框架：专用智能体使用专属记忆和反思反馈检索相关历史病例并改进推理；复杂度评估决定采用单独、协作或升级工作流，共识模块和伦理监督模块分别负责推理整合与输出审查。
Result: 在 MedQA 和 MedMCQA 上的评估显示相比多种基线表现较强；消融研究表明智能体专属记忆、反思与外部检索结合时性能最佳。
Conclusion: 作者认为结构化记忆与反馈机制有助于构建更可信的医学智能体，并公开了源代码。

papers.title: Self-prompting and cross-model consensus enable reproducible data extraction from scientific literature with large language models
papers.abstract_en: Accurately extracting nuanced, contextualized data from research articles is laborious and time intensive. Here, we investigate the performance of frontier, browser-based large language models (LLMs) to extract highly contextualized information. We demonstrate four escalating workflows, 1) given an expert curated prompt and research articles, most frontier LLMs perform well at data extraction, however can struggle with interpreting scientific context and nuance, 2) given simple instructions, LLMs can author their own prompts which were almost as eNective as expert-written prompts, 3) autonomous discovery of research literature was diNicult, agents either missed or hallucinated references, and 4) LLMs can create new datasets from published guidelines that closely match human-expert judges, but still require a human-in-the-loop. Together, these findings define an auditable division of labour in which experts specify the evidence standard, models cross-check repeated extractions and researchers resolve disputed cases, providing a practical route to scaling scientific data curation without relinquishing expert oversight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于浏览器的前沿大语言模型（LLM）从科研文献中提取高度情境化数据的性能，并设计了四种递进式工作流：专家编写提示词、LLM 自写提示词、自主文献发现、以及从已发表指南生成新数据集。摘要显示大多数前沿 LLM 在专家提示下提取效果良好，但处理科学语境与细节时仍有困难；LLM 自写提示词几乎与专家提示词相当；自主发现文献容易遗漏或虚构引用；生成的数据集与人类专家判断接近但仍需人在回路。作者据此提出一种可审计的分工模式，以在保留专家监督的前提下规模化科学数据策展。
Motivation: 从研究文章中准确提取细微且情境化的数据既费时又费力，现有方法难以兼顾可重复性与专家监督，本文针对这一数据策展瓶颈展开研究。
Method: 作者考察了前沿、基于浏览器的 LLM，并设计了四种递进式工作流：1) 使用专家策展的提示词与论文进行提取；2) 仅给简单指令让 LLM 自行编写提示词；3) 让智能体自主发现相关文献；4) 让 LLM 依据已发表指南生成新数据集。
Result: 摘要报告：多数前沿 LLM 在专家提示下提取表现良好但在科学语境理解上存在不足；LLM 自写提示词的提取效果几乎与专家编写提示词相当；自主文献发现困难，智能体会遗漏或幻觉化参考文献；LLM 依据指南生成的数据集与人类专家判断高度接近，但仍需人在回路介入。

papers.title: Scalable Amortized Variational Inference for Non-Poisson Buy-'Til-You-Die Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the wide variety of existing Buy-`Til-You-Die (BTYD) models, nearly all rely upon the convenient assumption of transactions following a Poisson process. As modern customer bases grow larger and more diverse, a major gap in the marketing literature is BTYD models that can account for heterogeneity in timing patterns across millions of customers. This paper addresses that gap, introducing a family of models that assume transactions follow a Weibull renewal process and developing a highly scalable scheme for parameter estimation based on an amortized variational inference procedure. The proposed model fits to a proprietary dataset of 5 million online retail customers in 8 minutes which would take the current state-of-the-art an estimated 3-4 days. We show both theoretically and empirically that this dramatic improvement in computational performance comes with no appreciable change to either model interpretation or predictive performance. Beyond scalability, gradient-based variational inference also makes it easy to extend the model to covariates, which we illustrate on a public dataset of 4 million political donors during the 2020 US General election cycle. More generally, this paper demonstrates how to blend recent advances in approximate Bayesian inference and the tools of modern machine learning to dramatically improve the efficiency and expressivity of probabilistic models for customer base analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对客户基数分析中 Buy-'Til-You-Die (BTYD) 模型几乎都假设交易服从 Poisson 过程的问题，提出一类以 Weibull 更新过程 (Weibull renewal process) 刻画交易间隔的模型，并设计了基于摊销变分推断 (amortized variational inference) 的高度可扩展参数估计方案。该模型在 500 万在线零售客户的专有数据上 8 分钟完成拟合，而当前最先进方法估计需要 3-4 天；作者从理论和经验上表明计算性能的大幅提升不会显著改变模型解释或预测性能。
Motivation: 现有 BTYD 模型几乎都依赖交易服从 Poisson 过程的便捷假设，难以适应现代大规模且多样化的客户群体，营销文献中缺少能刻画数百万客户间时序模式异质性的 BTYD 模型。
Method: 提出一族假设交易服从 Weibull 更新过程的 BTYD 模型，并开发基于摊销变分推断的可扩展参数估计方案；由于使用基于梯度的变分推断，模型易于扩展到包含协变量的情形。
Result: 在 500 万在线零售客户的专有数据集上，该模型 8 分钟完成拟合，而当前最先进方法预计需要 3-4 天；理论和经验结果均表明这一计算性能提升不会带来模型解释或预测性能的明显变化。作者还在 2020 年美国大选周期的 400 万政治捐赠者公开数据集上展示了协变量扩展。
Conclusion: 作者总结该方法展示了如何将近似贝叶斯推断的最新进展与现代机器学习工具结合，以大幅提升客户基数分析概率模型的效率与表达能力。

papers.title: Orthogonal Polynomial Approximation for Matrix Log Normalization in Global Covariance Pooling
papers.abstract_en: Global Covariance Pooling (GCP) improves deep networks by capturing second-order feature statistics, and is especially effective for fine-grained recognition. Because covariance matrices live on the Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) manifold, a normalization step is required before the Euclidean classifier. The faithful choice is the matrix logarithm (MLN-COV), which maps the SPD manifold to its tangent space; in practice it was abandoned in favour of the matrix square root because its eigendecomposition-based gradient is numerically unstable. We show that this instability is an artifact of computing the logarithm spectrally, not of the logarithm itself. Approximating the logarithm with finite polynomials in the covariance matrix removes the eigendecomposition from both passes: every operation becomes a General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM), the gradient stays bounded on the spectral support of the pre-normalized covariance, and the unstable 1/(lambda_i-lambda_j) term never appears. The key ingredient is a mean-eigenvalue pre-normalization that centres the spectrum near 1, away from the singularity of log, with a scalar post-compensation that returns the singular part of log(A) in closed form. Our recommended normalizer is a degree-8 Chebyshev expansion evaluated by a three-term matrix recurrence, with a matching reverse recurrence for the backward pass; Legendre, Laguerre, Taylor and Pade expansions are studied as controls that isolate the roles of the basis and of the target function. On three fine-grained benchmarks and ImageNet-1k the decomposition-free logarithm is both faster and more accurate than the spectral logarithm and than the square-root approximations it replaces, and at matched basis and degree the log target beats the square-root target, confirming that the gain comes from the faithful Riemannian map rather than from a better polynomial family.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全局协方差池化 (Global Covariance Pooling, GCP) 中的矩阵对数归一化问题，指出 MLN-COV 早前被弃用是因为谱分解计算的梯度不稳定，而非对数本身有问题。作者提出用有限多项式（推荐 8 阶 Chebyshev 展开，配合三项矩阵递推和反向递推）近似矩阵对数，完全移除两个方向的特征分解，使所有运算变为通用矩阵乘法 (GEMM)，梯度在谱支撑上有界且不出现 1/(lambda_i-lambda_j) 项。在三个细粒度基准和 ImageNet-1k 上，免分解对数比谱对数及平方根近似更快且更准。
Motivation: 协方差矩阵位于对称正定 (SPD) 流形上，送入欧氏分类器前需归一化；矩阵对数 (MLN-COV) 是忠实选择，但因基于特征分解的梯度数值不稳定而在实践中被平方根近似取代。作者的目标是证明该不稳定性来源于谱计算方式，并给出稳定的免分解替代方案。
Method: 利用协方差矩阵的有限多项式来近似矩阵对数，核心是均值特征值预归一化 (mean-eigenvalue pre-normalization)，使谱中心接近 1、远离 log 的奇点，并用标量后补偿以闭合形式恢复 log(A) 的奇异部分。推荐使用 8 阶 Chebyshev 展开，通过三项矩阵递推计算前向、反向递推计算反向；同时研究 Legendre、Laguerre、Taylor 和 Pade 展开作为对照组，以隔离基函数和目标函数的作用。
Result: 在三个细粒度基准和 ImageNet-1k 上，免分解对数比谱对数和它所替换的平方根近似更快且更准确；在匹配基与阶数时，log 目标优于平方根目标，说明增益来自忠实的黎曼映射而非更好的多项式族。
Conclusion: 作者认为矩阵对数的不稳定性是谱分解计算方式的伪影，多项式近似可使 MLN-COV 在实际中可行，并确认改进来自对 SPD 流形的忠实映射本身。摘要未讨论该方法的适用范围或潜在局限。

papers.title: One-Stage Object Detectors in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles depend on fast and reliable perception systems to detect surrounding vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, traffic signs, and other road objects in real time. This paper presents a comprehensive survey and analysis of one-stage object detectors for autonomous driving rather than an implementation of a new detection system. The survey reviews the evolution of major one-stage detectors, including YOLOv1, SSD, RetinaNet, EfficientDet, anchor-free detectors such as FCOS and CenterNet, and recent real-time models such as YOLOv10. It compares these architectures through their design choices, feature-fusion strategies, loss functions, deployment trade-offs, and reported benchmark performance. The paper also summarizes commonly used autonomous-driving datasets, evaluation metrics, open challenges, and future research directions. Overall, this survey highlights how one-stage detectors balance speed, accuracy, efficiency, and robustness, while also emphasizing the remaining gap between benchmark results and dependable real-world autonomous-driving performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于自动驾驶场景中单阶段目标检测器（one-stage object detectors）的综述，而非新检测系统的实现。它回顾了从 YOLOv1、SSD、RetinaNet、EfficientDet 到 anchor-free 的 FCOS、CenterNet 以及实时模型 YOLOv10 等主要架构，从设计选择、特征融合策略、损失函数、部署权衡和已报告基准性能等维度进行比较，并总结了常用自动驾驶数据集、评估指标、开放挑战与未来方向。
Motivation: 自动驾驶车辆依赖快速可靠的感知系统实时检测车辆、行人、骑行者、交通标志等道路目标；单阶段检测器在速度与精度之间需要权衡，但缺少系统性的综述来梳理其演化历程和实际部署中的关键问题。
Method: 采用综述方法，按时间线梳理主要单阶段检测器的演进，重点比较各架构的设计选择、特征融合方式、损失函数、部署权衡以及在公开基准上的性能表现，同时整理自动驾驶常用数据集、评估指标、开放挑战和未来研究方向。
Result: 摘要未报告具体定量实验结果，而是定性总结单阶段检测器如何在速度、精度、效率和鲁棒性之间取得平衡，并指出基准测试结果与可靠的真实世界自动驾驶性能之间仍存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 综述强调单阶段检测器在自动驾驶感知中的权衡关系，并指出从基准性能到真实世界可靠部署之间的差距是当前剩余的核心挑战与未来研究重点。

papers.title: Harness Continual Learning: Continual Adaptation Beyond Model Parameters
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning has largely been model-centric, treating model parameters as the state that changes with sequential experience. Modern agents can also adapt through a harness of prompts, memories, tools, skills, and routing rules. Because these contents jointly shape later execution, a harness update can disrupt previously reliable behavior even when the model is frozen. This raises a new question: how can an agent continually improve its state outside the model while retaining behavior acquired earlier? We formulate Harness Continual Learning (HCL), a new continual learning paradigm in which the harness evolves around a frozen foundation model, and define the resulting loss of earlier behavior as harness-level forgetting. We instantiate HCL with four execution-facing components: the Task Interface, Experience Memory, Capability Map, and Adaptive Router. We further introduce guarded harness evolution to separate update generation from state commitment. A Continual Optimizer proposes candidate harnesses from post-execution feedback, and a Continual Evaluator commits the resulting candidate harness only after checking current improvement, historical retention, and validity. Experiments on textual reasoning, multimodal perception, and open-world interaction demonstrate capability accumulation and failure recovery, with relative gains exceeding 10% over corresponding baselines in multiple settings. Component ablations assess the contribution of each harness component, while controlled retention sweeps reveal measurable harness-level forgetting and show that the stability--plasticity trade-off can be explicitly adjusted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的持续学习范式 Harness Continual Learning (HCL)，将提示、记忆、工具、技能等外部 harness 视为可在冻结基础模型之外演化的智能体状态，并定义因更新 harness 导致旧行为丧失的现象为 harness 级遗忘。作者用四个组件实例化该范式，并设计受保护的演化机制来分离候选生成与状态提交。实验在文本推理、多模态感知和开放世界交互中展示能力积累与失败恢复，多个设置相对基线增益超过 10%。
Motivation: 现有持续学习大多以模型为中心，把模型参数视为随经验变化的唯一状态；但现代智能体还能通过 harness 适应，而更新 harness 即使模型冻结也可能破坏此前可靠的行为。因此需要一种在模型参数之外持续改进状态、同时保留已习得行为的范式。
Method: 提出 HCL，围绕冻结的基础模型演化 harness，实例化为四个执行面向组件：Task Interface、Experience Memory、Capability Map、Adaptive Router。引入受保护的 harness 演化（guarded harness evolution），将更新生成与状态承诺分离：一个 Continual Optimizer 从执行后反馈提出候选 harness，一个 Continual Evaluator 仅在检查当前改进、历史保留和有效性之后才提交候选。
Result: 在文本推理、多模态感知和开放世界交互上的实验表明能力积累和失败恢复，多个设置相对对应基线的增益超过 10%；组件消融评估各 harness 组件的贡献，受控保留扫描揭示可测量的 harness 级遗忘，并表明稳定性-可塑性权衡可以被显式调整。
Conclusion: 作者强调持续适应可以发生在模型参数之外，受保护的 harness 演化能够在冻结基础模型的情况下实现能力累积与失败恢复，并允许明确调节稳定性-可塑性权衡。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种新的持续学习范式 Harness Continual Learning (HCL)，将提示、记忆、工具、技能等外部 harness 视为可在冻结基础模型之外演化的智能体状态，并定义因更新 harness 导致旧行为丧失的现象为 harness 级遗忘。作者用四个组件实例化该范式，并设计受保护的演化机制来分离候选生成与状态提交。实验在文本推理、多模态感知和开放世界交互中展示能力积累与失败恢复，多个设置相对基线增益超过 10%。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有持续学习大多以模型为中心，把模型参数视为随经验变化的唯一状态；但现代智能体还能通过 harness 适应，而更新 harness 即使模型冻结也可能破坏此前可靠的行为。因此需要一种在模型参数之外持续改进状态、同时保留已习得行为的范式。
summary_sections.method: 提出 HCL，围绕冻结的基础模型演化 harness，实例化为四个执行面向组件：Task Interface、Experience Memory、Capability Map、Adaptive Router。引入受保护的 harness 演化（guarded harness evolution），将更新生成与状态承诺分离：一个 Continual Optimizer 从执行后反馈提出候选 harness，一个 Continual Evaluator 仅在检查当前改进、历史保留和有效性之后才提交候选。
summary_sections.result: 在文本推理、多模态感知和开放世界交互上的实验表明能力积累和失败恢复，多个设置相对对应基线的增益超过 10%；组件消融评估各 harness 组件的贡献，受控保留扫描揭示可测量的 harness 级遗忘，并表明稳定性-可塑性权衡可以被显式调整。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调持续适应可以发生在模型参数之外，受保护的 harness 演化能够在冻结基础模型的情况下实现能力累积与失败恢复，并允许明确调节稳定性-可塑性权衡。

papers.title: From Threat Intelligence to Detection: Knowledge-driven Enrichment and Template-based Rule Grounding for Automated Sigma Rule Generation
papers.abstract_en: Mechanisms for dynamically converting cyber threat intelligence (CTI) into actionable detection capabilities are necessary due to the rapid evolution of Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs). Sigma rules are an essential part of contemporary threat detection workflows because they offer a platform-independent framework for expressing detection logic that can be converted into particular queries across SIEM systems. Conventional techniques for manually crafting Sigma rules are prone to mistakes, and necessitate extensive knowledge, which restricts their scalability. Although there are open-source and industry-maintained Sigma rule repositories, they often fail to keep pace with emerging threats and require frequent customization to fit diverse operational environments. This emphasizes the necessity of dynamic rule generation that is adapted to evolving attack techniques as well as particular use cases. In this work, we design AUTOSIGMA, an automated solution for transforming unstructured CTI reports into relevant Sigma rules. Rather than relying solely on language models, AUTOSIGMA leverages a structured knowledge base to enrich partial inputs, matches the enriched content against a repository of existing Sigma rules, and then employs an LLM-as-a-Judge mechanism to iteratively validate the rules. By combining knowledge-driven enrichment, template-based rule grounding, and a multi-stage solution, AUTOSIGMA enables accurate, context-aware, and relevant rule generation. Evaluations across multiple real-world APT reports and multiple security blogs demonstrate that AUTOSIGMA outperforms alternative solutions and LLM models in rule validity, rule relevancy, MITRE ATT&CK technique coverage, and robustness to input quality. AUTOSIGMA's Demo: https://youtu.be/iSr6IurQ6BM
papers.comment: Submitted for publication and currently under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AUTOSIGMA，一种将非结构化网络威胁情报 (CTI) 报告自动转换为 Sigma 规则的解决方案。它利用结构化知识库丰富不完整输入，将丰富后的内容与现有 Sigma 规则库匹配，并采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 机制迭代验证规则。在多个真实 APT 报告和安全博客上的评估表明，其在规则有效性、规则相关性、MITRE ATT&CK 技术覆盖率以及对输入质量的鲁棒性方面优于替代方案和 LLM 模型。
Motivation: 手动编写 Sigma 规则容易出错且需要广泛专业知识，限制了可扩展性；现有开源或行业维护的规则库难以跟上新兴威胁，且需要频繁定制以适应不同运营环境。因此需要能够适应不断演变的攻击技术和特定用例的动态规则生成方案。
Method: AUTOSIGMA 结合知识驱动的输入丰富 (knowledge-driven enrichment)、基于模板的规则落地 (template-based rule grounding) 和多阶段流程，并利用 LLM-as-a-Judge 机制迭代验证生成的规则，而非仅依赖语言模型。
Result: 在多个真实 APT 报告和安全博客上的评估显示，AUTOSIGMA 在规则有效性、规则相关性、MITRE ATT&CK 技术覆盖率以及对输入质量的鲁棒性方面均优于替代方案和 LLM 模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过结合知识库丰富、模板匹配和多阶段验证，AUTOSIGMA 能够生成准确、上下文相关且相关的 Sigma 规则，适用于动态威胁检测场景。

papers.title: Extremes on Rewind: Generating 1,000-Member Ensembles Initialized at a Final Condition
papers.abstract_en: Scenario planning for rare, high-impact events often requires massive ensembles to stochastically sample relevant trajectories. Although autoregressive weather emulators can efficiently generate such ensembles, isolating trajectories of interest requires sifting through petabytes of data, a challenge that grows exponentially with lead time and rarity. In contrast, a non-autoregressive foundation model like Climate in a Bottle video (cBottle-video) can directly sample trajectories terminating in extremes, avoiding large-ensemble search. We use cBottle-video to generate 1000-member ensembles with start- and/or end-conditioning across three extreme events---the 2021 Pacific Northwest (PNW) heatwave, Superstorm Sandy, and Hurricane Ian. Antecedent 500 hPa geopotential height ($z_{500}$) spread at the free end of end-conditioned ensembles reaches 84--89\% of the final-state spread of start-conditioned ensembles, revealing substantial diversity consistent with each extreme event. For the 2021 PNW heatwave, end-conditioned ensemble members begin uniformly warmer than reanalysis and stay warm, replacing the observed rapid intensification with persistent antecedent heat. For Superstorm Sandy, the leading modes of $z_{500}$ at the antecedent end of the end-conditioned ensemble explain 44\% of the variance in track latitude, and roughly 10\% of ensemble members begin as stronger hurricanes than Sandy. For Hurricane Ian, variation in the first landfall location among end-conditioned trajectories underscores the importance of accounting for intermediate hazard exposure in risk planning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用非自回归基础模型 Climate in a Bottle video (cBottle-video) 直接生成以极端事件终止的轨迹，避免在自回归仿真器的大规模集合中筛选罕见事件。作者针对 2021 年太平洋西北 (PNW) 热浪、飓风 Sandy 和飓风 Ian 分别生成 1000 成员的起始/终止条件集合，发现终止条件集合自由端的 500 hPa 位势高度 (z500) 离散度达到起始条件集合最终态离散度的 84–89%，同时揭示不同极端事件对应的前兆多样性。摘要还报告了 PNW 热浪的前兆持续偏暖、Sandy 前兆 z500 主模态解释 44% 的路径纬度方差，以及 Ian 首次登陆位置变化对中间灾害暴露评估的意义。
Motivation: 为罕见高影响事件做情景规划通常需要海量集合来随机采样相关轨迹，但自回归天气仿真器生成此类集合后，要从 PB 级数据中筛选目标轨迹的代价随预报时长和事件稀有度指数增长，需要更直接的采样途径。
Method: 使用非自回归基础模型 cBottle-video，在生成过程中对起始条件和/或终止条件进行约束，从而直接采样终止于极端事件的轨迹；对三个极端事件各生成 1000 成员集合，并分析自由端的前兆离散度与事件特征。
Result: 终止条件集合自由端的 z500 离散度达到起始条件集合最终态离散度的 84–89%；对 Sandy，前兆端 z500 前几个模态解释 44% 的路径纬度方差，约 10% 的成员起始强度强于 Sandy 实际强度；对 PNW 热浪，终止条件成员整体比再分析资料更暖且保持偏暖，观测到的快速增强被持续前兆高温取代；对 Ian，首次登陆位置的变化凸显中间灾害暴露评估的重要性。
Conclusion: 作者认为非自回归的终止条件生成可以避免大规模集合搜索，直接提供终止于极端事件的多样轨迹，并强调在风险规划中需考虑轨迹中间阶段的灾害暴露。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: Autonomous Agricultural Tractor: Integrated Weed Detection and LiDAR Navigation for Precision Paddy Farming
papers.abstract_en: Site-specific weed management in paddy farming offers substantial reductions in herbicide use over conventional broadcast spraying, but field deployment has been limited by three persistent challenges: robust crop-row navigation under canopy where GNSS degrades, real-time visual discrimination between rice and morphologically diverse weeds, and the asymmetric cost of misclassifying rice as weed, which is irreversible. This paper presents AgriNav, an integrated autonomous tractor system built around four ROS-coupled modules: a custom PyTorch reimplementation of WeedDet for rice detection, a parallel lightweight 1.68M-parameter CNN-FPN variant with asymmetric class weighting, an inverted-logic discrimination module that protects the rice class through a hardcoded confidence-gate veto, and a 6-state constant-velocity-turn-rate Extended Kalman Filter fusing GNSS, IMU, and wheel odometry with three-level outage bridging. Our primary system-level contribution is a four-mechanism LiDAR-camera fusion bridge that uses the navigation LiDAR for region-of-interest constraint, world-coordinate projection, ground-plane filtering, and bidirectional confidence fusion at zero additional hardware cost. Simulation experiments demonstrate continuous position tracking through a 20-second GNSS outage, crop row detection confidence above 0.9 throughout operation, and rice-detection confidences from 0.32 to 0.95 across paddy, aerial, and post-flood imagery. The LiDAR ROI constraint reduces detection inference region by an estimated 30 to 50 percent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgriNav，一个面向水稻田定点杂草管理的集成自主拖拉机系统，由四个 ROS 耦合模块组成：基于 PyTorch 的 WeedDet 水稻检测、带非对称类权重的轻量 CNN-FPN 变体、保护水稻类别的倒置逻辑判别模块，以及融合 GNSS/IMU/轮式里程计的六状态恒速转弯率扩展卡尔曼滤波器。核心系统级贡献是四机制 LiDAR-相机融合桥，复用导航 LiDAR 实现 ROI 约束、世界坐标投影、地面平面滤波和双向置信度融合，且零额外硬件成本。模拟实验显示在 20 秒 GNSS 中断期间位置跟踪连续，作物行检测置信度高于 0.9，水稻检测置信度在不同图像域上为 0.32 至 0.95。
Motivation: 稻田定点杂草管理相比传统广播喷洒可大幅减少除草剂用量，但实际部署受三个持续挑战制约：GNSS 在冠层下退化时的作物行导航、水稻与形态多样杂草的实时视觉区分，以及水稻被误判为杂草时不可逆的不对称代价。
Method: 构建 AgriNav 系统，包含四个 ROS 耦合模块：自定义 PyTorch 实现的 WeedDet 用于水稻检测，并行的 1.68M 参数 CNN-FPN 变体采用非对称类权重，倒置逻辑判别模块通过硬编码置信度门控否决来保护水稻类别，以及融合 GNSS、IMU 和轮式里程计并经三级中断桥接的六状态恒速转弯率扩展卡尔曼滤波器。核心方法是四机制 LiDAR-相机融合桥，利用导航 LiDAR 进行 ROI 约束、世界坐标投影、地面平面滤波和双向置信度融合，不增加额外硬件成本。
Result: 模拟实验表明系统能在 20 秒 GNSS 中断期间保持连续位置跟踪，作物行检测置信度全程高于 0.9；水稻检测置信度在稻田、航拍和洪水后图像上介于 0.32 至 0.95。LiDAR ROI 约束估计可将检测推理区域减少 30% 至 50%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该零额外硬件成本的 LiDAR-相机融合桥可在 GNSS 退化环境下维持导航与检测，支撑定点杂草管理；实验为模拟环境，未提供实际田间部署验证。

papers.title: A Theory of Post-hoc Debate Judgement
papers.abstract_en: Debates have recently emerged as a useful methodology for agentic AI to improve performance as well as to aid explainability and user engagement. For example, LLM-empowered agents may debate internally (with themselves) and/or externally (with other agents). In many settings where debates are used, debates' outcomes and resulting outputs are determined post-hoc by external judges, often LLMs. In this paper we develop and test a novel theory of debate judgement applicable to all settings where agents engage in debates by providing pros and cons for their opinions therein. Specifically, we identify a number of formal properties that debate judgement may be required to satisfy in general, as concerns reproducibility, robustness, groundedness and explainability. Then, we explore their satisfaction formally and/or experimentally, for claim verification settings, for two specific alternative debate judgement methods: variants of the LLMs as a judge idea and formal semantics drawn from computational argumentation. We show that the two methods give similar accuracy performances but the former may lack formal guarantees that the latter brings. Overall, our study indicates argumentation semantics as an ideal candidate for principled judges in debate-driven AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向事后辩论裁决 (post-hoc debate judgement) 的理论框架，适用于智能体以赞成/反对理由参与辩论、并由外部评判者（通常是 LLM）事后决定结果的场景。作者定义可复现性、鲁棒性、接地性 (groundedness) 与可解释性等正式性质，并在声明验证 (claim verification) 设置中形式化与实验比较两类裁决方法：LLM-as-judge 变体与基于计算论证 (computational argumentation) 的语义。结果显示两者准确率相近，但前者可能缺乏后者提供的正式保证，论证语义更宜作为有原则的裁决者。
Motivation: 基于辩论的智能体 AI 日益用于提升性能、可解释性与用户参与，但辩论结果常由外部 LLM 事后裁决，缺乏统一理论来界定裁决应满足的性质，也难以比较不同裁决方法的保证。
Method: 作者建立辩论裁决理论，针对代理用赞成/反对理由辩论的设定提出可复现性、鲁棒性、接地性和可解释性等正式性质；并在声明验证任务中，对两类方法——LLM-as-judge 变体与计算论证中的形式语义——进行形式化验证和实验考察。
Result: 两种裁决方法在准确率上表现相近，但 LLM 类方法可能缺少论证语义所能提供的正式保证。
Conclusion: 研究表明计算论证语义是辩论驱动 AI 中规范化裁决者的理想候选；同时指出 LLM-as-judge 类方法在保证方面存在局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mise-en-Scène: Implicit Layout Emergence in Diffusion Transformers for Human-AI Design Co-Creation
papers.abstract_en: Automating graphic design synthesis from user-provided elements requires both a coherent overall composition and the exact preservation of each asset. Existing methods predict a layout as explicit bounding-box coordinates with a language model and then paste the assets into it, which separates spatial planning from visual synthesis and tends to produce rigid, mis-scaled compositions. We instead ask whether the layout can emerge implicitly inside a pretrained image-editing diffusion transformer. We present Mise-en-Scène, a two-stage framework. In the first stage, a diffusion transformer adapted with a small, knockout-selected LoRA drafts a complete design in which the arrangement of the elements emerges jointly with the rendered canvas. In the second stage, a deterministic match-and-place step moves the original high-resolution assets to the drafted positions, which guarantees exact asset fidelity and yields an editable, layered design that a designer can keep refining rather than a flat image. Notably, a minimal adaptation of the pretrained transformer already suffices, without the specialized conditioning machinery commonly introduced for multi-element generation. On the large-scale PrismLayersPlus benchmark, the designs produced by Mise-en-Scène are the closest to the ground truth in perceived quality among all compared methods, by a wide margin over both an LLM layout planner and a specialized layout transformer, while our match-and-place stage bridges the remaining fidelity gap to the ground-truth composites.
papers.comment: Best Paper Award at ECCV Human-AI Co-Creation Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mise-en-Scène，一个两阶段框架，利用预训练图像编辑扩散 Transformer 让布局在渲染画布中隐式涌现，再通过确定性的 match-and-place 步骤将原始高分辨率资产放置到草稿位置。在 PrismLayersPlus 基准上，该方法生成的合成设计在感知质量上最接近真实地面真值，大幅超过 LLM 布局规划器和专用布局 Transformer。
Motivation: 现有方法先用语言模型预测显式包围框坐标布局，再粘贴资产，将空间规划与视觉合成分离，导致构图僵硬、缩放失调。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段使用经小规模 knockout-selected LoRA 适配的扩散 Transformer 草拟完整设计，使元素排布与渲染画面联合生成；第二阶段执行确定性的 match-and-place，将原始高分辨率资产移动到草稿位置，保证资产保真并生成可编辑的分层设计。
Result: 在 PrismLayersPlus 基准上，Mise-en-Scène 生成的合成设计在感知质量方面最接近真实地面真值，相比 LLM 布局规划器和专用布局 Transformer 有大幅度优势，match-and-place 阶段弥合了与真实合成图像的保真差距。
Conclusion: 仅需对预训练 Transformer 进行最小化适配即可实现多元素隐式布局生成，无需专门的条件机制，且可编辑的分层输出支持设计师继续精修。

papers.title: GrabVG: Graph-Attentive Binding for Visual Grounding in UAV Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery aims to localize a target object in complex bird's-eye-view scenes according to a natural language description. However, the abundance of small, densely distributed, and visually similar objects creates high visual redundancy, while repetitive local configurations give rise to strong topological ambiguity. Existing approaches mainly focus on visual--language feature alignment or dense contextual interaction, yet they struggle to distinguish subtle inter-instance differences and effectively exploit spatial topological structures, leading to inaccurate grounding in highly crowded scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose $\textbf{GrabVG}$, a novel visual grounding framework inspired by human visual search. GrabVG explicitly decomposes grounding into two sequential stages: $\textit{preattentive hypothesis search}$ and $\textit{graph-attentive feature binding}$. Specifically, we first generate a compact set of reliable object hypotheses through distillation-guided proposal induction and text-aware hypothesis filtering, substantially reducing background distractions and semantic mismatches. These hypotheses are then organized into a sparse graph, where language-guided intra-instance visual cues and inter-instance topological relationships are jointly bound and propagated via graph attention, enabling efficient spatial reasoning and accurate target localization. Extensive experiments on AerialVG and AerialSense show that GrabVG achieves a favorable accuracy--speed trade-off, reaching 67.31$\%$ and 80.34$\%$ Acc@0.5 and outperforming the corresponding baselines by 10.55 and 8.76 percentage points, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GrabVG，一个面向无人机（UAV）鸟瞰图场景的视觉定位（visual grounding）框架，受人类视觉搜索启发，将定位显式分解为前注意假设搜索（preattentive hypothesis search）和图注意力特征绑定（graph-attentive feature binding）两个阶段。在 AerialVG 和 AerialSense 上，GrabVG 分别达到 67.31% 和 80.34% 的 Acc@0.5，超出对应基线 10.55 和 8.76 个百分点，并取得了较好的精度-速度权衡。
Motivation: UAV 图像中目标小、密集分布且视觉相似，存在高视觉冗余和强拓扑歧义；现有方法侧重视觉-语言特征对齐或密集上下文交互，难以区分细粒度的实例间差异并有效利用空间拓扑结构，导致高度拥挤场景下定位不准确。
Method: GrabVG 将定位分解为两阶段：先通过蒸馏引导的提议归纳（distillation-guided proposal induction）和文本感知假设过滤（text-aware hypothesis filtering）生成紧凑可靠的候选集合以减少背景干扰与语义错配；再将这些候选组织成稀疏图，通过图注意力（graph attention）联合绑定并传播语言引导的实例内视觉线索与实例间拓扑关系，实现空间推理与目标定位。
Result: 在 AerialVG 和 AerialSense 基准上，GrabVG 分别取得 67.31% 和 80.34% 的 Acc@0.5，超过对应基线 10.55 和 8.76 个百分点，并达到良好的精度-速度权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式模拟人类视觉搜索的两阶段分解，以及利用稀疏图进行语言引导的实例内与实例间信息绑定，能有效缓解拥挤 UAV 场景中的视觉冗余和拓扑歧义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ForeSightGuide: An Anticipatory Framework toward Accurate and Low-Redundancy Guidance for the Visually Impaired
papers.abstract_en: Electronic travel aids are pivotal for the independent mobility of the visually impaired. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer rich environmental understanding, they often suffer from excessive false positives in dynamic scenarios, leading to cognitive overload. To address this, we present ForeSightGuide, an anticipatory assistive guidance framework that couples semantic scene understanding with predictive hazard assessment. Unlike reactive systems, ForeSightGuide leverages the reasoning capabilities of VLMs to anticipate obstacle motion, effectively filtering out non-threatening objects to provide concise, actionable guidance. To validate our approach, we introduce a novel dataset captured in complex, dynamic real-world traffic scenes, designed to benchmark predictive capabilities. Extensive experiments on both public benchmarks and our proposed dataset demonstrate that ForeSightGuide achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, it significantly mitigates information overload by reducing redundant alerts to 0.299 per guidance output while maintaining a low missed-hazard rate of 0.112, proving its efficacy for safe walking assistance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ForeSightGuide，一个面向视障人士的预期式辅助导航框架，将语义场景理解与预测性危险评估结合，利用 VLM 的推理能力预判障碍物运动并过滤无威胁目标，从而提供简洁可执行的引导。作者引入了一个在复杂动态真实交通场景中采集的新数据集来测评预测能力。实验表明该方法在公开基准和自建数据集上达到 state-of-the-art，并将每次引导输出的冗余警报降至 0.299，同时保持 0.112 的低漏报率。
Motivation: 现有电子出行辅助工具中的 VLM 在动态场景下常产生过多误报，造成认知过载；论文认为需要从反应式告警转向预期式危险评估，以提升视障人士独立行动的安全性与可用性。
Method: ForeSightGuide 将语义场景理解与预测性危险评估耦合，借助 VLM 推理预测障碍物运动，并据此滤除非威胁物体；同时构建了一个在复杂动态真实交通场景中采集的新数据集，用于基准测试预测能力。
Result: 在公开基准和提出的新数据集上，ForeSightGuide 取得 state-of-the-art 性能；冗余警报降低到每次引导输出 0.299 个，同时保持 0.112 的低漏报危险率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能有效缓解信息过载，证明其适合作为安全步行辅助；论文未在摘要中说明局限或泛化边界。

papers.title: DeepWeaver: Bridging the Evidence Synthesis Gap in Open-Ended Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Retrieve-then-generate pipelines are commonly used to produce deep-research answers for open-ended questions, but retrieval alone is insufficient: LLMs must organize noisy and fragmented evidence into comprehensive, well-cited answers. We refer to this process as evidence synthesis. However, direct generation often underuses evidence, misaligns citations, and collapses diverse information into shallow summaries, exposing an evidence synthesis gap between retrieval and generation. Thus, we propose DeepWeaver, a novel framework that weaves noisy retrieved evidence into comprehensive answers by maintaining Thought Block Chains (TBCs), a structured representation that groups claims, salient information, keywords, and supporting evidence. DeepWeaver uses subordinate TBCs to inspect residual evidence, commit TBC revisions, and discover new claims before final generation. We evaluate DeepWeaver on open-ended QA over both knowledge bases and the web, and introduce LoQA, a high-density benchmark for evidence synthesis. Across multiple LLMs, DeepWeaver improves content sufficiency, citation grounding, and detail preservation on LoQA, while achieving deeper insights and higher citation quality on DeepResearch Bench. These results show that evidence weaving is an effective mechanism for bridging retrieval and generation in open-ended QA. Our code is available at https://github.com/KlozeWang/DeepWeaver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepWeaver 框架，通过维护 Thought Block Chains (TBCs) 将检索到的杂乱证据编织成全面、引用准确的开放问答答案，旨在弥合检索与生成之间的证据合成差距。作者在知识库和网页上的开放问答任务中评估该方法，并引入高密度证据合成基准 LoQA。
Motivation: Retrieve-then-generate 管道中，仅有检索不足以支撑深度研究式回答：LLM 需要组织嘈杂且碎片化的证据，但直接生成往往欠利用证据、导致引用错位，并把多样信息压成浅层摘要，形成检索与生成之间的证据合成差距。
Method: DeepWeaver 使用 Thought Block Chains (TBCs) 作为结构化表示，将声明、关键信息、关键词和支持证据分组；通过下级 TBC 检查残留证据、提交 TBC 修订并在最终生成前发现新声明，从而编织证据。
Result: 在 LoQA 基准上，跨多个 LLM 的 DeepWeaver 提升了内容充分性、引用依据和细节保留；在 DeepResearch Bench 上实现了更深的见解和更高的引用质量。
Conclusion: 证据编织（evidence weaving）是桥接开放问答中检索与生成的有效机制；代码已开源。

papers.title: X-LMC: Cross-View Spatiotemporal Collateral Circulation Scoring from DSA
papers.abstract_en: Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) is the reference standard for leptomeningeal collateral (LMC) assessment, providing critical prognostic insights to guide secondary treatment strategies, neurorehabilitation planning, and retrospective stroke research. However, clinical LMC grading via the ASITN/SIR scale relies on manual, highly variable visual inspection. We introduce X-LMC, a spatiotemporal framework for automated collateral scoring from time-resolved biplane DSA. The proposed architecture encodes spatial frame representations through a DINOv2 backbone, fuses orthogonal projections via a token-level cross-view attention module, and models representations of contrast bolus dynamics using a recurrent network architecture. We evaluate our framework on a multicenter dataset of 134 patients with M1-segment occlusions. In a 5-fold cross-validation setting, X-LMC yields higher point estimates than static architectures and spatiotemporal baselines adapted from related angiographic tasks, achieving a Quadratic Weighted Kappa (QWK) of 0.398 (vs. 0.322) and a dichotomized macro-F1 score of 0.711 (vs. 0.663) against the best-performing baseline. X-LMC performance also aligns with the observed clinical inter-rater agreement (QWK: 0.314). As the first DSA study attempting to automate LMC scoring, we demonstrate that multi-view temporal deep learning can capture collateral-specific contrast kinetics. Ultimately, these benchmarks delineate the clinical ambiguities and achievable performance boundaries of automated ASITN/SIR grading, establishing a reproducible foundation for objective hemodynamic phenotyping in stroke cohorts. Code is available at https://github.com/maedehafezi/X-LMC.

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Art-Historical Dating with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Museum and archival datasets do not mirror historical artistic production, but materialize the contingent histories of collecting, preservation, cataloging, and digitization. This has direct consequences for interpreting pretrained image representations: they may appear to encode historical time while actually encoding the institutional conditions under which objects become visible as data. We describe this phenomenon as temporal entanglement and investigate it by formulating artwork dating as an uncertainty-aware regression task over frozen image embeddings. We evaluate several pretrained vision models on a temporally controlled Wikidata corpus of artworks. Our results show that these models contain usable temporal information, with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) outperforming purely visual self-supervised baselines. However, a qualitative analysis indicates that this temporal knowledge is shaped by various biases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对博物馆与档案数据集无法真实反映历史艺术生产的问题，提出“时间纠缠”(temporal entanglement) 现象：预训练图像表征看似编码历史时间，实则可能编码对象被收集、保存、编目和数字化的制度条件。作者将艺术品断代建模为基于冻结图像嵌入的不确定性感知回归任务，并在时间受控的 Wikidata 艺术品语料上评估多种预训练视觉模型。
Motivation: 博物馆和档案数据本身受收藏、保存、编目与数字化历史的影响，直接使用预训练图像表征可能混淆历史时间与制度条件，从而误导基于视觉特征的时间解释。
Method: 将艺术品断代形式化为对冻结图像嵌入的不确定性感知回归任务，并在时间受控的 Wikidata 艺术品语料上系统评估多种预训练视觉模型，包括视觉语言模型 (VLM) 与纯视觉自监督基线。
Result: 预训练模型包含可用的时间信息，其中视觉语言模型优于纯视觉自监督基线；但定性分析表明，这种时间知识受到多种偏差的影响。
Conclusion: 作者强调时间表征可能被制度性条件所塑造，因此对预训练视觉特征中时间信息的解读需要谨慎，并指出该时间知识存在多种偏差。

papers.title: Monroe: A Molecular Foundation Model for In-Context Probabilistic Inference
papers.abstract_en: Bioassay activity prediction is often data-limited because drug-discovery datasets rely on time-consuming and expensive wet-lab experiments for data generation and evaluation. This challenge has inspired recent research into molecular foundation models (MFMs), which aim to encode general-purpose chemical knowledge into molecular representations that generalize well in data-constrained scenarios. This paper presents Monroe, a new MFM with several innovations over the existing state of the art: increased scale allowing pre-training on over 81 million molecules from the PM6 quantum chemistry dataset; improved graph representation of stereochemistry; improved training losses including conformer denoising and embedding decorrelation; improved multi-task learning; and the use of a prior-data-fitted model (TabPFN) for downstream in-context prediction. Our evaluations use a principled pairwise comparison framework that measures statistically significant performance differences. Across established Polaris benchmarks, Monroe matches or exceeds existing MFMs, while on activity cliff benchmarks, designed to assess utility for molecular discovery, it achieves significant improvements over prior methods. Finally, ablation and transfer experiments show that PFN-based downstream predictors also substantially improve two leading existing models, MiniMol and CheMeleon, yielding new state-of-the-art variants we call MiniMol_PFN and CheMeleon_PFN, suggesting that our downstream adaptation strategy generalizes beyond Monroe. Source code is at github.com/blazejba/monroe.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Monroe，一种面向生物活性预测的分子基础模型 (MFM)。Monroe 在包含超过 8100 万分子的 PM6 量子化学数据集上进行大规模预训练，并引入立体化学的改进图表示、构象去噪 (conformer denoising) 与嵌入去相关 (embedding decorrelation) 等训练损失和多任务学习，同时采用先验数据拟合模型 (TabPFN) 进行下游上下文预测。在 Polaris 基准上与现有 MFM 持平或超越，在活性悬崖 (activity cliff) 基准上取得显著改进。
Motivation: 生物活性预测常受限于数据规模，因为药物发现数据集依赖耗时且昂贵的湿实验来生成和评估数据，这推动了对通用分子表示方法的研究。
Method: Monroe 在模型规模、立体化学图表示、训练损失（构象去噪和嵌入去相关）、多任务学习以及使用 TabPFN 进行下游上下文预测等方面进行创新，并在 PM6 量子化学数据集上对超过 8100 万分子进行预训练。评估采用能衡量统计显著性能差异的成对比较框架。
Result: 在 Polaris 基准上 Monroe 匹配或超越现有 MFM；在面向分子发现效用的活性悬崖基准上实现显著改进。消融和迁移实验还表明，基于 PFN 的下游预测器能显著提升 MiniMol 和 CheMeleon 两个现有模型，得到新 SOTA 变体 MiniMol_PFN 和 CheMeleon_PFN。
Conclusion: PFN 式下游适应策略的有效性可推广到 Monroe 之外的模型，作者据此认为该方法具有一般性；代码和权重已开源。

papers.title: When Simplicity Wins: Bottleneck-Aware Context Modeling for Lightweight Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation demands a careful balance between accuracy, efficiency, and scalability, which remains difficult to achieve for high-resolution imagery. Convolutional networks effectively model local patterns but struggle with long-range dependencies, whereas Vision Transformers capture global context at a high computational cost. While recent work largely focuses on encoder design, the bottleneck stage, central to contextual aggregation and information flow, has been relatively overlooked. We propose SiConMo, a lightweight yet effective framework, implemented in two variants: an RGB-only model (SiConMo) and a GME-enhanced variant (SiConMo$_\dagger$). We show that simplicity arises from a key design principle: at very low computational budgets, the bottleneck is the most efficient stage to integrate local and global context. SiConMo integrates three complementary components: a Token Pyramid Extraction Module for hierarchical multi-scale representation, a Transformer-Branched Depthwise Convolution block for bottleneck-aware context modeling, and a Feature Merging Module that preserves spatial structure while enhancing semantic consistency. Extensive experiments on ADE20K, PASCAL Context, Cityscapes, and COCO-Stuff demonstrate that SiConMo achieves a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-off among lightweight semantic segmentation models, highlighting simplicity as a powerful design principle.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE ICIP 2026; ranked among the Top 3%
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SiConMo，一个面向轻量级语义分割的框架，包含 RGB-only 的 SiConMo 与 GME 增强的 SiConMo$\dagger$ 两个变体。核心设计主张是：在极低计算预算下，bottleneck 阶段是整合局部与全局上下文最有效的环节。模型集成 Token Pyramid Extraction Module、Transformer-Branched Depthwise Convolution 块和 Feature Merging Module，并在 ADE20K、PASCAL Context、Cityscapes 与 COCO-Stuff 上取得轻量级模型中的先进精度-效率权衡。
Motivation: 语义分割需要在精度、效率与可扩展性之间取得平衡，高分辨率图像尤其困难；卷积网络擅长局部模式但缺乏长程依赖，Vision Transformer 捕获全局上下文但计算成本高。近期工作多关注 encoder 设计，而负责上下文聚合和信息流的 bottleneck 阶段相对被忽视。
Method: 提出以 bottleeck 为中心的轻量级框架 SiConMo，由三部分组成：Token Pyramid Extraction Module 用于层级多尺度表示，Transformer-Branched Depthwise Convolution 块用于 bottleneck 感知的上下文建模，Feature Merging Module 在保持空间结构的同时增强语义一致性；并提供融合 GME 的增强变体 SiConMo$\dagger$。
Result: 在 ADE20K、PASCAL Context、Cityscapes 和 COCO-Stuff 上的大量实验表明，SiConMo 在轻量级语义分割模型中取得了先进的精度-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在极低计算预算下将局部与全局上下文整合到 bottleneck 阶段是一种有效的简单设计原则，可为轻量级语义分割提供较强基线。

papers.title: Fuzzy Accuracy Compensates for Label Subjectivity in Classification of Skin Tone Using Wearable Photoplethysmography Signals
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of classification of skin tone using photoplethysmography (PPG) signals with labels of the ordinal six-class Fitzpatrick skin tones. A typical accuracy for this task is a poor 40-55 %. However, the labels are subjectively determined by comparing the skin with a colour chart, and hence contain widespread small-scale inaccuracies. By working with a "fuzzy accuracy", which deems a prediction of skin tone class to be correct if its difference from the labelled class is not greater than one, much higher accuracy is obtained which provides more convincing evidence that skin tone can be accurately predicted from PPG signals. Three machine learning approaches were used, namely deep learning or tree-based approaches on raw PPG signals, deep learning on image representations of the signals generated by the Symmetric Projection Attractor Reconstruction (SPAR) method, and machine learning on features extracted from the signals. The first method also employed a fuzzy version of the cross entropy loss function, which gave the best results. Tree-based models on raw signals give accuracies up to 55 % and higher fuzzy accuracies up to 96 %, while deep learning models on the SPAR images obtained lower results of 44 % accuracy and 85 % fuzzy accuracy. The machine learning on PPG features gave similar results to the SPAR method with accuracy of 42 % and fuzzy accuracy of 87 %. We have shown that classification of skin tone using PPG signals is possible with high fuzzy accuracy which implies that our modelling approach enables accurate prediction of skin tone class within at most one class of the observer's choice of class, from which we conclude that PPG signals are affected by skin tone in a discernible way.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可穿戴光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号进行 Fitzpatrick 皮肤色调六分类任务，指出传统准确率仅 40-55% 且标签由观察者对照色卡主观判定。作者提出模糊准确率（fuzzy accuracy），将预测类与标注类相差不超过 1 视为正确，从而大幅提升评估结果。比较了三种机器学习路径，其中在原始 PPG 信号上使用树模型并配合模糊交叉熵损失得到最佳模糊准确率 96%。
Motivation: 皮肤色调标签依赖人工对照色卡的主观判断，包含普遍的小尺度误差，使得传统准确率指标严重低估模型能力，难以令人信服地证明 PPG 信号能够预测皮肤色调。
Method: 定义模糊准确率，即预测类与标注类差异不超过 1 即算正确；采用三种建模路线：原始 PPG 信号上的深度或树模型、SPAR 方法生成的信号图像表示上的深度学习、以及信号特征上的机器学习，并在第一种路线中引入模糊版本的交叉熵损失。
Result: 树模型在原始信号上达到 55% 准确率和 96% 模糊准确率；SPAR 图像深度学习为 44% 准确率和 85% 模糊准确率；特征机器学习为 42% 准确率和 87% 模糊准确率；模糊交叉熵损失取得最佳结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为高模糊准确率表明 PPG 信号能以相差至多一个类别的方式可辨地反映皮肤色调，模糊准确率可以有效补偿标签主观性带来的评估偏差。

summary_sections.result: 树模型在原始信号上达到 55% 准确率和 96% 模糊准确率；SPAR 图像深度学习为 44% 准确率和 85% 模糊准确率；特征机器学习为 42% 准确率和 87% 模糊准确率；模糊交叉熵损失取得最佳结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为高模糊准确率表明 PPG 信号能以相差至多一个类别的方式可辨地反映皮肤色调，模糊准确率可以有效补偿标签主观性带来的评估偏差。

papers.title: Frozen DINO Localizes Image Edits Without a Localizer
papers.abstract_en: Localized image edits can change a photograph's meaning while leaving most of it authentic, so forensic analysis must identify where an edit occurred. We show that patch-level perturbation responses from frozen DINO encoders are themselves localization maps. Training-free Localization of AI-image Edits from patch-token Drift (TRAIL) applies one global Haar perturbation and maps cosine drift between corresponding patch tokens. On 80 source-disjoint CocoGlide test images, TRAIL reaches .903 patch AUROC versus .912 for the mask-supervised Detective SAM; fixed-threshold Dice is .619 versus .709, while an oracle threshold raises TRAIL to .790. Transferred unchanged to Poisson image interpolation, TRAIL reaches .855 AUROC versus .864, showing that the cue persists without a generator. Across sixteen DINO encoders, the best block lies at normalized depth .80-.94. Global context matters: AUROC falls from .903 globally to .857 for local-in-canvas perturbations and .735 for independently encoded crops. Frozen DINO patch tokens therefore contain a strong late-layer localization signal whose visibility depends on the perturbation and preserved context. Code: https://github.com/VishalJ99/trail-image-edit-localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的图像编辑定位方法 TRAIL（Training-free Localization of AI-image Edits from patch-token Drift），利用冻结 DINO 编码器的 patch token 在全局 Haar 扰动下的余弦漂移来生成定位图。摘要报告在 80 张源不相交的 CocoGlide 测试图上达到 .903 的 patch AUROC，接近掩码监督的 Detective SAM（.912）；固定阈值的 Dice 为 .619 对 .709，而使用 oracle 阈值可提升到 .790。作者还发现最佳中间层位于归一化深度 .80–.94，且全局上下文对定位性能至关重要。
Motivation: 局部图像编辑可以改变照片含义而大部分内容保持真实，取证分析需要确定编辑发生的位置，但现有方法往往依赖掩码监督或生成器信息。
Method: TRAIL 对整幅图像施加一次全局 Haar 扰动，然后计算冻结 DINO 编码器对应 patch token 之间的余弦漂移（cosine drift），将漂移响应本身作为定位图，全程无需训练。
Result: 摘要报告 TRAIL 在 CocoGlide 测试集上 patch AUROC 为 .903（Detective SAM 为 .912），固定阈值 Dice 为 .619；迁移到 Poisson 图像插值任务时 AUROC 为 .855。全局扰动时 AUROC 为 .903，局部画布内扰动降至 .857，独立编码裁剪块则降至 .735。
Conclusion: 冻结 DINO 的 patch token 在较深层包含强定位信号，但该信号的可见性取决于扰动方式和上下文是否被保留；TRAIL 无需生成器即可工作，但精度仍低于掩码监督方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Institutional Books - Visual Elements: An open-source pipeline for extracting, classifying, deduplicating, and captioning visual elements from digital book collections
papers.abstract_en: Historical book collections contain rich visual elements - such as illustrations, photographs, engravings, and decorative art - that are frequently under-explored in large-scale digitization projects. While Optical Character Recognition (OCR) has standardized the extraction of textual content, these visual components offer a layer of nuance and context that remains largely untapped by automated text extraction workflows. This technical report introduces Institutional Books - Visual Elements, an open-source end-to-end pipeline for detecting, classifying, deduplicating, and captioning visual elements from historical book collections. Alongside this pipeline, we release an initial dataset of 22.6 million visual elements extracted from the 983,004 scanned volumes that comprise the Institutional Books: Harvard Library dataset. This work contributes to ongoing, community-wide efforts to enable new use cases for digitized library collections through computational access, from artificial intelligence model training to digital humanities research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Institutional Books - Visual Elements，一个用于历史书籍数字化收藏中视觉元素提取的开源端到端流水线，涵盖检测、分类、去重和字幕生成（captioning）。作者同时发布了从 983,004 卷扫描中提取的 2260 万视觉元素初始数据集，旨在弥补 OCR 流程对插图、照片、版画等视觉内容挖掘不足的问题。
Motivation: 大规模数字化项目中 OCR 已标准化文本提取，但历史书籍中的插图、版画和装饰艺术等视觉元素长期未被自动化流程充分利用。
Method: 构建并开源一个端到端流水线，对历史书籍中的视觉元素进行检测、分类、去重和生成说明文字，并配套发布提取自 Institutional Books: Harvard Library 数据集的大规模视觉元素数据集。
Result: 摘要报告从 983,004 卷扫描中提取出 2260 万个视觉元素，并作为初始数据集随流水线一起发布。
Conclusion: 该工作支持从 AI 模型训练到数字人文研究的社区性努力，为数字化图书馆收藏的计算访问提供新用例。

papers.title: rEDMRec: Distilling Large Language Model Reasoning into an Editable Experience Memory for Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can improve recommendation quality by reasoning explicitly over user history and candidate items - for example, extracting a user's preferences or explaining why one item fits better than another - rather than mapping history directly to a ranked list. This reasoning, however, is expensive to repeat on every ranking request and, once produced, is typically consumed once and discarded, leaving it neither reusable across future requests nor easy to inspect or correct as user tastes drift. Our insight is that reasoning does not need to be regenerated at every call if it can instead be compressed once into a compact, structured memory that a lightweight model retrieves from. We propose rEDMRec, which distills a teacher LLM's reasoning into four typed, editable experience channels - long-term preference, short-term context, item-perception, and counterfactual hard-negative comparisons - maintained by an LLM memory controller that performs Add/Delete/Modify/Keep operations and refines entries via K-agent debate. A lightweight student LLM then ranks candidates purely by retrieving from this memory, without invoking the teacher again, decoupling online inference cost from reasoning depth. Across ML-1M, Amazon Beauty, and Steam and ten student backbones, rEDMRec improves HR@1 over zero-shot, few-shot, and RAG on every backbone, and over GraphRAG on most backbones, with Impv up to 13.3% vs. the second-best baseline on ML-1M. Channel ablations show that short-term context is the only channel that helps consistently across capacity tiers, whereas long-term, item-perception, and counterfactual contributions are capacity-dependent (and can reverse on the strongest students); debate-based memory optimization lowers bank duplication by 7.4 percentage points while raising downstream HR@1 by up to +0.029 over six optimization epochs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 rEDMRec，将教师大语言模型 (LLM) 的推荐推理压缩为四种可编辑经验通道——长期偏好、短期上下文、商品感知和反事实硬负样本比较——并由 LLM 记忆控制器维护，支持增删改操作和 K-agent 辩论优化。轻量学生 LLM 仅通过检索该记忆进行候选排序，不再调用教师模型，从而将在线推理成本与推理深度解耦。摘要报告在 ML-1M、Amazon Beauty 和 Steam 三个数据集及十个学生骨干上，HR@1 全面超过 zero-shot、few-shot 和 RAG 基线，并在大部分骨干上超过 GraphRAG。
Motivation: LLM 能通过显式推理提升推荐质量，但每次排序请求都重复推理成本高昂，且生成的推理一次性使用，无法在后续请求中复用，也难以随用户偏好漂移进行检查和纠正。
Method: 将教师 LLM 的推理压缩成紧凑、结构化的可编辑经验记忆，包含长期偏好、短期上下文、商品感知和反事实硬负样本比较四个通道；由 LLM 记忆控制器执行 Add/Delete/Modify/Keep 操作，并通过 K-agent 辩论细化条目；学生 LLM 只检索该记忆进行排序，推理时不再调用教师。
Result: 在 ML-1M、Amazon Beauty 和 Steam 上，rEDMRec 在全部十个学生骨干上 HR@1 优于 zero-shot、few-shot 和 RAG，并在大多数骨干上优于 GraphRAG（ML-1M 上最高比第二好基线提升 13.3%）。通道消融显示短期上下文是唯一在所有容量层级上一致有帮助的通道，其余通道贡献依赖容量；基于辩论的记忆优化将记忆库重复率降低 7.4 个百分点，并在六个优化轮次内将下游 HR@1 最高提升 +0.029。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过将教师推理蒸馏为可编辑记忆并让学生模型检索，可以在不重复调用教师的情况下复用推理，从而解耦在线推理成本与推理深度；但不同经验通道的收益是容量依赖的，短期上下文通道最为稳健。

papers.title: AlphaClifford: Efficient Clifford Synthesis and Transpilation with Model-based RL
papers.abstract_en: Clifford circuits play a foundational role in quantum computing, particularly due to their importance in quantum error correction and fault-tolerant logical synthesis. While these circuits can be efficiently simulated and represented as symplectic matrices, standard synthesis methods-such as the Aaronson-Gottesman algorithm-often yield sub-optimal circuits with excessively high gate counts. In this work, we introduce AlphaClifford, a model-based Reinforcement Learning framework powered by Monte Carlo Tree Search, designed to efficiently synthesize Clifford circuits from the fundamental gate set composed of H, S, and CNOT. By modeling the state space through the algebraic properties of the symplectic group, AlphaClifford effectively explores this combinatorial space to minimize overall circuit cost. For unconstrained Clifford optimization, our approach achieves a consistent reduction in both total and two-qubit (CNOT) gate counts compared to state-of-the-art synthesis heuristics, despite operating with a strictly less expressive gate set. Furthermore, we demonstrate the broad applicability of our framework on two additional tasks: hardware-constrained Clifford transpilation, where we outperform existing RL-based compilers, and as a post-synthesis optimization component within a full Clifford+T logical synthesis pipeline. Our results underscore that model-based RL is highly effective at addressing the combinatorial complexities of quantum compilation, offering a scalable pathway to mitigate hardware constraints in both near-term and future fault-tolerant quantum devices.
papers.comment: Accepted manuscript to appear in the proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering (QCE 2026). 11 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AlphaClifford，一个基于模型强化学习（model-based RL）与蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的 Clifford 电路综合与转译框架。它利用辛群（symplectic group）的代数性质建模状态空间，从 {H, S, CNOT} 门集出发最小化电路代价。摘要报告在无约束 Clifford 优化中相对现有启发式方法一致降低总门数和 CNOT 门数，并在硬件约束转译与 Clifford+T 逻辑综合后优化任务上表现良好。
Motivation: Clifford 电路在量子纠错和容错逻辑综合中作用基础，但标准综合方法（如 Aaronson-Gottesman 算法）常生成门数过多的次优电路，需要更高效的自动优化手段。
Method: 提出 AlphaClifford，以蒙特卡洛树搜索驱动的 model-based RL 框架；通过辛群代数性质表示和探索状态空间，以 H、S、CNOT 为基本门集最小化总电路代价，并扩展应用于硬件约束转译及 Clifford+T 流水线的后综合优化。
Result: 摘要称在无约束 Clifford 优化中，即使使用表达力更弱的门集，该方法相比现有综合启发式仍一致减少了总门数和 CNOT 门数；在硬件约束 Clifford 转译任务上优于现有基于 RL 的编译器，并作为 Clifford+T 逻辑综合管线中的后优化组件有效。
Conclusion: 作者认为模型驱动的强化学习能有效应对量子编译的组合复杂性，为近端与未来容错量子设备缓解硬件约束提供了可扩展路径。

papers.title: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
papers.abstract_en: Single-step retrosynthesis is a central component of computer-aided synthesis planning, yet its intrinsically one-to-many nature is poorly captured by single-answer evaluation and benchmarking protocols. To address this, we introduce Top-K prompting as a robust training and inference paradigm to better capture diverse, plausible reaction predictions. We compile CREED-CCV-2+USPTO-XL, an ultra-large-scale dataset of ~45.6 million verified reactions to train the C3LM (Chemistry Constraint-Consistent Language Model). By integrating fine-tuning with ChemCensor-based and novelty-oriented rewards, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the OOD URSA-expert-2026 benchmark. Further analysis of reaction uniqueness shows that LLMs and conventional models explore complementary reaction spaces, motivating ensemble-based retrosynthesis systems. Overall, our results establish Top-K, plausibility-aware training as a practical new direction for robust future LLM-based synthesis planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单步逆合成（single-step retrosynthesis）固有的多解（one-to-many）特性，提出 Top-K prompting 作为训练与推理范式，并构建约 4560 万条已验证反应的超大规模数据集 CREED-CCV-2+USPTO-XL，训练化学约束一致语言模型 C3LM。通过结合 ChemCensor 与新颖性导向奖励的微调，模型在 OOD URSA-expert-2026 基准上取得最优结果。反应唯一性分析还表明 LLM 与传统模型探索互补的反应空间，支持集成式逆合成系统。
Motivation: 单步逆合成是计算机辅助合成规划的核心，但其天然的一对多本质未被单答案评估与基准协议充分刻画，现有方法难以捕捉多样且合理的反应预测。
Method: 提出 Top-K prompting 作为稳健的训练与推理范式；构建约 4560 万条已验证反应的超大规模数据集 CREED-CCV-2+USPTO-XL；训练 C3LM（Chemistry Constraint-Consistent Language Model）并将 ChemCensor 和面向新颖性的奖励纳入微调。
Result: 模型在 OOD URSA-expert-2026 基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能；反应唯一性分析显示 LLM 与传统模型探索互补的反应空间。

papers.title: Breaking the weakest link to evade vision language models
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have recently emerged as a critical component of multimodal AI systems, enabling joint reasoning over visual and textual inputs in real-world and safety-critical applications. Despite their growing deployment, the robustness of VLMs against adversarial threats remains insufficiently explored, particularly in the context of evasion attacks targeting multimodal alignment. In this work, we investigate the vulnerability of VLMs to adversarial perturbations applied to visual inputs and study two attack settings: untargeted attacks, where the goal is to disrupt the model's interpretation of the original image, and targeted attacks, where the adversary aims to force the model to generate a specific semantic description unrelated to the original image. To efficiently generate adversarial examples, we propose a gradient-based attack method that performs optimization exclusively on the vision encoder of the VLM rather than on the entire multimodal architecture. This design significantly reduces the computational cost and resource requirements of the attack while maintaining strong effectiveness. We evaluate our approach on several open-source VLMs, including Qwen2.5-VL, Granite-Vision, FastVLM, and Phi-3.5-Vision, and show that small, human-imperceptible perturbations can substantially alter the textual interpretation produced by the models. Our findings highlight the vulnerability of modern VLMs to adversarial manipulation and emphasize the need for improved robustness and security mechanisms in multimodal AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性，重点关注针对多模态对齐的逃逸攻击。作者提出一种仅在视觉编码器上做梯度优化的攻击方法，以降低计算成本，并在 Qwen2.5-VL、Granite-Vision、FastVLM、Phi-3.5-Vision 等开源模型上验证，表明小幅不可感知扰动可显著改变模型的文本输出。
Motivation: VLM 在安全关键应用中广泛部署，但其对抗鲁棒性，尤其是针对多模态对齐的逃逸攻击，尚未被充分研究；现有攻击通常对整个多模态架构优化，计算开销大。
Method: 提出基于梯度的攻击方法，将对抗扰动优化的范围限制在 VLM 的视觉编码器上，而不是整个多模态架构；方法覆盖无目标攻击（破坏模型对原图的理解）和有目标攻击（迫使模型生成与图像无关的特定语义描述）。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL、Granite-Vision、FastVLM 和 Phi-3.5-Vision 等多个开源 VLM 上，小幅、人眼不可察觉的扰动能够实质性地改变模型生成的文本解释，且仅在视觉编码器上优化仍保持较强攻击效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调现代 VLM 容易受到对抗性操纵，凸显了多模态 AI 系统在鲁棒性和安全机制方面需要改进。

papers.title: MedUAG: Unified Understanding and Generation for Medical Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving into unified understanding and generation (UAG) frameworks. However, extending these unified paradigms to the medical domain is hindered by: the absence of comprehensive training and evaluation benchmarks, and the lack of broadly validated unified medical model. To address these gaps, we present a comprehensive foundation for medical UAG. First, we construct MedUAGCorpus, the largest unified medical understanding and generation dataset to date, comprising over 6 million instances across 14 imaging modalities. Second, we introduce MedUAGBench, a systematic benchmark that expands medical generation evaluation to 12 diverse tasks under standardized protocols. Finally, leveraging these resources, we develop MedUAG, an end-to-end trained unified medical model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MedUAG achieves strong performance across a wide array of understanding and generation tasks, establishing a competitive baseline and paving the way for next-generation medical multimodal systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向医学领域构建统一理解与生成（UAG）框架的基础设施：提出 MedUAGCorpus、MedUAGBench 与 MedUAG 模型。MedUAGCorpus 是目前最大的医学统一理解与生成数据集，包含超过 600 万实例、覆盖 14 种成像模态；MedUAGBench 将医学生成评估扩展到 12 个任务并采用标准化协议；MedUAG 是端到端训练的统一医学模型，实验显示其在多种理解与生成任务上表现强劲。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）正在向统一理解与生成（UAG）框架发展，但该范式难以扩展到医学领域，原因是缺少全面的训练与评估基准，也缺乏经过广泛验证的统一医学模型。
Method: 作者构建了三个组成部分：最大规模医学统一理解与生成数据集 MedUAGCorpus（600 万+实例、14 种成像模态）；系统化基准 MedUAGBench（12 个多样化任务、标准化协议）；以及基于这些资源端到端训练的统一医学模型 MedUAG。
Result: 广泛实验表明 MedUAG 在一系列理解与生成任务上取得强性能，建立了有竞争力的基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为下一代医学多模态系统奠定了基础，但摘要未提及具体局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Graphical Design of Interpretable Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Designing, implementing, and comparing interpretable architectures requires a formal language to represent them. The most common representations fall short in one of two ways. Symbolic equations give no global view of an architecture at a glance. Probabilistic graphical models and flowcharts do not describe actual tensor manipulations, thus hiding key insights and limiting reproducibility. To close this gap, we introduce a graphical notation for designing interpretable AI architectures, adapted from Penrose tensor notation. This graphical notation gives a global view of an architecture and maps one to one onto PyTorch einsum code. We first use this notation to describe architectures that are interpretable by construction, including concept bottlenecks, sparse probes, prototype networks, neural additive models, and mixtures of linear models. We then diagram the key architectural components of Steerling-8B, a frontier interpretable language model. The diagram yields global insights into the architecture (e.g., showing that Steerling is a residual model), a geometric interpretation of each individual operation, and a direct translation into 33 lines of PyTorch code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于设计和表示可解释 AI 架构的图形化记号，改编自 Penrose 张量记号，可与 PyTorch einsum 代码一一对应。作者用该记号描述概念瓶颈、稀疏探针、原型网络、神经加性模型和线性模型混合等可解释架构，并绘制了前沿可解释语言模型 Steerling-8B 的架构图，展示其残差结构、逐操作的几何解释，并直接翻译为 33 行 PyTorch 代码。
Motivation: 现有可解释架构的表示方式存在不足：符号方程缺乏全局视图，概率图模型和流程图无法描述实际的张量操作，从而隐藏关键细节并限制可复现性。
Method: 引入一种改编自 Penrose 张量记号的图形化记号，使架构表示既能提供全局视图，又能与 PyTorch einsum 代码逐行对应，用于设计可解释架构和绘制现有模型。
Result: 摘要报告该记号成功描述了包括概念瓶颈、稀疏探针、原型网络、神经加性模型和线性模型混合在内的可解释架构，并将 Steerling-8B 的架构完整绘制成图并翻译为 33 行 PyTorch 代码。
Conclusion: 该图形化记号提供了一种兼具全局性与可复现性的架构表示方式，可直接指导可解释 AI 的建模与实现。
