papers.title: SkillForge: Self-Distilling Agents for Project-Specific Issue Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) based agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in automated software issue resolution, yet they often struggle to resolve issues in a specific repository because they lack project-specific knowledge. Existing self-evolving approaches acquire such knowledge from repository history or online repair trajectories, but they either depend on available historical issue-resolution signals or incur substantial per-issue test-time exploration cost. In this paper, we propose SkillForge, a self-distillation framework that proactively acquires project-specific knowledge from the repository itself. Instead of waiting for real issues to expose project-specific knowledge gaps, SkillForge synthesizes project-specific issues by re-implementing test-covered core functionalities of the repository. By resolving these synthetic issues, SkillForge distills reusable project-specific knowledge into entity-grounded skills and associates them with relevant repository entities for future issue resolution. Extensive experiments using both open-source and closed-source models show that SkillForge consistently improves issue resolution performance over strong baselines. These results demonstrate that proactively acquiring project-specific knowledge before solving real issues substantially improves downstream software issue resolution.
papers.comment: Our code and data are available at https://github.com/cslsolow/SkillForge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillForge，一个面向项目特定软件问题修复的自蒸馏框架。其核心是让基于 LLM 的智能体先根据仓库中测试覆盖的核心功能合成项目特定问题，再通过解决这些合成问题把可复用的项目特定知识蒸馏为与实体绑定的技能 (entity-grounded skills)，供后续真实问题修复使用。实验基于开源与闭源模型，报告该方法在 issue resolution 上持续优于强基线。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的智能体在自动化软件问题修复中缺乏项目特定知识；现有自演进方法要么依赖仓库历史中的 issue-resolution 信号，要么为每个问题付出大量测试时探索成本。需要一种不依赖历史信号、且不增加逐问题探索开销的知识获取方式。
Method: SkillForge 通过重新实现仓库中被测试覆盖的核心功能来合成项目特定问题，让智能体解决这些合成问题；随后将解决过程中获得的可复用知识蒸馏为与仓库实体关联的技能，以便后续真实 issue 修复时调用。
Result: 摘要报告在开源与闭源模型上的大量实验中，SkillForge 一致地提升了 issue resolution 性能，超过强基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为在解决真实问题之前主动获取项目特定知识能显著改善下游软件 issue 修复效果。

papers.title: Transportable Causal Effect Estimation across Networks under Interference
papers.abstract_en: Estimating causal effects under network interference typically assumes that the network used for training and the network used for deployment coincide. In practice, an intervention is run on one population while the question of interest concerns a different population, and the two generally differ in topology, node-covariate composition, and spillover pathways. Transporting a causal effect across networks is therefore a data-fusion problem that no existing algorithm solves. We employ a selection diagram, extended to the network setting so that covariate shift and structural network shift enter as separate selectors, and derive from it a transport formula for the direct, spillover, and total effects in the deployment population. Each formula makes explicit which interventional mechanism is assumed invariant and which observational distribution must be reweighted. We then turn the formulas into TranCE (Transported Causal Effects), a doubly-robust algorithm combining an interventional outcome model, a domain density-ratio correction, and cross-fitted inference. Extensive experiments on two semi-synthetic benchmarks derived from real-world social networks and on a fully real weather-insurance field experiment, where the transported effects are checked against held-out randomized estimates, confirm the effectiveness of our approach. Our findings have the potential to improve intervention strategies in networked systems, particularly in social networks and public health.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究网络干扰 (network interference) 下的因果效应迁移问题：训练网络与部署网络在拓扑、节点协变量组成和溢出路径上通常不同，而已有方法默认二者一致。作者将选择图 (selection diagram) 扩展到网络设定，用独立的选择器分别表示协变量偏移与结构网络偏移，并为部署总体中的直接效应、溢出效应和总效应导出传输公式。基于这些公式提出 TranCE，一种结合干预结局模型、领域密度比校正和交叉拟合推断的双稳健算法。实验在来自真实社交网络的两个半合成基准和一个真实天气保险实地试验上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 在具有干扰 (interference) 的网络中估计因果效应通常假设训练与部署网络重合，但实际中的干预总体与目标总体往往不同，且拓扑、节点协变量组成与溢出路径均有差异。摘要指出该跨网络因果效应传输是一个尚无现有算法解决的数据融合 (data-fusion) 问题。
Method: 将选择图推广到网络场景，使协变量偏移与结构性网络偏移分别进入选择器，并据此推导部署总体中直接、溢出和总效应的传输公式。随后把公式实现为 TranCE (Transported Causal Effects)，一个双稳健 (doubly-robust) 算法，包含干预结局模型、领域密度比校正 (domain density-ratio correction) 与交叉拟合推断 (cross-fitted inference)。
Result: 摘要报告在两个基于真实社交网络的半合成基准以及一个真实天气保险实地试验上进行了广泛实验，并将传输效应与留出随机化估计进行对照，结果确认了方法的有效性。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法有望改进网络系统中的干预策略，尤其在社交网络和公共卫生领域。摘要并未讨论方法的局限性。

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling in the Wild: Why Exploitation, Not Exploration, Is the Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves language model outputs by spending additional inference compute - generating multiple candidates, searching over partial sequences, or iteratively refining drafts. These techniques yield large gains on mathematics and code, but have been developed and stress-tested almost exclusively on tasks where verification is straightforward. We conduct the first compute-normalised comparison of five TTS families across five open-ended generation benchmarks spanning medicine, law, finance, general chat, and creative writing - grounded in a unified framework that decomposes the effectiveness of each method's token budget into exploration and exploitation. The answer depends on which side of that decomposition you examine. Scaling exploration works: the best candidate in the pool improves steadily with compute across all settings. What breaks is exploitation - the step that converts a rich candidate pool into a final output. With state-of-the-art generators, reward models correlate at only $ρ_v \approx 0.12$ with true quality, rendering selection near-random regardless of budget. Tree search amplifies this failure through diversity collapse. Refinement helps on one of five benchmarks; its apparent gains elsewhere are confounded. Only synthesis across candidates (Fusion) consistently improves over single-sample baselines, yet still recovers only ~40% of available quality. The candidate pool is not the bottleneck - choosing from it is.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对五种测试时扩展 (test-time scaling, TTS) 方法族在医学、法律、金融、通用对话和创意写作五个开放式生成基准上进行计算量归一化比较，并提出统一的探索-利用分解框架。摘要发现扩展探索有效，候选池中最佳输出随计算量稳定提升；瓶颈在于利用阶段，奖励模型与真实质量的相关性仅约 ρ_v≈0.12，导致选择近乎随机。融合 (Fusion) 是唯一稳定优于单样本基线的方法，但仍只能恢复约 40% 的可用质量。
Motivation: TTS 技术在数学和代码任务上收益显著，但这些任务验证简单；开放式生成任务中验证困难，现有方法几乎未在此类场景下被系统测试。作者希望弄清开放式场景下 TTS 的 token 预算究竟消耗在探索还是利用，以及哪一侧才是真正的性能瓶颈。
Method: 提出一个统一框架，将每种 TTS 方法的 token 预算分解为探索 (exploration) 和利用 (exploitation) 两部分；在五个开放式基准上对五种 TTS 方法族进行计算量归一化比较，包括候选生成、树搜索、迭代精炼与跨候选合成等。摘要未给出具体模型名称。
Result: 扩展探索有效：候选池中的最佳输出随计算量在所有设置下稳定提升。破坏性能的是利用环节：在 SOTA 生成器下奖励模型与真实质量相关性仅约 ρ_v≈0.12，使选择几乎随机；树搜索通过多样性崩溃放大该失败；精炼仅在五个基准之一有效，其余收益存在混淆；只有跨候选合成 (Fusion) 一致优于单样本基线，但仍仅恢复约 40% 的可用质量。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是开放式生成中候选池本身不是瓶颈，从候选池中选择或合成最终输出的利用步骤才是瓶颈。作者据此暗示研究重点应从扩大候选数量转向改进选择与合成机制；该结论基于摘要层面的分析，未涉及具体模型与实现细节。

papers.title: SMTrap: Cost-Effective DoS Attacks Against Large Reasoning Models via SMT Conflict Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Existing LRM-DoS methods rely heavily on model feedback to synthesize attack queries, requiring either repeated queries to the target model or training a dedicated attack model. These expensive operations severely weaken attack leverage. In this paper, we propose \emph{search amplification}, a novel, model-feedback-free LRM-DoS paradigm. It employs the conflict count derived from an Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solver as a low-cost external signal to guide the synthesis of inference-heavy Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP) instances. Our key observation is that LRMs depend on trial-and-backtracking search when solving CSPs, where higher SMT conflict counts on a given CSP instance positively correlate with more extensive LRM backtracking search and substantially longer output trajectories. Building on this finding, we propose \textsc{SMTrap}, a lightweight, CPU-only framework. Guided by SMT conflict counts, \textsc{SMTrap} generates inference-heavy CSP queries without model queries, attack-model training, or GPU computation. Evaluations across seven frontier models demonstrate the state-of-the-art LRM-DoS capability of \textsc{SMTrap}, producing DoS effects multiple times stronger than existing baselines. To mitigate the threat of \textsc{SMTrap}, we demonstrate a tool-based mitigation that significantly cuts token usage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SMTrap，一种针对大型推理模型 (LRM) 的拒绝服务攻击 (DoS) 框架。其核心思想是利用 SMT 求解器产生的冲突计数 (conflict count) 作为外部信号，无需查询目标模型或训练攻击模型，即可合成推理密集的约束满足问题 (CSP) 实例，诱导 LRM 进行大量回溯搜索并产生超长输出轨迹。作者在七个前沿模型上评估，称其 DoS 效果比现有基线强数倍，并展示了一种基于工具的缓解措施。
Motivation: 现有 LRM-DoS 方法依赖目标模型的反馈来合成攻击查询，要么反复查询目标模型，要么训练专用攻击模型，成本高昂，削弱了攻击的杠杆效应。
Method: 提出 search amplification 范式，利用 SMT 求解器得到的冲突计数作为低成本外部信号，引导生成推理密集的 CSP 实例；SMTrap 是仅需 CPU 的轻量框架，不需要模型查询、攻击模型训练或 GPU 计算。
Result: 在七个前沿模型上的评估显示 SMTrap 达到当前最优的 LRM-DoS 能力，产生比现有基线强数倍的 DoS 效果；此外还展示了一种基于工具 (tool-based) 的缓解方法，可显著降低 token 使用。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SMT 冲突计数与 LRM 在 CSP 上的回溯搜索深度正相关，并以此构建了低成本的 DoS 攻击；同时指出该威胁可以通过工具辅助的缓解措施得到削弱。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Lost in Aggregation: How Benchmarks Overlook Irreplaceable Model Strengths
papers.abstract_en: Tabular machine learning benchmarks typically summarize performance by averaging scores, ranks, or pairwise wins across datasets. Such aggregates are useful for selecting robust default models, but they can obscure a different question: which models are necessary to attain peak performance on particular datasets? We argue that benchmark evaluation should also consider the data-centric peak performance frontier, defined by the best statistically supported performance achieved on each dataset. From this perspective, a model may be irreplaceable, sufficient, redundant, or fallible depending on where it lies on the frontier relative to other models. Applying this framework to the TabArena benchmark, we find that common aggregation metrics are highly correlated and largely measure consistency and avoiding failures, while being much less aligned with dataset-level irreplaceability. Consequently, models performing decently across datasets without ever being the best choice are rewarded while models with unique dataset-specific strengths appear mediocre under aggregation. Hence, benchmark progress should be measured not only by improvements on aggregation metrics but also by whether new models expand the set of attainable peak performances across datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出表格型机器学习基准通常用平均分数、排名或两两胜场等聚合指标评估模型，但这会掩盖另一个问题：在特定数据集上达到最优性能究竟需要哪些模型。作者提出以数据为中心的峰值性能前沿（data-centric peak performance frontier）视角，将模型划分为不可替代、充分、冗余和易失手四类，并在 TabArena 基准上验证了这一框架。
Motivation: 现有基准聚合指标适合挑选稳健的默认模型，但无法回答哪些模型对特定数据集的最优表现是必要的，导致具有独特数据集特长的模型被低估。
Method: 提出以每个数据集上统计上最优可达性能定义峰值性能前沿，并依据模型相对于该前沿的位置将其归类为 irreplaceable、sufficient、redundant 或 fallible，然后在 TabArena 基准上应用该框架。
Result: 摘要报告常见聚合指标彼此高度相关，主要衡量一致性与避免失败，而与数据集层面的不可替代性对齐较弱；因此表现均衡但从不最优的模型在聚合指标上被奖励，而具有独特数据集专长的模型显得平庸。
Conclusion: 基准进展不仅应看聚合指标提升，还应考察新模型是否扩展了各数据集上可达到的峰值性能集合。

papers.title: Score the Algebra, Not the Span: Dimension Reduction for Transfer Operator Models of Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Dimension reduction for dynamical systems is standard practice, and the standard route is spectral: model the transfer (Koopman) operator by its leading modes. We show that on systems assembled from several weakly interacting components --- a structure common in physical and biological settings --- this may either require an exponential number of modes, or drop an entire component: the component is absent from the model rather than modeled coarsely, and no function of it can be predicted at any accuracy. We call this linear masking. The cause is that a rank-based model pays one coordinate per mode. We propose to score instead the $σ$-algebra the coordinates generate, so that products and powers come free and a component's cost is governed only by its generators rather than by all its interactions. The criterion is a $χ^2$-divergence between the embedded present and future, and it carries a budget guarantee: twice the intrinsic dimension of the dynamics is enough coordinates for an embedding whose algebra carries the operator's entire spectrum, with its full infinite rank. In variational form the criterion admits off-the-shelf estimators, and restricting its critic to the bilinear class returns the VAMP score on the span, so rank-based methods are one end of the same family. We demonstrate the proposed objective on a composite of published benchmark systems. We exhibit examples where the rank-based methods completely miss the masked components at all ranks $k<100$, while ten algebra coordinates recover all of them. In addition, the resulting algebra representation supports predicting the masked components from few labels, while direct regression from the high-dimensional observation or from the VAMP features fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动力学系统中传递算子（transfer/Koopman operator）的降维问题，指出基于前导模态的谱方法在弱耦合组件系统中会出现线性掩盖（linear masking），即完全丢失某个组件。作者提出对坐标生成的 σ-代数打分，以嵌入的现在与未来之间的 χ² 散度为准则，并给出两倍内在维数即可承载完整谱的预算保证。在复合基准系统上的实验显示，秩方法在 k<100 时完全错过被掩盖组件，而十个代数坐标可全部恢复，并支持少标签预测。
Motivation: 标准做法是对传递算子取前导模态做谱降维，但系统由多个弱相互作用组件构成时，该方法要么需要指数多个模态，要么直接丢弃整个组件，且该组件的任何函数都无法被预测；作者称之为线性掩盖。
Method: 提出对坐标生成的 σ-代数评分而非对坐标张成空间评分，使乘积与幂次免费，组件成本只由其生成元决定。准则为嵌入的现在与未来之间的 χ² 散度（χ²-divergence），其变分形式可用现成估计器；将判别器限制为双线性类时退化为 VAMP 分数。
Result: 理论保证是两倍内在维数的坐标足以让代数承载算子的完整无限秩谱。在发布的基准系统复合实验上，秩方法对所有 k<100 完全错过被掩盖组件，而十个代数坐标全部恢复；代数表示还能从少量标签预测被掩盖组件，而直接从高维观测或 VAMP 特征回归失败。
Conclusion: 作者认为用代数而非张成空间作为打分对象可以避免线性掩盖，且与 VAMP 等秩方法同属一个方法族；摘要中的验证限于复合基准系统。

papers.title: Simple, Safe, and Overlooked: Reclaiming Sustainable Domain Generalization with Statistical Color Matching
papers.abstract_en: Hardware shifts, color variations, and changing patient characteristics between development and deployment routinely break trained medical image classifiers. Existing remedies fall short: standard color jittering provides insufficient diversity, while deep generative style transfer algorithms hallucinate features, destroy clinically relevant structures, and waste massive compute resources. To address this, we revisit classical statistical color matching and repurpose it as Colorist, a highly efficient data augmentation strategy that applies global mean-standard deviation matching directly in the RGB color space. We demonstrate that this training-free, fully interpretable approach safely generates structurally intact domain variations, outperforming deep generative models in structural fidelity and color alignment. Across out-of-distribution histopathology, peripheral blood, dermatology, and retinal datasets, it improves balanced accuracy by up to +9% over state-of-the-art domain generalization regularizers and by +13% over an unaugmented baseline. Moreover, by avoiding neural networks in the augmentation loop, Colorist preserves anatomical structure, minimizes carbon footprint, and integrates seamlessly into standard dataloaders. Together, these findings establish statistical matching as a safe, interpretable, yet overlooked alternative to deep architectures for clinical robustness. Source code is available at https://github.com/sdoerrich97/colorist.
papers.comment: Accepted to DEMI @ MICCAI 2026 (4th Workshop in Data Engineering in Medical Imaging)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Colorist，一种基于经典统计颜色匹配的数据增强策略，直接在 RGB 空间对全局均值-标准差进行匹配，用于提升医学图像分类器在域分布偏移下的鲁棒性。实验覆盖组织病理、外周血、皮肤科和视网膜数据集，报告相比最先进的域泛化正则化方法，平衡准确率最高提升 +9%，相比无增强基线最高提升 +13%。该方法无需训练、完全可解释，并声称比深度生成式风格迁移更保结构、更省算力。
Motivation: 训练与部署之间的硬件变化、颜色差异和患者特征漂移会破坏医学图像分类器；现有方案中，标准颜色抖动多样性不足，深度生成风格迁移会伪造特征、破坏临床相关结构并消耗大量计算资源。
Method: 重新利用经典统计颜色匹配，将其改造为 Colorist 数据增强：直接在 RGB 颜色空间进行全局均值-标准差匹配，无需训练，完全可解释，并声称能无缝集成到标准 dataloader。
Result: 在多种带外分布（out-of-distribution）的医学影像数据集（组织病理、外周血、皮肤科、视网膜）上，相对最先进域泛化正则化器平衡准确率最高提升 +9%，相对无增强基线最高提升 +13%；同时避免在增强回路中使用神经网络，从而保留解剖结构并降低碳排放。
Conclusion: 统计颜色匹配是医学影像临床鲁棒性问题上一种安全、可解释且被忽视的替代方案，但论文的应用场景限定于医学图像分类的域偏移。

papers.title: Converting Expert Deliberation into Financial Signals Through A Context-Aware NLP Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the CDSP (context-conditional deliberation signal pipeline), converting an investment committee's meeting transcripts into structured predictive features. CDSP segments the meeting transcripts into topical chunks, assigns asset-class context labels using a large language model (LLM), maps financial keywords to a pre-determined taxonomy of labels, and constructs complementary features: sentiment polarity and mention frequency. This feature engineering framework is applied to a dataset spanning 48 monthly committee meetings to predict if global equities will perform better or worse than global bonds in the following month. In experiments with engineered features, raw transcript text, sentence embeddings, and combined representations, the prediction accuracy ranges from 62% to 73%, compared to always choosing stocks, which outperforms bonds 60.4% of the time. The best (73% accurate) model combines sentence embeddings with engineered CDSP features, achieving a 0.73 F1 score (although this is not statistically significant compared to always choosing stocks). Sentiment carries a stronger signal than mention frequency for several taxonomy categories. These findings suggest that experts' deliberations may contain forward-looking information that context-aware NLP can extract.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CDSP（context-conditional deliberation signal pipeline），将投资委员会的会议记录转化为结构化预测特征。管道将会议记录切分为主题块、用大语言模型（LLM）赋予资产类别上下文标签、将金融关键词映射到预定义标签体系，并构建情感极性与提及频率等互补特征。基于 48 次月度委员会会议数据，用于预测次月全球股票是否跑赢全球债券，预测准确率在 62%–73% 之间，最佳模型结合句子嵌入与 CDSP 特征达到 73% 准确率和 0.73 的 F1 分数。
Motivation: 专家会议讨论可能包含前瞻性信息，但原始会议记录是非结构化文本，难以直接用于生成金融预测信号。作者希望验证通过上下文感知的 NLP 特征工程能否从专家审议中提取可用的预测信号。
Method: 构建 CDSP 管道，包括会议记录分段、利用大语言模型分配资产类别上下文标签、将金融关键词映射到预定义标签体系，并生成情感极性和提及频率两类补充特征。实验对比了仅用工程特征、原始文本、句子嵌入以及组合表示等不同输入形式。
Result: 在 48 次月度会议数据集上，预测全球股票相对全球债券次月表现的准确率范围为 62%–73%，而始终选择股票的基准胜率为 60.4%。最佳模型（句子嵌入加 CDSP 特征）达到 73% 准确率和 0.73 F1 分数，但该结果相对始终选股并不具有统计显著性；此外，部分类别中情感信号比提及频率更强。
Conclusion: 摘要认为专家审议可能含有可被上下文感知 NLP 提取的前瞻性信息，但当前最佳模型的优势未达统计显著性，方法仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: On the Slow Convergence to Trivial Solutions of Algorithms for Hard Optimization Problems
papers.abstract_en: Hard combinatorial optimization problems, many of which are NP-hard, present fundamental algorithmic challenges. Average-case analysis on random instances has emerged as a powerful framework for understanding typical algorithmic performance beyond worst-case guarantees. A substantial body of work has established negative results: for sufficiently hard instances (often controlled by the underlying graph connectivity/constraints density), no known polynomial-time algorithm can significantly outperform naive heuristics in the double asymptotic limit where both problem size and constraints density tend to infinity. We revisit this picture by studying the finite-size behavior of some optimization algorithms across easy, intermediate, and hard regimes. Through rigorous analysis of large-graph asymptotics combined with numerical experiments on canonical problems (maximum independent set and maximum $K$-SAT), we demonstrate that while algorithms do eventually converge to theoretically predicted bounds, this convergence can be remarkably slow. In the intermediate regime where instances are already highly constrained, local algorithms achieve solutions substantially better than their predicted performance in the high-constraint-density limit. This gap between finite-regime and asymptotic behavior has important practical implications: sophisticated algorithmic design remains crucial even when asymptotic theory predicts inevitable failure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机困难组合优化实例上算法的有限尺寸行为，对象包括最大独立集 (maximum independent set) 与最大 K-SAT。作者通过大型图渐近的严格分析结合数值实验发现，算法最终确实收敛到理论预测的界限，但收敛速度可能非常缓慢；在实例已经高度受约束的中间区域，局部算法得到的解显著优于高约束密度极限下的预测值。作者据此指出，渐近理论预示失败时，精细的算法设计仍然具有实际价值。
Motivation: 平均情况分析已给出大量负面结果：在问题规模与约束密度同时趋于无穷的双重极限下，没有已知多项式时间算法能显著优于朴素启发式。本文认为该图景忽略了有限尺寸行为，并关注中间区域内理论与实际性能差距带来的实践影响。
Method: 对大型图渐近进行严格分析，并结合对典型问题（最大独立集和最大 K-SAT）的数值实验，研究算法在容易、中间和困难三个区域的有限尺寸行为。
Result: 摘要报告算法虽然会收敛到理论上界，但收敛可能极其缓慢；在中间区域（实例已高度受约束）中，局部算法获得的解质量显著超过高约束密度极限下的理论预测。
Conclusion: 作者强调有限区域与渐近行为之间的差距具有重要实际意义：即使渐近理论预测必然失败，复杂的算法设计仍然不可或缺。

papers.title: Learning-State-Aware Dynamic Generative Data Augmentation on Small-Scale Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Small-scale image classification is often limited by the scarcity of training data. Generative data augmentation (GDA) based on pretrained generative models has emerged as an effective solution. However, existing methods rely on task-agnostic augmentation strategies that overlook downstream model needs. Although recent dynamic GDA methods incorporate model feedback to guide augmentation, they still struggle to reliably determine sample-specific augmentation strengths and adapt augmentation strategies to different image regions while balancing image diversity and class semantics. To address these issues, we propose learning-state-aware dynamic generative data augmentation (LSADA). Specifically, LSADA constructs a learning state for each sample based on its current loss and loss-decrease rate, which is then mapped to a sample-specific augmentation strength. Furthermore, LSADA introduces a decoupled data augmentation and diffusion fusion strategy that applies strength-controlled transformations to class-relevant regions and generates diverse class-irrelevant regions, progressively fusing them to improve image diversity while preserving class semantics. Experiments on nine public datasets show that LSADA outperforms the existing SOTA dynamic GDA method by an average of 4.5% on six natural image datasets and 2.5% on three medical image datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出学习状态感知的动态生成数据增强方法 LSADA，面向小样本图像分类。LSADA 根据每个样本的当前损失与损失下降率构造学习状态，并映射为样本特定的增强强度；同时引入解耦的数据增强与扩散融合策略，对类别相关区域施加受控变换、生成多样类别无关区域并渐进融合。在九个公开数据集上，相比现有 SOTA 动态 GDA 方法，六个自然图像数据集平均提升 4.5%，三个医学图像数据集平均提升 2.5%。
Motivation: 现有生成式数据增强（GDA）多采用任务无关的增强策略，忽略下游模型的实际需求；已有的动态方法虽引入模型反馈，但仍难以可靠确定样本级增强强度，也难以对不同图像区域自适应增强并平衡图像多样性与类别语义。
Method: LSADA 为每个样本构建由当前损失与损失下降率组成的学习状态，并将其映射为样本特定增强强度；进一步提出解耦的数据增强与扩散融合策略，对类别相关区域施加强度受控的变换，同时生成多样的类别无关区域并渐进融合，以提升多样性同时保留类别语义。
Result: 在九个公开数据集上的实验表明，LSADA 相比现有 SOTA 动态 GDA 方法，在六个自然图像数据集上平均提升 4.5%，在三个医学图像数据集上平均提升 2.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过感知下游模型的学习状态并对不同图像区域解耦处理，LSADA 能更可靠地平衡小样本图像分类中的多样性提升与类别语义保持。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A FEM-Based Surrogate Modelling and Optimization Framework for Physics-Constrained Electromagnetic Coil Design
papers.abstract_en: This work evaluates surrogate-assisted optimization of a seven-parameter current-excited coil--core benchmark subject to geometric, manufacturing, and separate core and copper mass constraints. A Python--MPh--COMSOL workflow couples a two-dimensional axisymmetric finite-element method (FEM) model to a Matern 5/2 Gaussian-process (GP) probabilistic surrogate. Here, physics-constrained denotes a design problem evaluated by a governing-equation FEM model and restricted by explicit physical, geometric, manufacturing, and material-allocation constraints; it does not denote a physics-informed GP architecture. Sequential Bayesian optimization (BO) ranks candidates using expected improvement (EI), and every reported incumbent is verified by FEM. Five paired runs show that optimizer ranking depends on the available FEM-evaluation budget: EI--BO improves rapidly at small continuation budgets, COBYLA is stronger at the earliest checkpoint, and BOBYQA attains the highest mean terminal response. A retrospective finite-pool study further finds no robust endpoint advantage of EI over posterior-mean ranking on this smooth response surface. The broader result is that early progress, terminal response, information use, and wall-clock cost can favor different methods in simulation-driven design. A selected-design check at a common total current preserves the observed BOBYQA--COBYLA--EI-BO ordering. The conclusions nevertheless remain conditional on this axisymmetric benchmark and do not establish a fixed-current optimum, fixed-power performance, or electrical-efficiency superiority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估七参数电流激励线圈-铁芯基准上的代理辅助优化，使用Python-MPh-COMSOL工作流将二维轴对称有限元模型（FEM）与Matern 5/2高斯过程（GP）概率代理耦合，并通过序贯贝叶斯优化（BO）和期望提升（EI）对候选排序，每个报告的当前最优解均经FEM验证。五对配对运行表明，优化器排名取决于FEM评估预算：EI-BO在小延续预算下快速改进，COBYLA在最早检查点更强，BOBYQA获得最高平均终端响应。结论仅限于该轴对称基准，不建立固定电流最优、固定功率性能或电效率优越性。
Motivation: 仿真驱动设计中，早期进展、终端响应、信息利用和墙钟成本可能偏向不同优化方法，需要系统评估代理辅助优化在物理约束电磁线圈设计中的表现，以理解方法选择的权衡。

Conclusion: 结论有条件性，仅适用于该轴对称基准，不建立固定电流最优、固定功率性能或电效率优越性；不同优化方法可能在早期进度、终端响应、信息使用和墙钟成本上各具优势。

papers.title: Quantum Tensor Network Learning with DMRG
papers.abstract_en: Tensor Networks are a relatively new machine learning approach. The architectures proposed initially are inspired by approaches from quantum many-body physics simulations. One common layout is the matrix product state (MPS) also known as a tensor train optimized with gradient descent techniques. We introduce a global normalization condition, so that the MPS represents a quantum state. We investigate two optimization methods that find the locally optimal tensors and compare them regarding their effectiveness. One is based on gradient descent and the other on an adaptation of DMRG.
papers.journal_ref: ESANN 2025 Proceedings pp. 537-542
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在张量网络机器学习中引入全局归一化条件，使矩阵乘积态（MPS，即张量训练格式）表示一个量子态，并比较两种寻找局部最优张量的优化方法：梯度下降和改编的 DMRG 算法。摘要报告两者在有效性上的比较，但未给出具体数值。
Motivation: 张量网络是较新的机器学习方法，其初始架构受量子多体物理模拟启发，而 MPS 通常用梯度下降优化；本文希望引入全局归一化条件使 MPS 成为量子态，并考察更有效的优化途径。
Method: 引入全局归一化条件，使 MPS 表示量子态；对比基于梯度下降的优化与基于 DMRG（密度矩阵重整化群）改编的优化两种方法。
Result: 摘要仅说明比较了两种方法在有效性上的差异，未报告具体实验数字或基准。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过全局归一化条件将 MPS 与量子态对应，并比较两种局部最优张量求解方法是可行且有意义的。

papers.title: \textsc{TestifAI}: Tomography-Based Testing for Deep Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical application domains (e.g., autonomous driving), associated risks increase too. Deep learning models underlying modern AI systems, therefore, must undergo thorough testing to ensure their correct behaviour. A single robustness test involves thousands of inferences to empirically verify if a model's outputs remain stable under a bounded perturbation of its inputs. However, existing testing frameworks lack the means to systematically explore and summarise robustness across a combinatorial space of perturbations. We propose TestifAI, a deep learning testing framework for efficient and accurate estimation of robustness against combinations of perturbations. TestifAI enables users to specify operational conditions as structured spaces of semantic input perturbations (e.g., image blur, brightness and zoom) and discrete severity levels (e.g., low, medium and high). Users can query model robustness for any combination (e.g., "low blur, high brightness, and medium zoom"). To achieve efficiency and accuracy, TestifAI introduces partial model tomography, a novel approach to reconstructing model behaviour in a multi-perturbation space from tests that apply only a small number of perturbations (lower-order projections). To estimate robustness against at least three perturbations, TestifAI trains an auxiliary model on the results of tests involving up to two perturbations only, avoiding execution of an exponential number of tests. Our experiments on five image and language classification tasks show that TestifAI can predict higher-order (3 and 4 perturbations) test outcomes from low-order (1 and 2 perturbations) observations with an aggregate robustness estimation error of less than 7%, while reducing the number of inferences by 60-80%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TestifAI，一个面向深度学习系统的鲁棒性测试框架，用于高效且准确地估计模型在组合扰动下的鲁棒性。其核心是部分模型断层扫描 (partial model tomography)：仅用低阶（1-2 个扰动）测试结果训练辅助模型，来预测高阶（3-4 个扰动）测试结果，从而避免指数级数量的测试。在五个图像和语言分类任务上，聚合鲁棒性估计误差低于 7%，推理次数减少 60-80%。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在安全关键领域（如自动驾驶）的部署要求充分测试鲁棒性，但单次鲁棒性测试已需数千次推理，现有框架缺乏对组合扰动空间进行系统探索和总结的手段，面对指数级扰动组合时成本过高。
Method: TestifAI 允许用户将操作条件表示为语义扰动（如模糊、亮度、缩放）和离散严重级别（低、中、高）的结构化空间，并查询任意组合下的鲁棒性。框架引入 partial model tomography，通过仅涉及少量扰动的低阶投影重构多扰动空间中的模型行为；对于至少三个扰动的鲁棒性估计，辅助模型只基于最多两个扰动的测试结果训练，避免执行指数级测试。
Result: 在五个图像和语言分类任务上，TestifAI 能从 1-2 阶观测预测 3-4 阶测试结果，聚合鲁棒性估计误差小于 7%，并将推理次数减少 60-80%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TestifAI 为组合扰动空间中的深度学习鲁棒性测试提供了一种高效且准确的估计途径，适用于安全关键 AI 系统的测试需求。

papers.title: Syntactic Simplification of OWL Class Expressions
papers.abstract_en: Class expression learning often produces complex OWL class expressions that are difficult to interpret and reason over. However, by following theoretically grounded simplification principles, this complexity can be reduced. In this paper, we propose Class Expression Simplifier (CES), a novel algorithm for the syntactic simplification of class expressions in Description Logics (DL). CES aims to preserve formal semantics while reducing representational complexity. It systematically applies rewriting rules to eliminate redundancies and identify simpler yet equivalent expressions, thereby producing more compact and human-readable representations without altering logical entailments. We evaluate the effectiveness of CES on class expressions learned from two medium-sized ontologies, demonstrating measurable improvements in reasoning efficiency and reductions in verbosity. This work contributes to the broader goal of making ontology-driven applications more accessible, maintainable, and scalable, with direct implications for knowledge graph construction, semantic search, and Web-scale reasoning. CES is implemented within the open-source Python framework OWLAPY and is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Class Expression Simplifier (CES)，一个用于描述逻辑 (Description Logics, DL) 中 OWL 类表达式语法简化的算法。CES 在保持形式语义和不改变逻辑蕴含的前提下，系统应用重写规则消除冗余并识别更简单但等价的表达式，从而生成更紧凑、更易读的表示。作者在两个中等规模本体上评估了从学习到的类表达式上的效果，报告了推理效率的提升和冗长度 (verbosity) 的降低。CES 已实现在开源 Python 框架 OWLAPY 中并公开可用。
Motivation: 类表达式学习常常产生复杂且难以解释和推理的 OWL 类表达式，阻碍了本体驱动应用的可访问性与可维护性。本文旨在通过理论上可论证的简化原则降低这种复杂性，支持知识图谱构建、语义搜索和 Web 规模推理。
Method: 提出 CES 算法，系统性地应用重写规则来消除冗余并寻找语义等价但结构更简单的 DL 类表达式，在保持逻辑蕴含不变的前提下减少表示复杂度，并集成于 OWLAPY 框架。
Result: 在两个中等规模本体上学习到的类表达式上进行评估，报告了可测量的推理效率提升和表达式冗长度降低。
Conclusion: 本文工作有助于使本体驱动应用更可访问、可维护和可扩展，对知识图谱构建、语义搜索和 Web 规模推理有直接意义；CES 的代码已公开。

papers.title: Graph-Based Approaches to Learning Epileptogenic Zone Localization Using Stereo-EEG Recordings
authors: Ali A. Minai (1) ((1) University of Cincinnati
papers.abstract_en: The epileptogenic zone (EZ) is the brain region that generates seizures in an individual, and is the target of epilepsy surgery. Localizing the EZ from stereo-EEG (sEEG) recordings supports surgical planning, but manual interpretation is time-consuming and focuses on seizure recordings. Graphical learning models of resting-state functional connectivity among the recorded brain regions are an attractive alternative, but depend crucially on the network topology chosen for the model. We present a controlled study of graph-based models to explore how graph topology affects EZ localization from resting-state sEEG in 40 patients. Using the same simple learnable model and leave-one-patient-out evaluation, we compare dense graphs, anatomy- and geometry-informed priors, budgeted sparsification methods, and learned sparsification, including the proposed Region-Bridge-$c$ topology. To compare graph constructions fairly, we control the number of incoming edges per node and vary graph sparsity. At $\approx 30\%$ edge retention, Region-Bridge-$c$ achieves the highest observed mean PR-AUC ($0.371\pm0.015$; ROC-AUC $0.743\pm0.010$) while using $\approx 69\%$ fewer edges than Dense (PR-AUC $0.349\pm0.014$). Spatial-$k$ is competitive, whereas random pruning requires near-dense retention. Learned sparsification benefits from anatomical node metadata but, on average, does not surpass the best fixed prior. Across all topologies, the best choice varies by patient. These results suggest that graph construction should be evaluated explicitly rather than treated as fixed preprocessing.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for the Proceedings of IEEE WCCI 2026 (IJCNN), Maastricht, Netherlands
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对立体脑电图 (stereo-EEG, sEEG) 记录的致痫区 (epileptogenic zone, EZ) 定位问题，系统比较不同图拓扑对静息态功能连接建模的影响。作者在 40 例患者数据上，使用同一简单可学习模型和留一患者评估 (leave-one-patient-out)，对比稠密图、解剖/几何先验、预算稀疏化与学习稀疏化，并提出 Region-Bridge-c 拓扑。在约 30% 边保留率下，Region-Bridge-c 取得最高平均 PR-AUC (0.371±0.015; ROC-AUC 0.743±0.010)，同时比 Dense 少用约 69% 的边。
Motivation: 致痫区是癫痫手术的靶区，从 sEEG 记录中定位 EZ 有助于手术规划，但人工判读耗时且依赖发作期记录。基于静息态功能连接的图模型是有吸引力的替代方案，但其效果严重依赖于所选网络拓扑，而拓扑选择往往未被显式研究。
Method: 作者开展了一项受控研究，在 40 例患者上比较多种图构建方式：稠密图、基于解剖和几何信息的先验、预算化稀疏化方法、学习式稀疏化，以及新提出的 Region-Bridge-c 拓扑。为保证公平比较，所有拓扑使用相同的基础可学习模型，固定每个节点的入边数并变化图稀疏度，采用留一患者评估。
Result: 在约 30% 边保留率下，Region-Bridge-c 取得最高的平均 PR-AUC (0.371±0.015, ROC-AUC 0.743±0.010)，且比 Dense (PR-AUC 0.349±0.014) 少用约 69% 的边；Spatial-k 表现接近，而随机剪枝需要接近稠密的保留率。学习式稀疏化能从解剖节点元数据中获益，但平均而言未超过最好的固定先验；在所有拓扑中，最佳选择随患者而变化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，图构建对 EZ 定位的影响显著，应被显式评估而不是当作固定的预处理步骤。由于最佳拓扑因患者而异，实际应用中可能需要个性化的图构建策略。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在约 30% 边保留率下，Region-Bridge-c 取得最高的平均 PR-AUC (0.371±0.015, ROC-AUC 0.743±0.010)，且比 Dense (PR-AUC 0.349±0.014) 少用约 69% 的边；Spatial-k 表现接近，而随机剪枝需要接近稠密的保留率。学习式稀疏化能从解剖节点元数据中获益，但平均而言未超过最好的固定先验；在所有拓扑中，最佳选择随患者而变化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，图构建对 EZ 定位的影响显著，应被显式评估而不是当作固定的预处理步骤。由于最佳拓扑因患者而异，实际应用中可能需要个性化的图构建策略。

papers.title: Training-Free Inference-Time Self-Reflection and Cost-Bounded Early Stopping for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning training of reasoning LLMs (e.g., GRPO) is expensive and requires a controllable environment, committing every contribution to a full training pipeline. We present EvoResearcher, a training-free, inference-time protocol that adds cost-bounded self-reflection to a single frozen LLM backbone. The protocol iterates generate -> self-critique -> revise until a maximum depth D is reached or the critique returns the CONFIRMED sentinel, an implicit early stop that lets the backbone self-verify its answer under a strict compute budget. Four self-reflective meta-reward components (correctness, efficiency, reflection depth, tool-call diversity) act as design principles instantiated as prompt-level mechanisms, so their benefits accrue with zero gradient updates. We validate the protocol on Big-Bench Hard (100 questions) and establish cross-domain behavior on GSM8K (500) and MATH (500) on the same frozen backbone, with cross-model replication on Qwen2.5-72B. All experiments use pure-reasoning benchmarks; the tool-call diversity component is validated in prompt-level form, and the environment-level and multi-agent extensions are design blueprints left to future work. On clean BBH the protocol does not raise accuracy beyond the 95% Wilson interval; its value is cost-bounded self-verification, with the CONFIRMED early stop terminating 82-88% of items at equal accuracy (about 2.1 generations per question).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoResearcher，一种无需训练 (training-free) 的推理时协议，在单个冻结 LLM 主干上加入受计算预算约束的自我反思过程。协议迭代执行生成、自我批评、修订，直到达到最大深度 D 或收到 CONFIRMED 哨兵标记以提前停止。作者在 Big-Bench Hard、GSM8K、MATH 上验证，并指出其主要价值是成本受限的自我验证而非准确率提升。
Motivation: 对推理型大语言模型的强化学习训练（如 GRPO）成本高昂且需要可控环境，使每项贡献都依赖完整训练流水线。因此需要一种推理时的、不更新梯度的替代方案来获得自我反思收益。
Method: 提出 EvoResearcher 协议：以冻结的单一 LLM 为骨干，循环执行 generate -> self-critique -> revise，直至达到最大反思深度 D 或批评步骤返回 CONFIRMED 哨兵作为隐式提前停止。四个自我反思元奖励组件（正确性、效率、反思深度、工具调用多样性）被实现为提示级机制，完全不需要梯度更新。
Result: 在 Big-Bench Hard（100 题）、GSM8K（500 题）、MATH（500 题）上使用同一冻结主干验证，并在 Qwen2.5-72B 上做了跨模型复现。在干净的 BBH 上，协议未将准确率提升超过 95% Wilson 区间；CONFIRMED 提前停止以相同准确率终止了 82-88% 的题目，每问约 2.1 次生成。
Conclusion: 该协议的价值在于成本受限的自我验证而非更高的准确率。工具调用多样性的环境级和多智能体扩展仅作为设计蓝图，留给未来工作；实验均基于纯推理基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Falcon Perception-HD: High Density Perception via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive perception models trained to localize visual entities under the open-vocabulary setting are mostly trained using Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with maximum likelihood, yet it optimizes a proxy objective (per-token cross-entropy) that is fundamentally misaligned with perception metrics such as precision and recall. In this paper, we explore post-training reinforcement learning (RL), specifically GRPO, to directly align these models with their evaluation metrics. Building up on the recently introduced Falcon Perception, we design an RL framework that addresses perception-specific challenges: reward design for set-structured outputs and multi-head sampling control. We discover multiple benefits from RL for perception: first, RL unlocks state-of-the-art performance in very dense scenes (up to 500 objects per scene), a regime where most existing systems degrade sharply or collapse; furthermore it fixes common issues in autoregressive perception models like mask repetitions and removes almost entirely the need for NMS and coordinate deduplication, which improve both performance and efficiency and remove the need for hyperparameters tuning; overall, we notice improvements on all levels of difficulties in referring expression segmentation (on PBench and SACO-Gold), and we find an elegant way to preserve the knowledge of whether an object exists or not (as evaluated by MCC) without training on negative samples. We show that a simple reward that penalizes false negatives and positives is sufficient. We develop two hybrid self-annotation pipelines, respectively tailored for difficult referring expressions and very dense scenes, and show their benefits on RL-training. Model weights are released as a Falcon Perception revision~\footnote{https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/Falcon-Perception}. Datasets will be published.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Falcon Perception基础上引入GRPO强化学习后训练，直接对齐自回归感知模型的评估指标（如精确率与召回率），而非SFT的逐token交叉熵代理目标。方法在每场景多达500个物体的极密集场景中达到SOTA，并修复掩码重复、几乎消除NMS与坐标去重需求；在PBench和SACO-Gold的指代表达分割各难度上均有提升。作者发布模型权重，数据集将公开。
Motivation: 自回归感知模型在开放词汇设置下通常用SFT最大似然训练，但逐token交叉熵是代理目标，与precision/recall等感知指标内在不一致；且多数现有系统在极密集场景下性能急剧下降或崩溃。
Method: 提出面向感知的RL后训练框架，基于GRPO，针对集合化输出设计奖励（惩罚假阴性与假阳性）和多头采样控制；并开发两种混合自标注pipeline，分别用于困难指代表达和超密集场景。
Result: RL在最多500物体/场景的密集场景中解锁SOTA；缓解掩码重复问题，几乎完全去除NMS与坐标去重，提升性能与效率且无需超参数调优；在PBench和SACO-Gold上所有难度等级的指代表达分割均获提升；不训练负样本即可保持物体存在性判断（以MCC评估）。
Conclusion: 简单的假阴性/假阳性惩罚奖励足以驱动感知指标对齐，强化学习可作为自回归感知模型后训练的有效方案；模型权重已发布为Falcon Perception修订版，数据集随后公布。

papers.title: DentAgent: Evidence-Centric Multi-Agent Coordination for Multimodal Dental Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Oral diseases affect billions of people worldwide, underscoring a pressing need for accurate and reliable dental assessment that integrates heterogeneous evidence from domain knowledge, radiographs, intraoral photographs, and 3D dental data. Most existing dental AI systems remain modality- or task-specific. Although recent vision-language models support flexible dental question answering, directly generated response leaves evidence implicit and untraceable. To address these limitations, we introduce DentAgent, an evidence-centric multi-agent framework, in which the Orchestrator coordinate five specialized agents spanning various modalities. Each specialist utilizes domain tools to convert observations into structured evidence records. The Evidence Blackboard manages these records as a shared evidence state, tracking coverage, gaps, and conflicts before response generation. This standardized evidence representation integrates isolated dental capabilities into a unified agentic workflow. Across four benchmarks, DentAgent demonstrates leading performance, even surpassing the senior specialists by 17.3 percentage points on multi-label diagnosis, which supports its value for broadly applicable and traceable multimodal dental reasoning, and highlights its potential as a technical foundation for population oral health assessment and management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DentAgent，一个以证据为中心的（evidence-centric）多智能体框架，用于多模态牙科推理。Orchestrator 协调五个覆盖不同模态的专用智能体，各智能体利用领域工具将观测转化为结构化证据记录，Evidence Blackboard 在生成回答前维护共享证据状态并追踪覆盖、缺口与冲突。系统在四个基准上表现领先，并在多标签诊断上超过资深专科医生 17.3 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有牙科 AI 系统大多局限于单模态或单任务，而近期视觉-语言模型虽支持灵活的牙科问答，但直接生成回答会使证据隐式且不可追溯。
Method: 提出多智能体协作框架：Orchestrator 协调五个专用智能体，每个智能体使用领域工具将观测转为结构化证据记录，并由 Evidence Blackboard 作为共享证据状态管理这些记录。
Result: 在四个基准上取得领先性能，其中多标签诊断任务比资深专科医生高出 17.3 个百分点。
Conclusion: 标准化证据表示可将孤立的牙科能力整合为统一智能体工作流，支持可追溯的多模态牙科推理，并有望成为群体口腔健康评估与管理的技术基础。

papers.title: RVLoss: Runoff Vote Loss for Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR scene flow estimates point-wise motion between two consecutive scans, referred to as the source and target. Leading self-supervised methods typically minimize the Chamfer loss, the nearest neighbor distance between the flow-compensated source and the target. However, nearest-neighbor search does not enforce motion rigidity, often leading to inconsistent flows within object instances. Existing approaches address this issue with additional regularization terms, but flow consistency among points remains limited, especially for large objects. We propose RVLoss, a self-supervised loss that incorporates motion rigidity by design through a runoff vote mechanism. Our key observation is that the point-wise motion, calculated from nearest neighbor search, can often be grouped into a small set of dominant flow candidates by voting (top-k voting). Furthermore, when compensating the source by these candidates, the flow that best represents the underlying rigid motion often yields the highest consensus after a second voting (top-1 voting). Based on this insight, we incorporate the two-stage runoff vote into loss design and create cluster-wise rigid flows and free-form flows as pseudo-labels for self-supervised learning. RVLoss can be seamlessly integrated into existing feedforward architectures. Experiments on the Argoverse2 2026 Challenge show that models trained with RVLoss achieve state-of-the-art performance among self-supervised approaches, outperforming baseline models trained with alternative loss designs by 20%. Moreover, cross-dataset evaluations demonstrate consistent performance improvements across four additional datasets. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RVLoss，一种通过 runoff vote（两阶段投票）机制将运动刚性约束内建到损失函数中的自监督 LiDAR 场景流估计方法。作者观察到基于最近邻搜索得到的逐点运动可被 top-k 投票归纳为少数主导流候选，再经 top-1 投票选出最能代表刚体运动的流，据此生成聚类刚性流与自由形式流作为伪标签。在 Argoverse2 2026 Challenge 上，使用 RVLoss 训练的模型达到自监督方法最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有自监督场景流方法通常最小化 Chamfer 损失，即流补偿后的源点云与目标点云之间的最近邻距离，但最近邻搜索不强制运动刚性，导致物体实例内部的流不一致；已有方法依赖额外正则项，但对大物体的流一致性改善仍然有限。
Method: 提出 RVLoss 自监督损失，通过 runoff vote 机制显式利用运动刚性：先对最近邻搜索得到的逐点运动做 top-k 投票形成少数主导流候选，再用 top-1 投票选择最能表征潜在刚体运动的流，两阶段投票结果用于构造聚类刚性流（cluster-wise rigid flows）和自由形式流（free-form flows）伪标签，可无缝集成到现有前馈架构中。
Result: 在 Argoverse2 2026 Challenge 上，RVLoss 训练的模型在自监督方法中达到 state-of-the-art，比使用替代损失设计的基线模型提升 20%；跨数据集评估在另外四个数据集上均表现出一致的性能改进。
Conclusion: 作者主张通过投票机制将运动刚性内建于损失设计可有效改善自监督 LiDAR 场景流估计中的流一致性，并计划在论文接收后公开代码。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Sharper Regret Bounds for Time-Varying Gaussian Process Bandits with Constant Exploration
papers.abstract_en: We study Bayesian optimization in a time-varying environment where the unknown reward function evolves according to a Gaussian process drift model. Existing GP-UCB analyses in this setting typically require the exploration parameter to grow with the horizon to maintain uniform confidence bounds. Using per-round local confidence events, we show that GP-UCB can instead be run with a constant exploration parameter and obtain an expected-regret bound whose coefficient depends on the drift rate. We also derive a sharper time-varying maximum-information-gain bound. For the squared exponential kernel, it yields $\tildeγ_T/T=\widetilde{\mathcal O}(ε^{1/2})$ and expected average regret $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(ε^{1/4})$ in the persistent-drift regime. The same constant-exploration analysis also yields realized-regret guarantees. Simulations support the predicted logarithmic dependence of the bound-suggested exploration parameter on $1/ε$.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 1 figure. Code included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时变环境下的贝叶斯优化，假设未知奖励函数服从高斯过程漂移模型。作者利用逐轮局部置信事件证明 GP-UCB 可以采用常数探索参数运行，并得到系数依赖漂移率的期望遗憾界，同时推导了更尖锐的时变最大信息增益界。对于平方指数核，在持续漂移机制下给出平均遗憾界约为 O~(epsilon^{1/4})，并扩展出可实现遗憾 (realized-regret) 保证。模拟验证了由界推导出的探索参数对 1/epsilon 的对数依赖关系。
Motivation: 现有 GP-UCB 在时变环境中的分析通常要求探索参数随视界 (horizon) 增长以维持一致置信界，这在实际中会导致过度探索和次优遗憾。本文的目标是证明常数探索参数在时变高斯过程模型下仍然可行，从而简化算法使用并改进理论界。
Method: 提出基于逐轮局部置信事件 (per-round local confidence events) 的分析框架，使 GP-UCB 无需随视界增长探索参数；同时推导一个新的时变最大信息增益界，并利用它分析平方指数核下的持续漂移场景。
Result: 对于平方指数核，得到平均信息增益界 tilde(γ_T)/T = O~(epsilon^{1/2}) 以及期望平均遗憾 O~(epsilon^{1/4})；常数探索分析还额外给出可实现遗憾的保证。模拟结果与界预测的探索参数与 1/epsilon 的对数依赖一致。
Conclusion: 本文表明在时间变化的 GP 漂移模型下保持常数探索参数即可获得次线性遗憾界，并提供了更紧的信息增益界和模拟验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent frameworks increasingly package procedural knowledge as skills: instruction files an agent reads on demand, while public libraries now hold thousands of them. Which skill to read has thus become a decision the policy itself makes in the middle of an episode, yet no existing signal trains it. We show that the default remedy, outcome-rewarded RL over the candidate slate, cannot teach it, for a structural reason we identify and name selector credit starvation: under a broadcast, sequence-level advantage, the few tokens that name the chosen skill carry a vanishing share of the loss, and the credit they inherit is increasingly wrong-signed as trajectories lengthen. A correct choice is punished whenever the execution after it fails, even though the choice itself is among the most valuable decisions in the trajectory. Auditing a completed run's own training artifacts confirms all three properties, each worsening monotonically with horizon. SkillGate removes the failure by construction: it partitions the token support into two disjoint credit channels, outcome credit reaching only execution tokens, and a separate action-local advantage reaching exactly the skill-naming tokens, positive only when a trajectory's single read is the correct one. On five agentic benchmarks under a 16-candidate slate, SkillGate lifts a 9B policy from 40.8% to 53.2% trial success, well ahead of the identical budget spent on outcome reward alone, while cutting exposure to misleading candidates by two thirds and reading fewer skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长程智能体 (long-horizon agents) 中由策略自身在 episode 中途决定读取哪个技能文件的问题。作者指出默认的基于结果回报的强化学习 (outcome-rewarded RL) 无法教会这种选择，并识别出其结构性原因：选择器信用饥饿 (selector credit starvation)，即广播的序列级优势使得命名所选技能的那几个 token 承担的损失份额趋近于零，且随轨迹变长信用符号越来越错。为此提出 SkillGate，将 token 支持集划分为两个不相交的信用通道，分别给执行 token 和技能命名 token 分配信用，并在五个智能体基准、16 个候选技能池下把 9B 策略的试次成功率从 40.8% 提升到 53.2%。
Motivation: Agent 框架越来越多地把程序性知识打包成技能文件，公共库已有数千个技能，策略必须在 episode 中途自行决定读哪个技能，但现有没有任何信号训练这一决策。摘要进一步表明，默认的候选集结果回报 RL 因选择器信用饥饿而结构性失效，且随轨迹长度恶化。
Method: SkillGate 从构造上消除该失败：把 token 支持集分成两个不相交的信用通道，结果信用 (outcome credit) 只到达执行 token，另设一个动作局部的优势 (action-local advantage) 只到达技能命名 token，且仅当轨迹中唯一一次读取的选择正确时该优势为正。
Result: 在五个智能体基准、16 个候选技能池下，SkillGate 将 9B 策略的试次成功率从 40.8% 提升到 53.2%，明显超过把相同预算花在纯结果回报上的设置；同时将暴露给误导性候选的比例削减三分之二，并读取更少的技能。
Conclusion: 作者通过审计完整训练工件验证了选择器信用饥饿的三个性质均随 horizon 单调恶化，并强调 SkillGate 通过构造性信用分离解决了该问题，而不是依赖对现有训练信号的修补。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Multi-stage neural operator learning with application for convolutions
papers.abstract_en: Convolution integrals widely exist in applications, and to enable fast and accurate computations, this paper introduces two general multi-stage neural operator learning frameworks. The first, Deep Collocation Neural Operator (DCNO), is a supervised approach that iteratively refines the operator approximation by learning residuals from input-output data pairs. The second, Deep Galerkin Neural Operator (DGNO), is an unsupervised framework applicable when the target operator can be represented by a PDE, leveraging the weak form of the PDE residual for training. Both methods progressively construct basis operators through multiple training stages to enrich the approximation space, leading to significantly improved accuracy over standard one-shot operator learning. We provide theoretical analysis for their approximation capabilities and implement them for learning convolutions. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate that both DCNO and DGNO achieve high accuracy, approaching machine precision under single float for convolution problems, and offer substantial efficiency gains for numerous queries or parametric variations compared to traditional solvers. We also extend these frameworks to handle multi-input operator learning scenarios involving variations in both the density and kernel of a convolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对卷积积分运算提出两种多阶段神经算子学习框架：DCNO（Deep Collocation Neural Operator）与 DGNO（Deep Galerkin Neural Operator）。DCNO 通过输入-输出数据对的残差学习逐步修正算子逼近，DGNO 则在目标算子可用 PDE 表示时利用弱形式残差进行无监督训练。两者均通过多个训练阶段逐步构造基算子以扩充逼近空间，并在卷积问题数值实验中逼近单精度机器精度。
Motivation: 卷积积分在应用中广泛存在，传统求解器在大量查询或参数变化场景下计算成本高，而标准的一次性算子学习（one-shot operator learning）精度有限，需要更高效、更精确的算子学习框架。
Method: 提出两种多阶段框架：DCNO 采用有监督方式，在输入-输出数据对上迭代学习残差来精化算子逼近；DGNO 采用无监督方式，利用 PDE 残差的弱形式进行训练。两种方法都通过多个训练阶段逐步构建基算子，以丰富逼近空间，并给出了逼近能力的理论分析。
Result: 大量数值实验表明，DCNO 与 DGNO 在卷积问题上均可达到接近单精度浮点机器精度的精度，并且相比传统求解器在众多查询或参数变化场景下具有显著效率优势；框架还被扩展到密度与核同时变化的多输入算子学习场景。
Conclusion: 作者认为多阶段构造基算子能够显著提升超过标准一次性算子学习的精度，并具备理论支撑；当前工作以卷积积分为实现对象，其应用范围主要在卷积类算子学习问题上。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: GEAR: Generative Expansion and Real Anchoring for Two-Stage Distillation of Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong performance through in-context learning, but context-dependent inference imposes substantial latency and memory costs, hindering large-scale deployment. We propose GEAR (\emph{Generative Expansion and Real Anchoring}), a modular two-stage framework that distills TFMs into lightweight MLP or tree-based predictors that can be deployed on commodity CPUs. Stage 1 uses synthetic covariates solely as teacher-query locations and trains the student on soft TFM targets, expanding coverage beyond observed rows. Stage 2 re-anchors the student to the target distribution using real labels and out-of-fold teacher predictions, whitch avoids self-labeling leakage. We further derive a risk certificate characterizing the trade-off between generated-query volume and generator fidelity. Experiments on TALENT and TabArena demonstrate the broad applicability of GEAR. Two-stage MLPs outperform supervised MLPs by 1.81--2.00 AUC points on binary tasks and 1.19--1.35 points on multiclass tasks, with additional gains over real-data-only distillation of 1.76--2.19 and 2.09--2.40 points, respectively. On binary tasks, the gains also transfer to LightGBM and XGBoost, and all three student families outperform CatBoost, the strongest non-TFM baseline, in mean AUC. Ablations show gains beyond longer training or alternative warm starts, greater stability from staged than mixed optimization, and generator-dependent diminishing returns as query volume increases. Finally, GEAR reduces median inference time by 57--2866 times and peak prediction memory by 1.9--3.3 times, while retaining higher AUC than matched supervised baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GEAR（Generative Expansion and Real Anchoring），一个将表格基础模型（TFM）蒸馏为轻量级 MLP 或树模型的两阶段框架，以降低上下文相关推理带来的延迟和内存开销。第一阶段用合成协变量作为教师查询点，在软标签上训练学生模型以扩展覆盖范围；第二阶段用真实标签和折外教师预测将学生重新锚定到目标分布，避免自标签泄漏。实验在 TALENT 和 TabArena 上展示广泛适用性，并显著降低推理时间与内存。
Motivation: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习取得强性能，但上下文相关推理带来大量延迟和内存开销，妨碍大规模部署。
Method: GEAR 是模块化两阶段蒸馏框架：阶段一仅将合成协变量作为教师查询位置，用软 TFM 目标训练学生，扩展观测行之外的覆盖；阶段二用真实标签和折外教师预测将学生重新锚定到目标分布。作者还推导了描述生成查询量与生成器保真度之间权衡的风险证书。
Result: 两阶段 MLP 在二分类任务上比监督 MLP 高 1.81–2.00 AUC 点，在多分类任务上高 1.19–1.35 点；相比仅用真实数据的蒸馏，额外提升分别达 1.76–2.19 和 2.09–2.40 点。在二分类任务上增益可迁移到 LightGBM 和 XGBoost，三类学生模型平均 AUC 均超过最强非 TFM 基线 CatBoost。GEAR 将中位推理时间降低 57–2866 倍，峰值预测内存降低 1.9–3.3 倍，同时保持高于匹配监督基线的 AUC。
Conclusion: 消融实验表明，增益来自方法本身而非更长训练或替代热启动，分阶段优化比混合优化更稳定，且随着查询量增加存在依赖生成器的递减收益。整体上 GEAR 提供了一种将 TFM 部署到通用 CPU 上的高效蒸馏路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ORBITER: Conflict-Aware Decision-Making for Agentic Last-Mile Delivery
papers.abstract_en: Last-mile delivery aims to handle dynamically arriving orders with couriers while modeling complex spatial and temporal correlations. Recent learning-based methods model spatiotemporal dependencies among orders to predict courier service sequences, but leave next-order decision making unexplained. Describing the current delivery state in language allows LLMs to reason explicitly about the spatial, temporal, and behavioral cues behind an individual decision. As direct predictors, however, LLMs remain sensitive to task presentation and often produce unreliable decisions. To address these challenges, we introduce ORBITER, an agentic Order Arbiter for next-order decision-making in last-mile delivery. ORBITER models courier service through decision points, each containing the courier's spatiotemporal state and visible orders and exposing local trade-offs for modeling and verification. Fixed proposers rank the candidates, and a structured report identifies where their rankings disagree. The LLM uses task-specific tools to gather evidence on the leading alternatives, while an independent critic checks the resulting decision against that evidence. We conduct extensive evaluations on data in four cities, where ORBITER outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines by up to 9.2% on average showing its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORBITER 是一个面向最后一英里配送 (last-mile delivery) 的智能体决策框架，用于决定快递员下一步接哪个订单。它把快递员服务建模为一系列决策点，由固定排序器 (fixed proposers) 给出候选排序，用结构化报告标识排序分歧，再让 LLM 调用任务专用工具收集证据，并由独立评审器 (critic) 核验最终决策。在四个城市的数据集上，ORBITER 平均比现有最先进基线提升最高 9.2%。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的方法虽能建模订单间时空依赖并预测快递员服务序列，但下一步订单决策过程缺乏可解释性；直接用作预测器的 LLM 对任务呈现方式敏感，容易产生不可靠的决策。
Method: ORBITER 通过决策点暴露快递员的时空状态、可见订单和局部权衡；用固定排序器对候选排序，生成结构化报告找出排序不一致之处；LLM 借助任务专用工具收集主要备选方案的证据，独立评审器依据该证据检查最终决策。
Result: 在四个城市的数据上进行广泛评估，ORBITER 相比现有最先进基线平均最多提升 9.2%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将决策点、排序分歧报告与独立验证结合，能让 LLM 在最后一英里配送的下一步订单决策中既保持可解释性又获得更强性能。

papers.title: Beyond Placement and Articulation: Usage-Driven Code Scenes for Embodied Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Indoor scene synthesis provides essential environments for embodied AI, robotic manipulation, and simulation-based policy learning. Recent code-based scene generation methods produce editable and extensible environments, yet they remain focused on visual construction and object-level articulation, leaving the functional usage of scenes largely unmodeled. To address this problem, we present RoomWright, an agentic usage-driven framework for generating 3D scenes represented entirely as code for embodied interaction. RoomWright performs usage-driven object reasoning, which treats each anchor as a task centre and admits task-required objects and their affordances. A code agent further enables multi-part interaction by compiling each interaction into a trigger, condition, effect rule that updates structured object states, capturing causal dependencies across objects. Moreover, since manipuland orientation is ambiguous and hard to recover from pixels, RoomWright alleviates this via annotation-informed usage-guided orientation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. The resulting scenes are executable, editable, and simulation-ready, providing interactive environments for embodied AI and policy learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoomWright，一个 agentic usage-driven 框架，用代码形式生成面向具身交互的 3D 室内场景。与既有 code-based 场景生成只关注视觉构造和物体级关节不同，该方法把功能使用建模为场景生成的核心：将每个 anchor 视为任务中心，引入任务所需物体及其 affordances，并由代码智能体把交互编译成 trigger、condition、effect 规则以更新结构化物体状态、捕捉跨物体因果依赖。摘要报告实验验证有效，生成场景可执行、可编辑且可直接用于仿真。
Motivation: 现有 code-based 场景生成方法产出可编辑、可扩展的环境，但只停留在视觉构造与物体级 articulation，缺少对场景功能使用的建模，限制其在具身 AI、机器人操作和仿真策略学习中的应用。
Method: RoomWright 采用 usage-driven object reasoning，把每个 anchor 当作任务中心并接收任务所需物体及其 affordances；代码智能体将每个交互编译为 trigger、condition、effect 规则来更新结构化物体状态，从而刻画物体间的因果依赖；针对 manipuland 朝向难以从像素恢复的问题，使用 annotation-informed usage-guided orientation 加以缓解。
Result: 摘要称大量实验证明了方法的有效性，生成场景具备可执行、可编辑、simulation-ready 的特性，可为具身 AI 与策略学习提供交互环境。
Conclusion: 作者认为在代码式场景生成中显式建模功能使用与多部件交互规则，可以生成面向具身交互的仿真就绪环境。

papers.title: Verifiable abstention makes AI leak diagnosis accountable in water distribution networks
papers.abstract_en: Utilities lose a substantial share of treated water to leakage, yet rarely trust artificial-intelligence localizers to dispatch crews: guessing everywhere cannot justify excavation. The gap is accountability, not accuracy: no method proves when it should not act. Here we recast leak localization as decision-making under verifiable abstention. A physics-grounded executor agent falsifies hypotheses (leak, demand, sensor, valve) against a digital twin; an independent supervisor agent, with a large-language-model (LLM) auditor, checks evidence against a code-verifiable contract, then certifies a dispatch, requests evidence or abstains. Under field-grade noise, a 32% forced baseline becomes 96% decision precision on acted events. On an independently generated benchmark it acts on only 4 of 33 leaks, all correct. A 194-event register of audited real leak locations with twin-simulated pressures and flows yields five excavation dispatches, three correct, and 44% survey recovery at full district precision. Accountable abstention offers a defensible route to autonomous water-infrastructure operation.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 5 main figures, 1 main table, 2 extended data figures, 3 supplementary figures, 15 supplementary tables. Code and data availability described in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把供水管网漏损定位重构为“可验证弃权”(verifiable abstention) 下的决策问题，以解决 AI 定位器因缺乏问责机制而不被信任的问题。物理驱动的执行体 (executor) 在数字孪生 (digital twin) 上对泄漏、需水、传感器、阀门等假设进行证伪，独立的监督体 (supervisor agent) 配合大语言模型审计器 (LLM auditor) 对照可代码验证的契约检查证据，然后决定签发抢修指令、要求更多证据或弃权。摘要报告在含现场噪声条件下，强制决策基线的 32% 决策精度在“已行动事件”上提升到 96%，并在独立基准上仅对 33 个泄漏中的 4 个行动且全部正确。
Motivation: 自来水公司因缺乏问责机制而不信任 AI 定位器，现有方法只追求定位精度而不能证明自己何时不应行动；作者认为差距在于 accountability（可问责性）而非精度。
Method: 提出“在可验证弃权下做决策”的框架：物理驱动的执行体 agent 基于数字孪生对泄漏、需水、传感器、阀门等假设进行证伪；独立监督体 agent 借助 LLM 审计器按代码可验证的契约检查证据，据此签发派工、要求更多证据或弃权。
Result: 摘要称在野外级噪声下，强制行动基线的 32% 决策精度在已行动事件上变为 96%；在独立生成基准上只对 33 个泄漏中的 4 个采取行动且全部正确；在含 194 个已审计真实泄漏位置与孪生模拟压力流量的事件登记表上，产生 5 次开挖派工、其中 3 次正确，并在全区精度上实现 44% 的巡查恢复率。
Conclusion: 作者认为可问责的弃权机制为自主水务基础设施运行提供了可辩护的路径；摘要未明确讨论该方法在其他管网或真实执行条件下的泛化局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EVADE: Evidence-Verified Agentic Diagnosis with Escape
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) can achieve high accuracy but remain unreliable: they are systematically overconfident, benefit little from test-time reasoning, and lack the ability to reliably calibrate trust in their own responses. We introduce EVADE (Evidence-Verified Agentic Diagnosis with Escape), an inferential, non-training method that enhances the safety of deploying a single frozen VLM. EVADE responds and, when uncertain, localises the region most diagnostically relevant, re-answers on a zoomed view, and commits only when both the entire image and the zoomed view responses agree; otherwise, it abstains. To directly address verification hallucination in single-model self-checking, our main idea is to verify gate consistency across different image views rather than re-reading the model's own text. Experimental evaluation on VQA-RAD, SLAKE, and PathVQA using Qwen2.5-VL-7B reports that EVADE is the only method that simultaneously improves both calibration and selective risk while maintaining accuracy, reducing expected calibration error (ECE) by up to 45% compared to zero-shot. Chain-of-thought, self-consistency, and self-verification all fail at least one axis. A grounding analysis reports that self-proposed regions perform better at diagnostic structure localisation than centres or random crops. However, a 7B VLM cannot use this localisation to revise answers. Therefore, reliability gains come from the consistency gate and calibrated abstention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EVADE (Evidence-Verified Agentic Diagnosis with Escape) 是一种在推理阶段、无需训练的方法，旨在提升单个冻结医学视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的部署安全性。模型先作答，当不确定时定位最相关的诊断区域并在放大视图上重新作答，只有整图与放大视图的响应一致时才提交结果，否则弃权 (abstain)。在 VQA-RAD、SLAKE 和 PathVQA 上用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 验证，EVADE 是唯一同时改善校准与选择性风险并保持准确率的方法，相比零样本将期望校准误差 (ECE) 最多降低 45%。
Motivation: 医学 VLM 虽然准确率较高但不可靠：系统性地过度自信、从测试时推理中获益有限，且缺乏对自身响应的可信校准能力。这限制了其在临床应用中的安全部署。
Method: EVADE 通过跨图像视图的一致性检验来替代单模型自读文本式的自检：模型给出回答后，在不确定情况下定位最具诊断相关性的区域，对放大视图重新回答；仅当整图回答与放大视图回答一致时才提交，否则弃权。核心思想是验证不同图像视图间的门控一致性，以直接应对单模型自检中的验证幻觉 (verification hallucination)。
Result: 在 VQA-RAD、SLAKE 和 PathVQA 上基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的实验显示，EVADE 同时改善了校准和选择性风险且保持准确率，ECE 相对零样本最多下降 45%；链式思维 (chain-of-thought)、自一致性 (self-consistency) 和自验证 (self-verification) 均至少在一个评估维度上失败。接地分析 (grounding analysis) 表明模型自提议区域比中心裁剪或随机裁剪更好地定位诊断结构，但 7B 规模 VLM 无法利用该定位来修正答案。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可靠性提升的来源是一致性门控与经过校准的弃权机制，而非视觉定位对回答的直接修订。方法限定为单个冻结 VLM，并在医学视觉问答基准与 7B 参数规模下评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EfficientSync: Real-Time Lip Synchronization via Deformation-Based Reference Texture Mixing
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven lip synchronization manipulates the mouth region of a talking-face video to match the driving audio while preserving head pose, identity, and background. Although the task is inherently local editing, prevailing approaches reconstruct the entire lower face with heavy GAN- or diffusion-based decoders, incurring substantial latency and, more critically, hallucinating intra-oral details such as teeth and lip wrinkles instead of preserving authentic textures. We contend that the bottleneck in identity preservation is not the scarcity of reference frames, but the lack of a mechanism that faithfully transfers the genuine textures they already contain. We therefore present EfficientSync, a real-time deformation-based framework that retains reference textures rather than resynthesizing them. First, the Dynamic Texture Mixer reformulates multi-reference fusion as channel-wise selection, evaluating each spatially aligned reference in a global context and aggregating them by channel-wise weighted summation, preserving textural integrity at low cost. Second, Spatio-Temporal Shifted Adaptive Masking decomposes the source frame into lip-generation conditions and an independent background prior, suppressing lower-face leakage while blending the synthesized mouth seamlessly into the background. Third, STAR Sampling, a zero-overhead pre-processing step, retrieves the sharpest and most topologically diverse reference frames. Experiments on HDTF and VFHQ show state-of-the-art visual quality and identity preservation at 166 FPS on a single GPU. Video demos: https://alunaticat.github.io/EfficientSync/index.html.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EfficientSync，一个基于形变（deformation）的实时音频驱动唇形同步框架。与用重 GAN 或扩散解码器重建下半脸的现有方法不同，EfficientSync 保留参考帧的真实纹理而非重新合成：Dynamic Texture Mixer 把多参考融合转化为通道级选择与加权求和，Spatio-Temporal Shifted Adaptive Masking 将源帧分解为嘴唇生成条件与独立背景先验以抑制下半脸泄漏，STAR Sampling 作为零开销预处理检索最清晰且拓扑最多样的参考帧。在 HDTF 和 VFHQ 上达到 SOTA 视觉质量与身份保持，单 GPU 上为 166 FPS。
Motivation: 音频驱动的唇形同步本质上是局部编辑，但主流方法用重型 GAN 或扩散解码器重建整个下半脸，带来较大延迟，并会幻觉出牙齿、唇纹等口内细节而非保留真实纹理。作者认为身份保持的瓶颈不在于参考帧稀缺，而在于缺乏一种机制来忠实传递参考帧中已包含的真实纹理。
Method: 提出 EfficientSync 的形变式框架：Dynamic Texture Mixer 在全局上下文中评估每个空间对齐的参考帧并通过通道级加权求和聚合，以低成本保持纹理完整性；Spatio-Temporal Shifted Adaptive Masking 将源帧分解为嘴唇生成条件与独立背景先验，抑制下半脸泄漏并将合成嘴部无缝融入背景；STAR Sampling 作为零开销预处理步骤检索最清晰且拓扑最多样的参考帧。
Result: 在 HDTF 和 VFHQ 数据集上的实验显示，该方法取得了最优的视觉质量和身份保持，并在单 GPU 上达到 166 FPS 的实时速度。

papers.title: MLREF: Efficient Module Reuse for Reward Design in Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reward function design remains a bottleneck in reinforcement learning. While large language models (LLMs) have enabled automated reward generation, existing methods generate and revise reward functions as monolithic programs, making it difficult to reliably preserve and reuse effective components discovered in earlier iterations, leading to unstable performance across iterations. To address this, we propose Module Level Reward Evolution Framework (MLREF). At the core of MLREF is a module pool, a persistent repository of reusable reward components. MLREF treats the module pool as the primary optimization object: the pool evolves across iterations by accumulating successful modules, refining underperforming ones, and reusing proven components; while reward functions are constructed as linear combinations of modules drawn from this pool. To drive this evolution, MLREF integrates three mechanisms: reflection-based refinement, hybrid credit assignment, and a merge strategy with rollback, which together improve the effectiveness and robustness of reward optimization. Experiments on 17 tasks show that MLREF outperforms strong baselines by 25.2% in locomotion and 6.6% in manipulation, with more stable optimization dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出模块级奖励进化框架 (MLREF)，针对强化学习中奖励函数设计的瓶颈。核心是模块池 (module pool)，奖励函数被构造为从池中抽取的模块的线性组合，池本身通过累加成功模块、精炼低效模块并复用已验证组件而跨迭代进化。摘要报告在 17 个任务上，MLREF 在运动控制 (locomotion) 上超过强基线 25.2%，在操作 (manipulation) 上超过 6.6%，且优化动态更稳定。
Motivation: 现有基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的自动奖励生成方法把奖励函数当作单体程序反复生成和修改，难以可靠地保留并复用早期迭代中发现的有效组件，导致跨迭代性能不稳定。
Method: MLREF 将模块池作为主要优化对象，集成三种机制：基于反思的精炼 (reflection-based refinement)、混合信用分配 (hybrid credit assignment) 以及带回滚的合并策略 (merge strategy with rollback)，奖励函数由池中模块线性组合而成。
Result: 在 17 个任务上的实验显示，MLREF 相比强基线在运动控制任务上提升 25.2%，在操作任务上提升 6.6%，并具有更稳定的优化动态。
Conclusion: 将奖励组件模块化并持久化复用，而不是整体重写奖励程序，可以提升 LLM 驱动的奖励优化过程的有效性和鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Understanding Multilingual Medical ASR Adaptation Through Layer-Wise Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Medical automatic speech recognition (MedASR) requires adaptation to specialised terminology, limited annotated clinical data, and multilingual use cases. Although large-scale pretrained ASR models such as Whisper achieve strong generalisation, their behaviour after medical and multilingual adaptation remains insufficiently understood beyond word error rate (WER). This paper investigates how multilingual medical adaptation reshapes the internal representations of Whisper models through layer-wise encoder analysis. We compare zero-shot decoding, English-only fine-tuning, German-only diagnostic fine-tuning, two-stage EN->EN+DE continuation, and direct EN+DE fine-tuning across Whisper model sizes. Fine-tuning substantially improves MedASR performance, but the best model depends on the adaptation setting: Whisper-Medium gives the lowest English WER (7.72%) and the lowest combined EN+DE WER under direct EN+DE training (26.30%); German-only Whisper-Large-v3 gives the lowest German WER (44.96%), but as a within-corpus diagnostic on 86 single-speaker training utterances rather than robust generalisation. Layer-wise analysis of the two-stage Whisper-Small trajectory shows that English medical fine-tuning produces the dominant encoder shift, whereas multilingual continuation largely preserves the adapted representation space. Domain and language information remain highly recoverable across layers, while linearly recoverable error-predictive cues weaken as WER improves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多语言医疗语音识别（MedASR）中 Whisper 模型经过微调后内部表示的变化，通过逐层编码器分析对比零样本解码、仅英文微调、仅德文诊断微调、两阶段 EN->EN+DE 续训以及直接 EN+DE 微调。摘要报告微调显著提升 MedASR 性能，但最优模型取决于适应设置；两阶段 Whisper-Small 轨迹中英文医疗微调主导编码器偏移，多语言续训大致保留已适应的表示空间。
Motivation: MedASR 需要适应专业术语、有限的标注临床数据和多语言用例，而 Whisper 这类大规模预训练模型虽然泛化强，但其经过医疗与多语言适应后的内部行为除 WER 外仍缺乏理解。
Method: 对 Whisper 编码器进行逐层分析，比较零样本、仅英文微调、仅德文诊断微调、两阶段 EN->EN+DE 续训和直接 EN+DE 微调，并覆盖多种 Whisper 模型尺寸。
Result: Whisper-Medium 在直接 EN+DE 训练下得到最低英文 WER（7.72%）和最低合并 EN+DE WER（26.30%）；德语仅用 86 条单说话人训练话语时，German-only Whisper-Large-v3 达到最低德语 WER（44.96%），但属于语料内诊断而非稳健泛化。逐层分析显示英文医疗微调主导编码器偏移，领域与语言信息跨层高度可恢复，而线性可恢复的误差预测线索随 WER 改善而减弱。
Conclusion: 摘要强调理解微调如何重塑 Whisper 内部表示有助于解释多语言医疗 ASR 适应，但德语结论受极少量训练话语限制，仅作为诊断性结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Identifying Implicit Premises for Logical Reconstruction of Argument Graphs
papers.abstract_en: The logical reconstruction of argument graphs from natural language text is challenging because of the prevalence of enthymemes (i.e., arguments with implicit premises). There are natural language processing methods for identifying enthymemes in text, and there are symbolic methods based on abduction for identifying missing premises in a logical representation of enthymemes. However, there is a need for methods to generate implicit premises to logically show a known entailment or contradiction relationship between a pair of statements. To address this, we propose a neuro-symbolic pipeline that uses large language models (LLMs) to generate intermediate implicit premises that are translated into logical formulae and used with logical formulae representing explicit premises and explicit claims to show the logical relationships between them (entailment, contradiction, or neutrality). Our approach is evaluated on the Microtext Argumentative Corpus.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 11th International Conference on Computational Models of Argument (COMMA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自然语言论证图逻辑重构中省略式论证 (enthymeme) 的隐式前提生成问题，提出一个神经符号流水线：用大语言模型 (LLM) 生成中间隐式前提，将其翻译为逻辑公式，并与显式前提和结论的逻辑公式结合，以展示语句间的蕴涵、矛盾或中性关系。方法在 Microtext Argumentative Corpus 上进行了评估。
Motivation: 论证图逻辑重构的难点在于文本中普遍存在省略式论证，即带有隐式前提的论证；现有方法要么侧重自然语言层面的省略识别，要么侧重逻辑层面的溯因补全，缺少专门生成隐式前提以逻辑地证明两个语句间已知蕴涵或矛盾关系的方法。
Method: 提出神经符号流水线：首先使用 LLM 生成中间隐式前提，再将这些前提翻译成逻辑公式，并与表示显式前提和显式结论的逻辑公式一起用于推理，从而判定语句对之间的逻辑关系为蕴涵 (entailment)、矛盾 (contradiction) 或中性 (neutrality)。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 Microtext Argumentative Corpus 上进行了评估，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该方法填补了为逻辑重构生成隐式前提以证明语句对之间逻辑关系的空白，其可行性在 Microtext 语料上得到验证。

papers.title: Pairwise Logical Selection of Enthymeme Completions under Semantic-Link Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Arguments often omit premises or claims, forming enthymemes. We study pairwise logical selection between two candidates for the omitted component. Existing natural language methods can identify or generate candidates but often do not expose how the selected candidate completes the inference, while logic-based approaches usually assume that the required formulae and background knowledge are available. We extend a prior neuro-symbolic pipeline from missing-premise to missing-claim selection and replace binary entailment outcomes with logical-resistance scores. Top-Link uses weighted Partial MaxSAT under a single configuration of highest-confidence semantic links. We then introduce Possible-World Atom-Link Formalization (PWAL), which keeps translated formulae fixed and marginalizes logical resistance over alternative cross-formula semantic-link configurations. We evaluate PWAL on five tasks: ARCT and a CDED-derived task for missing-premise selection, iDebate- and AAE2-derived tasks for missing-claim selection, and alphaNLI for abductive hypothesis selection. Relative to Top-Link, PWAL raises strict accuracy by 2.95-30.86 percentage points and reduces tie rates by 4.57-58.00 percentage points on all five tasks. When ties receive half credit, accuracy still increases by 0.45-6.04 percentage points. PWAL also records the translated formulae, sampled link configurations, and resistance components for every comparison, providing a transparent trace of each score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究省略三段论 (enthymeme) 中缺失成分的成对逻辑选择问题，将先前的神经符号流水线从缺失前提选择扩展到缺失主张选择，并用逻辑阻力分数 (logical-resistance scores) 替代二元蕴含结果。作者提出 Possible-World Atom-Link Formalization (PWAL)，保持翻译后的公式固定，对替代的跨公式语义链接配置进行边际化。在 ARCT、CDED 派生任务、iDebate 派生任务、AAE2 派生任务和 alphaNLI 五个任务上，PWAL 相对 Top-Link 在严格准确率上提升 2.95-30.86 个百分点，平局率降低 4.57-58.00 个百分点；平局计半分时准确率仍提升 0.45-6.04 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有自然语言方法能够识别或生成被省略的候选成分，但不揭示所选候选如何补全推理；基于逻辑的方法通常又假设所需公式和背景知识可用。本文针对语义链接不确定条件下两个候选之间成对逻辑选择这一空白展开研究。
Method: 扩展先前的神经符号流水线，使其同时支持缺失前提与缺失主张选择，并以逻辑阻力分数取代二值蕴含判断。Top-Link 在最高置信度语义链接的单一配置下使用加权 Partial MaxSAT；PWAL 则固定翻译后的公式，在不同跨公式语义链接配置上对逻辑阻力进行边际化，并记录翻译公式、采样链接配置和阻力成分。
Result: 在 ARCT、CDED 派生、iDebate 派生、AAE2 派生和 alphaNLI 五项任务上，PWAL 相对 Top-Link 将严格准确率提高 2.95-30.86 个百分点，平局率降低 4.57-58.00 个百分点；当平局计半分时，准确率仍提高 0.45-6.04 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PWAL 在多个论证与反事实推理任务上同时提升选择准确率并减少平局，且通过记录翻译公式、采样链接配置与阻力成分，为每个分数提供透明的可追踪轨迹。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在 ARCT、CDED 派生、iDebate 派生、AAE2 派生和 alphaNLI 五项任务上，PWAL 相对 Top-Link 将严格准确率提高 2.95-30.86 个百分点，平局率降低 4.57-58.00 个百分点；当平局计半分时，准确率仍提高 0.45-6.04 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 PWAL 在多个论证与反事实推理任务上同时提升选择准确率并减少平局，且通过记录翻译公式、采样链接配置与阻力成分，为每个分数提供透明的可追踪轨迹。

papers.title: A Unifying Relational Perspective on Expressive Lottery Tickets
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are widely used, but how parameter sparsity affects the expressivity of relational (RGNNs) and temporal (TGNNs) variants is poorly understood. The Strong Expressive Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (SELTH) posits the existence of sparse GNNs that preserve Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) expressivity on static graphs. We generalize this existence result to a probabilistic statement for multi-relational and temporal domains via the relational WL (RWL). We prove that sufficiently parameterized RGNNs contain sparse subnetworks that maintain 1-RWL expressivity and derive a lower bound on the probability that a random pruning yields such a subnetwork. We show that common TGNNs and cross-graph message passing schemes admit RGNN reformulations such that they inherit these guarantees and, moreover, that the expressivity of a sparse RGNN is connected to its optimization behavior under common update regimes. Experiments instantiate the bound, compare it to empirical probabilities on synthetic data, and study how pre-training expressivity relates to optimization and prediction quality metrics on temporal and molecular benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一视角，将强表达性彩票假设 (SELTH) 从静态图推广到多关系与时序图神经网络。作者借助关系 WL (RWL) 将存在性结果改为概率陈述，证明充分参数化的 RGNN 包含保持 1-RWL 表达性的稀疏子网络，并导出随机剪枝得到该子网络的概率下界。实验在合成数据上实例化该下界并与经验概率比较，还在时序和分子基准上考察预训练表达性与优化、预测质量的关系。
Motivation: 图神经网络应用广泛，但参数稀疏性如何影响关系 (RGNN) 与时序 (TGNN) 变体的表达性仍不清楚。该工作旨在把静态图上的强表达性彩票假设推广到更一般的多关系和时间域，并建立表达性与优化行为的联系。
Method: 通过关系 WL (RWL) 将 SELTH 推广为概率性结论，证明充分参数化的 RGNN 中含保持 1-RWL 表达性的稀疏子网络，并推导随机剪枝成功的概率下界。同时证明常见 TGNN 和跨图消息传递模式可重写为 RGNN 以继承这些保证，并论证稀疏 RGNN 的表达性与其在常见更新规则下的优化行为相关。
Result: 摘要报告了概率下界的推导及其在合成数据上的实例化，并与随机剪枝的经验概率进行了比较；在时序和分子基准上研究了预训练表达性对优化与预测质量指标的影响，但未给出具体数值结论。
Conclusion: 该研究统一了关系域与时序域中的表达性彩票假设，为稀疏化 RGNN/TGNN 提供了理论保证，并初步验证了表达性与优化行为的联系。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Large Language Models Hallucinate Electric Fata Morganas?
papers.abstract_en: AI hallucinations - that is, outputs which are made up, cannot be verified, or contradict the source material - are generally regarded as an engineering flaw to be dealt with. This paper contends that they also have philosophical significance when it comes to the question of machine consciousness. We examine the known causes of hallucinations in large language models - such as source-target divergence, discrepancies between training and inference, and overfitting - and we present two empirical investigations. In the first, we apply successive generations of the GPT model to ambiguous factual questions under different temperature settings, finding that higher temperatures result in plausible but incorrect answers while lower temperatures lead to factually accurate ones. The sampling parameters that cause a model to seem creative or spontaneous and thus more likely to pass behavioral tests of intelligence are the same ones that increase its hallucination rate. In the second, we look at an encoder-only model that has been trained on encyclopedic data and which answers questions of the same type factually and without embellishment, indicating that hallucinations are due to exposure to subjective and socially diverse training data rather than to the development of any cognitive ability. Using references to Turing, Searle's Chinese Room, the frame problem, and the cybernetic tradition of Wiener and Ashby, we claim that a model's self-reports of emotion or sentience come within the definition of hallucination, and that any future occurrence of machine consciousness might remain epistemically inaccessible since it would be indistinguishable from a sufficiently advanced hallucination.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Consciousness Studies 32 (11): 96-120. 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从哲学角度讨论大语言模型幻觉现象与机器意识问题的关联，认为幻觉不仅是工程缺陷，也具有哲学意义。作者回顾幻觉的已知成因，并呈现两个经验研究：不同温度设置下 GPT 系列模型对模糊事实问题的回答，以及编码器专用模型在百科全书式数据上的事实性回答。基于 Turing、Searle 中文屋、框架问题以及 Wiener/Ashby 控制论传统，作者主张模型对情感或感知能力的自我报告属于幻觉，且未来机器意识可能因与高级幻觉不可区分而在认识论上不可及。
Motivation: 大语言模型的幻觉（即编造、无法验证或与源材料矛盾的输出）通常只被视为需要处理的工程缺陷，但作者认为它关系到机器意识这一哲学问题，值得专门考察。
Method: 进行两个经验调查：一是将连续多代 GPT 模型应用于模糊事实问题并在不同温度设置下比较回答；二是考察一个在百科全书数据上训练的仅编码器模型，询问同类型问题以对比其事实性和修饰程度。
Result: 经验结果显示，较高温度会产生看似合理但错误的答案，较低温度则产生事实准确的答案；使模型显得有创造性或自发性的采样参数同时会提高其幻觉率。仅编码器模型能事实性回答问题且不加修饰，提示幻觉源于主观且社会多样的训练数据暴露，而非任何认知能力的发展。
Conclusion: 作者声称模型关于情绪或感知的自我报告落入幻觉的定义范围内；任何未来出现的机器意识可能仍然是认识论上不可及的，因为它与足够先进的幻觉无法区分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A strengthening of the MCFL-ness of $O_2$
papers.abstract_en: In the last years, a number of proofs of the fact that $O_2$ is a multiple context-free grammar (MCFG) were given. Such results can be exploited in the fields of both computational linguistics and of computational algebra. Here, we focus on a recent such proof spelled in terms of factorizations of string tuples, and give a new result with a stronger characterization of such factorizations than in existing theorems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注 O_2 是多重上下文无关文法（MCFG）这一事实的证明，基于字符串元组分解（factorizations of string tuples）给出一个新的结果，对这类分解提供比现有定理更强的刻画。作者指出该结果可在计算语言学和计算代数领域得到应用。
Motivation: 近年来已有多个证明表明 O_2 是 MCFG，这些结果可被用于计算语言学和计算代数。本文聚焦于其中一个以字符串元组分解表述的证明，希望给出更强的分解性质刻画。
Method: 给出一个新定理，对字符串元组的分解方式提出比现有定理更强的特征描述，从而加强关于 O_2 具有 MCFL 性质（MCFL-ness）的已有证明。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据或数值结果；主要贡献是理论性的，即对字符串元组分解给出更强的定理性刻画。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该结果强化了 O_2 是 MCFG 的现有证明，但未展开讨论其在计算语言学或计算代数中的具体应用细节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Many Optimizers But Only One Training Path: Repeated Resampling for Adaptive Optimizer Selection
papers.abstract_en: An optimizer is usually chosen before training a deep neural network and then kept fixed. Treating optimizer choice as a hyperparameter could boost performance, but it requires several complete training runs and discards all but the winner. Repeated Optimizer Resampling (ROR) instead searches during one evolving run. Every $b$ epochs, each candidate optimizer scouts from the current model weights for $s$ epochs. The best scout continues for the remaining $b-s$ epochs, and that completed segment becomes the new incumbent if it improves the validation objective. This design allows the preferred optimizer to change as training progresses. We compare two variants of ROR on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and two motor insurance claim-count models. Nine fixed optimizers and both ROR variants are evaluated with the same ten seeds. One-epoch ROR uses 24\% to 35\% of the aggregate training needed to identify the best fixed optimizer exhaustively and remains close to that optimizer on all four tasks. These results support short scouting as a practical way to search over optimizers without completing every candidate run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Repeated Optimizer Resampling (ROR)，一种在单次训练过程中动态选择优化器的方法。ROR 周期性让候选优化器从当前权重出发进行短程侦察 (scouting)，由验证目标决定哪个优化器继续推进训练。作者在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST 和两个车险理赔次数模型上比较了九个固定优化器与两个 ROR 变体。
Motivation: 优化器通常训练前选定并固定；若把优化器选择当作超参数，需要多次完整训练并丢弃多数结果，代价高昂。
Method: 每 b 个 epoch，每个候选优化器从当前模型权重出发侦察 s 个 epoch，表现最好的侦察结果继续完成剩余 b-s 个 epoch；若该完整段改进验证目标，则成为新的 incumbent，从而允许训练过程中切换偏好优化器。
Result: 在四个任务上，one-epoch ROR 只需穷举搜索最优固定优化器所需总训练的 24% 到 35%，且性能与最优固定优化器接近。
Conclusion: 摘要认为短程侦察是一种实用的优化器搜索方式，无需跑完每个候选的完整训练。
Relevance: 3
