papers.title: Tensor Field Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces Tensor Field Models (TFMs), realization-level Mathematical Structures in which a learned Operator maps a product of admissible component-section families to a prescribed family of time-dependent tangent sections on a Generative State Manifold. Analytic and dynamical restrictions are encoded through the choice of admissible families rather than imposed by the root definition. Constructed, component-separable, and Tensor Bundle TFMs provide structured refinements of this common object. In the conditional realizations considered here, a structured condition $c=(c_1,\ldots,c_n)$ is mapped componentwise to a reusable collection $\mathbf H_c=(H_{c_1}^{(1)},\ldots,H_{c_n}^{(n)})$. In the architectures evaluated here, the component representations remain distinct and are combined only by the Field Operator to produce the generated Vector Field. All learned models are trained using Flow Matching. Experiments show that TFMs can improve performance and that amortized sampling enabled by reusable condition representations can accelerate generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出张量场模型 (Tensor Field Models, TFMs)，一类实现层面的数学结构：学习到的算子将可容许分量族 (admissible component-section families) 的乘积映射到生成状态流形 (Generative State Manifold) 上规定的时变切截面族。解析与动力学约束通过选择可容许族来编码，而非由根定义强制。论文构造了 component-separable 与 Tensor Bundle 等结构化变体，并在条件实现中把结构化条件 c=(c_1,...,c_n) 按分量映射到可复用表示集合 H_c=(H_{c_1}^{(1)},...,H_{c_n}^{(n)})。所有模型使用 Flow Matching 训练，实验表明 TFM 可提升性能，且可复用条件表示带来的摊销采样 (amortized sampling) 能加速生成。
Motivation: 现有生成模型的数学结构常将约束直接写入定义，限制了可表达性与模块化。本文试图通过把解析和动力学限制放到可容许族的选择中，建立更灵活、可分量的统一生成结构框架。
Method: 提出 Tensor Field Models，用 Field Operator 将分量表示族映射为生成向量场；构造了 Constructed、component-separable 和 Tensor Bundle 等细化变体，并采用 Flow Matching 训练所有模型。
Result: 实验表明 TFMs 能改善生成性能，且利用可复用条件表示 (reusable condition representations) 的摊销采样可加速生成过程。
Conclusion: 作者强调将约束编码在可容许族中并保持分量表示在 Field Operator 前相互独立，可以在统一框架下获得性能提升与采样加速。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Forgetting, plasticity, and co-observation: a third facet of continual learning
papers.abstract_en: Efficient continual learning remains a fundamental challenge for deep neural networks. While catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity are widely considered the primary obstacles to overcome, we show that these two issues cannot fully explain the performance gap between naive sequential training and offline joint training. In this paper, we highlight data co-observation as a distinct factor influencing continual learning performance. By decoupling the constraints of separate data access from stability and plasticity, we systematically investigate the representational benefits gained by observing training data together. Empirically, we demonstrate a consistent performance difference between joint and separate training across both supervised and self-supervised paradigms in generic data-incremental "chunking" scenarios, whilst mitigating forgetting and controlling for plasticity. Our findings indicate that simultaneous observation of training data (co-observation) yields benefits to the learner's generalization that extend well beyond mere knowledge retention, and that this effect does not require a specific continual distribution shift. Furthermore, we contextualize prominent continual learning mechanisms through this lens: while distillation-based approaches act only as effective knowledge retention mechanisms, our results suggest that the empirical success of memory replay goes beyond the mitigation of forgetting, actively reintroducing the benefits of data co-observation into the learning process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出持续学习（continual learning）中除灾难性遗忘（catastrophic forgetting）和可塑性丧失（loss of plasticity）之外的第三个影响因素：数据共观察（co-observation），即模型同时观察训练数据所带来的表征收益。作者将数据访问约束与稳定性/可塑性解耦，在监督与自监督的数据增量“分块”场景中系统比较联合训练与分离训练，发现两者存在一致的性能差异，且该收益超出知识保留本身、不依赖于特定分布偏移。蒸馏类方法仅起到知识保留作用，而记忆回放（memory replay）的经验成功可部分归因于其重新引入了共观察的收益。
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘和可塑性丧失被广泛视为持续学习的主要障碍，但它们无法完全解释朴素顺序训练与离线联合训练之间的性能差距，表明存在被忽略的独立因素。
Method: 通过将“数据分开访问”的约束从稳定性与可塑性中解耦，在通用的数据增量“分块”场景下对比联合训练和分离训练，并在控制遗忘与可塑性的前提下考察共观察的泛化收益；同时用蒸馏和记忆回放等持续学习机制进行情境化分析。
Result: 在监督和自监督两种范式下均观察到联合训练与分离训练之间一致的性能差异；共观察带来的泛化收益不依赖持续分布偏移。蒸馏仅有效保留知识，而记忆回放的效果超越缓解遗忘，能够主动把共观察收益重新引入学习过程。
Conclusion: 共观察是持续学习性能中独立于遗忘与可塑性的第三个方面；记忆回放的经验成功部分源于其恢复了联合观察数据的表征收益。

papers.title: Decomposing Wrong-Consensus Agreement in LLM Self-Consistency: A GPT-4.1 Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Majority voting over multiple LLM samples is widely used to raise answer accuracy, yet its gain varies erratically: on hard questions it can even backfire. This paper gives a quantitative account of this failure. A pluralistic agreement index Gamma is defined as the expected fraction of the samples of a wrong run that agree with the consensus, normalized by a reference scale d=(1-p)/(C-1), and is decomposed into a mechanical component (what a vote delivers given only a per-case answer preference) and a preference-unexplained residual. The mechanical null is difficulty-matched and leak-free: each case is resimulated at its own accuracy and option preference, estimated from the case's other runs, so no run predicts its own agreement. On GPT-4.1 the decomposition shows benchmark-associated direction (an observational ordering over n=4 cells per benchmark, not a significance claim). On multiple-choice GPQA-Diamond, the per-case answer preference explains 81-93% of the held-out test-run agreement index: the shared-bias-dominates account over-claims here, because a wrong but attractive option the whole cohort latches onto is captured by the per-case preference channel (whether that preference is induced by shared training bias is not identified). On open-domain AIME, the mechanical preference explains only 59-78% (21-29% if shrunk to pure noise), and a preference-unexplained residual of 1.56-2.80 Gamma units survives, which a run-level preference-heterogeneity reference more than absorbs (1.4-2.1). A self-consistency backfire on hard questions is reproduced (binned voting gap down to -0.09, coupled CI [-0.12,-0.07]), and the highest-agreement bin reaches an accuracy of only 0.42-0.83, a 1.2-3.6x lift over base rate: agreement is graded evidence, not certification. No new voting method is proposed; code and evidence are committed and reproducible.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables; quantitative kappa-decomposition of agreement saturation in self-consistency;
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 LLM 自一致性（self-consistency）中多数投票的失效给出量化解释。作者定义多元一致性指标 Gamma 为错误运行的样本与共识一致比例的期望，并用参考尺度 d=(1-p)/(C-1) 归一化，将其分解为机械成分（仅由逐样本答案偏好决定）与偏好无法解释的残差。在 GPT-4.1 上的案例研究显示，多项选择题 GPQA-Diamond 中逐样本偏好可解释 81-93% 的留出测试运行一致性，而开放域 AIME 上仅解释 59-78%，并存在显著残差；同时复现了难题上的自一致性回火（voting gap 最低 -0.09，CI [-0.12,-0.07]）。作者强调一致性是分级证据而非认证，未提出新的投票方法。
Motivation: 对多个 LLM 样本做多数投票被广泛用于提升答案准确率，但其收益在不同问题上波动剧烈，在难题上甚至可能适得其反；本文旨在对这一失效模式给出定量解释，而不是停留在定性观察。
Method: 定义以 (1-p)/(C-1) 为参考尺度的多元一致性指标 Gamma，并将其分解为机械成分与偏好无法解释的残差；机械零模型通过每个 case 的其他 run 估计自身准确率与选项偏好进行难度匹配的无泄漏重模拟，从而保证每条 run 不预测自身的一致性。研究以 GPT-4.1 在 GPQA-Diamond 和 AIME 上做案例性观测排序（每个基准 n=4 个单元格，不作显著性声明）。
Result: 在 GPQA-Diamond 上，逐 case 答案偏好解释了测试 run 一致性指标的 81-93%；在 AIME 上仅解释 59-78%（若收缩到纯噪声则为 21-29%），并残留 1.56-2.80 个 Gamma 单位的偏好无法解释残差，而 run 级偏好异质性参考可吸收其中的 1.4-2.1。难题上复现了自一致性回火，最高一致性分箱的准确率仅 0.42-0.83，为基线准确率的 1.2-3.6 倍提升。
Conclusion: 一致性应被视作分级的证据而非认证；对多项选择题而言，共享偏差主导的解释有所夸大，因为群体共同选择的错误诱人选项已被逐 case 偏好通道捕获（该偏好是否由共享训练偏差导致无法识别）。作者明确不提出新投票方法，并承诺代码与证据可复现。

papers.title: A Real-Time Tsetlin Machine-based Non-intrusive Load Monitoring System on MCUs
papers.abstract_en: Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) systems estimate individual appliance energy consumption from a single aggregate meter, without requiring separate sensors for each device. By installing a single meter that measures a building's total electricity consumption, NILM algorithms can determine the active status of each appliance. However, traditional NILM systems use computationally intensive optimization algorithms to process offline data, limiting their capability for on-device deployment, where sensitive household data must be processed locally. This paper proposes a Tsetlin Machine (TM)-based NILM framework, targeting real-time applications on resource-constrained microcontrollers (MCUs), enabling privacy-preserving edge deployment. The problem is reformulated as a classification task, and the proposed approach achieves an average precision of 90% and recall of 96% for two-appliance classification, and 77% precision and 80% recall for four appliances on the REDD dataset. The trained model occupies only 18 KB of flash memory and achieves an inference latency of 0.43 ms on an ESP32, demonstrating its suitability for embedded NILM applications on MCUs.
papers.comment: Accepted by International Symposium on the Tsetlin Machine (ISTM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Tsetlin Machine (TM) 的非侵入式负荷监测 (NILM) 框架，面向资源受限的微控制器 (MCU) 进行实时边缘部署。该框架将 NILM 重构为分类任务，在 REDD 数据集上对两类电器达到平均精确率 90%、召回率 96%，对四类电器达到精确率 77%、召回率 80%。模型仅占用 18 KB 闪存，在 ESP32 上推理延迟为 0.43 ms。
Motivation: 传统 NILM 系统依赖计算密集的优化算法处理离线数据，难以在设备端部署；而家庭敏感数据需要本地处理以保护隐私，因此需要适合资源受限 MCU 的实时方案。
Method: 将 NILM 问题重新表述为分类任务，采用 Tsetlin Machine 构建模型，以较小内存占用和低延迟满足 MCU 上的实时推理需求，支持隐私保护的边缘部署。
Result: 在 REDD 数据集上，两类电器分类达到平均精确率 90%、召回率 96%；四类电器达到精确率 77%、召回率 80%。模型闪存占用 18 KB，在 ESP32 上推理延迟 0.43 ms。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提方法在嵌入式 MCU 上的低资源开销和实时性能表明其适用于嵌入式 NILM 应用，并支持隐私保护的本地处理。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SIDScope: A Diagnostic Resource for Semantic-ID Interfaces in Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic-ID mappings are reusable interfaces between item tokenizers and generative recommenders, yet released mappings rarely state whether they are coherent, what structure they expose, how generated paths resolve, or what must be revalidated after a refresh. SIDScope is a source-traced diagnostic resource for these decisions. It normalizes item-to-code artifacts, verifies provenance and joins, profiles mapping structure, compares paired revisions, and accounts for path-to-item outcomes in generated traces. Across nine source-traced tokenizer exports from seven families on Amazon and Yelp data - eight executable routes plus one auditable snapshot - SIDScope reveals that interface health is multi-signal rather than scalar. Its central finding is mechanism-conditional: prefix alignment strongly tracks held-out candidate exposure when retrieval consumes SID prefixes, then weakens as scoring becomes prefix-independent. Trained trace accounting exposes a second hidden gap: a valid target path can survive without uniquely retrieving the target item by 1.2-3.0 percentage points. A refresh case establishes a third: repairing the mapping does not by itself restore an inherited generator; model reuse requires a separate handoff check. The package provides frozen evidence summaries, conformance reports, trace labels, table builders, and CPU-only verifiers. It supports decisions about artifact readiness, interface risks, and revalidation before model reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIDScope 是一个面向生成式推荐中语义 ID（Semantic-ID）映射的诊断资源，用于评估 item tokenizer 与生成式推荐器之间的可复用接口。论文基于 Amazon 和 Yelp 数据上的九个源追溯 tokenizer 导出（八个可执行路线加一个可审计快照），揭示接口健康是多信号而非标量问题，并给出三个机制相关的发现。
Motivation: 发布的语义 ID 映射很少说明自身是否连贯、暴露何种结构、生成路径如何解析，以及刷新后需要重新验证什么，导致接口重用决策缺乏依据。
Method: SIDScope 对 item-to-code 工件进行规范化，验证来源与连接（provenance and joins），刻画映射结构，比较成对修订版本，并在生成轨迹中核算路径到 item 的结果；包内提供冻结的证据摘要、一致性报告、轨迹标签、表构建器和仅 CPU 的验证器。
Result: 中心发现具有机制条件性：当检索使用 SID 前缀时，前缀对齐与保留候选曝光紧密相关，而打分不再依赖前缀时该相关性减弱；轨迹核算显示有效的目标路径可能在 1.2–3.0 个百分点内无法唯一检索到目标 item；刷新案例表明修复映射本身并不能恢复继承的生成器。
Conclusion: 论文认为接口健康需要多信号综合判断，并支持在模型复用前对工件就绪度、接口风险和重新验证做出决策。

papers.title: GraphK: Variable-Size Graph Generation with Efficient Edge Construction
papers.abstract_en: Graph generation models have advanced significantly with deep learning, yet they remain limited in scalability, flexibility, and ability to model underlying structures. We present GraphK, a novel encoder-sampler-decoder framework for graph generation that overcomes these challenges through structural flexibility and computational efficiency. Unlike autoregressive approaches constrained by vocabulary size (i.e. number of nodes in graph generation), GraphK allows for both upscaling (generating graphs with more nodes than the input) and downscaling, providing a flexible control over output graph size. By learning permutation-invariant latent representations and sampling new node embeddings via maximum likelihood estimation, GraphK generalizes across graph sizes and structures. For edge generation, we employ edge prediction with a KDTree-based top-k neighbor search in the latent space, reducing computational cost. Based on the manifold smoothness assumption, our method effectively captures graph properties. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that GraphK outperforms existing methods, accurately learns graph structures, and generates synthetic graphs without explicit definitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GraphK，一种 encoder-sampler-decoder 图生成框架，通过排列不变潜表示、基于最大似然估计的节点嵌入采样，以及 KDTree 支持的 top-k 最近邻边预测，实现对输出图大小的上/下缩放并降低边构造计算成本。摘要称在合成与真实数据集上优于现有方法，能准确学习图结构，并在无显式定义的情况下生成合成图。
Motivation: 现有图生成模型在可扩展性、灵活性和底层结构建模方面存在局限；自回归方法受输出词汇量（即节点数）约束，难以灵活控制生成图的大小。
Method: GraphK 采用编码器-采样器-解码器框架，学习排列不变的潜表示，并通过最大似然估计采样新节点嵌入；边生成阶段在潜空间中使用基于 KDTree 的 top-k 最近邻搜索进行边预测，并借助流形平滑性假设来捕捉图属性。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验显示，GraphK 在图结构学习和生成质量上优于现有方法，且无需显式规则即可生成合成图；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调 GraphK 的结构灵活性与计算效率，支持图大小的放大和缩小，并能跨不同图大小和结构泛化；摘要未讨论明确局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MIFR: A Modality-Invariant and Fair Representation Framework for Skin Disease Classification
papers.abstract_en: Skin diseases represent a major global public health burden, yet machine learning tools developed to assist in their diagnosis suffer from two critical limitations: reliance on only one modality for diagnosis and systematic performance disparities across skin tones. While existing approaches address each challenge separately, this work proposes a modality-invariant framework with fair representation (MIFR) for skin disease classification. The architecture pairs clinical photographs with dermoscopic images using ViT-based encoders, projecting each input into a high-dimensional embedding space via modality-specific projection heads. The resulting model is trained with a five-component multi-objective loss including weighted cross-entropy for classification, confusion and skin-type classification losses for fairness, per-modality supervised contrastive loss for class alignment, and a modality-invariance loss for clinical and dermoscopic modality alignment. Experiments on the HIBA+Derm7pt paired dataset and the external PAD-UFES-20 and ISIC 2019 datasets showed that modality-invariant representation learning provides competitive predictive performance compare to relevant baseline models and competitive fairness on the internal dataset. t-SNE visualizations confirmed that clinical and dermoscopic embeddings of the same disease are geometrically aligned, validating the joint objectives.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the First Workshop on Advancing African Medical AI through Global Integration (AFRICAI)-MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MIFR（Modality-Invariant and Fair Representation）框架，用于皮肤疾病分类，将临床照片与皮肤镜图像配对，使用基于 ViT 的编码器和模态专属投影头，并采用五组件多目标损失联合训练。在 HIBA+Derm7pt 配对数据集及外部 PAD-UFES-20 和 ISIC 2019 数据集上，该框架取得与基线相当的预测性能和公平性；t-SNE 可视化显示同一疾病的临床与皮肤镜嵌入在几何上对齐。
Motivation: 现有皮肤疾病诊断工具多依赖单一模态，且在不同肤色上存在系统性性能差异；已有方法通常分别处理这两个问题，缺乏同时兼顾模态融合与公平性的统一框架。
Method: 采用 ViT 编码器分别处理临床照片和皮肤镜图像，通过模态专属投影头将输入映射到高维嵌入空间；训练损失包含加权交叉熵分类损失、混淆度与皮肤类型分类的公平性损失、每模态监督对比损失用于类对齐，以及模态不变性损失用于临床与皮肤镜模态对齐。
Result: 在 HIBA+Derm7pt 内部配对数据集以及 PAD-UFES-20 和 ISIC 2019 外部数据集上，模态不变表示学习相比相关基线模型取得有竞争力的预测性能和内部数据集上的公平性；t-SNE 可视化证实同病种的临床与皮肤镜嵌入几何对齐。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过联合优化分类、公平性和模态对齐目标，模态不变表示学习能够同时满足预测性能与公平性要求。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: To Go Far, Go Together: Diverse Preferences Induce a Curriculum for Reward Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Learning a reward model from human feedback and optimizing a policy against it is one approach to aligning AI systems with individual users. From a fairness perspective, existing work improves such alignment by developing data-efficient and accurate reward models that capture minority preferences despite scarce data. We push this line of inquiry one step further and argue that data-efficient and accurate per-user reward models are not sufficient: users whose reward models are difficult to \textit{optimize} at the policy level can become a new underserved group. We start from the observation that one user's reward model can be easy to optimize from the initial policy while another's is not. We argue that, given a sufficiently diverse user population, a curriculum naturally emerges between easy- and hard-to-optimize reward models. Building on this insight, we propose CurriPO, which grows a tree-structured curriculum to accommodate diverse user-specific objectives, covering the population in a single traversal. Specifically, CurriPO automatically constructs a curriculum over diverse user reward models, allowing it to branch from the existing curriculum and reuse reward models previously incorporated into the curriculum. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to explicitly exploit multi-user structure to address optimization in AI alignment. Extensive experiments on personalized continuous control in a simulated environment show that CurriPO achieves $1.2$--$2.1\times$ the population satisfaction of the strongest baseline while substantially reducing training time. Additional analysis attributes much of this improvement to the users left underserved by conventional optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从公平性视角研究基于人类反馈的奖励优化（reward optimization），指出现有工作只关注数据效率和每用户奖励模型的准确率，而忽略了某些用户的奖励模型在策略层面难以优化的问题。作者观察到，在足够多样化的用户群体中，容易与难以优化的奖励模型之间会自然形成课程（curriculum），并提出 CurriPO，通过树状结构课程在一次遍历中覆盖多样化的用户目标。在个性化连续控制模拟环境的实验中，CurriPO 达到最强基线 1.2–2.1 倍的人口满意度，同时显著减少训练时间。
Motivation: 现有工作通过数据高效的准确奖励模型来捕捉少数偏好，但即使每用户奖励模型准确，若其难以在策略层优化，用户仍可能成为被忽视群体；不同用户的奖励模型从初始策略出发的优化难度不同。作者认为这构成公平性缺口。
Method: 提出 CurriPO，利用多样化用户群体中自然涌现的课程结构，自动构建树状课程（tree-structured curriculum），在单次遍历中覆盖不同用户目标，并允许从已有课程分支、复用先前纳入课程的奖励模型。
Result: 在模拟环境中的个性化连续控制任务上，CurriPO 达到最强基线 1.2–2.1 倍的人口满意度（population satisfaction），并大幅缩短训练时间；进一步分析表明提升主要来自传统优化所忽视的用户。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首个显式利用多用户结构来应对 AI 对齐中优化问题的工作；结果表明面向多样化用户群体的课程设计能提升公平性，但实验限于模拟连续控制环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gradient Mirage: Trainable yet Label-Unidentifiable Gradients in Large Language Model Split Learning
papers.abstract_en: Gradient matching attacks (GMAs) in LLM split learning (SL) rely on a critical yet underexplored assumption: the gradient exposed at the split interface is a faithful derivative of the client's full-label training objective. This gradient-objective consistency allows a curious server to recover private labels by searching for a sequence whose induced gradient explains the observation. We propose Gradient Mirage, a defense that breaks this consistency without discarding the optimization utility of the backward signal. Our key idea is to induce the adversary to solve a misspecified inverse problem, in which no plausible label sequence in the sequence space can explain the observed gradients. Concretely, Gradient Mirage achieves this by inducing inconsistency across three dimensions: objective, direction, and scale. Selective Autoregressive Supervision derives the exposed gradient from a masked surrogate loss rather than the full-label objective assumed by the attacker; Scale Blinding then applies randomized multiplicative rescaling, obscuring the gradient's natural magnitude; and Directional Privatization further randomizes the gradient direction while preserving its magnitude through the von Mises-Fisher (vMF) mechanism under a directional metric differential privacy guarantee. Crucially, utility is preserved: the Top segment still learns from all target tokens via Dual-Track Backpropagation, the exposed gradient remains informative since each supervised token retains its complete autoregressive context, and Bottom-Gradient Recovery restores the effective gradient for Bottom-segment optimization. Extensive experiments show that Gradient Mirage provides substantially stronger protection than existing defenses under comparable fine-tuning performance, achieving a better privacy-utility trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gradient Mirage，一种针对大语言模型 (LLM) 拆分学习 (split learning, SL) 中梯度匹配攻击 (gradient matching attacks, GMA) 的防御方法。其核心思路是破坏拆分接口处暴露梯度与客户端全标签训练目标之间的一致性，迫使攻击者求解一个无法被任何合理标签序列解释的错误设定逆问题。具体通过目标、方向和尺度三个维度的不一致实现防御，并在保持微调性能的同时取得更好的隐私-效用权衡。
Motivation: 梯度匹配攻击依赖一个关键假设：拆分接口处的梯度是客户端全标签训练目标的忠实导数。这一梯度-目标一致性使服务器能够通过搜索诱导梯度匹配的标签序列来恢复私有标签，而现有防御很少关注并打破这一一致性。
Method: Gradient Mirage 从三个维度引入不一致：选择性自回归监督 (Selective Autoregressive Supervision) 用掩码代理损失 (masked surrogate loss) 取代攻击者假定的全标签目标；尺度盲化 (Scale Blinding) 对梯度施加随机乘性缩放以掩盖其自然量级；方向私有化 (Directional Privatization) 在方向性度量差分隐私 (differential privacy) 保证下，通过 von Mises-Fisher (vMF) 机制随机化梯度方向同时保留其幅度。效用通过 Dual-Track Backpropagation 保留顶端 (Top) 段对所有目标 token 的学习，且每个监督 token 保留完整自回归上下文，并通过 Bottom-Gradient Recovery 恢复底端 (Bottom) 段优化的有效梯度。
Result: 大量实验表明，在相当的微调性能下，Gradient Mirage 相比现有防御提供显著更强的隐私保护，取得更好的隐私-效用权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，打破梯度与目标之间的一致性可以在不丢弃反向传播信号优化效用的前提下有效抵御梯度匹配攻击。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Learning Canonical Register Automata over Ordered Data Domains
papers.abstract_en: Register automata are finite automata equipped with memory that recognize data languages over infinite alphabets. In this work, we investigate active learning algorithms for deterministic register automata (DRAs) over ordered data domains--covering both dense domains, such as the rationals, and non-dense domains such as the integers. We show that the active learning problem for DRAs over both dense and non-dense ordered domains can be treated within a single unified framework. More specifically, we develop and implement a polynomial-time active learning procedure for DRAs over ordered domains, using oracles for membership, equivalence and memorability queries. The memorability queries were originally introduced for learning DRAs over domains with identity tests. Our unified framework also leads to a new consequence: minimization of DRAs over the non-dense ordered domain of integers is decidable, extending a result previously known only for dense domains. Finally, we give improved complexity bounds of several decision problems for DRAs over ordered domains that are closely related to the queries used in active learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有序数据域（包括稠密域如有理数，以及非稠密域如整数）上确定性寄存器自动机（DRA）的主动学习。作者提出一个统一框架，借助成员查询（membership）、等价查询（equivalence）和可记忆性查询（memorability queries）实现多项式时间的主动学习过程。该框架还导出新结论：整数这一非稠密有序域上的 DRA 最小化问题可判定，并给出若干与相关查询有关的决策问题的改进复杂度界。
Motivation: 已有 DRA 主动学习工作主要针对带身份测试的域，而有序数据域（稠密与非稠密）缺乏统一的处理框架；此外非稠密有序域上 DRA 的最小化可判定性此前未知。
Method: 提出并实现一个统一框架，将稠密与非稠密有序域上的 DRA 主动学习纳入同一套构造，使用成员、等价和可记忆性三类 oracle，并给出多项式时间主动学习过程。
Result: 摘要报告的理论结果包括：整数上 DRA 最小化可判定，扩展了先前仅适用于稠密域的结果；同时改进若干与主动学习查询密切相关的决策问题的复杂度界。
Conclusion: 作者认为有序数据域上的 DRA 主动学习可以在统一框架下处理，并强调最小化可判定性的扩展与改进的复杂度界。摘要未提及实验评估或方法局限。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告的理论结果包括：整数上 DRA 最小化可判定，扩展了先前仅适用于稠密域的结果；同时改进若干与主动学习查询密切相关的决策问题的复杂度界。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为有序数据域上的 DRA 主动学习可以在统一框架下处理，并强调最小化可判定性的扩展与改进的复杂度界。摘要未提及实验评估或方法局限。

papers.title: Enhancing Distance-Based Graph Autoencoders with Structural Penalties for Dynamic Graph Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Graph autoencoders (GAEs) are widely used for learning representations of dynamic graphs. However, their optimisation objectives typically do not take structural heterogeneity across nodes into account. We propose three distance-based GAE variants that incorporate structural penalties into the reconstruction loss. All variants share a two-layer Graph Convolutional Network encoder and a Euclidean-distance decoder trained with distance-based reconstruction objectives. We extend sparsity-corrected loss with two node-level regularization terms: (i) a hub penalty based on degree centrality, and (ii) a penalty based on Natural Community Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (NC-LID). The paper is motivated by prior evidence linking high NC-LID to reduced embedding quality. The proposed methods are designed to emphasize reconstruction errors for structurally ambiguous nodes. Experiments on multiple dynamic graph data sets show that incorporating NC-LID-based regularization consistently improves reconstruction performance over the baseline without structural regularization and the method using hub-aware regularization. These findings highlight NC-LID as a useful structural signal for enhancing distance-based graph autoencoders in dynamic settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态图自编码器（GAE）在重构损失中未考虑节点结构异质性的问题，提出三种基于距离的 GAE 变体，在重构损失中加入结构惩罚项。所有变体共享两层图卷积网络（GCN）编码器和基于欧氏距离的解码器，并在稀疏校正损失上扩展两类节点级正则项：基于度中心性的枢纽惩罚（hub penalty）和基于 Natural Community Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (NC-LID) 的惩罚。实验表明，加入 NC-LID 正则化能在多个动态图数据集上一致改善重构性能。
Motivation: GAE 的优化目标通常不考虑节点间的结构异质性，而先前证据表明高 NC-LID 与嵌入质量下降相关，因此需要对结构上模糊的节点给予更强的重构误差关注。
Method: 提出三种基于距离的 GAE 变体，采用两层 GCN 编码器与欧氏距离解码器，并在稀疏校正损失上加入两种节点级正则项：基于度中心性的枢纽惩罚与基于 NC-LID 的惩罚，以强调结构模糊节点的重构误差。
Result: 在多个动态图数据集上的实验显示，NC-LID 正则化方法在重构性能上一致优于无结构正则化的基线以及使用枢纽感知正则化的方法。
Conclusion: 摘要将 NC-LID 视为增强动态环境下基于距离的图自编码器的有效结构信号。

papers.title: Beyond Predictive Fairness: Quantifying Attribution Consistency Across Demographic Groups in Diabetic Retinopathy Screening
papers.abstract_en: Fairness in medical imaging is commonly evaluated through subgroup performance metrics, yet it remains unclear whether models rely on consistent visual evidence across demographic groups. This work introduces the Explanation Consistency Score (ECS), a fairness-aware metric based on Jensen-Shannon divergence that quantifies the similarity of attribution maps across subgroups. Using diabetic retinopathy screening as a case study, ECS is evaluated globally and within disease severity. Experiments reveal that while predictive performance differs across ethnic groups, explanation consistency remains relatively high and shows no significant association with performance disparities. These findings suggest that predictive fairness and explanation consistency capture complementary dimensions of model behavior, motivating fairness evaluations that extend beyond predictive performance.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the joint FAIMI, BRIDGE, and EPIMI Workshop at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出解释一致性分数 (Explanation Consistency Score, ECS)，一种基于 Jensen-Shannon 散度的公平性感知度量，用于量化不同人口统计亚组之间归因图 (attribution maps) 的相似性，并以糖尿病视网膜病变筛查为案例研究。实验发现不同种族群体的预测性能存在差异，但解释一致性相对较高，且与性能差异无显著关联。作者据此认为预测公平性与解释一致性捕捉了模型行为的互补维度。
Motivation: 医学影像中的公平性通常通过亚组性能指标评估，但尚不清楚模型是否在不同人口统计组间依赖一致的视觉证据，因此需要一个显式衡量解释一致性的公平性指标。
Method: 提出 ECS，基于 Jensen-Shannon 散度量化跨人口统计亚组归因图的相似性，并在糖尿病视网膜病变筛查场景中分别在全局层面和疾病严重程度内部进行评估。
Result: 实验显示不同种族群体的预测性能存在差异，但解释一致性保持相对较高，且与性能差异之间没有显著关联。
Conclusion: 预测公平性和解释一致性捕捉了模型行为的互补维度，作者据此主张公平性评估应超越预测性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Epistemic Subordination: Generative AI and the Infrastructure of Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI does not merely produce biased outputs. It encodes the majority's way of knowing as the default infrastructure of knowledge itself. We call this epistemic subordination. The training process compresses the full breadth of human expression into a single probabilistic model whose statistical baseline reflects the languages, assumptions, and cultural frameworks of the dominant culture. Minority epistemologies are not excluded but absorbed: present in the training data, yet structurally subordinated in the output. The result is not a collection of discrete biases that can be audited and corrected. It is an epistemic condition embedded in the architecture from which all outputs emerge. This unified harm cuts across three legal domains -- anti-discrimination law, cultural and linguistic rights, and democratic viewpoint pluralism -- and each fails to address it for the same structural reason: existing law regulates downstream, at the level of decisions and applications. The remedy must match the site of harm. If epistemic subordination is produced at the level of model training, then law must learn to govern at that level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“认知从属”（epistemic subordination）概念，认为生成式AI并非只是产生可审计的离散偏见，而是在训练过程中把主流文化的认知方式编码为知识本身的默认基础设施。少数群体的认识论并未被排除，而是被吸收进训练数据，却在输出结构中处于结构性从属地位。作者主张这种统一性伤害横跨反歧视法、文化与语言权利、民主观点多元主义三个法律领域，而现有法律都在下游决策与应用层面规制，因此无法触及训练层面的根源。
Motivation: 现有AI偏见讨论和法律规制多聚焦于可审计、可修正的离散偏见，且法律规范停留在下游决策和应用层面；摘要指出真正的伤害是嵌入架构的认知条件，需要从模型训练层面加以治理。
Method: 提出“epistemic subordination”这一概念框架，分析反歧视法、文化与语言权利、民主观点多元主义三个法律领域面对此伤害时的共同结构性失败，并论证法律应转向规制模型训练层面。
Result: 本文为概念性法律理论论文，摘要未报告实证结果；其主要结论性发现是三个法律领域都以相同结构性原因无法回应这一认知层面的伤害。
Conclusion: 补救措施必须与伤害产生的位置相匹配：如果认知从属产生于模型训练层面，法律就必须学会在该层面进行治理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SED-FOD: Scattering-Aware Expert Decomposition for Few-Shot Cross-Sensor SAR Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) object detection is an important part of remote sensing interpretation. However, because of variations in frequency band, resolution, background clutter, and target scattering responses, the performance of existing detectors often degrades when training and testing data are acquired from different SAR domains. Although domain adaptation methods offer a promising paradigm for solving this problem, most of them mainly pursue domain-invariant feature alignment and suppress sensor-dependent scattering characteristics that are useful for object detection. This problem becomes more challenging in few-shot scenarios, where only a few fully annotated target-domain SAR images are available. To address this issue, we propose a scattering-aware shared-specific feature decomposition framework for few-shot SAR domain adaptation object detection. We decompose detection features into a shared path and several soft-gated scattering-specific expert paths. The shared path learns transferable object structural information and is used for asymmetric domain alignment, while the scattering-specific experts adaptively compensate heterogeneous SAR responses. In addition, routing-domain auxiliary loss is introduced to encourage specific experts to capture sensor-dependent routing preferences, and an expert balancing loss is used to prevent routing collapse. Extensive experiments on four bidirectional heterogeneous SAR detection tasks between FARAD-X/FARAD-Ka and MiniSAR under different few-shot settings have been conducted and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance in both forward and reverse adaptation directions.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE JSTARS. 13 pages, 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对少样本跨传感器合成孔径雷达（SAR）目标检测性能退化问题，提出散射感知的共享-特有特征分解框架 SED-FOD。该方法将检测特征分解为共享路径与多个软门控散射特有专家路径，并引入路由域辅助损失和专家平衡损失。在 FARAD-X/FARAD-Ka 与 MiniSAR 之间的四个双向异构 SAR 检测任务上，实验表明正反两个适应方向均取得优越性能。
Motivation: 不同 SAR 域在频带、分辨率、背景杂波和目标散射响应上存在差异，现有域适应方法多追求域不变特征对齐，反而抑制了对检测有用的传感器依赖散射特征；少样本场景下仅有少量目标域标注，使该问题更具挑战。
Method: 提出散射感知的共享-特有特征分解框架：共享路径学习可迁移的目标结构信息并用于非对称域对齐，散射特有专家路径通过软门控自适应补偿异质 SAR 响应；同时引入路由域辅助损失使专家捕捉传感器依赖的路由偏好，并用专家平衡损失防止路由坍缩。
Result: 在 FARAD-X/FARAD-Ka 与 MiniSAR 之间构成的四个双向异构 SAR 检测任务、多种少样本设置下，该方法在正向和反向适应方向上均取得优于对比方法的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为将特征分解为共享结构与散射特有响应对少样本跨传感器 SAR 目标检测是有效的，实验验证了该框架在双向域适应中的优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Geometric Data Perturbation with Noisy-Anchor Alignment for Privacy-Preserving Collaborative Learning
papers.abstract_en: Geometric Data Perturbation (GDP) enables one-shot, privacy-preserving collaborative learning: each participant applies a distance-preserving transformation to its private data and uploads only the resulting representation to a central analyst. We study GDP under analyst-participant collusion, in which the analyst combines all uploaded representations with the private data and transformations disclosed by colluding participants to recover a non-colluding participant's private data. Participant-specific independent transformations resist this attack but map participants' data into incompatible representation spaces, degrading downstream model performance. Shared-anchor alignment from Data Collaboration (DC) analysis restores compatibility and improves utility, but we show that disclosing the DC anchor matrix enables exact recovery of non-colluding participants' private data even in the presence of collusion. Adding noise directly to the private-data representations mitigates this vulnerability but substantially reduces utility. We propose adding noise to the anchor representations instead. Each participant independently transforms its private data and the shared anchor matrix, perturbs only the resulting anchor representation, and uploads both representations in a single round. Using the noisy anchor representations, the analyst aligns the private-data representations by solving a Generalized Orthogonal Procrustes Problem. We characterize alignment and recovery errors, specialize a conservative sufficient condition for convergence of the alignment to our setting, and analyze three recovery attacks. Experiments on MNIST and CelebA show that, across the evaluated attacks and deployment settings, anchor noise achieves higher learning accuracy than private-data noise at comparable measured leakage, yielding a more favorable privacy-utility trade-off under the specified collusion model.
papers.comment: 72 pages total: 36-page main paper and 36-page supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究几何数据扰动 (Geometric Data Perturbation, GDP) 在分析者与参与者合谋攻击下的隐私泄露问题，并提出向锚点表示加噪的替代方案。作者证明共享 DC 锚点矩阵即使存在合谋也会导致非合谋参与者私有数据被精确恢复，而直接给私有数据表示加噪会明显损害效用。他们提出参与者只扰动共享锚点矩阵对应的表示，分析者通过求解广义正交 Procrustes 问题完成对齐；MNIST 与 CelebA 实验表明，在可比泄露水平下锚点噪声比私有数据噪声获得更高的学习准确率。
Motivation: GDP 可实现一次性隐私保护协作学习，但参与者特定的独立变换会使数据落入不兼容的表示空间，损害下游效用；共享锚点对齐虽恢复兼容性并提供更好的效用，却让分析者能借助合谋者的私有数据与变换精确恢复非合谋参与者的数据。现有直接对私有数据表示加噪的做法能缓解该漏洞但大幅降低效用，因此需要一种保持效用的扰动方式。
Method: 每个参与者独立变换自己的私有数据与共享锚点矩阵，只扰动得到的锚点表示，并在单轮中同时上传私有数据表示与带噪锚点表示；分析者根据带噪锚点表示，通过求解广义正交 Procrustes 问题 (Generalized Orthogonal Procrustes Problem) 对齐各参与者的私有数据表示。论文还给出了对齐误差与恢复误差的表征，将保守的收敛充分条件适配到该设定，并分析了三种恢复攻击。
Result: 在 MNIST 与 CelebA 数据集上，针对所评估的攻击与部署设置，锚点噪声在可比较的实测泄露水平下实现了高于私有数据噪声的学习准确率，从而在指定合谋模型下获得更有利的隐私-效用权衡 (privacy-utility trade-off)。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在分析者与参与者合谋的威胁模型下，扰动共享锚点表示而非私有数据表示，是兼顾隐私与效用的一种更优策略。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究几何数据扰动 (Geometric Data Perturbation, GDP) 在分析者与参与者合谋攻击下的隐私泄露问题，并提出向锚点表示加噪的替代方案。作者证明共享 DC 锚点矩阵即使存在合谋也会导致非合谋参与者私有数据被精确恢复，而直接给私有数据表示加噪会明显损害效用。他们提出参与者只扰动共享锚点矩阵对应的表示，分析者通过求解广义正交 Procrustes 问题完成对齐；MNIST 与 CelebA 实验表明，在可比泄露水平下锚点噪声比私有数据噪声获得更高的学习准确率。
summary_sections.motivation: GDP 可实现一次性隐私保护协作学习，但参与者特定的独立变换会使数据落入不兼容的表示空间，损害下游效用；共享锚点对齐虽恢复兼容性并提供更好的效用，却让分析者能借助合谋者的私有数据与变换精确恢复非合谋参与者的数据。现有直接对私有数据表示加噪的做法能缓解该漏洞但大幅降低效用，因此需要一种保持效用的扰动方式。
summary_sections.method: 每个参与者独立变换自己的私有数据与共享锚点矩阵，只扰动得到的锚点表示，并在单轮中同时上传私有数据表示与带噪锚点表示；分析者根据带噪锚点表示，通过求解广义正交 Procrustes 问题 (Generalized Orthogonal Procrustes Problem) 对齐各参与者的私有数据表示。论文还给出了对齐误差与恢复误差的表征，将保守的收敛充分条件适配到该设定，并分析了三种恢复攻击。
summary_sections.result: 在 MNIST 与 CelebA 数据集上，针对所评估的攻击与部署设置，锚点噪声在可比较的实测泄露水平下实现了高于私有数据噪声的学习准确率，从而在指定合谋模型下获得更有利的隐私-效用权衡 (privacy-utility trade-off)。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，在分析者与参与者合谋的威胁模型下，扰动共享锚点表示而非私有数据表示，是兼顾隐私与效用的一种更优策略。

papers.title: Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning
papers.abstract_en: JEPA-style latent world models can use Euclidean distance to a goal latent as the cost for model-predictive control (MPC). Strong decoding of task variables, however, does not guarantee that this particular cost ranks candidate action sequences by real task progress. We call the latter property \emph{decision-metric alignment}. We introduce Plan-Real Spearman, which measures latent--real rank agreement on random plans, and CEM-stage Spearman, which measures the same agreement as cross-entropy-method (CEM) search concentrates its proposal. We analyze sufficient conditions under which latent distance preserves real-cost rankings, identifying encoder distortion, terminal rollout error, and candidate margins as the controlling quantities. Guided by the observed empirical alignment gap, DA-LeWM augments LeWM with inverse-dynamics and demonstration-conditioned goal-action heads. Across all our experiments, DA-LeWM accelerates convergence and achieves higher online success than LeWM, while probe scores remain similar. These results show that action-conditioned objectives improve the geometry used by Euclidean-cost, CEM-based latent MPC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 JEPA 式潜在世界模型 (latent world model) 中以目标潜在向量的欧氏距离作为 MPC 代价时，代价排序是否与实际任务进展一致的问题，将此性质称为决策度量对齐 (decision-metric alignment)。作者提出 Plan-Real Spearman 与 CEM-stage Spearman 两个诊断指标，分析潜在距离保持真实代价排序的充分条件，并据此提出 DA-LeWM，在 LeWM 上增加逆动力学与演示条件目标动作头。实验表明 DA-LeWM 比 LeWM 收敛更快、在线成功率更高，且探针分数相近。
Motivation: 即使潜在世界模型能够强解码出任务变量，也不能保证欧氏距离代价能按真实任务进展对候选动作序列排序；这一对齐缺口直接影响 Euclidean-cost、基于 CEM 的潜在 MPC 规划质量，但目前缺少诊断与针对性改进。
Method: 提出 Plan-Real Spearman，在随机规划上度量潜在排序与真实代价排序的一致性；提出 CEM-stage Spearman，在 CEM 搜索逐步集中提议分布的过程中度量同样的一致性。作者分析潜在距离保持真实代价排序的充分条件，识别出编码器畸变 (encoder distortion)、末端 rollout 误差与候选裕度 (candidate margins) 为控制量；基于观察到的对齐缺口，DA-LeWM 在 LeWM 上加入逆动力学头和演示条件目标动作头。
Result: 在所有实验中，DA-LeWM 相比 LeWM 加速收敛并获得更高的在线成功率，同时探针分数保持相近；这支持动作条件目标改善了欧氏代价、CEM 潜在 MPC 所用几何的结论。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过动作条件目标改进潜在表征几何，可以提升 Euclidean-cost、CEM 式潜在 MPC 的规划质量，而不仅仅是提升任务变量的可解码性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Metrics That Write Themselves: Evolving an Evaluator from Its Own Blind Spots
papers.abstract_en: Agents improve quickly against a reliable automatic metric and stall without one, and the applications that need them most, report generation among them, are the ones nobody knows how to score. Can the metric write itself? Saying what makes an answer good is hard; pointing at something wrong with one is easier, so the metric we evolve is a pool of small Python operators that each flag a candidate for one named defect, or abstain, and vote. Asking a model for operators directly does not work: 183 candidates realise only 96 distinct behaviours, from one narrow region of an enormous space. EvalCEGAR instead borrows counterexample-guided abstraction refinement from program verification. It reads the pool as an abstraction and searches for a collision, two answers the operators score identically, one correct and one not. That pair, not a prompt, is the authoring request, and when a collision defeats every attempt the loop widens what an operator may read rather than resampling. On MBPP+ and HumanEval+, a sandbox whose hidden unit tests give exact ground truth, the loop writes a 55-line operator that closes 15.4% of the gap between flagging nothing and a perfect filter on 428 unseen tasks (+0.0065, p=0.0010) at a quarter of our best hand-written operator's flags. On the benchmark it never saw it matches that operator's effect exactly on a third of the flags. Six of eight runs admit such an operator and all six help out of sample; our 15 hand-written operators applied together as one filter lose accuracy. An LLM judge on the same information ties that delta on a nearly disjoint set of candidates, and charges a model call per candidate forever where the operator charges none.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvalCEGAR，一种从自身盲点演化自动评估指标的方法。它维护一个由小型 Python 操作符构成的池子，每个操作符针对一个命名缺陷对候选答案投票或弃权；直接让模型生成操作符效果有限，183 个候选仅表现出 96 种不同行为。EvalCEGAR 借用程序验证中的反例引导抽象细化 (counterexample-guided abstraction refinement)，把操作符池视为抽象，搜索两个被评分相同但一正一误的答案碰撞，并用该配对作为作者请求，必要时扩大操作符可读取的信息而非重新采样。在 MBPP+ 和 HumanEval+ 上，循环写出一条 55 行的操作符，在 428 个未见任务上闭合了什么都不标记与完美过滤器之间 15.4% 的差距，标记数仅为最佳手写操作符的四分之一，且无需每次调用模型。
Motivation: 许多应用（尤其是报告生成等）缺少可靠的自动评估指标，代理在缺乏指标时会停滞；直接定义何为好的答案很困难，而指出答案的错误相对容易，因此需要一个能自动发现自身盲点并改进的评估指标生成方法。
Method: 方法的核心是 EvalCEGAR：把操作符池当作对答案空间的一种抽象，搜索一对评分相同但一正确一错误的答案（碰撞），以该碰撞对作为改进请求；当一次请求无法解决时，循环拓宽操作符可读取的输入范围，而不是重新采样操作符。
Result: 在 MBPP+ 和 HumanEval+ 的沙盒环境中，该方法生成的操作符在 428 个未见任务上闭合了无标记与完美过滤器之间 15.4% 的差距 (+0.0065, p=0.0010)，标记数仅为最佳手写操作符的四分之一；在从未见过的基准上，它恰好匹配该手写操作符在三分之一的标记上的效果。八次运行中有六次能生成此类操作符且全部在样本外有效，而 15 个手写操作符合并为一个过滤器时准确性反而下降。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过操作符池与反例引导抽象细化，评估指标可以从自身盲点中被演化出来，并以零推理成本工作；不过并非所有运行都能成功，但成功案例在样本外保持有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Regularised Iterative Generalised Least Squares with Optimal Selection of the Hyper-Parameter for Identifying Nonlinear Phenomenological Models
papers.abstract_en: In some fields currently dominated by empirical approaches, such as state of health (SoH) prediction for lithium-ion batteries, phenomenological models motivated by quasi-physical thinking contain parameters to be estimated from experimental data. Often the structure of such models yields fully or partially confounded parameters, which are difficult or even impossible to estimate reliably. To preserve the desired model formulation and simultaneously improve the numerical conditioning for the problem we introduce a ridge regression scheme. An automated method is provided, based on information theoretic measures of model performance, which optimises the ridge regression hyper-parameter at each iteration. The formulae presented require fixed point iteration to solve for the hyper-parameter. Given a suitable starting value, analysis demonstrates convergence is very rapid. The optimal hyper-parameter selection mechanism is incorporated within an efficient regularised iterative generalised least squares mechanism, capable of fitting both heteroscedastic and serially correlated data as required. Simulation confirms the efficacy of the overall method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种正则化迭代广义最小二乘（Regularised Iterative Generalised Least Squares）方法，用于辨识非线性现象学模型，并通过基于信息论准则的自动机制在每个迭代步优化岭回归（ridge regression）超参数。该方法针对参数完全或部分混杂（confounded）导致的数值病态问题，采用不动点迭代求解最优超参数，且能处理异方差（heteroscedastic）与序列相关（serially correlated）数据。模拟实验验证了整体方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现象学模型（如锂离子电池健康状态 SoH 预测）的结构常导致参数混杂，难以可靠估计；而纯经验方法缺乏可解释的物理结构。作者希望在不改变模型设定的前提下改善数值条件（numerical conditioning），使参数估计在统计上可行。
Method: 在迭代广义最小二乘框架中引入岭回归正则化，每次迭代通过基于信息论模型性能度量的自动化机制选择最优超参数；该超参数由不动点迭代求解，给定合适初值时收敛很快。所提机制可灵活适配异方差和序列相关数据。
Result: 摘要报告模拟实验确认了整体方法的有效性，并证明超参数的不动点迭代在合适初值下收敛非常迅速；文中未给出具体数值指标或实际数据集结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调将自动化超参数选择与正则化迭代广义最小二乘结合，可在保持现象学模型形式的同时提升参数辨识的数值可靠性。该方法属于方法论研究，摘要仅以模拟验证为主，未涉及实际电池或天气数据应用。
Relevance: 6

papers.title: A Multi-Agent Platform for Automated Enterprise Analytics and Insight Generation
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a multi-agent framework built on CrewAI [1] for conversational business intelligence. Five specialized AI agents operate in a sequential pipeline to process natural language queries, retrieve and analyze data, generate visualizations via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) [2], and deliver actionable insights. The platform features a defense-in-depth security architecture for multi-tenant data isolation and a query parameterization mechanism for transforming conversational insights into reusable dashboard components. Evaluation across 300 end-to-end test cases spanning synthetic and production enterprise datasets demonstrates 95.3% functional accuracy, a mean response latency of 24 seconds, and a response quality score of 4.52/5.0 as assessed by an LLM-as-a-Judge framework, with a 93.0% hallucination-free rate, representing a 22.6 percentage point accuracy improvement and 20.2% quality gain over a single-agent baseline. Cross-model evaluation across four LLM backends and human expert validation confirm architectural generalizability and evaluator reliability. An ablation study confirms that the Data Analysis and Report Aggregation agents are the primary drivers of output quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 CrewAI 构建的多智能体平台，用于面向企业会话式商业智能（conversational business intelligence）的自动化分析与洞察生成。五个专业化智能体以顺序流水线方式处理自然语言查询、检索与分析数据、通过模型上下文协议（MCP）生成可视化，并输出可执行的洞察。在 300 个端到端测试用例上，系统取得 95.3% 的功能准确率、24 秒的平均响应延迟、4.52/5.0 的响应质量评分以及 93.0% 的无幻觉率，并相对单智能体基线实现 22.6 个百分点的准确率提升和 20.2% 的质量提升。
Motivation: 企业分析场景中自然语言查询到可信洞察的转换具有高复杂度和多租户安全要求，单智能体系统在准确性和输出质量上存在明显瓶颈，需要更结构化的多智能体协作方案。
Method: 提出一个包含五个专门智能体的顺序流水线框架，构建在 CrewAI 之上，使用模型上下文协议（MCP）处理可视化生成；同时引入纵深防御（defense-in-depth）安全架构实现多租户数据隔离，并通过查询参数化机制将会话式洞察转换为可复用的仪表盘组件。
Result: 在覆盖合成与企业生产数据集的 300 个端到端测试用例上，功能准确率为 95.3%，平均响应延迟 24 秒，LLM-as-a-Judge 评分的响应质量为 4.52/5.0，无幻觉率为 93.0%，相比单智能体基线准确率提升 22.6 个百分点、质量提升 20.2%；四个 LLM 后端的跨模型评估和人类专家验证支持架构泛化性与评估可靠性，消融研究表明 Data Analysis 与 Report Aggregation 两个智能体对输出质量贡献最大。
Conclusion: 作者认为该多智能体流水线与安全机制能显著提升企业级会话分析的准确性和质量，并指出数据分析与报告聚合智能体是质量的主要驱动因素。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个基于 CrewAI 构建的多智能体平台，用于面向企业会话式商业智能（conversational business intelligence）的自动化分析与洞察生成。五个专业化智能体以顺序流水线方式处理自然语言查询、检索与分析数据、通过模型上下文协议（MCP）生成可视化，并输出可执行的洞察。在 300 个端到端测试用例上，系统取得 95.3% 的功能准确率、24 秒的平均响应延迟、4.52/5.0 的响应质量评分以及 93.0% 的无幻觉率，并相对单智能体基线实现 22.6 个百分点的准确率提升和 20.2% 的质量提升。
summary_sections.motivation: 企业分析场景中自然语言查询到可信洞察的转换具有高复杂度和多租户安全要求，单智能体系统在准确性和输出质量上存在明显瓶颈，需要更结构化的多智能体协作方案。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个包含五个专门智能体的顺序流水线框架，构建在 CrewAI 之上，使用模型上下文协议（MCP）处理可视化生成；同时引入纵深防御（defense-in-depth）安全架构实现多租户数据隔离，并通过查询参数化机制将会话式洞察转换为可复用的仪表盘组件。
summary_sections.result: 在覆盖合成与企业生产数据集的 300 个端到端测试用例上，功能准确率为 95.3%，平均响应延迟 24 秒，LLM-as-a-Judge 评分的响应质量为 4.52/5.0，无幻觉率为 93.0%，相比单智能体基线准确率提升 22.6 个百分点、质量提升 20.2%；四个 LLM 后端的跨模型评估和人类专家验证支持架构泛化性与评估可靠性，消融研究表明 Data Analysis 与 Report Aggregation 两个智能体对输出质量贡献最大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该多智能体流水线与安全机制能显著提升企业级会话分析的准确性和质量，并指出数据分析与报告聚合智能体是质量的主要驱动因素。

papers.title: FedLNS: Leverage LayerNorm Signature Modeling to Mitigate Adversarial Manipulation in Federated LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Federated training enables language models to learn from distributed private text, but the server cannot directly verify the local supervision or optimization process that produces each client update. A malicious client can therefore train on corrupted targets, introduce incorrect context-token associations, and degrade the global model through repeated aggregation. Such degradation can also increase the risk of unreliable or hallucinatory generation. We propose Federated Learning with Normalization Signatures (FedLNS), a server-side framework for lightweight malicious-update screening. FedLNS represents each client update through changes in trainable normalization-layer parameters and screens suspicious updates against a robust, history-aware cross-client reference. Because the signatures are extracted at the server from the returned local models, FedLNS requires no additional client-to-server parameter or metadata exchange compared to standard federated learning (FL) methods. After screening, the retained full-model updates can be aggregated using standard FL or another compatible aggregation rule. FedLNS requires no raw client data, trusted server dataset, labeled attack examples, or separately trained detector. Experiments on GPT-style, BERT-style, and LLaMA-style models trained from scratch with 200 clients show that, under 40% population-level target manipulation, FedLNS achieves lower test perplexity than the strongest of six baselines for all three architectures under both IID (independently and identically distributed) and non-IID data partitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedLNS（Federated Learning with Normalization Signatures），一种面向联邦大语言模型的服务器端恶意更新筛查框架。它利用可训练归一化层参数的变化作为客户端更新签名，并对照历史感知的跨客户端参考进行筛查，无需额外通信开销。在 200 个客户端、40% 群体目标操纵下，GPT 风格、BERT 风格和 LLaMA 风格模型在 IID 与非 IID 数据划分上的测试困惑度均低于六个基线中最强者。
Motivation: 联邦训练中服务器无法直接验证客户端本地监督或优化过程，恶意客户端可通过在损坏目标上训练、引入错误上下文-词元关联并经反复聚合降低全局模型质量，还可能增加不可靠或幻觉生成的风险。
Method: FedLNS 在服务器端从返回的本地模型中提取可训练归一化层参数变化作为签名，将可疑更新与稳健的、历史感知的跨客户端参考进行比对；筛查后保留的完整模型更新可继续使用标准联邦学习或其他兼容聚合规则。它不需要原始客户端数据、可信服务器数据集、标注攻击样本或单独训练检测器。
Result: 在 200 个客户端、40% 群体级目标操纵的实验设置下，对于 GPT 风格、BERT 风格和 LLaMA 风格三种架构，FedLNS 在 IID 与非 IID 数据划分下均取得低于六个基线中最强者的测试困惑度。
Conclusion: 作者强调该筛查框架轻量且与标准联邦学习通信成本一致，并能有效缓解恶意客户端更新带来的模型退化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CL4D: Contrastive Language-4D Pretraining for Vision-Language Reasoning in Dynamic Scenes
papers.abstract_en: 4D understanding and reasoning is a fundamental capability for embodied AI agents operating in dynamic physical environments. However, existing vision encoders are largely limited to static 2D images or 3D point clouds without temporal modeling, or to 2D videos that lack accurate geometric depth reasoning. Consequently, current approaches fail to jointly capture spatial structure and motion evolution in dynamic scenes. We present CL4D, the first foundational 4D vision encoder that directly operates on dynamic point clouds, trained with a contrastive learning objective to align spatio-temporal geometric representations with natural language descriptions. By learning a shared embedding space between text and 4D scene dynamics, CL4D enables zero-shot motion-to-text and text-to-motion retrieval in dynamic environments and serves as a foundational 4D vision encoder for downstream 4D vision-language tasks. Building on this encoder, we introduce 4DVLM, a 4D vision-language model that conditions language generation on dynamic geometric representations. 4DVLM is the first VLM designed to operate directly on 4D point clouds without relying on 2D images, 2D videos, or static 3D point clouds. We train CL4D and subsequently 4DVLM on a newly constructed dataset termed DynAction4D capturing diverse human motions across varying object interactions and scene environments. Extensive experiments across multiple 4D human action benchmarks demonstrate that CL4D achieves state-of-the-art performance, with improvements of approximately ~16.75% over prior methods. Furthermore, 4DVLM outperforms frontier video VLMs such as Gemini and GPT-5 even when these models are provided with RGB video sequences corresponding to the same scenes represented as 4D point clouds for 4DVLM.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CL4D，首个直接操作动态点云的 4D 基础视觉编码器，通过对比学习 (contrastive learning) 将时空几何表示与自然语言描述对齐，并在此基础上构建 4DVLM 视觉语言模型，使语言生成直接以 4D 点云表示为条件。作者新建 DynAction4D 数据集用于训练，并在多个 4D 人体动作基准上报告约 16.75% 的性能提升；4DVLM 在对应 RGB 视频序列上优于 Gemini 和 GPT-5 等前沿视频 VLM。论文被 ECCV 2026 接收。
Motivation: 现有视觉编码器局限于静态 2D 图像、3D 点云或缺少精确几何深度推理的 2D 视频，无法同时捕捉动态场景中的空间结构与运动演化，因而难以支撑具身智能体的 4D 理解与推理。
Method: 提出 CL4D，一种直接以动态点云为输入的 4D 基础视觉编码器，通过对比学习在文本与 4D 场景动态之间学习共享嵌入空间，从而实现零样本的运动-文本双向检索；并基于该编码器构建 4DVLM，直接在 4D 点云上条件化语言生成，不依赖 2D 图像、2D 视频或静态 3D 点云。训练数据为新建的 DynAction4D 数据集，涵盖多样人体动作、物体交互和场景环境。
Result: 在多个 4D 人体动作基准上，CL4D 达到最先进性能，相对先前方法提升约 16.75%；4DVLM 在输入对应场景 RGB 视频序列的对比设置下，优于 Gemini、GPT-5 等前沿视频 VLM。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CL4D 作为首个 4D 基础视觉编码器的意义，并验证了直接基于 4D 点云进行视觉语言推理的可行性；实验证据主要集中在 4D 人体动作基准上。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Flama: a Python framework for development and deployment of production-ready APIs, machine learning, and LLM services
papers.abstract_en: We present Flama, an open-source Python framework for developing and deploying production-ready web APIs, machine learning services, and large-language-model (LLM) applications. Built on the Asynchronous Server Gateway Interface (ASGI), Flama offers a type-driven, async-first programming model that unifies REST API development, predictive model serving, and generative AI inference in one architecture. It is organised around seven subsystems: a component-based dependency injection system resolving handler parameters from type annotations at startup; a pluggable schema layer supporting Pydantic, Marshmallow and Typesystem behind a single adapter; an automatic CRUD generator turning a SQLAlchemy table and a schema class into REST endpoints backed by the Repository and Unit of Work patterns; a portable binary format (.flm) packaging models from scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers with their metadata for zero-code deployment; a multi-backend LLM server running vLLM (Linux/CUDA) or MLX (Apple Silicon) and exposing four wire protocols (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and a native streaming dialect) through a shared codec; a Rust-accelerated core compiled via Maturin for routing, JSON encoding, compression and parsing; and a Model Context Protocol module turning any application into an MCP server over JSON-RPC 2.0. Built-in capabilities include JWT authentication, two pagination strategies, background tasks in threads or processes, WebSocket endpoints, Server-Sent Event and NDJSON streaming, OpenAPI 3.2.0 generation from handler signatures, and a command-line interface for running applications and for serving, packaging and inspecting models. We describe the architecture, present the programming model through worked examples, and compare Flama with existing frameworks, model serving platforms and LLM inference engines.
papers.comment: 83 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Software available at https://github.com/vortico/flama, up-to-date documentation at https://flama.dev
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flama 是一个基于 ASGI 的开源 Python 框架，将 REST API 开发、机器学习模型 serving 和 LLM 推理统一在类型驱动、async-first 的编程模型下。框架包含依赖注入、schema 适配、自动 CRUD、.flm 模型打包、多后端 LLM 服务、Rust 加速核心和 Model Context Protocol 模块七个子系统，并提供 JWT 认证、OpenAPI 生成、WebSocket 与流式输出等内置能力。论文以架构描述、示例和框架对比为主，未给出定量基准。
Motivation: 作者瞄准生产环境中 REST API、预测模型和生成式 AI 服务往往需要不同工具链的问题，希望用单一框架降低开发和部署成本，并统一传统模型 serving 与 LLM 推理。
Method: 提出 Flama，包含七个子系统：基于类型注解的组件依赖注入；统一 Pydantic/Marshmallow/Typesystem 的 schema 层；由 SQLAlchemy 表和 schema 自动生成 REST CRUD 的生成器；将多框架模型打包为 .flm 的二进制格式；支持 vLLM 与 MLX 后端、暴露 OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama 等四种协议的多后端 LLM server；用 Maturin 编译的 Rust 加速核心；以及把应用变成 MCP server 的模块。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；主要呈现架构设计和编程模型，并通过示例说明使用方式、与现有框架、模型 serving 平台和 LLM 推理引擎进行对比。
Conclusion: Flama 的定位是生产可用的一体化服务框架，作者建议开发者可用它同时处理 REST、模型 serving 与生成式推理；该工作属于系统/工具类贡献，未涉及实验验证。

papers.title: A Few Cases Are All You Need: An Empirical Study of Annotation-Efficient LoRA Fine-Tuning of MedSAM3
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation is essential for clinical workflows such as treatment planning and disease assessment. While specialist tools like TotalSegmentator and MRSegmentator achieve strong performance, they require large annotated datasets for training. Medical foundation models offer a promising alternative through large-scale pretraining that reduces the annotation burden for new tasks, but zero-shot performance remains limited. Parameter-efficient adaptation via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient specialization with few trainable parameters, but a key question remains: how many expert-annotated cases are needed to achieve clinically useful segmentation performance? We address this by adapting MedSAM3 with LoRA for five abdominal organs (liver, kidneys, spleen, gallbladder, and pancreas) in CT and MRI using only 1, 2, 5, and 10 annotated cases, evaluating on AMOS22 dataset. With just 10 cases, models achieve performance competitive with specialist systems trained on orders of magnitude more data. Notably, this includes reliable gallbladder segmentation (Dice 0.68 CT, 0.59 MRI) where existing tools fail almost completely (Dice 0.0004), while remaining within 5--10% of MRSegmentator for liver, kidneys, and spleen using over 100 times fewer annotations. Furthermore, external validation on the Whole Heart Segmentation dataset shows that the approach extends to cardiac segmentation, a use case beyond the scope of TotalSegmentator (MRI) and MRSegmentator, achieving competitive left ventricle (LV) performance with only 10 annotated cases. Training requires only3--5,hours per organ on a single GPU, approximately 2--3 times faster than nnU-Net. These findings suggest that ten annotated cases are sufficient for clinically useful segmentation, effectively reducing bottlenecks for both image annotation and training time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实验研究使用 LoRA 对医学基础模型 MedSAM3 进行少样本微调，仅用 1、2、5、10 个专家标注病例在 CT 和 MRI 上分割五个腹部器官（肝脏、肾脏、脾脏、胆囊、胰腺），并在 AMOS22 上评估。结果表明 10 个病例即可达到与训练数据多几个数量级的专用系统相当的性能，胆囊分割达到 Dice 0.68 (CT) 和 0.59 (MRI)，而现有工具几乎完全失败（Dice 0.0004）。训练每器官只需 3–5 小时单 GPU，比 nnU-Net 快约 2–3 倍。
Motivation: 医学图像分割对临床工作流至关重要，但专用工具（TotalSegmentator、MRSegmentator）依赖大量标注数据；医学基础模型的零样本性能仍有限。关键问题是需要多少专家标注病例才能通过参数高效微调获得临床可用的分割性能。
Method: 采用 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 微调 MedSAM3，针对 CT 和 MRI 中的五个腹部器官，仅使用 1、2、5、10 个标注病例进行训练，并在 AMOS22 数据集上评估；另外在 Whole Heart Segmentation 数据集上做外部验证以测试对心脏分割的迁移能力。
Result: 仅用 10 个病例，模型即可达到与用数量级更多数据训练的专用系统相当的性能，包括可靠的胆囊分割（CT Dice 0.68，MRI Dice 0.59），而现有工具几乎完全失败（Dice 0.0004）；对肝脏、肾脏、脾脏与 MRSegmentator 差距在 5–10% 以内，但标注量少了 100 倍以上。外部验证表明该方法可扩展到心脏分割，左心室 (LV) 性能在仅 10 个病例下具有竞争力；训练每器官需 3–5 小时单 GPU，比 nnU-Net 快约 2–3 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为十个标注病例足以实现临床有用的分割性能，有效减小图像标注和训练时间两大瓶颈；但摘要未报告更多器官或模态的局限性。

summary_sections.motivation: 医学图像分割对临床工作流至关重要，但专用工具（TotalSegmentator、MRSegmentator）依赖大量标注数据；医学基础模型的零样本性能仍有限。关键问题是需要多少专家标注病例才能通过参数高效微调获得临床可用的分割性能。
summary_sections.method: 采用 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 微调 MedSAM3，针对 CT 和 MRI 中的五个腹部器官，仅使用 1、2、5、10 个标注病例进行训练，并在 AMOS22 数据集上评估；另外在 Whole Heart Segmentation 数据集上做外部验证以测试对心脏分割的迁移能力。
summary_sections.result: 仅用 10 个病例，模型即可达到与用数量级更多数据训练的专用系统相当的性能，包括可靠的胆囊分割（CT Dice 0.68，MRI Dice 0.59），而现有工具几乎完全失败（Dice 0.0004）；对肝脏、肾脏、脾脏与 MRSegmentator 差距在 5–10% 以内，但标注量少了 100 倍以上。外部验证表明该方法可扩展到心脏分割，左心室 (LV) 性能在仅 10 个病例下具有竞争力；训练每器官需 3–5 小时单 GPU，比 nnU-Net 快约 2–3 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为十个标注病例足以实现临床有用的分割性能，有效减小图像标注和训练时间两大瓶颈；但摘要未报告更多器官或模态的局限性。

papers.title: Visual-Aware Representation of Web Pages for Machine Learning Applications
papers.abstract_en: Applying machine learning to web pages is challenging due to the need to interpret HTML together with associated resources and perform rendering to obtain a meaningful visual and layout-aware representation. As a result, machine learning over web content remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we present a platform for visual-aware representation and machine learning over web pages based on the open-source rendering tool FitLayout. The platform provides a server capable of rendering web pages, explicitly capturing their visual and structural properties in an RDF-based representation, and persisting the rendered documents in an integrated storage. The processing pipeline is controlled via a REST API, while SPARQL queries are used to retrieve structured data suitable as input for machine learning algorithms. By explicitly modeling rendered web pages, including fine-grained layout details, the platform enables dataset sharing and supports the reproducibility of experimental results. The architecture supports the complete dataset preparation workflow, from web page collection and rendering through preprocessing and annotation of content elements to downstream learning tasks. We further provide a Python client library that integrates the platform with standard machine learning workflows. As a demonstration, we show how rendered web pages can be transformed into graph-based representations and used to train graph neural networks for recognizing key content elements, illustrating both the applicability of the approach and the reproducibility of the results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于开源渲染工具 FitLayout 的视觉感知网页表示与机器学习平台：服务端负责渲染网页，将视觉与结构属性显式建模为 RDF 表示并持久化存储，通过 REST API 控制处理流水线，用 SPARQL 查询获取适合机器学习算法的结构化数据。作者还提供 Python 客户端库以对接标准机器学习工作流，并演示将渲染后的网页转化为图表示后训练图神经网络 (GNN) 识别关键内容元素，强调数据集共享与实验可复现性。
Motivation: 对网页应用机器学习需要同时解释 HTML 及相关资源并执行渲染，才能得到有意义的视觉与布局感知表示，这使得网页内容上的机器学习研究相对不足。
Method: 平台以 FitLayout 为渲染核心，采用服务器端渲染方式显式捕获网页的视觉和结构属性并存入集成存储；处理流水线由 REST API 控制，结构化数据通过 SPARQL 查询导出；另提供 Python 客户端库，架构覆盖从网页收集、渲染、预处理、内容元素标注到下游学习任务的完整数据集制备流程。
Result: 演示实验将渲染后的网页转化为图表示，并用于训练图神经网络识别关键内容元素，展示了方法的适用性与结果可复现性；摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过显式建模渲染后网页的细粒度布局细节，平台能够支持数据集共享和实验结果复现。

papers.title: Budget-First Tariff Recommendation (BFTR): A Complete Algorithmic Framework for Telecom Plan Recommendation without Overcharging
papers.abstract_en: Telecom operators traditionally offer predefined tariff grids, forcing users to choose from a limited set of plans. This paper proposes BFTR (Budget-First Tariff Recommendation), a complete algorithmic framework integrating eight Budget-First strategies, including two original hybrid approaches: Recursive Hybrid (conditional interpolation) and Knapsack-First Hybrid (priority knapsack). Unlike existing approaches that adjust prices upward to guarantee a minimum margin, BFTR guarantees the absence of overcharging by systematically aligning the final price with the catalog reference price. We mathematically formalize each strategy, prove the existence of an offer for any positive budget, and prove that the price deviation (surcharge) is zero for all strategies that do not use interpolation with correction. A detailed comparative analysis confronts BFTR to ten main existing tariff models on ten dimensions. Experiments on a dataset of 974 customers inspired by the Nigerian MTN market show that: (i) Recursive Hybrid is optimal for the customer (100% budget used, 29.9 GB volume, utility 0.946, 0% overcharging), (ii) Piecewise offers the highest volume (39.7 GB) with 0% overcharging, (iii) Power Law provides an excellent compromise (99.9% budget, 38.1 GB, 0% overcharging). All strategies achieve a zero surcharge, confirming the theoretical guarantees. A sensitivity analysis on the weighting parameter alpha (0.2 - volume priority, 0.5 - balance, 0.8 - budget priority) shows that utility rankings evolve logically. Execution times (< 10 ms) and very low failure rates (0% for robust strategies) confirm the operational viability of the system. The formal proof of the absence of overcharging constitutes a major theoretical contribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BFTR (Budget-First Tariff Recommendation)，一个面向电信套餐推荐的完整算法框架，整合了八种 Budget-First 策略，其中包含两种原创混合方法：Recursive Hybrid（条件插值）和 Knapsack-First Hybrid（优先背包）。与现有通过向上调价保证最低利润的做法不同，BFTR 通过将最终价格与目录参考价对齐来保证不溢价。在受尼日利亚 MTN 市场启发的 974 名客户数据集上，实验显示所有策略的附加费均为零，其中 Recursive Hybrid 为客户最优（100% 预算使用、29.9 GB 流量、效用 0.946、0% 溢价），Piecewise 提供最高流量（39.7 GB），Power Law 是良好折中（99.9% 预算、38.1 GB、0% 溢价）。
Motivation: 传统电信运营商提供预定义资费网格，用户只能在有限套餐中选择；现有推荐方法常向上调整价格以保证最低利润，导致用户被过度收费。
Method: 提出包含八种 Budget-First 策略的完整框架，并数学化形式化每种策略，其中包括 Recursive Hybrid（条件插值）与 Knapsack-First Hybrid（优先背包）两种新混合方法；同时证明任意正预算下套餐存在性，并证明不使用带修正插值的策略价格偏差（附加费）为零。
Result: 在 974 名客户数据集上的对比实验表明：Recursive Hybrid 对客户最优（100% 预算、29.9 GB、效用 0.946、0% 溢价）；Piecewise 给出最高流量 39.7 GB 且 0% 溢价；Power Law 为良好折中（99.9% 预算、38.1 GB、0% 溢价）；所有策略附加费均为零。针对权重参数 alpha 的敏感性分析显示效用排名合理变化，执行时间小于 10 ms，鲁棒策略失败率为 0%。
Conclusion: 不溢价的正式证明是主要理论贡献，低延迟与极低失败率表明系统具备运营可行性；研究还将 BFTR 与十个现有资费模型在十个维度上做了详细比较。

papers.title: Competence, Not Accuracy: A Diagnostic for Reference-Free Judge Gates in Skill Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Text-space skill optimization adapts a frozen agent by evolving a natural-language skill document, accepting each candidate through a validation gate. Existing gates rely on verifiable rewards, confining these methods to tasks with an automatic verifier. Replacing the verifier with an LLM-judge gate would lift that restriction, but whether such a gate carries usable signal is untested. We ask a prior question: can we tell, before placing a judge in the loop, whether its scores separate correct from incorrect answers at all? We formalize a reference-free judge as a latent solver -- its verdict rests on agreement with whatever it would itself conclude, so its capacity to evaluate is bounded by its capacity to solve. The model yields a closed-form bound on discriminability (ROC-AUC) in the judge's competence $c$ and answer-space size $k$, a necessary condition $c > 1/k$, and the result that the marginal AUC is confounded by item difficulty while a within-question estimator is not. A non-intervening probe records judge scores on genuine optimization runs without altering any decision. We find discriminability at chance where competence sits near the floor and usable above it; that a judge's benchmark accuracy overstates the competence that matters; and, in a closed-loop study, that the screen predicts which kind of gating error occurs. The result is a cheap pre-deployment diagnostic for judge gates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在文本空间技能优化中，用LLM评判门替代自动验证器的可行性。作者将无参考评判建模为潜在求解器，推导出判别力（ROC-AUC）关于能力c和答案空间规模k的闭式界，以及必要条件c>1/k。通过非介入探针和闭环研究，发现当能力接近下限时判别力为随机水平，超出后可用；基准准确率高估了关键能力，且屏幕预测了门控错误类型。
Motivation: 现有文本空间技能优化依赖可验证奖励，限制了只能用于有自动验证器的任务。用LLM评判门可解除限制，但尚不清楚这类门是否携带可用信号，因此需要事前诊断。
Method: 形式化无参考评判为潜在求解器，其判定基于与自身结论的一致性，因此评估能力受限于求解能力。推导出判别力的闭式下界和必要条件，提出非介入探针记录真实优化运行中的评判分数而不改变决策，并用闭环研究验证屏幕预测。
Result: 当能力接近下限时判别力为随机水平，能力超过下限后才可用；评判的基准准确率高估了实际关键能力；闭环研究显示屏幕能预测哪种门控错误会发生。
Conclusion: 结果是部署前廉价评判门诊断工具，但摘要未明确提限制。

papers.title: Multi-Class Electrical and Mechanical Fault Classification Using Random Convolutional Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Diagnosing faults in rotating machinery is essential for ensuring the reliability of industrial processes. Random convolutional kernel-based Time Series Classification (TSC) methods, such as ROCKET and its variants, provide an attractive trade-off between predictive performance and computational efficiency. In this work, we evaluate SelF-Rocket for the multi-class diagnosis of both mechanical and electrical faults and introduce, as a new contribution, a multivariate extension of the original method. The proposed approach is compared with leading ROCKET-based methods on two public benchmark datasets, MaFaulDa (mechanical faults) and ITSC-UDG (stator inter-turn short circuits), under both univariate and multivariate settings. Experimental results show that SelF-Rocket achieves the best overall accuracy-latency trade-off among the evaluated methods, obtaining the highest classification performance on MaFaulDa while remaining highly competitive on the more challenging ITSC-UDG dataset.
papers.comment: Interdisciplinary Conference on Electrics and Computer (INTCEC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 SelF-Rocket 用于旋转机械的多类故障诊断（机械与电气故障），并提出原始方法的多元扩展。在两个公开基准数据集 MaFaulDa 和 ITSC-UDG 上，与主流 ROCKET 系列方法对比，SelF-Rocket 在准确率-延迟权衡上取得最优，在 MaFaulDa 上获得最高分类性能，在 ITSC-UDG 上保持高度竞争力。
Motivation: 旋转机械故障诊断对工业过程可靠性至关重要；基于随机卷积核的时间序列分类方法（如 ROCKET）在预测性能与计算效率之间提供良好折中，但多类机械与电气故障的多元诊断尚未充分验证。
Method: 在原始 SelF-Rocket 基础上引入多元扩展 (multivariate extension)，并在单变量与多变量设置下与领先的 ROCKET 类方法进行比较。
Result: 实验表明 SelF-Rocket 在评估方法中取得最佳的整体准确率-延迟权衡，在 MaFaulDa 上取得最高分类性能，在更具挑战性的 ITSC-UDG 数据集上保持高度竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SelF-Rocket 及其多元扩展在故障诊断中具有良好的准确率与计算效率平衡。

papers.title: The Impact of CutMix on Reliability and Robustness in Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring not only high accuracy but also reliable and robust predictions is critical for the deployment of semantic segmentation models in safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Despite the widespread use of CutMix - a simple yet powerful data augmentation strategy - its effect on the reliability and robustness in dense predictions tasks remains unexplored. Motivated by recent findings that semi-supervised segmentation methods, where CutMix is a core component, can severely degrade reliability, this study isolates and systematically analyzes the influence of CutMix on segmentation accuracy, calibration, and uncertainty quality. We evaluate two representative architectures, the CNN-based DeepLabV3+ and the transformer-based SegFormer, across both in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios. Our results show that CutMix has only a minor impact on segmentation accuracy but consistently improves the reliability, particularly under distribution shifts. These improvements indicate that CutMix primarily enhances the trustworthiness of the model's calibration and uncertainty rather than the raw segmentation prediction itself. This distinction is crucial for safety-critical deployment, where reliable confidence estimates are as important as raw performance.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the ISPRS Annals (ISPRS Congress 2026, Toronto, Oral Presentation)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了CutMix数据增强对语义分割模型可靠性与鲁棒性的影响，采用CNN架构DeepLabV3+和Transformer架构SegFormer，在域内与域外场景下评估精度、校准和不确定性质量。结果显示CutMix对分割精度影响很小，但持续改善可靠性，尤其在分布偏移情况下，主要提升的是校准和不确定性质量而非原始分割预测。
Motivation: 安全关键应用（如自动驾驶）中的语义分割不仅需要高精度，还需要可靠且鲁棒的预测。CutMix虽被广泛使用，但它在密集预测任务中对可靠性的影响尚未被探索；且近期研究发现以CutMix为核心组件的半监督方法会严重降低可靠性，因此需要隔离并系统分析其作用。
Method: 将CutMix作为唯一变量，系统分析其对语义分割精度、校准（calibration）和不确定性质量的影响，并跨两种代表性架构（DeepLabV3+与SegFormer）以及域内和域外场景进行评测。
Result: CutMix对分割精度影响很小，但一致性地改善可靠性，尤其在分布偏移下改善更明显。作者将这种改善归因于模型校准和不确定性质量的提升，而非原始分割预测本身。
Conclusion: CutMix增强的是模型的可信度（校准与不确定性）而非原始性能，这一区分对安全关键部署至关重要，因为可靠的置信估计与原始性能同等重要。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A single design choice determines whether machine learning models of materials make physically impossible predictions
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learned models are replacing first-principles calculations across materials discovery, and physical symmetry is the central guarantee built into them. The debate over how much symmetry to hard-wire rather than learn has run on rotations, where a symmetry error is an approximation error. Some constraints are exact: symmetry forces certain property tensors to exactly zero, so a nonzero prediction is physically impossible rather than inaccurate. Here we show that whether a model can make such predictions is decided before training by one rarely reported design bit, whether its features carry parity labels, and derive a criterion, the parity gap, that computes from group theory alone which properties and crystals are exposed. Across matched architecture pairs differing only in that bit, evaluated on two thousand centrosymmetric crystals whose piezoelectric tensor must vanish, parity-labelled arms sit at the floating-point floor while rotation-only arms predict forbidden responses on 90-96% of crystals, six orders of magnitude apart, at no accuracy cost. Training on explicit zeros does not recover exactness, and a head on a frozen universal potential inherits its backbone's symmetry group. One reflection at random initialization verifies the label in seconds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究材料机器学习模型中物理对称性的设计选择：是否在特征中携带宇称标签 (parity labels) 这一单一设计位，决定了模型能否预测物理上不可能的张量结果。作者从群论推导出宇称间隙 (parity gap) 判据，用于识别哪些性质和晶体暴露于此类风险，并在两千个中心对称晶体（其压电张量必须为零）上验证：带宇称标签的模型预测落在浮点误差水平，而仅依赖旋转对称的模型在 90-96% 的晶体上预测了被禁止的响应，差距达六个数量级且无精度损失。
Motivation: 材料发现中机器学习模型正取代第一性原理计算，物理对称性是其核心保证。以往关于硬编码对称性还是学习对称性的争论聚焦于旋转对称，此时对称性误差只是近似误差；但某些约束是精确的，例如对称性强制某些性质张量恰好为零，预测非零值属于物理上不可能而非不准确。现有讨论忽略了这个区分。
Method: 作者提出一个标准，即宇称间隙 (parity gap)，完全由群论计算得出，用来判定哪些性质和晶体在给定模型下会产生被禁止的非零预测。核心设计变量是输入特征是否携带宇称标签 (parity labels)，该变量在训练前就已决定。论文通过仅在该位上有差异的匹配架构对进行实验，并检验在冻结的通用模型骨干上添加预测头是否会继承其对称群。
Result: 在两千个中心对称晶体上，带宇称标签的模型分支预测压电张量时停留在浮点下限，而仅使用旋转对称的分支在 90-96% 的晶体上预测了被禁止的响应，两者相差六个数量级，且没有精度损失。在随机初始化时进行一次反射操作即可在数秒内验证标签的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调单一设计位——特征是否携带宇称标签——预先决定了模型是否会做出物理上不可能的预测；显式地训练零值也无法恢复精确性，而且冻干骨干上的预测头会继承骨干的对称群。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Sensitivity of the ECMWF seasonal forecast model to CO2 and anthropogenic aerosol forcings: Experimental design and impact on climate trends
papers.abstract_en: Detection and attribution studies typically rely on free running climate models with modified anthropogenic forcings, yet they fail to reproduce key observed decadal trends. Despite reduced biases, higher predictive skill, large ensembles, and improved trends through frequent reinitialization, seasonal forecast models have not been used for this purpose. We introduce a new set of counterfactual seasonal hindcasts using the ECMWF coupled seasonal forecasting system based on alternative forcing scenarios by modifying atmospheric forcing and ocean and sea ice initial conditions. An observation based estimate of the forced ocean temperature signal is derived to amplify or remove this signal from the ocean initial conditions. Retrospective forecasts include a control configuration together with enhanced and reduced forcing experiments in which either CO2 increases together with doubled anthropogenic ocean warming or CO2 is fixed and the anthropogenic ocean-warming signal is removed. Additional experiments isolate aerosol forcing. The counterfactual hindcasts substantially alter long term temperature trends while largely preserving seasonal prediction skill, interannual variability, and model drift. Enhanced forcing strengthens several observed climate trends underestimated by the control, including top of atmosphere radiative fluxes and aspects of tropical Pacific atmospheric circulation. However, the coupled atmosphere ocean system fails to sustain the strengthened tropical Pacific temperature gradient through Bjerknes feedbacks, suggesting a fundamental model limitation. Aerosol forcing has little impact, likely because indirect aerosol effects are omitted. These results establish counterfactual seasonal hindcasts as a powerful tool for dynamic attribution and diagnosing model deficiencies in responses to anthropogenic climate forcing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 ECMWF 耦合季节预报系统引入一组新的反事实季节回报 (counterfactual seasonal hindcasts)，通过修改大气强迫以及海洋和海冰初始条件来改变 CO2 与人为气溶胶强迫情景。摘要报告称这些反事实回报显著改变长期温度趋势，同时基本保留季节预报技巧、年际变率和模式漂移；增强强迫能加强若干观测到的气候趋势，但耦合大气-海洋系统无法通过 Bjerknes 反馈维持增强的热带太平洋温度梯度，气溶胶强迫因未包含间接效应而影响很小。
Motivation: 检测与归因 (detection and attribution) 研究通常依赖自由运行的气候模式并修改人为强迫，但这些模式无法再现关键的观测年代际趋势；季节预报模式虽具有较小偏差、较高预测技巧、大集合和频繁再初始化带来的改进趋势，却尚未被用于此类目的。
Method: 提出一组新的反事实季节回报试验：基于观测推导强迫性海洋温度信号，并将其从海洋初始条件中放大或移除；同时改变 CO2 与气溶胶强迫，设置控制配置、增强/减弱强迫试验，以及单独隔离气溶胶强迫的附加试验。
Result: 反事实回报在基本保持季节预测技巧、年际变率和模式漂移的同时，大幅改变长期温度趋势；增强强迫加强了控制试验中低估的若干观测气候趋势，包括大气顶辐射通量和热带太平洋大气环流，但耦合系统未能通过 Bjerknes 反馈维持增强的热带太平洋温度梯度；气溶胶强迫影响很小。
Conclusion: 摘要认为反事实季节回报可成为动态归因和诊断模式对人为气候强迫响应缺陷的有效工具，同时也指出未包含间接气溶胶效应等模式局限性。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: EgoHRV: Continuous Heart Rate Variability Estimation from Egocentric Systems for Autonomic Response and Skill Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric vision systems capture human behavior from visible cues, but overlook physiological indicators of autonomic states such as stress, engagement, and attention. Heart rate variability (HRV) is a widely used noninvasive marker of autonomic regulation under stress. HRV reflects small timing differences between successive heartbeats and has so far been out of reach for egocentric platforms, where motion and noise in gaze video mask exactly this fine-grained timing. We propose EgoHRV, a method that estimates HRV as well as heart rate (HR) from the gaze cameras that are already integrated into egocentric headsets. Our pipeline combines a 3D backbone with a novel low--high decomposition module that extracts the blood volume pulse (BVP) signal from gaze video. Our cross-domain pretraining aligns the frequency-domain representations of contact-based and camera-derived signals. This alignment gives EgoHRV the temporal precision to recover HRV from the subtle fluctuations in gaze video. EgoHRV achieves state-of-the-art accuracy for HR and HRV estimation from egocentric video, and its uncertainty-aware design improves downstream behavioral modeling. Integrating our HRV estimates and confidence measures into EgoExo4D's proficiency estimator raises accuracy by 17.8%. Beyond skill, continuous HRV estimation also opens egocentric systems to stress- and arousal-aware estimation tasks. Code: https://github.com/eth-siplab/EgoHRV
papers.comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoHRV，一种从已集成在头戴式 egocentric 设备中的 gaze camera 视频估计心率变异性 (HRV) 与心率 (HR) 的方法。方法结合 3D backbone 与新颖的 low–high decomposition 模块提取 blood volume pulse (BVP) 信号，并通过跨域预训练对齐接触式与相机采集信号的频域表示。摘要报告 EgoHRV 在 egocentric 视频的 HR/HRV 估计上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，并将 HRV 估计与置信度整合进 EgoExo4D 的 proficiency estimator 后准确率提升 17.8%。
Motivation: Egocentric 视觉系统能从可见线索捕获人类行为，但忽略了压力、投入度与注意力等自主神经状态的生理指标；HRV 是应激下自主神经调节的常用无创标记，然而 gaze 视频中的运动与噪声掩盖了逐次心跳间的细微时序，使 HRV 此前难以在 egocentric 平台上估计。
Method: EgoHRV 采用 3D backbone 配合新颖的 low–high decomposition 模块，从 gaze 视频中提取 BVP 信号；通过跨域预训练对齐接触式与相机采集信号的频域表示，从而获得恢复 HRV 所需的时序精度，并采用 uncertainty-aware 设计。
Result: 摘要称 EgoHRV 在从 egocentric 视频估计 HR 与 HRV 上取得 state-of-the-art 准确率；将 HRV 估计与置信度度量整合进 EgoExo4D 的 proficiency estimator 后，准确率提升 17.8%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调连续 HRV 估计不仅提升技能评估等下游行为建模，还使 egocentric 系统能够支持压力与唤醒度感知的估计任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CamWorldQA: Perceptual Quality Assessment of Camera-Controlled World Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative video models have enabled camera-controlled world video generation, allowing models to synthesize videos under user-defined camera trajectories. However, existing video quality assessment (VQA) methods are mainly developed for natural videos and fail to capture the unique perceptual characteristics of camera-controlled generation, such as viewpoint consistency, motion coherence, and content preservation. In this work, we introduce CamWorldQA, the first benchmark for perceptual quality assessment of camera-controlled world video generation. CamWorldQA contains 720 generated videos produced by 6 representative generation methods from 20 diverse source videos under 6 camera trajectories, where each video is annotated with a human-rated perceptual quality score through subjective experiments. Furthermore, we propose CWQA, a no-reference quality assessment network with three complementary branches that extract spatial features, temporal motion features and optical flow features to jointly predict quality scores. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CWQA achieves superior performance over existing quality assessment methods on the CamWorldQA dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CamWorldQA，据称是首个面向相机控制的世界视频生成（camera-controlled world video generation）的感知质量评估基准。该基准包含 720 个由 6 种生成方法在 6 条相机轨迹下从 20 个源视频生成的视频，并通过主观实验为每个视频标注人类评分的感知质量分数。作者还提出无参考质量评估网络 CWQA，用空间特征、时间运动特征和光流特征三个互补分支联合预测质量分数，实验显示其在 CamWorldQA 上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有视频质量评估（VQA）方法主要面向自然视频，难以捕捉相机控制生成内容的独特感知特性如视角一致性（viewpoint consistency）、运动连贯性（motion coherence）和内容保持（content preservation）。
Method: 构建 CamWorldQA 基准，包含 6 种生成方法、6 条相机轨迹、20 个源视频生成的 720 个视频及主观质量标注；提出无参考质量评估网络 CWQA，采用空间特征、时间运动特征与光流特征三个互补分支联合预测质量分数。
Result: 摘要报告 CWQA 在 CamWorldQA 数据集上优于现有质量评估方法；数据集规模为 720 个生成视频，覆盖 6 种生成方法、20 个源视频和 6 条相机轨迹。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需要专门针对相机控制世界视频生成的感知质量评估，并认为 CWQA 是这一方向的有效方案。局限性未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: A Critical Synthesis of Uncertainty Quantification and Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly breaking what seemed to be impossible not long ago by enabling unprecedented accuracy and cross-domain generalization. Yet their lack of interpretability, tendency to be overconfident, and sensitivity to real-world domain shifts pose critical challenges for safety- and mission-critical applications. Uncertainty quantification (UQ) offers a principled way to address these issues, but its integration into segmentation foundation models has yet to be explored. In this paper we present the first systematic evaluation of UQ methods applied to a foundation model for semantic segmentation. We fine-tune a lightweight DPT decoder on top of the pretrained SAM2 encoder to establish a simple yet competitive baseline and benchmark four representative UQ approaches - Monte Carlo Dropout, Deep Sub-Ensemble, Test-Time Augmentation, and Evidential Deep Learning - across Cityscapes, NYUv2, and two challenging out-of-domain settings. Our analysis compares segmentation accuracy, calibration, uncertainty quality, and inference time, revealing clear trade-offs between predictive performance, reliability, and computational cost. These results highlight both the promise and the current limitations of uncertainty-aware foundation models, pointing to the need for future work that jointly optimizes accuracy, robustness, and efficiency for real-world deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the ISPRS Annals (ISPRS Congress 2026, Toronto, Oral Presentation)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估了不确定性量化 (UQ) 方法在语义分割基础模型上的表现。作者在预训练 SAM2 编码器上微调轻量级 DPT 解码器,作为简单但有竞争力的基线,并在 Cityscapes、NYUv2 以及两个挑战性域外 (out-of-domain) 设置中基准测试了 Monte Carlo Dropout、Deep Sub-Ensemble、Test-Time Augmentation 和 Evidential Deep Learning 四种代表性方法。分析比较了分割精度、校准、不确定性质量和推理时间,揭示预测性能、可靠性与计算成本之间的明确权衡。
Motivation: 分割基础模型虽精度高、跨域泛化强,但缺乏可解释性、容易过度自信且对真实世界域移敏感,这在安全与任务关键型应用中构成挑战。UQ 是解决这些问题的原则性手段,但其与分割基础模型的集成尚未被探索。
Method: 提出以 SAM2 编码器加轻量 DPT 解码器为基线的基准框架,并系统评估四种 UQ 方法(MC Dropout、Deep Sub-Ensemble、Test-Time Augmentation、Evidential Deep Learning),在多个数据集和域外设置下对比多种指标。
Result: 摘要报告了在 Cityscapes、NYUv2 和两个挑战性域外设置下,四种 UQ 方法在分割准确率、校准质量、不确定性质量及推理时间上的对比,显示出清晰且互异的性能-可靠性-计算成本权衡,但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 结果表明不确定性感知的基础模型既有潜力也存在当前局限,作者指出未来需要联合优化精度、鲁棒性和效率,以适应真实部署需求。
