papers.title: MemFuse: Multi-Source Memory Fusion from Fragmented Observations
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for agents that operate across extended interactions, yet existing memory systems and benchmarks predominantly focus on single-source textual histories. In realistic settings, however, relevant information is often fragmented across applications and devices, as well as across users and time, requiring agents to integrate dispersed observations into coherent episodic memories while preserving their source provenance. To address these gaps, we introduce **MemFuseBench**, a benchmark for *multi-source memory fusion*. MemFuseBench is built with a Scene-to-Sensor pipeline that synthesizes controllable scenarios into source-tagged observations, evidence-grounded questions, and adversarial distractors. It enables systematic evaluation of temporal reasoning, cross-source evidence fusion, and robustness to noise. We further propose **MemFuse**, a structured memory system that preserves source-level evidence in event-layer atomic memory and organizes related atomic events into cluster-layer fused memory within a causal fusion graph. During retrieval, MemFuse retrieves and organizes related evidence fragments while maintaining traceability to original source events. Experiments on MemFuseBench show that MemFuse achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated memory systems under all three LLM settings and consistently improves performance on questions requiring cross-source evidence fusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有长期记忆系统与基准仅关注单源文本历史、无法处理多源碎片化观测的问题，提出多源记忆融合基准 MemFuseBench 和记忆系统 MemFuse。MemFuseBench 采用 Scene-to-Sensor 流程生成带来源标签的观测、证据 grounded 的问题和对抗性干扰项；MemFuse 在事件层原子记忆中保留来源级证据，并通过因果融合图将相关原子事件组织为簇层融合记忆，检索时保持对原始事件的可追溯性。实验显示 MemFuse 在三种 LLM 设置下均取得最佳综合性能，并在跨源证据融合问题上持续提升。
Motivation: 现实场景中相关信息常常碎片化地分布在应用、设备、用户和时间维度上，而现有记忆系统和基准主要覆盖单一来源的文本历史，缺乏对多源信息融合及来源溯源的支持。
Method: 提出 MemFuseBench 基准，通过 Scene-to-Sensor 流程合成可控场景为带来源标签的观测、证据支撑的问题和对抗性干扰项；并提出 MemFuse 结构化记忆系统，在事件层原子记忆中保存来源级证据，在簇层通过因果融合图组织相关原子事件，检索时组织相关证据片段并保持对原始来源事件的可追溯性。
Result: 在 MemFuseBench 上的实验表明，MemFuse 在三种 LLM 设置下均优于所评估的其他记忆系统，取得最佳综合性能，并在需要跨源证据融合的问题上稳定提升性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调来源级证据保留与因果融合图组织能够有效支持多源碎片化观测下的长期记忆融合，并可通过 MemFuseBench 系统评估时间推理、跨源证据融合和噪声鲁棒性。

papers.title: Impact of Iterative Fine-Tuning on Transcription Accuracy in Complex Historical Sanskrit Manuscripts
papers.abstract_en: Digitizing the text from handwritten historical manuscripts is required to make them easily accessible, preservable, and to enable historical scholars to study them in new ways. Historical manuscripts, however, often exhibit complex heterogeneous layouts and non-standard appearance due to period-specific writing styles, page textures, camera noise, and other nuisance factors, making them difficult to perform OCR on. To tackle this challenge, we introduce a local traditional OCR pipeline, which can be iteratively fine-tuned on the target manuscript at the layout-level and the appearance-level. By adapting to the target manuscript distribution, the proposed Traditional OCR pipeline makes better predictions on subsequent pages, causing iterative reduction in human annotation effort, which is expensive and time-consuming as it requires historical domain expertise. Using this pipeline, we digitize text from three complex historical Sanskrit manuscripts and introduce a dataset with granular layout-level annotations, along with Unicode annotations in the standard PAGE-XML format. We demonstrate quantitative gains due to iterative fine-tuning of the proposed traditional OCR pipeline, and also benchmark the performance of leading Multi-Modal Large Language Models on the introduced Dataset. Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/flame-cai/gnn-synthetic-layout-historical/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对历史手稿数字化中的 OCR 难题，提出一种可迭代微调的本地传统 OCR 流水线 (Traditional OCR pipeline)，通过在版式层面 (layout-level) 和外观层面 (appearance-level) 适应目标手稿分布，降低逐页人工标注成本。作者用该流水线数字化了三份复杂的历史梵语手稿，并发布带细粒度版式标注和 Unicode 标注 (PAGE-XML 格式) 的数据集，同时量化了迭代微调带来的收益，并基准测试了主流多模态大语言模型在该数据集上的表现。
Motivation: 历史手稿因时期特定书写风格、页面纹理、相机噪声等因素呈现复杂异构版式和非标准外观，通用 OCR 难以处理；人工标注又因需要历史领域专业知识而昂贵耗时。
Method: 提出本地传统 OCR 流水线，可在目标手稿上进行版式层和外观层的迭代微调；通过适应目标手稿分布改善后续页面预测，从而迭代减少人工标注工作量，并构建了带 PAGE-XML 格式细粒度标注的数据集。
Result: 摘要报告迭代微调带来定量提升，并在新引入的数据集上对主流多模态大语言模型进行了基准评测。
Conclusion: 该方法及其数据集面向三份复杂历史梵语手稿，证明了迭代微调能有效降低人工标注负担。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Composed Historical Image Retrieval by Modeling Temporal Representations
papers.abstract_en: While time evolves linearly, the geometry of neural embedding spaces is inherently multi-dimensional, often chaotic, and difficult to interpret. In principle, one could constrain an embedding space to a single temporal dimension; however, such a reduction would sacrifice performance on downstream tasks, as one-dimensional embeddings cannot retain sufficient expressive capacity. This paper asks whether it is possible to learn representations that preserve temporal structure while remaining effective for image and object retrieval, and answers this question by building the mathematical foundations of such a system. We propose Temporally Decomposable Image Representations (TDIR), a representation learning algorithm that decomposes historical photographs into separate date and content components through orthogonal subspaces. We define and prove the conditions under which such a decomposition is achievable, characterize the error incurred when those conditions are only partially met, and show that orthogonality between temporal and categorical subspaces emerges naturally from the joint optimization, without requiring it to be imposed explicitly. Beyond its geometric properties, TDIR enables a class of transitive operations on embedding spaces: the temporal information of one image can be extracted and injected into the representation of another, with no label supervision required. All theoretical properties are grounded and validated in the real-world problem of Composed Image Retrieval on historical photographs, where a query simultaneously specifies object content and a target time period, either through labels or through example images. This in-the-wild setting serves as a concrete backing for the propositions we derive, offering an intuitive and interpretable way to navigate photographic archives while maintaining competitive performance in both date estimation and object retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Temporally Decomposable Image Representations (TDIR)，一种将历史照片嵌入分解为相互正交的日期子空间与内容子空间的表示学习算法。作者证明该分解成立的条件，刻画条件部分满足时的误差，并指出时间与类别子空间的正交性可由联合优化自然涌现，无需显式约束。TDIR 还支持将一张图像的时间信息提取并注入另一张图像的表征中，且无需标签监督；论文在历史照片的组合图像检索 (Composed Image Retrieval) 场景中验证了这些理论性质。
Motivation: 时间在现实中线性演化，而神经嵌入空间是多维、混沌且难以解释的；若将嵌入空间限制为单一时间维度，又会因表达能力不足而损失下游任务性能。论文想要回答能否学习既保持时序结构、又对图像和物体检索仍然有效的表征。
Method: 提出 TDIR 表示学习算法，通过正交子空间将历史照片分解为独立的日期成分和内容成分；定义并证明可实现该分解的条件，分析条件仅部分满足时的误差，并说明正交性可从联合优化中自然涌现而不需显式施加。此外，TDIR 允许跨图像进行时间信息的提取与注入操作，整个过程无需标签监督。
Result: 论文在真实世界的历史照片组合图像检索任务上验证其理论性质，其中查询同时指定物体内容和目标时间段（通过标签或示例图像）。摘要称该方法在日期估计和物体检索上保持有竞争力的性能，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为既能保留时间结构又适用于检索的表示建立了数学基础，并在历史照片档案检索这一现实场景中提供了直观、可解释的导航方式；摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 论文在真实世界的历史照片组合图像检索任务上验证其理论性质，其中查询同时指定物体内容和目标时间段（通过标签或示例图像）。摘要称该方法在日期估计和物体检索上保持有竞争力的性能，但未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该工作为既能保留时间结构又适用于检索的表示建立了数学基础，并在历史照片档案检索这一现实场景中提供了直观、可解释的导航方式；摘要未明确讨论局限。

papers.title: Europe's Climate Ambition Under Scrutiny: Evidence from Deep Learning Emission Projections
papers.abstract_en: The European Union has committed to reducing greenhouse gas emissions 55% below 1990 levels by 2030, but whether current trends are compatible with this ambition remains uncertain. We apply deep learning to high-resolution socioeconomic and sectoral data across EU27 member states till 2023 to project sectoral CO$_2$ trajectories under current trends, extrapolating observed sectoral momentum without assuming changes in the pace or effectiveness of the policy environment beyond what is already reflected in historical data. We project that EU27 emissions will exceed the 2030 target by 35% (620 Mt CO$_2$ shortfall), with only a small minority of countries on trajectories consistent with the bloc's commitments. While the Power sector achieves target-consistent reductions driven by the renewable transition, Mobility shows minimal progress and accounts for over a third of total emissions by 2030, reflecting a structural inertia across member states rather than geographically concentrated lag. Our findings indicate that substantial additional intervention is required to close Europe's ambition-implementation gap, and call for establishing up-to-date energy information in Europe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用深度学习方法，基于EU27成员国截至2023年的高分辨率社会经济与部门数据，外推当前趋势下的部门CO2排放轨迹。预测结果显示EU27排放将超出2030年目标35%（缺口620 Mt CO2），且只有少数国家处于与承诺一致的路径上。电力部门因可再生能源转型实现达标，而交通部门进展微弱，到2030年占排放总量三分之一以上，体现成员国层面的结构性惯性而非地域集中性滞后。
Motivation: 欧盟承诺到2030年将温室气体排放较1990年水平降低55%，但当前趋势是否与该雄心兼容尚不确定，论文旨在通过数据驱动的排放预测来识别这一雄心与实施之间的差距。
Method: 将深度学习应用于EU27成员国的部门级高分辨率社会经济数据，外推已观测到的部门减排动能；明确不假设政策环境的节奏或有效性会发生历史数据尚未反映的变化。
Result: 预测EU27排放将超过2030年目标35%，即620 Mt CO2缺口；仅少数国家处于符合承诺的轨迹上。电力部门由可再生能源转型驱动实现目标一致减排，交通部门几乎无进展，到2030年占排放总量超过三分之一。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需要大量额外干预来弥合欧洲的雄心-实施差距，并呼吁建立更新的欧洲能源信息体系。

papers.title: Aslema at NADI 2026: Augmentation through Fewshot for SLU
papers.abstract_en: We present Aslema, our system for NADI 2026 Shared Task 5, which consists of two subtasks: intent recognition and slot filling. We evaluate four omni LLMs in a zero-shot setting and compare them with fine-tuned models. Our results show that fine-tuning consistently outperforms zero-shot inference. We further explore synthetic data augmentation by using an LLM to generate culturally grounded Tunisian Derja utterances, followed by voice cloning to generate synthetic speech. Incorporating this synthetic data improves performance on both tasks. Our final submitted system, based on Qwen3-Omni-30B and trained with a mixture of original and synthetic data, achieves 86.8% intent accuracy and 34.7 WER on the devtest split. On the official test set it ranks 1st in slot filling (59.5 CoER) and 4th among 8 teams in intent recognition (66.1% accuracy). We release our experimental scripts and will soon share the synthetic dataset to support further research in this area.
papers.comment: LLMs, Native, Arabic LLMs, Augmentation, Multilingual, Multimodal, Language Diversity, Contextual Understanding, Minority Languages, Culturally Informed, Foundation Models, Large Language Models, Audio Models, Omni Models, Slot Filling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述Aslema系统，用于NADI 2026共享任务5的意图识别（intent recognition）和槽填充（slot filling）两个子任务。作者评估了四个omni大语言模型（LLM）的零样本性能并与微调模型对比，发现微调稳定优于零样本推理；随后利用LLM生成文化相关的突尼斯Derja话语，并用语音克隆合成语音数据，加入合成数据后两个任务均有提升。最终系统基于Qwen3-Omni-30B，在devtest上达到86.8%意图准确率和34.7 WER，官方测试集上槽填充排名第1（59.5 CoER），意图识别在8个队伍中排名第4（66.1%准确率）。
Motivation: 阿拉伯语方言（尤其是突尼斯Derja）在口语理解任务中缺乏标注数据，NADI 2026共享任务5要求在该低资源场景下完成意图识别与槽填充，论文旨在探索少样本（few-shot）下的数据增强和模型选择策略。
Method: 首先在零样本设置下评估四个omni LLM，并与微调模型比较；随后使用LLM生成文化语境正确的突尼斯Derja语句，再通过语音克隆（voice cloning）生成合成语音，将合成数据与原始数据混合用于训练最终模型。
Result: 微调在所有设置中一致优于零样本推理；加入合成数据进一步提升了意图识别和槽填充性能。最终系统在devtest上取得86.8%意图准确率和34.7 WER，官方测试集槽填充获得59.5 CoER并排名第1，意图识别以66.1%准确率在8个队伍中排名第4。
Conclusion: 论文表明结合LLM驱动的合成文本与语音克隆的合成数据能有效改善低资源阿拉伯语方言的SLU性能，并公开实验脚本与后续合成数据集以支持进一步研究。

papers.title: Transforming Heart Disease Prediction with Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
papers.abstract_en: Heart disease remains the leading cause of mortality globally, necessitating early and accurate detection to improve patient outcomes. This research focuses on the predictive analysis of heart disease using machine learning (ML) techniques, comparing the performance of multiple classifiers to identify the most accurate and least error-prone method. Two datasets from UCI and Kaggle repositories were utilized, each containing 14 attributes related to heart health indicators. Techniques including J48, Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, Simple Cart, Bagging, Decision Stump, AdaBoost, Artificial Neural Networks, and Support Vector Machine (SVM) were applied. Evaluation metrics such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Relative Absolute Error (RAE), accuracy, precision, recall, and F-measure were used for performance comparison. Results revealed that SVM achieved the highest performance on the UCI dataset, while Simple Cart performed best on the Kaggle dataset, offering the highest accuracy and lowest error rates. The research work concludes that ML models, when properly tuned and validated, can significantly assist in the early diagnosis of heart disease, offering critical support for clinical decision-making. Future work may involve hybrid approaches and the use of more recent datasets to further improve prediction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较多种机器学习分类器在心脏病预测上的表现，使用UCI和Kaggle两个含14个属性的数据集，评估指标包括MAE、RAE、准确率、精确率、召回率和F-measure。结果显示SVM在UCI数据集上表现最佳，Simple Cart在Kaggle数据集上准确率最高且误差最低。
Motivation: 心脏病是全球主要死因，早期准确检测对改善患者预后至关重要，因此需要对比不同机器学习方法以找出最准确、错误率最低的预测模型。
Method: 在UCI和Kaggle两个心脏病数据集上应用J48、Naive Bayes、Logistic Regression、Simple Cart、Bagging、Decision Stump、AdaBoost、人工神经网络和SVM，并用MAE、RAE、准确率、精确率、召回率和F-measure进行性能比较。
Result: 摘要报告SVM在UCI数据集上取得最高性能，而Simple Cart在Kaggle数据集上获得最高准确率和最低错误率。
Conclusion: 作者认为经过适当调参和验证的ML模型能显著辅助心脏病早期诊断，并指出未来可探索混合方法及使用更新数据集以进一步提高预测精度。

papers.title: DocClaw: A Unified Agentic System for Intelligent Document Processing
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent document processing (IDP) encompasses a broad range of tasks, including optical character recognition (OCR), document question answering (DocQA), and key information extraction (KIE). Despite their distinct objectives, these tasks share a common need to perceive document content, acquire task-relevant information, and progressively refine intermediate results. However, they are typically formulated as separate prediction problems and addressed by task-specific models or processing pipelines. We introduce DocClaw, a unified agentic system that formulates diverse intelligent document processing tasks as a shared process of interaction between an agent and a document. Given a document and a task-specific query, DocClaw follows an appropriate document skill to iteratively identify the information required, invoke relevant tools, and integrate the resulting observations into the desired output. Throughout this process, a structured document state organizes reusable document knowledge and task-specific interaction context, allowing the agent to accumulate, revisit, and progressively refine information as the interaction proceeds. Under this formulation, task-specific requirements are captured by the agent's interpretation of the query objective and the corresponding document skill, while the underlying interaction loop, tool space, and document state are shared across tasks. Extensive experiments across multiple intelligent document processing benchmarks demonstrate that DocClaw effectively handles diverse tasks within a single agentic framework and achieves competitive performance compared with both general-purpose VLMs and task-specific methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DocClaw，一个统一的智能体系统 (agentic system)，将光学字符识别 (OCR)、文档问答 (DocQA)、关键信息抽取 (KIE) 等智能文档处理 (IDP) 任务统一建模为智能体与文档之间的交互过程。系统根据任务查询选择相应文档技能，迭代调用工具并整合观察结果，同时通过结构化的文档状态 (document state) 积累和精炼信息。实验表明 DocClaw 能在单一框架内处理多种文档任务，性能与通用 VLM 及任务特定方法相当。
Motivation: 现有 IDP 任务虽然共享感知文档内容、获取任务相关信息并逐步精炼中间结果的需求，但通常被建模为独立的预测问题，由任务特定模型或流水线分别处理，缺乏统一的系统框架。
Method: DocClaw 将任务目标交由智能体对查询意图的解释和对应文档技能来承载，而底层交互循环、工具空间和文档状态跨任务共享；过程中用一个结构化的文档状态组织可复用的文档知识与任务相关的交互上下文，使智能体能够积累、回溯并逐步精炼信息。
Result: 摘要报告在多个智能文档处理基准上的实验表明，DocClaw 能在单一智能体框架内有效处理多种任务，并相比通用 VLM 和任务特定方法取得有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将不同 IDP 任务统一为智能体与文档的交互过程是有效的，共享交互循环、工具空间和文档状态的设计是核心支撑；摘要未提及具体局限。

papers.title: RTPO: Reverse-Turn Policy Optimization for Stabilizing Agentic RL Training
papers.abstract_en: Training multi-turn agentic workflows with reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models to perform complex reasoning, use external tools, and conduct iterative search beyond single-turn settings. Yet multi-turn RL training remains highly unstable, often causing severe performance degradation as the number of turns increases. Through theoretical analysis, we identify three tightly coupled sources of instability: rollout-training context mismatch, weak turn-level credit assignment under sparse terminal rewards, and asynchronous policy drift when short and long trajectories are optimized under different policy versions. We show that these issues share a common structural origin in flattened trajectory optimization and address them through a unified reverse-turn formulation. We propose Reverse-Turn Policy Optimization (RTPO), which organizes multi-turn rollouts as sparse reverse trees and performs turn-level policy updates in temporal reverse order, aligning each decision with its downstream continuation. RTPO enables causally consistent turn-level credit assignment and on-policy continuation to control asynchronous drift. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that RTPO eliminates context mismatch and asynchronous drift under the proposed turn-level formulation, reduces credit bias, and converges to recursive optimality. Experiments on multi-turn agentic RL benchmarks show that RTPO improves upon trajectory- and turn-level baselines by 21.50% and 10.76%, respectively, highlighting its potential to support more stable training for tool-using agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reverse-Turn Policy Optimization (RTPO)，用于稳定多轮 agentic RL 训练。作者通过理论分析指出 rollout-训练上下文不匹配、稀疏终结奖励下的弱回合级信用分配、以及长短轨迹在不同策略版本下导致的异步漂移三个不稳定来源，并提出统一的逆序回合公式来缓解。实验显示 RTPO 在多轮 agentic RL 基准上比轨迹级和回合级基线分别提升 21.50% 和 10.76%。
Motivation: 多轮 agentic 工作流的 RL 训练高度不稳定，随回合数增加常出现严重性能退化，现有方法未从结构上解决扁平轨迹优化带来的多个耦合不稳定源。
Method: RTPO 将多轮 rollout 组织为稀疏反向树 (sparse reverse trees)，按时间逆序执行回合级策略更新，使每个决策与其下游延续对齐；该公式支持因果一致的回合级信用分配和 on-policy 延续，从而控制异步漂移，并提供消除上下文不匹配、减少信用偏差并收敛到递归最优性的理论保证。
Result: 在多轮 agentic RL 基准上，RTPO 相比轨迹级基线提升 21.50%，相比回合级基线提升 10.76%，表明其能更稳定地训练工具使用智能体。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一的逆序回合公式能够消除上下文不匹配与异步漂移，实现因果一致的信用分配，为多轮 agentic RL 训练稳定性提供了理论支撑与实证验证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Reverse-Turn Policy Optimization (RTPO)，用于稳定多轮 agentic RL 训练。作者通过理论分析指出 rollout-训练上下文不匹配、稀疏终结奖励下的弱回合级信用分配、以及长短轨迹在不同策略版本下导致的异步漂移三个不稳定来源，并提出统一的逆序回合公式来缓解。实验显示 RTPO 在多轮 agentic RL 基准上比轨迹级和回合级基线分别提升 21.50% 和 10.76%。
summary_sections.motivation: 多轮 agentic 工作流的 RL 训练高度不稳定，随回合数增加常出现严重性能退化，现有方法未从结构上解决扁平轨迹优化带来的多个耦合不稳定源。
summary_sections.method: RTPO 将多轮 rollout 组织为稀疏反向树 (sparse reverse trees)，按时间逆序执行回合级策略更新，使每个决策与其下游延续对齐；该公式支持因果一致的回合级信用分配和 on-policy 延续，从而控制异步漂移，并提供消除上下文不匹配、减少信用偏差并收敛到递归最优性的理论保证。
summary_sections.result: 在多轮 agentic RL 基准上，RTPO 相比轨迹级基线提升 21.50%，相比回合级基线提升 10.76%，表明其能更稳定地训练工具使用智能体。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为统一的逆序回合公式能够消除上下文不匹配与异步漂移，实现因果一致的信用分配，为多轮 agentic RL 训练稳定性提供了理论支撑与实证验证。

papers.title: FRAGMENT: Factorized Graph Representations for Document Generation and Editing via Entity-Aware Transformations
papers.abstract_en: Structured documents such as invoices, forms, reports, and scientific articles derive meaning from the interplay between spatial layout, textual content, and logical structure. Generative models operating at the pixel or token level often struggle to capture these dependencies effectively. We explore FRAGMENT, a generative framework that represents a document as a typed relational graph and factorizes its distribution as p(structure, content) = p(structure) * p(content | structure). The framework consists of two stages. The first stage, the Architect, is a causally masked Transformer conditioned on document category that autoregressively generates the graph topology and typed spatial relations. The second stage, the Builder, is a GATv2-based graph attention network that enriches the graph with normalized bounding boxes, text, and visual style attributes. Both stages define explicit likelihood models, yielding a tractable document-level likelihood that serves as an anomaly score for forgery detection. For controlled editing, a prompt-conditioned extension injects instruction embeddings into the Builder through cross-attention, enabling semantic and entity-aware modifications. We describe training on DocLayNet and fine-tuning on FUNSD and SROIE. Experiments on DocLayNet, FUNSD, and SROIE evaluate FRAGMENT alongside representative autoregressive, layout-only, and graph-based baselines, providing an empirical analysis of the characteristics and trade-offs of the proposed factorized graph generation framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FRAGMENT，一个将结构化文档表示为带类型的关系图并分解为 p(structure) * p(content | structure) 的生成框架。框架分为两阶段：Architect 用因果掩码 Transformer 生成图拓扑与空间关系，Builder 用 GATv2 图注意力网络补充边界框、文本与视觉风格，两阶段都有显式似然模型，可提供文档级似然作为伪造检测的异常分数。作者在 DocLayNet 上训练并在 FUNSD、SROIE 上微调，与自回归、仅布局和基于图的基线进行对比实验。
Motivation: 发票、表格、报告等结构化文档的意义来自空间布局、文本内容与逻辑结构的相互依赖，而像素级或 token 级生成模型难以有效捕获这些依赖关系，因此需要一种显式建模结构与内容联合分布的生成框架。
Method: FRAGMENT 将文档建模为带类型的关系图，并分解其分布为结构分布与条件内容分布；第一阶段的 Architect 是因果掩码 Transformer，在文档类别条件下自回归生成图拓扑和类型化空间关系；第二阶段的 Builder 是基于 GATv2 的图注意力网络，为图补充归一化边界框、文本和视觉风格属性。受控编辑通过提示条件扩展实现，将指令嵌入经交叉注意力注入 Builder，支持语义级和实体级修改。
Result: 摘要报告在 DocLayNet、FUNSD 和 SROIE 上评估 FRAGMENT，并与代表性自回归、仅布局和基于图的方法进行对比，提供了对因式分解图生成框架特性与权衡的经验分析；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架的显式似然模型带来可计算的文档级似然，可作为伪造检测的异常分数，同时提示条件扩展支持受控的语义与实体感知编辑；其定位是探索性框架，结论集中于对因式分解图生成方法特性的实证分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sanyu Studio: A Multi-Agent System for Art-Historical Narrative Construction
papers.abstract_en: Amid concerns that generative AI may standardize art interpretation, this paper examines whether LLM-based interaction can support plural art-historical narrative construction. We present Sanyu Studio, a multi-agent dialogue system that models 321 Sanyu oil paintings as agents with fact, interpretation, organization, and memory-filtering mechanisms. Based on a seven-day workshop with eight art-university participants, the study shows that user prompts, evidence organization, and cognitive tendencies shaped divergent yet coherent versions of digital Sanyu. The findings suggest that, under conditions of limited historical evidence, AI can amplify human agency and offer public audiences an interactive entry point into art-historical interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注生成式 AI 可能使艺术阐释标准化的担忧，考察基于 LLM 的交互能否支持多元艺术史叙事构建。作者提出 Sanyu Studio，一个将 321 幅常玉油画建模为智能体（figure agent）的多智能体对话系统，每个智能体具备事实、阐释、组织和记忆过滤机制。基于八名艺术院校参与者的七天工作坊，研究发现用户提示、证据组织与认知倾向共同塑造了分歧但又连贯的数字常玉版本，表明在历史证据有限条件下 AI 可以增强人的能动性并为公众提供艺术史阐释的交互入口。
Motivation: 现有生成式 AI 被认为可能标准化艺术理解，论文针对这一担忧，希望检验 LLM 驱动的交互是否能够支持非单一、多元的艺术史叙事构建。
Method: 提出 Sanyu Studio 多智能体对话系统，将 321 幅常玉油画建模为具有事实、阐释、组织和记忆过滤机制的智能体，并通过七天工作坊观察八名艺术院校参与者的使用情况。
Result: 摘要报告，用户提示、证据组织和认知倾向会影响生成内容，形成分歧但连贯的数字常玉版本；在有限历史证据条件下 AI 能放大人类能动性，并为公众提供艺术史阐释的互动入口。
Conclusion: 论文认为在历史证据有限的条件下，AI 可以支持多元艺术史叙事而非简单标准化，并为公共观众提供交互式阐释入口。

papers.title: An Empirical Benchmark of Deep Time-Series Models for Smart Meter Energy Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate forecasting of energy consumption is important for the efficient operation of power systems, with direct implications for operational costs, energy management, and system maintenance. Due to the availability of extensive high-resolution consumption data from smart meters, data-driven methods have been used for short-term and long-term forecasting. However, their comparative performance on real-world smart meter data is still not well studied. In this paper, we present an empirical benchmark of nine modern deep learning models for time-series forecasting, including linear, MLP-based, convolutional, and Transformer architectures. We evaluate these models on two publicly available smart meter datasets. Our analysis focuses on three factors that strongly affect forecasting performance: the length of historical input, the prediction horizon, and the choice of model architecture. We show that extending the historical context improves accuracy, but only up to a saturation point, after which additional input provides limited benefit. In contrast, accuracy decreases as the prediction horizon increases. We also investigate the trade-off between prediction accuracy and computational complexity, and assess the statistical significance and practical magnitude of performance differences across models. Our results show that deep learning models consistently outperform classical baselines, while lightweight architectures achieve relatively similar performance at significantly lower computational cost. Additionally, architectural differences only become meaningful at longer forecasting horizons and on more heterogeneous datasets. Finally, a subgroup analysis across geodemographic and household categories shows that model choice has limited impact for most population segments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对智能电表能源预测中的九种现代深度学习时间序列模型进行了经验基准测试，涵盖线性、MLP、卷积和 Transformer 架构。基于两个公开数据集，研究发现扩展历史输入长度可提升准确率但存在饱和点，而预测范围增加会降低准确率。深度学习模型一致优于经典基线，轻量级架构在显著较低计算成本下达到相近性能，架构差异仅在较长预测范围和更异构数据集上变得显著。
Motivation: 尽管数据驱动方法已广泛用于智能电表能耗预测，但它们在真实智能电表数据上的对比性能仍未得到充分研究；本文旨在系统评估影响预测性能的关键因素。
Method: 构建包含九个现代深度学习模型的基准，覆盖线性、MLP、卷积和 Transformer 架构，在两个公开的智能电表数据集上评估，分析历史输入长度、预测范围和架构选择对预测性能的影响，并进行统计显著性与计算复杂度的权衡分析。
Result: 扩展历史上下文可提升准确率但存在饱和点；预测范围增大则准确率下降。深度学习模型始终优于经典基线，轻量级架构以显著较低计算成本达到相似性能；架构差异仅在更长预测范围和更异构数据集上显著，且子组分析显示模型选择对大多数人群影响有限。
Conclusion: 作者强调轻量级架构在实际应用中具有更好的性能-成本权衡，架构选择在多数人群和较短预测范围内影响有限。

papers.title: DynCur-Geo: Dynamic Curiosity Reward Shaping for Multimodal Active Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Active geo-localization enables low-altitude UAVs to search for specified targets from limited local aerial observations, supporting time-sensitive applications such as search and rescue and emergency inspection. However, multimodal target cues, restricted views, and sparse feedback make it difficult to balance exploration with target convergence. Existing curiosity-driven methods assign a fixed intrinsic-reward weight throughout search, which can continue rewarding novelty after the agent nears the target and induce detours. We propose DynCur-Geo, a dynamic curiosity framework that adjusts prediction-error intrinsic reward according to remaining target distance. A distance-aware gate encourages early exploration and shifts the policy toward goal-directed behavior near the target, while potential-based reward shaping supplies dense progress guidance. Experiments across multimodal, cross-scene, disaster-affected, and long-range settings show consistent gains over active geo-localization baselines.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 18 figures, 15 tables. The main paper is 7 pages, with supplementary material included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynCur-Geo，一种面向多模态主动地理定位（active geo-localization）的动态好奇心奖励塑形框架。针对现有好奇心驱动方法在搜索全程使用固定内在奖励权重、靠近目标时仍奖励新奇性并导致绕路的问题，作者根据剩余目标距离动态调整预测误差型内在奖励，并引入距离感知门控与基于势能的奖励塑形。实验在多个多模态、跨场景、灾后场景和长距离设置上相对主动地理定位基线取得一致增益。
Motivation: 主动地理定位中，多模态目标线索、受限视野和稀疏反馈使探索与目标收敛难以平衡；现有好奇心驱动方法固定内在奖励权重，靠近目标时仍持续奖励新奇性，导致不必要的绕路。
Method: 提出动态好奇心框架 DynCur-Geo，根据剩余目标距离调整预测误差内在奖励的权重；距离感知门控（distance-aware gate）在早期鼓励探索、靠近目标时转向目标导向行为；基于势能的奖励塑形（potential-based reward shaping）提供密集的进度指引。
Result: 摘要报告在多模态、跨场景、灾后以及长距离设置上的实验相对主动地理定位基线均有一致性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态调整好奇心奖励能够改善探索与目标收敛的平衡，减少靠近目标时的绕路行为；方法在多种场景设置下得到验证。

papers.title: Orienteering Problem with Uncertain Time-Varying Rewards: Framework and Benchmark for Everyday Service Robotics
papers.abstract_en: We present the orienteering problem with uncertain time-varying rewards (OP-UTVR), a novel variant of the orienteering problem (OP). While most existing OP formulations assume rewards to be known in advance, practical applications involve uncertain and time-varying rewards, as with shifting customer demand for delivery agents. OP-UTVR relaxes this assumption by allowing agents to estimate reward dynamics from observations and forecast future rewards. This enables informed routing decisions despite stochastic reward changes and inevitable prediction errors. We address this problem using three planners that differ in planning horizon and online adaptivity, and derive theoretical bounds on their performance under reward stochasticity. We further introduce a mobile service robot benchmark for OP-UTVR, where a robot navigates among pedestrians in indoor environments. Experiments reveal trade-offs between planning horizon and adaptivity, and demonstrate the effectiveness of long-horizon planning with online adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出具有不确定时变奖励的定向越野问题（OP-UTVR），放松了经典定向越野问题（OP）中奖励已知的假设，允许智能体从观测中估计奖励动态并预测未来奖励。作者设计了三种在规划时域和在线自适应性上不同的规划器，为其在奖励随机性下的表现推导了理论界限，并引入了室内移动服务机器人基准。实验揭示了规划时域与自适应性之间的权衡，并展示了长时域规划结合在线自适应的有效性。
Motivation: 现有的定向越野问题大多假设奖励预先已知，但实际应用中的奖励往往不确定且随时间变化，例如配送代理面临的顾客需求变化。这一差距使得智能体难以在随机奖励变化和不可避免的预测误差下做出明智的路由决策。
Method: 提出 OP-UTVR 问题形式化，允许智能体从观测中估计并预测奖励动态；采用三种规划器，它们在规划时域与在线自适应性上有所区分；推导了奖励随机性下的理论性能界限；构建了一个机器人在室内环境下于行人中导航的移动服务机器人基准。
Result: 实验表明规划时域与自适应性之间存在权衡，并证明了长时域规划结合在线自适应方法在不确定时变奖励场景中的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在不确定且时变的奖励下，长时域规划与在线自适应的结合能够改善服务机器人的路由决策质量；本文的验证场景限定于室内移动服务机器人基准。

papers.title: Vision-Language Models for Egocentric Video: From Hand-Object Interaction to Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric video captures activities from the wearer's perspective, providing a direct view of human attention, hand--object interaction, and goal-directed behavior. This perspective is increasingly important for wearable intelligence, assistive systems, human--robot interaction, and embodied AI, yet it introduces challenges including ego-motion, occlusion, small active objects, viewpoint-dependent appearance, and long-range temporal dependencies. Vision--language models (VLMs) offer a promising foundation for addressing these challenges by linking visual observations with semantic knowledge and natural-language supervision. This survey presents a critical review of VLMs for egocentric video understanding, tracing the progression from conventional recognition architectures to multimodal foundation models and embodied systems. We organize the literature around tasks, datasets, hand--object interaction understanding, temporal reasoning, frame and clip selection, multimodal representation learning, prompting, semantic alignment, and model adaptation. Particular attention is given to graph-based and object-centric reasoning as mechanisms for modeling relations among hands, objects, actions, and scene context over time. We further examine how first-person perception and multimodal foundation models support wearable assistance, robot skill learning, human-to-robot transfer, and embodied decision making. Across the reviewed literature, a consistent limitation emerges: current models recognize visible objects more reliably than evolving interactions, actions, and user intent, especially over long activities. We therefore identify temporally grounded reasoning, interaction-aware supervision, efficient long-video processing, multimodal fusion, graph-enhanced representations, cross-domain generalization, privacy, and trustworthy evaluation as key priorities for deployable embodied intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 用于第一视角 (egocentric) 视频理解的综述，梳理了从传统识别架构到多模态基础模型再到具身系统的发展脉络。作者围绕任务、数据集、手-物交互理解、时序推理、帧与片段选择、多模态表示学习、提示、语义对齐和模型适配组织文献，并重点讨论了基于图和以对象为中心的推理机制。综述指出当前模型对可见对象的识别可靠，但对演化中的交互、动作和用户意图的建模仍不足，并将时序接地推理、交互感知监督、长视频高效处理等列为可部署具身智能的关键优先方向。
Motivation: 第一视角视频对可穿戴智能、辅助系统、人机交互和具身 AI 越来越重要，但存在自我运动、遮挡、小目标、视角相关外观和长程时序依赖等挑战；VLM 被视为连接视觉观察与语义知识的有前景基础，亟需系统性的批判性综述来梳理该领域。
Method: 作为综述，作者按任务、数据集、手-物交互理解、时序推理、帧/片段选择、多模态表示学习、提示、语义对齐和模型适配等维度组织文献，并特别分析基于图和以对象为中心的推理机制，以及第一视角感知与多模态基础模型如何支持可穿戴辅助、机器人技能学习、人-机器人迁移和具身决策。
Result: 综述未报告新实验，主要发现是一致的局限：当前模型识别可见对象比识别演化中的交互、动作和用户意图更可靠，尤其在长活动场景中；基于此提出了时序接地推理、交互感知监督、高效长视频处理、多模态融合、图增强表示、跨域泛化、隐私与可信评估等关键优先事项。
Conclusion: 作者认为，面向可部署具身智能的 VLM 第一视角视频理解需要在时序接地推理、交互感知监督、长视频高效处理、多模态融合、图增强表示、跨域泛化、隐私和可信评估方面取得进展；摘要未给出具体的量化解法或实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reinforced Planning with Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Humans solve complex problems by constructing plans and mentally simulating their outcomes with an internal model of the world. Machine learning has produced world models that similarly predict the outcomes of action sequences, but the improvement of candidate plans still isn't fully learned. Current planners are either hand-designed, distilled from a hand-designed optimizer, or learned only to inform an amortized policy rather than to revise the plan itself. We introduce the Reinforced Planning, a method based on the idea that search can be learned by reinforcing good search rules into a neural planner. Our implementation RP1 learns both how to evaluate imagined outcomes through a critic, as well as how to improve multi-step plans through an optimizer trained fully offline from imagined world-model roll-outs. To our knowledge, RP1 is the first method to fully learn how to improve multi-step plans. Furthermore, it can be trained independently of and attached to any pretrained latent world model. Across visual navigation, arm reaching, and robotic manipulation on two world-model backbones, RP1 substantially outperforms hand-designed search algorithms, reaching near-perfect success in several settings while using $1,000 \times$ less world-model rollouts and being up to $67 \times$ faster than the strongest alternative under concurrent planner inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reinforced Planning（RP1），一种完全学习如何改进多步计划的神经规划方法。RP1 通过 critic 评估想象结果，并通过一个完全离线训练、基于世界模型想象 rollout 的优化器来改进计划。摘要称 RP1 可独立训练并附加到任意预训练潜在世界模型，在视觉导航、机械臂到达和机器人操作任务上大幅优于手工设计的搜索算法。
Motivation: 现有规划器要么是手工设计的，要么从手工设计的优化器中蒸馏，要么只学习指导摊销策略而并不修改计划本身；候选计划的改进过程尚未被真正学习。
Method: RP1 把搜索视为可通过强化学习学习的规则，训练一个 critic 来评估想象结果，并训练一个优化器，利用完全离线的世界模型想象 roll-out 来改进多步计划。
Result: 在视觉导航、机械臂到达和机器人操作等任务上，基于两种世界模型骨干，RP1 大幅超越手工搜索算法，在多个设置中接近完美成功率，同时使用约 1000 倍更少的 world-model rollouts，并在并发规划器推理下比最强替代方法快最多 67 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RP1 是第一个完全学习如何改进多步计划的方法，且可以独立于任何预训练潜在世界模型进行训练并附着使用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Teeth2Point: A Two-Stage Dental CBCT ROI-to-Point Segmentation Framework
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep learning architectures have demonstrated strong performance in dental CBCT segmentation. One remaining crucial challenge is accurate tooth labeling in cases with missing or malpositioned teeth, which are highly relevant for dental practice. Transformer-based architectures should in theory be able to resolve such ambiguities using global anatomical context. However, due to the high resolution of CBCT volumes and the wide spatial distribution of teeth within volumes, dense patch-based volumetric processing faces an inherent trade-off. Computational costs limit the number of patches that can be used in self-attention and thus, one can either increase the extent of the context captured in self-attention or capture fine-grained structural details by using small patches, but not both. In this work, we present Teeth2Point, an efficient point-based transformer framework for dental CBCT semantic segmentation that can avoid this trade-off. Teeth2Point first localizes volumetric regions of interest (ROIs) surrounding teeth using a convolutional model, then converts ROIs into point tokens using adaptive sampling. A transformer model predicts accurate segmentations using the point tokens, which allow capturing global context while retaining high resolution. The transformer is first pretrained using self-supervised learning (SSL), in the style of DINO but using domain-specific augmentation strategies, followed by supervised finetuning. The SSL pretraining, which includes random token masking, provides robustness to complex anatomical variations. Compared with the strongest two-stage baseline, Teeth2Point improves abnormal-case performance by 1.44 DSC points on average across four datasets; relative to the first-stage nnU-Net, the gain is 1.9 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Teeth2Point，一种用于牙科 CBCT 语义分割的两阶段、基于点的高效 Transformer 框架。该方法先用卷积模型定位牙体周围的感兴趣区域 (ROI)，再通过自适应采样将 ROI 转换为点 token，由 Transformer 进行分割，从而兼顾全局上下文与高分辨率。Transformer 先以 DINO 风格的自监督学习 (SSL) 并结合领域专属增强与随机 token 掩码进行预训练，再监督微调。相比最强的两阶段基线，该方法在四个数据集上的异常病例性能平均提升 1.44 个 DSC 点，相对第一阶段 nnU-Net 提升 1.9 个点。
Motivation: 牙齿缺失或错位的情况下准确标注牙齿仍是 CBCT 分割的关键挑战。由于 CBCT 体素分辨率高且牙齿空间分布广，基于稠密 patch 的体处理方法面临固有取舍：计算成本限制自注意力可处理的 patch 数量，因此难以同时扩大上下文范围和保持细粒度结构细节。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：先用卷积模型定位牙体周围的体积 ROI，再用自适应采样将 ROI 转为点 token，送入 Transformer 进行分割，以在保留高分辨率的同时捕获全局上下文。Transformer 先采用 DINO 风格的自监督预训练，使用领域专属增强策略和随机 token 掩码，随后进行监督微调。
Result: 摘要报告，与最强的两阶段基线相比，Teeth2Point 在四个数据集上的异常病例分割性能平均提升 1.44 个 DSC 点；相对第一阶段 nnU-Net，增益为 1.9 个点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，包含随机 token 掩码的 SSL 预训练为复杂解剖变异提供了鲁棒性，且点 token 方案避免了上下文范围与细节分辨率之间的取舍。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Candidate-Fate Accounting for Transparent Sensor Diagnostic Pipeline Search
papers.abstract_en: Industrial sensor diagnostics relies on preprocessing, representation, and classification pipelines, making automated pipeline search useful for reducing manual design cost. However, existing automated machine/deep learning (AutoML/AutoDL) reports typically retain only fitted trials, scores, and winners, omitting generated candidates that are invalid, pruned, skipped, cached, or unfitted. This omission limits reviewers' ability to check signal constraints, budget use, and unevaluated legal alternatives. To address this, we propose candidate-fate accounting, a candidate-level audit framework for diagnostic search traces. It records each observed candidate as auditable evidence: hashes merge repeated observations, legality checks flag invalid candidates, allocation rationales explain budget decisions, and a closed fate ledger assigns one terminal fate to each candidate. Experiments on three bearing-diagnostic datasets show that the framework detects invalid candidates and identifies 30--41 candidates omitted by fitted-trial-only reports, with closed fate records verifying complete candidate accounting while maintaining competitive diagnostic performance. The code is available at https://github.com/XXIE999/candidate-fate-accounting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出候选命运核算 (candidate-fate accounting) 框架，用于对工业传感器诊断中的自动流水线搜索 (pipeline search) 痕迹进行候选级审计。框架通过哈希合并重复观测、合法性检查标记无效候选、分配理由解释预算决策，并为每个候选分配单一终结命运，从而补足传统 AutoML/AutoDL 报告只保留已拟合 trial 的缺口。三个轴承诊断数据集上的实验表明，该框架能检测无效候选，并识别出仅靠 fitted-trial 报告遗漏的 30–41 个候选，同时保持有竞争力的诊断性能。
Motivation: 现有 AutoML/AutoDL 报告通常只保留已拟合的 trial、分数和获胜者，而忽略无效、被剪枝、跳过、缓存或未拟合的候选，导致评审者无法检查信号约束、预算使用和未评估的合法备选方案。
Method: 提出候选命运核算框架，将每个观测到的候选记录为可审计证据：用哈希合并重复观测，合法性检查标记无效候选，分配理由解释预算决策，并用封闭命运账本为每个候选赋予一个终结命运。
Result: 在三个轴承诊断数据集上，该框架能检测无效候选，并识别出比 fitted-trial-only 报告多 30–41 个候选；封闭命运记录验证了候选核算的完整性，同时保持有竞争力的诊断性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架可用于提升诊断搜索痕迹的透明度和可审计性，并指出完整候选核算可在不牺牲诊断性能的情况下实现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dynamic SpectraFormer for Ultra-High-Definition Underwater Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Underwater images suffer from color distortion, haze, and poor visibility due to light refraction and absorption in water. These challenges significantly impact the utilization of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) or marine robots. Typically, color and brightness distortions manifest at lower frequencies, while edge and texture distortions are prevalent at higher frequencies. Traditional methods struggle to concurrently rectify these mixed distortions as they primarily concentrate on the spatial domain. To address these issues, we introduce the Dynamic SpectraFormer, which enhances underwater images through a frequency domain transformer. The Dynamic SpectraFormer introduces an ultra-high-resolution sparse spectrum attention module, which could capture the long-term dependency without losing the universal approximating power. Additionally, we have developed a dynamic spectrum weight generation layer that serves as an adaptive spectrum band selector, accentuating critical frequency bands and suppressing less relevant ones. Consequently, this method significantly improves underwater image quality by addressing both high- and low-frequency distortions. Our extensive ablation studies and comparative evaluations consolidate the Dynamic SpectraFormer's efficacy across multiple underwater image enhancement benchmarks. The source code is available at https://github.com/arifence2024/DynamicSpectraFormer.git.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Published in the 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2024)
papers.journal_ref: 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), pp. 8634-8641, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dynamic SpectraFormer，一种面向超高清水下图像增强的频率域 Transformer 方法。该方法引入超高清稀疏频谱注意力模块，在不损失通用逼近能力的前提下捕获长程依赖，并用动态频谱权重生成层作为自适应频谱带选择器，突出关键频带、抑制无关频带。作者称该方案同时处理高频与低频畸变，并在多个水下图像增强基准上通过消融和对比实验验证其有效性。
Motivation: 水下图像因光在水中的折射与吸收而产生颜色失真、雾化和低可见度，影响自主水下机器人（AUV）和海洋机器人的使用。颜色与亮度畸变主要出现在低频、边缘与纹理畸变主要出现在高频，而传统方法多集中于空间域，难以同时修正这些混合畸变。
Method: 提出 Dynamic SpectraFormer，一种频率域 Transformer 增强框架。核心包括超高清稀疏频谱注意力模块（ultra-high-resolution sparse spectrum attention）与动态频谱权重生成层（dynamic spectrum weight generation layer）；后者充当自适应频谱带选择器，用于强化关键频带、抑制不相关频带。
Result: 摘要报告了广泛的消融研究和对比评估，在多个水下图像增强基准上验证了 Dynamic SpectraFormer 的有效性；摘要未给出具体定量数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该频率域方法通过同时处理高频与低频畸变显著提升水下图像质量，并公开了源代码链接。

papers.title: Computational Measurement of Team-Process Phase Dynamics in Collaborative Virtual Reality
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative virtual reality (VR) environments make team communication observable as it unfolds, but conventional transcript analyses often summarize entire trials or divide them into fixed temporal windows. Such approaches can obscure changes in team communication and coordination over time. This article presents a computational framework for detecting and interpreting dynamic team-process phases from timestamped dialogue in a collaborative VR game. The framework uses late chunking to generate context-aware transcript representations, aggregates them into temporal chunks, and applies penalized Gaussian-kernel change-point detection to identify semantic transitions in team communication. After boundary detection, term frequency--inverse document frequency (TF-IDF), non-negative matrix factorization (NMF), and representative transcript segments provide structured evidence for phase interpretation. A locally deployed large language model (LLM) uses in-context learning to generate initial interpretations that are subsequently reviewed by humans. Independently recorded interaction logs are then aligned with the detected phases to examine corresponding task-action patterns. The evaluation compares representations, pooling strategies, segmentation methods, parameter settings, reviewed phase interpretations, and phase-aligned interaction profiles. The results show that the framework identifies coherent and interpretable phase structures while preserving traceability to the underlying transcript evidence. The correspondence between transcript-derived phases and interaction behavior further supports their relevance for analyzing collaborative activity. The framework therefore offers a transparent and transferable approach for studying temporal changes in teamwork from timestamped transcripts across collaborative task settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个计算框架，用于从协作 VR 游戏中的时间戳对话中检测并解释团队过程的动态阶段。框架先用 late chunking 生成上下文感知的转录表示并聚合成时间块，再用带惩罚的高斯核变点检测 (penalized Gaussian-kernel change-point detection) 识别语义转变；随后结合 TF-IDF、NMF 与代表性转录片段进行阶段解释，并由本地部署的大语言模型 (LLM) 通过 in-context learning 生成初稿、人工复核。评估显示该框架能识别连贯、可解释且可追溯到转录证据的阶段结构，且转录阶段与交互行为之间存在对应关系。
Motivation: 传统的转录分析通常汇总整个试验或采用固定时间窗口，会掩盖团队沟通与协调随时间的变化，因此需要一种能捕捉并解释团队过程随时间演变的方法。
Method: 框架包括四个环节：基于 late chunking 的上下文感知转录表示及其时间块聚合、带惩罚的高斯核变点检测定位语义转变、使用 TF-IDF、NMF 和代表性转录片段辅助阶段解释，以及本地 LLM 结合 in-context learning 生成初步解释并由人工复核；最后将独立记录的交互日志与检测到的阶段对齐以考察任务-行动模式。
Result: 评估比较了表示方法、池化策略、分割方法、参数设置、复核后的阶段解释和阶段对齐的交互画像；结果表明该框架能识别连贯且可解释的阶段结构，同时保持对底层转录证据的可追溯性，转录衍生阶段与交互行为的对应关系支持其用于分析协作活动。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种透明且可迁移的途径，可从时间戳转录中研究跨协作任务场景的团队工作随时间的变化；摘要未涉及超出协作 VR 之外的泛化或局限性讨论。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machines: Interpretable Quantum Machine Learning with Commuting Projector Clauses
papers.abstract_en: Tsetlin Machines (TMs) learn interpretable Boolean clauses using finite-state automata. We introduce the Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine (QL-TM), which replaces Boolean literals with quantum propositions represented by projectors while retaining classical include/exclude automata. Clauses are restricted to commuting measurement contexts and activate through the Born probability of their joint projector. We prove an exact reduction to ordinary Boolean TM clauses in diagonal computational-basis contexts and connect Pauli-projector clauses to stabilizer and syndrome semantics. Controlled experiments on Bell states, phase-flip syndromes, randomized 16-class stabilizer tasks, mixed literal pools, context-budget ablations, and finite-shot noise show that correct non-diagonal contexts recover physically meaningful clauses, while diagonal or wrong contexts lose the relevant phase/syndrome information. The context-budget results closely follow the predicted separability ladder 2^(b-k) as true stabilizer generators are removed. The contribution is a controlled bridge between Tsetlin clause learning and quantum logic, not a claim of quantum advantage.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the Fifth International Symposium on the Tsetlin Machine (ISTM 2026), Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, India, 12-14 October 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子逻辑 Tsetlin 机 (Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine, QL-TM)，用投影算子 (projector) 表示的量子命题替换布尔文字，同时保留经典的包含/排除自动机。子句被限制在交换测量上下文 (commuting measurement contexts) 中，并通过其联合投影器的 Born 概率激活。作者证明在对角计算基上下文中可精确约化为普通布尔 TM 子句，并将 Pauli 投影子句与稳定子 (stabilizer) 和综合征 (syndrome) 语义联系起来。受控实验表明，正确的非对角上下文能恢复有物理意义的子句，而对角或错误上下文会丢失相位/综合征信息。
Motivation: 现有 Tsetlin 机以有限状态自动机学习可解释的布尔子句，但缺少与量子逻辑的衔接；本文目标是建立 Tsetlin 子句学习与量子逻辑之间受控的桥梁，而不是宣称量子优势。
Method: 提出 QL-TM：将布尔文字替换为量子命题（由投影器表示），保留经典自动机结构；子句限制于可交换测量上下文，以联合投影器的 Born 概率作为激活条件。作者还证明了对角计算基到普通布尔 TM 子句的精确约化，并连接了 Pauli 投影子句与稳定子/综合征语义。
Result: 受控实验（Bell 态、phase-flip 综合征、随机 16 类稳定子任务、混合文字池、上下文预算消融和有限次噪声）显示，正确的非对角上下文恢复有物理意义的子句，而对角或错误上下文会丢失相位/综合征信息；上下文预算结果符合预测的可分离梯子 2^(b-k)，即真实稳定子生成元被移除时的规律。
Conclusion: 本文的贡献是 Tsetlin 子句学习与量子逻辑之间的受控桥接，明确不是量子优势的声明。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FlashAttention for Scalable Vector Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Inference with transformer models on CPUs is increasingly important, especially for Small Language Models (SLMs), where vector architectures are emerging as a promising execution substrate. The attention module is a major bottleneck due to high memory bandwidth requirements; FlashAttention mitigates this by fusing operations to improve data locality and reduce intermediate memory traffic. In this paper, we present FlashAttention-V, a blocked FlashAttention for scalable vector architectures that adapts efficiently from short to very long vectors by exploiting parallelism across attention heads, inter-head packing to enable efficient utilization of vector lengths beyond the head dimension, and improving vector register utilization and memory access locality. We integrate FlashAttention-V into ggml within llama.cpp and evaluate it on TinyLlama, Llama 3.2, Qwen2.5, and Pythia-410M using gem5 and a Banana Pi BPI-F3. On the Banana Pi BPI-F3, we confirm that loop reordering and loop unrolling across attention heads are effective optimization principles, scaling performance gains with larger models and most pronounced with short contexts and during decoding. Simulation-based analysis shows that FlashAttention-V achieves 22x-42x speedup over scalar FlashAttention at 512-bit VL in prefill, with an additional 2x-2.5x gain scaling to 64 lanes and 4096-bit VL. During decode, FlashAttention-V achieves 8x-11x speedup using 512-bit vector lengths over scalar FlashAttention, with performance showing diminishing sensitivity to vector width and lane count due to single-token, memory-bound execution. We further identify structural bottlenecks in Q8_0 quantized linear layers that limit arithmetic amortization under long-vector execution, consistent across RVV and Arm SVE, indicating that current quantization formats pose a fundamental challenge to long-vector scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlashAttention-V，一种面向可扩展向量架构的分块 FlashAttention 实现，并集成到 llama.cpp 的 ggml 中。它通过跨注意力头并行、头间打包 (inter-head packing) 等手段，在短到极长向量范围内提升向量寄存器利用率和访存局部性。在 Banana Pi BPI-F3 和 gem5 模拟器上对 TinyLlama、Llama 3.2、Qwen2.5、Pythia-410M 进行评估，prefill 阶段相对标量 FlashAttention 取得 22x-42x 加速，decode 阶段取得 8x-11x 加速。
Motivation: CPU 上的 Transformer 推理日益重要，尤其是小型语言模型，而注意力模块因高内存带宽需求成为主要瓶颈；FlashAttention 通过算子融合改善数据局部性，但尚未针对可扩展向量架构进行适配。
Method: 提出 FlashAttention-V，一种分块 (blocked) FlashAttention 实现，利用跨注意力头并行和头间打包使向量长度超过 head 维度时仍能高效利用，并改进向量寄存器利用率与访存局部性；将实现集成进 ggml/llama.cpp，并在 gem5 模拟器与 Banana Pi BPI-F3 实机上评估。
Result: 在 Banana Pi BPI-F3 上确认循环重排与跨注意力头循环展开是有效优化原则，性能增益随模型增大而扩大，在短上下文和解码阶段最显著。模拟显示 prefill 阶段在 512-bit 向量长度下相对标量 FlashAttention 实现 22x-42x 加速，扩展到 64 lanes 和 4096-bit 向量长度时再获 2x-2.5x 增益；decode 阶段在 512-bit 向量长度下实现 8x-11x 加速，且性能对向量宽度和 lane 数不敏感，原因是单 token 内存受限执行。

papers.title: Clinically Structured Surrogate Rewards for Post-SFT Medical Image Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Medical image captioning requires translating heterogeneous visual evidence into concise clinical descriptions, where errors in findings, assertion states, or anatomical relations can alter clinical meaning despite surface-level fluency. Sequence-level policy optimization can directly optimize complete captions, but common rewards rely on global text similarity, direct image-caption compatibility, or unordered concept overlap, leaving visual neighborhoods and clinical-claim structure implicit. We propose a clinically structured surrogate reward framework for post-SFT medical image captioning. The framework combines biomedical semantic and short-range lexical fidelity with two structured rewards: distributional image-neighborhood alignment, which matches the medical-image-bank distributions induced by reference and generated captions, and clinical graph consistency, which applies maximum-weight one-to-one matching to entities, assertion states, and typed relations. The four rewards are independently normalized within each rollout group, combined with fixed relative weights, and optimized with GDPO. Across organizer-evaluated hidden test sets for the Standard and Synthetical ImageCLEFmedical Caption tracks and three vision-language backbones, the method improves Overall, Relevance, and Factuality over matched SFT baselines in all six backbone-track combinations, with average relative gains of 3.4%, 2.1%, and 5.8%, respectively. Ablations and paired diagnostics indicate that the structured rewards provide complementary signals, reducing image-neighborhood divergence and improving entity-assertion-relation consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学图像描述（medical image captioning）提出一种临床结构化的替代奖励（surrogate reward）框架，用于 SFT 后的策略优化。该框架将生物医学语义与短程词汇保真度同两类结构化奖励结合：分布级图像邻域对齐和临床图一致性，并通过 GDPO 优化。在 ImageCLEFmedical Caption 的 Standard 和 Synthetical 隐藏测试集以及三个视觉-语言骨干网络上，相比匹配的 SFT 基线，Overall、Relevance、Factuality 在所有六种骨干-赛道组合上均有提升。
Motivation: 序列级策略优化可直接优化完整描述，但常见奖励依赖全局文本相似度、直接图像-描述兼容性或无序概念重叠，使得视觉邻域和临床声明结构隐含；而医学描述中发现项、断言状态或解剖关系的错误即使表面流畅也会改变临床含义。
Method: 提出包含四个奖励的框架：生物医学语义、短程词汇保真度、分布级图像邻域对齐（匹配参考与生成描述诱导的医学图像库分布）以及临床图一致性（对实体、断言状态和类型化关系进行最大权重一对一匹配）。四个奖励在每组 rollout 内独立归一化，以固定相对权重组合，并使用 GDPO 优化。
Result: 在组织者评估的 Standard 和 Synthetical ImageCLEFmedical Caption 隐藏测试集上，配合三个视觉-语言骨干网络，该方法在所有六种骨干-赛道组合中均超过匹配的 SFT 基线，Overall、Relevance、Factuality 的平均相对提升分别为 3.4%、2.1% 和 5.8%。消融和配对诊断表明结构化奖励提供互补信号，降低图像邻域散度并改善实体-断言-关系一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构化奖励能提供互补信号，减少图像邻域发散并提升实体-断言-关系的一致性，从而改善医学图像描述的临床相关性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Progressive Experience Fusion for Multi-Task World Model Control in Endovascular Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous endovascular navigation could support the delivery of mechanical thrombectomy to underserved areas, but controllers must navigate long, multi-stage paths across varying vascular anatomies. This study investigates Progressive Experience Fusion (PEF) to train a multi-task TD-MPC2 controller. We additionally evaluate a heuristic that changes the Model Predictive Path Integral planning horizon using residual action-sequence dispersion, and fine-tuning in a patient-specific simulation. Across five subtasks in ten known training anatomies with held-out targets, PEF achieved a mean success rate of 74%, compared with 37% for Soft Actor-Critic (p < 0.001) and 65% for base TD-MPC2 (p = 0.053). A PEF controller with adaptive-horizon planning trained on 30 vasculatures achieved a mean success rate of 90% in ten held-out vasculatures. The PEF agent successfully transferred to an unseen in vitro stroke patient vasculature under fluoroscopy, achieving a mean path ratio improvement from 63% to 80% with fine-tuning (p < 0.001), following 40x103 fine-tuning steps (corresponding to approximately 107 min of clinical inter-hospital transfer time). This work represents a proof of concept for multi-vasculature training and patient-specific adaptation, while further validation is required before clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多任务世界模型控制在血管内导航中的应用，提出渐进式经验融合（Progressive Experience Fusion, PEF）训练多任务 TD-MPC2 控制器，并引入基于残差动作序列离散度的自适应 Model Predictive Path Integral 规划视界启发式与患者特定仿真微调。摘要报告 PEF 在十个已知训练解剖结构上的五个子任务中平均成功率为 74%，优于 Soft Actor-Critic 的 37% 和基础 TD-MPC2 的 65%；在三十个血管结构上训练并自适应规划视界的 PEF 控制器在十个未见血管结构上达到 90% 平均成功率，并成功迁移到体外卒中患者血管模型。
Motivation: 自主血管内导航有望支持机械取栓手术在医疗资源匮乏地区的推广，但控制器需在多变血管解剖结构中完成长距离、多阶段路径导航，现有方法难以兼顾多血管泛化与患者特定适应。
Method: 提出渐进式经验融合（PEF）训练多任务 TD-MPC2 控制器；评估一种使用残差动作序列离散度动态调整 Model Predictive Path Integral 规划视界的启发式方法，并在患者特定仿真中进行微调。
Result: PEF 在十个已知训练解剖结构上的五个子任务中平均成功率为 74%，相比 Soft Actor-Critic 的 37%（p < 0.001）和基础 TD-MPC2 的 65%（p = 0.053）有提升；使用自适应视界规划并在三十个血管结构上训练的控制器在十个未见血管结构上达 90% 成功率；经约 4 万步微调后，在体外卒中患者血管模型上的平均路径比从 63% 提升至 80%（p < 0.001）。
Conclusion: 本工作为多血管训练与患者特定适应提供了概念验证，但作者强调临床部署前仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: ProxyGuard: Direct Reliability Inference for Randomized Data Release Mechanisms with Shared Targets
papers.abstract_en: Researchers often choose a proxy dataset from many releases, transformations, or seeds. Search can make an invalid release appear adequate, while one adequate release does not establish that its generator is reliable. ProxyGuard controls both errors using prespecified bounded risks and a sealed target set. Named-release mode corrects for multiplicity and certifies specific releases. Direct shared-target mode evaluates independent mechanism draws on a common target, lower-bounds their favorable-score rate, and subtracts a bound on favorable scores contributed by invalid releases. Conditional on the target, release scores are independent, yielding a finite-sample mechanism-reliability guarantee without independent target batches or assumptions on release-level $p$-value dependence. We show that the mean-only penalty is sharp and derive a smooth-score certificate with additive target concentration. In a registered three-requirement study, direct mode raises power from 5.6\% to 64.2\% at reliability 0.95, while named mode remains stronger under high-signal evidence. Prospective audits span full-pipeline Rice--TVAE, which retrains on every draw, and a non-tabular text mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProxyGuard，用于在共享目标 (shared target) 上评估随机化数据发布机制 (randomized data release mechanisms) 的可靠性，区分命名发布模式与直接共享目标模式。方法在预设风险界和密封目标集下同时控制两类错误，并给出无需独立目标批次或释放级 p 值独立性假设的有限样本可靠性保证。注册研究中，直接模式在可靠性 0.95 下把功效从 5.6% 提升到 64.2%，命名模式在高信号证据下表现更强。
Motivation: 研究者常从众多发布、变换或随机种子中挑选代理数据集 (proxy dataset)，搜索过程可能让无效发布看起来合格，而单一合格发布也不能证明其生成器可靠。因此需要同时控制假阳性与假阴性两类错误，并给出可认证的机制级可靠性结论。
Method: ProxyGuard 使用预设的有界风险和密封目标集来控制两类错误。命名发布模式对多重性进行校正并对特定发布给出认证；直接共享目标模式在共同目标上评估独立机制抽样，给出有利分数率的下界，并减去无效发布可能贡献的有利分数上界。由于给定目标后发布分数条件独立，可获得有限样本机制可靠性保证。
Result: 摘要表明均值唯一惩罚 (mean-only penalty) 是紧的，并推导了带加性目标集中 (additive target concentration) 的平滑分数证书。在注册的三需求研究中，直接模式在可靠性 0.95 下将功效从 5.6% 提高到 64.2%，命名模式在高信号证据下更强；前瞻性审计覆盖每次抽样都重训的完整流水线 Rice–TVAE 以及非表格文本机制。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种不依赖独立目标批次或释放级 p 值相关性假设的机制可靠性审计框架，适用于跨发布选择的可靠性认证和完整流水线生成机制的审计。

papers.title: SAM2Dual: Training-Free, Dual Memory for Long-Term Video Object Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Long-term video object segmentation (VOS) remains challenging due to error accumulation under extended occlusions, re-appearance, and scene changes. Although SAM2 provides strong zero-shot performance, its streaming memory can amplify drift over long horizons when recent, unreliable predictions dominate the memory state. We propose SAM2Dual, a training-free, plug-and-play inference-time enhancement that improves long-video robustness without updating model weights. SAM2Dual introduces a Dual Memory design that explicitly separates (i) short-term memory for rapid local adaptation and (ii) long-term memory built via interval-based sampling to preserve global identity cues, combined through a gated fusion strategy. In addition, we present Text-Aware Memory (TAM), which extracts a compact word-level cue from early frames and uses text embeddings to reweight memory contributions based on semantic compatibility, supporting identity preservation when visual evidence becomes weak or ambiguous. Across long-term benchmarks, SAM2Dual consistently improves stability on long videos, raising J&F from 49.33 to 50.65 on MOSEv2 and achieving consistent gains on LVOSv2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAM2Dual，一种无需训练、即插即用的推理期增强方法，用于改善 SAM2 在长视频目标分割 (VOS) 中的稳定性。其核心是显式分离短期记忆与基于间隔采样的长期记忆，并通过门控融合策略结合二者；此外还提出 Text-Aware Memory (TAM)，利用早期帧提取的词级文本嵌入按语义兼容性重新加权记忆贡献。摘要报告该方法在 MOSEv2 上将 J&F 从 49.33 提升到 50.65，并在 LVOSv2 上获得一致增益。
Motivation: 长视频 VOS 在长时间遮挡、目标重现和场景变化下会因误差累积而退化；SAM2 的流式记忆在长时程中会被近期不可靠预测主导，放大漂移。
Method: 提出 SAM2Dual 双记忆设计：短期记忆负责快速局部适应，长期记忆通过间隔采样保留全局身份线索，并以门控融合整合二者；同时提出 Text-Aware Memory (TAM)，从早期帧提取词级文本嵌入，依据语义兼容性对记忆贡献重新加权。
Result: 在长时程基准上，SAM2Dual 将 MOSEv2 的 J&F 从 49.33 提升到 50.65，并在 LVOSv2 上取得一致增益。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法是训练免费且即插即用的推理期增强，可以在不更新模型权重的情况下提升长视频鲁棒性；其作用范围限于长视频目标分割任务。

papers.title: Change Point--Aware Evaluation and Re-Calibration of PPG-Based Blood Pressure Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Non-invasive continuous blood pressure (BP) monitoring using photoplethysmography (PPG) is a promising alternative to cuff-based measurements. However, existing PPG-based BP estimation studies predominantly rely on aggregated performance metrics (e.g., mean absolute error) computed over entire evaluation intervals, which can obscure model failures during rapid BP fluctuations and limit clinical relevance. In this work, we propose a fluctuation-aware evaluation framework for PPG-based BP estimation based on time-series change point detection. Instead of heuristic BP thresholding (e.g., $Δ\mathrm{BP} > 10\mathrm{mmHg}$), we identify BP change points by capturing abrupt distributional shifts in BP trajectories and evaluate estimation performance specifically during these fluctuation periods. Our analysis shows that several state-of-the-art models exhibit substantial performance degradation around BP change points, and that periodic test-time calibration is insufficient to handle such dynamic BP variations. To address this limitation, we introduce a targeted re-calibration framework triggered by detected BP change points, improving robustness without modifying model architectures. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic evaluation of PPG-based BP estimation from a BP change point perspective, highlighting the importance of fluctuation-aware evaluation and calibration for real-world continuous BP monitoring.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对PPG无创连续血压估计中现有评估依赖整体聚合指标（如平均绝对误差）而掩盖快速血压波动期模型失效的问题，提出基于时间序列变点检测（change point detection）的波动感知评估框架。摘要报告多个SOTA模型在血压变点附近出现明显性能下降，且周期性测试时校准不足以应对动态变化，由此引入由检测到的变点触发的定向重新校准框架，在无需修改模型结构的情况下提升鲁棒性。作者称这是首个从血压变点角度对PPG血压估计进行系统评估的工作。
Motivation: 现有PPG血压估计研究主要在整个评估区间上计算聚合性能指标，会掩盖快速血压波动期间模型的失败，限制临床相关性；启发式阈值（如ΔBP>10mmHg）也被认为不够充分。
Method: 提出基于时间序列变点检测的波动感知评估框架，通过捕捉BP轨迹中的分布突变识别变点，并在这些波动时段专门评估估计性能；同时引入由检测到的血压变点触发的针对性重新校准（re-calibration）框架，不修改模型架构。
Result: 摘要显示多个现有SOTA模型在血压变点附近出现显著性能退化，并且周期性测试时校准不足以处理动态血压变化。
Conclusion: 作者强调波动感知评估与校准对真实世界连续血压监测的重要性，并指出这是首次从血压变点视角系统评估PPG血压估计。

papers.title: Coordination on a Budget: Federated Active Learning with Few Labels
papers.abstract_en: Federated Active Learning (FAL) addresses the dual challenges of data privacy and label scarcity, where the absence of a global data view introduces additional hurdles for coordinated query selection. We study cross-silo FAL in the low-budget regime, where annotation decisions are most critical. We characterize, both theoretically and empirically, a heterogeneity reversal: in low-budget settings, homogeneous (IID) data requires stronger coordination to avoid redundant queries, whereas heterogeneous data naturally promotes diversity; this trend reverses at higher budgets. Thus, in contrast to the standard federated learning (FL) narrative where heterogeneity is a primary challenge, we show that IID settings are more challenging for query selection in FAL. Motivated by these findings, we propose a new FAL framework that utilizes federated representation learning to align client data in a shared embedding space. This enables the server to perform globally coordinated active selection over optionally obfuscated client embeddings, while annotation remains local to each client. Although our framework operates in the more challenging low-budget regime, it achieves performance that surpasses existing FAL methods even when they are given substantially larger annotation budgets, demonstrating the value of centralized coordination under privacy constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究跨 silo 联邦主动学习（FAL）在低标注预算下的查询选择问题。作者在理论与经验上刻画了一种“异质性反转”：低预算时同构（IID）数据需要更强的协调以避免冗余查询，而异构数据天然促进多样性，该趋势在高预算时反转。基于此提出的新框架利用联邦表示学习将客户端数据对齐到共享嵌入空间，由服务器基于可选混淆的客户端嵌入进行全局协调的主动选择，而标注仍保留在客户端本地。
Motivation: FAL 需要同时应对数据隐私与标签稀缺，且缺少全局数据视图给协调查询选择带来额外困难；低预算区间标注决策最敏感，而标准联邦学习（FL）叙事中异构是主要挑战，但本文发现 IID 设定在 FAL 中反而更难处理。
Method: 提出一个利用联邦表示学习对齐客户端数据到共享嵌入空间的 FAL 框架，使服务器能在可选混淆的客户端嵌入上执行全局协调的主动选择（active selection），同时标注过程仍完全在客户端本地进行。
Result: 在更具挑战性的低预算区间，该框架的性能超过现有 FAL 方法，即使这些方法被给予明显更大的标注预算；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调隐私约束下集中协调（centralized coordination）的价值，并指出低预算 FAL 中 IID 数据比异构数据更难以进行有效查询选择。

papers.title: Preference Reasoning under Indeterminacy in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As large language models evolve into decision-making agents, the ability to reason over preferences becomes fundamental to alignment, coordination, and collective intelligence. Yet, unlike standard benchmarks, real-world preference reasoning is inherently indeterminate: information may be incomplete, and valid solutions may not exist. We argue that indeterminacy, rather than correctness alone, is a central challenge for AI reasoning. We formalize this challenge along two axes, (i) epistemic indeterminacy, arising from incomplete, partial, or expressive preferences, and (ii) structural indeterminacy, arising from the non-existence of solutions under standard social choice concepts. Across a hierarchy of tasks, we show that state-of-the-art language models systematically fail to distinguish between determined and undetermined instances, exhibiting miscalibrated reasoning even in verification settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注大语言模型在偏好推理中的不确定性（indeterminacy）问题，提出沿认知不确定性（epistemic indeterminacy，源于不完整、部分或表达性偏好）与结构不确定性（structural indeterminacy，源于标准社会选择概念下解不存在）两个轴对其进行形式化。作者在一系列分层任务上测试现有模型，发现最先进的语言模型系统性地无法区分确定（determined）与不确定（undetermined）的实例，即使在验证设置中也表现出校准不良的推理。
Motivation: 现有偏好推理基准只关注正确性，而真实场景中的偏好推理本质上是确定与不确定并存的：信息可能不完整，有效解可能不存在。作者认为不确定性本身是 AI 推理的核心挑战，而非仅以正确性衡量。
Method: 将不确定性形式化为两个维度：认知不确定性与结构不确定性，并构建从简单到复杂的分层任务体系，用于评估大语言模型区分可确定与不可确定实例的能力。
Result: 摘要报告称，最先进的语言模型系统性失败于区分确定的与不确定的实例，在验证设置中也呈现出校准不良的推理。未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调不确定性应被视为 AI 推理的核心挑战，并暗示当前模型在处理无解或不完整偏好信息时的推理能力存在明显缺陷。

papers.title: When Safety Overrides Vision: Exploring Dynamics between Vision Influence and Safety Alignment in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Aligned vision-language models (VLMs) are designed to balance grounded visual reasoning with safe generation behavior. However, we observe a striking phenomenon: under safety-constrained instruction, models frequently abstain from answering questions that remain correctly answerable under default instruction despite receiving identical image-question inputs. This raises a fundamental question: does safety alignment suppress perceptual grounding itself, or does visual evidence remain internally available while generation is redirected toward abstention? In this work, we investigate the internal decoding dynamics underlying safety-induced abstention in aligned VLMs. Across multiple architectures and multimodal benchmarks, we show that abstained generations remain consistently influenced by visual evidence throughout decoding, indicating that perceptual grounding is largely preserved despite refusal behavior. We further demonstrate that, although the representational organization of refusal differs substantially across architectures, safety-constrained instruction consistently alters late-stage hidden-state dynamics toward refusal-oriented decoding. Finally, through targeted activation-level interventions, we show that suppressing refusal-related representations reliably restores grounded answering behavior across models without retraining or modifying visual inputs. Together, these findings reveal a previously underexplored failure mode in aligned VLMs: safety alignment can override grounded visual expression even when perceptual evidence remains internally preserved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对齐后的视觉语言模型（VLM）在安全约束指令下拒绝回答的现象，发现模型即使面对与默认指令下可正确回答的相同图文输入，也常选择拒答。作者通过跨多个架构和多模态基准的内部解码动态分析，表明拒答生成过程中视觉证据仍持续影响解码，即感知接地（perceptual grounding）大体保留；但安全指令会稳定地把后期隐状态动态推向拒答。激活层面的干预实验显示，抑制与拒答相关的表征可以在不重训练、不修改视觉输入的情况下恢复接地回答。
Motivation: 现有对齐 VLM 在安全约束下经常放弃回答本可正确回答的问题，作者想弄清安全对齐究竟抑制了感知接地本身，还是视觉证据仍内部可用、仅生成被导向拒答。
Method: 作者分析多个 VLM 架构在多模态基准上的内部解码动态，比较安全约束与默认指令下的隐状态变化，并通过针对拒答相关表征的激活级干预（activation-level intervention）验证因果关系。
Result: 摘要显示拒答生成仍受视觉证据一致影响，说明感知接地在拒答中基本保留；拒答的表征组织在不同架构间差异很大，但安全指令都会改变后期隐状态动态；抑制拒答相关表征可稳定恢复接地回答行为。
Conclusion: 作者指出这揭示了对齐 VLM 中一个此前少被关注的失败模式：即使感知证据在内部保留，安全对齐仍可能覆盖接地的视觉表达。

papers.title: PCQA-R1: Advancing Generalized 3D Point Cloud Quality Assessment with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: No-reference point cloud quality assessment (PCQA) has been an active topic in recent years and is used to measure and optimize the visual experience of point clouds. However, large multimodal models (LMMs) have rarely been explored in this area. Previous LMM-based methods mainly rely on supervised fine-tuning to directly predict numerical quality scores, lacking the ability to generalize across datasets with heterogeneous MOS scales and limited annotations. A key difficulty is that absolute MOS regression can be brittle across datasets with different score scales and distortion distributions, whereas relative quality ranking is more stable under such shifts. In this paper, we present PCQA-R1, the first reinforcement learning LMM for 3D point cloud quality assessment to simultaneously model quality understanding and scoring. Built upon the group relative policy optimization (GRPO) strategy, PCQA-R1 first constructs a chain-of-thought dataset, PCQA-CoT, which serves as cold-start training data through a reverse reasoning strategy that teaches the LMM to generate its reasoning process. We further introduce a Gaussian proximity reward that prevents calibration drift by anchoring score predictions to the source MOS range. Experimental results demonstrate that PCQA-R1 achieves state-of-the-art cross-dataset generalization across five benchmarks and competitive in-domain accuracy. Ablation studies support the role of ranking, Gaussian reward, and cold-start traces.

Method: 提出 PCQA-R1，采用 GRPO 训练 LMM；先构建思维链数据集 PCQA-CoT，通过反向推理策略让模型生成推理过程作为冷启动数据，再引入高斯邻近奖励，将预测分数锚定到源 MOS 范围以避免校准漂移。

Conclusion: 摘要强调 GRPO 结合思维链冷启动与高斯邻近奖励，可同时实现质量理解与打分，并显著提升跨数据集的泛化稳健性。

papers.title: Evaluation of Image Matching Methods for Visual Odometry on UAVs
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are becoming a powerful tool for many environmental monitoring and transport applications. Yet, their reliance on Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) technology for navigation makes them susceptible to catastrophic failures in scenarios where the positioning signal is unavailable or disrupted. This work explores Visual Odometry (VO) as a crucial navigation component. Recently, numerous deep-learning-based methods for image matching have been proposed that are yet to be implemented in a fully-fledged VO system. In this paper, we evaluate recent state-of-the-art image matching methods for the task of VO for UAV position tracking, with a downwards-facing camera, on our synthetic dataset, and find that while the best results are generated by the recent RoMa matcher, SIFT features can outperform some recent state-of-the-art.
papers.comment: 5 pages, published in the Proceedings of the 33rd International Electrotechnical and Computer Science Conference ERK 2024
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 33rd International Electrotechnical and Computer Science Conference ERK 2024, pp. 479-483, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 UAV 在 GNSS 信号缺失时依赖视觉里程计 (Visual Odometry, VO) 进行导航的问题，评估了多种近期基于深度学习的图像匹配方法在无人机下视相机位置跟踪任务中的表现。作者使用自己的合成数据集进行实验，发现最近的 RoMa 匹配器结果最好，而传统 SIFT 特征也能超过部分最新方法。文章发表于 ERK 2024 会议，篇幅为 5 页。
Motivation: 无人机导航高度依赖 GNSS，在定位信号不可用或被干扰时容易发生灾难性失效，因此需要探索视觉里程计作为关键的导航补充。当前许多新的深度学习图像匹配方法尚未集成到完整的 VO 系统中，缺乏针对无人机位置跟踪任务的系统评估。
Method: 作者在自建的合成数据集上，针对配备下视相机的无人机位置跟踪任务，评估了若干种最新图像匹配方法在视觉里程计中的表现，并结合传统特征方法进行比较。
Result: 实验结果显示最近的 RoMa 匹配器产生了最好的结果，而 SIFT 特征在部分情况下也能优于一些近期最先进的方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调图像匹配方法的选择会显著影响无人机视觉里程计的性能，且传统 SIFT 仍具竞争力，但该评估基于合成数据集，结论的泛化范围有限。

papers.title: PALATE: Personalized Aesthetic Learning through Adaptive Taste Evolution for Multi-User Portrait Retouching
papers.abstract_en: Automatic portrait retouching has advanced rapidly, yet its objective is inherently subjective: the same portrait admits multiple professionally valid results, and users disagree about which one is best. Most existing methods optimize a population-level aesthetic standard and therefore cannot capture individual taste, while fine-tuning a separate editing model for every user incurs prohibitive training, storage, and data costs. We propose PALATE, a shared reward-evolution framework that keeps the image editor fixed and instead personalizes the selection among retouched candidates of the same source portrait. PALATE decomposes the reward for each user into a global backbone shared by all users, category-level residuals shared by aesthetically similar users, and a lightweight user adapter, with anti-collapse regularizers keeping the three levels complementary.A cyclic dual-level distillation scheme first distills user-specific preferences into category rewards and then consolidates the resulting category-level knowledge into the global backbone, which is redistributed to initialize the next evolution round. In this way, the shared initialization improves progressively across rounds, enabling unseen users to be calibrated from only a few rankings. On expert-retouched candidates from PPR10K with held-out users and held-out images, PALATE attains 72.83% pairwise preference-prediction accuracy, surpassing all reward, aesthetic, and image-quality baselines, of which the strongest, PickScore, reaches 58.06%. Each new user costs only 512 bytes of user-specific parameters and millisecond-level scoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PALATE，一个共享奖励演化框架，用于多用户人像修图。它保持图像编辑器固定，只个性化对同一源人像的候选修图结果的挑选，并将每个用户的奖励分解为全局骨干、类级残差和轻量用户适配器，通过循环双层蒸馏让共享初始化跨轮次逐步改进。在 PPR10K 的专家修图候选上，对留出用户和留出图像达到 72.83% 的成对偏好预测准确率，超过所有奖励、美学与图像质量基线（最强基线 PickScore 为 58.06%）。
Motivation: 自动人像修图的目标本质上是主观的，同一张人像可有多个专业上有效的结果，而现有方法大多优化群体级美学标准，无法捕捉个体品味；逐用户微调编辑模型则会带来高昂的训练、存储和数据成本。
Method: PALATE 保持图像编辑器固定，转而个性化候选结果的选择；将每个用户的奖励分解为全局共享骨干、审美相似用户的类级残差和轻量用户适配器，并用防坍缩正则化保证三层互补。采用循环双层蒸馏，先把用户特定偏好蒸馏到类别奖励，再整合类别级知识到全局骨干，用于初始化下一轮演化。
Result: 在 PPR10K 专家修图候选上，对留出用户和留出图像的成对偏好预测准确率为 72.83%，超过所有基线（最强基线 PickScore 为 58.06%）。每个新用户仅需 512 字节的用户特定参数和毫秒级评分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调共享初始化跨轮次逐步改进，使未见用户只需少量排名即可校准，从而在不修改图像编辑器的前提下实现个性化修图。

papers.title: SPARC: Slice-to-volume Pipeline for Automated Reconstruction of gated 3D+time fetal Cardiac MRI
papers.abstract_en: Fetal cardiac MRI (fCMR) provides valuable diagnostic information complementary to echocardiography, particularly for complex congenital heart disease (CHD). Dynamic cine imaging captures cardiac motion essential for assessment of cardiac function; however, the reconstruction of 3D+time cine volumes from 2D+time acquired slices remains challenging due to unpredictable fetal motion and the absence of automated and robust processing tools suitable for clinical deployment. We present the SPARC pipeline (Slice-to-volume Pipeline for Automated Reconstruction of gated 3D+time fetal Cardiac MRI) which combines physics-informed slice-to-volume reconstruction (SVR) of Doppler ultrasound (DUS) gated stacks of slices, assisted by deep learning (DL) models for thoracic segmentation and anatomical reorientation. The proposed SVR algorithm achieves a tenfold reduction in reconstruction time relative to existing frame-wise approaches ($4.8 \pm 1.0$ vs $49.0 \pm 14.1$ min, $p < 0.0001$) while improving the reconstruction quality. Thoracic segmentation performance using ensemble aggregation exceeded inter-rater agreement (Dice $84.7 \pm 3.9\%$ vs $81.4 \pm 7.7\%$, $p<0.05$), while anatomical reorientation achieved a success rate of $90.1\%$. End-to-end evaluation on a large held-out clinical cohort ($n = 121$) demonstrated fully automatic processing in $82.6\%$ of cases with a mean runtime of $7.1 \pm 1.3$ min, compatible with clinical deployment. The complete SPARC pipeline is publicly available as a Docker container https://hub.docker.com/r/aboutill/sparc and is currently deployed at our institution as a clinical research tool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPARC 流水线（Slice-to-volume Pipeline for Automated Reconstruction of gated 3D+time fetal Cardiac MRI），结合物理知情的切片到体积重建（SVR）与深度学习胸部分割和解剖重定向，实现门控胎儿心脏 MRI 的 3D+time 自动重建。摘要报告重建时间较现有逐帧方法缩短十倍且质量提升，并在 121 例临床队列中实现 82.6% 的完全自动处理，平均运行时间 7.1 分钟。完整流水线以 Docker 容器形式公开，并已作为临床研究工具部署。
Motivation: 胎儿心脏 MRI 对复杂先天性心脏病有补充诊断价值，但从 2D+time 切片重建 3D+time 电影体积仍受胎儿不可预测运动和缺乏自动化稳健工具影响，难以满足临床部署需求。
Method: 提出 SPARC 流水线，由多普勒超声（DUS）门控的物理知情切片到体积重建（SVR）算法驱动，并借助深度学习模型进行胸部分割（采用集成聚合）和解剖重定向。
Result: 摘要报告 SVR 将重建时间从 49.0 ± 14.1 分钟降至 4.8 ± 1.0 分钟（十倍减少，p<0.0001）且重建质量提升；胸部分割集成聚合的 Dice 为 84.7 ± 3.9%，超过评分者间一致性 81.4 ± 7.7%（p<0.05）；解剖重定向成功率为 90.1%；在 121 例临床队列中 82.6% 案例实现全自动处理，平均运行时间 7.1 ± 1.3 分钟。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该流水线具备临床部署兼容性，已作为临床研究工具在本机构部署，并以公开 Docker 容器形式提供。
Relevance: 0
