papers.title: CDGP: Contrastive Dual Gaussian Processes for Weakly Supervised Anomaly Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Industrial visual inspection must both decide whether a product is defective and localize the defect, yet pixel-level masks are costly to collect at scale. Most anomaly-segmentation methods learn only from defect-free images and score deviations from normality. A true defect and an unusual-but-normal region, however, can both deviate substantially and receive similarly high scores. We propose Contrastive Dual Gaussian Processes (CDGP), a weakly supervised framework that models normal and anomaly inducing-variable predictive distributions over dense tokens. Its posterior-dominance statistic standardizes their predictive-mean difference by the joint predictive uncertainty, providing both spatial evidence and image-level confidence. This evidence complements hierarchical normal-reconstruction residuals for fine localization. All calibration uses training data only, without human pixel annotations or test-time fitting. Across MVTec AD~2, KSDD2, and VisA, CDGP ranks first among the evaluated methods on all MVTec AD~2 localization metrics and is first-place or competitive on KSDD2 and VisA. Factorized and matched linear-head controls delimit the contribution and scope of the linear-kernel Gaussian process (GP) formulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对比双高斯过程（Contrastive Dual Gaussian Processes, CDGP），一种弱监督异常分割框架，对密集 token 分别建模正常与异常诱导变量（inducing variables）的预测分布。其“后验优势统计量”用联合预测不确定性对预测均值差做标准化，同时提供空间证据和图像级置信度，并与分层正常重建残差互补用于精细定位。所有校准仅使用训练数据，不需要像素级标注或测试时拟合。在 MVTec AD~2、KSDD2 和 VisA 上，CDGP 在 MVTec AD~2 的所有定位指标上排名第一，在 KSDD2 和 VisA 上为第一或具有竞争力。
Motivation: 工业视觉检测需要同时判断产品是否有缺陷并定位缺陷，但像素级掩膜标注在大规模场景下成本高昂。现有大多数异常分割方法仅从无缺陷图像学习并打分偏离正常分布的程度，导致真正缺陷与“异常但正常”的区域都可能获得高偏差分数而难以区分。
Method: 提出 CDGP，用两个高斯过程分别刻画正常与异常的诱导变量预测分布；通过后验优势统计量将预测均值差用联合预测不确定性标准化，得到空间证据和图像级置信度，并结合分层正常重建残差实现精细定位。校准过程只使用训练数据，不引入人类像素标注，也不需要测试时拟合。
Result: 摘要报告在 MVTec AD~2 的所有定位指标上，CDGP 在被评估方法中排名第一；在 KSDD2 和 VisA 上取得第一或竞争力的表现。因子分解和匹配线性头对照实验限定了线性核高斯过程（GP）公式的贡献与适用范围。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CDGP 在弱监督条件下无需像素标注和测试时拟合即可在多个异常分割基准上达到领先性能，同时通过消融界定了线性核 GP 设计的贡献边界。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出对比双高斯过程（Contrastive Dual Gaussian Processes, CDGP），一种弱监督异常分割框架，对密集 token 分别建模正常与异常诱导变量（inducing variables）的预测分布。其“后验优势统计量”用联合预测不确定性对预测均值差做标准化，同时提供空间证据和图像级置信度，并与分层正常重建残差互补用于精细定位。所有校准仅使用训练数据，不需要像素级标注或测试时拟合。在 MVTec AD~2、KSDD2 和 VisA 上，CDGP 在 MVTec AD~2 的所有定位指标上排名第一，在 KSDD2 和 VisA 上为第一或具有竞争力。
summary_sections.motivation: 工业视觉检测需要同时判断产品是否有缺陷并定位缺陷，但像素级掩膜标注在大规模场景下成本高昂。现有大多数异常分割方法仅从无缺陷图像学习并打分偏离正常分布的程度，导致真正缺陷与“异常但正常”的区域都可能获得高偏差分数而难以区分。
summary_sections.method: 提出 CDGP，用两个高斯过程分别刻画正常与异常的诱导变量预测分布；通过后验优势统计量将预测均值差用联合预测不确定性标准化，得到空间证据和图像级置信度，并结合分层正常重建残差实现精细定位。校准过程只使用训练数据，不引入人类像素标注，也不需要测试时拟合。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在 MVTec AD~2 的所有定位指标上，CDGP 在被评估方法中排名第一；在 KSDD2 和 VisA 上取得第一或竞争力的表现。因子分解和匹配线性头对照实验限定了线性核高斯过程（GP）公式的贡献与适用范围。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 CDGP 在弱监督条件下无需像素标注和测试时拟合即可在多个异常分割基准上达到领先性能，同时通过消融界定了线性核 GP 设计的贡献边界。

papers.title: CTIFoundry: An Agent-Native Corpus Scaffold for Cyber Threat Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) is increasingly consumed not by human analysts but by LLM agents that compose multi-step investigations at query time. The harness side of this shift has matured rapidly (planning loops, tool protocols, context management), but the corpus side has not: threat reports and vulnerability databases are still packaged for retrieval-augmented generation, as opaque chunks behind an embedding index. We argue that this substrate, not model capability, is the bottleneck on agentic CTI investigation, and present CTIFoundry, an agent-native corpus scaffold. At build time, CTIFoundry materializes the latent structure of a CTI corpus: a deterministic ontology graph over four authoritative knowledge bases (CVE, CWE, CAPEC, ATT&CK) whose official cross-references become typed, traversable edges; a span-grounded report layer whose canonical, alias-resolved cross-vendor entities index provenance-carrying chunks; and hybrid dense+lexical retrieval surfaces. At query time this structure is exposed through seven typed tools and three procedural skills mounted on a stock open-source agent harness. On the public CTIConnect benchmark, swapping only the action surface lifts the identically-harnessed agent by +0.19 to +0.28 overall F1 across a four-model, two-provider panel: a small model on CTIFoundry surpasses a flagship on the flat substrate, and the gain is not bought with search effort, since on both Claude models the scaffolded agent is more accurate at roughly half the tool calls. An ablation attributes it: typed structure carries the larger share, procedural skills convert structure into discipline, and the two compose super-additively, because skills bind only to structure that exists.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CTIFoundry，一种面向智能体 (agent) 的威胁情报语料脚手架，认为当前 CTI 语料仍按 RAG 的嵌入块方式组织，是智能体化 CTI 调查的瓶颈。构建时它从 CVE、CWE、CAPEC、ATT&CK 四个权威知识库生成确定性本体图，并叠加跨厂商、解析别名的实体级报告层与混合稠密+词法检索；查询时通过七种类型化工具和三个程序性技能挂载到开源智能体框架上。在 CTIConnect 基准上，仅替换动作面即让同一框架的智能体在四个模型、两个提供商上整体 F1 提升 0.19 至 0.28。
Motivation: CTI 的消费方正从人工分析师转向在查询时组合多步调查的 LLM 智能体，但语料侧仍停留在面向检索增强生成 (RAG) 的不透明分块加嵌入索引形态；作者主张这一底层语料而非模型能力才是智能体 CTI 调查的瓶颈。
Method: CTIFoundry 在构建时物化 CTI 语料的潜在结构：基于 CVE、CWE、CAPEC、ATT&CK 四个知识库构建确定性本体图，官方交叉引用成为带类型的可遍历边；报告层用规范化且解析别名的跨厂商实体索引带溯源的分块；并提供混合稠密+词法检索面。查询时通过七种类型化工具和三个程序性技能将结构暴露给智能体。
Result: 在 CTIConnect 基准上，只替换动作面使同一智能体框架在四模型、两提供商组合上整体 F1 提升 +0.19 至 +0.28；小模型配合 CTIFoundry 超过旗舰模型在扁平语料上的表现，且该增益并非来自更多搜索：在 Claude 两个模型上，脚手架化智能体约以一半工具调用数取得更高准确率。消融显示类型化结构贡献更大，程序性技能将结构转为纪律，二者超线性叠加。
Conclusion: 作者强调 CTI 语料的组织方式而非模型能力是智能体化调查的瓶颈，类型化结构加程序性技能的组合能在不增加工具调用的情况下显著提升性能。

papers.title: Scalable Geospatial Machine Learning for Power-Line Asset Risk: Integrating Remote Sensing for Lightning and Vegetation Risk Modelling
papers.abstract_en: Electric power networks are increasingly exposed to weather-sensitive failure mechanisms that require asset-level, spatially explicit risk modelling for effective intervention planning. This study contributes a modular, robust, and explainable probability-of-failure (PoF) modelling framework for utility asset management. The central contribution is an asset-level architecture that can be scaled to new environmental data sources and additional PoF types without reworking the underlying pipeline. This is particularly relevant for industry settings, where risk models must remain operationally maintainable while adapting to changing data availability, asset-management priorities, and climate-driven hazard conditions. We demonstrate the framework for vegetation-related and lightning-related failure modes using a harmonised geospatial machine-learning pipeline. The implementation integrates multi-source predictors, including topography (SRTM), vegetation condition (MODIS Normalised Difference Vegetation Index - NDVI), lightning climatology (LIS VHRMC), OpenStreetMap-derived proximity features, and utility operational records. The resulting architecture is computationally efficient, operationally extensible, and suitable for utility-scale deployment. It provides actionable asset-level risk stratification for inspection prioritisation, vegetation management, asset hardening, and resilience planning, supporting earlier intervention and more climate-resilient network operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向电网资产概率失效（probability-of-failure, PoF）建模的模块化地理空间机器学习框架，重点覆盖植被与雷电两类失效模式。作者将多源遥感与运营记录整合到统一流水线中，强调架构可扩展到新的环境数据源和更多 PoF 类型，而无需重构底层流程，并面向行业部署的运维可维护性与气候适应能力。
Motivation: 电力网络日益暴露于天气敏感型失效机制，需要在资产级别进行空间显式风险建模以支持干预规划；同时行业场景要求风险模型在数据可用性、资产管理优先级和气候灾害变化下保持运维可维护性。
Method: 提出资产级、模块化、可解释的 PoF 建模框架，采用协调统一的地理空间机器学习流水线，整合 SRTM 地形、MODIS NDVI 植被状况、LIS VHRMC 雷电气候学、OpenStreetMap 邻近特征以及公用事业运营记录等多源预测变量。
Result: 框架在植被相关和雷电相关的失效模式上得到验证，被描述为计算高效、可在运营上扩展，并适合公用事业规模部署；摘要未报告具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 该框架能够提供可操作的资产级风险分层，用于巡检优先级、植被管理、资产加固和韧性规划，支持更早干预和更具气候韧性的网络运营。

papers.title: Denoising-Aware Inversion: Revealing Privacy Risks in Noise-Protected Text Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Dense text embeddings are widely used in data mining, retrieval, and downstream machine learning systems due to their compact and semantically rich representations, but recent embedding inversion attacks have shown that they can expose substantial information about the original text, leading to serious privacy leakage risks. A common defense is to release perturbed embeddings by adding Gaussian noise, which is simple yet effective against standard inversion attacks and does not significantly degrade embedding utility for downstream tasks. However, it remains unclear whether such noise-protected embeddings are sufficiently safe against adaptive attackers that explicitly account for the perturbation process. In this paper, we study text embedding inversion in a noise-protected setting, where the attacker can observe only noisy embeddings and has no access to clean embedding targets. We first analyze why existing generative inversion methods fail under this setting and identify a "Double Noise Trap", which fundamentally prevents standard generative inversion models from achieving high-quality reconstruction. To address this challenge, we propose DAEI, a denoising-aware embedding inversion pipeline that combines a residual denoising autoencoder with generative text inversion where the denoiser is trained in an unsupervised manner using Stein's unbiased risk estimate to enable denoising from noisy observations alone. Extensive experiments show that DAEI achieves approximately 154\% relative improvement in BLEU over the existing generative inversion baseline, while also improving token-level F1 and ROUGE-L by 32--60\%. The promising inversion performance of DAEI challenges the prevailing assumption that simple Gaussian perturbation is sufficient to prevent sensitive information leakage from embedding representations.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted by IEEE ICDM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究噪声保护下的文本嵌入逆向攻击（embedding inversion），指出在仅能观测到加噪嵌入且无干净嵌入目标时，现有生成式逆向方法会陷入“双重噪声陷阱”（Double Noise Trap）而难以高质量重建。作者提出 DAEI（denoising-aware embedding inversion）流水线，将残差去噪自编码器与生成式文本逆向结合，并用 Stein 无偏风险估计以无监督方式训练去噪器。实验显示 DAEI 在 BLEU 上相对现有生成式逆向基线提升约 154%，token 级 F1 和 ROUGE-L 提升 32–60%。
Motivation: 常见的防御手段是对发布的文本嵌入添加高斯噪声，但现有研究未充分评估针对该扰动过程的自适应攻击者是否仍能泄露敏感信息。本文聚焦噪声保护设置下的嵌入逆向，探究简单高斯扰动是否足以防止隐私泄露。
Method: 提出 DAEI 流水线，包含一个残差去噪自编码器（residual denoising autoencoder）和生成式文本逆向模块；去噪器仅利用噪声观测训练，通过 Stein 无偏风险估计（Stein's unbiased risk estimate）实现无监督去噪，从而绕开“双重噪声陷阱”。
Result: 在噪声保护嵌入逆向任务上，DAEI 相对现有生成式逆向基线在 BLEU 上实现约 154% 的相对提升，token 级 F1 与 ROUGE-L 提升 32–60%，表明噪声保护下的嵌入仍可被有效重建。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DAEI 的重建性能挑战了“简单高斯扰动足以防止嵌入表示敏感信息泄露”这一普遍假设，提示需要更强大的隐私保护机制。

papers.title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation
papers.abstract_en: Using reinforcement learning to post-train joint video-audio generation models requires a reward signal. Existing methods construct this reward by combining metrics for individual quality dimensions, including audio quality, visual fidelity, and synchronization. However, these metrics evaluate perceptual dimensions separately and fail to capture the overall semantic and temporal coherence among the text prompt, video, and audio that shapes human preferences. Optimizing models against these metrics encourages reward hacking, generating video-audio content that achieves high scores on these metrics yet appears incoherent or unfaithful to human viewers. To address this problem, we first construct a large-scale human-preference dataset VAPref-10K for joint video-audio generation, comprising 9K prompts and 10.3K fine-grained paired comparisons from open-source generation models. We also introduce the VA-Judger-Bench benchmark with both in-domain and out-of-domain model comparisons to evaluate whether reward models truly align with human preferences. We further propose VA-Judger, a chain-of-thought omni-reward model for joint video-audio generation. In particular, VA-Judger first learns from pairs with clear quality gaps to establish structured output and coarse preference discrimination, then distills reliable preference explanations for harder near-quality comparisons via rejection sampling verified against human annotations, and finally performs dimension-wise reinforcement learning that decomposes human feedback into individual quality dimensions for denser reward signals than a single binary preference label. Experiments show that VA-Judger outperforms metric baselines in predicting human preferences on both in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations. Using its human-aligned rewards for post-training audio-video generation model also yields significant improvements in generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联合视频-音频生成的后训练奖励信号问题，提出 VA-Judger，一个基于人类偏好反馈的 chain-of-thought omni-reward 模型。作者构建了大规模人类偏好数据集 VAPref-10K（9K 提示、10.3K 细粒度成对比较）和 VA-Judger-Bench 基准，并采用先粗粒度判别、再拒绝采样蒸馏、最后分维度强化学习的训练流程。实验显示 VA-Judger 在域内和域外预测人类偏好上优于基于指标的基线，并显著提升下游生成模型的生成质量。
Motivation: 现有方法通过组合音频质量、视觉保真度和同步性等单维指标构造奖励，但这些指标分别评估感知维度，无法捕捉文本、视频和音频之间的整体语义与时间连贯性，导致奖励黑客（reward hacking）和内容与人类感知不一致。
Method: 提出 VA-Judger：先在质量差距明显的样本对上学习结构化输出与粗粒度偏好判别，再通过经人类标注验证的拒绝采样（rejection sampling）蒸馏出困难近质量比较的可信偏好解释，最后进行分维度强化学习，将人类反馈分解到各质量维度以获得比二元偏好标签更稠密的奖励信号。
Result: 在域内和域外评估中，VA-Judger 预测人类偏好的性能优于基于指标的基线；用它的人类对齐奖励对音频-视频生成模型进行后训练，在生成质量上取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调人类对齐的奖励建模可以替代逐维指标组合来避免奖励黑客，并指出 VAPref-10K 数据集和 VA-Judger-Bench 基准可供社区使用，以检验奖励模型是否真正与人类偏好一致。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对联合视频-音频生成的后训练奖励信号问题，提出 VA-Judger，一个基于人类偏好反馈的 chain-of-thought omni-reward 模型。作者构建了大规模人类偏好数据集 VAPref-10K（9K 提示、10.3K 细粒度成对比较）和 VA-Judger-Bench 基准，并采用先粗粒度判别、再拒绝采样蒸馏、最后分维度强化学习的训练流程。实验显示 VA-Judger 在域内和域外预测人类偏好上优于基于指标的基线，并显著提升下游生成模型的生成质量。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法通过组合音频质量、视觉保真度和同步性等单维指标构造奖励，但这些指标分别评估感知维度，无法捕捉文本、视频和音频之间的整体语义与时间连贯性，导致奖励黑客（reward hacking）和内容与人类感知不一致。

summary_sections.result: 在域内和域外评估中，VA-Judger 预测人类偏好的性能优于基于指标的基线；用它的人类对齐奖励对音频-视频生成模型进行后训练，在生成质量上取得显著提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调人类对齐的奖励建模可以替代逐维指标组合来避免奖励黑客，并指出 VAPref-10K 数据集和 VA-Judger-Bench 基准可供社区使用，以检验奖励模型是否真正与人类偏好一致。

papers.title: Teach a Molmo2Fish: Towards interactive fish tracking with natural language guidance
authors: Sara Beery (1) ((1) Massachusetts Institute of Technology)
papers.abstract_en: Computer vision is increasingly used to automate recognition tasks in large ecological datasets, but more complex tasks such as multi-object tracking continue to pose challenges. As researchers seek to incorporate vision models in ecology workflows, various lines of research have explored how to make imperfect predictions useful through human-in-the-loop processes. We propose a new approach to working with imperfect tracking predictions through an interactive prediction correction workflow taking place as a conversation with a multimodal large language model, which we tailor to a sonar fish tracking dataset as an initial proof of concept. We investigate the performance of the tool, Molmo2Fish, across guided and unguided tasks, correcting its own predicted tracks and external tracks. We find that Molmo2Fish achieves high performance on fish tracking and track correction tasks, but there is still much room to improve on incorporating natural language guidance. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/tidalove/molmo2fish.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, to be published in Third Workshop on Computer Vision for Ecology at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Molmo2Fish，一种基于多模态大语言模型 (multimodal LLM) 的交互式预测修正工作流，用于声纳鱼类数据集中的多目标跟踪。作者通过对话形式让模型修正自身或外部的轨迹预测，并在有引导与无引导任务上评估。摘要报告其在鱼类跟踪与轨迹修正任务上表现良好，但自然语言引导的融入仍有较大提升空间。
Motivation: 生态学大数据中视觉模型的预测往往不完美，需要人工介入；现有 human-in-the-loop 流程缺乏自然交互方式。论文旨在探索用多模态大模型对话实现交互式跟踪修正，使不完美预测更易被生态学工作流使用。
Method: 提出将跟踪预测修正建模为与多模态大语言模型的对话过程，针对声纳鱼类跟踪数据定制，包含引导 (guided) 与无引导 (unguided) 任务，并可对模型自身预测轨迹与外部轨迹进行修正。
Result: 摘要报告 Molmo2Fish 在鱼类跟踪和轨迹修正任务上达到较高性能，但明确指出在融入自然语言引导方面仍有很大改进空间；未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作为概念验证，该工作展示交互式对话修正对生态学视觉任务的潜力，并指出自然语言引导是后续关键改进方向。代码和数据已公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Off-Manifold Collapse in Guided Protein Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Protein language models are widely used priors for protein sequence design, and a growing body of work controls them at inference time as an alternative to fine-tuning. Such guidance faces a dilemma: mild enough to preserve natural activation statistics, it barely moves the property; strong enough to move it, the generations become progressively harder to fold. We show the failure has a specific and cheaply detectable signature, an off-manifold collapse of the model's own representations. Guided activations fall toward a region statistically indistinguishable from random amino-acid input, and the sequences degenerate to low complexity, yet the property oracle being optimized can still score these generations as a success. The optimized oracle can therefore fail to witness the collapse and, for solubility, can actively reward it, whereas structure and composition expose the failure. Because the failure is already visible in a finished candidate, we detect it at the output rather than modify the generator. We introduce a cheap density prior over natural protein activations and keep only the candidates that remain typical under it, a training-free post-hoc step we call Mahalanobis filtering. At matched guidance settings it improves both the property score and the structural plausibility of the sequences it keeps at negligible cost, without touching the generator, and transfers across different guidance methods. We release the activation statistic at https://huggingface.co/Shuibai12138/off-manifold-collapse-plm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究蛋白质语言模型在推理时引导（inference-time guidance）下的失效模式。作者发现强引导会引起模型表示的 off-manifold collapse，引导后的激活落入与随机氨基酸输入统计上不可区分的区域，序列退化为低复杂度，而被优化的属性评分器仍可能将这些生成判为成功。为此提出训练无关的后处理步骤 Mahalanobis filtering，用自然蛋白质激活的密度先验只保留典型候选，在匹配引导设置下同时改善属性得分与结构合理性。
Motivation: 推理时引导作为微调的替代方案面临两难：温和引导几乎不改变目标属性，强引导则使生成序列越来越难以折叠。作者指出属性 oracle 无法察觉这种退化，甚至对溶解度会主动奖励 collapse，而结构与组成可以暴露失败，因此需要一种不依赖生成器的检测与筛选手段。
Method: 提出 Mahalanobis filtering：在自然蛋白质激活上建立廉价的密度先验，对已完成候选按其在先验下的典型性进行后验筛选。该步骤是 training-free 的 post-hoc 方法，不改动生成器，并可迁移到不同引导方法。
Result: 摘要报告在匹配引导设置下，Mahalanobis filtering 以可忽略不计的成本同时提升保留序列的属性得分与结构合理性，且不接触生成器。
Conclusion: 作者强调 collapse 在最终候选上即可观测，因此应在输出端检测而非修改生成器；该方法可在不同引导方法间迁移，并发布了相关激活统计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReX-Shot: Single-Image Rephotography via Geometry- and Camera-Grounded Generation
papers.abstract_en: Single-image rephotography aims to synthesize new shots of a scene from a single reference image with specified viewpoints, focal lengths, and photographic effects, which are intrinsically coupled in imaging. Existing methods typically treat these factors separately and struggle under joint control: novel-view synthesis may introduce geometric distortions under focal-length changes, while super-resolution and instruction-guided editing remain confined to 2D and cannot reliably extend detail restoration or appearance control to novel viewpoints. We attribute these limitations to imperfect single-image 3D reconstruction and the sampling limit of continuous focal-length enlargement. To reduce projection bias from geometric errors, we use implicitly transformed foundation-model features for robust target-view guidance. We further formulate focal-length enlargement as a geometry-guided super-resolution problem and exploit generative detail priors to recover details lost during sparse 3D resampling. Built on this 3D-aware generative backbone, we lift photographic-effect control from 2D filtering to 3D-aware appearance editing, preserving content consistency across viewpoints and focal lengths. These components form ReX-Shot, a geometry- and camera-grounded generative framework for single-image rephotography. To our knowledge, ReX-Shot is the first unified framework to jointly control viewpoint, focal length, and parameterized photographic effects from a single image. Experiments show that ReX-Shot outperforms representative baselines across all three controls while enabling near-real-time interactive rephotography.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReX-Shot，一个基于几何与相机约束的生成式框架，用于从单张参考图像联合控制视角、焦距和参数化摄影效果的单图重摄影 (single-image rephotography)。方法利用隐式变换的基础模型特征来减少几何误差带来的投影偏差，将焦距放大建模为几何引导的超分辨率问题，并把摄影效果控制提升为 3D 感知的外观编辑。实验表明在三类控制上优于代表性基线，并支持近实时交互。
Motivation: 现有方法通常分开处理视角、焦距和摄影效果，联合控制时会出现新视角合成在焦距变化下引入几何畸变、超分辨率和指令编辑局限于 2D 而无法可靠扩展到新视角的问题。作者将原因归结为单图 3D 重建不完善以及连续焦距放大的采样限制。
Method: 提出三部分核心设计：使用隐式变换的基础模型特征进行稳健的目标视角引导；将焦距放大表述为几何引导的超分辨率问题，并利用生成式细节先验恢复稀疏 3D 重采样过程中丢失的细节；将摄影效果控制从 2D 滤波提升到 3D 感知的外观编辑，以保持跨视角和焦距的内容一致性。
Result: 实验显示 ReX-Shot 在视角、焦距和参数化摄影效果三类控制上均优于代表性基线，并实现近实时交互式重摄影。
Conclusion: 作者称 ReX-Shot 是首个从单张图像联合控制视角、焦距和参数化摄影效果的统一框架，属于单图重摄影方向的生成式方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Infrared Universality of Collective Dynamics across Transformer and State-Space Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Whether distinct neural architectures develop common collective dynamics remains an open question. Recent analysis of Transformer language models revealed a nearly flat, weakly infrared-enhanced time-scale density of states (TDOS) associated with near-marginal long-memory dynamics. Here we test whether a closely related organization emerges in Mamba, whose selective state-space dynamics provides a fundamentally different microscopic mechanism. Mamba allows relaxation dynamics to be resolved at three levels: the intrinsic spectrum of the learned state-space generator, its input-conditioned selective rescaling, and the collective TDOS of the complete block measured from its Jacobian. These spectra are not identical: selective dynamics and the remaining block transformations substantially reorganize the microscopic relaxation hierarchy. Nevertheless, the full block develops a reproducible slow-mode continuum whose infrared sector becomes progressively better resolved with increasing sequence length. Cumulative analysis yields $ρ(λ)\simλ^β$, with the long-sequence Mamba exponent stabilizing near $β_{\rm M}\simeq-0.17$. The corresponding memory dynamics follows $K(t)\sim t^{-(1+β)}$, close to the marginal $1/t$ regime. Despite fundamentally different microscopic dynamics, Transformer full-block spectra exhibit closely related infrared organization, with representative exponents of order $β_{\rm Tr}\sim-0.1$. These results separate explicit state-space memory from collective infrared organization and show that distinct sequence architectures can develop closely related near-marginal slow-mode dynamics. They extend infrared collective organization beyond Transformers and provide an independent test of the dynamical structure described by Cognitive Field Theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不同神经架构是否发展出共同的集体动力学，聚焦于近边际长记忆行为对应的红外增强时间尺度态密度 (TDOS)。作者在 Mamba 上从三个层次解析弛豫动力学：学到的状态空间生成器固有谱、输入条件的选择性重标定、以及完整模块 Jacobian 测得的集体 TDOS，发现完整模块形成可复现的慢模连续谱，长序列 Mamba 指数稳定在 β_M≈-0.17，记忆核接近边际 1/t 行为，而 Transformer 全模块谱的红外组织也相近。
Motivation: 不同神经架构是否拥有共同的集体动力学仍属开放问题；此前对 Transformer 语言模型的分析发现近平坦且弱红外增强的 TDOS，本文想检验微观机制完全不同的选择性状态空间模型 Mamba 是否也出现类似组织。
Method: 在 Mamba 中把弛豫动力学分成三层：状态空间生成器的固有谱、输入条件选择性重标定、以及完整模块 Jacobian 测得的集体 TDOS；通过累积谱分析得到 ρ(λ)∼λ^β 并据此推算记忆动力学 K(t)∼t^{-(1+β)}，再与 Transformer 全模块谱对比。
Result: 完整模块出现可复现的慢模连续谱，且红外区随序列长度增加而更好地分辨；长序列 Mamba 指数 β_M≈-0.17，对应记忆接近 1/t 边际区；代表性 Transformer 谱指数 β_Tr∼-0.1。各层谱并不相同，选择性动力学和其余块变换显著重组了微观弛豫层级。
Conclusion: 该结果将显式状态空间记忆与集体红外组织区分开，表明不同序列架构可以形成密切相关的近边际慢模动力学，把红外集体组织从 Transformer 推广出去，并为 Cognitive Field Theory 描述的动力学结构提供了独立检验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can a Lightweight Multimodal Model Estimate LLM Reasoning Performance? A Study for Compute-Optimal Document Inference
papers.abstract_en: Uniformly allocating inference reasoning budgets to LLMs is expensive and prone to over-thinking penalties; especially in document tasks where visual layouts drive complexity. To address this, we introduce BudgetDoc, the first multimodal benchmark providing explicit supervision for model-budget-performance trade-offs across three document tasks. Using BudgetDoc, we train DRB (Document-Reasoning Balancer), an approx. 1B-parameter pre-flight estimator (SigLIP-2 + Qwen3-0.6B) that predicts ordinal model performance across budget levels, achieving a 0.753 weighted F1. When dynamically allocating reasoning budgets across five frontier models and three datasets, DRB matches or improves F1 scores compared to always-maximum-budget baselines in 9 of 15 configurations while drastically reducing cost. Finally, preliminary evaluations demonstrate DRB's potential to generalize to cross-model selection.

Conclusion: 轻量级多模态预检估计器可以有效估计 LLM 在文档推理中的性能-预算权衡，并支持成本更低的动态推理预算分配。

papers.title: FD-CanKD: Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Attention Distillation as a Refinement Prior for Compact Object Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Compact object detectors are suitable for resource-constrained visual perception, but their limited representation capacity creates an accuracy gap relative to large models. Conventional detector distillation often relies on prediction-level supervision or a single feature-alignment target, such as response, distribution, correlation, or frequency-domain matching. Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Attention Knowledge Distillation (FD-CanKD) is presented as a detector-oriented framework that transfers teacher knowledge at three complementary levels: head-level prediction supervision, relation-level non-local context transfer, and frequency-level component-selective alignment. Student features first aggregate teacher-side spatial context through cross-attention-based relation transfer, after which frequency-aware alignment preserves complementary structural and detail-sensitive cues. Under controlled Microsoft Common Objects in Context (COCO) experiments, fixed 50-epoch from-scratch comparisons show that FD-CanKD remains competitive with representative detector knowledge distillation baselines. Post-distillation continued fine-tuning further produces a stronger refinement-ready student than detector-only fine-tuning, reaching 48.87 mean average precision (mAP) at intersection-over-union thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95 (mAP50:95), 65.84 mAP50, and 53.40 mAP75 after 20 additional epochs. All distillation modules are removed after training, leaving the deployed student unchanged at 19.7M parameters. The framework is instantiated and evaluated in a controlled YOLOv12 teacher-student setting as a representative compact-detector case study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Attention Knowledge Distillation (FD-CanKD)，一种面向紧凑目标检测器的知识蒸馏框架，在 head 级预测监督、relation 级非局部上下文迁移和 frequency 级分量选择性对齐三个互补层面传递教师知识。在 COCO 上固定 50 epoch 从头训练的比较中，FD-CanKD 与代表性检测器蒸馏基线保持竞争力；继续微调 20 epoch 后达到 mAP50:95 48.87、mAP50 65.84、mAP75 53.40，部署学生模型参数为 19.7M。所有蒸馏模块在训练后被移除，部署结构不变，框架以 YOLOv12 师生设置为代表性紧凑检测器案例进行实例化与评估。
Motivation: 紧凑目标检测器受表示能力限制，与大模型相比存在精度差距，而传统检测器蒸馏常依赖预测级监督或单一特征对齐目标（如响应、分布、相关性或频域匹配），难以充分迁移教师知识。
Method: 提出 FD-CanKD 框架，包含三层互补蒸馏：head 级预测监督、基于交叉注意力 (cross-attention) 的 relation 级非局部上下文迁移，以及 frequency 级分量选择性对齐；学生特征先聚合教师侧空间上下文，再通过频率感知对齐保留结构性和细节敏感线索。
Result: 在受控 COCO 实验中，固定 50 epoch 从头训练下 FD-CanKD 与代表性检测器蒸馏基线竞争；蒸馏后继续微调 20 epoch 得到 mAP50:95 48.87、mAP50 65.84、mAP75 53.40，优于仅检测器微调。
Conclusion: FD-CanKD 可作为紧凑检测器的精炼先验 (refinement prior)，在 YOLOv12 师生设置下验证有效；蒸馏模块训练后可完全移除，部署学生参数保持 19.7M 不变。

papers.title: OmniHandwritingOCR: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs in Handwritten OCR Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as OCR systems in document and knowledge-processing pipelines, but their ability to faithfully read real handwriting remains underexplored. Existing OCR benchmarks focus largely on printed text or clean single-line inputs, leaving limited coverage of realistic handwritten OCR scenarios such as multilingual handwriting, writer errors, and structurally complex mathematical expressions. We introduce OmniHandwritingOCR, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating MLLMs and OCR systems on handwritten OCR. It covers handwritten text recognition and handwritten mathematical expression recognition across six subtasks and twelve subsets, totaling 77.57K labeled images from public datasets and newly collected student writings. A key component is a difficulty-stratified multi-line formula corpus designed to test robustness under increasing structural complexity. We evaluate thirteen open- and closed-source systems with five complementary metrics under a unified protocol. Results show that current systems remain far from faithful transcription: performance drops sharply on complex multi-line formulas, model rankings vary across language and formula settings, and several generative models hallucinate plausible but visually unsupported corrections. OmniHandwritingOCR provides a challenging testbed for diagnosing language, content, structural, and visual-grounding failure modes of multimodal models in handwritten OCR scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniHandwritingOCR，一个面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 与 OCR 系统的手写识别诊断基准，覆盖手写文本识别与手写数学表达式识别，共六个子任务、十二个子集、77.57K 张标注图像。基准包含难度分层的多行公式语料，并在统一协议下用五个互补指标评估了十三个开源与闭源系统。结果显示现有系统在手写转录上仍远非忠实，多行复杂公式上性能骤降，且若干生成模型会出现视觉上无依据的幻觉性修正。
Motivation: 现有 OCR 基准多聚焦印刷文本或干净的单行输入，对真实手写场景（如多语言手写、书写者错误、结构复杂的数学表达式）覆盖不足，而 MLLM 正越来越多地被用作文档与知识处理流水线中的 OCR 系统。
Method: 构建 OmniHandwritingOCR 基准，融合公开数据集与新收集的学生手写样本，设计六个子任务与十二个子集，并引入难度分层 (difficulty-stratified) 的多行公式语料以测试结构复杂度下的鲁棒性；在统一评测协议下使用五种互补指标对十三个开源和闭源系统进行对比评估。
Result: 摘要报告当前系统离忠实转录仍有很大差距：在复杂多行公式上性能显著下降，模型在不同语言和公式设置下的排名不一致，且多个生成模型会产生看似合理但缺乏视觉依据的幻觉性修正。
Conclusion: OmniHandwritingOCR 为诊断多模态模型在手写 OCR 场景中的语言、内容、结构与视觉接地 (visual grounding) 失效模式提供了一个具有挑战性的测试平台。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SPARC: Subspace Position-Aware Robust Few-Shot Calibration for Distribution-Shifted Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based industrial anomaly detectors are calibrated on one distribution but may be deployed on another that differs in illumination, fixture placement, or sensor characteristics, sharply degrading an otherwise accurate detector. Adapting to the incoming lot is a natural response, but labeled anomalies are scarce. We therefore consider calibration using only a handful of verified-normal images available before scoring the rest of the lot. Existing fixes require backpropagation, detector-specific tuning, or choices about feature directions that few calibration samples cannot justify. We present SPARC, a few-shot calibration method that intercepts patch features between encoder and detector and removes a closed-form, spatially indexed estimate of deployment-time nuisance through per-cell subspace projection. It needs only $k \le 8$ verified-normal images and uses the algebraic saturation rank $r{=}k{-}1$ on the encoder's native patch grid. The correction requires no gradient or weight updates and works with memory-bank, density, prototype, and mutual detectors. On the shift-prone benchmarks, SPARC improves pooled Image AUROC and AU-PRO$_{0.3}$ for all seven detectors whose image scores depend on corrected patch features by $+13.8$ and $+3.5$ percentage points (pp), respectively; on benchmarks without engineered shift, the changes are small and mixed. Controls that give competing corrections the same calibration images attribute these gains to the per-cell subspace structure rather than the images alone. Further ablations support the saturation-rank choice and characterize sensitivity to backbone and calibration conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPARC，一种用于分布偏移下工业异常检测的少样本校准方法，仅需要 k≤8 张已验证为正常的图像。SPARC 在编码器与检测器之间拦截 patch 特征，通过逐单元子空间投影去除闭式估计的部署时干扰（nuisance），无需梯度或权重更新，适用于 memory-bank、density、prototype 和 mutual 检测器。摘要报告在偏移工程基准上，对七个检测器将池化 Image AUROC 和 AU-PRO0.3 分别提升 +13.8 和 +3.5 个百分点；在无工程偏移基准上变化小而混合。
Motivation: 视觉工业异常检测器在一个分布上校准但可能部署在光照、夹具位置或传感器特性不同的另一分布上，导致精度急剧下降。标注异常稀缺，只能利用少量已验证正常图像进行校准，而现有修复需要反向传播、检测器特定调参或依赖少量样本无法支撑的特征方向选择。
Method: SPARC 在编码器与检测器之间拦截 patch 特征，并在编码器原生 patch 网格上利用代数饱和秩 r=k−1，通过逐单元子空间投影移除闭式估计的部署时干扰。该校正不需要梯度或权重更新，且与多种检测器架构兼容。
Result: 在考虑了工程偏移的基准上，对七个图像分数依赖校正后 patch 特征的检测器，池化 Image AUROC 提升 +13.8 个百分点、AU-PRO0.3 提升 +3.5 个百分点；在无工程偏移基准上变化小且方向混合。控制实验表明增益来自逐单元子空间结构而非仅校准图像；进一步消融支持饱和秩选择，并刻画了对 backbone 与校准条件的敏感性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，仅使用少量正常图像的无梯度校准即可缓解工业异常检测中的分布偏移，并指出逐单元子空间结构是收益的关键来源。

papers.title: From Storage to Access: Verifiable Activation of Parametric Knowledge in LLMs via Explicit Priming and Implicit Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) encode rich factual knowledge in their parameters, reliably recalling and verifying such knowledge remains a key bottleneck in factual question answering. Existing end-to-end methods entangle knowledge elicitation with reasoning, making it difficult to determine whether correct answers arise from parametric knowledge or the input context. To address this challenge, we propose VAKE (Verifiable Activation of Parametric KnowledgE), a two-stage reinforcement-learning framework that externalizes latent parametric knowledge through explicit Priming and transfers the acquired elicitation capability to implicit Reasoning. Given a query and an insufficient retrieved subgraph, the Priming policy explicitly inserts bridging triples as verifiable evidence, with supervision provided by rewards derived from answers generated by a separate frozen model over the augmented subgraph. Building on the policy learned during Priming, the Reasoning stage trains the model to answer from the original input, testing whether the capability acquired through explicit knowledge elicitation transfers to implicit reasoning. Experiments across seven benchmarks and models from 3B to 14B show that VAKE consistently outperforms standard baselines, including when transferring directly from HotpotQA to OOD datasets. LLM-based evaluation further shows that over 80% of the inserted triples provide factual bridging knowledge not derivable from the retrieved context, while more than half elicit knowledge inaccessible through direct prompting. These results suggest that VAKE activates latent parametric knowledge rather than copying the input context or memorizing dataset-specific associations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VAKE（Verifiable Activation of Parametric Knowledge），一个两阶段强化学习框架，用于在事实问答中显式激活并验证 LLM 的参数化知识。Priming 阶段在检索子图不足时显式插入桥接三元组作为可验证证据，并以冻结模型在增强子图上的答案生成奖励作为监督；随后 Reasoning 阶段让模型直接基于原始输入作答，检验显式知识引出能力能否迁移到隐式推理。在七个基准、3B 到 14B 规模模型上，VAKE 一致优于标准基线，并能从 HotpotQA 直接迁移到 OOD 数据集。LLM 评测显示超过 80% 的插入三元组提供了无法从检索上下文推导的事实桥接知识，超过一半引出了直接提示无法获取的知识。
Motivation: 现有端到端方法将知识引出与推理过程纠缠在一起，难以判断正确答案究竟来自参数化知识还是输入上下文，这成为事实问答可靠性的瓶颈。
Method: 提出 VAKE 两阶段强化学习框架：Priming 策略在查询和不足的检索子图之上显式插入桥接三元组作为可验证证据，奖励来自单独冻结模型在增强子图上生成的答案；随后 Reasoning 阶段基于 Priming 学到的策略，训练模型直接从原始输入作答，检验显式引出能力向隐式推理的迁移。
Result: 在七个基准和 3B 至 14B 规模模型上，VAKE 一致优于标准基线，包括从 HotpotQA 直接迁移到 OOD 数据集；LLM 评测表明超过 80% 的插入三元组提供无法从检索上下文推导的事实桥接知识，超过一半能引出直接提示无法访问的知识。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果表明 VAKE 激活的是潜在的参数化知识，而非复制输入上下文或记忆数据集特定的关联；其适用范围是检索子图不足时的事实问答知识验证。

papers.title: FACET: Preserving Source Intent and Executable State in Terminal Task Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Training terminal agents requires scalable executable supervision, yet synthesizing high-quality terminal tasks remains challenging. Each task couples an instruction, an initialized environment, a reference solution, and an executable verifier; if these artifacts are generated from inconsistent assumptions, the resulting task may be unsolvable or incorrectly evaluated. Meanwhile, multi-stage synthesis can discard the goals, dependencies, state transitions, and procedural constraints encoded in the original sources. We present FACET (Fine-grained Agentic Construction of Executable Tasks), a framework that addresses both information preservation and cross-artifact consistency. FACET reconstructs related agent skills into coherent, information-rich scenarios, then realizes and repairs the execution environment before generating the final task artifacts. The resulting container state serves as shared grounding for the instruction, solution, and verifier, while execution-based validation and targeted repair correct artifact-specific failures without unnecessarily regenerating valid components. FACET produces complex terminal tasks with dense executable checks, and successful trajectories collected from these tasks provide effective, data-efficient supervision. Fine-tuning models across multiple scales consistently improves performance on Terminal-Bench 2.1, while analyses of alternative generation schemes support the importance of environment-grounded construction for task validity and solution-verifier alignment. These results establish source-intent preservation and shared executable-state grounding as key principles for scalable terminal-task synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FACET (Fine-grained Agentic Construction of Executable Tasks)，一个面向终端智能体训练任务合成的框架。FACET 将相关智能体技能重构成连贯且信息丰富的场景，先实现并修复执行环境，再生成指令、参考答案和可执行验证器，使容器状态成为各工件共享的 grounding。执行式验证与定向修复用于纠正工件级错误，基于这些任务收集的成功轨迹可提供数据高效的监督，微调多尺度模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上持续提升性能。
Motivation: 终端智能体训练需要可扩展的可执行监督，但高质量终端任务合成困难：指令、初始化环境、参考答案和可执行验证器若来自不一致的假设，任务可能不可解或被错误评估；多阶段合成还可能丢弃原始来源中编码的目标、依赖、状态转移和过程约束。
Method: 提出 FACET 框架，先重构相关智能体技能为连贯的信息丰富场景，再实现并修复执行环境，最后生成任务工件；以容器状态作为指令、解答和验证器共享的 grounding，并通过执行式验证和定向修复纠正工件级失败，避免不必要地重新生成有效组件。
Result: 摘要报告 FACET 能生成带密集可执行检查的复杂终端任务，其成功轨迹提供数据高效的监督；在多个模型规模上微调均在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上提升性能，且对替代生成方案的分析支持环境 grounding 对任务有效性与 solution-verifier 对齐的重要性。
Conclusion: 作者将源意图保留 (source-intent preservation) 与共享可执行状态 grounding 确立为可扩展终端任务合成的关键原则。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MR-IQA-2: Faithful Image Quality Reflection via Fine-Grained Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for image quality assessment (IQA) by improving consistency between quality ratings and their underlying reasoning. However, most approaches supervise reasoning through human-provided ratings and rarely examine whether it faithfully reflects image quality. Rating accuracy alone does not ensure faithful reasoning; a shared reward also obscures supervision sources and may reinforce unfaithful reasoning when a correct rating occurs by chance. To improve the faithfulness and reliability of blind IQA, we aim to (1) decouple credit assignment for reasoning and rating and (2) provide verifiable supervision for faithful reasoning. We introduce MR-IQA-2, an actor-editor-judge framework that operationalizes reasoning-editing-reflection. The actor generates quality reasoning for an input image, and the editor revises the image according to the identified quality factors. A frozen judge compares the original and edited images and provides reflective supervision for the actor's reasoning. MR-IQA-2 further uses fine-grained credit assignment to decouple reasoning and rating supervision. Judge feedback supervises reasoning, whereas human ratings supervise the predicted rating. Masked token-specific updates distinguish these signals while preserving the causal relation from reasoning to rating. Across IQA benchmarks, MR-IQA-2 achieves competitive rating alignment with humans. Visual reflection also enables richer and more faithful visual understanding beyond rating, which may inform image-quality optimization and related downstream tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/RobinY99/MR-IQA-2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MR-IQA-2，一个面向无参考图像质量评估 (blind IQA) 的 actor-editor-judge 框架，通过思考生成、图像编辑与裁判反思来解耦推理与评分的信用分配，并用掩码 token 级更新分离两类监督信号。摘要称其在多个 IQA 基准上达到与人类评分相当的对齐，并带来超越评分的更丰富、更忠实的视觉理解。
Motivation: 现有基于多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的 IQA 方法用人类评分监督推理过程，但评分准确并不保证推理忠实；共享奖励会模糊监督来源，在正确评分偶然出现时可能强化不忠实的推理。
Method: 提出 actor-editor-judge 框架：actor 生成图像质量推理，editor 按推理中识别的质量因素编辑图像，冻结的 judge 比较原始图像与编辑图像并提供反思性监督；MR-IQA-2 进一步使用细粒度信用分配解耦推理与评分监督，法官反馈监督推理、人类评分监督预测分数，并通过掩码 token 特定更新保留从推理到评分的因果关系。
Result: 摘要报告 MR-IQA-2 在 IQA 基准上达到与人类评分一致的评级对齐；视觉反思还带来更丰富和忠实的视觉理解，可用于图像质量优化及下游任务。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将推理与评分的监督来源解耦并提供可验证的推理监督，可以提升盲 IQA 的忠实性与可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes Quantization Amplifies Proactive Interference in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Proactive interference (PI) is a documented failure mode in large language models in which retrieval of a repeatedly overwritten value degrades as prior overwrites accumulate, mirroring a classical phenomenon in human working memory. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is now the default deployment path for open-weight models, yet its effect on this failure mode has not been tested. We evaluate three precision levels (FP16, INT8, INT4/NF4, via bitsandbytes) across three architecturally distinct instruction-tuned models (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct), holding the retrieval task fixed. INT4 quantization significantly reduces accuracy under high interference in every model (e.g., from 81.0% to 68.3% for Qwen), confirmed by paired McNemar's tests ($p \le 2.6 \times 10^{-6}$) and a mixed-effects regression spanning all interference levels; INT8, often assumed safe, also carries a smaller but real penalty in two of three models. The effect is specific to semantically similar (word-type) distractors and reverses sign under a numeric control condition, and is mechanistically linked to a rise in same-key intrusion errors under INT4 (from 21.5% to 24.6% of trials, $p = 4.8 \times 10^{-7}$). A follow-up ablation shows the effect originates in the quantized transformer backbone rather than the output projection layer. These results suggest that bitsandbytes 4-bit quantization can impose an additional cost on applications relying on long, updatable, semantically dense contexts, even when aggregate benchmark accuracy appears largely unaffected. We release our code and tokenizer-verified vocabulary construction method at https://github.com/ShayanShahrabi/compress-and-forget
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and data released at https://github.com/ShayanShahrabi/compress-and-forget
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次检验后训练量化 (post-training quantization, PTQ) 对大型语言模型中主动干扰 (proactive interference, PI) 的影响。作者用 bitsandbytes 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 和 Phi-3.5-mini-instruct 三个模型上比较 FP16、INT8 和 INT4/NF4 精度，保持检索任务不变。结果发现 INT4 在高干扰条件下显著降低准确率（如 Qwen 从 81.0% 降至 68.3%），INT8 在三个模型中的两个也有较小但真实的损失，且该效应与同键侵入错误 (same-key intrusion errors) 增加相关。消融表明效应源于量化的 transformer 主干而非输出投影层。
Motivation: 主动干扰是 LLM 中已有记录的一类失效模式，即频繁覆写某值后检索该值的能力随覆写累积而下降；PTQ 已成为开放权重模型的默认部署方式，但其对这一失效模式的影响此前未被测试。
Method: 作者在固定检索任务下，对三个架构不同的指令微调模型，使用 bitsandbytes 在 FP16、INT8、INT4/NF4 三种精度下进行系统评估；采用配对 McNemar 检验与混合效应回归分析干扰水平，并通过消融实验定位效应来源为 transformer 主干还是输出投影层。
Result: INT4 量化在每模型中均显著降低高干扰下的准确率（例如 Qwen 从 81.0% 到 68.3%，配对检验 p ≤ 2.6×10⁻⁶）；INT8 在三个模型中的两个同样带来较小但真实的损失；INT4 下同键侵入错误从 21.5% 升至 24.6%（p = 4.8×10⁻⁷），且效应仅在语义相似（词类型）干扰物下出现，在数字控制条件下符号反转。
Conclusion: bitsandbytes 4-bit 量化可能对依赖长、可更新、语义密集上下文的应用造成额外成本，即使聚合基准准确率看起来基本不受影响；作者强调该效应源于量化的 transformer 主干层。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond receptive fields: sequence-pooled normalization can supply most of a sequence labeler's context
papers.abstract_en: A convolutional sequence labeler's receptive field is routinely treated as the extent of the model's usable context: it sets dilation schedules, bounds streaming horizons, and underwrites locality claims. However, we show that this can be false: when a normalization layer computes statistics from the current input along the sequence at inference, those statistics open a sequence-spanning path that bypasses the convolutional receptive field to provide global context. We derive this from the layer's Jacobian (the criterion needs no experiment), and what the path carries has a closed form. On a synthetic labeling process with computable optima, the global summary that a sequence-spanning normalization encodes already supplies almost all of what a larger receptive field would buy where labels come in long runs: a network reaching 9 positions comes within 0.009 of the whole-sequence optimum, against a near-chance bound for its reach. Closing the path, by taking the same statistics per position, multiplies what enlarging the receptive field is worth by up to an order of magnitude on simulated genomes at every difficulty level tested and on real 1000 Genomes haplotypes. The same path also confounds attribution: ablating a trained network's receptive-field-enlarging blocks severs part of the path, overstating their contribution 8.3-16.1-fold relative to retraining from scratch. The substitution of normalization for receptive field fades as labels switch more often. Where labels run long, neither the receptive-field justification nor the ablation is wrong about its numbers, but both credit the wrong component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证卷积序列标注器的感受野并不等同于其可用上下文：推理时沿序列维度统计的归一化层（sequence-spanning normalization）会开辟一条绕过卷积感受野的全局上下文路径。作者从该层的Jacobian推导出路径的存在及其封闭形式，并在合成标注过程、模拟基因组和真实1000 Genomes单倍型上检验其作用。结果发现，在标签长连续运行（long runs）的场景下，这种全局统计几乎能提供扩大感受野所能带来的绝大部分收益，同时还会严重扭曲基于消融的归因结论。
Motivation: 现有惯例把卷积序列标注器的感受野当作模型可用上下文范围的尺度，由此设定膨胀率（dilation schedule）、限制流式推理范围并支撑局部性宣称。该论文指出这一假设可能是错误的，因为推理时的归一化层统计量能在序列维度上跨越整个输入，提供与感受野无关的全局上下文。
Method: 从归一化层的Jacobian出发推导出这条序列跨越式全局路径，并给出其携带信息的封闭形式；在具有可计算最优值的合成标注过程上直接对比网络感受野与整序列最优之间的差距。随后在模拟基因组和1000 Genomes真实单倍型上，通过比较逐位置统计（关闭该路径）与扩大感受野的效果来量化该路径的贡献，并检查消融实验对感受野扩增块的归因偏差。
Result: 在合成任务中，可触及9个位置的网络在长标签运行下与整序列最优仅差0.009，而仅凭其感受野则接近随机界限；关闭该路径后，扩大感受野的收益在模拟基因组的各难度水平上提升最多达一个数量级，在真实1000 Genomes单倍型上同样如此。消融实验对感受野扩增块的贡献估计被过高了8.3-16.1倍，因为切掉这些块同时会切断该全局路径的一部分。
Conclusion: 当标签切换频率较低时，归一化提供的全局统计与扩大感受野之间存在强替代关系；感受野论证和消融结果在数字上本身不错，但都把功劳归于错误的组件，且这种替代效应在标签切换更频繁时减弱。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continual Reasoning Gym: Diagnosing and Harnessing Shared Reasoning in Continual RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) commonly post-trains reasoning models on multiple tasks, while rerunning multitask RLVR (MTRL) as new tasks are added makes capability expansion costly. We therefore study continual RLVR, which updates the existing model as each task arrives. The central question is whether a model updated this way can perform as well as a jointly trained model. To answer this question, we introduce Continual Reasoning Gym, a continual-RLVR environment that organizes text and visual reasoning tasks into five task sequences. In this setting, we identify two key observations: Sequential RLVR exhibits modest forgetting, yet its final performance remains below that of MTRL. To understand the latter, we decompose final performance and show that forgetting accounts for only part of the gap. To explain the former, we identify shared reasoning: transferable reasoning structure allows training on one task to support others on average. We therefore introduce Continual Prompt Replay (CPR), which harnesses shared reasoning to improve learning on the arriving and future tasks by replaying previous-task prompts and regenerating their responses with the current policy. On average, only CPR reaches MTRL-level performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究持续 RLVR（continual RLVR），即任务顺序到达时增量更新现有推理模型，而非重新运行多任务 RLVR。作者引入 Continual Reasoning Gym 环境，将文本与视觉推理任务组织为五个任务序列，并发现顺序 RLVR 的遗忘较轻，但最终性能仍低于多任务 RLVR（MTRL）。通过分解最终性能，作者指出遗忘只能解释部分性能差距，并识别出“共享推理”（shared reasoning）这一机制。据此提出 Continual Prompt Replay (CPR)，通过回放前序任务的提示并用当前策略重新生成响应，利用共享推理改进当前与未来任务的学习。
Motivation: 多任务 RLVR 在任务不断加入时重新训练代价高昂，因此需要研究持续 RLVR 能否让模型仅靠顺序更新就达到与联合训练相当的性能，核心问题是这种更新方式能否媲美共同训练的模型。
Method: 提出 Continual Reasoning Gym，一个包含五个文本与视觉推理任务序列的持续 RLVR 环境；在此基础上识别共享推理现象，并提出 Continual Prompt Replay (CPR)，即回放之前任务的提示并用当前策略重新生成其响应，以利用共享推理结构。
Result: 摘要报告顺序 RLVR 仅表现出适度遗忘，但最终性能仍低于 MTRL；对最终性能的分解显示遗忘仅占性能差距的一部分。平均而言，只有 CPR 能达到 MTRL 级别的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为可迁移的推理结构使训练某一任务能够在平均意义上支持其他任务，而 CPR 通过提示回放与响应再生成来利用这种共享推理，从而改善到达任务与未来任务的学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PATE-Forensics: Perception-as-Tool for Explainable Deepfake Forensics with General-Purpose MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Existing explainable deepfake forensic methods typically rely on task-adapted MLLM to jointly address detection, localization, and explanation. Inspired by agent-style tool use, we instead introduce a Perception-as-Tool paradigm and instantiate it as PATE-Forensics, which architecturally decouples detection and localization from explanation generation while coupling detection and localization as tightly as possible within a forensic perception tool. The DINOv3-based tool couples a multi-granularity detection module that integrates global, patch-level, and segment-level evidence with a cue-guided localization module by spatializing the patch-level and segment-level evidence into forgery score maps that guide dense mask prediction. The original image and forensic perception outputs produced by the tool form structured forensic context for a general-purpose MLLM, which is guided by prompt constraints to generate explanations without task-specific fine-tuning. On DDL-X Track 3, PATE-Forensics achieves the best official score of 0.89, outperforming the second-ranked team by 0.19 points. Our code is available at https://github.com/yqli00000/PATE-Forensics.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables; DDL-X Track 3, IJCAI 2026 AI Safety Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PATE-Forensics，一种基于通用多模态大模型 (MLLM) 的可解释深伪取证方法。其核心是 Perception-as-Tool 范式：将检测与定位耦合在一个基于 DINOv3 的取证感知工具中，再把原图与感知输出作为结构化上下文交给通用 MLLM，在无需任务特定微调的情况下生成解释。在 DDL-X Track 3 上取得官方最佳分数 0.89，领先第二名 0.19。
Motivation: 现有可解释深伪取证方法通常依赖任务适配的 MLLM 联合完成检测、定位和解释，架构耦合度不足且需要针对性微调。本文希望借鉴智能体工具使用思路，将感知任务与解释生成解耦，同时让检测和定位紧密耦合，以提升整体取证性能。
Method: 提出 Perception-as-Tool 范式并实例化为 PATE-Forensics。感知工具基于 DINOv3，包含多粒度检测模块（整合全局、patch 级和 segment 级证据）和线索引导的定位模块（将 patch 级和 segment 级证据空间化为伪造分数图，引导稠密掩码预测）；工具输出与原图构成结构化取证上下文，供通用 MLLM 在提示约束下生成解释，无需任务特定微调。
Result: 在 DDL-X Track 3 上，PATE-Forensics 取得官方最佳分数 0.89，比第二名团队高出 0.19 分；代码已公开。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将检测定位与解释生成在架构上解耦、同时紧密耦合检测与定位，可以凭借通用 MLLM 在不做任务微调的情况下获得领先的可解释深伪取证性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NanoSleep: A Parameter-Efficient Hybrid Temporal Convolutional Network for Single-Channel Sleep Stage Classification
papers.abstract_en: Sleep stage classification from single-channel electroencephalography (EEG) is essential for wearable and home-based sleep monitoring. However, many deep learning models achieve high accuracy at the cost of large model sizes, which limits their deployment on resource-constrained devices. In this work, we present NanoSleep, a compact hybrid temporal convolutional network for automatic sleep stage classification. NanoSleep combines a learnable Sinc-convolutional front end, a dual-branch feature extractor that fuses multi-scale temporal and spectral representations, a gated dilated temporal convolutional backbone with channel recalibration, and a conditional random field for sequence-level decoding. We further employ a weighted calibrated focal loss to address class imbalance. We evaluate NanoSleep on the Sleep-EDF and Sleep-EDF-Expanded datasets using subject-wise cross-validation. The proposed model consistently outperforms six representative baseline methods, and an ablation study confirms the contribution of each major component. These results demonstrate that NanoSleep provides an effective balance between accuracy and efficiency, making it well suited for wearable devices, home-based sleep monitoring, and resource-constrained clinical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NanoSleep，一个面向单通道脑电（EEG）睡眠阶段分类的紧凑混合时序卷积网络。模型组合了可学习的 Sinc 卷积前端、融合多尺度时域与频域表示的双分支特征提取器、带通道重校准的门控膨胀时序卷积骨干、用于序列级解码的条件随机场（CRF），并采用加权校准 focal loss 处理类别不平衡。作者在 Sleep-EDF 和 Sleep-EDF-Expanded 数据集上使用受试者级交叉验证评估，称其稳定优于六个基线方法，且消融实验验证了各主要组件的贡献。
Motivation: 可穿戴与家庭睡眠监测需要基于单通道 EEG 的高效睡眠分期，但许多深度学习模型以较大模型尺寸换取高准确率，难以部署在资源受限设备上。
Method: NanoSleep 由多个组件构成：可学习 Sinc 卷积前端、融合多尺度时域与频域表示的双分支特征提取器、带通道重校准的门控膨胀时序卷积骨干、用于序列解码的条件随机场，以及缓解类别不平衡的加权校准 focal loss。
Result: 在 Sleep-EDF 和 Sleep-EDF-Expanded 上采用受试者级交叉验证，模型一致优于六个代表性基线方法；消融研究确认了每个主要组件的贡献。
Conclusion: 模型在准确率与效率之间取得有效平衡，适合可穿戴设备、家庭睡眠监测和资源受限的临床应用场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning Topological Features of $\widehat Z$-invariants
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning and data analysis techniques have recently emerged as powerful tools for identifying patterns and formulating conjectures in mathematical research, most notably in the field of low-dimensional topology. In this paper, we initiate a systematic approach to handling mathematical data structured as (truncated) infinite $q$-series, or equivalently, infinite series of integers. To apply this data analysis pipeline, we construct a comprehensive dataset of $\widehat{Z}$-invariants (homological blocks) for plumbed 3-manifolds. We demonstrate that neural networks can reliably extract essential topological information, such as homology class and underlying graph structure, directly from the $q$-series coefficients. A central feature of our methodology is a focus on interpretability; by contrasting local gradient sensitivity with global feature relevance, we reveal that the networks learn to bypass complex topological rules in favor of specific spectral and geometric proxies. Finally, we apply this pipeline to probe homology cobordism, discovering a high-accuracy predictive relationship between the $\widehat{Z}$-invariant exponents and the Heegaard Floer $d$-invariant (correction term). These results suggest that $\widehat{Z}$-invariants capture subtle geometric information regarding cobordism equivalences, warranting a new direction for the study of quantum invariants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用机器学习系统处理以（截断）无限 q-级数形式组织的数学数据，并为此构建了 plumbed 3-流形的 \widehat{Z}-不变量（同调块）数据集。作者展示神经网络能从 q-级数系数直接提取同调类和底层图结构等拓扑信息，并通过对比局部梯度敏感性与全局特征重要性来增强可解释性。最后将该流程用于同调配边（homology cobordism）探测，发现 \widehat{Z}-不变量指数与 Heegaard Floer d-不变量（correction term）之间存在高精度预测关系。
Motivation: 低维拓扑研究中机器学习已被用于识别模式和提出猜想，但缺少系统处理无限 q-级数或整数序列这类数学数据结构的方法；本文旨在建立一套专门的数据分析与预测管线。
Method: 构建 plumbed 3-流形的 \widehat{Z}-不变量数据集，将截断无限 q-级数的系数作为神经网络输入，训练模型预测同调类与底层图结构；在可解释性层面对比局部梯度敏感性与全局特征重要性，并将同一管线迁移到同调配边性质的预测。
Result: 摘要报告神经网络能够可靠地从 q-级数系数提取关键拓扑信息，并在同调配边探测中发现 \widehat{Z}-不变量指数与 Heegaard Floer d-不变量之间存在高精度预测关系。
Conclusion: 结果表明 \widehat{Z}-不变量能够捕获关于配边等价的微妙几何信息，为量子不变量的研究提供了新方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Role of Grid Cells in Reducing Spatial Aliasing in Hippocampal Place Representations
papers.abstract_en: Spatial aliasing occurs when two or more distinct locations produce highly similar place-cell representations, primarily due to environmental symmetry or repetitive structures. This issue is most pronounced when place representations are constructed solely from boundary vector cell (BVC) inputs, because symmetric or repetitive structures can yield indistinguishable sensory patterns across multiple locations in an environment. This work introduces grid cell signals to mitigate spatial aliasing in such settings. Because grid cells contribute periodic, internally generated spatial signals that vary independently of environmental geometry, they play a key role in disambiguating perceptually identical locations. We integrate multiple modules of analytically constructed grid cells with BVC-driven place cells and show that this leads to a 94--99% reduction in spatial aliasing relative to a BVC-only baseline across three environments: an open environment without obstacles; an environment with a cross-shaped central obstacle creating high visual symmetry; and a maze environment. The greatest improvement occurs in the environment with the highest visual symmetry. These results indicate that grid cells provide information complementary to boundary-based inputs, yielding more reliable place representations in geometrically ambiguous environments.
papers.comment: IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence, Masstricht, Netherlands, June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究海马体位置表征中的空间混叠（spatial aliasing）问题，即环境中对称或重复结构导致不同位置产生相似的位置细胞表征。作者提出在仅由边界向量细胞（BVC）驱动的位置细胞表征中引入解析构造的多模块网格细胞（grid cells）信号，以区分感知上相同的位置。摘要报告在三种环境（无障碍开放环境、带十字形中央障碍的高对称环境、迷宫环境）中，混叠现象相对仅 BVC 的基线降低了 94%–99%，且在高对称环境中改善最显著。
Motivation: 当位置表征仅由边界向量细胞输入构建时，环境中的对称或重复结构会使多个位置产生难以区分的感知模式，导致空间混叠。该问题在几何模糊的环境中会削弱位置表征的可靠性，因此需要引入与环境几何无关的附加信号。
Method: 采用解析构造的多个网格细胞模块，与 BVC 驱动的位置细胞相整合；网格细胞提供周期性、内部生成且独立于环境几何的空间信号，从而对感知上相同的位置进行去混淆（disambiguate）。
Result: 在开放环境、含十字形中央障碍的高视觉对称环境以及迷宫环境三种场景下，空间混叠相对仅 BVC 的基线降低 94%–99%；最大改进出现在视觉对称性最高的环境中。
Conclusion: 结果表明网格细胞提供与基于边界的输入互补的信息，可在几何模糊环境中产生更可靠的位置表征。

papers.title: SemanticSlider3D: Training-Free Continuous Semantic Editing for 3D Objects
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained control over continuous semantic attributes of 3D objects is essential for 3D content creation, but is not well supported by conventional 3D modeling workflows or prompt-based interaction with existing generative AI tools. While slider-based methods have proven effective for fine-grained semantic control in 2D image generation, no equivalent approach exists for 3D. Extending these 2D methods to 3D is non-trivial due to challenges unique to 3D, including geometric integrity and cross-view coherence. We present SemanticSlider3D, a technique for continuous semantic attribute editing of 3D objects that requires no per-attribute training. Given a user-specified attribute, our pipeline constructs a semantic editing direction in the latent space of a state-of-the-art 3D generation model, presenting a diverse and coherent spectrum of 3D variations. A technical validation on a dataset of 50 3D object-attribute pairs shows our method was preferred by all five human assessors across variation range, consistency, 3D object quality, and attribute disentanglement, over a baseline combining a 2D slider with an image-to-3D model. An exploratory study with six participants demonstrates that SemanticSlider3D supported decision-making in 3D prototyping and was perceived as a valuable addition to existing workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SemanticSlider3D，一种无需逐属性训练即可对 3D 对象进行连续语义属性编辑的技术。该方法在 SOTA 3D 生成模型的潜空间中构造语义编辑方向，并生成多样且连贯的 3D 变体谱。技术验证显示其在 50 个 3D 对象-属性对上优于 2D slider 与 image-to-3D 模型结合的基线，探索性研究也表明该工具能支持 3D 原型设计中的决策。
Motivation: 现有 3D 建模流程和基于提示的生成式 AI 工具难以对 3D 对象进行细粒度的连续语义属性控制；2D 图像生成中的 slider 方法有效，但 3D 领域尚无对应方案，且直接扩展面临几何完整性和跨视图一致性等 3D 特有挑战。
Method: 给定用户指定的属性，无需逐属性训练，在 SOTA 3D 生成模型的潜空间中构建语义编辑方向，从而输出多样化且跨视图一致的 3D 变体光谱。
Result: 在 50 个 3D 对象-属性对的数据集上，全部五名人工评估者在变化范围、一致性、3D 对象质量和属性解耦方面均更偏好该方法，优于结合 2D slider 与 image-to-3D 模型的基线；六名参与者的探索性研究显示该方法支持 3D 原型设计中的决策。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法实现了无需训练的 3D 连续语义编辑，并被用户视为对现有工作流的有价值补充。摘要未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: MorphoGP: A Nonparametric Framework for Predicting Equilibrium Beach Profiles Under Tidal Influence
papers.abstract_en: The prediction of equilibrium beach profiles under tidal influence is of fundamental importance for sustainable coastal development, informing shoreline protection strategies and managing coastal ecosystems under changing environmental conditions. However, it remains challenging due to the highly nonlinear interactions among wave, tide, and sedimentary processes. Traditional empirical and numerical models often exhibit limited adaptability across diverse coastal environments, with especially pronounced limitations in beach systems where tidal processes are important . To improve data-driven prediction under these conditions, this study proposes MorphoGP, a unified category-specific Gaussian process framework for predicting equilibrium beach profiles (EBPs) under tidal influence. The framework first introduces a ContourCluster model based on contrastive learning to classify tide-influenced beach morphologies automatically. Within each morphological category, a specialized Gaussian process expert learns statistical associations between environmental descriptors including waves, tides, and sediments and the beach profile's shape. A Gating Net then integrates the outputs of all experts through a probabilistic weighting mechanism to produce the final prediction. Evaluated on data from over 180 beach profiles from tide-influenced coasts along the Chinese coast, MorphoGP achieves improved predictive performance compared with conventional and deep learning models, reducing the test RMSE by about 59.3\% compared with the best baseline and achieving a final RMSE of 0.297 m. The proposed framework provides a physically informed, data-driven tool for equilibrium beach-profile prediction under tidal influence and coastal management, while stronger process-level physical coupling remains an important direction for future development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MorphoGP，一个面向潮汐影响下平衡海滩剖面（equilibrium beach profile, EBP）预测的统一类别特定高斯过程（Gaussian process）框架。框架先用基于对比学习（contrastive learning）的 ContourCluster 模型自动对潮汐影响海滩形态分类，再为每个形态类别训练专门的高斯过程专家，最后由 Gating Net 以概率加权方式集成专家输出。在中国海岸 180 多条潮汐影响海滩剖面上，MorphoGP 相对最优基线将测试 RMSE 降低约 59.3%，最终 RMSE 为 0.297 m。
Motivation: 潮汐影响下平衡海滩剖面的预测对海岸可持续发展和生态管理很重要，但波、潮、沉积过程的非线性交互使其困难；传统经验模型和数值模型在不同海岸环境间的适应性有限，在潮汐过程显著的海滩系统中尤其不足。
Method: 提出 MorphoGP 框架：包含基于对比学习的 ContourCluster 模型来自动划分潮汐影响下的海滩形态类别；每个类别内训练专门的高斯过程专家，学习波、潮、沉积物等环境描述符与海滩剖面形状之间的统计关联；Gating Net 通过概率加权机制集成所有专家输出，得到最终预测。
Result: 在中国海岸潮汐影响海岸的 180 多条海滩剖面数据上，MorphoGP 比传统模型和深度学习模型取得更优的预测性能，相对最优基线将测试 RMSE 降低约 59.3%，达到 0.297 m。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架为潮汐影响下的平衡海滩剖面预测与海岸管理提供了一个物理信息增强的数据驱动工具；同时指出更强的过程级物理耦合仍是未来发展方向。

papers.title: Performance Drift Detection in Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) for IoT Environments
papers.abstract_en: Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) is a powerful cloud paradigm enabling data-driven intelligent applications in Internet of Things (IoT) environments, widely adopted across healthcare, smart homes, and industry due to its cost-effectiveness. However, the dynamic nature of IoT frequently alters data distributions, affecting MLaaS stability, while periodic MLaaS updates further introduce performance drift. Unlike traditional ML systems, MLaaS clients operate as black-box users without access to internal data or parameters, making drift detection particularly challenging. To address this, we propose a novel MLaaS Performance Drift Detection framework for IoT environments. The framework first employs an MLaaS extraction model that learns service behavior from input-output pairs and identifies prediction-influenced features. Building on this, the proposed MLaaS Performance Drift Detection (MPDD) model jointly captures variations in input data and MLaaS behavior. We further design an Adaptive-Temporal Performance Drift Detection Mechanism (APDDM) that dynamically adjusts monitoring frequency based on behavioral and data variations, enabling timely drift detection for effective service management. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that MPDD achieves up to 22-25% accuracy improvement over baseline drift detection methods. APDDM provides an average accuracy gain of approximately 4% and reduces the miss detection rate by around 9% compared to fixed-interval monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向物联网（IoT）环境下的机器学习即服务（MLaaS）场景，提出性能漂移检测框架。由于 MLaaS 客户端是黑盒用户，无法访问内部数据或参数，漂移检测尤为困难；作者先利用输入-输出对训练提取模型以学习服务行为并识别受预测影响的特征，再构建 MPDD 模型联合捕获输入数据与 MLaaS 行为变化，并设计 APDDM 机制动态调整监控频率。实验表明 MPDD 相对基线漂移检测方法最多提升 22-25% 准确率，APDDM 相比固定间隔监控平均准确率提升约 4%、漏检率降低约 9%。
Motivation: IoT 环境动态性强，数据分布频繁变化，加上周期性 MLaaS 更新会导致性能漂移；与传统 ML 系统不同，MLaaS 客户端无法访问内部数据或参数，现有漂移检测方法难以直接适用。
Method: 提出 MLaaS 性能漂移检测框架：先通过 MLaaS 提取模型从输入-输出对中学习服务行为并识别预测受影响特征；在此基础上用 MPDD 模型联合建模输入数据变化与 MLaaS 行为变化；再设计自适应时间性能漂移检测机制（APDDM），根据行为与数据变化动态调整监控频率。
Result: 在真实数据集上，MPDD 较基线漂移检测方法实现最高 22-25% 的准确率提升；APDDM 与固定间隔监控相比平均准确率提升约 4%，漏检率降低约 9%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能在黑盒 MLaaS 客户端条件下实现及时的性能漂移检测，从而支持有效的服务管理。

papers.title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Most LLM benchmarks rank models on their ability to automate work tasks. In practice, however, models are often used to assist other (human or LLM) agents. The question that drives model selection is therefore not only which model produces the best output, but which model most improves the work of another (weaker) agent. We introduce a unified framework that evaluates the capability of models to automate and augment another agent's performance. Across seven economically grounded real-world tasks, an assistant model writes assistance text for a standardized lower-capacity worker model, which produces the deliverable. In automation mode, the assistant produces the output directly. Outputs are scored through blind pairwise comparisons by an LLM judge panel with task-specific rubrics, replicated across ten runs. Rankings across the two regimes are only modestly correlated, and the automation winner loses augmentation on five of seven tasks. Assistance is not reliably positive. The unaided worker outranks every assisted condition on three tasks, and only one model's guidance beats no guidance on average. These results suggest that automation ability is an incomplete proxy for assistance quality, motivating benchmarks that evaluate models according to the roles they play in human-AI and multi-agent systems.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，用于评估 LLM 在自动化 (automation) 与增强 (augmentation) 两种模式下对另一端到端工作任务的贡献。框架中助手模型为标准化低能力工人模型撰写辅助文本，或在自动化模式下直接生成交付物，结果由 LLM 评审团按任务特定评分标准进行盲对比。摘要报告两种模式下的排名相关性较弱，自动化模式胜出的模型在七个任务中的五个上并未在增强模式下胜出，且辅助并非总是带来正向收益。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 基准大多按模型独立完成任务的能力排序，但实际中模型常被用于辅助其他人类或 LLM 代理。因此模型选择的关键问题不仅仅是哪个模型输出最好，而是哪个模型最能改善另一个较弱代理的工作表现。
Method: 构建七项基于经济学的真实世界任务，采用统一的自动化与增强评估框架：增强模式下助手模型为标准化低能力工人模型撰写辅助文本，由后者产出交付物；自动化模式下助手直接产出输出。所有输出由 LLM 评审团依据任务特定评分标准进行盲配对比较，并跨十次运行重复。
Result: 两种模式下的排名仅呈现中等程度相关；自动化模式的胜者在七个任务中的五个上未在增强模式中胜出。辅助并非总是可靠正向：在三个任务上，无辅助的工人模型排名高于所有辅助条件，且仅有一个模型的指导在平均意义上优于无指导。

papers.title: MARCUS: Missing-Aware Region Representation with Contextual Urban Signals for Rent Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal urban data has expanded the applications of urban region representation learning, such as functional zone identification and real estate appraisal, but also introduces challenges caused by data incompleteness. Existing studies usually handle missing data through imputation, treating missingness as noise while ignoring its potential semantic value. To address this issue, we propose MARCUS, a missing-aware region representation model that treats missingness as a contextual urban signal. MARCUS models missingness in three stages: Intra Learning jointly encodes observed features and missing patterns, Inter Learning estimates modality reliability to guide cross-modal interaction, and Fusion uses missing-aware and time-aware gating to generate the final region embedding. We apply MARCUS to rent prediction, a task with long-term trends and seasonal fluctuations, using real-world datasets from Sydney and New York. Experimental results show that MARCUS achieves state-of-the-art performance, reducing MAE by 51.35% on Sydney and 12.62% on New York compared with the best baselines. Additional experiments, including an imputation-based ablation study and randomized additional-missingness analysis, further demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MARCUS，一种缺失感知的区域表示模型，将数据缺失性视为具有语义价值的上下文城市信号，而非单纯噪声，并应用于租金预测。模型通过 Intra Learning、Inter Learning 和 Fusion 三阶段分别处理观测特征与缺失模式、模态可靠性估计以及缺失/时间感知门控融合。在悉尼和纽约的真实数据集上，MARCUS 相比最优基线将 MAE 分别降低 51.35% 和 12.62%。
Motivation: 多模态城市数据常存在不完整性问题，现有研究通常用插补法处理缺失，把缺失当作噪声而忽略其潜在的语义价值。
Method: 提出三阶段建模：Intra Learning 联合编码观测特征与缺失模式；Inter Learning 估计各模态可靠性以指导跨模态交互；Fusion 采用缺失感知和时间感知门控生成最终的区域嵌入（region embedding）。
Result: 在悉尼和纽约真实数据集上取得最先进性能，相比最优基线 MAE 分别降低 51.35% 和 12.62%；基于插补的消融实验和随机额外缺失分析进一步验证了方法有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将缺失性作为上下文城市信号能显著提升城市区域表示与租金预测效果，并表明该方法在额外缺失场景下仍具稳健性。

papers.title: Zero-Shot SAM2 Segmentation and Vision Transformer-Based Recognition of Elamite Cuneiform Symbols from Degraded Tablet Images
papers.abstract_en: Automated recognition of ancient cuneiform script poses a compound signal-degradation problem: the three-dimensional relief of clay tablets creates spatially varying illumination and cast shadows, surface erosion introduces structured noise that overlaps with genuine sign impressions, and severe class imbalance across 141 sign categories undermines classifier reliability. We introduce EpigraphNet, a segmentation-guided transformer pipeline evaluated on the Persepolis Fortification Archive. From 1,239 annotated tablet images, brightness-adaptive morphological preprocessing and zero-shot SAM2-Large segmentation generate clean binary symbol masks, which a fine-tuned Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16) with inverse-frequency class weighting then classifies. EpigraphNet reaches 86.41% top-1 accuracy on a 132-class benchmark, a 17.21 percentage-point gain over the strongest CNN baseline (ResNet-101, 69.20%) and 5.31-12.91% over four modern backbones (DeiT-B/16, Swin-B, ConvNeXt-B, EfficientNet-B4) under identical conditions. The full pipeline runs at approximately 18 ms per sign on an NVIDIA A100 GPU. A lower Spearman correlation between sign frequency and per-class performance indicates more balanced recognition across frequent and rare classes. Implementation is available at: github.com/r11up/sam-guided-vit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对古代楔形文字符号的自动识别问题，提出 EpigraphNet，一个分割引导的 Transformer 流水线。该流水线结合亮度自适应形态学预处理、零样本 SAM2-Large 分割和微调后的 ViT-B/16 分类器，在 Persepolis Fortification Archive 的 132 类基准上达到 86.41% 的 top-1 准确率，显著超过 CNN 基线。
Motivation: 楔形文字自动识别面临复合信号退化问题：泥板三维浮雕造成光照变化与阴影、表面侵蚀引入与真实符号重叠的结构化噪声，且 141 个符号类别存在严重类别不平衡，削弱了分类器的可靠性。
Method: 从 1,239 张标注泥板图像出发，先进行亮度自适应形态学预处理，再用零样本 SAM2-Large 分割生成干净的二进制符号掩码，最后由带逆频率类别加权的微调 ViT-B/16 进行分类，构成 EpigraphNet 流水线。
Result: EpigraphNet 在 132 类基准上达到 86.41% top-1 准确率，比最强 CNN 基线 ResNet-101（69.20%）高 17.21 个百分点，比 DeiT-B/16、Swin-B、ConvNeXt-B、EfficientNet-B4 等四个现代骨干网络高 5.31-12.91%。在 NVIDIA A100 上每个符号约 18 ms，且符号频率与每类性能的 Spearman 相关较低，表明常见与罕见类别的识别更平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分割引导的 ViT 流水线结合类别加权能有效应对楔形文字图像中的退化与类别不平衡问题。

papers.title: Bridging Search and CRM: Productionizing AI Product Research Agents for Customer Re-Engagement
papers.abstract_en: Modern e-commerce platforms often operate search, recommendation, personalization, and CRM systems independently, limiting opportunities for proactive customer re-engagement. This is particularly challenging for exploratory intents such as best smartphones or latest 5G phones, where users may leave the platform for external research before purchasing. We present a scalable, production-deployed framework that bridges search and CRM workflows through AI-powered Product Research Agents. The system identifies users with exploratory purchase intent and low engagement, conducts grounded multi-agent product research using behavioral signals, external knowledge, and enterprise catalog data, and delivers personalized recommendations through WhatsApp. We evaluate the framework in a 23-day production deployment involving approximately 15K WhatsApp notifications for mobile product discovery. The campaign achieved substantial CTR improvements over traditional WhatsApp recommendation campaigns, with evidence of secondary engagement through message forwarding and sharing. The deployment also generated downstream purchases and GMV impact, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of AI Product Research Agents for proactive customer re-engagement and end-to-end customer journey optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个生产级部署的框架，用于弥合电商平台搜索/推荐系统与 CRM 工作流之间的鸿沟。框架通过 AI 产品研究代理（Product Research Agents）识别具有探索性购买意图且参与度低的用户，基于行为信号、外部知识和企业目录数据进行多代理产品研究，并通过 WhatsApp 推送个性化推荐。23 天的生产部署涉及约 15K 条 WhatsApp 通知，CTR 相比传统推荐活动有显著提升，并产生转发、分享、下游购买及 GMV 影响。
Motivation: 电商平台通常将搜索、推荐、个性化和 CRM 系统独立运行，难以进行主动的客户再互动；对‘最佳智能手机’等探索性意图，用户可能在购买前离开平台做外部研究，现有系统缺乏衔接这些流程的机制。
Method: 提出一个规模化、生产部署的框架，通过 AI 产品研究代理连接搜索与 CRM 工作流：识别具有探索性购买意图和低参与度的用户，利用行为信号、外部知识和企业目录数据执行有依据的多代理产品研究，并通过 WhatsApp 提供个性化推荐。
Result: 在 23 天的生产部署中，系统发送约 15K 条 WhatsApp 通知用于手机产品发现；与传统 WhatsApp 推荐活动相比，CTR 有显著提升，并观察到通过消息转发和分享产生的次级参与，同时带来下游购买和 GMV 影响。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该部署证明了 AI 产品研究代理在主动客户再互动和端到端客户旅程优化方面的实际有效性，但其评估限于移动产品发现场景和 WhatsApp 渠道的短期部署。

papers.title: Evaluating and Explaining Prompt Sensitivity of LLMs Using Interactions
papers.abstract_en: The remarkable capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are often undermined by their instability. Even subtle and semantically irrelevant changes in prompts can cause dramatic fluctuations in performance, a phenomenon known as prompt sensitivity. Previous studies typically evaluate prompt sensitivity by comparing the LLM's final outputs when prompts change. However, such coarse-grained metrics fail to explain the internal reasons for prompt sensitivity. In this paper, we introduce interactions as a fine-grained tool to analyze prompt sensitivity of LLMs. Specifically, we decompose the output score of the LLM into a set of interactions. Each interaction represents a nonlinear relationship involving a set of input variables. We discover that subtle changes to prompts can trigger severe instability in interactions, even when the outputs of the LLM remain the same. To this end, we propose an Interaction-based Prompt Sensitivity (IPS) metric by quantifying changes in interactions when we introduce subtle changes to prompts. We apply the IPS metric to 50 open-source LLMs and uncover four factors that reduce the prompt sensitivity of LLMs, including supervised fine-tuning, increased model scales, dense architectures, and few-shot learning. More crucially, we discover a common mechanism by which these four factors reduce prompt sensitivity: all four factors tend to reduce the prompt sensitivity of low-order interactions (i.e., interactions involving few input variables).
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 46 pages, 48 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用交互（interactions）作为细粒度工具来分析大语言模型（LLM）的提示敏感性（prompt sensitivity）。作者将LLM的输出分数分解为一组交互，每个交互表示若干输入变量之间的非线性关系，并发现提示的细微变化即使不改变输出也会引发交互的严重不稳定。基于此提出Interaction-based Prompt Sensitivity (IPS) 指标，并在50个开源LLM上应用，识别出降低提示敏感性的四个因素及其共同机制。
Motivation: 已有研究通常通过比较提示变化后LLM的最终输出来评估提示敏感性，但这种粗粒度指标无法解释提示敏感性的内部原因。
Method: 将LLM输出分数分解为一组交互，量化提示细微变化引起的交互变化，提出IPS指标；在50个开源LLM上实证分析。
Result: 发现监督微调、增大模型规模、稠密架构和少样本学习（few-shot learning）四个因素均能降低LLM的提示敏感性，且共同机制是这些因素倾向于降低低阶交互（涉及少量输入变量的交互）的提示敏感性。
Conclusion: 交互分析为解释LLM提示敏感性提供了细粒度视角，揭示了多个去敏感化因素的统一机制。

papers.title: FinRCA-Bench: Benchmarking Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning for Financial AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to support financial operations, but their apparent reasoning performance can depend on whether they receive the right evidence. In financial reconciliation, the evidence needed for diagnosis is distributed across invoices, purchase orders, approvals, allocations, payments, ledger entries, and bank activity, linked by transactional relationships rather than textual similarity. End-to-end accuracy can therefore conflate evidence access with reasoning quality. We introduce FinRCA-Bench, a deterministic synthetic benchmark of 2,250 accounts-payable-to-bank reconciliation cases spanning 14 operational tables, including 1,500 injected failures across 15 causal categories and 750 legitimate or hard-negative cases. Root-cause labels and record-level evidence contracts are hidden from the model, allowing retrieval to be evaluated independently of answer correctness. We compare Rules/SQL, classical machine learning, dense semantic retrieval, deterministic relational expansion, and Typed Provenance Graph Retrieval (TPGR), a typed traversal restricted to persisted transaction relationships. Rules/SQL reaches 84.97% held-out exact accuracy and classical ML reaches 95.44%. Holding the reasoning model, prompt, and generation settings fixed while changing only retrieval increases macro required-record recall from 0.83% to 77.70% and exact 16-class accuracy from 2.05% to 72.44%. Structural retrieval failures outnumber reasoning failures with sufficient retrieval by 95 to 15; 254 correct predictions occur despite incomplete retrieval, and strict returned-evidence contract accuracy is only 5.72%. On FinRCA-Bench, retrieval architecture strongly shapes observed AI-system performance, and a correct root-cause label is a weak proxy for an auditable diagnosis.

papers.title: StateTrace: An Object-Centric Framework for Hidden-State Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Long Videos
papers.abstract_en: Existing VLMs have achieved strong performance in video understanding, yet they struggle with long-video spatiotemporal reasoning when target objects become invisible, often mistaking "invisible" for "unknown". We define this challenge as hidden-state spatiotemporal reasoning: inferring object states during prolonged invisible intervals from context interactions. To address this, we propose StateTrace, a novel object-centric framework that endows VideoLLMs with an explicit mechanism for hidden state reasoning in long videos. StateTrace builds a reusable spatiotemporal state memory that organizes object trajectories, inter-object relations, and state-transition events into a structured reasoning substrate. At inference time, it retrieves question-relevant state-evolution trajectories and converts them into compact reasoning cues, enabling the model to explicitly reason about why an object disappears, how its state evolves while invisible, and whether that state should persist at query time. We further build HSR-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for hidden-state reasoning, containing 1,427 video-QA samples from 1,384 unique videos. Extensive experiments across multiple VideoLLMs show that StateTrace consistently improves performance on both public benchmarks and HSR-Bench (e.g., improving VideoLLaMA3 from 39.6 to 64.2 on HSR-Bench).

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StateTrace，一个面向视频大语言模型（VideoLLM）的物体中心（object-centric）框架，用于解决长视频中目标物体长时间不可见时的隐状态时空推理（hidden-state spatiotemporal reasoning）问题。框架构建可复用的时空状态记忆，将物体轨迹、物体间关系和状态转换事件组织为结构化推理基底，并在推理时检索与问题相关的状态演化轨迹生成紧凑推理线索。作者还构建了包含 1,427 个视频问答样本的诊断基准 HSR-Bench，实验显示该方法在多个 VideoLLM 上持续提升性能。
Motivation: 现有视频大语言模型在长视频时空推理中，当目标物体变得不可见时常将“不可见”误判为“未知”，无法推断物体在长时间隐形期间的状态。作者将这一挑战定义为隐状态时空推理，并指出这是现有模型在长视频理解中的一个明显缺口。
Method: 提出 StateTrace 框架，为 VideoLLM 加入显式的隐状态推理机制：构建包含物体轨迹、物体间关系和状态转换事件的重用型时空状态记忆；推理时检索与问题相关的状态演化轨迹并转换为紧凑推理线索，使模型能显式推理物体为何消失、不可见期间状态如何演化以及查询时刻该状态是否应持续。此外还构建了 HSR-Bench 诊断基准，包含来自 1,384 个视频的 1,427 个视频问答样本。
Result: 在多个 VideoLLM 上的大量实验表明，StateTrace 在公开基准和 HSR-Bench 上均一致提升性能，例如将 VideoLLaMA3 在 HSR-Bench 上的得分从 39.6 提升到 64.2。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，为 VideoLLM 配备显式的隐状态推理机制可以使其在长视频中推理物体的隐藏状态演化，而不是简单地把不可见当作未知。论文定位是框架加基准的贡献，未在摘要中明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 8
