papers.title: Pairwise Ranking Outperforms Single-Action RL for Offline Explanation Selection: A Practical Lesson
papers.abstract_en: Industrial explainable-recommendation systems built on LLMs incur a substantial serving cost: each request triggers an LLM generation, with latency in the hundreds of milliseconds and cost that scales linearly with traffic. We separate generation from selection: explanations are produced ahead of time as a frozen candidate pool (six prompt styles, two commodity LLMs), and a small CPU-resident selector picks one at request time. The stack needs no GPU and returns in under 100 ms. Our primary benchmark is a 2,958-pair XRec Google Local subset, evaluating six offline-pool selectors (LambdaRank, PPO, GRPO, DPO, teacher-student distillation) and three KG-path selectors (random walks, edge-disjoint enumeration, MMR-reranked paths). A 300-pair MovieLens-1M split with Claude-Sonnet-4.5 references serves as an internal cross-dataset check, since no public benchmark exists for this setting. All variants use the same BERTScore-F1 protocol as XRec and G-Refer, averaged across five seeds. LambdaRank reaches F1 = 0.500 on Google Local, exceeding both G-Refer and XRec, and F1 = 0.329 on the MovieLens-1M check. With seed variance below 0.003 F1, the ordering is reliable: pairwise learning-to-rank outperforms single-action RL (PPO, GRPO, DPO), which use only one labelled candidate per rollout, leaving K-1 labels unused. The KG-path family targets a different objective: all three variants reach USR = 1.000 on Google Local and 0.997-1.000 on MovieLens-1M, since per-request path grounding yields a unique output per query, avoiding template-collapse failures affecting cached-LLM outputs. A generator-pool study comparing Claude 3 Haiku and Claude Haiku 4.5 shows small F1 shifts (0.001-0.006) while preserving selector ranking: selector and generator can be evaluated independently, though absolute F1 depends on the generator. End-to-end build cost is near $15 on commodity hardware.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向基于 LLM 的可解释推荐系统，把解释生成与选择分离：离线预生成候选解释池（六种提示风格、两个商用 LLM），请求时由一个小型 CPU 选择器在 100 ms 内选出一条，无需 GPU。在 2,958 对 Google Local XRec 子集上比较六种离线池选择器和三种 KG-path 选择器，LambdaRank 达到 F1=0.500，超过 G-Refer 与 XRec；成对排序学习优于只使用单个标注样本的单动作 RL（PPO、GRPO、DPO）。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的可解释推荐系统每次请求都触发一次 LLM 生成，延迟数百毫秒且成本随流量线性增长，工业部署代价高。
Method: 将生成与选择解耦：预先用六种提示风格和两个商用 LLM 生成冻结的候选池，再由 CPU 端选择器在请求时挑选一条解释；基准比较 LambdaRank、PPO、GRPO、DPO、师生蒸馏等离线池选择器，以及随机游走、边不相交枚举、MMR 重排路径等 KG-path 选择器，全部使用与 XRec/G-Refer 一致的 BERTScore-F1 协议并取五个种子平均。
Result: LambdaRank 在 Google Local 上 F1=0.500，超过 G-Refer 和 XRec，在 MovieLens-1M 检查集上 F1=0.329，种子方差低于 0.003 F1，排序可靠；KG-path 家族在 Google Local 上 USR=1.000，在 MovieLens-1M 上为 0.997–1.000；更换生成器只带来 0.001–0.006 的 F1 波动，端到端构建成本约 15 美元。
Conclusion: 作者给出的实用结论是：离线解释选择中成对学习排序（pairwise learning-to-rank）优于只利用一个标注样本的单动作 RL，且选择器与生成器可独立评估，但绝对 F1 依赖生成器；由于该设置没有公开基准，MovieLens-1M 子集仅作为内部跨数据集检查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
papers.abstract_en: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with multi-turn tool-calling capabilities is essential for building autonomous agents. However, progress is fundamentally limited by the reliance on full-length trajectory imitation. For tasks involving multiple order-independent sub-goals, the optimal solution space forms a vast combinatorial diamond lattice. Forcing this rich topology into monolithic trajectories causes a severe topological collapse, indiscriminately penalizing valid alternative explorations and severely degrading policy diversity. To address this, we propose DART-SD (Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation), a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from global forcing to topology-guided localized correction. DART-SD first models the execution process as a converging Interaction-State Transition Graph (ISTG), faithfully capturing the inherent diamond topology of successful and failed exploratory paths. During autonomous rollouts, the framework identifies the Critical Topological Breakpoint (CTB) and retrieves success-supported recovery references. Finally, we introduce a progressive self-distillation paradigm through CTB-guided localized supervision, ensuring that the training loss is calculated exclusively on the generated recovery steps while strictly protecting the valid reasoning prefix from destructive gradient updates. Experiments on complex multi-turn tool-calling benchmarks demonstrate that DART-SD significantly outperforms traditional full-trajectory baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多轮工具调用智能体训练中全轨迹模仿导致拓扑坍缩的问题，提出 DART-SD 框架，将执行过程建模为聚合的 Interaction-State Transition Graph (ISTG)，在自主 rollout 中识别 Critical Topological Breakpoint (CTB) 并检索成功恢复参考，最后通过 CTB 引导的局部监督进行渐进式自蒸馏，使损失只作用于生成的恢复步骤并保护有效推理前缀。实验表明该方法在复杂多轮工具调用基准上显著优于传统全轨迹基线。
Motivation: 依赖全长度轨迹模仿会破坏包含多个顺序无关子目标任务的组合最优解空间（diamond 晶格拓扑），导致拓扑坍缩，不必要地惩罚有效替代探索并降低策略多样性。
Method: 提出 DART-SD 框架：先构建 Interaction-State Transition Graph (ISTG) 捕捉成功与失败探索路径的 diamond 拓扑；在自主 rollout 中识别关键拓扑断点 (CTB) 并检索成功支持的恢复参考；再通过 CTB 引导的局部监督进行渐进式自蒸馏，训练损失仅在生成的恢复步骤上计算，避免破坏有效推理前缀。
Result: 在复杂多轮工具调用基准上，DART-SD 显著优于传统的全轨迹基线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明从全局强制到拓扑引导的局部纠正这一范式转变能有效缓解轨迹级模仿带来的拓扑坍缩问题，但未给出具体数值或更广泛场景的泛化结论。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明从全局强制到拓扑引导的局部纠正这一范式转变能有效缓解轨迹级模仿带来的拓扑坍缩问题，但未给出具体数值或更广泛场景的泛化结论。

papers.title: Prior-Conditioned Gaussian Discriminants for Generalizable AI-generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based generators have made synthetic images ubiquitous, but detectors often fail under simultaneous shifts in generator, prompt/style, and source-domain. We study AI-generated image detection as a transfer system described by training prior, frozen encoder feature space, and decision rule, and ask when classifier head training adds value beyond what is already separable in modern features. As a controlled diagnostic, we fit a prior-conditioned Gaussian discriminant ladder: closed-form heads built from first- and second-order feature statistics under nested covariance assumptions. On Percept-Lens, a unified protocol over 39 public datasets (7.1 million images), the best rung is frequently competitive with, and sometimes exceeds, released AI-generated image detector heads when matched on both prior and encoder. We further quantify strong sensitivity to the training prior, data-efficiency of moment-based heads, and representation dependence of Gaussian shift metrics, motivating (prior, encoder, head)-level reporting and stronger analytical baselines for AIGI transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把 AI 生成图像检测 (AI-generated image detection) 视为由训练先验 (training prior)、冻结编码器特征空间和决策规则构成的迁移系统，并研究分类器头训练在多大程度上能超越现代特征本身的可分性。作者提出一个先验条件的高斯判别阶梯 (prior-conditioned Gaussian discriminant ladder)，即在嵌套协方差假设下用一阶、二阶特征统计量构造闭式解分类头；在包含 39 个公开数据集、710 万图像的 Percept-Lens 统一评测协议上，最佳档位在与先验和编码器匹配时通常可与已发布的检测器头竞争，有时还超越它们。
Motivation: 扩散生成器使合成图像无处不在，但检测器在生成器、提示/风格和源域同时发生偏移时经常失效。作者想弄清在现代特征空间中数据是否已经足够可分，以及分类器头训练何时仍能带来额外价值。
Method: 提出先验条件的高斯判别阶梯作为受控诊断工具：在嵌套协方差假设下，用一阶与二阶特征统计量拟合闭式解的高斯分类头；并构建 Percept-Lens 统一协议，覆盖 39 个公开数据集共 710 万图像，用于系统比较不同 (prior, encoder, head) 组合。
Result: 在 Percept-Lens 上，最佳阶梯档位在与训练先验和编码器匹配时，常常与已发布的检测器头相当，有时甚至超过它们；此外还量化了检测对训练先验的强敏感性、基于矩的头部的高数据效率，以及高斯偏移度量对表征的依赖性。
Conclusion: 摘要主张以 (prior, encoder, head) 三层次进行报告，并提出更强的解析基线用于 AIGI 迁移评测；本文定位是受控诊断与分析，而非端到端的新检测器。

papers.title: GCNO: Gramian Chebyshev Neural Operator for Physics-Based Compression of Wireless Channels
papers.abstract_en: Large antenna arrays allow wireless systems to serve more users and achieve higher data rates, but they also make channel feedback expensive: the receiving device must repeatedly report a large complex-valued channel matrix to the base station. Most neural compressors treat this matrix like an image and replace it with a fixed-length code that only a matched neural decoder can interpret. The message therefore does not adapt to channel complexity, and changing the antenna count typically requires retraining. We ask whether a device can instead report only the few dominant propagation paths underlying each channel. We introduce the Gramian Chebyshev Neural Operator (GCNO), a physics-based, variable-rate compressor that identifies a sample-dependent set of path directions. GCNO uses receive-transmit channel structure to locate paths, a first-order Taylor correction to refine directions that fall between grid points, and least squares to recover their complex strengths. It is trained without path labels, and the base station reconstructs the channel analytically from the transmitted path tuples rather than through a learned decoder. Across three ray-traced environments, GCNO achieves better reconstruction accuracy at the same payload - or lower payload at the same accuracy - than neural feedback baselines, and transfers to unseen antenna counts without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GCNO（Gramian Chebyshev Neural Operator），一种基于物理的可变速率无线信道压缩器，它不再把信道矩阵当作图像编码成固定长度码字，而是让设备只报告每个信道对应的少数主传播路径。GCNO 利用收-发信道结构定位路径，用一阶 Taylor 修正细化位于网格点之间的方向，并通过最小二乘恢复路径的复幅度，训练无需路径标签；基站端从传输的路径元组解析重构信道，而非使用学习式解码器。在三个射线追踪环境下，GCNO 在相同负载下获得比神经反馈基线更好的重建精度，或在相同精度下使用更低负载，并且能免重训迁移到未见过的天线数。
Motivation: 大天线阵列带来更高数据速率的同时使信道反馈代价高昂，而现有神经压缩器将信道矩阵当作图像处理并输出固定长度码字，消息无法随信道复杂度自适应，改变天线数通常需要重训练。作者希望设备仅报告每条信道背后的少数主传播路径，以降低反馈开销并提升泛化性。
Method: GCNO 识别样本依赖的路径方向集：利用收-发信道结构定位路径，应用一阶 Taylor 校正细化落在网格点之间的方向，再以最小二乘恢复各路径的复强度。方法无需路径标签训练，基站端通过解析方式从传输的路径元组重构信道，而不是经过学习式解码器。
Result: 在三个射线追踪环境中，GCNO 相比神经反馈基线，在相同负载下取得更好的重建精度，或在相同精度下需要更低负载，并且能够无需重训练地迁移到未见过的天线数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调物理驱动、可变速率且无需路径标签的信道压缩可以自适应信道复杂度，并泛化到不同天线规模；其实验验证限于三个射线追踪场景，且论文本身为 22 页、含 6 图 19 表。

papers.title: Which Negatives Matter? Ask Your Text Encoder: Adaptive Similarity Margins for Dense-Caption Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Dense-caption retrieval has recently been improved by introducing segmentation, edge maps, LLM-filtered captions, and cross-modal modules into contrastive fine-tuning. However, these methods largely inherit the same InfoNCE objective, whose optimization can prematurely saturate under a strong pre-trained initialization: on dense captions, the loss falls below 10^{-3} on 80% of batches within the first epoch, while its gradient reaches exact zero in fp32 in 47% of measurements. We find that this behavior is closely related to the large number of near-duplicate captions in dense-caption benchmarks, where a few highly similar negatives remain unresolved after the easy majority has already been separated. As a remedy, we introduce HN-CLIP, which uses the text encoder's own text-text geometry to construct per-negative adaptive similarity margins. Specifically, a detached caption-similarity matrix is added to the negative logits, assigning larger margins to more similar captions without mining, synthesizing, or resampling negatives. The resulting objective requires only one caption-similarity matrix and a masked logit addition during training, with no auxiliary data, additional parameters, offline preprocessing, or inference-time overhead. Extensive experiments on four dense-caption retrieval benchmarks show that HN-CLIP improves over the strongest competitors by +2.4--+4.3 R@1 while training 2.4x faster than GOAL and 5.4x faster than StructXLIP. Moreover, the proposed objective improves all six tested fine-tuning frameworks on the in-domain benchmarks and reaches the strongest full-data baseline with only 20% of the training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对密集字幕检索（dense-caption retrieval）中对比微调目标过早饱和的问题提出 HN-CLIP。作者发现 InfoNCE 损失在强预训练初始化下于首个 epoch 便在 80% 的批次中降到 10^-3 以下，并在 47% 的测量中梯度在 fp32 下精确为零，这与数据集中大量近似重复字幕有关。HN-CLIP 利用文本编码器自身的 text-text 几何结构，为每个负样本构建自适应相似度间隔（adaptive similarity margin），无需挖掘、合成或重采样负样本。在四个密集字幕检索基准上，该方法相对最强竞争者提升 +2.4~+4.3 R@1，同时训练速度比 GOAL 快 2.4 倍、比 StructXLIP 快 5.4 倍。
Motivation: 现有密集字幕检索方法主要继承 InfoNCE 目标，但在强预训练初始化下会过早饱和，大量近似重复字幕使得容易区分的多数负样本被分离后，少数高度相似的负样本仍无法解决，限制了检索性能。
Method: HN-CLIP 将一份 detached 的字幕相似度矩阵加到负样本 logits 上，为更相似的字幕分配更大的 margin；该方法仅需一个字幕相似度矩阵和训练时的 masked logit 加法，不引入额外数据、额外参数、离线预处理或推理开销。
Result: 在四个密集字幕检索基准上，HN-CLIP 比最强竞争者提升 +2.4~+4.3 R@1，训练速度比 GOAL 快 2.4 倍、比 StructXLIP 快 5.4 倍；该目标还能改善全部六个测试的微调框架，并仅用 20% 训练数据达到最强全量数据基线。
Conclusion: 基于文本编码器几何结构的自适应相似度间隔能有效缓解 InfoNCE 的过早饱和问题，以极低的额外代价显著提升密集字幕检索效果。

papers.title: OptiModNet: A UNet-Transformer Hybrid with Grouped-Query and Channel Attention for Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Precise segmentation of the optic disc and cup is critical for the early detection and diagnosis of glaucoma. However, achieving consistently high performance across datasets while maintaining low computational requirements remains a significant challenge. In glaucoma detection, low-computation methods are crucial for enabling rapid, large-scale screening and facilitating deployment in resource-limited clinical environments. While deep learning models such as UNets, Vision Transformers (ViTs), and Diffusion models have demonstrated strong segmentation performance but these methods often come with substantial computational overhead. UNets are efficient at capturing local features but are limited in modeling global contextual information. Conversely, ViTs excel at long-range dependency modeling but are computationally intensive. Hybrid architectures, such as UNetR, which combine transformer-based encoders with UNet-style decoders, have shown improved performance but while incurring additional complexity. Considering these, in this work, we propose OptiModNet, a light weight novel hybrid architecture tailored for optic disc and cup segmentation. The model integrates diverse attention mechanisms at multiple stages of the network to enhance both local and global feature representation. We include an Aggregated Pyramid Loss that supervises predictions at multiple decoder depths, to promote better gradient flow and structural consistency. We evaluate OptiModNet on the REFUGE2 dataset for both optic disc and cup segmentation tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, exceeding existing approaches by over 2.5\%, while maintaining high efficiency with only 3.73 GFLOPs and 1.93M parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/SG1947/OptiModNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OptiModNet，一种面向视盘和视杯分割的轻量级 UNet-Transformer 混合架构，在网络多个阶段集成分组查询注意力与通道注意力以增强局部和全局特征表示，并使用 Aggregated Pyramid Loss 在多个解码器深度监督预测。在 REFUGE2 数据集上，该方法以 3.73 GFLOPs 和 1.93M 参数达到超过现有方法 2.5% 以上的分割性能，兼顾效率与精度。
Motivation: 青光眼的早期检测依赖视盘和视杯的精确分割，但现有深度学习模型（如 UNet、ViT、扩散模型）往往计算开销大；UNet 擅长局部特征但缺乏全局上下文，ViT 擅长长距离依赖但计算密集，混合架构虽有提升却增加复杂度。低计算量方法对大规模筛查和资源受限的临床环境至关重要。
Method: 提出轻量级混合架构 OptiModNet，将基于 Transformer 的编码器与 UNet 风格解码器结合，并在网络多个阶段集成分组查询注意力（Grouped-Query Attention）和通道注意力（Channel Attention），以同时提升局部与全局特征表示。训练中使用 Aggregated Pyramid Loss，在多个解码器深度监督预测，促进梯度流动和结构一致性。
Result: 在 REFUGE2 数据集上进行视盘和视杯分割评估，该方法达到 state-of-the-art 性能，超过现有方法 2.5% 以上，同时保持高效率，仅需 3.73 GFLOPs 和 1.93M 参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轻量化混合注意力架构可在保持高精度的情况下大幅降低计算需求，适合青光眼筛查和资源受限环境的部署；代码已开源。

papers.title: Cross-Modal MRI Ovary Segmentation in Endometriosis Using Unpaired TVUS Prototype Priors
papers.abstract_en: Transvaginal ultrasound (TVUS) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provide complementary information for endometriosis image analysis, yet existing studies mainly focus on single-modality analysis or disease classification, leaving cross-modal ovarian segmentation largely unexplored. In this work, to tackle the increased difficulty of ovary segmentation in MRI due to ovaries' small target size and ambiguous boundaries with surrounding pelvic structures, we propose a dual branch framework for ovary segmentation across TVUS and MRI. More specifically, by adapting MedSAM3 with TVUS-derived prototype bank, we aim to align anatomically consistent feature representations across both modalities. Extensive experiments are conducted on endometriosis-related TVUS and MRI datasets. We observe quantitative and qualitative improvements of over 5 percentage points for the proposed dual-branch approach compared with multiple state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, our ablation study shows the contribution of individual components such as the prototype bank and the importance of warm-up pretraining in the source TVUS domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对子宫内膜异位症（endometriosis）图像分析中跨模态卵巢分割缺失的问题，提出一个双分支框架，利用 TVUS 派生的原型库（prototype bank）适配 MedSAM3，从而对齐 TVUS 与 MRI 之间解剖一致的跨模态特征表示。在内异症相关 TVUS 和 MRI 数据集上的实验显示，该方法相对多个现有 SOTA 方法取得超过 5 个百分点的定量与定性提升；消融实验还表明原型库各组件以及 TVUS 源域 warm-up 预训练均有贡献。
Motivation: TVUS 与 MRI 对内异症分析提供互补信息，但已有研究主要集中于单模态分析或疾病分类，跨模态卵巢分割尚未被充分探索；且 MRI 中卵巢目标尺寸小、与周围盆腔结构边界模糊，进一步加大了分割难度。
Method: 提出双分支分割框架：通过使用 TVUS 导出的原型库对 MedSAM3 进行适配，对齐两种模态间解剖一致的特征表示，并用源域 TVUS 的 warm-up 预训练来提升跨模态迁移效果。
Result: 在内异症相关 TVUS 和 MRI 数据集上，与多个 SOTA 方法相比，该方法在定量和定性指标上均提升超过 5 个百分点；消融实验证明原型库和 warm-up 预训练各自的重要性。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用 TVUS 原型先验并适配 MedSAM3 是缓解 MRI 卵巢分割跨模态困难的有效途径，并强调源域 warm-up 预训练在其中的关键作用。摘要未讨论超出该范围的方法局限。

papers.title: Science Done on a Machine by a Machine: AI Agents in Computational Chemistry
papers.abstract_en: We are witnessing an explosion of agentic systems for computational chemistry simulations: from half a dozen in 2024 to a dozen in 2025, and the current number approaches fifty, surveyed in this Perspective as of 8 August 2026. The capabilities of these agentic systems are shifting from assisting in performing a selection of computational tasks to autonomous design and execution of \textit{in silico} experiments, their analysis, and even manuscript writing. The ultimate destination is a fully autonomous AI scientist, where the entirety of computational chemistry is performed on a machine by a machine, without human supervision. While we are not there yet, and all reported systems currently involve a human in the loop, the trend is unmistakable. Even building specialized agentic systems for computational chemistry is increasingly commoditized by generalist agents, which may in the end replace the need for the specialized ones altogether, since adding a new capability will be as easy as asking AI to do it for you. Both the explosion in their number and the very limited adoption beyond their own developers point that way, and we close this Perspective on what it leaves us to do. The speed and scale of disruption agentic systems are bringing to computational chemistry leave many of us dumbfounded about the field's future and what we should spend our efforts on, as already established specialists, teachers, and students, and we have no answer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 Perspective 综述，系统梳理截至 2026 年 8 月 8 日用于计算化学模拟的 AI 智能体 (agentic systems) 的快速扩张：数量从 2024 年的约六个、2025 年的约十二个增长到当前的近五十个。作者指出这些系统的能力正从辅助执行计算任务转向自主设计并执行 in silico 实验、结果分析和论文写作，最终目标是无需人工监督的全自主 AI 科学家 (autonomous AI scientist)。文章认为目前所有系统仍有人类参与 (human in the loop)，但趋势明显，且专业化系统正在被通用型智能体商品化。
Motivation: 计算化学领域正经历 AI 智能体带来的快速变化，令既有研究者、教师和学生对该领域的未来以及应投入精力的方向感到困惑。作者希望通过盘点现状来讨论这种颠覆性趋势带来的问题与应对方式。
Method: 论文采用 Perspective（观点/综述）形式，对截至 2026 年 8 月 8 日的近五十个计算化学智能体系统进行统计与分类，梳理其能力演变、开发与采用模式，并据此推断该领域的演进方向。
Result: 摘要报告了量化增长：智能体系统数量从 2024 年的约六个、2025 年的约十二个增至当前的近五十个；同时观察到，尽管所有系统目前仍有人类参与，其能力正从辅助任务转向自主实验设计与执行、结果分析和写作，且通用型智能体正在使专用系统的构建变得商品化。
Conclusion: 作者认为完全自主的 AI 科学家是明确但尚未实现的趋势，所有系统目前仍需人在回路；通用型智能体可能最终取代专用系统。文章没有给出明确答案，而是以'这给我们留下了什么任务'这一问题收束。

papers.title: UMER: Unifying Embedding and Ranking via Pair-Aware Discriminative Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Universal multimodal retrieval aims to support diverse instruction-aware retrieval tasks, demanding both efficient corpus-scale matching and fine-grained semantic reasoning. Recent MLLM-based embedding methods typically derive representations from hidden states, while Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning is emerging as a promising strategy for embedding enhancement by encoding intermediate semantic evidence into the representation space. However, existing CoT methods typically use item-wise reasoning over queries and candidates in isolation, providing no explicit evidence to distinguish a positive from a semantically confusable hard negative. Moreover, contrastive embeddings capture global similarity but struggle with meta-tasks requiring answer verification, category judgment or fine-grained reasoning. In this paper, we propose UMER, a Unified Multimodal Embedding and Ranking framework for universal multimodal retrieval. UMER replaces item-wise reflection with Pair-Aware Discriminative Reasoning, which compares query--candidate pairs to identify instruction-relevant matching and discrepancy evidence. UMER jointly learns contrastive embeddings for efficient global matching and discriminative ranking for explicit pairwise relevance judgment within a single MLLM. A complementary mutual distillation strategy further transfers reliable pairwise preferences between the embedding and ranking functions. On the MMEB-V2 benchmark, UMER achieves state-of-the-art performance under comparable experimental settings while supporting budget-adjustable inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UMER，一个面向通用多模态检索 (universal multimodal retrieval) 的统一嵌入与排序框架。UMER 用 Pair-Aware Discriminative Reasoning 替代单独对查询和候选进行推理的方式，显式比较查询-候选对以找出与指令相关的匹配与差异证据。框架在同一个多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 中联合学习用于全局匹配的对比嵌入 (contrastive embedding) 和用于显式成对相关性判断的判别式排序，并通过互补互蒸馏在两者间传递可靠的成对偏好。在 MMEB-V2 基准上，UMER 在可比实验设置下达到最先进性能，并支持可调节推理预算。
Motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的嵌入方法通常只对查询和候选做孤立的逐项 (item-wise) 推理，无法提供区分正例与语义混淆困难负例的显式证据；同时，对比嵌入擅长捕捉全局相似度，却难以胜任需要答案验证、类别判断或细粒度推理的元任务。
Method: UMER 提出 Pair-Aware Discriminative Reasoning，将查询-候选对进行比较以识别与指令相关的匹配与差异证据；在单一 MLLM 内联合学习对比嵌入与判别式排序，并采用互补互蒸馏策略将可靠的成对偏好从排序函数迁移到嵌入函数，反之亦然。
Result: 在 MMEB-V2 基准上，UMER 在可比实验设置下取得最先进性能，同时支持预算可调节 (budget-adjustable) 的推理。
Conclusion: 作者认为，用成对判别式推理代替逐项反思，并将全局匹配的嵌入学习与显式成对排序结合，能够有效提升通用多模态检索中细粒度语义判断的能力。

papers.title: LLM-Powered Predictive Decision-Making for Sustainable Data Center Operations
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for AI-driven workloads, particularly from Large Language Models (LLMs), has raised concerns about the significant energy and resource consumption in data centers. This work introduces a novel LLM-based predictive scheduling system designed to enhance operational efficiency while reducing the environmental impact of data centers. Our system utilizes an LLM to predict key metrics such as execution time and energy consumption from source code, and it has the potential to extend to other sustainability-focused metrics like water usage for cooling and carbon emissions, provided the data center can track such data. The predictive model is followed by a real-time scheduling algorithm that allocates GPU resources, aiming to improve sustainability by optimizing both energy consumption and queuing delays. With fast inference times, the ability to generalize across diverse task types, and minimal data requirements for training, our approach offers a practical solution for data center scheduling. This framework demonstrates strong potential for advancing sustainability objectives in AI-driven infrastructure. Through our collaboration with a data center, we achieved a 32% reduction in energy consumption and a 30% decrease in waiting time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的预测性调度系统，用于提升数据中心运营效率并降低环境影响。系统利用LLM从源代码预测执行时间和能耗等关键指标，再通过实时调度算法分配GPU资源，以同时优化能耗和排队延迟。作者与数据中心合作，报告实现了32%的能耗降低和30%的等待时间减少。
Motivation: AI驱动的工作负载（尤其是LLM）快速增长，使数据中心的能源和资源消耗问题日益突出，需要在实际运营中兼顾效率和可持续性。
Method: 系统先由LLM根据源代码预测执行时间、能耗等指标，并声称可扩展到冷却水耗和碳排放等可持续性指标；预测结果随后输入实时调度算法，用于GPU资源分配，目标是同时优化能耗与排队延迟。
Result: 摘要报告在与数据中心的合作中实现了32%的能耗降低和30%的等待时间减少，并强调该方法推理速度快、能泛化到多种任务类型且训练数据需求低。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为AI驱动基础设施中的可持续性目标提供了实用方案，但其扩展到水耗、碳排放等指标依赖于数据中心能够追踪相关数据。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Tianmu-TC: Physics-constraints Generative Artificial Intelligence for Global Tropical Cyclone Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Tropical cyclones (TCs) pose severe risks from strong winds and heavy rainfall. However, forecasting their track and intensity remains challenging due to chaotic atmosphere and the rapid amplification of initial condition errors, leading to growing forecast uncertainty. While numerical weather prediction (NWP) and deep learning models have made progress, they remain computationally demanding and often fail under complex meteorological scenarios. Here, we present Tianmu-TC, a physics-constraints generative framework for global TC forecasting. Trained on Western North Pacific data, Tianmu-TC leverages physics-constraints to generate controllable outputs with reduced uncertainty thus improving forecast reliability. Experiments show Tianmu-TC outperforms deterministic and ensemble meteorological artificial intelligence models and authoritative NWP systems such as ECMWF in global ocean basins, with significantly lower computational cost. We further show Tianmu-TC performs well in challenging scenarios such as data sparsity, anomaly tracks, rapid intensification and weakening. These findings suggest physics-constraints generative AI offers a promising approach for reliable, efficient global TC forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tianmu-TC，一个带物理约束的生成式人工智能框架，用于全球热带气旋（TC）路径和强度预报。模型基于西太平洋海域数据训练，通过物理约束生成可控输出并降低预报不确定性。实验表明，Tianmu-TC 在多个全球海洋流域上优于确定性和集合式气象人工智能模型以及 ECMWF 等权威数值天气预报（NWP）系统，且计算成本显著更低；在数据稀疏、异常路径、快速增强和快速减弱等困难场景中也表现良好。
Motivation: 热带气旋预报因大气混沌性和初值误差的快速放大而面临严重不确定性，而现有 NWP 和深度学习模型计算成本高，且在复杂气象情景下常常失效，需要更可靠且高效的全球 TC 预报方法。
Method: 提出 Tianmu-TC，一种物理约束（physics-constraints）生成式人工智能框架，利用物理约束生成可控输出以降低预报不确定性，从而提升预报可靠性。
Result: 在多个全球海洋流域上，Tianmu-TC 优于确定性和集合气象人工智能模型以及 ECMWF 等权威 NWP 系统，且计算成本显著更低；在数据稀疏、异常路径、快速增强和快速减弱等挑战场景中也表现良好。
Conclusion: 作者认为物理约束生成式 AI 为可靠、高效的全球热带气旋预报提供了一条有前景的技术路径；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限。

papers.title: DyG$^2$T: Modeling Object Dynamics with 3D Gaussian Temporal-Spatial Particle Graph Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Modeling object dynamics from limited visual observations is a fundamental problem for enabling accurate motion trajectory prediction in embodied interaction scenarios. Existing dynamics modeling methods first compress reconstructed particle representations into sparse Key Points and model their evolution using locally constrained interactions, thereby discarding fine-grained local details and obscuring discriminative interaction modeling across spatial and temporal scales, leading to drifting trajectories and inaccurate appearance prediction. To tackle these issues, we propose DyG$^2$T, a dynamics modeling framework that infers object motion trajectories by spatially completing and temporally discriminating Key Point representations and modeling multi-scale interaction over particle graphs. Spatially, DyG$^2$T enriches each Key Point by aggregating neighboring raw particle positions to recover fine-grained local details, while explicitly encoding relative offsets among Key Points to enhance geometric structure perception. Temporally, we introduce a Temporal Disentangling Network (TDN) to identify dominant cross-frame variations in latent space and amplify inter-frame differences, yielding temporally discriminative representations that are subsequently aggregated via Temporal Attention to capture frame-wise temporal evolution cues. For comprehensive interaction modeling, a Particle Graph Transformer leverages global attention to preserve discriminative long-range dependencies among Key Points, mitigating representation homogenization induced by locality-constrained modeling and providing a robust basis for accurate trajectory prediction. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that DyG$^2$T achieves accurate dynamics modeling and reasoning, and exhibits strong cross-object and real-world generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DyG^2T，一个面向具身交互场景中物体运动轨迹预测的动力学建模框架，用 3D 高斯时-空粒子图 Transformer 对 Key Point 表示进行空间补全与时间判别，并在粒子图上建模多尺度交互。摘要报告该方法在合成和真实数据集上取得准确的运动建模与推理，并具有较强的跨物体和真实世界泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有动力学建模方法先把重建的粒子表示压缩为稀疏 Key Points，再用局部受限的相互作用建模其演化，这会丢失细粒度局部细节并模糊跨时空尺度的判别性交互，导致轨迹漂移和外观预测不准确。
Method: 空间上，DyG^2T 通过聚合邻近原始粒子位置来丰富每个 Key Point 的局部细节，并显式编码 Key Points 间的相对偏移以增强几何结构感知；时间上引入 Temporal Disentangling Network (TDN) 在隐空间分离主导的跨帧变化并放大帧间差异，再经 Temporal Attention 聚合帧级时间演化线索；最后用 Particle Graph Transformer 的全局注意力保留 Key Points 间的长程依赖，缓解局部约束建模导致的表示同质化。
Result: 摘要称在合成和真实世界数据集上的实验表明该方法能够实现准确的动力学建模与推理，并展现出良好的跨物体和真实世界泛化能力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合空间补全、时间判别表示和全局注意力可以为准确轨迹预测提供稳健基础，并缓解局部受限建模带来的表示同质化问题；摘要未明确说明方法局限。

papers.title: Physics-Unrolled Neural Operator for Wireless Field Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Radio maps are essential for wireless decision-making tasks such as access-point placement, coverage planning, and localization, but their fine spatial details are governed by complex propagation effects and are costly to simulate accurately. Machine learning offers a path to high-fidelity radio-map prediction without running expensive high-fidelity simulations for every scene. However, generating high-quality training labels at scale is also difficult: the affordable labels come from finite-ray simulations, which are richer than low-fidelity inputs but carry residual Monte Carlo noise. We address this challenge with Physics-Unrolled Hybrid Neural Operator (PU-HNO), a three-stage cascade that predicts high-fidelity indoor radio maps from low-fidelity ray-tracing outputs and scene priors by progressively capturing reflection, diffraction, and scattering effects, rather than treating radio maps as generic images. We prove that, under conditionally unbiased label noise, the model can learn stable propagation structure and outperform its own training labels. Experiments across diverse floorplans show that PU-HNO outperforms image-to-image baselines, wireless learning models, and monolithic neural operators across both image-quality and wireless deployment metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Physics-Unrolled Hybrid Neural Operator (PU-HNO)，一个三阶段级联模型，用于从低精度射线追踪输出和场景先验中预测高保真室内无线电地图，逐步捕捉反射、衍射和散射效应，而不是将无线电地图当作普通图像处理。作者证明在条件无偏的标签噪声下，模型可以学习稳定的传播结构并超越其训练标签。跨多种楼层平面图的实验显示，PU-HNO 在图像质量和无线部署指标上优于图像到图像基线、无线学习模型和单体神经算子。
Motivation: 无线电地图对无线决策任务至关重要，但高保真模拟成本高昂；机器学习可在不逐场景运行昂贵模拟的情况下预测无线电地图，但大规模高质量标签难以获得，低成本标签来自有限射线模拟，带有残余蒙特卡洛噪声。
Method: 提出 PU-HNO，一种三阶段级联混合神经算子，利用场景先验和低精度射线追踪输出，逐步建模反射、衍射和散射，并给出在条件无偏标签噪声下可学习稳定传播结构的理论证明。
Result: 实验表明 PU-HNO 在多种楼层平面图上，相比图像到图像基线、无线学习模型和单体神经算子，在图像质量和无线部署指标上均表现更好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过显式建模物理传播效应而非通用图像处理，可以有效从带噪标签中学习高保真无线电地图。

papers.title: WhiteMatter: All-to-All Cross-Layer Connections via KV Mixing
papers.abstract_en: In a Transformer, each layer attends to past tokens only through KV produced at its own depth, despite the presence of deeper representations during autoregressive decoding. Feedback architectures allow shallow consumer layers to attend to KV produced by deeper past-token representations, but give all consumer layers the same fixed connection patterns to source layers. We propose WhiteMatter, which connects every attention layer to the representations from all layers of each past token, with connection weights that can vary across consumer layers and adapt to the source token. For each token, a router implements these connections by mixing its $L$ layer states into $k$ KV channels that are cached for subsequent tokens; each consumer layer attends to one of the channels. The number of channels $k$ controls the KV-cache size. Setting $k<L$ reduces the cache's memory footprint. In our pretraining experiments, WhiteMatter outperforms a vanilla Transformer with 50% more layers and retains most of this gain with a 50% KV-cache compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WhiteMatter，一种让 Transformer 的每个注意力层都能访问每个 past token 的所有层表示的架构。通过一个 router 将 token 的 L 个层状态混合为 k 个 KV channel 并缓存，每个消费层（consumer layer）只关注其中一个 channel；k 直接控制 KV-cache 大小，k<L 时可减小缓存占用。预训练实验表明，WhiteMatter 优于层数多 50% 的 vanilla Transformer，并且在 50% KV-cache 压缩下仍保留大部分收益。
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 中每层只能关注自身深度产生的 KV，无法利用自回归解码时已存在的更深层表示；已有的 feedback 架构虽允许浅层消费深层 KV，但给所有消费层施加了相同的固定连接模式，缺乏灵活性。
Method: WhiteMatter 将每个注意力层与每个 past token 的所有层表示相连，连接权重可随消费层变化并适应源 token。具体地，router 将每个 token 的 L 个层状态混合成 k 个 KV channel 并缓存，每个消费层关注其中一个 channel，通道数 k 决定 KV-cache 大小。
Result: 预训练实验中，WhiteMatter 超过了层数多 50% 的 vanilla Transformer，并且在将 KV-cache 压缩 50% 时仍保留大部分性能提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过设置 k<L 可以减小 KV-cache 的内存占用，表明灵活的全对全跨层连接结合 KV channel 混合能在提升模型性能的同时控制缓存成本。

papers.title: Partition the Support, Reconstruct the Residual: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Video Generation and World Models
papers.abstract_en: Training-free block-sparse attention can accelerate video transformers, but row-wise attention concentration does not by itself specify an executable sparse operator. Queries sharing a block route may have poorly overlapping supports, while retained attention mass alone does not determine the post-softmax error from skipped interactions. We show that partition geometry affects both pooled support and the predictability of the remaining residual from the sparse output. We introduce SparsePR, which combines Response-Coupled Partitioning with Probe-Fitted Residual Reconstruction. Sampled-query key responses form paired K/V groups, whose centroids induce query-response coordinates for shared routing. A small set of exact query rows then calibrates a call-specific affine correction from the sparse output within the output subspace observed in the probe residuals. Across four heterogeneous video generation and world models, SparsePR consistently reduces attention-reconstruction error. Ablations show that probe fitting accounts for most of this reduction, while response-coupled partitioning lowers hard-drop error and improves reconstruction under a finite probe budget. SparsePR preserves generation quality at 22.0-26.0% realized executed-pair density while achieving 1.48x-2.61x end-to-end speedups. Project page: https://pardistaghavi.github.io/SparsePR-website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的块稀疏注意力方法 SparsePR，用于加速视频生成和世界模型中的 Transformer。方法结合响应耦合分区 (Response-Coupled Partitioning) 与探针拟合残差重建 (Probe-Fitted Residual Reconstruction)，在两个异构视频生成和世界模型上降低注意力重建误差，并在 22.0–26.0% 的实际执行配对密度下保持生成质量，实现 1.48x–2.61x 端到端加速。
Motivation: 现有无训练块稀疏注意力虽然能加速视频 Transformer，但行方向注意力集中本身并未指定可执行的稀疏算子：共享块路由的查询可能支持集重叠很差，仅保留注意力质量无法决定跳过交互带来的 softmax 后误差。作者指出分区几何同时影响池化支持集和从稀疏输出预测剩余残差的可预测性。
Method: SparsePR 包含两个组件：响应耦合分区通过采样查询的键响应形成配对的 K/V 组，以质心诱导查询-响应坐标用于共享路由；探针拟合残差重建则用少量精确查询行校准一个逐调用 (call-specific) 的仿射校正，在探针残差中观察到的输出子空间内从稀疏输出重建残差。
Result: 在四个异构视频生成和世界模型上，SparsePR 持续降低注意力重建误差。消融表明探针拟合贡献了大部分误差降低，响应耦合分区则降低硬丢弃误差并在有限探针预算下改善重建。方法在 22.0–26.0% 的实际执行配对密度下保持生成质量，并实现 1.48x–2.61x 端到端加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分区几何与残差可预测性的耦合是稀疏注意力设计的关键因素，SparsePR 以训练无需方式在保持生成质量的同时实现视频 Transformer 的显著加速。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Coverage-Driven RTL Assertion Generation with Formal Exploration and Neuro-Symbolic Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Hardware functional verification relies on high-quality assertions to expose design bugs and establish confidence in Register Transfer Level (RTL) designs. Yet existing assertion mining methods still struggle to produce complete and reliable assertion sets: random or limited traces fail to cover hard-to-reach behaviors, and one-shot generation provides little feedback about what remains unverified or how the assertion set should be improved. As a result, critical design behaviors can remain uncovered even when many assertions are generated. We present NeuroAssertion, a coverage-driven assertion generation framework that combines formal trace generation, syntax-guided synthesis (SyGuS), and an agent-inspired refinement process within a unified framework. Our framework first converts hard-to-reach control-flow conditions into formal reachability objectives, uses model checking to generate behaviorally diverse traces, and mines initial assertions from these traces with SyGuS. It then performs targeted agent-inspired refinement under verification feedback: one LLM first proposes candidate assertions for uncovered regions, and if a candidate fails formal checking, a second LLM generates a repair grammar that guides constrained symbolic synthesis in a neuro-symbolic repair procedure. Experimental results show that this framework delivers around 2X more assertions and about 2X higher mutation coverage than traditional assertion mining methods.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有断言挖掘方法难以生成完整可靠的断言集：随机或有限迹无法覆盖难以到达的行为，一次性生成缺乏关于哪些行为仍未验证或如何改进断言集的反馈，导致即便生成大量断言，关键设计行为仍可能未被覆盖。
Method: 提出 NeuroAssertion 统一框架：将难达控制流条件转为形式化可达性目标，用模型检验生成行为多样的迹，并用 SyGuS 从迹中挖掘初始断言；随后在验证反馈下进行 agent-inspired 细化，由第一个 LLM 对未覆盖区域提议候选断言，候选若未通过形式化检查，则由第二个 LLM 生成修复语法，引导约束下的符号综合进行神经符号化修复。
Result: 实验结果显示，与传统断言挖掘方法相比，该框架生成约 2 倍数量的断言，并达到约 2 倍的突变覆盖率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调覆盖率驱动的形式化迹生成与神经符号化反馈细化相结合，可以有效提升 RTL 断言生成的完整性。

papers.title: COSTA: A Cluster-Centric Paradigm for Annotation-Free Open-Set Semantic Segmentation of Aerial Point Clouds with Domain Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation of aerial point cloud is trapped in a generalization crisis under distinct domain shifts. While test-time adaptation offers a privacy-preserving and computationally efficient way to adapt pre-trained models to unlabeled target-domain data during inference, existing methods, bound to closed-set label assumptions and non-scalable point-wise segmentation pipelines, still struggle with semantic shifts. We ask: can we adapt any given pre-trained aerial point cloud segmentation model to a shifted target domain at the inference phase alone, without additional training, while segmenting target-specific categories beyond the source label space on demand? This paper introduces COSTA, which breaks this limitation by shifting from closed-set point-wise adaptation to cluster-centric open-set semantic propagation. Our core discovery is that, once effectively adapted at test time, the rich feature distribution of aerial point clouds can be distilled into a compact set of well-separated semantic centroids that are transferable across label spaces. COSTA leverages this to reformulate open-set semantic segmentation as a cluster-level propagating process: it first bridges the domain gap through proven test-time adaptation, then groups each batch of target-domain points into a small set of semantic clusters based on the similarity distribution in the adapted feature space, and finally propagates high-confidence pseudo labels obtained from an open-vocabulary vision-language model to all points through cluster-level voting. This cluster-centric paradigm enables test-time adaptation of aerial point clouds under significant domain gaps with mixed semantic shifts. With DALES as the source domain, COSTA enables on-demand segmentation across three aerial point cloud benchmarks with distinct domains and heterogeneous category spaces, achieving up to 70.09% mIoU under this new setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COSTA，一种以聚类为中心的开放集语义分割范式，用于在领域偏移下对航空点云进行语义分割。核心发现是，经过有效测试时适应后，航空点云的特征分布可被提炼为一组可跨标签空间迁移的语义质心；COSTA 据此把开放集分割转化为聚类级传播：先用测试时适应桥接领域差距，再将目标域点聚为语义簇，最后通过聚类级投票将开放词汇视觉语言模型的高置信伪标签传播到所有点。以 DALES 为源域时，COSTA 在三个领域和类别空间异构的航空点云基准上实现了按需分割，最高 mIoU 达 70.09%。
Motivation: 航空点云语义分割在显著领域偏移下存在泛化危机；现有测试时适应方法受闭集标签假设和非可扩展的逐点分割流程限制，难以处理语义移位。
Method: COSTA 将闭集逐点适应重构为聚类中心的开放集语义传播：首先利用已有测试时适应方法桥接领域差距，然后依据适应后特征空间的相似度分布将每批目标域点分组为少量语义簇，最后通过聚类级投票把开放词汇视觉语言模型得到的高置信伪标签传播到所有点。
Result: 以 DALES 为源域，COSTA 在三个具有不同领域和异构类别空间的航空点云基准上实现了按需开放集分割，最高达到 70.09% mIoU。
Conclusion: 作者认为该聚类中心范式使得在显著领域差异和混合语义移位条件下，预训练模型仅靠推理阶段就能完成空中点云的测试时适应与开放集分割，无需额外训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ERASE: EaRly bAckpropagation SchEdule for Faster Training of Modern Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight proxy models enable rapid experimentation without repeatedly training frontier-scale systems, but their small kernels often leave modern accelerators underutilized. Conventional training compounds this inefficiency by scheduling the forward and backward passes as disjoint phases, so spare capacity in one cannot be filled by work from the other. We reinterpret the detachment mechanism of Forward-Forward (FF) as a scheduling primitive: given a local objective, detaching a block's output removes downstream gradient dependencies, making its backward pass ready when its forward pass finishes. ERASE launches each detached subgraph's backward pass early on a separate CUDA stream, overlapping it with subsequent forward work. Execution trace on a lightweight transformer demonstrates this overlap and its limit: a kernel that saturates the device leaves no capacity for concurrency. On a large-scale click-through-rate model, detaching six dense subarchitectures improves training throughput by up to $9.51\%$ while keeping normalized entropy close to the baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ERASE，一种把 Forward-Forward (FF) 的 detachment 机制重新解释为调度原语的方法，用于加速现代推荐系统训练。通过在独立 CUDA stream 上提前启动每个被 detach 子图的 backward pass，并与后续 forward 计算重叠，该方法在大型点击率模型上最高提升训练吞吐 9.51%，同时保持 normalized entropy 接近基线。轻量 Transformer 的执行轨迹展示了重叠效果及其极限。
Motivation: 轻量代理模型的小核常让现代加速器利用不足，而传统训练将 forward 和 backward 调度为不相交的阶段，导致一个阶段的空闲算力无法被另一个阶段的工作填补。作者针对这一调度空隙提出解决方案。
Method: 将 Forward-Forward (FF) 的 detachment 机制重新解释为调度原语：给定局部目标时，detach 某块的输出会移除下游梯度依赖，使该块的 backward pass 在其 forward 完成后即可就绪。ERASE 在独立 CUDA stream 上提前启动每个 detached 子图的 backward pass，与后续 forward 工作重叠执行。
Result: 在执行轨迹中，轻量 Transformer 展示了这种重叠及其上限：当单个核已占满设备时没有并发空间。在大型点击率 (click-through-rate) 模型上，detach 六个稠密子架构使训练吞吐提升最高 9.51%，同时 normalized entropy 保持在接近基线的水平。
Conclusion: 摘要表明将 detachment 当作调度原语可以在不明显损害模型质量的前提下提升训练吞吐，但并发收益受限于设备饱和度。

papers.title: Atrial Fibrillation Detection with Arbitrary Leads via a Codebook-Based Reconstruction-Classification Framework
papers.abstract_en: \textbf{Background and Objective}: Reliable atrial fibrillation (AF) detection from electrocardiogram (ECG) signals remains challenging in real-world clinical settings due to variable lead configurations, cross-dataset domain shifts, and pervasive physiological and technical artifacts. So we develop a robust and generalizable deep learning model for accurate AF detection.\\ \textbf{Methods}: We propose the Dual-Codebook Graph Collaborative Network (DCGCNet), a novel end-to-end vector-quantized variational autoencoder that jointly performs AF classification and ECG reconstruction. DCGCNet introduces two key components: (1) a Local-Global Contrastive Module for learning noise-invariant representations, and (2) an Adaptive Codebook Vector Quantizer that dynamically refines codebook prototypes to better align with input data distributions, thereby preventing codebook collapse and enhancing generalization.\\ \textbf{Results}: DCGCNet achieves state-of-the-art performance in standard intra-dataset 12-lead evaluation and demonstrates exceptional cross-dataset generalization across seven diverse settings, consistently attaining AUC > 0.98 in all cases. Furthermore, it maintains high diagnostic accuracy under realistic noisy conditions, including baseline wander, powerline interference, and EMG artifacts.\\ \textbf{Conclusions}: DCGCNet establishes a new benchmark for robust, generalizable, and noise-resilient AF detection, showing strong potential for deployment in real-world clinical environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DCGCNet（Dual-Codebook Graph Collaborative Network），一个端到端的向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）框架，联合进行房颤（AF）分类与 ECG 重建。模型包含局部-全局对比模块（Local-Global Contrastive Module）和自适应码本向量量化器（Adaptive Codebook Vector Quantizer），前者用于学习抗噪表征，后者动态细化码本原型以避免码本崩溃。摘要报告其在标准 12 导联数据集上达到最先进性能，在七个跨数据集设置中 AUC 均大于 0.98，并在基线漂移、电源干扰和 EMG 伪影等噪声条件下保持高诊断精度。
Motivation: 真实临床场景中 ECG 的导联配置多变、跨数据集存在域偏移，且生理与技术伪影普遍存在，使得可靠的房颤检测仍然具有挑战性。
Method: 提出 DCGCNet，一种联合房颤分类和 ECG 重建的端到端向量量化变分自编码器；引入 Local-Global Contrastive Module 学习噪声不变表征，并通过 Adaptive Codebook Vector Quantizer 动态调整码本原型以对齐输入数据分布，防止码本崩溃并提升泛化能力。
Result: 在标准数据集内的 12 导联评估中取得最先进性能；在七个不同的跨数据集设置中均达到 AUC > 0.98；在基线漂移、电源干扰和 EMG 伪影等真实噪声条件下仍保持较高诊断准确率。
Conclusion: DCGCNet 为鲁棒、可泛化且抗噪声的房颤检测建立了新基准，并显示出在真实临床环境中部署的潜力。

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Agent Feature Selection for Personalized Fall Risk Prevention
papers.abstract_en: Falls among older adults represent a major public health challenge driven by complex, time-varying interactions across multiple risk domains. Effective fall risk factor identification requires learning from heterogeneous longitudinal data while accounting for sparse and delayed fall-related outcome events. However, existing approaches are largely static and fail to adaptively model evolving, individualized risk factors across modalities and time. We propose PAFIR, a Personalized and Adaptive Feature selection framework for fall risk Identification and pRevention, which formulates adaptive feature selection as a reinforcement learning problem over longitudinal multimodal health data. PAFIR jointly models structural dependencies among correlated assessment variables and temporal dynamics in wearable-derived physical activity data, and learns adaptive selection policies across repeated study visits using reward signals derived from sparse fall incidence outcomes. We apply PAFIR to data from the Physio fEedback Exercise pRogram (PEER) cluster-randomized trial. Experimental results demonstrate that PAFIR more effectively captures longitudinal and structural patterns of feature relevance than state-of-the-art baselines, and enables dynamic, subject-specific feature selection. By adapting selected features over time, PAFIR supports more timely and personalized fall prevention strategies.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 10 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PAFIR，一个基于强化学习的自适应特征选择框架，用于从纵向多模态健康数据中识别跌倒风险因素。该方法在 PEER 整群随机试验数据上验证，能建模评估变量间的结构依赖与可穿戴设备活动数据的时间动态，并根据稀疏跌倒结局信号学习逐次随访的自适应选择策略。实验表明其比现有基线更好地捕捉纵向与结构特征相关性，支持个性化、动态的跌倒预防。
Motivation: 老年人跌倒由多领域复杂时变交互驱动，现有风险因素识别方法多为静态，难以跨模态与时间自适应建模个体化风险因素，且需要处理稀疏、延迟的跌倒结局事件。
Method: PAFIR 将自适应特征选择建模为纵向多模态健康数据上的强化学习问题，联合建模相关评估变量的结构依赖和可穿戴衍生活动数据的时间动态，并利用稀疏跌倒结局信号推导奖励来学习跨多次研究随访的自适应选择策略。
Result: 在 PEER 整群随机试验数据上，实验结果表明 PAFIR 比最先进基线更能捕获特征相关性的纵向与结构模式，并实现动态、个体特异性的特征选择。
Conclusion: 通过随时间自适应调整所选特征，PAFIR 支持更及时和个性化的跌倒预防策略。

summary_sections.method: PAFIR 将自适应特征选择建模为纵向多模态健康数据上的强化学习问题，联合建模相关评估变量的结构依赖和可穿戴衍生活动数据的时间动态，并利用稀疏跌倒结局信号推导奖励来学习跨多次研究随访的自适应选择策略。
summary_sections.result: 在 PEER 整群随机试验数据上，实验结果表明 PAFIR 比最先进基线更能捕获特征相关性的纵向与结构模式，并实现动态、个体特异性的特征选择。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过随时间自适应调整所选特征，PAFIR 支持更及时和个性化的跌倒预防策略。

papers.title: Formal Verification of Romanov's Triplet Logic: A Verified Filter for Sliding-window 3-CNF with Application to Structured Formulas
papers.abstract_en: We present the first mechanised formalisation of Romanov's Triplet Logic (TLS) in the Rocq proof assistant. TLS is a triplet-based combinatorial framework for reasoning about compatible paths through layered triplet structures, called Compact Triplets Structures (CTS), and their intersection via Romanov's Effective Procedure, which we refer to as Simple Vertex Intersection (SVI). Originally motivated by Boolean satisfiability, TLS constitutes a self-contained mathematical theory whose formal properties had not been previously established. We formalise the core of TLS in Rocq, including Compact Triplets Formulas (CTF), CTS, hyperstructures, clearing, and SVI. For the well-formed sliding-window fragment we verify a clause-by-clause CNF-to-CTF translation, the clearing procedure, and aligned intersection, and we prove explicit polynomial-time bounds for the filter stages. Our main contribution is a precise correctness boundary: the existence of a joint satisfying set implies non-emptiness of SVI, but the converse does not hold in general; for aligned structures we recover a complete bi-implication, extended to systems of structures. We also formalise soundness of grouped-window translation and exhibit a formal counterexample to its completeness. We introduce VFR, an extracted OCaml prototype that provides a verified decision procedure for the sliding-window fragment and a sound one-sided filter for general 3-CNF, with a Python runtime and reproducible Docker packaging. Benchmarks on random and structured instances confirm the predicted behaviour, and the complete toolchain is available as a curated Zenodo artifact. The Rocq development comprises more than 23,000 lines of code across seventeen files, with 427 proved lemmas and theorems and zero admitted goals.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables, 3 listings, 16 bibliographic references, more than 23,000 lines of Rocq code across 17 files, with 427 proved lemmas and theorems and zero admitted goals
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在 Rocq 证明助手中对 Romanov 三元逻辑 (Triplet Logic, TLS) 做了机械化形式化。TLS 是一种基于三元组的组合框架，用于推理分层三元结构 (Compact Triplets Structures, CTS) 中的兼容路径及其经由 Simple Vertex Intersection (SVI) 的交集。作者形式化了 CTF、CTS、超结构、clearing 与 SVI 的核心内容，并为良构滑动窗口片段验证了逐子句的 CNF-to-CTF 翻译、clearing 过程和对齐交集，同时证明了过滤阶段的显式多项式时间界。主要贡献是给出了精确的正确性边界：联合可满足集的存在蕴含 SVI 非空，但反向一般不成立；在对齐结构上恢复了完整的双向蕴含。
Motivation: TLS 起源于布尔可满足性问题，但此前其形式性质从未被建立；该论文针对的是这套自足数学理论缺乏机械化验证、以及 3-CNF 过滤算法正确性边界不精确的问题。
Method: 在 Rocq 中形式化 TLS 核心（CTF、CTS、超结构、clearing 与 SVI），对良构滑动窗口片段验证逐子句 CNF-to-CTF 翻译、clearing 过程与对齐交集，并证明显式多项式时间界；同时引入 VFR，一个提取自形式化证明的 OCaml 原型，为滑动窗口片段提供验证过的判定过程，为一般 3-CNF 提供可靠的单侧过滤器，配有 Python 运行时与 Docker 打包。
Result: 证明联合可满足集的存在蕴含 SVI 非空，但反向一般不成立；对于对齐结构可恢复完整的双向蕴含并推广到结构系统。还形式化了分组窗口翻译的可靠性，并给出其完备性的形式化反例。Rocq 开发包含 17 个文件、超过 23,000 行代码、427 条已证明引理与定理，且零 admitted goals；随机与结构化实例上的基准测试确认了预期行为。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作的核心是一侧过滤方法在一般情况下的可靠性与仅在对齐结构上可达的完备性精确边界，并通过完全验证的工具链 VFR 为滑动窗口片段提供判定过程、为一般 3-CNF 提供可靠的过滤过程。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Pedagogical AI in Mental Health: A Tri-Stream Fine-Tuned LLM Framework for Automated Clinical Supervision and Risk Triage
papers.abstract_en: Modern mental healthcare faces a critical shortage of senior supervisory oversight, leading to a "supervision gap" where novice therapists manage high-stakes risks with delayed professional feedback. This paper proposes a new framework utilizing a fine-tuned Mistral-7B-instruct model as an automated "Supervisor-in-the-Loop" system. By leveraging 106 sessions from the DAIC-WOZ dataset, the model performs a tri-stream analysis: (1) Therapeutic Alliance tracking via semantic adherence, (2) Latent risk prediction using attention-weighted analytics, and (3) Supervisory Triage via a Dynamic Clinical Urgency Index (D-CUI). Our multi-modal VAL (Visual-Acoustic-Linguistic) framework achieves 95% technique identification accuracy [95% CI: 75.1%-99.9%], alliance assessment MAE of 0.105 on a 5-point scale [95% CI: 0.059-0.151], therapeutic fidelity alpha = 0.423, and mean D-CUI of 0.370 [95% CI: 0.322-0.419]. Training converged in 105 steps with 85.2% loss reduction on a single Tesla T4 GPU. The system reduces supervisory triage latency from 72 hours to real time (~10 seconds per session), enabling proactive intervention in high-risk cases. The system addresses the cold-start problem through Bayesian priors and implements timestamp-based modality synchronization for robust multi-modal fusion.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted for publication in AICTC 2026, Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems, vol. 2165, Springer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于微调 Mistral-7B-instruct 的自动"Supervisor-in-the-Loop"框架，利用 DAIC-WOZ 数据集的106个会话进行三流分析：治疗联盟追踪、潜在风险预测和基于动态临床紧迫指数（D-CUI）的监督分流。摘要报告技术识别准确率95%、5点量表上联盟评估 MAE 0.105、平均 D-CUI 0.370，并将监督分流延迟从72小时降至约每会话10秒。系统还通过贝叶斯先验处理冷启动问题，并实现基于时间戳的多模态同步。
Motivation: 现代心理健康护理缺乏资深督导师的监督，新手治疗师在高风险场景中只能获得延迟的专业反馈，形成了所谓的"监督缺口"（supervision gap）。
Method: 采用微调后的 Mistral-7B-instruct 模型，构建多模态 VAL（Visual-Acoustic-Linguistic）框架，执行三流分析：基于语义一致性的治疗联盟追踪、注意力加权的潜在风险预测，以及通过 D-CUI 进行临床紧迫度分级；同时使用贝叶斯先验缓解冷启动，并用时间戳同步实现稳健的多模态融合。
Result: 摘要报告技术识别准确率95% [95% CI: 75.1%-99.9%]，联盟评估 MAE 0.105 [95% CI: 0.059-0.151]，治疗保真度 alpha=0.423，平均 D-CUI 0.370 [95% CI: 0.322-0.419]；训练在单张 Tesla T4 GPU 上105步收敛、损失降低85.2%，监督分流延迟从72小时降至实时（约10秒/会话）。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该系统可将监督分流从延迟反馈变为实时处理，支持对高风险案例的主动干预，并同时解决冷启动与多模态同步问题。

papers.title: The Embodiment Gap in Robot Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Robot foundation models (RFMs), including vision-language-action (VLA) policies, are often discussed through a scaling view: more data, larger models, and broader benchmarks should improve generalization. In robotics, however, a model can generalize while work still remains before it can run on a robot with a particular body. The work required differs across methods and target robots, and those differences affect practical deployment. We call the gap between reusable models, representations, or data and their use in execution on the target robot the embodiment gap. This survey examines what can be reused across robot embodiments and what must still be implemented on a new robot. We place existing methods on a two-axis map that shows the type of shared structure and the stage at which adaptation is needed for execution on the target robot. We then examine recent work through three overlapping research directions: sharing semantics and perception, sharing robot data and interfaces, and learning correspondence across embodiments. We also propose a reporting framework for adaptation work that success rate alone does not reveal. The framework identifies the work that should be checked when comparing cross-embodiment learning and highlights work that remains on a new robot and questions for future study.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 4 figures. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), August 2026
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, August 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于机器人基础模型（robot foundation models, RFMs）的综述，提出“具身差距”（embodiment gap）这一概念，指可复用模型、表征或数据与在目标机器人上实际执行之间仍需要完成的工作。作者用一张两轴图对现有方法分类，从共享语义与感知、共享机器人数据与接口、跨具身对应学习三个方向梳理近期工作，并提出一个报告框架，用于揭示成功率之外仍需在新型机器人上实现的适配工作量。
Motivation: 机器人基础模型常被放在缩放视角下讨论，即更多数据、更大模型和更广基准应带来更好的泛化；但实际中模型即便泛化，距离开跑在特定形态的机器人上仍有差距，且这种差距因方法和目标机器人而异，影响实际部署。本文旨在系统刻画并分析这一被忽视的“具身差距”。
Method: 作为综述，作者提出两轴分类图，一轴表示共享结构的类型，另一轴表示在目标机器人上执行所需适配发生的阶段；并从共享语义与感知、共享机器人数据与接口、跨具身对应学习三个重叠方向审视现有工作。此外提出一个适配工作报告框架，补充成功率之外的评估维度。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值；主要结果是概念化框架与分类体系，即用两轴图组织现有跨具身方法，并识别在新型机器人上仍需检查的适配工作以及未来研究问题。
Conclusion: 摘要强调仅靠成功率无法揭示跨具身学习中的适配工作量，所提报告框架可用于比较不同方法并指出部署新机器人时还需完成的工作，并为后续研究提出开放问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Process Optimization Under Uncertainty for Improving the Bond Quality of Polymer Filaments in Fused Filament Fabrication
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a computational framework to optimize the process parameters such that the bond quality between extruded polymer filaments is maximized in fused filament fabrication (FFF). A transient heat transfer analysis providing an estimate of the temperature profile of the filaments is coupled with a sintering neck growth model to assess the bond quality that occurs at the interfaces between adjacent filaments. Predicting the variability in the FFF process is essential for achieving proactive quality control of the manufactured part; however, the models used to predict the variability are affected by assumptions and approximations. This paper systematically quantifies the uncertainty in the bond quality model prediction due to various sources of uncertainty, both aleatory and epistemic, and includes the uncertainty and the model discrepancy in the process parameter optimization. Variance-based sensitivity analysis based on Sobol indices is used to quantify the relative contributions of the different uncertainty sources to the uncertainty in the bond quality. A Gaussian process (GP) surrogate model is constructed to compute and include the model discrepancy within the optimization. Physical experiments are conducted for calibration and validation of the physics model and also for validation of the optimum solution. The results show that the proposed formulation for process parameter optimization under uncertainty results in high bond quality between adjoining filaments of the FFF product.
papers.comment: 12 pages, ASME Journal of Manufacturing Science and Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对熔融沉积成型（FFF）中聚合物丝材间界面结合质量，建立了一个过程参数优化框架，将瞬态传热分析得到的丝材温度场与烧结颈生长模型耦合来评估结合质量。作者系统量化了模型预测中的随机性（aleatory）与认知性（epistemic）两类不确定性，并将不确定性和模型偏差（model discrepancy）纳入过程参数优化。方差基敏感性分析（Sobol indices）用于区分各不确定性来源的贡献，高斯过程（GP）代理模型用于在优化中计入模型偏差，并通过物理实验进行标定与验证。结果表明，所提出的不确定性下的参数优化方案能使FFF相邻丝材获得较高的结合质量。
Motivation: 实现FFF制件的主动质量控制需要预测工艺变异性，但现有变异预测模型受假设与近似的影响。论文指出，结合质量预测中的不确定性来源需要被系统量化，并在过程参数优化中一并考虑，否则优化结果无法真实反映工艺波动。
Method: 将瞬态传热分析与烧结颈增长模型耦合，以温度场估计丝材间的结合质量；利用基于Sobol指数的方差敏感性分析量化随机与认知不确定性来源的相对贡献；构建高斯过程（GP）代理模型用于计算并在优化中纳入模型偏差；开展物理实验对物理模型和最优解进行标定与验证。
Result: 摘要报告，在不确定性下进行过程参数优化的公式化方法能够使FFF产品相邻丝材之间获得较高的结合质量，且该最优解经过物理实验验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在过程参数优化中显式纳入不确定性及模型偏差，可以提升FFF丝材间结合质量，并通过实验验证了所提出框架的有效性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对熔融沉积成型（FFF）中聚合物丝材间界面结合质量，建立了一个过程参数优化框架，将瞬态传热分析得到的丝材温度场与烧结颈生长模型耦合来评估结合质量。作者系统量化了模型预测中的随机性（aleatory）与认知性（epistemic）两类不确定性，并将不确定性和模型偏差（model discrepancy）纳入过程参数优化。方差基敏感性分析（Sobol indices）用于区分各不确定性来源的贡献，高斯过程（GP）代理模型用于在优化中计入模型偏差，并通过物理实验进行标定与验证。结果表明，所提出的不确定性下的参数优化方案能使FFF相邻丝材获得较高的结合质量。

papers.title: Multi-Level Bayesian Calibration of a Multi-Component Dynamic System Model
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a multi-level Bayesian calibration approach that fuses information from heterogeneous sources and accounts for uncertainties in modeling and measurements for time-dependent multi-component systems. The developed methodology has two elements: quantifying the uncertainty at component and system levels, by fusing all available information, and corrected model prediction. A multi-level Bayesian calibration approach is developed to estimate component-level and system-level parameters using measurement data that are obtained at different time instances for different system components. Such heterogeneous data are consumed in a sequential manner, and an iterative strategy is developed to calibrate the parameters at the two levels. This calibration strategy is implemented for two scenarios: offline and online. The offline calibration uses data that is collected over all the time-steps, whereas online calibration is performed in real-time as new measurements are obtained at each time-step. Analysis models and observation data for the thermo-mechanical behavior of gas turbine engine rotor blades are used to analyze the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多层贝叶斯校准 (multi-level Bayesian calibration) 方法，用于融合异构数据源并量化建模与测量不确定性，从而校准时变多组件动态系统的组件级和系统级参数。方法按顺序消费不同时间点、不同组件的测量数据，并采用迭代策略在两个层级间交替校准；同时给出了离线 (offline) 与在线 (online) 两种校准场景。作者用燃气轮机转子叶片的热机械行为分析模型与观测数据验证了该方法的效果。
Motivation: 多组件动态系统的校准需要同时处理组件级与系统级参数，且测量数据往往来自不同组件、不同时间点，具有异构性；现有方法难以在统一框架下融合这些信息并同时考虑建模和测量不确定性。
Method: 提出多层贝叶斯校准方法，包含两个要素：在组件级和系统级融合所有可得信息以量化不确定性，以及修正后的模型预测。异构数据被顺序消费，并开发了迭代策略来交替估计两个层级的参数；校准流程分别以离线方式（使用全部时间步数据）和在线方式（每个新测量到达时实时更新）实现。
Result: 摘要未报告定量数值结果，仅说明通过燃气轮机发动机转子叶片的热机械行为分析模型和观测数据来评估所提方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法能够在离线与在线场景下对多组件动态系统进行多层贝叶斯校准，通过融合异构测量数据同时处理组件级和系统级不确定性并修正模型预测。

papers.title: Multi-Objective Optimization Under Uncertainty of Part Quality in Fused Filament Fabrication
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a data-driven methodology for multi-objective optimization under uncertainty of process parameters in the fused filament fabrication (FFF) process. The proposed approach optimizes the process parameters with the objectives of minimizing the geometric inaccuracy and maximizing the filament bond quality of the manufactured part. First, experiments are conducted to collect data pertaining to the part quality. Then, Bayesian neural network (BNN) models are constructed to predict the geometric inaccuracy and bond quality as functions of the process parameters. The BNN model captures the model uncertainty caused by the lack of knowledge about model parameters (neuron weights) and the input variability due to the intrinsic randomness in the input parameters. Using the stochastic predictions from these models, different robustness-based design optimization formulations are investigated, wherein process parameters such as nozzle temperature, nozzle speed, and layer thickness are optimized under uncertainty for different multi-objective scenarios. Epistemic uncertainty in the prediction model and the aleatory uncertainty in the input is considered in the optimization. Finally, Pareto surfaces are constructed to estimate the tradeoffs between the objectives. Both the BNN models and the effectiveness of the proposed optimization methodology are validated using the actual manufacturing of the parts.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的多目标不确定性优化方法，用于熔融沉积成型（FFF）工艺参数的优化。研究以最小化几何不准确度和最大化丝材粘结质量为目标，构建贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）模型预测质量指标并量化不确定性，在优化中同时考虑认知不确定性和输入参数的偶然不确定性，最后通过实际制造验证模型和优化方法的有效性。
Motivation: FFF 制件的质量受工艺参数影响且存在多种不确定性来源，需要在多个相互冲突的质量目标之间进行权衡，同时处理模型参数不确定性和输入参数随机性。
Method: 该方法先通过实验采集制件质量数据，再用贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）建立几何不准确度和粘结质量关于工艺参数的随机预测模型；基于随机预测结果，针对喷嘴温度、喷嘴速度和层厚等工艺参数考察多种基于鲁棒性的多目标设计优化公式，并构造 Pareto 曲面描述目标间的折中关系。
Result: 摘要报告 BNN 模型与所提出的优化方法均通过实际制件制造得到验证，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 本文表明结合 BNN 的不确定性量化与多目标优化可以在 FFF 工艺参数空间中评估几何精度和粘结质量之间的权衡；研究范围限定于 FFF 工艺及所考察的工艺参数。

papers.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents now execute bounded tasks reliably. Whether they can sustain effective decision-making over long horizons, where actions have cumulative consequences and the environment responds to their choices, remains largely unmeasured. FM-Bench (Football Management Benchmark) measures this. An LLM agent runs a football club for 20 in-game years through 26 tools and roughly 340 to 400 decision stops. It drafts a squad on the same budget as every rival, trades players, negotiates contracts, invests in facilities and youth, sets lineups, and answers to a board that can fire it, while a deterministic engine accumulates every year into one final score with no LLM judge or human rater. The solo track plays each of 15 frontier models against a frozen scripted world, and the Arena places the same models plus a scripted anchor in one shared 20-year world; to our knowledge, the first head-to-head evaluation at this scale. We measure six behavioral capabilities behind the score. Across three seeds, all 15 models complete every horizon while the blind scripted baselines die out in most of theirs, and claude-fable-5 tops the solo board on mean score and the Arena, where the title nonetheless rotates among ten models. Neither scale, price, nor vendor predicts the order; the order settles only late in the horizon, and the best first-play human lands only at the bottom of the model board. What separates the models is managerial behavior rather than computation. Higher-scoring models reduce slow-payoff investment near the end, keep cash invested rather than idle, and open renewals well before the deadline, while token spend predicts nothing. No model learns the market's hidden prices from hundreds of rejected bids, and self-managed memory fails in two opposite modes: an archive that only grows or a plan rewritten every season. Code is available at https://github.com/Analogy-AI/fm-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FM-Bench 是一个面向长时域管理决策的基准，让 LLM 智能体通过 26 个工具在 20 个游戏年内运营一支足球俱乐部，经历约 340 到 400 次决策节点，并以确定性引擎累计出唯一最终分数。摘要报告对 15 个前沿模型在单机赛道和共享世界的 Arena 赛道进行了评估，所有模型均完成整个时域而脚本化基线大多中途破产，且表现差异主要由管理行为而非计算量或 token 花费解释。
Motivation: 现有语言模型智能体在有限时域任务上已可靠，但其能否在行动后果累积、环境会对选择做出响应的长时域中维持有效决策，仍缺乏系统度量。
Method: FM-Bench 让 LLM 智能体以与对手相同的预算组建阵容、交易球员、谈判合同、投资设施与青训、设定阵容并对董事会负责，同时用确定性引擎逐年累积分数，不依赖 LLM 评判或人工打分；包含面对冻结脚本世界的 solo 赛道，以及 15 个模型加脚本锚点共享同一 20 年世界的 Arena 赛道，并测量分数背后的六种行为能力。
Result: 在三个随机种子下，15 个模型全部完成每个时域，而盲脚本基线在多数时域中破产；claude-fable-5 在 solo 平均分和 Arena 中领先，但冠军在十个模型间轮换。规模、价格和供应商均不能预测排名，排名到后期才稳定；高分模型倾向在接近结束时减少迟回报投资、保持现金运作并提前开启续约，而 token 花费与表现无关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调区分模型的是管理行为而非计算能力：没有任何模型能从数百次被拒报价中习得市场隐藏价格，自管理记忆则在两种相反模式下失效——只增不减的档案或每赛季重写的计划。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Structure-Aware Numerical Reasoning in LLaMA 3.1 8B
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong numerical sequence modeling capabilities and show promise in time-series prediction. While LLMs display in-context learning capabilities, the mechanisms with which they accomplish time-series prediction remain unclear. Specifically, whether they truly understand the underlying structure, which at a minimum requires reasoning over first differences in the sequence of numbers. To study this, we investigate Llama 3.1-8B from a mechanistic interpretability point of view. Mechanistic interpretability is an emerging field concerned with the reverse engineering of the algorithms learned by neural networks such as LLMs. To assess Llamas' numerical sequence modeling capabilities and to facilitate our mechanistic interpretability analysis, we create a sequence modeling task that cannot be solved without picking up structural cues. Specifically, we sample n random numbers and repeat them with an offset. We find that Llama displays strong performance on our tasks suggesting that it can pick up on the underlying structure. To understand the mechanisms that allow it to do so, we perform probing experiments and activation patching based counterfactual analysis. Probing reveals that the model computes and stores first differences in its internal representations without explicit supervision, indicating that it tracks structural information about the sequence. Activation patching reveals that Llama retrieves the relevant first-difference with a mechanism similar to an induction circuit and subsequently adds it to the current value. Notably, our work represents one of the first studies to identify this form of concept induction in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从机械可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 角度研究 Llama 3.1-8B 的数值序列建模能力，重点考察模型是否真正理解序列结构，即至少需要对相邻数的一阶差分 (first differences) 进行推理。作者构造了一个必须捕捉结构线索才能解决的序列任务：采样 n 个随机数并加偏移重复。结果显示 Llama 在该任务上表现强，探测 (probing) 发现模型在无显式监督的情况下于内部表示中计算并存储一阶差分，激活修补 (activation patching) 则表明模型通过类似归纳电路 (induction circuit) 的机制检索相关一阶差分并加到当前值上。
Motivation: LLM 在数值序列建模和时间序列预测上表现出潜力并具有上下文学习能力，但其完成时间序列预测的具体机制尚不清晰；作者希望检验模型是否真正理解底层结构，而不是仅做表面模式匹配。
Method: 构造随机数加偏移重复的序列建模任务，使任务无法仅靠表面线索解决；随后对 Llama 3.1-8B 进行探测实验和基于激活修补的反事实分析，以定位内部表征和计算路径。
Result: Llama 在该结构化序列任务上表现强劲；探测实验显示模型在内部表示中无监督地计算和存储一阶差分，激活修补显示其以类似归纳电路的机制获取相关一阶差分并将其加到当前数值上。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是最早识别 LLM 中此类概念归纳 (concept induction) 机制的研究之一，说明模型确实在追踪序列的结构信息；该机制层面的发现主要针对通用数值序列，未涉及具体应用领域。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这是最早识别 LLM 中此类概念归纳 (concept induction) 机制的研究之一，说明模型确实在追踪序列的结构信息；该机制层面的发现主要针对通用数值序列，未涉及具体应用领域。

papers.title: The Road Taken: The Role of Optimizers at the Edge of Stability
papers.abstract_en: The edge of stability refers to a phenomenon in deep learning with gradient-based optimizers where the Hessian eigenvalues of the loss remain stable above a threshold that the classical descent lemma predicts to be unstable. Previous works formulate the edge of stability with respect to the maximum Hessian eigenvalue and the learning rate. However, we observe that many first-order methods, including gradient descent, significantly violate the stability bound predicted by these theories by a factor as large as $\times 21.1$. Moreover, this deviation turns out to be systematic and highly dependent on the underlying optimizer, which is not captured by previous formulations. This calls for a new formulation of the stability threshold, which we derive from the directional Hessian and the gradient-alignment score with respect to the actual update taken by the optimizer, rather than the maximum curvature mode. Our new formulation of the realized edge of stability not only removes optimizer-dependent offsets and provides more consistent predictions of the stability threshold, but also introduces new diagnostic tools that reveal the unique role of the optimizer in actively balancing between the temporal and spatial budgets in first-order optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度学习优化器中的 edge of stability 现象，即 Hessian 特征值稳定在经典下降引理所预测的不稳定阈值之上。作者观察到包括梯度下降在内的多种一阶方法会以最高达 21.1 倍的系统性偏差违反该稳定性界，且偏差与优化器强相关。为此提出基于方向 Hessian 和梯度对齐分数（gradient-alignment score）的 realized edge of stability 新框架，以实际更新方向而非最大曲率模态来定义稳定性阈值。
Motivation: 现有 edge of stability 理论以最大 Hessian 特征值和学习率定义稳定性阈值，但实验显示许多一阶方法会系统性且显著地违反该预测界，偏差幅度大且依赖底层优化器，说明已有公式未捕捉关键因素。
Method: 从优化器实际采取的更新方向出发，利用方向 Hessian（directional Hessian）和梯度对齐分数重新推导稳定性阈值，形成 realized edge of stability 表述，取代基于最大曲率模态的经典公式。
Result: 摘要报告梯度下降等一阶方法对稳定性界的偏差可高达 21.1 倍，且该偏差是系统性并依赖优化器的；新的 realized edge of stability 公式消除了优化器相关的偏移，并给出更一致的阈值预测，同时提供新的诊断工具。
Conclusion: 作者强调新框架揭示了一阶优化中优化器在时间预算（temporal budget）与空间预算（spatial budget）之间主动平衡的独特作用。

papers.title: CoMVS-GS: Collaborative Multi-View Stereo and 3D Gaussian Splatting for Surface Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables efficient novel view synthesis, but accurate mesh reconstruction remains difficult in weakly observed and occluded regions, where Gaussian primitives may grow into unstable or geometrically inconsistent structures. We propose CoMVS-GS, a general surface reconstruction framework that combines Multi-View Stereo with Gaussian splatting. CoMVS-GS initializes Gaussian primitives from dense multi-view stereo points with pre-flattened scales and normal-aligned orientations, providing stronger geometric priors than sparse structure-from-motion initialization and reducing ambiguity during early optimization. It further introduces PatchMatch-3DGS Mutual Supervision, where Gaussian-rendered depths and normals initialize PatchMatch refinement, and refined PatchMatch depths supervise Gaussian optimization to improve weakly constrained geometry. For surface extraction, CoMVS-GS replaces truncated signed distance field voxel fusion with a Delaunay graph-cut meshing pipeline, reducing sensitivity to voxel resolution while preserving visibility-consistent surface evidence. Experiments on DTU, GauU-Scene V2, and MatrixCity show that CoMVS-GS remains competitive on object-level reconstruction and improves geometric accuracy and mesh compactness in outdoor scenes while maintaining high rendering quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoMVS-GS，一个结合多视图立体 (Multi-View Stereo) 与 3D Gaussian Splatting 的通用表面重建框架。它从稠密多视图立体点初始化高斯原语，并通过 PatchMatch-3DGS 互监督改善弱观测与遮挡区域的几何，最后用 Delaunay 图割网格化替代 TSDF 体素融合。实验在 DTU、GauU-Scene V2 和 MatrixCity 上进行，表明物体级重建保持竞争力，室外场景的几何精度和网格紧凑度提升，同时维持高渲染质量。
Motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 能高效进行新视角合成，但在弱观测和遮挡区域难以获得准确网格重建，高斯原语可能生长为不稳定或几何不一致的结构。
Method: 从稠密多视图立体点初始化高斯原语，赋予预展平尺度和法线对齐朝向，以提供比稀疏 SfM 初始化更强的几何先验；引入 PatchMatch-3DGS 互监督，用 Gaussian 渲染的深度和法线初始化 PatchMatch 细化，再以细化后的 PatchMatch 深度监督 Gaussian 优化；表面提取采用 Delaunay 图割网格化流程替代 TSDF 体素融合，降低对体素分辨率的敏感性。
Result: 摘要报告在 DTU、GauU-Scene V2 和 MatrixCity 上，该方法在物体级重建上保持竞争力，在室外场景中提升了几何精度和网格紧凑度，同时保持高渲染质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多视图立体与 Gaussian splatting 的协作能够改善弱约束区域的几何重建，并且图割网格化能保留可见性一致的表面证据。

papers.title: JSL-DC: A Word-Level Japanese Sign Language Dataset with Linguist-Derived Descriptions for Distinguishing Confusable Signs
papers.abstract_en: Effective sign language (SL) acquisition is crucial for deaf children, yet 95% are born to hearing parents who often lack proficiency in SL. SL recognition can power learning tools to help parents communicate with their children. However, Japanese Sign Language (JSL) lacks large-scale, multi-signer datasets, hindering the development of models that can generalize to new users. To address this gap, we introduce JSL-DC, the largest JSL dataset by video count, comprising 36.7K videos from 19 signers. The entire process was Deaf-centric: the lexicon comprising 270 JSL words was selected by Deaf and Coda linguists to facilitate parent-child communication, all participants were Deaf individuals who use JSL daily, and the data underwent a two-stage review process involving Deaf linguists. Moreover, we provide linguist-derived descriptions for distinguishing confusable signs. We demonstrate that the proposed model inspired by the descriptions outperforms state-of-the-art recognition methods by 9.8% on the confusable subset. The dataset, along with its linguistic description that inspires new models, will be released under a CC-BY 4.0 license to accelerate research in SL recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JSL-DC，一个词级日本手语 (JSL) 数据集，按视频数量计是最大的 JSL 数据集，包含 19 位手语者的 36.7K 视频，词表由聋人及 Coda 语言学家选定的 270 个 JSL 单词组成。数据收集全程以聋人为中心，所有参与者都是日常使用 JSL 的聋人，并经过聋人语言学家的两阶段审查。作者还提供语言学家导出的易混淆手语区分描述，并展示受这些描述启发的模型在易混淆子集上比现有最优识别方法高出 9.8%。数据集将按 CC-BY 4.0 许可发布。
Motivation: 95% 的聋童出生于听力正常的父母家庭，而这些父母往往不精通手语；手语识别可用于构建帮助父母与孩子交流的学习工具。然而 JSL 缺乏大规模、多手语者的数据集，阻碍了能泛化到新用户的模型开发。
Method: 以聋人为中心构建数据集：词表由聋人及 Coda 语言学家为促进亲子交流而选定，所有参与者均为日常使用 JSL 的聋人，数据经过聋人语言学家两阶段审查；同时提供语言学家导出的易混淆手语 (confusable signs) 区分描述，并据此提出一种受描述启发的识别模型。
Result: 摘要报告，所提出的模型在易混淆子集上比最先进的识别方法高出 9.8%。
Conclusion: 该数据集及其语言描述将按 CC-BY 4.0 许可发布，以加速手语识别领域的研究；研究范围限于词级 JSL 识别，未涉及句子级或连续手语。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Impacts of Nuclear War on Human Health from Changed Surface Ultraviolet Radiation
papers.abstract_en: Climate model simulations indicate that surface ultraviolet (UV) radiation would change after soot injection into the stratosphere during a nuclear war, due to the competing effects of ozone depletion and aerosol attenuation. Using climate model simulations, we evaluate UV impacts under two scenarios: a regional India-Pakistan conflict producing 5 Tg of soot and a global U.S.-Russia war producing 150 Tg. UV enhancements due to ozone depletion substantially shorten safe outdoor exposure time, particularly for individuals with lighter skin types. Applying UV dose-response relationships to the year 2000 population data, without accounting for direct conflict mortality or famine-related population loss, the 5 Tg scenarios result in approximately 5,300-9,800 additional skin cancer deaths within 10-15 years and up to 75,000 cumulative excess deaths over the following century. In contrast, strong aerosol attenuation under the 150 Tg scenario initially suppresses surface UV, resulting in about 8,500 fewer skin cancer deaths within 15 years and a maximum cumulative reduction of approximately 17,000 deaths over the following century. These findings demonstrate that nuclear war-induced changes in surface UV radiation represent a persistent but previously understudied health impact of nuclear war. While skin cancer would not dominate overall mortality following a nuclear war, enhanced cumulative surface UV radiation represents an additional, long-lasting threat to human health that compounds other global impacts such as climate disruption and food insecurity. The excess UV may also pose negative impacts on animals and plants, including those used for agriculture, which remain to be quantified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用气候模式模拟核战争后平流层烟尘注入对地表紫外(UV)辐射的影响，评估两种情景：印度-巴基斯坦区域冲突注入5 Tg烟尘，以及美俄全球战争注入150 Tg烟尘。由于臭氧耗损与气溶胶衰减的竞争效应，UV变化显著改变安全户外暴露时间；基于2000年人口数据和UV剂量-响应关系，5 Tg情景在10-15年内新增约5300-9800例皮肤癌死亡，百年累计超额死亡最多约75000例，而150 Tg情景初期因气溶胶强衰减抑制UV，反而减少约8500例皮肤癌死亡。作者认为核战争引起的地表UV变化是持久但此前研究不足的健康影响，且对动物、植物和农业的负面影响尚待量化。
Motivation: 核战争的健康影响通常聚焦于直接冲突死亡、气候破坏和粮食不安全，地表紫外辐射变化作为核战争后一种长期且被忽视的健康威胁缺乏系统评估。
Method: 使用气候模式模拟烟尘注入后的地表UV变化，结合臭氧耗损与气溶胶衰减两种竞争机制，并对2000年人口数据应用UV剂量-响应关系估算皮肤癌超额死亡；估算未纳入直接冲突死亡或饥荒导致的人口损失。
Result: 5 Tg情景下10-15年内新增约5300-9800例皮肤癌死亡，随后百年累计超额死亡最多约75000例；150 Tg情景下气溶胶衰减使地表UV初期受抑制，15年内皮肤癌死亡减少约8500例，百年累计最多减少约17000例。
Conclusion: 核战争诱导的地表UV变化是持续性但不占主导地位的额外健康威胁，会与气候破坏和粮食不安全等其他全球影响叠加；对动物、植物及农业的潜在负面影响仍需进一步量化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Role-Conditioned Sub-Token Routing for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models process long multimodal token sequences, making inference expensive in both memory and computation. Existing efficiency methods mainly reduce visual tokens, but aggressive token pruning becomes fragile because removing a token discards its entire representation. Sub-token compression provides a complementary alternative by retaining more tokens while reducing their value width. However, directly applying sub-token compression to VLA policies is less effective because information important for perception, language understanding, and control is distributed differently across the multimodal representation. We introduce Role-Conditioned Sub-Token Routing (RoleSub), which learns how to compress the value representations of retained tokens. After visual token reduction, RoleSub partitions each retained value representation into groups in an orthogonal space and uses a lightweight router to determine which groups should be preserved. The routing decision is conditioned on the token representation, a learned latent role representation, and language context. The same mechanism can also be applied to language values, allowing visual and language representations to be compressed without removing additional tokens. We evaluate RoleSub on OpenVLA-OFT-7B across the four LIBERO suites. At matched visual-KV budgets, RoleSub outperforms a trained token-only control in 33 of 36 settings, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. Combining visual and language compression reduces total KV to 9.2--11.3% of the original while retaining strong control performance on most tasks. These results show that reducing the representation within retained tokens provides an effective complement to token pruning for aggressive VLA compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Role-Conditioned Sub-Token Routing (RoleSub)，一种面向视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的高效压缩方法。在视觉 token 减少之后，RoleSub 将每个保留 value 表示在正交空间中分组，并用轻量路由器根据 token 表示、潜在角色表示和语言上下文决定保留哪些组。在 OpenVLA-OFT-7B 的四个 LIBERO 套件上，匹配视觉 KV 预算下 33/36 设置优于 token-only 对照，联合视觉与语言压缩可将总 KV 降至原始的 9.2–11.3% 并保持多数任务的控制性能。
Motivation: VLA 模型处理长多模态 token 序列，推理内存和计算开销昂贵。现有效率方法主要减少视觉 token，但激进剪枝会丢弃整个表示而变得脆弱；子 token 压缩是补充手段，但直接用于 VLA 效果不佳，因为感知、语言理解与控制所需信息在多模态表示中分布不同。
Method: 提出 RoleSub，在视觉 token 减少后学习压缩保留 token 的 value 表示。它将每个保留的 value 表示在正交空间划分为若干组，并由一个轻量路由器决定各组是否保留；路由决策以 token 表示、学习到的潜在角色表示和语言上下文为条件。同一机制也应用于语言值，使视觉和语言表示都能被压缩而无需删除额外 token。
Result: 在 OpenVLA-OFT-7B 上跨四个 LIBERO 套件评估，匹配视觉 KV 预算下 RoleSub 在 36 个设置中的 33 个优于训练过的 token-only 对照，激进压缩下增益最大。组合视觉与语言压缩将总 KV 降至原始的 9.2–11.3%，同时在大多数任务上保持强控制性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，在保留 token 内部减少表示是 token 剪枝的有效补充，可用于激进的 VLA 压缩。

papers.title: Improving Natural-Language Combinatorial-Optimization Accuracy in Resource-Constrained Language Models via Formal Abstractions
papers.abstract_en: Combinatorial scheduling poses a significant challenge for language models, requiring them to identify feasible solutions within exponentially large search spaces while satisfying complex constraints. This challenge is especially pronounced in resource-constrained settings, where larger language models are impractical and selection is limited to smaller models which often fail to preserve feasibility when scheduling directly from natural language. To address these limitations, we introduce SDDL, a neuro-symbolic framework that translates natural-language scheduling problems into compact, solver-aligned representations of tasks, resources, constraints, and objectives, while delegating low-level modeling and search to a deterministic compiler and external solver. On a 300-instance, multi-family subset of scheduling problems, SDDL improves independently verified feasibility for every resource-constrained model tested. The two strongest SDDL configurations reach 55.3% and 28.3%, up from direct-generation baselines of 23.7% and 1.3% and solver-code baselines of 21.7% and 7.0%, with a 0.0% median optimality gap among feasible schedules. By expressing problem structure rather than generating solutions or solver code, SDDL enables smaller models to approach the strongest evaluated direct- and solver-code configurations, including substantially larger frontier models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SDDL，一个神经符号 (neuro-symbolic) 框架，将自然语言调度问题翻译成紧凑且与求解器对齐的任务、资源、约束和目标表示，并把底层建模与搜索交给确定性编译器和外部求解器。在 300 实例的多族调度问题子集上，SDDL 提高了每个受资源约束模型的独立验证可行性，最强的两个配置分别达到 55.3% 和 28.3%，而直接生成基线为 23.7% 和 1.3%、求解器代码基线为 21.7% 和 7.0%，且可行调度的中位最优间隙为 0.0%。
Motivation: 组合调度要求语言模型在指数级搜索空间中寻找满足复杂约束的可行解，这对模型本身是显著挑战；在资源受限场景下只能选用较小的模型，而小模型直接从自然语言生成调度时经常无法保持可行性。
Method: 引入 SDDL，把自然语言调度问题转化为紧凑、求解器对齐的形式化表示，并将低层建模和搜索委托给确定性编译器与外部求解器；其核心是表达问题结构而非直接生成解或求解器代码。
Result: 在 300 实例的多族调度问题子集上，SDDL 对所有被测试的资源受限模型都带来可行性提升；两个最强配置的可行性为 55.3% 和 28.3%，分别高于直接生成基线 (23.7%, 1.3%) 与求解器代码基线 (21.7%, 7.0%)，且在可行调度上的中位最优间隙为 0.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过表达问题结构而非生成解或代码，SDDL 能让较小的模型接近最强的直接生成与求解器代码配置，包括明显更大的前沿模型。
