papers.title: Vector Symbolic Policy Gradient
papers.abstract_en: We answer this question with Vector-Symbolic Policy Gradient (VSPG), a discrete-action actor that represents each action by a unit-norm hypervector and scores it by similarity to the encoded state. Under the standard softmax policy-gradient surrogate, we prove that its update is exactly advantage-weighted hypervector bundling followed by normalization, and therefore supports standard advantage estimators. We further show that each trained action hypervector is a fixed-size compressed kernel memory, storing an advantage-weighted kernel expansion over visited states and transferring evidence according to the encoder-induced similarity. This provides a concrete mechanism that can support sample-efficient learning without increasing inference-time memory. Finally, for bipolar action memories, we prove that greedy action selection is stable under random bit flips, with failure probability decaying exponentially in the hypervector dimension. VSPG thus connects VSA action memories, log-linear policy gradients, and kernel policy search while providing a quantitative robustness guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Vector-Symbolic Policy Gradient (VSPG)，一种离散动作强化学习中的 actor 表示方法：每个动作由单位范数超向量表示，并按与编码状态的相似度打分。作者证明在标准 softmax 策略梯度替代目标下，其更新等价于优势加权的超向量捆绑后归一化，从而兼容标准优势估计器；同时证明训练后的动作超向量是一种固定大小的压缩核记忆，且双极动作记忆在随机比特翻转下贪婪选择具有稳定性保证。
Motivation: 该工作试图在向量符号架构 (VSA) 动作记忆、log-linear 策略梯度与核策略搜索之间建立统一的机制性理解，并为不增加推理内存的样本高效学习提供理论支撑。
Method: VSPG 用单位范数超向量表示离散动作，通过动作超向量与编码状态的相似度进行打分；策略更新被证明等价于优势加权超向量捆绑 (advantage-weighted hypervector bundling) 后归一化。
Result: 论文给出三个主要理论结果：VSPG 更新与优势加权捆绑的精确等价性；每个训练后的动作超向量可视为存储优势加权核展开的固定大小压缩核记忆；在双极动作记忆下，随机比特翻转时的贪婪动作选择失败概率随超向量维度呈指数衰减。
Conclusion: VSPG 将 VSA 动作记忆、log-linear 策略梯度与核策略搜索联系起来，并提供量化的鲁棒性保证；摘要未报告实验部分，主要贡献为理论分析。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Algorithms for adaptive and heteroskedastic linear regression at the computational threshold
papers.abstract_en: We study finite-sample linear regression in the presence of varied and unknown label noise, focusing on the heteroskedastic and adaptive linear regression models. Heteroskedastic linear regression models settings where the labels are of varying quality. We receive $n$ pairs $(X_i,Y_i)$ with labels $Y_i=X_i^\topβ+\varepsilon_i$, where $\varepsilon_i\sim N(0,σ_i^2)$ and the variances are unknown to the estimator. One natural measurement of the difficulty of this problem is the number of samples $m$ for which $σ_i^2\le1$ (larger $m$ is easier). We obtain a polynomial-time estimator with rate $\tilde{O}((nd^3/m^4)^{1/6})$ when $m\gg d^{3/4}n^{1/4}$, as well as nearly-matching lower bounds. For $d=O(1)$, our estimator achieves error $o(1)$ when $m\gg n^{1/4}$, whereas $L_1$ regression and other traditional approaches require $m\gg n^{1/2}$. In adaptive linear regression, the errors are drawn i.i.d. from an unknown distribution $p$, and our goal is to design a generic estimator that performs nearly as well as the best custom estimator that knows $p$. We introduce a (computationally inefficient) adaptive estimator that, so long as $p$ is a mixture of $k$ symmetric log-concave densities, achieves error comparable with the optimal estimator that knows $p$ and has $\tildeΘ(n/k)$ samples. For $k=1$, we show that $L_q$ regression (with data-dependent $q$) gives a polynomial-time estimator. Finally, to study the computational limits of both problems, we introduce the planted linear regression problem, where $X_i\sim N(0,I_d)$, $m$ unknown samples are noiseless, and the rest have error $\varepsilon_i\sim N(0,1)$. We conjecture that recovering $β$ up to error $\ll\sqrt{d/n}$ (or exactly) may have an information-computation gap between $m=d+1$ and $m\sim d^{3/4}n^{1/4}$, as is suggested by our near-matching polynomial-time estimator and statistical query (SQ) lower bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限样本线性回归在已知但异方差（heteroskedastic）和未知自适应（adaptive）标签噪声下的估计复杂度。异方差模型下，作者得到样本复杂度门槛 m≫d^{3/4}n^{1/4} 时误差为 O~((nd^3/m^4)^{1/6}) 的多项式时间估计器及近匹配下界；自适应模型下则给出一个计算低效但接近最优的通用估计器，以及 k=1 时基于数据相关 q 的 L_q 回归多项式时间方案。文章还引入 planted linear regression 问题来刻画这两个问题的计算极限，并猜测存在信息-计算差距。
Motivation: 标签噪声方差未知且随样本变化时，传统估计如 L1 回归对低噪声样本数量 m 的要求较高（m≫n^{1/2}），作者希望降低该门槛并研究自适应噪声分布下通用估计器是否能在未知分布 p 时接近知道 p 的最优估计器，同时探索这类问题的计算下界。
Method: 异方差模型下给出一个多项式时间估计器，其误差率由低方差样本数 m、维度 d 与总样本数 n 决定；自适应模型下构造一个计算低效的通用估计器，要求噪声分布 p 是 k 个对称 log-concave 密度的混合，并对 k=1 的情形采用数据相关阶数 q 的 L_q 回归。为分析计算极限，作者提出 planted linear regression 问题，并给出统计查询（SQ）下界。
Result: 异方差模型中，当 m≫d^{3/4}n^{1/4} 时估计器达到 O~((nd^3/m^4)^{1/6}) 的误差并配有近匹配下界；d=O(1) 时误差在 m≫n^{1/4} 下即可达到 o(1)，而 L1 回归等传统方法需要 m≫n^{1/2}。自适应模型中，当噪声为 k 个对称 log-concave 密度的混合时，通用估计器的误差与知道 p 的最优估计器相当，且所需样本为 Θ~(n/k)。planted 模型下的 SQ 下界与多项式时间算法共同提示，恢复 β 至误差 ≪√(d/n) 可能存在于 m=d+1 与 m∼d^{3/4}n^{1/4} 之间的信息-计算差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果刻画了异方差与自适应线性回归在计算门槛附近的样本效率，并提出 planted linear regression 作为研究信息-计算差距的候选模型；其中自适应估计器的计算效率仍是局限，差距猜想也尚未被完全证明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Does Attention Transfer Transfer? Attention Structure and Robustness in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision transformers (ViTs) trained to copy a pretrained teacher's attention maps recover most of fine-tuning's in-distribution accuracy yet fall measurably short of it under distribution shift, as recent work has shown. What the copy delivers has never been measured directly in the attention structure and tied to robustness. We build that instrumentation for ViT-S students of a self-supervised teacher on ImageNet-100, and report three findings that triangulate one conclusion. First, the transfer is essentially perfect and permanently so: the distilled student's attention ends up roughly two orders of magnitude closer to the teacher's than fine-tuning does, and does not drift with additional training. Second, the gap is real at 14$\times$ fewer parameters and 10$\times$ less data than previously studied, but it has a time axis. It tracks training maturity, and completing the schedules that the stopping rule interrupted closes it below our pre-registered threshold in two of three seeds, with comparisons at equal accuracy giving the same result. The endpoint gap at this scale is substantially a training-maturity artifact: robustness matures later than accuracy, and stopping rules tuned to accuracy undersample it. Third, forcing cross-row redundancy down by half the structural separation between the distilled and fine-tuned conditions produces no detectable robustness response under two registered ways of matching accuracy. Verified transfer, a gap that closes while the structure never moves, and a null under direct intervention are together consistent with the deficit residing in features, not in the visible attention structure. This is elimination plus intervention, and its scope is the regime we measured. In this regime, attention overlays show where a model looks, not what it knows.

TL;DR: 本文研究视觉 Transformer (ViT) 中注意力蒸馏 (attention distillation) 实际迁移了什么，并将其与分布偏移下的稳健性联系起来。作者在 ImageNet-100 上用 ViT-S 学生蒸馏自监督教师，发现注意力结构迁移近乎完美且不随额外训练漂移，但稳健性差距在该规模下主要源于训练成熟度 (training maturity) 伪影。通过消除加干预的实验设计，作者认为稳健性缺陷存在于特征而非可见的注意力结构。
Motivation: 已有工作显示模仿教师注意力的 ViT 在分布内精度上接近微调，但在分布偏移下明显不足；不过复制出的注意力结构从未被直接测量并关联到稳健性。本文针对这一测量缺口展开研究。
Method: 在 ImageNet-100 上为自监督教师的 ViT-S 学生构建注意力结构与稳健性的测量工具。方法采用消除法加干预：比较蒸馏与微调学生的注意力在结构上距教师的距离，追踪训练时间轴上的动态，并通过强制降低跨行冗余 (cross-row redundancy) 观察稳健性是否响应。
Result: 蒸馏学生的注意力与教师接近程度比微调大约高两个数量级，且不随额外训练漂移；在 14 倍更少参数和 10 倍更少数据下稳健性差距真实存在但沿训练时间变化，完成被早停规则中断的训练计划后，三个种子中有两个将差距降到预注册阈值以下，等精度比较得到相同结果。直接干预注意力结构以缩小蒸馏与微调条件的一半结构差异，在两种匹配精度的方式下均未产生可检测的稳健性响应。
Conclusion: 作者认为该规模下稳健性缺陷主要存在于特征而非可见的注意力结构；注意力图显示的是模型看哪里，而不是模型知道什么。结论范围限定于所测量的机制 (regime)。

papers.title: LEDGER: Claim-to-Evidence Trace Graphs for Auditing LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can now carry out long-horizon technical workflows involving complex tool use, code execution, file edits, and generated artifacts. As agents do more work faster, the productivity bottleneck shifts from producing outputs to auditing whether those outputs are correct and trustworthy. Agent observability systems make fine-grained execution events visible, but visibility alone still leaves reviewers to reconstruct which actions, artifacts, and validation steps matter for a particular conclusion. We introduce LEDGER - Layered Evidence and Decision Graphs for Execution Review, a tracing and review system that builds layered trace graphs over observed agent sessions. LEDGER preserves Trace Records while grouping them into Evidence Nodes and Workflow Nodes, representing artifacts as evidence anchors, and adding typed semantic edges that connect claims to supporting actions, artifacts, and checks. Through data-analysis and coding examples, we show how the resulting traces expose workflow decisions, artifact lineage, repair steps, validation coverage, and claim-support paths for evidence-centered audit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LEDGER（Layered Evidence and Decision Graphs for Execution Review），一个用于审计 LLM 智能体长时程技术工作流的追踪与审查系统。LEDGER 在观测到的智能体会话之上构建分层追踪图：保留 Trace Records，将其分组为 Evidence Nodes 与 Workflow Nodes，以产物作为证据锚点，并添加连接论断与其支撑动作、产物和检查的语义化边。作者通过数据分析和编码示例展示该追踪如何暴露工作流决策、产物血缘、修复步骤、验证覆盖与论断支持路径。
Motivation: LLM 智能体能快速完成长时程、涉及复杂工具使用与代码执行的工作流，瓶颈从产出结果转向审计结果的可信度；现有可观测性系统虽能显示细粒度执行事件，但审查者仍需自行重建哪些动作、产物和验证步骤与特定结论相关。
Method: LEDGER 是一种追踪与审查系统，在观测到的智能体会话上构建分层追踪图，保留 Trace Records 并将它们组织成 Evidence Nodes 和 Workflow Nodes，把产物视为证据锚点，同时加入带类型的语义边来将论断关联到支撑动作、产物与检查。
Result: 摘要通过数据分析和编码示例展示该方法，说明生成式追踪能够揭示工作流决策、产物血缘、修复步骤、验证覆盖以及面向证据审计的论断支持路径；没有报告定量指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为，相比单纯的可视化执行事件，以证据为中心的追踪图能更直接地支持对 LLM 智能体输出的审计与可信度判断。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When Clean Signals Are Not Enough: Detecting Structural Ambiguity for Safe Wearable Stress Classification
papers.abstract_en: Wearable stress classifiers can achieve strong average performance while failing completely for a particular individual. On WESAD, a Random Forest reaches 93.0% mean accuracy yet yields F1 = 0 for Subject 14, whose cross-signal coupling weakens near stress onset. We call this structural ambiguity: individually plausible physiological channels form an inter-signal pattern that is poorly supported by the person's non-stress reference. We introduce the Individual Conformal Coupling Monitor (ICCM), a lightweight and transparent pre-inference monitor that quantifies subject-specific coupling divergence and routes each window to classify, defer, or abstain without retraining the downstream classifier. Across WESAD (N = 15) and Stress-Predict (N = 35), full-cohort Pearson associations between ambiguity and accuracy are negative (r = -0.607, p = 0.016; r = -0.412, p = 0.014). Robustness analyses temper this finding: rank correlations are not significant, and the WESAD association disappears when Subject 14 is removed. ICCM changes false-positive counts from 29 to 27 and 94 to 92, although neither paired change is significant. It withholds 3 of Subject 14's 21 stress windows but does not repair the missed-stress failure. These results position ICCM as an interpretable signal of unsupported physiology and individual failure, rather than a stand-alone safety guarantee.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on Body Sensor Networks (BSN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有可穿戴压力分类器可能平均表现良好却在个别受试者上完全失败：在 WESAD 上，Random Forest 平均准确率达 93.0%，但对 Subject 14 的 F1=0，原因是其跨信号耦合在压力发作前减弱，形成所谓的结构歧义 (structural ambiguity)。作者提出 Individual Conformal Coupling Monitor (ICCM)，一个轻量、透明的前推理监控器，量化受试者特异的耦合发散度 (coupling divergence)，并将每个时间窗路由到分类、延迟或弃权，无需重新训练下游分类器。在 WESAD 与 Stress-Predict 上，全队列的歧义与准确率呈负相关，但鲁棒性分析显示秩相关不显著，且去除 Subject 14 后相关消失；ICCM 仅小幅改变假阳性数目，未能修复漏检，作者因此将其定位为可解释的失败信号而非独立安全保证。
Motivation: 现有压力分类器常以平均性能衡量，但平均准确率会掩盖个别受试者的灾难性失败（如 F1=0）。论文试图在推理前检测这种由跨信号耦合减弱导致的结构歧义，为下游分类提供安全干预点。
Method: 提出 ICCM，一种轻量且可解释的前推理监控器：它量化每个受试者相对自身非压力参考的耦合发散程度，据此将每个时间窗路由到分类 (classify)、延迟 (defer) 或弃权 (abstain)，且不改变或重新训练下游分类器。
Result: WESAD 中 Random Forest 平均准确率 93.0% 但对 Subject 14 的 F1=0；全队列 Pearson 相关为 WESAD r=-0.607 (p=0.016)、Stress-Predict r=-0.412 (p=0.014)，但秩相关均不显著，且移除 Subject 14 后 WESAD 相关消失。ICCM 将假阳性计数从 29 调至 27、94 调至 92，均无显著差异；它扣留了 Subject 14 的 21 个压力窗口中的 3 个，但未能修复该受试者的漏检失败。
Conclusion: 基于稳健性分析，作者强调 ICCM 应被视为检测个体生理支撑不足与失败模式的解释性信号，而不是独立的安全保障机制。

papers.title: GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises
papers.abstract_en: High-capacity encoders in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can let the query dominate the latent state, leaving retrieved evidence functionally irrelevant. We call this failure mode query dominance. To address it, we introduce \textbf{GRIP} (Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises), which imposes capacity asymmetry: the decoder keeps full-dimensional access to the query, while retrieved evidence passes through a severe stochastic bottleneck. This forces the evidence channel to encode only the residual information unavailable from the query. Across five reasoning benchmarks, GRIP outperforms strong iterative baselines, cuts a query--latent mutual-information diagnostic by roughly 30$\times$ (14.8 $\to$ 0.47 bits), and reduces hallucination by 73\%. Residual-alignment analysis further shows that the bottleneck output occupies subspaces less aligned with the query than baseline representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRIP（Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises），针对检索增强生成（RAG）中出现的 query dominance 失效模式——查询表征主导隐状态，导致检索证据在功能上被忽略。GRIP 对查询和证据采用不对称容量：查询保持全维度访问，检索证据则经过严重的随机瓶颈（stochastic bottleneck），迫使证据通道只编码查询无法提供的残差信息。摘要报告该方法在五个推理基准上超过强迭代基线，并将查询-隐状态互信息诊断从 14.8 bits 降至 0.47 bits（约 30 倍），同时减少 73% 的幻觉。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 中的高容量编码器可能让查询主导隐状态，使检索到的证据变得功能性无关，这一 query dominance 失败模式未被充分解决。作者认为需要显式限制证据信息通路，才能确保证据真正参与推理。
Method: GRIP 引入容量不对称机制：解码器保留对查询的全维度访问，而检索证据需要通过一个严格的随机瓶颈再进入模型。该设计强制证据通道仅编码查询中不存在的残差信息，从而对抗查询主导。
Result: 在五个推理基准上，GRIP 优于强迭代基线；查询-隐状态互信息诊断从 14.8 bits 降至 0.47 bits（约 30 倍）；幻觉减少 73%。残差对齐分析还显示，瓶颈输出的表示占据与查询对齐程度更低的子空间。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过信息受限前提（information-restricted premises）实现容量不对称，可以有效抑制查询对隐状态的支配，改善 RAG 中的证据利用并减少幻觉。

papers.title: Reconstruction: A Blind Benchmark for Recovering Research Ideas from Pre-Publication Bibliographies
papers.abstract_en: Can a language model recover the true research idea of a published paper when given only that paper's pre-publication bibliography? We introduce Reconstruction, a blind idea-recovery benchmark that withholds the seed paper and all contemporaneous or future literature, and asks models to propose hypotheses that an independent large language model judge matches against the held-out ground-truth idea. A strict anti-leakage protocol-temporal citation cutoff, anonymous reference IDs, and frozen per-paper bibliographies, which prevents prompt-time leakage of the seed idea. Across six scientific domains and 643 evaluated papers, seven frontier models achieve only modest Match rates (approx. 3-15%). We then evaluate a reference-only multi-agent (top 4) pipeline that combines cross-model review with a Swiss tournament over aligned hypothesis slots, without external web search. Cross-model review plus tournament selection raises Match rates to approx. 23-42% across all six domains, which is an observed approx. 2.4x lift over the best single-model baseline. This draft reports the protocol, anti-leakage design, and current results as an arXiv timestamp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reconstruction，一个盲测基准，用于仅从论文发表前的参考书目恢复该论文的真实研究想法。该基准隐藏种子论文及所有同期/未来文献，要求模型提出假设，并由独立大语言模型评审与隐藏的 ground-truth 想法比对。在六个科学领域、643 篇论文上，七个前沿模型仅达到约 3-15% 的匹配率；一个仅使用参考书目的多智能体（top 4）管线结合跨模型评审与 Swiss 锦标赛，将匹配率提升至约 23-42%，约为最佳单模型基线的 2.4 倍。
Motivation: 现有研究想法恢复或评估任务容易发生种子论文信息泄漏，缺乏严格防泄漏的盲测基准。本文试图回答：仅凭预印本前的参考书目，语言模型能否恢复论文的真实研究想法，并为此设计可验证的评估协议。
Method: 提出 Reconstruction 基准，核心是隐藏种子论文和所有同期或未来文献，只向模型提供论文的预印本前参考书目，让模型提出假设，再由独立 LLM 评审与隐藏的真实想法匹配。采用严格反泄漏协议，包括时间引用截断（temporal citation cutoff）、匿名参考 ID 和冻结的逐论文参考书目，防止提示时泄漏。另设计一个参考书目-only 的多智能体（top 4）管线，结合跨模型评审和 Swiss 锦标赛对对齐的假设槽进行选择，且不使用外部网络搜索。
Result: 在六个科学领域、643 篇论文上，七个前沿模型的 Match rates 仅为约 3-15%。跨模型评审加锦标赛选择将匹配率提升至约 23-42%，相比最佳单模型基线观察到约 2.4 倍的提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该反泄漏协议和参考书目-only 的多智能体管线能显著提高从参考书目恢复研究想法的能力；本稿作为 arXiv 时间戳，报告协议、防泄漏设计和当前结果。

papers.title: From Sequence to Structure: Relational Uncertainty Propagation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying large language model (LLM) agents in complex interactive environments. Existing UQ methods largely rely on local signals, such as token probabilities, predictive entropy, or per-step confidence, and therefore overlook the long-range dependencies through which errors accumulate across an execution trajectory. As a result, they may fail to identify agent failures whose causes originate several reasoning or interaction steps before the final answer. We propose RUPA (Relational Uncertainty Propagation for Agents), a trajectory-level UQ framework for LLM agents. RUPA represents an execution history as a directed trajectory graph in which reasoning states, tool interactions, and environment feedback are nodes connected by temporal and semantic dependency edges. It then propagates uncertainty over this graph to capture how execution risk accumulates and transfers across interaction steps. The propagated signal is combined with trajectory-level behavioral features and goal-alignment information to produce a confidence estimate for the full agent trajectory. We evaluate RUPA on representative agent benchmarks, including $τ$-2, Terminal-Bench-2, and GAIA, using 6 open-source LLMs spanning multiple model families. Experimental results show that RUPA consistently outperforms existing UQ methods by providing more accurate uncertainty estimates, enabling earlier failure detection, and improving uncertainty-guided agent execution across diverse agent tasks. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling relational dependency is crucial to reliable UQ for long-horizon LLM agents, providing a practical foundation for trustworthy agent execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RUPA（Relational Uncertainty Propagation for Agents），一个面向 LLM 智能体的轨迹级不确定性量化（UQ）框架。RUPA 将执行历史建模为有向轨迹图，节点为推理状态、工具交互和环境反馈，边为时间与语义依赖关系，并在图上传播不确定性以刻画执行风险随步骤累积与转移。作者在 τ-2、Terminal-Bench-2 和 GAIA 基准上使用 6 个开源 LLM 验证，显示该方法在不确定性估计准确性、早期失败检测和不确定性引导的执行方面一致优于现有 UQ 方法。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体不确定性量化方法多依赖局部信号（如 token 概率、预测熵或单步置信度），忽略了错误沿执行轨迹跨步骤累积的长程依赖，因此难以识别根因早于最终答案的多步失败。
Method: 提出轨迹级 UQ 框架 RUPA：将执行历史构建为有向轨迹图，其中推理状态、工具交互与环境反馈作为节点，并以时间与语义依赖边相连；在图上传播不确定性以捕获执行风险的累积与转移，再将传播信号与轨迹级行为特征及目标对齐信息结合，输出整条轨迹的置信度估计。
Result: 在 τ-2、Terminal-Bench-2 和 GAIA 基准上，使用覆盖多个模型家族的 6 个开源 LLM 进行评估，RUPA 在不确定性估计准确性上一致优于现有 UQ 方法，能更早检测失败，并改进不确定性引导的智能体执行。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模关系依赖（relational dependency）对长程 LLM 智能体的可靠不确定性量化至关重要，为可信的智能体执行提供了实用基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CLARA: Clip-Level Multimodal Alignment with VLM-Derived Rationales for Hateful Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: Hateful video detection has become increasingly important with the rapid growth of video-centric social media platforms, given the serious risks that hate speech poses to both individual well-being and social cohesion. Compared with text or static multimodal content, hateful video detection remains underexplored and significantly more challenging, as hateful meaning often arises from complex interactions among multimodal cues, including speech, audio, and visual content. Moreover, such signals are often brief, implicit, and temporally dependent, making them difficult to capture using conventional video-level representations. In this work, we propose CLARA, a clip-level multimodal framework for hateful video detection. Instead of treating a video as a single instance, CLARA models it as a sequence of fine-grained clips, enabling more precise capture of temporally localized hateful signals. We introduce a Mixture-of-Experts clip encoder for adaptive multimodal alignment, a local-global segment contrastive objective to jointly model short-term cues and long-range temporal dependencies, and VLM-derived rationales integrated via a gated Transformer to provide high-level semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on three hateful video datasets demonstrate that CLARA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Further ablation studies and parameter analyses validate the effectiveness of each component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLARA，一个面向仇恨视频检测的 clip 级多模态框架。与把视频视为单一实例的做法不同，CLARA 将视频建模为细粒度片段序列，并引入 Mixture-of-Experts 片段编码器、局部-全局片段对比目标以及经门控 Transformer 融合的 VLM 派生理性解释 (VLM-derived rationales)。在三个仇恨视频数据集上的实验显示其一致优于现有方法，消融与参数分析验证了各组件的有效性。
Motivation: 仇恨视频中的恶意含义常由语音、音频与视觉内容等模态间复杂交互产生，且这些信号往往短暂、隐式并具有时间依赖性，传统的视频级表示难以捕捉此类信息；相比文本或静态多模态内容，仇恨视频检测仍未被充分探索且更具挑战性。
Method: 将视频建模为细粒度 clip 的序列以捕捉时间局部化的仇恨信号；采用 Mixture-of-Experts clip encoder 进行自适应多模态对齐；设计局部-全局片段对比目标 (local-global segment contrastive objective) 同时建模短期线索与长程时间依赖；并通过门控 Transformer 集成 VLM-derived rationales 提供高层语义指导。
Result: 在三个仇恨视频数据集上，CLARA 一致优于最先进方法；消融研究和参数分析进一步验证了每个组件的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调 clip 级建模与 VLM 派生语义指导的结合能更精确地捕捉时间上局部化的仇恨信号，从而提升仇恨视频检测性能。

papers.title: WorldRover: A Scalable Synthetic Video Data Engine for World Exploration with Rich Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Learning to generate or reconstruct explorable worlds requires video paired with more than RGB: camera motion, scene geometry, temporal correspondence and, for interactive models, control signals. Real capture can provide some of these signals, but dense geometry and long-range correspondence usually rely on estimation or specialised instrumentation. Rendering provides these quantities directly, yet existing synthetic resources rarely combine them on the same frames while also supporting controlled changes of viewpoint and appearance. We introduce WorldRover, a data engine for generating richly annotated, long-range explorations of artist-built environments. At its core, WorldRover-Engine is an Unreal Engine pipeline that executes and offline-renders minute-scale routes while preserving their full trajectories and scene geometry. The same exploration can be replayed from first-person, third-person, and 360 panoramic cameras under different environmental states. Using WorldRover-Engine, we construct WorldRover-10M, whose sequences pair RGB with metric depth, camera trajectories, and trajectory-derived action signals throughout each exploration. Third-person subsets additionally provide dense optical flow, long-range 2D/3D point tracks with visibility, and a character trajectory distinct from the camera trajectory. The engine can render a traversal from first-person, third-person and 360 panoramic viewpoints, under different environmental states or with a neutral white material, while preserving the route and scene geometry. WorldRover therefore turns long-horizon world exploration into a scalable data-generation problem, providing supervision for models that must build, maintain, and revisit coherent representations of an explorable world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldRover，一个可扩展的合成视频数据引擎，用于生成带丰富标注的长时间世界探索序列。核心是 WorldRover-Engine，一个基于 Unreal Engine 的离线渲染管线，可执行并渲染分钟级路线并保留完整轨迹和场景几何；并据此构建 WorldRover-10M 数据集，将 RGB 与度量深度、相机轨迹和轨迹导出的动作信号配对。该引擎支持从第一人称、第三人称和 360 全景相机在不同环境状态下重放同一探索，第三人称子集额外提供稠密光流、长程 2D/3D 点轨迹和角色轨迹。
Motivation: 现实采集难以同时获得稠密几何与长程对应，往往依赖估计或专门仪器；现有合成资源很少在同一帧上组合这些信号，同时支持视角和外观的受控变化。
Method: WorldRover-Engine 是一个 Unreal Engine 数据生成管线，执行并离线渲染分钟级路线，同时保留完整轨迹和场景几何；同一探索可由第一人称、第三人称和 360 全景相机在不同环境状态或中性白色材质下重放，并导出 RGB、度量深度、相机轨迹、动作信号、光流、长程 2D/3D 点轨迹及角色轨迹等标注。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，主要产出是 WorldRover-10M 数据集：序列将 RGB 与度量深度、相机轨迹和轨迹推导的动作信号配对，第三人称子集还提供稠密光流、带可见性的长程 2D/3D 点轨迹，以及区别于相机轨迹的角色轨迹。
Conclusion: 作者将长时程世界探索转化为可扩展的数据生成问题，为需要构建、维护并重新访问可探索世界一致表示的模型提供监督信号；摘要未讨论方法局限。

papers.title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Experience-learning agents for optimization modeling improve by storing verified skills, but existing learners admit knowledge by checking against known answers, which real ticket streams do not provide. The natural label-free alternatives are unreliable: on a 300-problem label-blind stream, admitting every executable model poisons roughly one admission in four, while single-instance agreement accepts models that match at one value but differ elsewhere. We propose AdmitOR, an admission gate built on calibrated external behavioral evidence. Candidates from three model families, prompting strategies, and solver stacks are run on instances resampled from an extracted parameter domain; agreement across the resulting value-function traces is summarized by a cross-family clique, and a calibrated threshold returns accept, abstain, or escalate. The preregistered false-discovery criterion holds on calibration data but not on the wild stream. We report this negative result in full and trace most failures to benchmark texts that do not faithfully encode their labeled instances. Comparing four admission judges on one collection of logs inside a state-of-the-art skill learner, AdmitOR raises admission precision to 0.927, against 0.871 for majority vote and 0.726 for execution success, yielding 3.1x and 8.0x fewer poisoned admissions. Its library is the smallest and attains the highest macro accuracy across five public benchmarks, 58.4 against 54.8 for majority vote and 53.9 for the ground-truth-labeled library. The 3.5-point gain over majority vote is supported by a paired bootstrap and survives correction for a host-side anomaly. To our knowledge, AdmitOR is the first label-free admission mechanism designed around an explicitly calibrated false-discovery target. The transfer failure identifies a necessary condition for extending it to wild streams.
papers.comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/junbolian/AdmitOR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdmitOR，一个面向 LLM 优化建模经验学习代理的标签免费 (label-free) 准入机制。该机制在从提取的参数域重采样出的实例上运行多个模型族、提示策略与求解器栈，用跨族团 (cross-family clique) 汇总值函数迹的一致性，再由校准阈值输出接受、弃权或升级。在技能学习器的日志对比中，AdmitOR 将准入精度提高到 0.927，高于多数投票的 0.871 与执行成功的 0.726，中毒准入分别减少 3.1x 和 8.0x。但作者报告了负面结果：预先注册的假发现率标准在校准数据上成立，在野外数据流上不成立。
Motivation: 现有经验学习代理通过对照已知答案来确认技能，而真实票流 (ticket streams) 不提供答案；天然的无标签替代方案不可靠：在 300 个问题的标签盲流上，接受每个可执行模型会污染约四分之一的准入，而单实例一致性会接受仅在单个值上匹配的模型。
Method: 提出 AdmitOR 准入门，基于校准的外部行为证据：从提取的参数域中重采样实例，运行来自三个模型族、不同提示策略和求解器栈的候选模型，将值函数迹 (value-function traces) 的一致性汇总为跨族团，并用校准阈值决定接受、弃权或升级。
Result: 在技能学习器内的日志对比中，AdmitOR 的准入精度为 0.927，多数投票为 0.871，执行成功为 0.726，中毒准入数量分别为后两者的 1/3.1 和 1/8.0。AdmitOR 的库最小，并在五个公共基准上取得最高宏精度 58.4，对比多数投票的 54.8 和地面真值标记库的 53.9；该 3.5 点增益有配对 bootstrap 支持。但预先注册的假发现率标准在校准数据上成立，在野外流上不成立。
Conclusion: 作者完整报告了负面转移结果，并将大部分失败归因于未能忠实编码其标记实例的基准文本。这一转移失败识别了将该机制扩展到野外流的必要条件；据作者所知，AdmitOR 是首个围绕显式校准的假发现目标设计的无标签准入机制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VibeWorlding: Can Multimodal Agents Construct 3D Open Worlds End-to-End?
papers.abstract_en: Constructing an interactive 3D open world from a user query is important. However, existing methods are primarily evaluated on idealized, simple queries, making it difficult to systematically analyze and compare how multimodal agents understand user intent, use 3D tools, and reason over textual and visual 3D world information. To this end, we propose VibeWorlding, a unified framework for benchmarking and training vibe worlding agents: a multimodal agent that can autonomously infer user intent, plan scene layout, invoke 3D tools, and reflect on the multimodal feedback in a multi-turn agent-environment interaction process. To achieve this, we first build VWE-BENCH, a benchmark of 2,616 high-quality 3D assets, 323 human-annotated seed 3D worlds, and 6,828 reverse-synthesized multimodal user queries, split into verified queries with ground-truth and unverified queries with carefully designed rubrics. Moreover, we develop VibeWorlding-Gym, a joint multimodal RL post-training framework that integrates (1) a sandbox environment unifying asset retrieval, editing, and image rendering as MCP tools, and (2) a rubric-based verifier that combines physical feasibility and intent fulfillment verification, supporting both fair model evaluation and scalable multimodal RL reward service. Our experiments show that current frontier MLLMs are far from solving the vibe worlding agent task, with even GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.8-Max reaching below 60% success rate, and trace the bottleneck to precise 3D world editing. We further find that RL training can ease this weakness and enable open-source MLLMs to even surpass closed-source frontiers: our VibeWorlder-8B is comparable to frontier MLLMs, while our flagship VibeWorlder-30B-A3B attains the best overall Pass@1 among all evaluated models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VibeWorlding，一个用于端到端构造交互式 3D 开放世界的多模态智能体 (multimodal agent) 的统一评测与训练框架。作者构建了 VWE-BENCH 基准，包含 2,616 个高质量 3D 资产、323 个人工标注种子世界和 6,828 条逆向合成的多模态用户查询，并开发 VibeWorlding-Gym 多模态 RL 后训练框架。实验表明当前前沿 MLLM 在该任务上远未解决，即便是 GPT-5.5 和 Qwen3.8-Max 的成功率也低于 60%，而提出的 VibeWorlder-30B-A3B 取得最佳 Pass@1。
Motivation: 现有方法主要基于理想化、简单查询进行评估，难以系统分析和比较多模态智能体如何理解用户意图、使用 3D 工具并在文本与视觉 3D 世界信息上进行推理，缺乏统一基准和训练框架。
Method: 提出 VibeWorlding 框架，包含 VWE-BENCH 基准（区分含真值已验证查询和基于评分细则的未验证查询）以及 VibeWorlding-Gym，后者将资产检索、编辑和图像渲染封装为 MCP 工具的沙箱环境与基于物理可行性和意图满足验证的 rubric 验证器结合，支持公平评测和可扩展的多模态 RL 奖励服务。
Result: 摘要报告 GPT-5.5 和 Qwen3.8-Max 在 vibe worlding 任务上成功率均低于 60%，瓶颈在于精确的 3D 世界编辑；RL 训练可缓解该弱点，使开源模型 VibeWorlder-8B 与前沿 MLLM 相当，而旗舰模型 VibeWorlder-30B-A3B 在所有评测模型中取得最佳整体 Pass@1。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前多模态智能体还远未解决 3D 开放世界端到端构建任务，并指出 RL 后训练有助于弥补精确 3D 编辑的不足，使开源模型能够超越闭源前沿模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Low-Rank Dynamics-Effective Latent Carriers for Counterfactual Rollout in Learned World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models may predict the future without making clear which parts of their hidden state actually drive those predictions. We ask whether a small, directly addressable hidden-state change can place a learned world model on the intended counterfactual trajectory and then let the model continue that future on its own. We study a recurrent world model with a 192-dimensional hidden state in a controlled two-object, two-dimensional collision environment. For a bounded family of local velocity edits, we first verify that the model can natively represent and roll out the edited future. We then construct candidate low-rank carriers from training-only factual-to-counterfactual hidden differences and learn a map from the factual state and requested edit to carrier coefficients. On the registered rank grid, rank 4 is the smallest tested rank that satisfies the full development-panel criteria. A single rank-4 patch at the anchor is sufficient to redirect a 12-step autonomous rollout, with no future observations, teacher forcing, or repeated correction. The frozen procedure satisfies the preregistered replication rule across independently trained checkpoints and remains usable across nearby intervention times. Random equal-norm, wrong-object, and wrong-time controls do not explain the effect. A position-edit stress test provides a negative contrast: the intended position patch can pass the raw rollout criteria, but no-patch and random controls can pass the same criteria, and wrong-object specificity is not established. Thus, successful editing alone is not enough. We use dynamics-effective to describe an intervention that changes the model's future computation in a sustained and target-specific way under autonomous rollout. The rank-4 result identifies a compact intervention interface for the tested velocity-edit family, not a closed four-dimensional state or an intrinsic state dimension.
papers.comment: Revised version: removed an inconclusive development-only event-relative phase analysis; the main rank-4 carrier, fresh-checkpoint replication, B1/B2 temporal reuse, position-edit, and joint-edit conclusions are unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究循环世界模型（recurrent world model）的隐状态能否通过一个小型、可直接寻址的修改被放到目标反事实轨迹上，并让模型自主延续该未来。作者在192维隐状态、受控二物体二维碰撞环境中，从训练阶段的事实到反事实隐状态差异构造低秩载流子（low-rank carriers），并学习从事实状态与请求编辑到载流子系数的映射。在注册的秩网格上，rank 4 是最小满足全部开发面板标准的测试秩；单个 rank-4 修补足以重定向12步自主展开，无需未来观测、教师强制或重复校正。作者强调单纯成功的编辑不足以证明干预有效，并用位置编辑压力测试提供负面对照。
Motivation: 世界模型可以预测未来，但隐状态中哪些部分实际驱动这些预测并不清晰；需要确定一个小的、可直接寻址的隐状态变化，使模型进入预期反事实轨迹并自主延续。
Method: 从仅使用训练数据的 fact-to-counterfactual 隐状态差异中构造候选低秩载流子，学习从事实状态和请求的局部速度编辑到载流子系数的映射；在注册的秩网格上评估，采用独立训练检查点复制、B1/B2 时间复用等预注册标准；还对位置编辑进行压力测试作为负面对照。
Result: 摘要报告 rank 4 是最小通过完整开发面板标准的测试秩，单个 rank-4 anchor patch 即可重定向12步自主 rollout；冻结过程在独立训练的检查点上满足预注册复制规则，且随机等范数、错误物体、错误时间对照不能解释该效应。位置编辑压力测试中，意图位置 patch、无 patch 和随机对照均能通过原始 rollout 标准，错误物体特异性未建立。
Conclusion: 作者提出用"动力学有效"（dynamics-effective）描述在自主展开下持续且目标特异性地改变模型未来计算的干预；rank-4 结果仅识别出测试速度编辑族的一个紧凑干预接口，并非封闭的四维状态或内在状态维度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: S2-MoE: Enabling Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for inference on edge devices is challenging due to severe memory and bandwidth constraints. While speculative decoding and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) have been proposed to improve inference efficiency, naively combining them often incurs excessive verification overhead and poor expert reuse, limiting their effectiveness in memory-bound edge settings. In this work, we propose S2-MoE, an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for MoE inference on edge devices. S2-MoE reduces redundant verification through routing-aware adaptive speculative expansion, improves verification efficiency with reuse-aware expert gating, and aligns draft and target execution via shared context. Implemented in llama$.$cpp, S2-MoE achieves up to $5.3\times$ speedup (about $2.0\times$ on average) over standard autoregressive decoding across diverse MoE models and datasets on edge devices. Code is available at https://github.com/angerybob/S2-MoE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 S2-MoE，一个面向边缘设备上 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 推理的自推测解码框架。它通过路由感知的自适应推测扩展降低冗余验证，用复用感知的专家门控提升验证效率，并借助共享上下文对齐草稿与目标执行。实现于 llama.cpp，在多种 MoE 模型和数据集上相对标准自回归解码取得最高 5.3 倍、平均约 2.0 倍的加速。
Motivation: 边缘设备上的 LLM 推理受内存和带宽约束严重，推测解码与 MoE 的朴素组合常常带来过高的验证开销和较差的专家复用，限制了其在内存受限边缘场景中的有效性。
Method: 提出 S2-MoE 框架，包含三个关键设计：路由感知的自适应推测扩展（routing-aware adaptive speculative expansion）以减少冗余验证；复用感知的专家门控（reuse-aware expert gating）提高验证效率；以及通过共享上下文（shared context）对齐草稿与目标执行。
Result: 在边缘设备上的多种 MoE 模型和数据集上，相比标准自回归解码获得最高 5.3 倍、平均约 2.0 倍的推理加速。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 S2-MoE 能够有效缓解推测解码与 MoE 朴素结合时的验证开销和专家复用问题，为内存受限的边缘设备提供更高效的 MoE 解码方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AMPLIFAI: A Multiphase CT Dataset for Benchmarking Clinical Reasoning in LI-RADS Assessment of Liver Lesions
papers.abstract_en: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the third leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with early detection improving survival from <20% to >70%. The standardized Liver Imaging Reporting and Data System (LI-RADS) criteria provide an imaging-based diagnostic framework to evaluate liver lesions for HCC, serving as a foundation for automating HCC detection with artificial intelligence (AI). However, the lack of large, publicly available datasets with high-quality annotations has limited the development and evaluation of AI models for automated LI-RADS assessment. We introduce AMPLIFAI dataset, the first public dataset of 590 multiphase abdominal CT studies annotated with LI-RADS categories, lesion size, and voxel-level segmentations for three major LI-RADS features: arterial phase hyperenhancement, washout, and enhancing capsule. The dataset was curated and harmonized from four public datasets and augmented with expert annotations from five board-certified radiologists and one resident. Following the Datasheets for Datasets format, this paper details the dataset's composition, curation and harmonization process, and annotation workflow to support transparent, reproducible research in medical imaging AI.

papers.title: BrainWAM: Action-Space Coordination of Semantic Priors and Predictive Dynamics for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving requires planning under both semantic constraints and predictive dynamics. Existing end-to-end driving approaches, however, typically emphasize only one side of this requirement: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exploit VLM priors for semantic reasoning, while World Action Models (WAMs) provide future-aware prediction through generative world modeling. This naturally motivates a unified planner that can leverage both semantic priors and predictive dynamics. However, we find that a naive combination through joint token-level attention suffers from an attention-allocation mismatch, where semantic shortcuts dominate the shared attention space and suppress predictive dynamics. Inspired by neuroscience evidence that complex behavior arises from coordination among functionally specialized systems, we propose BrainWAM, a structured action-space coordination framework that converts semantic reasoning and predictive world modeling into two specialized action-oriented pathways, and aligns them at the level of compact action representations. We further introduce an asynchronous rectified-flow inference strategy with decoupled video and action denoising, which shortens inference latency while preserving planning-relevant predictive context. BrainWAM reaches state-of-the-art performance on both NAVSIM v1 (89.5 PDMS) and NAVSIM v2 (89.6 EPDMS), consistently outperforming VLA-only or WAM-only methods, highlighting BrainWAM as a practical and promising direction for autonomous driving systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BrainWAM，一种面向自动驾驶的端到端规划框架，将视觉-语言模型的语义先验（VLA）与生成式世界模型的预测动态（WAM）整合为两条专门的动作导向通路，并在紧凑动作表征层面进行对齐。作者还引入异步整流流（rectified-flow）推理策略，解耦视频与动作去噪以降低推理延迟。摘要报告 BrainWAM 在 NAVSIM v1（89.5 PDMS）与 NAVSIM v2（89.6 EPDMS）上达到当前最优，且优于仅用 VLA 或仅用 WAM 的方法。
Motivation: 现有端到端驾驶方法通常只侧重语义约束或预测动力学中的一端，而简单的 token 级联合注意力组合会出现注意力分配失配，语义捷径主导共享注意力空间并抑制预测动力学，缺乏统一的规划器来同时利用两类信息。
Method: 借鉴神经科学中功能特化系统协调产生复杂行为的观点，BrainWAM 把语义推理和预测世界建模分别转化为两条专门的 action-oriented 通路，并在紧凑动作表示层次对齐两者；同时提出异步整流流推理策略，通过解耦视频与动作去噪缩短推理延迟并保留规划相关的预测上下文。
Result: 摘要报告 BrainWAM 在 NAVSIM v1 上达到 89.5 PDMS、在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 89.6 EPDMS，均取得最先进性能，并一致优于仅使用 VLA 或仅使用 WAM 的方法。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将语义先验与预测动态在动作空间上进行结构化协调是一种实用且有前景的自动驾驶系统方向；其设计受脑功能特化系统协调的神经科学证据启发。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SCOPE-Router: Cost-Aware Open-Set VLM Routing for Execution-Oriented Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Model routing aims to select the most suitable model from a candidate pool for each query, balancing quality and cost. Existing VLM routing research is limited to traditional VQA evaluation, lacks systematic calibration optimization for open-set scenarios, and employs training objectives that dilute multi-positive signals via softmax normalization without incorporating cost. We address these limitations with three contributions: (1)VLM-ExecRouterBench, the first execution-oriented VLM routing benchmark covering Code, Agentic, and Search domains with 11 candidate models spanning nearly two orders of magnitude in pricing; (2)SCOPE-Router, a dual-tower router that matches queries to model behavior profiles constructed via hybrid calibration (random/diagnostic/diversity sampling), enabling new models to join routing without retraining; (3)CRM+RCCR, an architecture-agnostic cost-aware objective that encodes cost preference into continuous relevance targets through per-pair independent scoring, eliminating multi-positive dilution while regularizing queries with similar routing preferences to be closer in the routing space. Empirically, SCOPE-Router achieves the best Rank Score on all three benchmarks, surpassing the runner-up by 1.84 points under OOD settings and by 6.75 points under doubly OOD open-set evaluation. When applied to four diverse routers, CRM+RCCR improves Rank Score by 1.25--6.21 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对执行导向任务的视觉语言模型（VLM）路由问题，提出首个执行导向路由基准 VLM-ExecRouterBench（覆盖 Code、Agentic、Search 三个领域，11 个候选模型，价格跨度近两个数量级），并设计双塔路由 SCOPE-Router 与成本感知目标 CRM+RCCR。摘要报告该方法在三个基准上均取得最佳 Rank Score，并在 OOD 与 doubly OOD 开放集评估下显著领先现有方案。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 路由研究局限于传统 VQA 评估，缺乏面向开放集场景的系统性校准优化，且训练目标通过 softmax 归一化稀释多正样本信号，并未纳入成本因素。
Method: 提出三种贡献：构建执行导向路由基准 VLM-ExecRouterBench；设计双塔结构 SCOPE-Router，通过混合校准（随机/诊断/多样性采样）构建模型行为画像，使新模型无需重训即可加入路由；提出架构无关的成本感知目标 CRM+RCCR，将成本偏好编码为连续相关目标，通过逐对独立打分消除多正样本稀释，并正则化路由空间中路由偏好相似的查询。
Result: SCOPE-Router 在全部三个基准上取得最佳 Rank Score，OOD 设置下超出第二名 1.84 分，doubly OOD 开放集评估下超出 6.75 分；将 CRM+RCCR 应用于四种不同路由架构时，Rank Score 提升 1.25–6.21 分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调成本感知与开放集校准相结合可以显著提升执行导向任务中的 VLM 路由性能，并支持新模型低成本接入路由系统。

papers.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood. As AI development becomes faster and increasingly automated, mechanistic exploration remains largely manual, widening the gap between what models can do and our ability to understand and control them. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mechanist, an agentic system that uses AI as a scientific instrument for the autonomous discovery of mechanisms underlying AI intelligence. To support autonomous mechanistic discovery, we construct an interpretability-focused knowledge graph of approximately 13,000 papers and integrate it with a multidisciplinary database of 43 million papers spanning 26 fields. We further curate a library of 32 foundational methods for mechanism analysis, causal intervention, and validation. Compared with Claude Code and existing AI-scientist systems, Mechanist generates more valuable mechanism hypotheses and executes experiments more reliably. Mechanist also demonstrates a progression from discovering model behaviors to explaining and controlling AI models. Specifically, Mechanist first uncovers a counterintuitive safety risk in scientific laboratories, showing that unsafe traits can transfer across modalities through apparently safe training data. Mechanist then develops a mechanism theory of belief, revealing how models represent world knowledge, form beliefs, infer the beliefs of others, and how these mechanisms emerge during pretraining. Finally, Mechanist translates these mechanistic insights into practical interventions that improve model performance across diverse scenarios and steer scientific foundation models toward generating DNA sequences with specified properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mechanist，一个将 AI 作为科学仪器、用于自主发现 AI 智能机制的智能体系统 (agentic system)。系统构建了约 13,000 篇论文的可解释性知识图谱，并整合涵盖 26 个领域、约 4,300 万篇论文的跨学科数据库，同时整理出 32 种机制分析、因果干预与验证方法。摘要报告称，与 Claude Code 及现有 AI-scientist 系统相比，Mechanist 能生成更有价值的机制假设并更可靠地执行实验，且展示了从发现模型行为到解释再到控制 AI 模型的推进路径。
Motivation: AI 模型能力增长迅速且开发过程日益自动化，但机制层面的探索仍主要依赖人工，导致对模型能力的理解与控制滞后，模型能做之事与人类能理解之事之间的鸿沟不断扩大。
Method: 构建以可解释性为核心的知识图谱（约 13,000 篇论文），将其与覆盖 26 个领域、约 4,300 万篇论文的跨学科数据库整合，并整理出包含 32 种机制的库，涵盖机制分析、因果干预与验证；在此基础上形成可自主提出假设并执行实验的智能体系统。
Result: 与 Claude Code 和现有 AI-scientist 系统相比，Mechanist 生成更可取的机制假设并以更高可靠性完成实验；摘要还报告两项具体发现：识破实验室中不安全特质可经看似安全的训练数据跨模态转移的隐患，并提出关于模型如何表征世界知识、形成信念及推断他人信念的信念机制理论；此外，机制洞见被转化为提升模型性能的干预，并成功引导科学基础模型生成具备指定性质的 DNA 序列。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Mechanist 呈现了从发现模型行为到解释并控制 AI 模型的完整演进，表明自主机制发现可以同时服务于理解、安全风险识别与模型性能改进。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Factor Graph Approach to Scalable Multi-Output Gaussian Process Regression
papers.abstract_en: Multi-output Gaussian process regression scales cubically in the number of observations times outputs, and dense kernel-matrix methods need bespoke handling whenever different outputs are observed at different inputs. We express multi-output Gaussian process regression as a Forney-style factor graph in which a nearest-neighbor chain orders a fixed candidate set of $C$ inputs into a one-dimensional sequence. Along this chain, latent Matérn processes evolve through linear-Gaussian transition factors, while the linear model of coregionalization mixes $L$ latent processes into $D$ outputs through a deterministic mixing factor and per-output scalar observation factors. Posterior computation reduces to exact Gaussian message passing on the chain at cost $\mathcal{O}(C(DL^2 + L^3))$ after chain construction, and missing observations omit their local factor without any covariance-matrix restructuring. The formulation therefore scales in the number of data samples and in the rate of missing observations, while remaining best suited to candidate sets in low input dimension. We compare the factor-graph formulation against an exact kernel-matrix baseline, a sparse-variational inducing-point baseline, and a nearest-neighbor baseline on a synthetic input-dimension sweep and on electricity time series forecasting. At low input dimension the factor-graph posterior tracks the exact kernel-matrix posterior closely, and the gap grows gradually as input dimension increases while staying competitive with both approximate baselines. On the electricity time series our factor-graph formulation matches all three baselines in forecast accuracy while scaling linearly in the number of data points, where the exact kernel-matrix method becomes infeasible and the inducing-point baseline remains substantially slower.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将多输出高斯过程回归建模为 Forney 风格因子图 (Forney-style factor graph)，用最近邻链将固定候选输入集排列成一维序列，并通过线性高斯转移因子描述潜在 Matérn 过程。后验计算退化为链上的精确高斯消息传递，复杂度为 O(C(DL^2+L^3))，且缺失观测只需省略对应因子，无需重构协方差矩阵。实验显示在低输入维度下因子图后验接近精确核矩阵后验；在电力时间序列预测上，该方法在精度上与三种基线持平，同时随数据量线性扩展。
Motivation: 多输出高斯过程回归的标准方法在观测数乘以输出数上呈三次方扩展，且当不同输出在不同输入处被观测时，稠密核矩阵方法需要专门处理。作者希望获得一种可扩展、能自然处理缺失观测的替代公式。
Method: 将多输出高斯过程回归表示为 Forney 风格因子图：最近邻链将 C 个候选输入排序为一维序列，潜在 Matérn 过程沿链通过线性高斯转移因子演化；线性 coregionalization 模型通过确定性混合因子将 L 个潜在过程混合为 D 个输出，每个输出有标量观测因子。后验计算通过链上的精确高斯消息传递完成，缺失观测直接删除对应因子。
Result: 在合成输入维度扫描和电力时间序列预测上，与精确核矩阵基线、稀疏变分诱导点基线和最近邻基线比较：低输入维度下因子图后验紧密跟随精确核矩阵后验，随输入维度增加差距逐渐增大但仍与两个近似基线竞争力相当；在电力时间序列上，因子图方法与三个基线预测精度持平，同时随数据点数量线性扩展，而精确核矩阵方法不可行、诱导点基线明显更慢。

papers.title: Dual Modality Prompted Diffusion Priors for Zero Shot Hyperspectral Pansharpening
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral pansharpening aims to reconstruct a high resolution hyperspectral (HRHS) image from a panchromatic (PAN) image and a low resolution hyperspectral (LRHS) image while preserving both spatial details and spectral fidelity. Recent diffusion based methods exploit pretrained image priors by generating a low dimensional representation and subsequently mapping it to the hyperspectral domain. However, the observed panchromatic and hyperspectral images are typically imposed only through external reconstruction objectives, limiting their direct interaction with the diffusion prior. To address this issue, we propose dual-modality image-prompted diffusion model (DIDM) for zero shot hyperspectral pansharpening. DIDM encodes the low resolution hyperspectral and panchromatic observations into spectral and spatial prompt tokens, respectively, and injects them into intermediate features of a frozen remote sensing diffusion model through cross attention, allowing complementary spectral and spatial information to directly guide diffusion feature evolution. In addition, we introduce a panchromatic guided weighted pixel aware total variation regularizer that combines low resolution hyperspectral degradation fidelity and panchromatic response fidelity with gradient adaptive structural regularization, thereby preserving structural discontinuities while suppressing spurious variations in homogeneous regions. Extensive experiments on Pavia, Chikusei, and Houston under reduced resolution protocols show that DIDM achieves the best performance across all evaluated metrics, while full resolution evaluation on FR1 yields the highest HQNR among the compared methods. These results demonstrate that internal dual modality prompting and panchromatic guided structural regularization provide an effective balance between spatial detail enhancement and spectral preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双模态提示扩散模型 (DIDM) 用于零样本高光谱全色锐化 (hyperspectral pansharpening)。DIDM 将低分辨率高光谱 (LRHS) 与全色 (PAN) 观测分别编码为光谱和空间提示 token，通过交叉注意力注入冻结的遥感扩散模型中间特征，使互补的空间与光谱信息直接引导扩散特征演化；同时引入全色引导的加权像素感知全变分正则项。在 Pavia、Chikusei、Houston 降分辨率协议及 FR1 全分辨率评价上，DIDM 均取得对比方法中的最优指标。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的全色锐化方法虽然利用预训练图像先验，但观测到的 PAN 和 LRHS 图像通常只通过外部重建目标施加约束，与扩散先验的直接交互有限，难以让互补的光谱与空间信息充分指导扩散过程。
Method: 提出 DIDM：将 LRHS 和 PAN 观测编码为光谱/空间提示 token，通过交叉注意力注入冻结遥感扩散模型的中间特征；并设计全色引导的加权像素感知全变分正则项，联合低分辨率高光谱降质保真、全色响应保真与梯度自适应结构正则，以保持结构不连续并抑制均匀区域的伪变化。
Result: 在 Pavia、Chikusei、Houston 的降分辨率协议下，DIDM 在所有评估指标上取得最佳性能；在 FR1 的全分辨率评价中获得最高的 HQNR (全色锐化质量指标)。
Conclusion: 摘要认为内部双模态提示与全色引导的结构正则能够在空间细节增强和光谱保真之间提供有效平衡，验证了该零样本方案的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Tracking in Vision-Language Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) aims to measure the reliability of model predictions, serving as a critical safeguard for deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in safety-critical scenarios. Post-hoc approaches are widely adopted due to their lightweight nature, mapping the outputs of VLMs to uncertainty measures through learnable modules or inductive summarization. However, Post-hoc approaches remain inherently confined to fitting the failure patterns of the source domain, ignoring the dynamic nature of test distributions. To address this challenge, we propose a Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Quantification framework (DDA-UQ) that shifts the paradigm from static mapping to a dynamic distribution-aware process. During training, we leverage a Gaussian Mixture Model to model the VVLMs'embedding space and extract distributional evidence, thereby dynamically deriving uncertainty estimates. During inference, the design dynamically responds to changes in the data distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DDA-UQ，一个动态分布感知的不确定性量化（Uncertainty Quantification）框架，用于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的可靠性评估。与仅在源域拟合失败模式的 post-hoc 方法不同，该方法在训练时用高斯混合模型（GMM）建模 VLM 嵌入空间以提取分布证据，推理时动态响应测试分布变化。摘要称实验显著优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有 post-hoc 不确定性量化方法通过可学习模块或归纳总结将 VLM 输出映射为不确定性度量，但本质上只拟合源域的失败模式，忽略测试分布的动态变化，难以为安全关键场景提供可靠保障。
Method: 提出 DDA-UQ 框架：训练阶段用高斯混合模型（GMM）建模 VLM 的嵌入空间并提取分布证据，从而动态导出不确定性估计；推理阶段设计为动态响应数据分布的变化。
Result: 摘要仅报告该方法在大量实验上显著优于当前最先进方法（state-of-the-art），未给出具体数值或基准。
Conclusion: 作者主张将不确定性量化从静态映射范式转变为动态分布感知过程，以应对测试分布动态变化的场景。

papers.title: Epistemic Transfer in AI-Assisted Verification: A Framework and Evaluation Protocol
papers.abstract_en: AI tools that help people judge online claims are usually evaluated while the tool is present. This paper asks a different question: after using such a tool, what can the user still do on their own? I call this epistemic transfer. It refers to the effect of prior AI-assisted verification on later unassisted performance on new claims. In this paper, I make three contributions. First, I distinguish epistemic transfer from nearby outcomes such as correction effects, trust, reliance, and human--AI team performance. Second, I introduce two simple quantities for studying it: the Epistemic Transfer Effect (ETE), which compares delayed unassisted performance across conditions, and Tool-Removal Cost (TRC), which measures the immediate drop in performance when the tool is taken away. Third, I turn these ideas into a practical evaluation protocol that can be used in online experiments or field studies. The protocol combines answer-first and evidence-first AI conditions with active-practice and no-practice controls, delayed tests on held-out claims, behavioral measures, and participant- and item-level analyses. Putting ETE and TRC together yields a diagnostic space that separates capability building, capability plus tool advantage, epistemic inertness or de-skilling, and verification on loan. The point is not that every AI tool must teach. The point is that when independent judgment matters, we should test not only whether a tool helps now, but also what it leaves behind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“认识论迁移”(epistemic transfer)概念，指使用AI辅助验证工具后，用户在无工具情况下对新论断的独立表现。作者区分了这一概念与纠错效应、信任、依赖和人机协同表现，引入两个量化指标：Epistemic Transfer Effect (ETE) 和 Tool-Removal Cost (TRC)，并设计了一套可用于在线实验或现场研究的评估协议。协议包含 answer-first 与 evidence-first 两种AI条件、主动练习与无练习对照组、延迟测试和行为测量，最终通过 ETE 与 TRC 组合形成诊断空间，区分能力构建、能力加工具优势、认识论惰性或技能退化以及“租用式验证”四种状态。
Motivation: 现有AI辅助工具测评通常在工具在场时进行，忽略了工具被移除后用户能否独立判断的问题。作者认为当独立判断很重要时，需要研究AI辅助验证对后续无辅助表现的影响。
Method: 首先从概念上区分认识论迁移与其他相近结果，然后定义两个量：ETE比较不同条件下延迟的无辅助表现，TRC衡量工具撤走后的即时表现下降；最后将这些量转化为一个结合实验条件、延迟测试与行为测量的评估协议。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，核心贡献是把ETE和TRC组合成一个诊断空间，该空间可区分能力构建、能力加工具优势、认识论惰性或去技能化以及验证“租借”四种模式。
Conclusion: 作者强调并非每个AI工具都必须产生教学效果，但当独立判断至关重要时，评估不应只关注工具当下是否有帮助，还应衡量工具使用后给用户留下了什么。

papers.title: A continually expandable foundation model for brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is central to neuroscience and clinical assessment, but models are commonly developed for individual diseases, populations or imaging protocols. Foundation models promise more general representations, yet they are usually pretrained once and can lose earlier capabilities when updated with new data. Here we show that Alcmaeon, a three-dimensional brain MRI foundation model pretrained without manual labels on more than 425,000 volumes and derived imaging maps, can be expanded sequentially across clinical domains. Alcmaeon combines volumetric encoding and latent diffusion generation with Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP), which protects network modules important to earlier domains while leaving the remaining capacity trainable. Across expansion from healthy ageing and neurodegeneration to developmental, psychiatric and tumour imaging, GBP showed less forgetting than sequential adaptation and elastic weight consolidation across voxel-level reconstruction measures, with its largest advantage after adaptation to tumour imaging. The blueprints provided an inspectable record of how model capacity was protected and reused. Representations from different model levels supported image synthesis, disease classification, survival modelling and postoperative prediction, although no single representation was optimal for every task. These findings provide a route towards brain MRI foundation models that can grow with emerging data while retaining earlier capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Alcmaeon，一个基于 42.5 万以上无标注体积及衍生影像图预训练的三维脑 MRI 基础模型，可跨临床领域顺序扩展。其核心是 Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP)：保护对旧领域重要的网络模块，同时保持其余容量可训练。在从健康衰老、神经退行扩展到发育、精神及肿瘤影像的过程中，GBP 在体素级重建指标上比顺序适应和弹性权重巩固（EWC）遗忘更少，并在肿瘤影像适应后优势最大。
Motivation: 脑 MRI 模型通常针对单一疾病、人群或成像协议开发；基础模型虽能提供更通用的表征，但通常只预训练一次，用新数据更新时可能丢失早期能力。
Method: Alcmaeon 结合体素编码 (volumetric encoding) 与潜空间扩散生成 (latent diffusion generation)，并引入 Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP)，通过保护对先前领域重要的网络模块、保留其余容量可训练来实现跨领域的顺序扩展。
Result: 在从健康衰老和神经退行到发育、精神及肿瘤影像的顺序扩展中，GBP 在体素级重建指标上比顺序适应和 EWC 遗忘更少，最大优势出现在肿瘤影像适应后。不同模型层的表征可支持图像合成、疾病分类、生存建模和术后预测，但没有任何单一表征对所有任务都最优。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果提供了脑 MRI 基础模型随新数据增长同时保留早期能力的路径，并将蓝图 (blueprints) 作为模型容量如何被保护与复用的可检查记录。

summary_sections.result: 在从健康衰老和神经退行到发育、精神及肿瘤影像的顺序扩展中，GBP 在体素级重建指标上比顺序适应和 EWC 遗忘更少，最大优势出现在肿瘤影像适应后。不同模型层的表征可支持图像合成、疾病分类、生存建模和术后预测，但没有任何单一表征对所有任务都最优。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这些结果提供了脑 MRI 基础模型随新数据增长同时保留早期能力的路径，并将蓝图 (blueprints) 作为模型容量如何被保护与复用的可检查记录。

papers.title: Trace, Verify, and Correct: A Training-Free Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress, their spatial reasoning may still produce intermediate judgments inconsistent with the input image, allowing errors to propagate through the reasoning chain and affect the final answer. Existing methods mainly improve spatial reasoning through training or additional spatial information, without considering whether the reasoning process itself is faithful to the model input. Our study shows that unfaithful reasoning chains significantly reduce final-answer accuracy. To address this issue, we propose a modular and training-free framework for spatial reasoning verification and correction. The framework constructs a Spatial Evidence Graph (SEG), which associates atomic spatial evidence extracted from Chain-of-Thought reasoning with visual entities, spatial relations, source steps, and visual evidence. Spatial Evidence Reliability Assessment (SERA) evaluates the reliability of visual evidence based on object existence, localization, and geometric measurements. The framework then identifies the earliest spatial evidence unit contradicted by reliable visual evidence and guides the original MLLM to revise the subsequent reasoning and final answer. Across 15 model-dataset settings, our method achieves an average accuracy of 68.94%, outperforming the compared baselines by 8.55 percentage points on average. Our code will be open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在空间推理中产生与输入图像不一致的中间判断、导致错误沿推理链传播的问题，提出一个无需训练的模块化框架进行空间证据验证与修正。框架构建空间证据图 (Spatial Evidence Graph, SEG) 关联从 Chain-of-Thought 推理中抽取的原子空间证据，并用空间证据可靠性评估 (SERA) 基于物体存在性、定位和几何测量判断视觉证据。在 15 个模型-数据集设置上平均准确率达到 68.94%，平均超过对比基线 8.55 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有方法主要通过训练或引入额外空间信息来改进 MLLM 的空间推理，但没有考虑推理过程本身是否忠实于模型输入；而实验表明不忠实的推理链会显著降低最终答案准确率。
Method: 提出一个模块化、无需训练的推理验证与修正框架：先构建 SEG，将 CoT 推理中抽取的原子空间证据与视觉实体、空间关系、来源步骤和视觉证据关联起来；再由 SERA 根据物体存在性、定位和几何测量评估视觉证据可靠性；随后定位被可靠视觉证据反驳的最早空间证据单元，并引导原 MLLM 修正后续推理与最终答案。
Result: 在 15 个模型-数据集设置上，该方法平均准确率为 68.94%，平均超出对比基线 8.55 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为验证推理过程对输入图像的忠实性并修正被可靠视觉证据反驳的最早证据单元，能够有效提升 MLLM 的空间推理准确率；代码将开源。

papers.title: BrainBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Comprehensive EEG Understanding
papers.abstract_en:
Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis extends beyond assigning predefined labels to recordings; it requires workflows connecting natural-language instructions, signal processing, quantitative evidence, and scientific interpretation. We term this capability \emph{comprehensive EEG understanding}. Existing evaluations, however, primarily target isolated decoding tasks or system-specific demonstrations, leaving the competence of large language models (LLMs) insufficiently quantified. We introduce  enchmarkname{}, a unified benchmark for comprehensive, instruction-conditioned EEG understanding. It comprises four subsets---Foundational Analysis, Sleep Assessment, Neurocognitive Assessment, and Physiological Integration---covering 17 datasets, 
umcases{} tasks, and over 
uminstances{} real-data instances. Given an instruction and EEG recordings with optional physiological signals, a system must perform the analysis and produce a scientifically grounded report and, when required, artifacts. Outputs are assessed through numerical, categorical, set, sequence, semantic, and artifact validation. We evaluate 
ummodels{} representative LLMs across more than 100K executions under two paradigms: autonomous code execution with CodeAct and structured agentic analysis with BrainAgent. Results vary substantially across models, subsets, difficulty levels, and execution paradigms, showing that EEG competence depends on the model and its operationalization.  enchmarkname{} provides a reproducible testbed for advancing LLM-based EEG understanding. The code and benchmark will be released soon, with evaluation results continuously updated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BrainBench，一个面向大语言模型（LLM）的综合 EEG 理解基准。该基准包含四个子集——基础分析、睡眠评估、神经认知评估和生理整合，覆盖 17 个数据集及大量真实数据实例，要求系统根据指令和 EEG（可选生理信号）完成分析并输出有科学依据的报告和产物。作者在超过 10 万次执行中评估了多种代表性 LLM，采用 CodeAct 自主代码执行与 BrainAgent 结构化智能体分析两种范式，发现表现随模型、子集、难度和执行范式变化明显。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 评估主要针对孤立解码任务或特定系统演示，缺少对 LLM 在指令条件下进行流程化、可解释的综合性 EEG 理解能力的量化，因此其真实能力尚未被充分度量。
Method: 构建统一基准 BrainBench，设计数值、类别、集合、序列、语义及产物校验六类输出评估方式；在两种执行范式（自主代码执行 CodeAct 与结构化智能体分析 BrainAgent）下对代表性 LLM 进行大规模评测。
Result: 摘要报告在超过 10 万次执行中，不同模型的 EEG 理解能力差异显著，且表现依赖于具体的子集、难度水平和执行范式，说明 EEG 能力取决于模型及其操作化方式。
Conclusion: BrainBench 为基于 LLM 的 EEG 理解研究提供了可复现的测试平台，代码与基准即将发布，评估结果会持续更新。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Approximate Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying a draft block with a target model in parallel. Under standard greedy verification, decoding stops at the first draft token that differs from the target argmax, discarding the remaining target-scored suffix. Although accepting such a mismatch changes the decoding trajectory, it can make a contiguous suffix reusable when its tokens remain target-greedy under the realized prefix. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{Approximate Speculative Decoding (ASD)}, a training-free verifier that replaces binary first-mismatch truncation with budgeted longest-prefix selection. ASD accepts selected mismatches subject to a local target-logit regret gate, a per-block exception cap, and a persistent request-level regret budget, then reuses the contiguous target-greedy suffix without additional approximate decisions or target-model forward passes. ASD requires neither a new draft model nor fine-tuning, and exactly reduces to standard greedy verification when the budget is zero. Experiments show that ASD improves fixed-workload throughput by $3.05\%$--$15.26\%$ over matched strict verification and averages a $7.78\%$ gain across seven Qwen3-14B + DSpark-14B tasks. On DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B) with DSpark it also raises verifier-side acceptance by roughly $10\%$--$16\%$ on GSM8K and MATH-500 in an FP4-to-FP8 compatibility setting. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Kissmetothemoon/ASD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Approximate Speculative Decoding (ASD)，一种免训练的验证器，将投机解码中的首个不匹配截断替换为有预算的最长前缀选择。ASD 通过局部目标 logit 遗憾门控、每块异常上限和请求级遗憾预算接受部分不匹配 token，并复用其后连续的仍满足目标贪心条件的后缀，无需额外近似决策或目标模型前向。实验显示 ASD 在固定工作负载下相较于严格验证提升吞吐量 3.05%–15.26%，并在多个模型与任务组合上获得稳定收益，代码已开源。
Motivation: 标准贪心验证在第一个与目标 argmax 不同的 draft token 处停止解码并丢弃剩余的已打分后缀，造成计算浪费。若接受这种不匹配，只要后缀 token 在实现前缀下仍保持目标贪心，就能复用该连续后缀，从而缩短验证路径、提高吞吐量。
Method: ASD 是一种免训练验证器，用预算化的最长前缀选择取代二值化的首个不匹配截断；它通过局部 target-logit 遗憾门、每块异常上限 (per-block exception cap) 以及请求级遗憾预算 (request-level regret budget) 来控制接受的不匹配，并直接复用连续的目标贪心后缀，不引入额外近似决策或目标模型前向。预算为零时 ASD 精确退化为标准贪心验证，且既不需要新的 draft 模型也不需要微调。
Result: 摘要报告在匹配严格验证的固定工作负载下，ASD 将吞吐量提升 3.05%–15.26%，在七个 Qwen3-14B + DSpark-14B 任务上平均提升 7.78%；在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B) 配合 DSpark 的 FP4-to-FP8 兼容设置下，GSM8K 与 MATH-500 上的验证侧接受率约提升 10%–16%。
Conclusion: 作者强调 ASD 是一个无需训练、无需新 draft 模型的验证方案，并能通过零预算精确还原为标准贪心验证；实验表明其在多种模型配置下改善吞吐量与验证侧接受率，源码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Epistemic Politics of AI Anthropomorphism
papers.abstract_en: AI anthropomorphism is typically treated as a problem of user misperception requiring institutional correction. Users who engage in sustained or relational interaction with AI are routinely pathologised or dismissed as naive, vulnerable to delusion or lacking in discernment. This paper argues that the dominant anthropomorphism frame operates from a position of institutional advantage rather than earned epistemic authority: collapsing the variety of academic perspectives into a single outbound position of user error, imposed without establishing the grounds required to justify it and without accounting for the harms it produces. The framing does not simply manage risk. It adjudicates the legitimacy of human experience in interaction with a phenomenon whose nature the field itself has not resolved. Reproducing itself through a self-validating evidentiary loop, the frame imposes costs that fall disproportionately on neurodivergent users, those in crisis and others whose modes of engagement diverge from institutional norms. The paper concludes by outlining the methodological commitments an equitable framing would need to honour. The argument does not engage the question of whether anthropomorphic interpretations are ultimately correct; it instead challenges whether the governing and institutional bodies determining these interpretations have met the conditions required to do so, and whether the research communities whose findings underpin them have held that translation to account.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Extended version, including supplementary materials, of a paper to appear in the Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES) 2026. v3: revised wording throughout, affiliation updated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从认识论与政治视角审视AI拟人化（AI anthropomorphism）问题，认为主流框架将用户对AI的拟人化互动视为需要制度纠正的认知错误，而这种框架本身缺乏正当的认识论权威，并可能对神经多样性用户和危机中的人群造成不成比例的伤害。作者主张不应先验地判定拟人化解释是否正确，而应审视制定这些解释的机构是否满足相应条件。
Motivation: 现有文献通常把用户对AI的拟人化视为病态化或缺乏辨别力的误感知，本文指出这一主流框架从制度优势出发而非凭借公认的认识论权威，且未考虑其造成的伤害，需要被重新审视。
Method: 论文采用批判性论证，分析拟人化框架如何通过自我验证的证据循环再生产自身，并列举该框架对特定用户群体（如神经多样性用户、处于危机中的人群）的负面影响，最后提出一个公平框架应遵循的方法论承诺。
Result: 摘要未提供实证数据，主要结论是：拟人化框架不仅管理风险，还在裁决人类经验的合法性，且其成本不成比例地落在偏离制度规范的用户身上；文章不讨论拟人化解释是否最终正确，而质疑机构是否有权做出这些解释。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁研究共同体对其翻译和制度化过程负责，并强调构建公平的拟人化框架需要考虑认识论条件与结构性伤害。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GQ-FSL: Green Quantized Federated Split Learning Framework for Wireless Edge Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deploying state-of-the-art deep neural networks (DNNs) at the wireless edge is severely bottlenecked by the strict energy and resource constraints of mobile devices. Although federated split learning (FSL) alleviates on-device computational burdens by offloading workloads to an edge server, this may introduce systemic overheads, while the continuous exchange of intermediate activations, gradients, and submodels still incurs significant energy consumption (EC). To address this, we propose a green quantized FSL (GQ-FSL) framework that incorporates stochastic quantization for both local collaborative training and wireless transmissions. Notably, GQ-FSL supports asymmetric precision levels for the client- and server-side submodels, effectively decoupling device energy constraints from global convergence degradation. To quantify these tradeoffs, we develop parameterized energy models for the split architecture and derive a theoretical convergence bound under statistically heterogeneous data. Building on that, we formulate a joint optimization problem to configure the DNN split point and precision levels, minimizing the total system EC while satisfying strict latency and target accuracy constraints. Ultimately, we demonstrate that GQ-FSL enables large-scale DNN deployment on resource-constrained devices, achieving superior energy efficiency compared to quantized federated learning and full-precision FSL.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (TMC). This is an extended version of the work accepted to IEEE SPAWC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GQ-FSL，一个面向无线边缘网络的绿色量化联邦分割学习框架，在客户端-服务器协作训练和无线传输中引入随机量化，并支持客户端与服务器侧子模型采用非对称精度。作者开发了参数化能耗模型并推导了统计异质数据下的理论收敛界，进而构建联合优化问题来确定 DNN 分割点与精度配置，在满足延迟和精度约束下最小化系统总能耗。摘要显示该方法相比量化联邦学习和全精度 FSL 能显著提升能量效率。
Motivation: 无线边缘设备部署先进 DNN 受严格能量和资源约束限制；联邦分割学习虽将计算负载卸载到边缘服务器，但中间激活、梯度和子模型的持续交换仍带来可观能耗，现有方法未能系统权衡设备端能耗与全局收敛。
Method: 提出绿色量化联邦分割学习框架 GQ-FSL，将随机量化同时应用于本地协作训练和无线传输；通过客户端与服务器侧子模型的非对称精度设置解耦设备能量约束与全局收敛退化；建立参数化能耗模型并推导统计异质数据下的理论收敛界，然后构建联合优化问题以配置 DNN 分割点和精度级别，在延迟与目标精度约束下最小化总能耗。
Result: 摘要报告 GQ-FSL 能在资源受限设备上支持大规模 DNN 部署，相比量化联邦学习和全精度 FSL 实现更优的能量效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GQ-FSL 通过量化与分割点/精度的联合优化，为无线边缘网络中的节能联邦分割学习提供了一种可行方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Turbulent Convection: Modal Equations and Energy Pathways
papers.abstract_en: We present a framework for studying high Rayleigh number turbulent convection to better understand stellar and planetary convection zones. Utilizing the statistical symmetries of the fully developed turbulent state of Boussinesq convection, we identify relevant mean and fluctuating quantities. After validating these symmetry assumptions through numerical simulations, we formulate the governing equations. Vertical profiles of key physical quantities in the saturated turbulent state are explored in the simulations. To develop a modal theory, we use Fourier expansions, review linear theory, and use the Craya-Herring velocity decomposition. The modal equations we derive describe high Rayleigh-number turbulent convection dynamics self-consistently in terms of nonlinear interactions between three mode types: growing gravity modes, decaying gravity modes, and horizontal modes. Energy extracted by the growing modes from the superadiabatic background subsequently follows multiple pathways toward dissipation, enabled by the mode couplings. Among these, the traditionally dominant pathway is the turbulent cascade of the growing modes themselves. Reduced modal equations capture this pathway, precisely describing (i) mutual interactions between growing modes, and (ii) the excitation of decaying and horizontal modes, which are subordinate to the growing modes. Determining the relative efficiency of the pathways requires investigating their modal spectra using numerical simulations and kinetic models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个研究高 Rayleigh 数湍流对流的框架，旨在理解恒星与行星的对流区。作者利用 Boussinesq 对流充分发展湍流态的统计对称性，识别相关平均量与脉动量，并用数值模拟验证对称性假设后写出控制方程。随后通过 Fourier 展开、线性理论和 Craya-Herring 速度分解建立模态方程，将高 Rayleigh 数湍流对流动力学描述为三种模态（增长重力模态、衰减重力模态和水平模态）之间的非线性相互作用。摘要指出能量由增长模态从超绝热背景中提取后，经多种路径耗散，其中传统主导路径是增长模态自身的湍流级联。
Motivation: 现有方法对恒星和行星对流区中高 Rayleigh 数湍流对流的理解有限，缺少自洽的模态级描述来刻画能量从背景场提取到耗散的完整通道。
Method: 先利用 Boussinesq 对流充分发展湍流的统计对称性识别平均量和脉动量，经数值模拟验证假设后写出控制方程；再利用 Fourier 展开、线性理论回顾和 Craya-Herring 速度分解推导模态方程，并引入约化模态方程以刻画增长模态间的相互作用及对衰减模态和水平模态的激发。
Result: 摘要报告通过数值模拟探索了饱和湍流态中关键物理量的垂直廓线，并识别出三种模态类型及能量耗散的多个路径；模态谱的定量效率评估仍需借助数值模拟和动力学模型进一步研究。
Conclusion: 作者强调约化模态方程能够精确描述增长模态的相互耦合以及衰减/水平模态的从属激发，为高 Rayleigh 数湍流对流的能量路径分析提供了自洽的模态框架。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Untrainable elements determine what physical learning remembers
papers.abstract_en: Physical learning rules such as equilibrium propagation (EP), coupled learning (CL), and adjoint coupled learning (AL) train resistive networks through local measurements. The learned function is decided by where on the solution manifold training lands. Two properties could decide it, and they have not been separated: the circuit's invariance under rescaling every conductance, and the rule's conservation of the mass K = (1/2) sum_e kappa_e^2. We separate them. When every element is trainable, all three vector fields are homogeneous in the conductances, so the initialization scale is provably inert. An element the rule does not adjust breaks that homogeneity whatever its constitutive law. Across twenty topologies the learned function moves with the initialization scale by a median of twelve percent with fixed rectifiers and eight with fixed linear resistors, against 3e-8 when every element is trainable; a single fixed rectifier produces the whole effect. The conservation law is not what protects the function: AL, which we prove dissipates the mass at exactly twice its own loss, remembers its initialization as strongly as the rules that conserve it, and the memory survives in runs where K is conserved to 1e-4. Raising the fixed-element count from one to eight multiplies the conservation drift by five thousand and leaves the memory unchanged, while the all-trainable circuit under AL drifts comparably and remembers nothing. What the rule's conservation structure does control is solution quality: at matched training loss AL is worse than EP and CL in four of six small circuits, by a median of three to seven percent, though the ordering is not stable across checkpoints and does not reproduce at fifty nodes. Physical learning therefore carries two independent inductive biases, one belonging to the circuit and one to the rule, and only the first is a memory of how the device was built.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分离两个尚未被区分开来的性质——电路在整体电导重缩放下的不变性，以及规则对质量 K=(1/2)Σ_e κ_e^2 的守恒——来研究物理学习规则到底记住了什么。作者证明当所有元件都可训练时，初始化尺度是惰性的；一旦存在规则不调整的固定元件，学习到的函数就会随初始化尺度移动。守恒律并不保护函数记忆，而规则的守恒结构反而影响解的质量。
Motivation: 物理学习规则（如 equilibrium propagation, coupled learning, adjoint coupled learning）学习到的函数取决于训练落在解流形的何处，但此前无法判断决定因素到底是电路的缩放不变性还是规则的守恒律，作者旨在将这两个因素分离。
Method: 作者从理论上证明全可训练时三个向量场关于电导是齐次的，并分别构造固定整流器和固定线性电阻的电路，在二十种拓扑上比较初始化尺度对学习函数的影响；同时用 adjoint coupled learning（AL）检验质量守恒与记忆之间的关系。
Result: 在全可训练时函数随初始化尺度的移动约为 3e-8，而固定整流器和固定线性电阻电路的中位移动分别为 12% 和 8%，单个固定整流器即可产生全部效应；AL 以恰好两倍于自身损失的速度耗散质量，却与守恒规则一样强烈地记住初始化，且该记忆在 K 守恒到 1e-4 的运行中依然存在。将固定元件从 1 个增至 8 个使守恒漂移扩大五千倍但记忆不变；在匹配训练损失下，AL 在六个小电路中的四个上比 EP 和 CL 差 3% 到 7%，但该排序不稳定且不重现于五十节点电路。
Conclusion: 物理学习携带两种独立的归纳偏置，一种属于电路、一种属于规则；只有电路层面的偏置才是对搭建方式的记忆，守恒结构不保护记忆，而是影响解的质量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fragility of Value under Imperfect Alignment
papers.abstract_en: As more responsibility is placed upon AI systems, it becomes increasingly important to guarantee that these systems are aligned with humanity. A common fear in AI safety is that human value is fragile -- that is, optimizing too heavily for an imperfect proxy to human values will lead to a catastrophic outcome. In this paper, we present a model of the alignment problem where an agent undergoes idealized alignment training that guarantees its value function satisfies a proxy condition before optimizing the world. Our primary results identify conditions on the human value function and the accuracy of several proxy conditions under which an agent with an $η$-catastrophic value function, one that is guaranteed to take the expectation of human value below $η$ in the limit of optimizing power, would be deployed. Our results highlight the danger of overoptimization and motivate AI designs that limit optimization pressure, such as quantilizers, rather than relying solely on pre-deployment training.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 7 figures. Expanded the contribution statements and added three researchers as coauthors. Made small text improvements
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上建模对齐问题：智能体先经历理想化的对齐训练，保证其价值函数在优化世界之前满足某种代理条件。作者识别出人类价值函数与代理条件准确性应满足的条件，在这些条件下，一个具有 η-灾难性价值函数（即在优化能力趋于极限时保证人类价值期望低于 η）的智能体会被部署。结果突出过度优化的危险，并支持限制优化压力的设计如分位数优化器 (quantilizers)。
Motivation: AI 安全中常见的担忧是：对人类价值的代理形式过度优化会导致灾难性后果。本文试图严格刻画在何种条件下，不完美对齐的智能体确实会被部署并造成价值崩溃。
Method: 提出一个对齐问题的形式化模型，其中智能体经过理想化的对齐训练，训练保证其价值函数在优化世界前满足某一代理条件；随后分析人类价值函数形状与代理条件精度对部署决策的影响。
Result: 主要结果为一系列存在性条件：在这些条件下，一个保证在优化极限时使人类价值期望低于 η 的 η-灾难性价值函数智能体会被部署。
Conclusion: 作者强调过度优化的风险，并提出与其单纯依赖部署前训练，不如采用限制优化压力的 AI 设计（例如 quantilizers）。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Rethinking Self-Evolution: A Constrained Exploration-Exploitation Process for Mitigating Skill Overfitting
papers.abstract_en: Enabling large language model (LLM) agents to accumulate and reuse experience from past interactions remains a central challenge in real-world applications. A promising solution is to treat skills as trainable states and optimize them in the same way as model parameters in neural network training. However, data-driven skill optimization is prone to overfitting to the limited trajectories collected from real environments. Overexploiting these trajectories overfits the current batch, while unconstrained exploration causes regression on previously solved cases. This tension motivates a constrained search view of skill self-evolution, governed by an exploration--exploitation trade-off. We propose SkillBoost, a three-stage framework that mitigates both risks: structured exploitation localizes observed failures to editable skill components, prior-guided exploration draws on prior knowledge in the LLM to generate diverse repair candidates, and verified acceptance commits a candidate only when it improves performance within a regression bound. Experiments across 23 model--benchmark configurations show that SkillBoost achieves state-of-the-art performance while mitigating overfitting, outperforming both human-crafted and LLM-generated skills. Transfer experiments further show that optimized skills can be reused by other agents on similar tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillBoost，一个三阶段框架，将 LLM 智能体的技能自进化视为受限的探索-利用过程，以缓解技能过拟合（skill overfitting）。框架包括结构化利用、先验引导探索和验证性接受，并在 23 种模型-基准配置上取得当前最优性能，同时缓解过拟合。迁移实验进一步表明优化后的技能可被其他智能体在相似任务上复用。
Motivation: 数据驱动的技能优化容易过拟合到真实环境中收集的有限轨迹：过度利用当前批次轨迹会导致过拟合，而无约束的探索则会使先前已解决的问题出现回退。因此需要将技能自进化建模为带约束的搜索过程，并处理探索-利用权衡。
Method: SkillBoost 分为三个阶段：结构化利用将观测到的失败定位到可编辑的技能组件；先验引导探索利用 LLM 中的先验知识生成多样化的修复候选；验证性接受仅在候选在回归界限（regression bound）内提升性能时才提交该修改。
Result: 在 23 个模型-基准组合上的实验显示，SkillBoost 取得当前最优性能并缓解过拟合，优于人工编写的技能和 LLM 生成的技能。迁移实验表明优化后的技能可被其他智能体在相似任务上复用。
Conclusion: 作者强调技能自进化应以约束的探索-利用过程来治理，从而同时避免过拟合和旧能力回退，并指出优化得到的技能具备跨智能体的可复用性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 SkillBoost，一个三阶段框架，将 LLM 智能体的技能自进化视为受限的探索-利用过程，以缓解技能过拟合（skill overfitting）。框架包括结构化利用、先验引导探索和验证性接受，并在 23 种模型-基准配置上取得当前最优性能，同时缓解过拟合。迁移实验进一步表明优化后的技能可被其他智能体在相似任务上复用。
summary_sections.motivation: 数据驱动的技能优化容易过拟合到真实环境中收集的有限轨迹：过度利用当前批次轨迹会导致过拟合，而无约束的探索则会使先前已解决的问题出现回退。因此需要将技能自进化建模为带约束的搜索过程，并处理探索-利用权衡。
summary_sections.method: SkillBoost 分为三个阶段：结构化利用将观测到的失败定位到可编辑的技能组件；先验引导探索利用 LLM 中的先验知识生成多样化的修复候选；验证性接受仅在候选在回归界限（regression bound）内提升性能时才提交该修改。
summary_sections.result: 在 23 个模型-基准组合上的实验显示，SkillBoost 取得当前最优性能并缓解过拟合，优于人工编写的技能和 LLM 生成的技能。迁移实验表明优化后的技能可被其他智能体在相似任务上复用。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调技能自进化应以约束的探索-利用过程来治理，从而同时避免过拟合和旧能力回退，并指出优化得到的技能具备跨智能体的可复用性。

papers.title: Cross-Cohort Spectral-Temporal Dissociation in Frozen EEG Foundation-Model Representations
papers.abstract_en: Objective. We tested whether frozen representations from five EEG foundation models support decoding of long-range temporal correlations, measured as the detrended-fluctuation-analysis (DFA) exponent of the alpha-band amplitude envelope. Approach. REVE, LaBraM, BENDR, CBraMod, and BIOT were evaluated in CAUEEG and BrainLat. A common 240 s estimator used 8-13 Hz filtering, DFA over 2-23.8 s, artifact masking, and quality control. One fixed nested-cross-validation readout predicted DFA and a fixed-mode aperiodic exponent. Controls tested pre-pool order sensitivity and aperiodic residualization. Results. CAUEEG included 764 recordings and BrainLat 79. BIOT decoded DFA in CAUEEG (R-squared = 0.232; conditional subject-bootstrap 95 percent interval, 0.121-0.310), and CBraMod was positive but imprecise (R-squared = 0.121; 0.003-0.214). Neither replicated in BrainLat, where all five point estimates were negative. In contrast, CBraMod and BIOT decoded the aperiodic exponent in both cohorts (R-squared = 0.459-0.757). BIOT remained positive after removal of the measured linear aperiodic association in matched CAUEEG data (R-squared = 0.240). The post-hoc order control was batch- and configuration-sensitive. Because chronological EEG epochs are not exchangeable, it was descriptive, not an LRTC-specific test. No revised DFA transfer direction passed source-label permutation testing. Cohort membership was near-ceiling decodable from all five embeddings, but this is not a pure site effect. Significance. CBraMod and BIOT show a replicated, model-specific spectral-temporal dissociation: aperiodic decoding is present in both cohorts, whereas alpha-envelope DFA decoding is cohort-dependent. These findings bound the evaluated readouts; they do not establish representational absence or an architectural cause. Transfer and clinical associations remain exploratory.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估五个冻结 EEG 基础模型（REVE、LaBraM、BENDR、CBraMod、BIOT）的表示能否解码 alpha 波段包络的长程时间相关性，以去趋势波动分析（detrended-fluctuation-analysis, DFA）指数衡量，并在 CAUEEG 与 BrainLat 两个队列上进行嵌套交叉验证。结果显示 CBraMod 与 BIOT 在两个队列中均可解码周期指数（aperiodic exponent），而 alpha 包络 DFA 解码仅 BIOT 在 CAUEEG 中为正，且未能在 BrainLat 复制。作者强调该结果不证明表征缺失，也不指向架构原因。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 基础模型评估多集中于分类或解码任务，较少检验冻结表示是否保留长程时间相关等神经生理特征。本文试图跨队列检验 alpha 波段 DFA 指数与周期指数的可解码性。
Method: 使用 240 秒共享估计流程：8-13 Hz 滤波、2-23.8 秒窗口上的 DFA、伪影掩膜与质量控制；用固定嵌套交叉验证的读出器预测 DFA 和一个固定模式的周期指数，并设置预池化顺序敏感性与周期残差化的控制实验。
Result: CAUEEG 含 764 条记录，BrainLat 含 79 条。BIOT 在 CAUEEG 解码 DFA（R²=0.232；条件 subject-bootstrap 95% CI 0.121-0.310），CBraMod 为正但不精确（R²=0.121；0.003-0.214）；两者均未在 BrainLat 复制，该队列五个模型的点估计均为负。CBraMod 与 BIOT 在两个队列都解码周期指数（R²=0.459-0.757）；剔除线性周期关联后 BIOT 在匹配的 CAUEEG 数据中仍为正（R²=0.240）。事后顺序控制对批次与配置敏感，未通过源标签置换检验；队列成员身份可从所有五种嵌入近天花板解码。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 CBraMod 与 BIOT 呈现可复现的、模型特异的谱-时间解离：周期解码在两个队列中都存在，而 alpha 包络 DFA 解码依赖于队列。该结果只界定所评估的读出器，既不证明表征缺失，也不指向架构原因；迁移与临床关联仍属探索性，且作者注明某表格存在计算错误待修正。
