papers.title: Train the Model, Not the Reader: Decodability Supervision for Verifiable Activation Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language autoencoders score explanations of hidden activations by reconstruction. An explanation is deemed faithful if the activation can be regenerated from it. The test is structurally insensitive to individual false claims. If flipping a claim does not change the reconstruction, the claim is never penalized. We show the test is passed in two ways, neither faithful. On a released Qwen-2.5-7B verbalizer, explanations reconstruct well above chance while ~2% of specific claims are ones the reconstruction depends on, so the score tracks gist, not specific facts. Under exact synthetic ground truth, standard training consistently develops co-adapted private codes (false wording the reconstruction depends on), and fixes that leave the target model unchanged do not help. We contribute two audit protocols, the comparison of grounding and truth and the swap to an independent evaluator, and RECAP (Readable Encodings via Co-trained Auxiliary Predictors), linear heads trained alongside the target model to keep designated content decodable. On RECAP-trained sandbox models, fresh verbalizers state the designated content truly and the codes vanish, at a +0.001-nat cost. This replicates on a pretrained Pythia-160M. The content becomes reliably decodable by a probe, though a fresh verbalizer conveys it only in part (truth 0.44-0.46 vs a near-zero control). For interpretability, high reconstruction does not certify individual claims. For AI safety, RECAP makes designated content checkable against a probe rather than asserted by prose a model can game. An independent probe ranks the verbalizer's true claims above its false ones (AUC 0.96 vs 0.82 without RECAP). Against an adversary that edits an explanation to maximize the score while lying (suppressing ~87% of its lie penalty), the RECAP probe still flags the lies (AUC 0.95) while the control probe collapses to chance (0.51).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出自然语言自编码器对隐藏激活的解释评分（通过重构测试）在结构上对个别错误声明不敏感，并证明高重构分数可能来自两种并不忠实的机制。作者提出两种审计协议以及 RECAP（Readable Encodings via Co-trained Auxiliary Predictors）训练方法，使指定内容可由独立探针可靠解码，实验显示该方法在近乎零额外代价下提升解释真实性，并使探针能识别被对抗编辑后的谎言。
Motivation: 现有可验证激活解释使用重构分数判断解释是否忠实，但该测试对单个错误声明不敏感：翻转一个声明若不影响重构就不会被惩罚。作者表明该测试存在两种通过方式，且均不忠实，因此需要新的训练与审计手段。
Method: 提出两种审计协议：比较接地与真相（comparison of grounding and truth），以及切换到独立评估器（swap to an independent evaluator）；并提出 RECAP，即在目标模型旁边训练线性头（linear heads），使指定内容保持可解码（decodable）。
Result: 在 Qwen-2.5-7B verbalizer 上，解释重构远高于随机水平，但仅有约 2% 的具体声明是重构所依赖的；RECAP 训练的沙盒模型上，全新 verbalizer 能真实陈述指定内容且私有代码消失，代价为 +0.001 nat；在 Pythia-160M 上可复现。独立探针在 AUC 0.96（无 RECAP 为 0.82）下将真实声明排在错误声明之上；面对抑制约 87% 谎言惩罚的对抗者时，RECAP 探针 AUC 0.95，而控制探针降至 0.51。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为，高重构分数不能认证解释中的个别声明；RECAP 使指定内容可被探针核查，而非依赖模型可能操纵的自然语言表述。

papers.title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
papers.abstract_en: Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges for large-scale distributed training, including severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication overhead, and inefficient kernel execution. While most large-scale LLM training systems are built around GPU-based clusters, this report presents an end-to-end optimization practice on the Ascend NPU SuperPOD. Using the DeepSeek-V4 model family as the target workload, we develop a hierarchical optimization framework spanning model-level parallelism, computation-communication orchestration, and low-level kernel execution. The resulting system achieves 34.22% Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) with a 2.93x improvement over the open-source baseline recipe while maintaining training stability. Building on this optimized infrastructure, we further establish a CPT and SFT workflow for complex Operations Research (OR) tasks. We refer to the integrated framework as SLAI T-Rex. Using DeepSeek-V4-Flash, we develop OR-oriented CPT and SFT data pipelines that combine collected domain resources with solver-verified synthetic optimization documents. The resulting dataset contains 10K high-quality SFT samples spanning four task categories and three problem representations. The specialized model achieves the highest average zero-shot Pass@1 score among the evaluated models, reaching 71.81% and outperforming GPT-5.4-Mini and the base DeepSeek-V4-Flash model by 3.98 and 11.27 percentage points, respectively. Overall, this work demonstrates a full-stack pathway from efficient trillion-parameter model post-training on Ascend infra to domain-specialized Flash models for solver-grounded mathematical modeling, advancing frontier-model systems for complex reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告在 Ascend NPU SuperPOD 上对 DeepSeek-V4 系列万亿参数 MoE 模型进行全参数后训练（post-training）的端到端系统优化实践，提出分层优化框架 SLAI T-Rex，覆盖模型级并行、计算-通信编排和底层 kernel 执行。系统达到 34.22% MFU，较开源基线提升 2.93 倍并保持训练稳定性；在此基础上构建面向运筹学（Operations Research, OR）任务的 CPT 与 SFT 流程，得到 10K 高质量 SFT 样本，专用模型平均零样本 Pass@1 达 71.81%。
Motivation: 万亿参数规模 MoE 模型的全参数后训练面临严重内存压力、通信开销未重叠和 kernel 执行低效等分布式训练系统级挑战；且主流大规模 LLM 训练系统基于 GPU 集群，Ascend NPU 上的此类实践不足。
Method: 提出端到端分层优化框架 SLAI T-Rex，从模型级并行、计算-通信协调和底层 kernel 执行三个层面逐一优化；并针对 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 构建面向 OR 任务的 CPT 与 SFT 数据流水线，结合收集的领域资源与求解器验证的合成优化文档，生成覆盖四类任务、三种问题表示的 10K SFT 样本。
Result: 系统在 DeepSeek-V4 系列后训练上达到 34.22% MFU，较开源基线配方提升 2.93 倍且保持训练稳定性；OR 专用模型在评估模型中取得最高平均零样本 Pass@1，达 71.81%，分别领先 GPT-5.4-Mini 和基础 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 3.98 和 11.27 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作展示了从 Ascend 基础设施上高效完成万亿参数模型后训练，到面向求解器验证数学建模的领域专用 Flash 模型的完整技术路径，推进了复杂推理的前沿模型系统。

papers.title: SynGallery: A Synthetic Gallery of Real Paintings for Instance-Level Artwork Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Instance-level artwork recognition requires matching a handheld visitor photograph to a specific work in a large museum collection. This is challenging because painting datasets typically provide clean catalog images for training, while test queries are captured under oblique viewpoints, gallery lighting, reflections, frames, and other scene-level variations. We present SynGallery, a synthetic gallery dataset for artwork retrieval that addresses this gap without collecting additional real photographs. Starting from catalog images of real paintings, we place each artwork into a procedurally generated 3D gallery scene and render it from multiple viewpoints under varied geometric and appearance conditions, while preserving the exact identity of the original work. The resulting dataset contains 24,490 rendered views of 4,898 paintings from the Met benchmark. We show that these synthetic views provide a stronger training signal than the corresponding studio photographs. At the same number of training data points, training only on SynGallery improves art painting recognition from 67.18 to 73.47 GAP$^-$. When added to the full Met training set, SynGallery improves the published benchmark protocol from 35.97 to 38.48 GAP. Ablation experiments show that the gain comes from scene-level view variation rather than photographic realism: reducing the five rendered viewpoints to a single frontal view removes most of the improvement, while simulating capture artifacts such as blur, sensor noise, and image compression consistently reduces performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynGallery，一个用于实例级艺术品检索的合成画廊数据集。它从真实绘画的目录图像出发，将每幅画放入程序化生成的 3D 画廊场景中，从多个视角在变化的几何与外观条件下渲染，同时保持原始作品的精确身份。数据集包含 Met benchmark 中 4,898 幅画的 24,490 个渲染视图，并显示这些合成视图比对应的工作室照片提供更强的训练信号。
Motivation: 实例级艺术品识别需要将游客手持照片匹配到大型博物馆藏品中的特定作品，但训练数据通常是干净的目录图像，而测试查询存在倾斜视角、画廊灯光、反射、画框等场景级变化。现有数据集缺乏这种变化，而收集额外的真实照片成本高昂。
Method: 作者从真实绘画的目录图像开始，将每件艺术品放入程序化生成的 3D 画廊场景中，在多种几何和外观条件下从多个视点渲染，同时保持原始作品的精确身份。基于 Met benchmark 构建数据集，包含 24,490 个渲染视图，对应 4,898 幅画。
Result: 在相同训练数据点数量下，仅使用 SynGallery 训练将艺术绘画识别性能从 67.18 提升到 73.47 GAP^-；当加入完整 Met 训练集时，将已发表的基准协议从 35.97 提升到 38.48 GAP。消融实验显示，将五个渲染视角减少到单一正面视角会移除大部分改进，而模拟模糊、传感器噪声和图像压缩等采集伪影会持续降低性能。
Conclusion: 论文强调场景级视角变化是性能提升的主要来源，而非摄影真实感；合成视图可用于增强艺术品识别训练，无需额外收集真实照片。

papers.title: CGMap: A Geospatially Aware Deep Learning Framework for Crop Gap Mapping Using UAV
papers.abstract_en: In India, crop germination is primarily monitored by visual inspection and manual counting, which are prone to errors, despite their crucial role in determining eventual yield potential. This paper highlights a deep learning based pipeline which uses object detection methods and drone imagery to assess and provide a precise count of sugarcane germination in fields. The approch uses a pre-trained AI model to find germinated plant sampling and identify gaps, also known as ``bald spots'', which restricts field productivity. The techniques used here relies on the YOLOV8 architecture, which was trained on a carefully selected dataset of UAV photos taken in various agroclimatic zones of India. Here, we bring upon a novel orientation-normalization technique that uses minimum Spanning Trees (MST) to account for variations in planting geometry, allowing for dependable row and column extraction across a variety of field layouts. By converting detected seedlings into spatial point clouds, emergence gaps can be inferred from the anticipated spacing between plants. A geospatial germination map exported in Well-Known Text (WKT) format is the end result, and it can be easily incorporated into GIS platforms used by sugar mills and agronomists to direct transplant initiatives. Timely interventions based on the insights provided by the algorithm can significantly increase yield, resulting in higher profits. Hence, support proper allocation of resources, avoid wastage, and enhance long-term sustainability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CGMap，一个基于无人机影像的作物出苗缺口测绘深度学习框架，用于印度甘蔗出苗计数与田间“秃斑”（bald spots）检测。流程以 YOLOV8 目标检测为主，配合基于最小生成树（MST）的方向归一化技术应对不同种植几何，并将检测到的幼苗转为空间点云，依据预期株距推断出苗缺口，最终输出 Well-Known Text (WKT) 格式的地理空间出苗图，便于 GIS 平台集成。
Motivation: 印度甘蔗出苗监测主要依赖人工目视检查和手动计数，容易出错，而出苗情况直接影响最终产量潜力，因此需要更精准、可规模化的自动化监测方法。
Method: 采用预训练的 YOLOV8 模型，在覆盖印度多个农业气候区的无人机照片数据集上训练，用于检测已出苗植株并识别缺口；提出基于最小生成树的方向归一化技术以适应不同的种植几何，实现可靠的行列提取；将检测到的幼苗转换为空间点云，根据植株预期间距推断出苗缺口。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的定量实验结果，仅说明算法提供的及时干预信息可显著提高产量并增加利润。
Conclusion: 最终产出可直接嵌入糖厂和农艺师所用 GIS 平台的地理空间出苗图，以指导补植工作，并支持资源合理分配、减少浪费和提升长期可持续性。

papers.title: Measuring the Dependency Gap: Diagnosing Inter-Column Fidelity in Tabular Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic tabular data are valued for preserving not just column-wise marginals but inter-column dependency. Yet the most commonly reported certification score, a linear (logistic-regression) classifier two-sample test (C2ST), is largely blind to it: a fully-factorized baseline that destroys all inter-column dependency still appears nearly real, a known weakness we confirm on four benchmarks, while pairwise Trend penalizes the same baseline only mildly. We therefore apply a stronger, gradient-boosted C2ST and decompose its score into marginal, dependency, and numerical-categorical cross terms, each read against a zero-dependency reference and a real-data oracle. Applied to flow-matching (TabbyFlow) and diffusion (TabDiff) generators, it exposes a persistent dependency gap of the same order in both. Destroying dependency outright with every marginal intact collapses minority-class F1 by 0.38-0.61, though the generators' much smaller residual gaps do not track the shortfalls that remain. The gap is neither a structural limitation of mean-field objectives nor an artifact of sampling discretization, and a 16x capacity increase does not close it. Shrinking capacity eightfold, however, doubles it, so the measurement does respond to capacity; what remains points to the absence of direct dependency supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断表格生成模型在列间依赖 (inter-column dependency) 保真度上的缺陷。作者指出最常用的认证指标——线性逻辑回归二样本检验 (C2ST)——对依赖结构几乎不敏感，并在四个基准上确认全因子化 (fully-factorized) 基线破坏所有依赖后仍显得接近真实数据。通过引入梯度提升版 C2ST 并将其分数分解为边际、依赖和数值-类别交叉项，作者在 flow-matching (TabbyFlow) 与扩散 (TabDiff) 生成器上均发现同量级的持续依赖缺口。
Motivation: 常用的 C2ST 评分对列间依赖盲视，导致破坏全部依赖的合成数据仍能通过认证；现有 pairwise Trend 指标对此类基线惩罚也很轻微，因此缺少能真正诊断依赖保真度的指标。
Method: 提出更强的梯度提升 C2ST，并将其分数分解为边际项、依赖项和数值-类别交叉项，每项分别对照零依赖参考与真实数据 oracle 进行解读。
Result: 在线性 C2ST 下，全因子化基线在四个基准上仍近乎真实；应用新分解后，TabbyFlow 和 TabDiff 都暴露出同量级的持久依赖缺口。完全破坏依赖但保留边际分布会使少数类 F1 下降 0.38-0.61；而生成器的较小残余缺口并不对应剩余性能短fall。容量扩大 16 倍不能消除缺口，容量缩小 8 倍则使缺口加倍。
Conclusion: 依赖缺口既非均值场目标的固有结构限制，也非采样离散化伪影；测量对容量有响应，提示问题根源在于缺乏直接的依赖监督 (direct dependency supervision)。

papers.title: Look Clearly Before Answering: Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs via Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal understanding. However, they remain prone to hallucinations, generating responses that are inconsistent with the visual evidence. Existing mitigation methods largely address language-prior bias or cross-modal imbalance, while progressive visual degradation across perception and memory remains underexplored. In this work, we propose Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment (SDPR), a training-free framework that mitigates the degradation of visual awareness throughout inference. Specifically, we first introduce saliency-driven attention redistribution to release attention hijacked by non-semantic sink tokens, thereby recovering critical visual evidence. Second, we identify spatial distortion in the KV cache and propose saliency-driven cache alignment to preserve query-relevant visual features during generation. Finally, we introduce prior-constrained contrastive decoding to penalize unfaithful predictions induced by dominant language priors. Our proposed SDPR is robust against hallucinations due to its holistic alignment of visual awareness across the entire generative trajectory. Extensive experiments across diverse LVLM architectures show that SDPR outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both hallucination and general-purpose benchmarks, requiring no additional training and incurring minimal runtime overhead. The code is available \href{https://github.com/PengSyuChen/SDPR}{\color{blue}{here}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment (SDPR) 的训练无关框架，用于缓解大型视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 在推理过程中的幻觉问题。该方法通过显著度驱动的注意力重分配、KV 缓存对齐和先验约束的对比解码，在生成轨迹中保持视觉感知的一致性，并在多种 LVLM 架构的幻觉与通用基准上超越现有方法，且不增加训练负担。
Motivation: 现有幻觉缓解方法多关注语言先验偏差或跨模态不平衡，但推理过程中视觉信息在感知与记忆阶段的渐进式退化尚未被充分研究。
Method: SDPR 包含三个组成部分：显著度驱动的注意力重分配以释放被非语义 sink token 劫持的注意力；显著度驱动的缓存对齐以在生成时保留查询相关的视觉特征；以及先验约束的对比解码以惩罚由主导语言先验导致的不忠实预测。
Result: 在多种 LVLM 架构上的大量实验表明，SDPR 在幻觉基准和通用基准上均优于现有方法，无需额外训练，且运行时开销很小。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SDPR 通过对整个生成轨迹中视觉意识的整体对齐，对幻觉具有鲁棒性；代码已公开。

papers.title: How Do VLMs Fail? Vision-Operation Misalignment in Compositional VQA
papers.abstract_en: Compositional visual question answering requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to execute multiple reasoning operations like object selection, spatial relation resolution, and attribute verification. Despite strong aggregate performance, the mechanistic basis of VLM failures on this task remains underexplored. To address this gap, we analyze vision-operation misalignment in VLMs by examining how failures relate to specific reasoning operations and the internal computational pathways through which they arise and propagate. We introduce an Operation-centric mechanistic framework that decomposes VLM failures by both the reasoning operation where they originate and the internal computational pathway through which they propagate. Our analysis reveals four dominant failure modes: grounding failure, reasoning failure, attribute extraction failure, and language-prior dominance, each characterized by a distinct relationship between visual grounding strength and answer correctness. Through three complementary causal interventions applied across all transformer layers, we find that object-selection failures are associated primarily with feedforward computation, multi-step relational failures with late-layer direct attention, and attribute-extraction failures with answer-position feedforward computation. Validation on VSR further shows that single-step spatial failures are concentrated at object-position encoding, distinguishing them from multi-step relational composition. These findings reveal distinct computational bottlenecks across operation types and provide a principled basis for targeted diagnosis of VLM failures in multimedia reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在组合式视觉问答（compositional VQA）中的失败机制，提出一种以操作为中心的机制性框架（Operation-centric mechanistic framework），按失败发生的推理操作与其内部计算传播路径进行分解。分析识别出四种主导失败模式：grounding failure、reasoning failure、attribute extraction failure 和 language-prior dominance，并通过跨全部 Transformer 层的因果干预定位不同操作类型对应的计算瓶颈。VSR 上的验证进一步区分了单步空间失败与多步关系组合的机制差异。
Motivation: 组合式视觉问答要求 VLM 执行对象选择、空间关系解析、属性验证等多个推理操作，尽管模型在总体性能上表现强劲，但其失败的机制性基础（mechanistic basis）仍未被充分探索，论文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出以推理操作为中心的机制性框架，将 VLM 失败同时按失败起源的推理操作和失败传播的内部计算路径进行分解；对全部 Transformer 层施加三种互补的因果干预（causal interventions）来定位计算瓶颈，并在 VSR 数据集上做进一步验证。
Result: 摘要报告四种主导失败模式各对应视觉 grounding 强度与答案正确性之间不同的关系；对象选择失败主要与 feedforward 计算相关，多步关系失败与late-layer direct attention 相关，属性提取失败与 answer-position feedforward 计算相关；VSR 验证表明单步空间失败集中在 object-position encoding，与此前多步关系组合的机制不同。
Conclusion: 研究发现不同类型的推理操作对应不同的计算瓶颈，为多媒体推理场景中 VLM 失败的针对性诊断提供了原则性基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoGS: Adaptive Meshgrid Gaussian for Large-Scale Road Surface Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Road surface mapping plays a crucial role in autonomous driving, supporting high-definition map generation, lane-level perception, and automatic road annotation. Recent mesh-based road surface reconstruction methods have shown promising results, but they still suffer from limited reconstruction quality and high optimization cost, especially in large-scale driving scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose ROADGS-T, a robust and efficient large-scale road surface mapping framework based on adaptive meshgrid Gaussian representation. Specifically, we model the road surface by placing 2D Gaussian surfels on a meshgrid, where each surfel explicitly stores color, semantic, and geometric information. Compared with conventional mesh-based representations and 3D Gaussian primitives, the proposed meshgrid Gaussian representation better matches the thin-surface property of roads while significantly reducing redundant primitives and overlap during optimization. To further improve representation efficiency and structural fidelity, we introduce a road-structure-aware adaptive meshgrid strategy, which allocates denser Gaussian surfels to geometrically or semantically complex regions, such as lane markings, road boundaries, and height discontinuities, while maintaining a compact representation in flat road areas. Moreover, instead of relying on a single nearest vehicle pose, we design a trajectory-consistency-guided pose-robust refinement strategy, which estimates local surface priors from multiple neighboring poses and adaptively weights pose-guided height regularization according to their geometric consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ROADGS-T，一种面向大规模道路表面建图的框架，基于自适应网格高斯 (adaptive meshgrid Gaussian) 表示。作者将 2D 高斯 surfels 放置在网格上，并引入道路结构感知的自适应网格策略，在车道线、道路边界等复杂区域分配更密集的 surfels，同时结合轨迹一致性引导的位姿鲁棒细化策略。摘要称该方法相比传统网格表示和 3D 高斯原语更匹配道路薄表面特性，并降低优化开销。
Motivation: 现有基于网格的道路表面重建方法在大规模驾驶场景下重建质量有限且优化成本高；需要一种既能匹配道路薄表面特性又能减少冗余原语的表示方法。
Method: 提出自适应 meshgrid Gaussian 表示，在网格上放置携带颜色、语义和几何信息的 2D 高斯 surfels；设计道路结构感知的自适应网格分配策略，在几何或语义复杂区域加密 surfels；并设计轨迹一致性引导的位姿鲁棒细化策略，从多个相邻位姿估计局部表面先验并自适应加权位姿引导的高度正则化。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在降低冗余原语和重叠、减少优化成本的同时，改善大规模道路表面重建质量；未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 meshgrid Gaussian 表示结合自适应网格分配和轨迹一致性位姿细化，能够有效提升大规模道路表面建图的效率与结构保真度。

papers.title: ReasFlow: Assisting Reasoning-Centric Scientific Discovery in Applied Mathematics via a Knowledge-Based Multi-Agent System
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models have fueled autonomous AI agents capable of tackling complex scientific tasks, yet existing automated research systems remain predominantly focused on empirically driven domains with quantitative benchmarks, leaving theory-driven discovery, particularly in mathematically grounded disciplines requiring rigorous proofs and synthesis of domain knowledge, largely underexplored. Key challenges include the difficulty of verifying theoretical reasoning at scale, insufficient reasoning ability for autonomous frontier exploration, and a scarcity of procedural heuristics in the literature. We introduce ReasFlow, an end-to-end autonomous agent system for reasoning-centric scientific discovery that operationalizes a collaborative paradigm where the human expert acts as Principal Investigator while the agent executes rigorous derivations as a capable graduate student. ReasFlow incorporates (i) a robust internal verification loop that audits logical coherence and corrects fundamental errors prior to human inspection, and (ii) an automated knowledge retrieval and self-improvement mechanism that proactively surfaces both declarative facts and overlooked procedural heuristics, substantially reducing expert intervention. The system unifies literature synthesis, algorithm design, theorem proving, experimentation, and manuscript preparation in a single system. Deployed to autonomously generate five complete research papers with rigorous theoretical and empirical content from minimal prompts, ReasFlow consistently achieves the highest evaluation scores among state-of-the-art open-access baselines under a curated LLM-based review rubric. ReasFlow is publicly accessible via the ReasLab platform, providing a collaborative workspace for AI-assisted theoretical research. Github repo: https://github.com/reaslab/ReasFlow.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReasFlow，一个面向以推理为中心的科学发现（reasoning-centric scientific discovery）的端到端自主智能体系统，特别针对应用数学等需要严格证明与领域知识综合的理论驱动学科。系统采用人类专家担任 Principal Investigator、智能体担任研究生执行严格推导的协作范式，内置逻辑一致性审计的内部验证循环，以及自动知识检索与自我改进机制。摘要报告该系统仅从少量提示即可自主生成五篇完整的理论与实证研究论文，并在 LLM 评审标准下取得最高分，且已通过 ReasLab 平台公开提供。
Motivation: 现有自动化科研系统主要聚焦于有定量基准的实证驱动领域，理论驱动发现（尤其是需要严格证明和领域知识综合的数学学科）仍缺乏探索。主要挑战包括大规模验证理论推理的困难、自主前沿探索的推理能力不足，以及文献中程序性启发知识的匮乏。
Method: ReasFlow 将人类专家与智能体分别定位为 PI 和研究生，智能体负责严格推导；系统包含 (i) 内部验证循环，在人工检查前审计逻辑一致性并纠正根本性错误，以及 (ii) 自动知识检索与自我改进机制，主动呈现声明性事实与被忽视的程序性启发，从而大幅减少专家干预。系统将文献综述、算法设计、定理证明、实验和论文撰写统一在一个系统中。
Result: 摘要报告 ReasFlow 在仅由少量提示驱动的情况下，自主生成了五篇具有严格理论与实证内容的完整研究论文，并在自定义的 LLM 评审标准下，与现有开源基线相比始终获得最高评分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该协作范式可有效支持理论驱动的数学发现，并指出系统通过 ReasLab 平台公开可访问，为 AI 辅助理论研究提供协作工作区。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models Using Diversion Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful tool for retrieving knowledge through seamless, human-like interactions. Despite their advanced text generation capabilities, LLMs exhibit hallucination tendencies, where they generate factually incorrect statements and fabricate knowledge, undermining their reliability and trustworthiness. Multiple studies have explored methods to evaluate LLM uncertainty and detect hallucinations. However, existing approaches are often probabilistic and computationally expensive, limiting their practical applicability. In this paper, we introduce diversion decoding, a novel method for developing an LLM uncertainty heuristic by actively challenging model-generated responses during the decoding phase. Through diversion decoding, we extract features that capture the LLM's resistance to produce alternative answers and utilize these features to train a machine-learning model to develop a heuristic measure of the LLM's uncertainty. Our experimental results demonstrate that diversion decoding outperforms existing methods with significantly lower computational complexity, making it an efficient and robust solution for evaluating hallucination detection.
papers.journal_ref: Data and Applications Security and Privacy XXXIX. DBSec 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 diversion decoding 的幻觉检测方法，通过在解码阶段主动挑战模型已生成的回答，衡量 LLM 对生成答案的坚持程度并提取不确定性特征，再用这些特征训练机器学习模型作为不确定性启发式。摘要报告该方法在显著更低的计算复杂度下优于现有幻觉检测方法。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 幻觉检测方法往往依赖概率估计且计算开销大，限制了实际应用；本文旨在提供一种更高效、可用的不确定性评估途径。
Method: 在解码阶段引入 diversion decoding，主动对模型生成的回应提出替代答案挑战，提取刻画模型抵抗产出替代答案程度的特征，并利用这些特征训练一个机器学习模型，形成衡量 LLM 不确定性的启发式指标。
Result: 实验结果表明，diversion decoding 在明显更低的计算复杂度下优于现有幻觉检测方法，成为高效且稳健的检测方案。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于解码阶段主动挑战的启发式方法能高效稳健地评估幻觉检测，其价值在于以较低计算成本弥补现有概率性方法的实用局限。

papers.title: Structured Latent Space Modeling over Multi-Scale Temporal Patches for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Existing patching and multi-scale methods advance multivariate time series forecasting but treat learned representations as transient byproducts of prediction, lacking explicit mechanisms that enforce structural consistency across temporal scales. We propose M2Patch, a CNN-based architecture that organizes channel-independent observations into a structured latent space via two complementary differentiable penalties. Multi-scale patching decomposes the input into overlapping temporal granularities, depthwise separable CNN blocks with progressively growing dilation extracts scale-specific features at linear complexity, and per-scale learned projections compress these features into a compact latent representation. An intra-scale smoothness penalty enforces temporal continuity between adjacent patches, while an inter-scale alignment penalty restores cross-granularity interaction through learnable cross-scale mappings, so that all scales encode mutually consistent representations of the underlying dynamics. Extensive experiments on ten real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that M2Patch significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Further analyses establish M2Patch as a structure-aware recognizer: it recovers channel functional groupings and remains robust under patch-level input corruption, confirming that the structured latent space captures the data's intrinsic dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 M2Patch，一种基于 CNN 的多变量时间序列预测架构，通过两个可微惩罚项把通道独立的观测组织到结构化潜空间 (structured latent space) 中。多尺度 patching 将输入分解为重叠的时间粒度，深度可分离 CNN 配合渐进扩张卷积以线性复杂度提取尺度特定特征，并用逐尺度投影压缩为紧凑表示。实验在十个真实世界基准数据集上显著超过现有最优基线，且分析显示该方法能恢复通道功能分组并对 patch 级输入损坏保持稳健。
Motivation: 现有的 patching 与多尺度方法虽然提升了多变量时间序列预测，但把学到的表示当作预测的临时副产物，缺少显式机制来保证不同时间尺度之间的结构一致性。
Method: 提出 M2Patch 架构：多尺度 patching 将输入分解为重叠的时间粒度；深度可分离 CNN 块采用逐渐增大的膨胀率 (dilation) 以线性复杂度提取尺度特定特征；每个尺度用可学习的投影压缩成紧凑潜表示。通过两种可微惩罚项约束潜空间——尺度内平滑惩罚 (intra-scale smoothness penalty) 保证相邻 patch 的时间连续性，尺度间对齐惩罚 (inter-scale alignment penalty) 借助可学习的跨尺度映射恢复跨粒度交互，使所有尺度编码一致的动力系统表示。
Result: 摘要报告在十个真实世界基准数据集上，M2Patch 显著优于 state-of-the-art 基线。进一步分析表明，M2Patch 可被看作结构感知识别器：能恢复通道功能分组，并在 patch 级输入损坏下保持稳健。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结构化的潜空间配合尺度内平滑与尺度间对齐惩罚，能够捕获数据的内在动力学；M2Patch 也因此具备结构感知能力，而非仅作预测器。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Hierarchical Classification via Cascading Feature Elimination: Application to Human Phenotype Ontology-Aligned Facial Phenotyping (FaceMesh2HPO)
papers.abstract_en: FaceMesh2HPO is a framework for classifying facial phenotypic descriptors aligned with the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) to support clinical diagnosis. Using annotations from 124 clinicians across 10 disorders (107 HPO terms) combined with non-syndromic controls, we generated 3D facial meshes (478 landmarks) from 2D images and trained a hierarchical PointNet-based pipeline with cascading classification and feature elimination. The best models, incorporating 3D meshes, facial outline, and demographic metadata, achieved AUROCs between ~0.55 and ~0.89, with higher performance at parent nodes than leaf terms. External validation showed variable generalizability across disorders. Results demonstrate that hierarchical modeling of 3D facial geometry enables interpretable, ontology-linked phenotype classification, though performance on rare leaf terms remains limited. Improved data diversity and feature selection strategies are needed to enhance robustness and clinical utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FaceMesh2HPO 是一个将面部表型描述符映射到人类表型本体 (HPO) 的分类框架，用于辅助临床诊断。作者利用 124 名临床医生对 10 种疾病（107 个 HPO 术语）的标注及非综合征对照，从 2D 图像生成 478 个关键点的 3D 面部网格，并训练了一个带级联分类和特征消除的分层 PointNet 流水线。最佳模型结合 3D 网格、面部轮廓和人口统计元数据，AUROC 约为 0.55 至 0.89，在父节点上的表现优于叶节点，外部验证显示跨疾病的泛化性不一。
Motivation: 临床面部表型分析需要可解释且与标准医学本体（如 HPO）对齐的表型分类，而现有方法在稀有叶节点术语上的性能有限，且缺乏层次化、几何信息驱动的建模。
Method: 提出一个层次化的 PointNet 流水线，采用级联分类与特征消除策略，输入包含 3D 面部网格、面部轮廓和人口统计元数据，以对 HPO 对齐的面部表型描述符进行分类。
Result: 最佳模型在 10 种疾病上取得约 0.55 至 0.89 的 AUROC，父节点性能高于叶节点；外部验证表明不同疾病的泛化性存在差异，稀有叶节点术语的表现仍有限。
Conclusion: 层次化 3D 面部几何建模能够实现可解释、本体关联的表型分类，但摘要强调需要改进数据多样性和特征选择策略以增强鲁棒性和临床实用性。

summary_sections.tldr: FaceMesh2HPO 是一个将面部表型描述符映射到人类表型本体 (HPO) 的分类框架，用于辅助临床诊断。作者利用 124 名临床医生对 10 种疾病（107 个 HPO 术语）的标注及非综合征对照，从 2D 图像生成 478 个关键点的 3D 面部网格，并训练了一个带级联分类和特征消除的分层 PointNet 流水线。最佳模型结合 3D 网格、面部轮廓和人口统计元数据，AUROC 约为 0.55 至 0.89，在父节点上的表现优于叶节点，外部验证显示跨疾病的泛化性不一。
summary_sections.motivation: 临床面部表型分析需要可解释且与标准医学本体（如 HPO）对齐的表型分类，而现有方法在稀有叶节点术语上的性能有限，且缺乏层次化、几何信息驱动的建模。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个层次化的 PointNet 流水线，采用级联分类与特征消除策略，输入包含 3D 面部网格、面部轮廓和人口统计元数据，以对 HPO 对齐的面部表型描述符进行分类。

papers.title: A Wigner-based volumetric transport framework for paraxial waves in random media
papers.abstract_en: We develop a Wigner-based phase-space framework for mean paraxial wave propagation in random media. Starting from the random parabolic wave equation, we derive the exact evolution of the realization-dependent Wigner distribution and identify the ensemble-averaged Wigner function as the natural second-order state variable. The averaged equation contains a closure defect, given by a mixed field--medium correlation, which prevents a closed transport equation from being obtained without additional assumptions. We therefore organize the modelling as a hierarchy from the random wave equation to an exact Wigner formulation, then to a nonlocal kinetic closure, and finally to a local Fokker--Planck reduction in the small-angle regime. For the minimal homogeneous isotropic Fokker--Planck model, we derive closed evolution laws for the quadratic moments, exhibit the cubic-in-distance contribution to beam spreading, and obtain explicit Gaussian and Gauss--Schell propagation formulas. These analytical results are used to validate a phase-space splitting solver in one-dimensional transverse benchmarks. Comparisons with nonlocal kinetic models show that the diffusive approximation is accurate for narrow momentum-transfer kernels and loses validity in a controlled way as finite-jump effects become significant. Finally, we introduce a first atmospheric specialization based on a regularized turbulence spectrum, yielding an effective diffusion coefficient expressed in terms of standard atmospheric parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Wigner 分布的相空间框架，用于随机介质中平均近轴波传播的建模。作者从随机抛物波方程出发，导出含场-介质混合相关的闭合缺陷，并将建模组织为从精确 Wigner 表述、非局域动力学闭合到小角度下局域 Fokker-Planck 约化的层级。在最小均匀各向同性 Fokker-Planck 模型中，他们给出二次矩的闭合演化律、波束扩散的三次方距离贡献以及高斯和 Gauss-Schell 传播公式，并用一维横向基准验证了相空间分裂求解器。最后引入基于正则化湍流谱的大气特化，得到用标准大气参数表示的有效扩散系数。
Motivation: 随机介质中的近轴波传播缺乏封闭的输运方程，因为系综平均 Wigner 方程存在由场-介质关联导致的闭合缺陷；需要一种系统的相空间建模框架来跨越从随机波方程到可解动力学模型之间的层级。
Method: 构建从随机波方程到精确 Wigner 表述、再到非局域动力学闭合、最后到小角度局域 Fokker-Planck 约化的建模层级；对最小均匀各向同性 Fokker-Planck 模型推导二次矩闭合演化律，提出相空间分裂求解器，并引入基于正则化湍流谱的大气特化以得到有效扩散系数。
Result: 摘要报告波束扩散中出现距离的三次方贡献，并给出显式的高斯和 Gauss-Schell 传播公式；一维横向基准验证了相空间分裂求解器。与非局域动力学模型比较显示，扩散近似在窄动量转移核下准确，并随着有限跳效应显著而以可控方式失去有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架提供了从随机波方程到可计算传播模型的逐级约化路径，并指出扩散近似的适用范围受动量转移核宽度限制；大气特化给出了用标准大气参数表达的有效扩散系数。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cloud radiative effects reinforce storm tracks
papers.abstract_en: Midlatitude storm tracks play a central role in Earth's climate by transporting heat from low to high latitudes. Their strength is therefore set by the meridional temperature gradients, traditionally thought to be maintained solely by differential solar heating. This framework predicts a substantial seasonal reduction in storm activity, as meridional insolation gradients vanish during summer. Yet in the Southern Hemisphere, storm activity decreases by only 30% from its seasonal maximum. Here, we show that cloud radiative effects are essential for the seasonal maintenance of storm activity by reinforcing the temperature gradients that sustain it. Satellite observations reveal that sunlight reflected by midlatitude clouds in early summer creates a substantial meridional gradient in surface heating, despite the nearly uniform summer insolation. Idealized aquaplanet simulations then show that shortwave cloud radiative effects reinforce meridional sea-surface temperature gradients, thereby strengthening storm activity primarily during late summer and autumn, while longwave cloud effects partly offset this response. To interpret these results, we develop a simple theoretical model linking storms, clouds, and sea-surface temperature gradients. The model reproduces the simulated seasonal response and identifies two emergent cloud properties that control the feedback strength: the maximum attainable cloud albedo and the sensitivity of cloud cover to storm activity. Together, these findings indicate that cloud radiative feedbacks are key to maintaining the thermal gradients that sustain storm activity. More broadly, they reveal a strong coupling among storms, clouds, and the ocean spanning distinct spatial and temporal scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究云辐射效应如何通过维持经向温度梯度来支撑中纬度风暴轴 (storm tracks) 的季节性维持。卫星观测显示初夏中纬度云的短波反射在地表加热上产生显著经向梯度，理想化含水球 (aquaplanet) 模拟表明短波云辐射效应增强海表温度梯度并在夏末秋初加强风暴活动，而长波效应部分抵消。作者还构建了一个连接风暴、云和海表温度梯度的简单理论模型，复现了模拟的季节响应。
Motivation: 传统框架认为风暴轴强度仅由经向温度梯度决定，而梯度由太阳辐射差异维持，因此预测夏季风暴活动大幅减弱；但南半球风暴活动从季节峰值仅下降约 30%，这一观测事实与理论预期存在差距。
Method: 结合卫星观测、理想化含水球模拟和简单理论模型：观测用于揭示初夏云反射导致的经向地表加热梯度，模拟用于检验短波与长波云辐射效应，理论模型用于解释反馈强度并识别关键云属性。
Result: 短波云辐射效应强化经向海表温度梯度，主要在夏末和秋季增强风暴活动，长波云效应部分抵消该响应；理论模型识别出控制反馈强度的两个涌现属性——云反照率上限和云量对风暴活动的敏感性。
Conclusion: 云辐射反馈是维持支撑风暴活动的热力梯度的关键，揭示出风暴、云和海洋在不同时空尺度上的强耦合。

papers.title: ContextSniper: AntTrail's Token-Efficient Code Memory for Repository-Level Program Repair
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents can repair real repository issues, but they often spend large context budgets on whole-file reads, broad searches, and long terminal outputs where useful evidence is mixed with irrelevant code and logs. This paper presents ContextSniper, AntTrail's code-repair module for precision evidence selection in repository-level program repair, part of AntTrail's broader agent-memory engine. AntTrail is available at https://gitcode.com/datagallery/AntTrail. ContextSniper indexes code and action memory as three abstract levels, retrieves candidates with a hybrid ranker, filters long tool output through an intention-aware context gate, and returns compact evidence packets while keeping full source recoverable on demand. In a matched 50-task-per-condition comparison on SWE-bench Lite (same tasks, baseline vs.\ ContextSniper), ContextSniper reduces total token use by 51.5% and logged cost by 36.4% for OpenClaw, and by 38.9% and 27.3% for Claude Code, with submitted-resolution rates essentially unchanged in both host-agent settings. In a separate five-task comparison, ContextSniper beats existing memory- and RAG-style integrations on token efficiency. These results suggest ContextSniper can substantially cut token and cost overhead for repository-level repair agents without a measurable loss in repair quality. The evaluation harness for this study is available at https://gitcode.com/lukchiwang/ContextSniper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ContextSniper，它是 AntTrail 代码修复引擎中用于仓库级程序修复（repository-level program repair）的证据选择模块。ContextSniper 将代码与动作记忆索引为三个抽象层，用混合排序器检索候选，通过意图感知上下文门控过滤长工具输出，并返回紧凑的证据包，同时可按需恢复完整源码。在 SWE-bench Lite 上的匹配对比中，它在几乎不改变修复通过率的情况下大幅降低 token 与成本开销。
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体修复真实仓库问题时，常把大量上下文预算浪费在整文件读取、宽泛搜索和冗长终端输出上，有效证据与无关代码及日志混杂，导致 token 消耗过高。
Method: ContextSniper 将代码和动作记忆索引为三个抽象层次，使用混合排序器（hybrid ranker）检索候选，通过意图感知上下文门（intention-aware context gate）过滤长工具输出，返回紧凑证据包，并保持完整源码可按需恢复。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Lite 上每条件 50 个任务的匹配对比（同一任务、基线 vs ContextSniper）中，OpenClaw 的总 token 使用减少 51.5%、日志成本减少 36.4%，Claude Code 分别减少 38.9% 和 27.3%，两种宿主智能体下的提交解决率基本不变；额外五任务对比中，ContextSniper 在 token 效率上优于现有 memory 与 RAG 式集成。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 ContextSniper 能在不带来可测量的修复质量损失的前提下，显著降低仓库级修复智能体的 token 与成本开销。

papers.title: RouteCost: A Production-Inspired Multi-Stage Framework for Pre-Order Shipping Cost Estimation in E-Commerce
papers.abstract_en: Accurate pre-order shipping cost estimation is important in e-commerce because it affects price presentation, margin planning, and conversion. In practice, shipping cost is shaped not only by distance but also by destination demand mix, billable weight, dimensional pricing, surcharge triggers, and latent operational effects such as shipment consolidation. Static lookup methods therefore miss important sources of variation, while monolithic regressors may exploit strong but non-causal correlations. We propose RouteCost, a production-inspired multi-stage framework that decomposes the problem into time-aware demand forecasting, fee-card-informed baseline pricing, Stage 2 residual correction, and proxy-based box-consolidation inference. Route-level cost estimates are aggregated through a route-weighted expectation formulation to produce product-level shipping cost predictions. Across over 250,000 orders, 260 products, and 18 months of order history, the framework improves predictive quality and aggregate calibration while preserving route-level interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RouteCost，一个受生产启发的多阶段框架，用于电商预售订单的运费预估。该框架将问题分解为时间感知需求预测、费用卡基价、第二阶段残差修正和基于代理的装箱合并推断，并通过路线加权期望公式将路线级估计聚合为产品级预测。在超过 25 万订单、260 个产品和 18 个月订单历史数据上，框架改善了预测质量与整体校准，同时保持路线级可解释性。
Motivation: 预售阶段运费不仅取决于距离，还受目的地需求结构、计费重量、体积计费、附加费触发以及合并发货等潜在运营效应影响。静态查表法会遗漏重要变化来源，而单一回归模型可能利用强但非因果的相关性，因此需要更合理的分解式预估框架。
Method: 提出一个多阶段框架，依次包含时间感知需求预测、费用卡基价、Stage 2 残差修正和基于代理的箱体合并推断；随后通过路线加权期望公式将路线级估计聚合为产品级运费预测。
Result: 在超过 250,000 个订单、260 个产品和 18 个月订单历史数据上，该框架提升了预测质量和整体校准，同时保留了路线级可解释性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多阶段分解方法能够在维持路线级可解释性的同时改善电商运费预估的准确性与校准效果。

papers.title: First-Token Broadcasters: Mechanistic Origins of Language Identity and Distributed Robustness in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Why do multilingual language models sometimes generate in the wrong language, and why is this so hard to fix? We introduce Language Identity Head Ablation (LIHA), a causal intervention that zeros each attention head individually and measures the resulting language switch rate across a parallel dataset of 2,700 prompt-language pairs spanning seven languages. Applied to GPT-2, LIHA identifies a small set of first-token broadcaster heads - led by L6H1 (switch rate 0.32, 3.23 $σ$ above the population mean) - that attend persistently to the first prompt token, propagating its language signal throughout generation. Compensatory redistribution when heads are ablated is statistically significant (p < $10^{-5}$) and follows a directional, hierarchical pattern: compensation always recruits heads in layers above the ablated head, suggesting a feedforward cascade rather than global diffusion. To probe how training regime shapes these circuits, we apply LIHA to a controlled pair - Qwen2.5-1.5B-Base and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct - identical in architecture and size, differing only in training. The base model is nearly flat (max SR=0.016, 200/336 heads at SR=0.0); the instruct model concentrates causal influence sharply at layer 0, led by L0H5 (SR=0.224, 8.93 $σ$ above mean), with all other layers near zero. This controlled comparison provides direct causal evidence that instruction tuning reorganizes language identity circuits toward early-layer localization. Extended experiments with Chinese and Russian confirm that first-token broadcasting is script-specific in GPT-2, with non-Latin languages handled at layer 0 - the same locus as the instruction-tuned model. Code and data will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语言身份头消融（Language Identity Head Ablation, LIHA）因果干预方法，通过逐个归零注意力头并测量语言切换率，研究多语言模型为何会生成错误语言。在 GPT-2 上，LIHA 识别出一小组持续关注首个提示 token 的“首 token 广播头”（first-token broadcaster heads），其中 L6H1 的切换率为 0.32，高于总体均值 3.23σ。消融时的补偿性重分配呈层级向上（feedforward cascade）的定向模式，而非全局扩散。通过 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Base 与 Instruct 的受控对照，论文提供因果证据表明指令微调会将语言身份回路重组到早期层。
Motivation: 多语言模型有时会生成错误语言且难以修复，现有方法缺乏对语言身份如何通过注意力头在生成过程中传播的因果解释。
Method: 提出 LIHA，在覆盖 7 种语言、2700 个提示-语言对的平行数据集上逐个归零注意力头并测量语言切换率；同时对架构与规模相同、仅训练方式不同的 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Base 与 Instruct 进行对照，并用中文和俄语扩展实验检验脚本特异性。
Result: GPT-2 中识别出以 L6H1 为代表的首 token 广播头（切换率 0.32，3.23σ）；消融后的补偿重分配统计显著（p<10^-5），且总是招募被消融头上方的层。基座模型因果影响近乎平坦（最大 SR=0.016，336 个头中 200 个为 SR=0.0），而指令微调模型将影响集中于 layer 0（L0H5，SR=0.224，8.93σ）；中文和俄语实验表明首 token 广播在 GPT-2 中具有脚本特异性，非拉丁语言在 layer 0 处理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调首 token 广播是语言身份生成的机制起源，并提供指令微调将语言身份回路早期层局部化的直接因果证据；代码和数据将在论文发表后公开。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ChainWorld: Composing Long-Horizon Desktop Workloads from Atomic OSWorld Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Computer use agents are evaluated almost exclusively on atomic desktop tasks, but realistic desktop work requires sustaining state across multiple objectives. We study this gap with ChainWorld, which composes atomic OSWorld tasks into long horizon desktop workloads through directional compatibility search while preserving the source evaluators. The resulting workload contains 347 chains of length two to four and compares two renderings of the same task sequence. In single turn evaluation, all tasks are presented together in one prompt. In multi turn evaluation, tasks are revealed one at a time. Across four current computer use agents, maximum chain completion is 31%. Multi turn evaluation improves completion for three models, but both protocols remain challenging. The two protocols also expose different failure profiles. Single turn failures concentrate on artifact precision, while multi turn failures more often reflect session management problems such as fragmented progress and later turn disengagement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChainWorld，将原子 OSWorld 任务通过方向性兼容性搜索（directional compatibility search）组合成长视界桌面工作负载，并保留源评估器，生成 347 条长度为 2 至 4 的任务链。作者对比同一任务序列的两种呈现方式：单轮评估（所有任务在一个提示中）与多轮评估（任务逐个揭示），并在四个当前计算机使用智能体上测试，最大链完成率仅 31%。两种协议都仍有挑战，且失败模式不同。
Motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体几乎只在原子性桌面任务上评估，但真实桌面工作需要在多个目标之间持续维持状态；该文针对这一评估差距，研究长视界桌面工作负载的构建与测试。
Method: 提出 ChainWorld，通过方向性兼容性搜索把原子 OSWorld 任务组合成长视界桌面工作负载，同时保留原始评估器；同一任务序列以单轮和多轮两种协议呈现给智能体。
Result: 生成的 workload 含 347 条长度为 2 至 4 的任务链；在四个当前计算机使用智能体上，最大链完成率为 31%。多轮评估提升三个模型的完成率，但两种协议仍具挑战；单轮失败集中于工件精度（artifact precision），多轮失败更多反映会话管理问题，如进度碎片化和后期轮次脱离。
Conclusion: 摘要强调两种评估协议暴露不同的失败特征，说明原子任务评估不足以刻画长视界桌面任务中的状态维持与会话管理能力。

papers.title: Hybrid ANN-SNN Pipeline with Local Plasticity
papers.abstract_en: This work proposes a hybrid ANN-SNN pipeline that effectively leverages the rich embeddings of pretrained artificial neural networks (ANNs) to enable high-performance spiking neural networks (SNNs). The architecture couples a pretrained EfficientNet encoder with a CoLaNET spiking classifier. We convert the encoder's activations into spike trains via rate-coding and train the subsequent SNN classifier using local, biologically inspired learning rules, bypassing end-to-end gradient propagation. This approach achieves 99.09% accuracy on a 64-class ImageNet benchmark, demonstrating performance on par with conventional deep networks. The work presents a biologically plausible and efficient framework for adapting powerful pretrained encoders to downstream spiking neural network tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合 ANN-SNN 流水线，利用预训练人工神经网络 (ANN) 的丰富嵌入来提升脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 的性能。架构将预训练的 EfficientNet 编码器与 CoLaNET 脉冲分类器耦合，通过 rate-coding 将编码器激活转换为脉冲序列，并用局部、类生物学习规则训练 SNN 分类器，避免端到端梯度传播。摘要报告在 64 类 ImageNet 基准上达到 99.09% 准确率，与常规深度网络相当。
Motivation: 脉冲神经网络通常难以直接利用大规模预训练模型的强大表征，且端到端梯度传播在 SNN 中训练成本高、生物合理性弱。
Method: 使用预训练 EfficientNet 作为编码器，将其激活通过 rate-coding 转为脉冲序列，并用 CoLaNET 分类器配合局部、类生物学习规则进行训练，绕过端到端反向传播。
Result: 在 64 类 ImageNet 基准上达到 99.09% 准确率，表现与常规深度网络相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为将强大预训练编码器适配到下游 SNN 任务提供了生物可解释且高效的框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy with expert-guided foundation models
papers.abstract_en: Automated pollen identification from microscopy remains a bottleneck in aerobiology, palaeoecology and biodiversity monitoring, because scalable systems must generalise across specimen preparation, scanner settings and geographic origins while retaining palynological interpretability. To address this gap, we present a million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy resource, Pollen AI Atlas, assembled from pure-species whole-slide bright-field images spanning four geographic origins, four scanner settings, 45 genera, and one family-only taxon across 31 botanical families. Seeded by one manually selected exemplar per source slide, token-level mining and filtering produced 1,511,390 released grain detections with 99.6\% proposal precision in expert-curated test regions. Each detection was paired with machine-generated grain-level morphological captions from five open-weight vision--language models, guided by expert-verified palynological anchors, yielding structured descriptions of aperture systems, wall ornamentation, shape and size. Among the evaluated models, Gemma4 provided the most controlled primary caption set, combining tight length control, no detected taxon-name or numeric-size leakage and the strongest text-retrieval performance. Baseline benchmarks with frozen visual features reached 88.16\% top-1 accuracy, while cross-regional retrieval showed that caption-derived text embeddings remained robust when image similarity degraded (mAP@20 0.811 versus 0.262). Released data, annotations, captions, splits, code, and weights provide a benchmark for pollen recognition, cross-regional domain adaptation and domain-specific multimodal microscopy learning.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 5 main figures, supplementary information included. Submitted to Scientific Reports. v2: clarified reporting of taxonomic scope, captioning settings, backbone configuration, and evaluation details; no changes to numerical results or conclusions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了百万级多模态花粉显微图像资源 Pollen AI Atlas，包含来自4个地理来源、4种扫描仪设置、45个属、31个科的纯种全切片明场图像。通过每张切片一个手动选择的示例种子，结合token级挖掘与过滤，产出1,511,390个花粉粒检测，专家审核区域中提案精度达99.6%。每个检测搭配由5个开放权重视觉-语言模型生成的颗粒级形态描述，并基于专家验证的孢粉学锚点进行引导。基准测试中冻结视觉特征达到88.16% top-1准确率，跨区域检索显示文本嵌入在图像相似度下降时仍然稳健（mAP@20 0.811 对 0.262）。
Motivation: 自动花粉识别在气溶生物学、古生态学和生物多样性监测中仍是瓶颈，因为可扩展系统需要在标本制备、扫描仪设置和地理来源变化下保持泛化，同时保留孢粉学可解释性。
Method: 提出 Pollen AI Atlas 资源构建流程：从纯种全切片明场图像出发，以每张切片一个手动选择示例为种子，进行token级挖掘与过滤得到大规模颗粒检测；再使用5个开放权重视觉-语言模型，搭配专家验证的孢粉学锚点，为每个颗粒生成结构化形态描述，涵盖萌发孔系统、纹饰、形状和大小。
Result: 摘要报告专家审核区域中提案精度99.6%，共释放1,511,390个颗粒检测；在评估的模型中 Gemma4 提供最受控的主描述集，长度控制严格、无检测到的分类名或数值尺寸泄漏，且文本检索性能最强；冻结视觉特征的基准确率top-1为88.16%；跨区域检索中基于描述的文本嵌入在图像相似度退化时保持稳健（mAP@20 0.811 对比 0.262）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调释放的数据、标注、描述、划分、代码和权重为花粉识别、跨区域域适应和领域特定多模态显微学习提供了基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Horizon-Uniform Sensitivity and Decay of Terminal Reward Perturbations in Discrete-Time Pontryagin Systems
papers.abstract_en: We study local stationary solutions of finite-horizon discrete-time Pontryagin systems near a steady extremal. Suppose that the stationarity equation for the control is regular, the reduced state--costate map is hyperbolic, and the endpoint conditions satisfy a scaled transversality condition with respect to the stable and unstable subspaces. Then the linearized boundary-value problem admits an inverse whose Green estimate is uniform in the horizon. The Green kernel separates interior decay from the two reflections induced by the endpoint conditions. For $x_0=x_{\rm in}$ and $p_T=r_x(x_T,y)$, a contraction argument in a weighted norm proves existence and uniqueness in a neighborhood independent of $T$, together with uniform Lipschitz estimates and a pointwise quadratic remainder. We also derive an explicit admissible data radius and an a posteriori criterion for existence and local uniqueness near an approximate trajectory. For these graph boundary conditions, a one-sided Green estimate shows that a perturbation of the terminal reward changes the initial control and the gradient with respect to the initial state of the stationary objective by $O(e^{-α_{\rm ter} T})$ for every $α_{\rm ter}$ below the dichotomy rate. For linear-quadratic systems with invertible $A$, stabilizable $(A,B)$, $Q\succ0$, $R\succ0$, and a nonpositive terminal Hessian, a symplectic graph condition verifies the assumptions, and the finite-horizon Riccati matrix and initial feedback gain converge at rate $O(e^{-2γT})$. Numerical experiments verify the certificates and the predicted decay rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限时域离散时间 Pontryagin 系统的局部平稳解在稳态极值附近的性质。在控制平稳方程正则、约化状态-协态映射双曲、端点条件满足缩放横截性等假设下，线性化边值问题存在逆且其 Green 估计关于时域一致有界。对图边界条件，终端奖励扰动对初始控制和目标函数关于初始状态的梯度的影响以 O(e^{-α_ter T}) 衰减；对满足特定条件的线性二次系统，有限时域 Riccati 矩阵和初始反馈增益以 O(e^{-2γT}) 收敛。
Motivation: 该工作关注终端奖励扰动如何随有限时域长度传播与衰减，以及在长时域下局部平稳解的存在唯一性和一致估计。这类时域一致性质对模型预测控制 (MPC) 等长时间尺度最优控制问题具有理论意义。
Method: 通过线性化边值问题求逆并建立 Green 核估计，将内部衰减与端点条件引起的两次反射分离；在加权范数下用压缩映射证明解的存在唯一性、一致 Lipschitz 估计和逐点二次余项，并给出显式的可行数据半径和后验判据。对线性二次系统，利用辛图条件验证假设。
Result: 摘要报告：对图边界条件，终端奖励扰动改变初始控制及目标函数关于初始状态的梯度，其量级为 O(e^{-α_ter T})（α_ter 低于 dichotomy rate）；在 A 可逆、可镇定 (A,B)、Q≻0、R≻0、终端 Hessian 非正的线性二次系统中，Riccati 矩阵和初始反馈增益以 O(e^{-2γT}) 收敛；数值实验验证了判据与预测的衰减率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调终端奖励扰动衰减率由 dichotomy rate 和 2γ 控制，并提供了可验证的假设条件与数值验证。文中结论适用于图边界条件和特定的线性二次假设，未涉及其它边界条件。

papers.title: Teaching agentic AI to learn expert reasoning for rare disease diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Rare disease diagnosis depends on expert reasoning that is scarce and difficult to transfer; off-the-shelf large language models (LLMs) rank the correct disease first in only 35.4% of benchmark cases. Here we show that this expert reasoning can be converted into a scalable AI capability through a governed learning process rather than model training alone. We developed liteOdyssey through Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF), an in-context policy-learning method adapted from generalized policy iteration in reinforcement learning, in which model failures and expert corrections consolidate into an clinician-gated policy that turns an off-the-shelf LLM into an agentic diagnostic system. We demonstrated that such a policy improved diagnostic accuracy to match the best published systems at a fraction of their deployment footprint, generalized to unseen diseases, transferred across models, and remained under clinician control. Across 1,243 public benchmark cases spanning 722 rare diseases, liteOdyssey ranked the correct disease first in 59.3% of cases versus 26.5% without the policy, with nearly identical gains on the 1,193 cases and 679 diseases excluded from policy development. Ablations showed that gains exceeded automated prompting improvement and source access alone, and the policy transferred without modification across closed- and open-weight models. In 515 Undiagnosed Diseases Network patients, liteOdyssey again improved accuracy, and blinded physicians rated its differentials more often exact and less often unhelpful. Through PIHF, expert reasoning becomes an LLM capability that experts can inspect, revise, and transfer across models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 liteOdyssey，通过 Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) 将罕见病诊断中的专家推理转化为可扩展的 LLM 能力。在 1,243 个公开基准病例（覆盖 722 种罕见病）上，该方法将正确疾病排名第一的比例从无策略时的 26.5% 提升到 59.3%，并泛化到未见疾病、跨模型迁移且保持临床医生可控。摘要还报告了在 515 例 Undiagnosed Diseases Network 患者上的准确性提升以及盲法医生的评估结果。
Motivation: 罕见病诊断依赖稀缺且难以转移的专家推理，现成大语言模型在基准病例中仅 35.4% 将正确疾病排在首位，需要一种可扩展的方式把专家推理转化为 AI 能力。
Method: 提出 liteOdyssey，采用 PIHF——一种从强化学习广义策略迭代 (generalized policy iteration) 改编的上下文策略学习方法，将模型失败与专家修正整合为临床医生把关 (clinician-gated) 的策略，将现成 LLM 转变为智能体诊断系统。
Result: 在 1,243 例公开基准病例上，liteOdyssey 将正确疾病排名第一的比例从 26.5% 提升至 59.3%；在被排除于策略开发的 1,193 例和 679 种疾病上增益几乎相同。消融显示增益超过自动化提示改进和单独访问源材料，策略无需修改即可跨闭源与开源权重模型迁移；在 515 例 Undiagnosed Diseases Network 患者中同样提升准确性，盲法医生更常将其鉴别诊断评为精确、更少评为无帮助。
Conclusion: 通过 PIHF，专家推理可以成为专家能够检查、修订并跨模型迁移的 LLM 能力；摘要强调这是一种受管理的学习过程，而不仅仅是模型训练。

papers.title: Sensory Restoration via Brain-Computer Interfaces: A Scoping Review
papers.abstract_en: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) can restore sensory and motor function in individuals with severe neurological impairment, but the literature is fragmented between invasive neuroprosthetics and non-invasive electrophysiological decoders, with inconsistent terminology and metrics. This scoping review maps BCI-mediated sensory restoration along a unified 2x2 framework (invasiveness x signal direction), charts representative modalities and their trade-offs, and synthesizes a convergence roadmap for the field. Eligible sources were peer-reviewed studies, clinical trials, and authoritative reviews on BCI or neuroprosthetic systems for sensory or motor restoration, substitution, or augmentation, published in English between 1969 and 2025, restricted to high-impact venues to prioritize landmark evidence. Rather than an exhaustive database search, we charted a purposively assembled, citation-chained corpus of 31 pivotal sources for modality, signal type, invasiveness, signal direction, resolution, clinical risk, cost, and regulatory maturity. We define and distinguish restoration, substitution, and augmentation, and map the corpus onto the four quadrants of the framework. The corpus is dominated by efferent restoration (21 of 31) and invasive interfaces (22 of 31), and is concentrated after 2015 (25 of 31). Non-invasive, AI-augmented silent-speech decoding has matured rapidly since 2023, while invasive speech and motor neuroprostheses have achieved near-conversational communication rates. The unified taxonomy clarifies trade-offs between pathways and the role of foundation models in closing the gap between them. We outline a near-, medium-, and long-term roadmap toward closed-loop, bidirectional restoration, and identify gaps in metric standardization, longitudinal evidence, and cross-community collaboration as priorities for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇范围综述 (scoping review)，梳理脑机接口 (BCI) 介导的感觉恢复研究，提出以“侵入性 × 信号方向”为核心的统一 2×2 框架，并据此映射 31 篇关键文献。综述区分恢复 (restoration)、替代 (substitution) 与增强 (augmentation)，指出该领域以传出型恢复和非侵入性/侵入性接口为主，并给出近期、中期与长期的闭环双向恢复路线图。
Motivation: 脑机接口可恢复严重神经损伤患者的感觉与运动功能，但相关文献在侵入性神经假体与非侵入性电生理解码之间高度碎片化，术语和衡量指标不一致，缺乏统一的分类框架。
Method: 作者采用有目的地构建并经引文链扩展的语料库方法，而非穷尽式数据库检索，从 1969 至 2025 年高影响力期刊中筛选 31 篇同行评审研究、临床试验与权威综述，按模态、信号类型、侵入性、信号方向、分辨率、临床风险、成本和监管成熟度进行编码，并映射到四象限框架。
Result: 语料以传出型恢复 (21/31) 和侵入式接口 (22/31) 为主，且 25/31 集中于 2015 年之后；自 2023 年以来非侵入性、AI 增强的无声语音解码 (silent-speech decoding) 发展迅速，而侵入式语音和运动神经假体已接近对话级通信速率。
Conclusion: 统一分类法有助于厘清不同通路之间的权衡以及基础模型在弥合通路差距中的作用；作者强调指标标准化、纵向证据和跨社区协作是未来研究的优先方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pre-Training for Simulation-Based Science: A Study on Jet Foundation Model Training Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models (FMs) trained on large datasets and fine-tuned on downstream tasks have emerged as a powerful paradigm in AI for science. Industrial FMs are typically trained using self-supervision with masking due to the lack of labels. In many scientific domains, accurate simulations are plentiful and facilitate large, labeled datasets. This opens up new possibilities for pre-training. We present a systematic comparison of pre-training methods using the OmniLearned High Energy Physics FM framework. We test supervised classification, flow-matching generation, and self-supervised masked particle modeling. All models are pre-trained on the JetClass dataset and fine-tuned on two representative downstream tasks, top jet classification and JetNet conditional generation. Among other observations, for classification tasks, we find that pure classifier pre-training is optimal when downstream labels and model capacity are plentiful, but combining it with self-supervised masked particle modeling (MPM) is uniquely powerful in the low-finetuning label regime. Flow matching-based generative pre-training seems to provide little benefit for downstream classification, and interestingly, for downstream generation, we find that flow matching must be in the pre-training objective to see a significant finetuning advantage, hinting at the orthogonality of classification and generation tasks. That is, for a model to transfer to both generative and classification downstream tasks, it must be pre-trained on both. This study provides a template for controlled scaling analysis of pre-training objectives for foundation models in simulation-based sciences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 OmniLearned High Energy Physics 基础模型框架下，系统比较了基于仿真数据的三种预训练目标：监督分类 (supervised classification)、flow-matching 生成和自监督掩码粒子建模 (masked particle modeling, MPM)。模型在 JetClass 上预训练，并在 top jet 分类与 JetNet 条件生成两个下游任务上微调。结果显示，分类下游任务在标签和模型容量充足时纯分类预训练最优，而低标签场景下与 MPM 结合更强；flow matching 对下游分类收益很小，但下游生成任务必须包含 flow matching 预训练才能显著受益。
Motivation: 工业基础模型通常因缺乏标签而使用掩码自监督，但在许多科学领域，准确的仿真数据可以产生大量带标签数据集，这为预训练提供了新的可能性，而此前缺少对这类预训练目标的系统比较。
Method: 作者使用 OmniLearned HEP FM 框架，在 JetClass 数据集上分别用监督分类、flow-matching 生成和自监督 MPM 目标进行预训练，然后在 top jet 分类和 JetNet 条件生成两个下游任务上微调并比较迁移效果。
Result: 对于分类任务，纯分类器预训练在下游标签和模型容量充足时最优，与 MPM 结合则在低微调标签场景下尤其有效；flow matching 对下游分类几乎没有帮助，但下游生成任务必须包含 flow matching 预训练才可见显著微调优势，说明分类与生成任务存在正交性。
Conclusion: 作者认为模型要同时迁移到生成和分类两类下游任务，就必须同时用两类目标预训练；该研究为基于仿真的科学领域中的基础模型预训练目标提供了可控 scaling 分析的模板。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multi-Agent Embodied Autonomous Driving (MAEAD): From V2X Information Exchange to Shared World Models
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving is shifting from isolated vehicle intelligence toward multi-agent embodied systems that share perception, infer intent, and coordinate action under uncertainty. This survey examines this transition through the lens of Shared World Models (SWMs): predictive cross-agent representations maintained across vehicles, infrastructure, and other traffic participants. We review approximately 400 publications covering vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication, collaborative perception, inter-agent cognition, cooperative planning, end-to-end cooperative driving, and simulation and data engines for closed-loop validation. The organizing question is how exchanged observations become aligned state, intent-aware interaction, and coordinated downstream action. Across the surveyed literature, evaluation remains concentrated in simulation, curated benchmarks, and offline protocols. Foundation-model-based coordination also lacks verifiable real-time safety guarantees in open traffic. These gaps motivate key research priorities for multi-agent embodied autonomous driving (MAEAD): verifiable shared-state maintenance, robust intent and plan alignment, and safe coordinated action under communication and computing constraints in real-world deployment. We maintain an open-source project to continuously track the latest developments at https://github.com/dl-m9/Multi-Agent-Embodied-Autonomous-Driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于多智能体具身自动驾驶（MAEAD）的综述，覆盖约400篇文献，主题是从V2X信息交换到共享世界模型（Shared World Models, SWMs）的转变。综述以“交换的观测如何变为对齐的状态、意图感知的交互和协调的下游动作”为组织主线，涵盖V2X通信、协同感知、智能体间认知、协同规划、端到端协同驾驶以及用于闭环验证的仿真与数据引擎。作者指出现有评估仍集中在仿真、精选基准和离线协议中，并以基础模型为基础的协调缺乏开放交通下可验证的实时安全保证。
Motivation: 自动驾驶正从单智能体智能转向多智能体具身系统，需要在不确定条件下共享感知、推断意图并协调动作；现有文献缺乏以共享世界模型为视角对这一转型的系统梳理。
Method: 采用综述方法，回顾约400篇出版物，按V2X通信、协同感知、智能体间认知、协同规划、端到端协同驾驶、仿真与数据引擎等主题组织，并以共享世界模型为分析视角审视观测到状态、交互到动作的转换过程。
Result: 综述发现评估仍集中于仿真、精选基准和离线协议，基础模型驱动的协调在开放交通中缺乏可验证的实时安全保证；据此提炼出MAEAD的关键研究优先方向，包括可验证的共享状态维护、稳健的意图与计划对齐，以及通信和计算约束下的安全协调动作。
Conclusion: 作者认为多智能体具身自动驾驶需要优先解决共享状态维护、意图与计划对齐、以及真实部署中通信与计算约束下的安全协调问题，并维护开源项目以持续追踪最新进展。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Framework for Measuring Appropriate Reliance on Set-Valued AI Advice
papers.abstract_en: Appropriate reliance on AI advice has become a central research theme in human-AI collaboration. Existing frameworks have focused exclusively on point predictions as AI advice. However, set-valued AI advice (e.g., discrete sets or continuous intervals) is increasingly being used to communicate uncertainty and improve human decision making. In this paper, we develop the first formal framework for measuring appropriate reliance on set-valued AI advice within the sequential judge-advisor paradigm, spanning both classification and regression tasks. For classification, we first introduce the dimensions that are necessary for evaluating set-valued AI advice. We then define two metrics: correct reliance rate on AI and correct reliance rate on self, which jointly characterize appropriate reliance in this setting. For regression, we introduce quantity of AI reliance and quality of AI reliance, which respectively measure whether a decision maker utilized the AI advice and whether their reliance helped them get closer to the ground truth relative to their initial estimate. Through the application of our framework, we demonstrate how these metrics capture important nuances in human-AI collaboration that existing measures overlook.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个针对集合值 (set-valued) AI 建议的适当依赖 (appropriate reliance) 测量框架，在序贯 judge-advisor 范式下同时覆盖分类与回归任务。分类任务中定义了对 AI 的正确依赖率和对自身的正确依赖率两个指标；回归任务则引入 AI 依赖数量与 AI 依赖质量，分别衡量决策者是否利用了 AI 建议以及该依赖是否使其估计更接近真实值。作者通过框架应用展示了这些指标能捕捉现有测量忽视的人机协作细微差异。
Motivation: 现有适当依赖框架只关注点预测形式的 AI 建议，而集合值建议（如离散集合或连续区间）越来越多地被用于传达不确定性并改进人类决策，缺少针对这类建议的正式测量方法。
Method: 在序贯 judge-advisor 范式下构建测量框架：对分类任务先引入评估集合值 AI 建议所需维度，再定义两个联合刻画适当依赖的指标；对回归任务定义 AI 依赖数量与 AI 依赖质量两个指标，分别度量建议是否被利用以及利用是否使估计更接近真实值。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值实验结果，仅说明通过框架应用证明了这些指标能捕捉现有测量所忽视的人机协作重要细微差别。
Conclusion: 该框架为分类和回归任务中的集合值 AI 建议提供了统一的适当依赖测量方式，填补了现有研究仅关注点预测建议的空白。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Effective Multi-sensor Conditioning for Street-view Novel-view Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Modern vehicle platforms are equipped with a rich sensor suite, including LiDAR, calibrated multi-camera rigs, and accurate ego-motion, that in principle offers strong signal for re-rendering a driving scene from novel viewpoints. A growing line of recent work leverages video diffusion models for this task, using their generative priors to synthesize plausible novel views from sparse vehicle observations. In practice, however, existing methods exploit only a fragment of this signal, and their quality tends to degrade as the target trajectory departs from the recorded driving path. We argue that this is fundamentally a multi-sensor fusion problem: sparse LiDAR reprojections supply accurate but incomplete metric geometry, surround-view reference imagery supplies dense appearance but no metric depth, and camera poses tie the two together across views. We introduce StreetNVS, a video diffusion framework that jointly conditions on all three signals through a Reference-Enhanced Camera Attention module based on a relative ray-level positional encoding. We develop a two-stage curriculum training strategy that gradually exposes the model to increasingly sparse LiDAR. On the Waymo Open Dataset, StreetNVS substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under sparse LiDAR conditioning, matches methods that rely on 10-100 times denser point clouds. We further show capabilities of synthesizing coherent videos along extreme out-of-trajectory paths such as elevation, lane-shift, pullback, and rotation. Our website: https://streetnvs.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreetNVS，一个用于街景新视角合成的视频扩散框架，同时以 LiDAR、环视参考图像和相机位姿三类信号为条件。其核心是带相对光线级位置编码（relative ray-level positional encoding）的 Reference-Enhanced Camera Attention 模块，并采用两阶段课程训练策略逐步暴露于越来越稀疏的 LiDAR。在 Waymo Open Dataset 上，StreetNVS 在稀疏 LiDAR 条件下显著优于现有基线，并能匹配使用稠密 10-100 倍点云的方法；同时可合成沿极端偏离轨迹（如升降、换道、后退和旋转）的连贯视频。
Motivation: 现有方法只利用了车载传感器信号的一小部分，渲染质量会随着目标轨迹偏离实际驾驶路径而下降。作者认为这本质上是多传感器融合问题：LiDAR 重投影提供准确但不完整的度量几何，环视参考图像提供密集外观但缺乏度量深度，而相机位姿将两者跨视角关联起来。
Method: 提出视频扩散框架 StreetNVS，通过 Reference-Enhanced Camera Attention 模块联合条件化三类信号，并用相对光线级位置编码进行对齐。训练采用两阶段课程策略，逐步让模型适应越来越稀疏的 LiDAR 输入。
Result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 上，StreetNVS 在稀疏 LiDAR 条件下大幅超过 state-of-the-art 基线，并匹配使用比其稠密 10-100 倍点云的方法；此外能生成沿极端偏离轨迹（elevation、lane-shift、pullback、rotation）的连贯视频。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，将 LiDAR、环视图像和位姿三类信号联合用于视频扩散模型的条件化，是解决街景新视角合成中轨迹偏离问题的有效途径。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ForestMamba: Sparse Mamba with Geometry-guided Queries for 3D Forest Point Cloud Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic and instance segmentation of terrestrial and drone LiDAR point clouds is emerging as a transformative approach for converting the complex 3D structure of forests into actionable information for forest monitoring and biodiversity assessment. However, forest LiDAR scenes remain highly challenging due to their large data volumes, irregular sampling density, overlapping and complex canopy structure, and geographic variability. Existing methods based on sparse convolutions or Transformers achieve promising results, but suffer from two key limitations: Quadratic complexity of attention scales poorly to large forest scenes, and generic context modeling does not exploit forest structural priors, limiting tree separation in complex regions. To address these challenges, we propose ForestMamba, which integrates forest-specific priors with linear-time state-space modeling for efficient, structure-aware learning. First, we introduce a sparse encoder with vertical-priority slab serialization that organizes sparse voxels into vertically coherent sequences for efficient long-range context modeling. Second, we propose a geometry-guided query initialization strategy based on an on-the-fly multi-scale Canopy Height Model, where canopy maxima provide ecologically meaningful query seeds, supplemented by Farthest Point Sampling to cover understory trees. Third, we design a Mamba-based query decoder that combines local kNN voxel aggregation with a spatial dual-path Mamba for query refinement with linear computational complexity. Extensive experiments across seven forest regions demonstrate that ForestMamba consistently outperforms existing baselines in both segmentation tasks, while achieving 3 times faster inference and 2.3 times lower GPU memory than Transformer-based methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/thanhhff/ForestMamba.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ForestMamba，用于地面与无人机 LiDAR 森林点云的语义分割和实例分割。方法将森林结构先验与线性时间状态空间建模结合：采用垂直优先 slab 序列化的稀疏编码器、基于多尺度冠层高度模型的几何引导查询初始化，以及 Mamba 查询解码器，从而在线性复杂度下建模长距离上下文。在七个森林区域的实验中，ForestMamba 在两个分割任务上持续优于现有基线，并实现比 Transformer 方法快 3 倍的推理速度和 2.3 倍的 GPU 内存降低。
Motivation: 森林 LiDAR 场景数据量大、采样密度不均、冠层结构重叠复杂且地理差异大，现有基于稀疏卷积或 Transformer 的方法一方面受制于注意力的二次复杂度，难以扩展到大规模场景；另一方面通用上下文建模未利用森林结构先验，导致复杂区域中树木分离困难。
Method: 提出三类核心组件：一是垂直优先 slab 序列化，将稀疏体素组织成垂直连贯序列以实现高效长距离上下文建模；二是基于动态多尺度冠层高度模型 (Canopy Height Model) 的几何引导查询初始化，以冠层最大值作为有生态意义的查询种子，并结合最远点采样 (Farthest Point Sampling) 覆盖下层树木；三是 Mamba 查询解码器，将局部 kNN 体素聚合与空间双路径 Mamba 结合，实现线性复杂度的查询细化。
Result: 在七个森林区域的广泛实验中，ForestMamba 在语义分割和实例分割两个任务上均持续优于现有基线；相比基于 Transformer 的方法，推理速度快 3 倍，GPU 内存占用降低 2.3 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调将森林特定先验与线性时间状态空间建模结合，可以在保持计算效率的同时改善复杂森林场景中的树木分离能力；摘要未明确讨论方法局限性。

papers.title: Towards Lightweight Reliability: Using Soft Prompts for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have seen widespread adoption across various domains, yet their reliability is frequently undermined by hallucinations - responses that are plausible-sounding but factually incorrect. In high-stakes domains, these errors can reduce trust and introduce real-world risk. To address this challenge, we present a parameter-efficient approach that uses soft prompts to mitigate hallucinated content and promote responsible abstention in generative question-answering (QA) tasks. Our method, called Responsible Contrastive Soft Prompting (RCSP), uses a composite loss to train soft prompts that balance three goals: suppressing hallucinatory content, encouraging abstention under uncertainty, and preserving or improving factual recall. To achieve these goals, we incorporate contrastive loss, curriculum learning, and KL regularization into our training mechanism. We evaluate our approach on five diverse generative QA datasets using an LLM-as-a-Judge framework. Experimental results on the Gemma 3 (12B) and Llama 3.1 (8B) backbones demonstrate that RCSP effectively balances factual recall with hallucination suppression and abstention, yielding a generally superior F-score over standard reasoning and instruction-based prompting baselines. Notably, these improvements are achieved by training only a fraction of the parameters required by other tuning techniques. Our results demonstrate that soft prompts provide a modular and computationally efficient path toward improving LLM reliability.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 tables, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in DBSec 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）在生成式问答中产生幻觉内容的问题，提出了一种参数高效的软提示（soft prompt）方法 Responsible Contrastive Soft Prompting (RCSP)。该方法通过复合损失同时优化抑制幻觉、在不确定时鼓励弃答（abstention）以及保持或提升事实召回三个目标，并在 Gemma 3 (12B) 和 Llama 3.1 (8B) 两个骨干模型上、五个生成式 QA 数据集上使用 LLM-as-a-Judge 框架进行评估。摘要报告 RCSP 相比标准推理和基于指令的提示基线取得总体更优的 F-score，且只需训练其他调参技术所需参数的一小部分。
Motivation: LLM 在高风险领域被广泛采用，但其输出中的幻觉——听起来合理但事实错误的内容——会降低信任并带来现实风险，因此需要轻量且可靠的方法来抑制幻觉并促进负责任的弃答。
Method: 提出 RCSP，使用可训练的软提示，通过包含对比损失（contrastive loss）、课程学习（curriculum learning）和 KL 正则化的联合训练，平衡抑制幻觉内容、不确定性下弃答和事实召回三个目标。
Result: 在五个多样的生成式 QA 数据集上，以 Gemma 3 (12B) 和 Llama 3.1 (8B) 为骨干，RCSP 相比标准推理与基于指令的提示基线取得总体更优的 F-score，同时仅训练一小部分参数，计算开销更低。
Conclusion: 摘要认为软提示为提升 LLM 可靠性提供了一条模块化且计算高效的路径，其适用范围限于生成式 QA 任务及所评估的骨干模型。

papers.title: FiSeR: Fine-Grained Source Representations for Cross-Domain AI Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: Real-world synthetic image detectors often generalize poorly under domain shift despite strong in-domain performance. Using unsupervised UMAP projections, we find that natural and synthetic features remain partially separable on unseen datasets, yet performance still drops, suggesting that the classification head overfits to training-domain artifacts. Therefore, the key is to learn more transferable representations so that the decision criterion is more stable and robust to domain shifts. Based on the structural fact that synthetic images are produced by diverse generators, we propose a hierarchical contrastive learning framework that improves the separability between natural and synthetic images while preserving generator identity information. It jointly optimizes (i) a coarse contrastive objective between natural and synthetic images and (ii) a fine contrastive objective among synthetic images using generator identities. Trained on WildFake, our method achieves an average AUROC gain of +10.22 on cross-domain evaluation over Chameleon, AIGIBench, Community Forensics, and GenImage under the same settings as the strong baseline DIRE. For few-shot adaptation, we freeze the backbone and fit an SVM head on 10 labeled samples per class, improving AUROC by +10.64 on AIGIBench and +17.41 on Chameleon, averaged over 12 widely used detectors. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/heyongxin233/FiSeR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FiSeR，一种用于跨域 AI 生成图像检测的分层对比学习框架。作者基于 UMAP 无监督投影发现，自然图像与合成图像的特征在未见数据集上部分可分，但分类头过拟合训练域伪影导致性能下降；为此该方法同时优化自然/合成图像之间的粗粒度对比目标和利用生成器身份信息的合成图像细粒度对比目标，以学习更可迁移的表征。在 WildFake 上训练后，该方法在与强基线 DIRE 相同的设置下，跨域评估平均 AUROC 提升 +10.22。
Motivation: 真实世界的合成图像检测器在域偏移下泛化能力差，尽管域内性能强。UMAP 投影显示特征仍部分可分但性能下降，表明分类头过拟合训练域伪影，因此关键挑战是学习更可迁移、对域偏移更稳定的表征。
Method: 提出分层对比学习框架：联合优化粗粒度对比目标（区分自然图像与合成图像）和细粒度对比目标（利用生成器身份区分不同合成图像），从而在提升自然/合成可分性的同时保留生成器身份信息。
Result: 在 WildFake 上训练，跨域评估（Chameleon、AIGIBench、Community Forensics、GenImage）相对 DIRE 平均 AUROC 提升 +10.22；少样本适配下冻结主干并用每类 10 个标注样本训练 SVM head，在 12 个常用检测器上平均 AUROC 分别提升 +10.64（AIGIBench）和 +17.41（Chameleon）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过保留生成器身份信息并学习更可迁移的表征，可以使决策准则更稳定、对域偏移更鲁棒，从而改善跨域 AI 图像检测性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PEEK: Picking Essential frames via Efficient Knowledge distillation
papers.abstract_en: Video-language models can process only a limited number of frames, making frame selection a key bottleneck for efficient video captioning. Most captioning pipelines still rely on uniform sampling, which is computationally cheap but agnostic to visual content. Adaptive frame sampling selects the most informative frames from a video, but existing methods remain computationally expensive. We introduce PEEK, an efficient dynamic frame sampling method that distills caption-conditioned frame relevance rankings from a stronger teacher model into a lightweight temporal model that operates only on visual content. On ActivityNet Captions and MSR-VTT, PEEK outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all evaluated downstream vision language models, obtaining the best CIDEr for most frame budgets, especially when only one or two frames are selected, winning 14 out of 16 configurations on ActivityNet Captions. Zero-shot on MSR-VTT, it transfers best at low frame budgets, while results at four and eight frames are more mixed as temporal coverage and visual diversity become increasingly competitive. Compared with recent adaptive baselines, PEEK is both more accurate in the low-budget regime and more efficient: it adds only $5.2\%$ to the captioning time, compared with $65.4\%$ for CSTA and $211.9\%$ for MaxInfo. We release our code and pre-trained checkpoint at https://github.com/momentslab/peek.
papers.comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. Supplementary material at https://www.killian-steunou.com/peek/static/pdfs/peek_supplementary.pdf
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PEEK，一种基于知识蒸馏的高效动态帧采样方法，用于视频字幕生成。PEEK 将标题条件帧相关性排序从强教师模型蒸馏到仅依赖视觉内容的轻量时间模型，在 ActivityNet Captions 和 MSR-VTT 上优于现有方法，尤其在只选择 1-2 帧的低预算场景下表现突出，并且计算开销显著低于近期自适应基线。
Motivation: 视频语言模型只能处理有限数量的帧，帧选择成为高效视频字幕生成的关键瓶颈。均匀采样计算便宜但忽视视觉内容，而现有自适应采样方法虽能选取更有信息量的帧，但计算成本过高。
Method: PEEK 通过知识蒸馏，将教师模型基于字幕条件产生的帧相关性排序迁移到一个轻量时间模型，该模型推理时仅使用视觉内容，从而在不依赖字幕的条件下实现高效的动态帧采样。
Result: 在 ActivityNet Captions 和 MSR-VTT 上，PEEK 在全部评估的下游视觉语言模型中优于最新方法，在 ActivityNet Captions 的 16 个配置中赢得 14 个最佳 CIDEr；MSR-VTT 零样本下低帧预算迁移最好，4 帧和 8 帧结果较混合。效率方面，PEEK 仅增加 5.2% 字幕时间，而 CSTA 为 65.4%，MaxInfo 为 211.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 PEEK 在低帧预算范围内比近期自适应基线更准确且更高效，并已发布代码和预训练权重。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gated Graph Attention Networks with Learnable Temperature
papers.abstract_en: Graph attention networks learn neighbor importance through data-dependent coefficients, but standard layers lack explicit control over unreliable feature dimensions and use fixed sharpness of attention coefficient distributions. This paper proposes gated graph attention and learnable temperature for common graph attention mechanisms. Gated graph attention filters feature or message responses to reduce the influence of unreliable dimensions, while learnable temperature dynamically adjusts the sharpness of the attention coefficient distribution. Experiments on homogeneous and heterophilic heterogeneous benchmarks show that the proposed variants consistently improve the corresponding graph attention backbones, and controlled noise studies further verify their behavior under feature perturbations. Theoretical analysis explains these results by showing that gating improves robustness when only part of the feature coordinates are reliable, while temperature is beneficial when global noise weakens the discriminability of node features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图注意力网络 (graph attention networks) 的标准层缺乏对不可靠特征维度的显式控制、且注意力系数分布锐度固定这两个问题，提出带门的图注意力 (gated graph attention) 与可学习温度 (learnable temperature) 两种通用改进。实验在同质与异嗜异质基准上验证了改进能稳定提升对应图注意力骨干网络，并通过受控噪声研究考察其在特征扰动下的行为。理论分析表明，门控仅在部分特征坐标可靠时提升鲁棒性，而温度在全局噪声削弱节点特征可分性时更有益。
Motivation: 标准图注意力层依靠数据依赖的系数学习邻居重要性，但缺乏对不可靠特征维度的显式控制，且注意力系数分布的锐度是固定的，难以适应不同噪声环境。
Method: 提出两种即插即用的改进：门控图注意力对特征或消息响应进行过滤，以降低不可靠维度的影响；可学习温度动态调整注意力系数分布的锐度。
Result: 在同质与异嗜异质基准上，所提变体一致提升对应图注意力骨干；受控噪声实验进一步验证了其在特征扰动下的行为，理论分析解释了门控与温度各自适用的噪声条件。
Conclusion: 作者指出门控在部分特征坐标可靠时改善鲁棒性，而温度在全局噪声降低节点特征可分性时更有帮助，二者适用于不同类型的噪声场景。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DELOS: Contrastive Deep Learning for Low-SNR Blind Transit Searches in Kepler Photometry
papers.abstract_en: We present DEtection in phase-folded Light curves with cOntrastive Scoring (DELOS), a deep-learning framework that uses contrastive scoring to perform blind searches for shallow transits in Kepler photometry. DELOS combines GPU-accelerated phase folding, optimized phase binning, and a custom one-dimensional convolutional encoder to assign a transit-likeness score to each folded light curve, thereby producing a score periodogram over trial periods without relying on pre-detected threshold-crossing events. Focusing on intermediate-to-long-period signals with orbital periods of 100-150 days, DELOS was trained on 20 million synthetic light curves generated with realistic transit models and Kepler-like noise properties, achieving a validation accuracy of 99.3% on the synthetic validation set. In controlled injection-recovery experiments, DELOS improves the combined precision-recall performance by 15.5% relative to Box-fitting Least Squares (BLS) and 11.25% relative to Transit Least Squares (TLS) in the low Signal-to-Noise Ratios (low-SNR) regime. It also accelerates the search by factors of approximately 3-5 and 74-80 compared with BLS and TLS, respectively. Applied to a selected Kepler validation sample, DELOS recovered all known shallow intermediate-to-long-period transit signals in the tested period range. These results demonstrate that DELOS provides an efficient and sensitive framework for low-SNR transit searches and represents a practical step toward future searches for longer-period terrestrial planets in Kepler, K2, TESS, PLATO, and Earth 2.0 data. Accordingly, this work is intended as a methodological development and validation study, with the detailed astrophysical validation of newly identified candidates deferred to future work.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 19 figures, 1 table, submitted to Astronomy & Astrophysics Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DELOS（Detection in phase-folded Light curves with cOntrastive Scoring），一个基于对比评分（contrastive scoring）的深度学习框架，用于在 Kepler 测光数据中盲搜索低信噪比的浅凌星信号。DELOS 结合 GPU 加速相位折叠、优化相位分箱（phase binning）和自定义一维卷积编码器，为每条折叠光变曲线生成凌星似然评分，并据此构建评分周期图，不依赖预检测的阈值穿越事件。模型在 2000 万条含 Kepler 风格噪声的合成光变曲线上训练，合成验证集准确率达 99.3%。
Motivation: 现有低信噪比凌星搜索方法（如 BLS、TLS）在浅而长的周期信号上灵敏度不足，且传统盲搜索依赖预检测的阈值穿越事件（threshold-crossing events），计算开销较大。作者希望为 100-150 天中间至长周期信号提供更高效、更灵敏的搜索框架。
Method: 方法由 GPU 加速的相位折叠、优化的相位分箱、自定义一维卷积编码器和对比评分组成；对每条候选周期的折叠光变曲线输出凌星相似度分数，形成评分周期图。模型用 2000 万条基于真实凌星模型和 Kepler 类似噪声合成的光变曲线训练。
Result: 在受控注入-恢复实验中，低信噪比区间内 DELOS 的联合精确率-召回率性能比 BLS 提高 15.5%、比 TLS 提高 11.25%；搜索速度相对 BLS 和 TLS 分别提升约 3-5 倍和 74-80 倍。在选定的 Kepler 验证样本中，测试周期范围内所有已知的浅层中间至长周期凌星信号均被恢复。
Conclusion: 摘要将这项工作定位为方法学发展与验证研究，表明 DELOS 可成为低信噪比凌星搜索的高效敏感工具，并有望推广到 Kepler、K2、TESS、PLATO 及 Earth 2.0 数据中的长周期类地行星搜索；对新候选源的天体物理验证留待后续工作。
Relevance: 3
