summary_sections.result: 在受控注入-恢复实验中，低信噪比区间内 DELOS 的联合精确率-召回率性能比 BLS 提高 15.5%、比 TLS 提高 11.25%；搜索速度相对 BLS 和 TLS 分别提升约 3-5 倍和 74-80 倍。在选定的 Kepler 验证样本中，测试周期范围内所有已知的浅层中间至长周期凌星信号均被恢复。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要将这项工作定位为方法学发展与验证研究，表明 DELOS 可成为低信噪比凌星搜索的高效敏感工具，并有望推广到 Kepler、K2、TESS、PLATO 及 Earth 2.0 数据中的长周期类地行星搜索；对新候选源的天体物理验证留待后续工作。

papers.title: RULER: Representation-Level Verification of Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training records from a deployed model without retraining from scratch. Current protocols verify this at the output level through membership inference, retain accuracy, and forget-set accuracy, but a model can satisfy all three whilst still encoding forgotten records in its intermediate representations. We introduce RULER, a set of representation-level verification metrics. The oracle-comparative metric M2 measures whether forget-set records occupy the same representational position as in a model retrained without them. The oracle-free metric M4 detects residuals from the unlearned model's internal similarity structure alone, without retraining. Four approximate unlearning methods all pass output-level evaluation, yet under a linear mixed-effects model M2 detects significant residuals in 10 of 12 conditions (p<0.05), with effect sizes growing as the forget fraction increases. A fifth method, Bad Teacher, shows the same residuals despite a different forgetting mechanism. M4 acts as a pre-unlearning diagnostic across tabular, image, clinical text, and face-identity settings: it detects identity-level memorisation in face recognition models where no tested method fully erases the signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RULER，一组面向机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 的表示级验证指标。现有协议只在输出层验证（成员推理、保留集准确率、遗忘集准确率），而模型可能在中间表示中仍编码被遗忘记录。RULER 包含有 oracle 对照的 M2 与无 oracle 的 M4；实验表明多种近似遗忘方法能通过输出级评测，但 M2 在大多数条件下仍检测到显著残留。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘验证仅停留在输出层面，模型即使通过了成员推理、保留集准确率和遗忘集准确率这三项检查，仍可能在中间表示中保留被遗忘记录的信息，因此需要表示级的验证方法。
Method: 引入 RULER 指标集：M2 为 oracle 对照指标，比较遗忘集记录在表示空间中的位置与不含该记录的重新训练模型中的位置是否一致；M4 为无 oracle 指标，仅利用遗忘模型内部的相似性结构检测残留，并使用线性混合效应模型 (linear mixed-effects model) 做显著性检验。
Result: 四种近似遗忘方法均通过输出级评测，但 M2 在 12 个条件中的 10 个检测到显著残留（p<0.05），且效应量随遗忘比例增大而增强；第五种方法 Bad Teacher 尽管遗忘机制不同，也呈现相同残留。M4 在表格、图像、临床文本和面部身份等设定下可作为去遗忘前的诊断工具，并在人脸识别模型中检测到身份级记忆残留，而所有测试方法均未完全擦除该信号。
Conclusion: RULER 表明仅依赖输出级指标不足以验证机器遗忘，表示级度量能揭示近似遗忘方法中的残留记忆；M4 可作为去遗忘前的诊断手段。

papers.title: ICICLE: Expanding Retrieval with In-Context Documents
papers.abstract_en: Generative retrieval (GR) maps queries directly to document identifiers (docids) using parametric knowledge, However, this design makes corpus expansion costly: adding new documents requires updating model parameters to encode new document-docid associations incurs repeated training and catastrophic forgetting of previously indexed documents. In this work, we revisit incremental GR as an in-context retrieval problem, where newly added documents are supplied as inference-time document-docid evidence. We propose ICICLE, an in-context indexing framework that performs source-aware docid generation over both parametric memory and context-provided document-docid pairs. ICICLE combines a `[COPY]`-based routing mechanism, preference-based calibration, and large context adaptation to distinguish context-grounded retrieval from parametric retrieval. Experiments on MS MARCO and NQ320K show that ICICLE improves retrieval of newly introduced documents while preserving seen-document retention without corpus-specific retraining. Our analysis further shows that high-shot degradation is mainly caused by routing failure, highlighting source-selection calibration as a key bottleneck for scaling in-context generative retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ICICLE，将增量生成式检索 (generative retrieval) 重新表述为 in-context 检索问题：新增文档通过推理期提供的文档-docid 证据来支持生成，而非更新模型参数。方法结合 [COPY] 路由机制、偏好校准和大上下文适配来区分上下文检索与参数检索。在 MS MARCO 与 NQ320K 上的实验显示 ICICLE 能改善新引入文档的检索并保持已见文档的记忆，无需语料特定重训练。作者进一步指出高样本退化主要源于路由失败。
Motivation: 生成式检索直接将查询映射到 docid，导致语料扩展成本高昂：新增文档需要更新参数以编码新的文档-docid 关联，反复训练会引发灾难性遗忘。因此需要一种能够在不重训练的前提下支持增量语料的检索框架。
Method: 提出 ICICLE，一个 in-context 索引框架，将新增文档作为推理时的文档-docid 证据进行源感知的 docid 生成；它结合基于 [COPY] 的路由机制、偏好校准 (preference-based calibration) 和大上下文适配 (large context adaptation)，以区分基于上下文的检索与基于参数记忆的检索。
Result: 在 MS MARCO 与 NQ320K 上的实验表明，ICICLE 提升了对新引入文档的检索效果，同时保留已见文档的检索能力，且无需语料特定重训练；分析显示 high-shot 退化主要由路由失败而非生成问题造成。
Conclusion: 摘要强调源选择校准 (source-selection calibration) 是扩展 in-context 生成式检索的关键瓶颈，并验证了将增量生成式检索视为上下文检索问题的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Phantom Transitions in Language Model Fine-Tuning: A Density-Matrix Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Language models fine-tuned where the correct completion must outrank a near-synonym competitor often fail silently. The cross-entropy loss falls monotonically while the correct token never overtakes the competitor in the model's ranking. We study this across five transformer architectures from two families spanning a sixfold parameter range, on ten contexts whose correct and competing completions share substantial embedding overlap. We build an order parameter combining the predicted distribution with embedding overlap, as a density matrix because that distribution lives over a non-orthogonal basis. It decomposes additively into a signal term tracking commitment to the correct token and a drag term set by how the embedding bulk leaks probability into the score. This isolates two failure modes. In kinematic failure the signal stays too small and the model never commits. In structural failure the drag worsens during fine-tuning, so the model degrades geometrically as its loss falls. The order parameter also shows sharp jumps resembling phase transitions. We test the spontaneous-symmetry-breaking reading by tracking it after every gradient step, and rule it out. The jumps persist under LoRA even though the token embedding matrix never changes. No geometric phase transition is possible when that geometry cannot move, so the discontinuity lies entirely in the softmax readout. A few dimensionless quantities organize the trajectory across architectures. One is consistent across all five models under full fine-tuning. A second sorts architectures into two classes by their bulk embedding distribution and predicts whether LoRA alone can make a sentence commit. As a blind test, the framework predicts a held-out architecture's critical learning rate to within 2.1% of a later sweep. These results characterize this near-synonym mechanism and need recalibration before extrapolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型微调中一种静默失败现象：正确补全需要排在近义词竞争者之前，但交叉熵损失持续下降时，正确 token 在排序中始终无法超过竞争者。作者在两种家族的五个 Transformer 架构、十倍参数范围和十个上下文上，构造结合预测分布与嵌入重叠的密度矩阵序参量 (order parameter)，将其分解为信号项和拖曳项，区分出运动学失效与结构失效两种模式，并观察到类似相变的尖锐跳变。作者通过逐梯度步追踪排除了自发对称破缺解读，并在 LoRA 下证明跳变源于 softmax 读出而非几何相变。
Motivation: 微调中正确 token 无法超越近义竞争者的失败常被单调下降的交叉熵掩盖，现有诊断无法解释该静默失败机制，需要一种能刻画非正交嵌入基上分布演化的序参量。
Method: 将预测分布视为定义在非正交嵌入基上的密度矩阵，构造序参量并加性分解为跟踪正确 token 承诺的信号项和由嵌入体量泄漏概率到得分造成的拖曳项；随后逐梯度步检验自发对称破缺解读，并在不改变 token 嵌入矩阵的 LoRA 设置下验证跳变来源。
Result: 摘要报告两种失效模式：运动学失效中信号过小、模型无法承诺；结构失效中拖曳项随微调恶化，模型在损失下降时几何式退化。序参量出现类似相变的尖锐跳变，但被排除为自发对称破缺；跳变在 LoRA 下仍存在，因而不连续位于 softmax 读出。少数无量纲量可组织跨架构轨迹，其中一个在全微调下对五种模型一致，另一个将架构分为两类并预测 LoRA 单独能否使句子承诺；盲测对留出架构临界学习率的预测与后续扫描误差在 2.1% 以内。
Conclusion: 该框架刻画了近义词竞争机制，但作者强调其结果在外推前需要重新校准。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MBABench: Evaluating LLM Agents on End-to-End Spreadsheet Tasks in Finance
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly expected to carry out end-to-end workflows, producing complete artifacts from high-level user instructions. To meet enterprise needs, frontier AI labs have developed agents that can construct entire spreadsheets from scratch. This is especially relevant in finance, where core workflows such as financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario analysis are commonly conducted through spreadsheets. Yet, existing spreadsheet benchmarks do not measure this new capability, focusing instead on question-answering or single-formula edits. To address this gap, we provide one of the first evaluations of agents on end-to-end spreadsheet tasks, focusing on economically critical financial workflows such as modeling and scenario analysis. Since deliverables therein are routinely reviewed and revised by multiple stakeholders, judging their quality necessarily involves high-level criteria such as readability or ease of modification. To reflect the multidimensional nature of solution quality, we develop an evaluation taxonomy comprising three dimensions: Accuracy, Formula, and Format, each comprising fine-grained criteria that reflect professional standards. Evaluating over 18 agents, the benchmark reveals that even the strongest agents fall short of basic professional finance standards, and their performance degrade sharply as the difficulty increases beyond a few chained calculations. This suggests that current agents are not yet able to reliably produce professional-quality spreadsheets at the level of complexity real-world workflows demand.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MBABench，一个面向金融领域端到端电子表格任务的 LLM 智能体评测基准，要求智能体从高层用户指令直接构造完整电子表格。基准从准确性、公式和格式三个维度评估交付物质量，并在 18 个智能体上进行评测。结果显示即使最强的智能体也达不到基本专业金融标准，且随任务复杂度超过若干链式计算后性能急剧下降。
Motivation: 现有电子表格基准只关注问答或单公式编辑，无法衡量前沿 AI 实验室新开发的从零构造整个电子表格的智能体能力；而在金融领域，建模、预测和情景分析等核心工作流都依赖电子表格。
Method: 构建金融端到端电子表格任务评测，提出包含 Accuracy、Formula、Format 三个维度的评估分类体系，每个维度下设符合专业标准的细粒度准则，并覆盖 18 个智能体进行系统评估。
Result: 基准评测显示最强的智能体也低于基本专业金融标准；当任务难度从少数链式计算继续提升时，智能体性能显著退化。
Conclusion: 当前智能体尚不能在真实工作流所需的复杂度水平上可靠产出专业质量的电子表格，这反映了端到端电子表格自动化仍存在明显能力缺口。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LionMuon: Alternating Spectral and Sign Descent for Efficient Training
papers.abstract_en: In large-scale optimization, the cheapness and effectiveness of update steps are the most crucial factors for a successful optimizer. Sign-based optimizers like Lion or Signum produce cheap per-step updates, whereas Muon's spectral matrix-sign update gives a much stronger direction at a substantially higher per-step cost. In this work, we propose LionMuon, which retains the effectiveness of Muon steps while considerably cutting the averaged iteration cost, similar to sign-based methods. It alternates between Lion's and Muon's updates on a fixed period P, sharing a single dual-EMA momentum buffer between them. The optimizer state memory therefore matches Lion and is exactly half of AdamW's. A simpler single-EMA variant, SignMuon, by itself already outperforms pure Muon. At P = 2, LionMuon Pareto-dominates Muon, Lion, Signum, and AdamW on every dataset and architecture we tested at 124M model size, reaching lower validation loss at lower compute, and the same advantage persists at 355M and 720M scale. On the theory side, we prove sharp complexity bounds under heavy-tailed noise which are governed by period-averaged smoothness and noise that interpolate between Muon's and Lion's constants. These bounds predict the compute-optimal period and the conditions under which LionMuon outruns Muon and Lion. Code: https://github.com/brain-lab-research/lion-muon

Result: 摘要报道在 124M 模型规模下，P=2 时 LionMuon 在所有测试数据集和架构上达到更低验证损失且使用更低计算，帕累托支配 Muon、Lion、Signum 和 AdamW；该优势在 355M 和 720M 规模下依然成立，且单 EMA 的 SignMuon 单独已优于纯 Muon。
Conclusion: 摘要强调交替调度配合共享动量缓冲可以在保持 Muon 更新有效性的同时把平均迭代成本降到接近符号类方法，并提供理论指导选择周期；其适用范围是通用大规模优化训练，摘要未涉及具体领域任务。

papers.title: Jacobian-Guided Anisotropic Noise Reshaping for Enhancing Representation Utility under Local Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: While Local Differential Privacy (LDP) serves as a foundational primitive for distributed data collection, its stringent randomization requirements often lead to severe degradation in data utility. This degradation stems from the task-agnostic nature of conventional LDP mechanisms, which perturb all dimensions without accounting for their relative importance to the downstream objective. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach that mitigates noise in task-relevant subspaces of the data representation. Our method identifies task-critical subspaces via the Jacobian of a public downstream model, selectively attenuates noise along these directions, and reshapes the isotropic noise of standard LDP mechanisms into an anisotropic distribution. The resulting mechanism preserves the privacy guarantee of the underlying LDP randomizer while heterogeneously modulating the impact of noise across task directions, thereby substantially enhancing data utility. The approach is applicable to both linear and nonlinear models and can be seamlessly integrated with existing LDP mechanisms. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10-C under brightness corruption at the highest severity level demonstrate that integrating our approach improves classification accuracy by approximately 8 percentage points for Laplace and 20 percentage points for PrivUnit variants at $ε=7.5$. The source code is available at https://github.com/ymha/jacobian-anr-ldp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Jacobian 的噪声重整形方法，用于在本地差分隐私（Local Differential Privacy, LDP）下提升数据表示的效用。方法通过公开下游模型的 Jacobian 识别任务关键子空间，选择性地衰减这些方向上的噪声，并将标准 LDP 机制的各向同性噪声重塑为各向异性分布，在保持隐私保证的同时提升数据效用。实验在 CIFAR-10-C 亮度损坏最高严重度下，于 ε=7.5 时对 Laplace 和 PrivUnit 变体分别提升约 8 和 20 个百分点的分类准确率。
Motivation: 传统 LDP 机制与任务无关地扰动所有维度，不考虑各维度对下游目标的相对重要性，导致数据效用严重退化。
Method: 通过公开下游模型的 Jacobian 识别任务关键子空间，选择性地衰减这些方向上的噪声，并将标准 LDP 机制的各向同性噪声重塑为各向异性分布；该方法适用于线性和非线性模型，并可无缝集成现有 LDP 机制。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10-C 亮度损坏最高严重度下，ε=7.5 时，集成该方法使 Laplace 变体分类准确率提升约 8 个百分点，PrivUnit 变体提升约 20 个百分点。
Conclusion: 该方法在保持底层 LDP 随机化器隐私保证的同时，通过跨任务方向异质调节噪声影响来提升数据效用，且可集成到现有 LDP 机制中。

papers.title: Key Coverage Matters: Semi-Structured Extraction of OCR Clinical Reports
papers.abstract_en: Clinical reports are often fragmented across healthcare institutions because privacy regulations and data silos limit direct information sharing. When patients seek care at a different hospital, they often carry paper or scanned reports from prior visits. This hinders EHR integration and longitudinal review, and downstream applications that depend on more complete patient records, such as patient management, follow-up care, real-world studies, and clinical-trial matching. Although OCR can digitize such reports, reliable extraction remains challenging because clinical documents are heterogeneous, OCR text is noisy, and many healthcare settings require low-cost on-premise deployment. We formulate this problem as canonical key-conditioned extractive question answering over OCR-derived clinical reports. Because the key fields are neither fixed nor known in advance, the key space is open. We maintain a canonical key inventory through iterative key mining, normalization, clustering, and lightweight human verification, and introduce key coverage as a metric to quantify inventory completeness. Using a 0.2B BERT-based model, experiments on real-world reports from more than 20 hospitals show performance improves monotonically with key coverage. The model achieves F1 scores of 0.839 and 0.893 under exact match and boundary-tolerant matching, respectively, once the Top-90 canonical keys are covered. These results show that key coverage is a dominant factor for end-to-end performance. At Top-90 coverage, our model outperforms a fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B baseline under exact match. Although our annotated corpus is Chinese, the method relies on the language-agnostic key-value organization of semi-structured clinical reports and can be adapted to other settings given an appropriate canonical key inventory and alias mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把 OCR 临床报告的结构化提取问题建模为基于规范键 (canonical key) 的抽取式问答，并通过迭代式键挖掘、归一化、聚类和轻量人工校验维护一个开放的键库，同时提出 key coverage 指标衡量键库完备性。作者用 0.2B 的 BERT 模型在来自 20 多家医院的真实报告上验证，结果显示在覆盖 Top-90 规范键时，精确匹配 F1 为 0.839，边界容忍匹配 F1 为 0.893，且性能随 key coverage 单调提升。方法依赖半结构化临床报告的键值组织形式，标注语料为中文但方法本身与语言无关。
Motivation: 临床报告常因隐私法规和数据孤岛而分散在不同机构，患者跨院就诊时只能携带纸质或扫描报告，阻碍 EHR 整合和纵向诊疗。OCR 可数字化报告，但文档异构、OCR 文本噪声大，且许多医疗场景要求低成本的本地化部署；同时关键字段并非固定或预先可知，键空间是开放的。
Method: 将任务定义为规范键条件下的抽取式问答 (canonical key-conditioned extractive QA)。通过迭代键挖掘、归一化、聚类和轻量人工验证维护规范键库存，并引入 key coverage 作为衡量库存完备性的指标；模型主体为 0.2B 参数的 BERT 类模型。
Result: 在来自 20 多家医院的真实报告上，模型性能随 key coverage 单调提升；覆盖 Top-90 规范键后，精确匹配 F1 为 0.839，边界容忍匹配 F1 为 0.893，并且在精确匹配下优于微调的 Qwen3-0.6B 基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为 key coverage 是影响端到端提取性能的主导因素；尽管标注语料是中文，方法依赖的是半结构化临床报告中与语言无关的键值组织方式，只要具备合适的规范键库和别名映射，就可以迁移到其他场景。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Event-Causal RAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Long Video Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models perform well on short- and medium-length video understanding but still struggle to maintain coherent event memory and recover long-range relationships in ultra-long videos. End-to-end methods are limited by visual-token growth and context length, while fixed-segment retrieval often fragments complete events and weakens state-transition modeling.We propose Event-Causal RAG (EC-RAG), a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework for ultra-long and streaming video reasoning. A dual visual-audio sentinel mechanism segments video streams into semantically complete events, represented as State-Event-State (SES) structures that organize observable pre-event states, central events, and post-event states as event-local causal transitions. These transitions are stored in dual vector-graph memory and temporally connected through entity-consistent trajectories. During question answering, bidirectional graph retrieval recovers relevant predecessor and successor events, and answers are generated using both structured memory and the corresponding video evidence.We further introduce ECV-1H, an hour-scale long-video QA benchmark dedicated to directed event-causal reasoning, with all source videos exceeding one hour. It covers over 150 hours of untrimmed video and contains 1,251 fully human-annotated QA pairs. EC-RAG improves overall accuracy by 4.96\%--11.67\% across three open-source video foundation models and achieves consistent gains across public datasets. On a single RTX 5090 GPU with 32 GB of memory, EC-RAG can continuously process videos while maintaining controlled streaming memory usage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Event-Causal RAG (EC-RAG)，一个面向超长视频与流式视频推理的轻量级检索增强框架。它通过双视觉-音频哨兵机制将视频流切分为语义完整的事件，并以 State-Event-State (SES) 结构表示事件内的因果转移，存入双向量-图记忆中。问答时使用双向图检索恢复前后继事件，并结合结构化记忆与视频证据生成答案。作者还引入小时级长视频问答基准 ECV-1H，并在三个开源视频基础模型上报告了准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有大型视觉语言模型在短中长度视频上表现良好，但在超长视频中难以维持连贯的事件记忆并恢复长程关系。端到端方法受限于视觉 token 增长和上下文长度，而固定分段检索往往会割裂完整事件并削弱状态转移建模。
Method: 提出 EC-RAG 检索增强框架：双视觉-音频哨兵机制将视频流划分为语义完整事件，并以 State-Event-State (SES) 结构组织可观察的前事件状态、中心事件与后事件状态，形成事件局部因果转移。这些转移存储在双向量-图记忆中，并通过实体一致的轨迹进行时间连接；问答阶段通过双向图检索获取相关前后继事件，结合结构化记忆与对应视频证据生成答案。同时提出 ECV-1H 基准，包含超过 150 小时未裁剪视频和 1,251 对人类标注 QA 对。
Result: 在三个开源视频基础模型上，EC-RAG 将整体准确率提升 4.96%–11.67%，并在公开数据集上取得一致的提升。在单张 32 GB 显存的 RTX 5090 GPU 上，它能够持续处理视频并保持受控的流式内存占用。
Conclusion: 作者认为事件化的因果记忆与图检索能够改善超长视频中的长程状态转移建模，并以低资源开销实现流式推理；其适用范围是面向事件因果推理的小时级长视频问答。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Sharp Capacity Thresholds in Linear Associative Memory: From Top-1 Retrieval to Tail-Average Learning
papers.abstract_en: How many key-value associations can a $d\times d$ linear memory store? The answer depends not only on the $d^2$ degrees of freedom in the memory matrix, but also on the retrieval criterion. Under isotropic Gaussian embeddings, we prove a sharp threshold for top-1 retrieval, where every signal must beat its largest distractor: the critical value of $d^2/(n\log n)$ is $2$. Above the threshold, we explicitly construct a linear memory that retrieves all $n$ associations with high probability; below it, no data-dependent linear memory can do so. The $\log n$ factor is therefore the unavoidable extreme-value cost of winner-take-all decoding. Without the logarithmic factor---that is, when $n/d^2\toα\in(0,\infty)$---simultaneous top-1 retrieval is impossible. The matched target can nevertheless remain near the top of the ranking. We capture this weaker retrieval goal with the Tail-Average Margin (TAM), which, for list size $k$, compares each signal with the average of its $k$ strongest competitors; a positive TAM margin certifies that the target belongs to the top-$k$ candidate list. When $k/n\to r\in(0,1)$, we learn the memory by empirical risk minimization with a smoothed TAM objective and derive an exact high-dimensional characterization through a two-parameter scalar variational problem. The result gives limiting laws for signal and competitor scores, margins, and percentile ranks. Sending the ridge parameter to zero after the high-dimensional limit yields a closed-form critical load $α_c(r)$ separating vanishing from positive average loss. The analysis in this work also develops a coupled leave-one-out method for matrix-valued empirical risk problems in which each sample enters many dependent comparisons, a tool that may be useful beyond associative memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在理论上研究 d×d 线性联想记忆能存储多少键值关联，并指出答案取决于检索准则。在各项同性高斯嵌入下，作者证明 top-1 检索存在尖锐阈值 d^2/(n log n)=2：高于阈值可构造线性记忆以高概率检索全部 n 条关联，低于阈值则任何数据依赖的线性记忆都无法做到。作者还引入 Tail-Average Margin (TAM) 描述较弱的 top-k 检索目标，并通过经验风险最小化与高维变分问题给出精确刻画。
Motivation: 线性记忆的存储容量不仅取决于矩阵的 d^2 个自由度，还取决于检索准则；winner-take-all 解码会引入极值代价，而较弱的目标（如目标仍在排名前列）可能获得不同的容量刻画，现有理论对此缺少精确阈值。
Method: 针对 top-1 检索证明尖锐阈值并显式构造达到阈值的线性记忆；引入 Tail-Average Margin (TAM)，将信号与其最强的 k 个竞争对手的平均值比较，以正边距保证目标进入 top-k 列表。当 k/n→r∈(0,1) 时，用平滑 TAM 目标进行经验风险最小化，并通过二参数标量变分问题推导信号与竞争者的分数、边距和百分位排名的极限律；分析中发展了耦合留一法 (coupled leave-one-out method) 处理每个样本参与多个依赖比较的矩阵值经验风险问题。
Result: 摘要给出关键数值：top-1 检索的临界值为 d^2/(n log n)=2；没有 log n 因子即 n/d^2→α∈(0,∞) 时，同时 top-1 检索不可能。对 TAM 目标，将岭参数在高维极限后趋于零，得到闭合形式的临界负荷 α_c(r)，其区分零均值损失与正平均损失。
Conclusion: log n 因子是 winner-take-all 解码不可避免的极值代价；TAM 刻画了目标保持在 top-k 候选列表内的弱检索目标，并给出精确高维极限。耦合留一法作为分析工具可能超出联想记忆的适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedStruct-S: A Benchmark for Key Discovery, Key-Conditioned QA and Semi-Structured Extraction from OCR Clinical Reports
papers.abstract_en: Semi-structured information extraction (IE) from OCR-derived clinical reports is crucial for efficiently reconstructing patients' longitudinal medical histories. In practice, this scenario commonly involves three tasks: (i) field-header (key) discovery, (ii) key-conditioned question answering (QA), and (iii) end-to-end key-value pair extraction. However, existing evaluations often under-model two factors: heterogeneous and incompletely known key representations, and OCR-induced noise. This makes it difficult to assess model robustness in real-world settings. We present MedStruct-S, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate these tasks under unknown keys and OCR noise. MedStruct-S contains 3,582 annotated real-world clinical report pages. Using MedStruct-S, we benchmark two representative paradigms: encoder-only sequence labeling with post-processing and decoder-only structured generation, covering four encoder-only and five decoder-only models spanning 0.11B to 103B parameters. Our results show that encoder-only models achieve the best performance for non-null-value key-conditioned QA despite being substantially smaller than decoder-only models. When comparing models of similar order of magnitude, encoder-only models still perform better overall. Without controlling for model scale, fine-tuned decoder-only models deliver the strongest overall results. These findings show that the benchmark provides a reliable and practical basis for selecting and comparing models across different semi-structured IE settings.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Accepted by KSEM 2026. This is the author's preprint version; the final authenticated version will be available in the Springer LNCS/LNAI proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedStruct-S 是一个面向 OCR 临床报告半结构化信息抽取的基准，覆盖字段头发现、键条件问答和键值对抽取三类任务，并显式建模未知键表示与 OCR 噪声。基准包含 3,582 页真实临床报告，评估了四种 encoder-only 和五种 decoder-only 模型（0.11B 至 103B 参数）。结果显示 encoder-only 模型在非空值键条件问答上最优且体积远小；同量级比较时 encoder-only 整体更优；不控制规模时，微调的 decoder-only 模型整体最强。
Motivation: 现有半结构化信息抽取评估低估了两个现实因素：键表示的异构性和不完全已知性，以及 OCR 引入的噪声，导致难以评估模型在真实场景中的鲁棒性。
Method: 构建 MedStruct-S 基准，包含 3,582 页带标注的真实临床报告，并设计三种任务（key discovery、key-conditioned QA、key-value extraction）来系统比较 encoder-only 序列标注加后处理与 decoder-only 结构化生成两类范式。
Result: encoder-only 模型在非空值键条件问答上取得最优性能，尽管参数量远小于 decoder-only 模型；在相似规模下 encoder-only 仍整体更优；不控制规模时，微调的 decoder-only 模型整体最强。
Conclusion: MedStruct-S 为不同半结构化信息抽取设置下的模型选择和比较提供了可靠且实用的基准依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Coarse-to-Fine Osteoarthritis Representations under Noisy Hierarchical Labels
papers.abstract_en: Knee osteoarthritis (OA) assessment contains a natural label hierarchy between binary disease status and Kellgren--Lawrence (KL) severity. We study whether supervision at these two granularities changes learned 3D MRI representations. A shared encoder with OA and KL prediction heads is evaluated under single-OA, single-KL, and dual-head training across ResNet3D, M3T, and nnMamba backbones. Evaluation combines predictive metrics with paired statistical comparisons under Benjamini--Hochberg FDR control, latent severity-axis geometry, and saliency--cartilage overlap. Dual supervision yields significant KL-grading gains for ResNet3D and a significant OA AUC gain for M3T, whereas nnMamba retains stronger single-task performance. Representation analysis further shows an architecture-dependent effect: Dual strengthens label-aligned latent organization for ResNet3D and M3T, while nnMamba retains stronger alignment under single-task supervision. For the responsive backbones, Dual also produces descriptively higher saliency overlap with cartilage. These results show that coarse-to-fine supervision can reshape disease representations under noisy hierarchical labels, with benefits that depend on backbone architecture. Code is available at https://github.com/jukieCheung/coarse2fine-oa-mri.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究膝关节骨关节炎 (OA) 评估中层级标签的监督方式是否改变 3D MRI 表征学习。作者在共享编码器上配置 OA 与 Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) 两个预测头，比较 single-OA、single-KL 和 dual-head 三种训练方式，并在 ResNet3D、M3T 和 nnMamba 三种骨干上评估。结果显示双任务监督能显著提升部分骨干的 KL 分级或 OA AUC，且表征重组效果依赖网络架构。
Motivation: OA 评估天然存在二元疾病状态与 KL 严重度之间的标签层级，但二元与细粒度监督如何影响学到的 3D MRI 表征尚不清楚。理解这种粗到细监督的作用有助于在噪声层级标签下设计更有效的表征学习方法。
Method: 采用带 OA 与 KL 两个预测头的共享编码器，在 ResNet3D、M3T、nnMamba 三种骨干上分别进行 single-OA、single-KL 和 dual-head 训练。评估结合预测指标、Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 控制下的配对统计比较、潜在严重度轴几何分析以及 saliency 与软骨重叠分析。
Result: 双任务监督 (Dual) 使 ResNet3D 获得显著的 KL 分级提升、M3T 获得显著的 OA AUC 提升，而 nnMamba 保持更强的单任务性能。表征分析显示架构相关效应：Dual 增强 ResNet3D 和 M3T 的标签对齐潜在组织，nnMamba 则在单任务监督下保持更强对齐；对响应良好的骨干，Dual 还带来描述性更高的 saliency 与软骨重叠。
Conclusion: 粗到细监督可以在噪声层级标签下重塑疾病表征，但收益取决于骨干网络架构。作者已开源代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: STAND: Semantic Anchoring Constraint with Dual-Granularity Disambiguation for Remote Sensing Image Change Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing image change captioning (RSICC) aims to describe the difference between two remote sensing images. While recent methods have explored video modeling, they largely overlook the inherent ambiguities in viewpoint, scale, and prior knowledge, lacking effective constraints on the encoder. In this paper, we present STAND, a Semantic Anchoring Constraint with Dual-Granularity Disambiguation for RSICC, to progressively resolve these ambiguities. Specifically, to establish a reliable feature foundation, we first introduce an interpretable constraint to regularize temporal representations. Operating on these purified features, a dual-granularity disambiguation module resolves spatial uncertainties by coupling macro-level global context aggregation for viewpoint confusion with micro-level frequency-refocused attention for small-object scale enhancement. Ultimately, to translate these visually disambiguated features into precise text, a semantic concept anchoring module leverages language categorical priors to tackle knowledge ambiguity during decoding. Extensive experiments verify the superiority of STAND and its effectiveness in addressing ambiguities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STAND，一种用于遥感图像变化描述 (remote sensing image change captioning, RSICC) 的语义锚定约束与双粒度消歧方法。方法先通过可解释约束正则化时序表示，再用双粒度消歧模块处理视角与尺度歧义，最后用语义概念锚定模块缓解解码时的知识歧义。摘要称实验验证了 STAND 的有效性以及其在消歧方面的作用。
Motivation: 现有 RSICC 方法虽然尝试视频建模，但忽略了视角、尺度和先验知识中固有的歧义，且缺乏对编码器的有效约束。
Method: 提出三部分技术路线：一是用可解释约束正则化时序表示，建立可靠特征基础；二是双粒度消歧模块，通过宏观全局上下文聚合解决视角混淆，通过微观频率重聚焦注意力增强小目标尺度；三是语义概念锚定模块，利用语言类别先验处理解码阶段的知识歧义。
Result: 摘要仅报告大量实验验证了 STAND 的优越性及其在解决各类歧义上的有效性，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为对编码器施加可解释约束并分粒度消歧，可以系统性地缓解 RSICC 中的多源歧义。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: OccDirector: Language-Guided Behavior and Interaction Generation in 4D Occupancy Space
papers.abstract_en: Generative world models increasingly rely on 4D occupancy for realistic autonomous driving simulation. However, existing generation frameworks depend on rigid geometric conditions (e.g., explicit trajectories) or simplistic attribute-level text, failing to orchestrate complex, sequential multi-agent interactions. To address this semantic-spatiotemporal gap, we propose OccDirector, a pioneering framework that generates 4D occupancy dynamics conditioned solely on natural language. Operating as a ``scenario director'', OccDirector maps natural language scripts into physically plausible voxel dynamics without requiring geometric priors. Technically, it employs a VLM-driven Spatio-Temporal MMDiT equipped with a history-prefix anchoring strategy to ensure long-horizon interaction consistency. Furthermore, we introduce OccInteract-85k, a novel dataset uniquely annotated with multi-level language instructions: ranging from static layouts to intricate multi-agent behaviors, alongside a novel VLM-based evaluation benchmark. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OccDirector achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and unprecedented instruction-following capabilities, successfully shifting the paradigm from appearance synthesis to language-driven behavior orchestration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OccDirector，一个仅以自然语言为条件生成 4D 占据空间（4D occupancy）动态的框架，用于自动驾驶仿真。该方法采用 VLM 驱动的时空 MMDiT 并配合历史前缀锚定策略（history-prefix anchoring）来保证长时程交互一致性，同时引入带多层级语言标注的数据集 OccInteract-85k 和基于 VLM 的评测基准。实验表明其在生成质量和指令跟随能力上达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有生成式世界模型通常依赖刚性几何条件（如显式轨迹）或简单属性级文本，难以编排复杂的、序列化的多智能体交互，存在语义与时空之间的差距（semantic-spatiotemporal gap）。
Method: 提出 OccDirector，作为“场景导演”将自然语言脚本映射为物理上合理的体素动态，无需几何先验。技术上采用 VLM 驱动的 Spatio-Temporal MMDiT，结合 history-prefix anchoring 策略保持长时程交互一致性；并构建带静态布局到复杂多智能体行为的多级语言指令标注数据集 OccInteract-85k。
Result: 大量实验表明，OccDirector 在生成质量和指令跟随能力上达到最先进水平，实现了前所未有的指令跟随性能。
Conclusion: 该工作将自动驾驶仿真的范式从外观合成（appearance synthesis）转向语言驱动的行为编排（language-driven behavior orchestration）。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有生成式世界模型通常依赖刚性几何条件（如显式轨迹）或简单属性级文本，难以编排复杂的、序列化的多智能体交互，存在语义与时空之间的差距（semantic-spatiotemporal gap）。
summary_sections.method: 提出 OccDirector，作为“场景导演”将自然语言脚本映射为物理上合理的体素动态，无需几何先验。技术上采用 VLM 驱动的 Spatio-Temporal MMDiT，结合 history-prefix anchoring 策略保持长时程交互一致性；并构建带静态布局到复杂多智能体行为的多级语言指令标注数据集 OccInteract-85k。
summary_sections.result: 大量实验表明，OccDirector 在生成质量和指令跟随能力上达到最先进水平，实现了前所未有的指令跟随性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作将自动驾驶仿真的范式从外观合成（appearance synthesis）转向语言驱动的行为编排（language-driven behavior orchestration）。

papers.title: Interval POMDP Shielding for Imperfect-Perception Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous systems that rely on learned perception can make unsafe decisions when sensor readings are misclassified. We study shielding for this setting: given a proposed action, a shield blocks actions that could violate safety. We consider the common case where system dynamics are known but perception uncertainty must be estimated from finite labeled data. From these data we build confidence intervals for the probabilities of perception outcomes and use them to model the system as a finite Interval Partially Observable Markov Decision Process with discrete states and actions. We then propose an algorithm to compute a conservative set of beliefs over the underlying state that is consistent with the observations seen so far. This enables us to construct a runtime shield that comes with a finite-horizon guarantee: with high probability over the training data, if the true perception uncertainty rates lie within the learned intervals, then every action admitted by the shield satisfies a stated lower bound on safety. Experiments on four case studies show that our shielding approach (and variants derived from it) improves the safety of the system over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究依赖学习感知的自主系统在传感器误分类时的不安全决策问题，提出一种运行时屏蔽（shielding）方法。作者从有限标记数据构建感知结果概率的置信区间，将系统建模为有限区间部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（Interval POMDP），并给出计算与观测一致的保守信念集的算法，从而构造带有限时域安全保证的屏蔽器。四个案例研究表明该方法相对于最先进基线提升了系统安全性。
Motivation: 自主系统依赖学习得到的感知模块，传感器读数被误分类时可能做出不安全决策；现有屏蔽方法通常假设感知不确定性已知，而实际中往往只能从有限标记数据中估计。
Method: 从有限标记数据为感知结果概率构建置信区间，用这些区间将系统建模为有限状态的 Interval POMDP；随后提出算法计算与已观测历史一致的保守信念集，并基于该信念集构造运行时屏蔽。
Result: 在四个案例研究中，该方法及其变体相对最先进基线提高了系统的安全性。
Conclusion: 该屏蔽器具有有限时域保证：以高概率（相对于训练数据）而言，若真实感知不确定性率落在学习到的区间内，则屏蔽器放行的每个动作都满足给定的安全性下界。

papers.title: AutoOR: Scalably Post-training LLMs to Autoformalize Operations Research Problems
papers.abstract_en: Optimization problems are central to decision-making in manufacturing, logistics, scheduling, and other industrial settings. Translating complicated descriptions of these problems into solver-ready formulations requires specialized operations research (OR) expertise, making it hard to scale. We present AutoOR, a scalable synthetic data generation and reinforcement learning pipeline that trains LLMs to autoformalize optimization problems specified in natural language across linear, mixed-integer, and non-linear categories. AutoOR generates verified training data from standard optimization forms and uses solver execution feedback as the reward signal for RL post-training. AutoOR applied to an 8B model achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results across six established OR benchmarks, matching significantly larger frontier models. For a non-linear problem class involving physical dynamics, where frontier models score near 0%, we introduce a curriculum RL strategy that bootstraps from limited initial training data to make this class tractable for post-training. We believe that methods such as AutoOR can significantly accelerate industrial decision-making with AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoOR，一个可扩展的合成数据生成与强化学习 (RL) 后训练管线，用于训练 LLM 将自然语言描述的优化问题自动形式化 (autoformalize) 为求解器可用的公式，覆盖线性、混合整数和非线性类别。摘要报告，将 AutoOR 应用于 8B 模型后，在六个既有 OR 基准上取得最先进或具有竞争力的结果，可与更大的前沿模型匹敌。
Motivation: 将复杂问题描述转化为求解器就绪的公式需要专门的运筹学 (OR) 专业知识，难以规模化，制约了优化问题在制造、物流、调度等工业决策场景中的广泛应用。
Method: AutoOR 从标准优化形式生成经过验证的训练数据，并使用求解器执行反馈 (solver execution feedback) 作为 RL 后训练的奖励信号；针对涉及物理动力学的非线性问题类别，引入课程式 RL 策略 (curriculum RL strategy)，从有限的初始训练数据中引导训练。
Result: 摘要称在 8B 模型上，AutoOR 在六个既有 OR 基准上达到最先进或竞争力的表现，匹配显著更大的前沿模型；在前沿模型得分为近 0% 的涉及物理动力学的非线性问题类别上，课程 RL 策略使该类问题变得可训练。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AutoOR 这类方法可以显著加速 AI 驱动的工业决策。

papers.title: When to Call an Apple Red: Humans Follow Introspective Rules, VLMs Don't
papers.abstract_en: Understanding when Vision-Language Models (VLMs) will behave unexpectedly, whether models can reliably predict their own behavior, and if models adhere to their introspective reasoning are central challenges for trustworthy deployment. To study this, we introduce the Graded Color Attribution (GCA) dataset, a controlled benchmark designed to elicit decision rules and evaluate participant faithfulness to these rules. GCA consists of line drawings that vary pixel-level color coverage across three conditions: world-knowledge recolorings, counterfactual recolorings, and shapes with no color priors. Using GCA, we ask both VLMs and human participants to state a threshold rule: the share of an object's pixels that must be a given color for the object to receive that color label. We then compare these rules with their subsequent color attribution decisions. Our findings reveal that models systematically violate their own introspective rules. For example, GPT-5-mini violates its stated introspection rules in nearly 60% of cases on objects with strong color priors. Human participants remain faithful to their stated rules, with any apparent violations being explained by a well-documented tendency to overestimate color coverage. In contrast, we find that VLMs can accurately estimate color coverage, yet directly contradict their own reasoning in their final responses. Across all models and strategies for eliciting introspective rules, world-knowledge priors systematically degrade faithfulness in ways that do not mirror human cognition. Our findings challenge the view that VLM reasoning failures are difficulty-driven and suggest that VLM introspective self-knowledge is miscalibrated, with direct implications for high-stakes deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Graded Color Attribution (GCA) 数据集，用于研究视觉语言模型（VLM）和人类是否遵循自己陈述的颜色标注阈值规则。实验发现模型会系统性违背自身的内省规则，例如 GPT-5-mini 在强颜色先验物体上近 60% 的情况下违反自己陈述的规则，而人类则保持忠实。作者认为 VLM 的内省自我知识存在校准错误，且其推理失败并非单纯由难度驱动。
Motivation: 可信赖部署需要理解 VLM 何时会产生意外行为、模型能否可靠预测自身行为，以及模型是否遵循自己的内省推理。现有认识常将 VLM 推理失败归因于任务难度，本文希望检验这一观点并考察模型自我知识是否校准良好。
Method: 构建 GCA 受控基准，使用像素级颜色覆盖率变化的线条画，分为世界知识重着色、反事实重着色和无颜色先验形状三种条件；要求 VLM 和人类参与者先陈述阈值规则，再与实际颜色归属决策进行比较。
Result: 模型系统性地违背自己陈述的内省规则；GPT-5-mini 在强颜色先验物体上违反率近 60%。人类参与者忠实于自己陈述的规则，表面违背可由高估颜色覆盖率的已知倾向解释；VLM 能准确估计颜色覆盖率，却在最终回答中直接反驳自身推理。
Conclusion: 世界知识先验会以不同于人类认知的方式系统性降低模型对内省规则的忠实度，表明 VLM 的内省自我知识校准不良，对高 stakes 部署有直接影响，也挑战了将 VLM 推理失败归因于任务难度的观点。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Multi-Agent to Single-Agent: When Is Skill Distillation Beneficial?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) for structured data-science tasks externalize analytical control through workflows spanning stages, tools, shared state, verification, and repair. Distilling such workflows into a single-agent skill can reduce orchestration overhead, but it remains unclear which workflow components should cross the control boundary. We distinguish capability resources, which expand what an agent can do, from pipeline guidance, which constrains which solutions it explores. On the same causal-estimation instances, adding task-qualified source pipeline guidance to a capability-matched skill changes normalized utility by +19.6 points under method-selection accuracy but -10.3 points under numerical error. To explain this reversal, we introduce Behavior-Outcome Freedom (F), a pre-synthesis diagnostic of signed behavior-outcome rank mismatch, and formalize its candidate-conditional role through Signed Anchor-Rank Transfer. Motivated by this mechanism, we propose AdaSkill, which preserves validated capability resources, removes runtime orchestration, and conditionally inherits pipeline guidance using a calibrated rule over F. Across 16 capability-matched interventions, the native-scale Full-minus-Discard effect decreases across the continuous F scale (r = -0.80, p < 0.001), while a 15-treatment atomic sweep localizes the reversal to pipeline guidance. Across 11 datasets spanning four structured data-science task families, AdaSkill combines strong task performance with substantially lower deployment overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将多智能体系统（MAS）的结构化数据科学工作流蒸馏为单智能体技能时何时有益。作者区分能力资源（capability resources，扩展智能体能做什么）与流水线指导（pipeline guidance，约束其探索哪些解），在相同因果估计实例上发现，给能力匹配的技能加入任务合格的源流水线指导会在方法选择准确率下使归一化效用 +19.6 点、在数值误差下却 -10.3 点。为解释这一反转，作者提出预合成诊断 Behavior-Outcome Freedom (F) 并形式化 Signed Anchor-Rank Transfer，进而设计 AdaSkill 方法。
Motivation: 多智能体系统通过跨阶段、工具、共享状态、验证与修复的工作流外部化分析控制，蒸馏为单智能体技能可降低编排开销，但哪些工作流组件应跨越控制边界尚不明确；摘要指出需要判据判断跨边界组件的得失。
Method: 作者区分能力资源与流水线指导，引入 Behavior-Outcome Freedom (F) 作为有符号行为-结果秩错配的预合成诊断，并形式化其候选条件作用。基于该机制提出 AdaSkill：保留已验证的能力资源、移除运行时编排，并用经过校准的规则按 F 值有条件地继承流水线指导。
Result: 摘要报告：加入任务合格的源流水线指导在方法选择准确率上使归一化效用 +19.6 点，在数值误差下 -10.3 点；16 项能力匹配干预中 Full-minus-Discard 效应随连续 F 尺度下降（r = -0.80, p < 0.001），15 项原子消融将反转定位到流水线指导；在 11 个数据集、四种结构化数据科学任务族上，AdaSkill 兼顾强任务性能与大幅降低的部署开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调技能蒸馏是否有利取决于组件类型：能力资源应保留，而流水线指导应按 F 诊断的条件规则继承；AdaSkill 在结构化数据科学任务上实现性能与部署开销的折中，但结论限于该任务族与因果估计实例。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Matching Accuracy, Different Geometry: Evolution Strategies vs GRPO in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Evolution Strategies (ES) have emerged as a scalable gradient-free alternative to reinforcement learning based LLM fine-tuning, but it remains unclear whether comparable task performance implies comparable solutions in parameter space. We compare ES and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) across four tasks in both single-task and sequential continual-learning settings. ES matches or exceeds GRPO in single-task accuracy and remains competitive sequentially when its iteration budget is controlled. Despite this similarity in task performance, the two methods produce markedly different model updates: ES makes much larger changes and induces broader off-task KL drift, whereas GRPO makes smaller, more localized updates. Strikingly, the ES and GRPO solutions are linearly connected with no loss barrier, even though their update directions are nearly orthogonal. We develop an analytical theory of ES that explains all these phenomena within a unified framework, showing how ES can accumulate large off-task movement on weakly informative directions while still making enough progress on the task to match gradient-based RL in downstream accuracy. These results show that gradient-free and gradient-based fine-tuning can reach similarly accurate yet geometrically distinct solutions, with important consequences for forgetting and knowledge preservation. The source code is publicly available: https://github.com/Bhoy1/ESvsGRPO.
papers.comment: Accepted to Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在四个任务上系统比较了进化策略 (Evolution Strategies, ES) 与 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 在 LLM 后训练中的表现，发现两者在任务精度上相近，但产生的参数更新在几何上截然不同：ES 的更新更大、导致更宽的 off-task KL 漂移，而 GRPO 的更新更小且更局部。尽管更新方向近似正交，两者的解仍线性连通且无 loss barrier。作者进一步提出一个统一的分析理论框架解释这些现象。
Motivation: 现有研究关注进化策略能否在任务精度上匹敌基于强化学习的微调，但尚不清楚任务性能相近是否意味着参数空间中的解也相近，这一问题对持续学习中的遗忘与知识保留具有重要影响。
Method: 作者在单任务和顺序持续学习 (sequential continual learning) 两种设置下，对四个任务比较 ES 与 GRPO，并控制 ES 的迭代预算以进行公平对比；随后开发了一个关于 ES 的分析理论，用于在统一框架内解释更新幅度、off-task 漂移与线性连通性等现象。
Result: ES 在单任务精度上匹配或超过 GRPO，在顺序学习中控制迭代预算后也能保持竞争力；但 ES 产生更大的参数更新和更广泛的 off-task KL 漂移，而两个方法的解线性连通且无 loss barrier，尽管其更新方向近似正交。
Conclusion: 摘要表明梯度无关 (gradient-free) 与基于梯度的微调可以达到精度相似但几何上不同的解，这一差异对遗忘和知识保留具有潜在影响；作者还公开了源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IPV-Bench: Benchmarking Image Protection Methods under Diverse Image-to-Video Generation Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-video (I2V) generation models can be misused to animate a single image into a convincing fake video, motivating perturbation-based image protection methods that aim to disrupt such generation. Yet these methods remain difficult to compare: they are reported under inconsistent metrics and generation settings, are often validated only on the single generator they were optimized against, and are evaluated on narrow, single-domain image sets that do not reflect real misuse. To address these challenges, we introduce IPV-Bench (Image Protection against Video generation), the first systematic benchmark for image protection in I2V generation scenarios. IPV-Bench couples a unified protocol that jointly scores protection effectiveness, visual fidelity, and robustness to preprocessing attacks together with IPV-500, a prompt-paired dataset spanning five misuse-relevant domains. Based on this benchmark, we evaluate five representative protection methods across four I2V models covering distinct architectures and both open-source and commercial systems. Extensive experiments show a consistently sobering picture: image protection and video disruption trade off against each other, most methods fail to disrupt generation beyond noise, protection rarely transfers across generators, and the few effective cases are broken by simple preprocessing. We further find that image content governs the perceptual cost of protection but not its benefit: no image domain offers an easier target. Overall, IPV-Bench provides a rigorous, reproducible, and extensible foundation for developing protection methods that work in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IPV-Bench，据称是首个面向图像到视频 (I2V) 生成场景的图像保护方法系统评测基准。该基准将统一的评测协议（同时衡量保护有效性、视觉保真度和对预处理攻击的鲁棒性）与覆盖五个滥用相关领域的 prompt-图像配对数据集 IPV-500 结合。作者基于该基准评估了五种代表性保护方法和四个覆盖不同架构、含开源与商业系统的 I2V 模型。实验显示保护与视频扰动互相权衡、多数方法仅能产生噪声级干扰、保护效果很少跨生成器迁移，且少数有效案例也会被简单预处理破坏。
Motivation: 图像到视频生成模型可被滥用将单张图片动画化为逼真虚假视频，因此出现了基于扰动的图像保护方法；但这些方法难以比较：评测指标和生成设置不一致，多数只在针对单一生成器优化时验证，且测试图像集狭窄、仅覆盖单一领域，不能反映真实滥用场景。
Method: 引入 IPV-Bench，包含统一的评测协议，联合评分保护有效性 (protection effectiveness)、视觉保真度 (visual fidelity) 和对预处理攻击的鲁棒性 (robustness to preprocessing attacks)，并配套构建 prompt 配对的 IPV-500 数据集，覆盖五个与滥用相关的图像领域。
Result: 在五种保护方法和四个不同架构的 I2V 模型（含开源与商业系统）上的实验显示：图像保护与视频破坏效果存在权衡；大多数方法除了产生噪声外无法真正破坏生成；保护效果极少跨生成器迁移；少数有效案例可被简单预处理攻破。此外，图像内容决定保护带来的感知成本，但并不决定保护收益，没有任何图像领域更易被保护。
Conclusion: 作者认为 IPV-Bench 为开发实际可用的图像保护方法提供了严谨、可复现且可扩展的评测基础，并强调当前保护方法在跨模型迁移和抗预处理方面仍远未达到实用水平。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Online Learning for Dynamic Constellation Topologies
papers.abstract_en: The use of satellite networks has increased significantly in recent years due to their advantages over purely terrestrial systems, such as higher availability and coverage. However, to effectively provide these services, satellite networks must cope with the continuous orbital movement and maneuvering of their nodes and the impact on the network's topology. In this work, we address the problem of (dynamic) network topology configuration under the online learning framework. As a byproduct, our approach does not assume structure about the network, such as known orbital planes (that could be violated by maneuvering satellites). We empirically demonstrate that our problem formulation matches the performance of state-of-the-art offline methods. Importantly, we demonstrate that our approach is amenable to constrained online learning, exhibiting a trade-off between computational complexity per iteration and convergence to a final strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动态星座卫星网络的拓扑配置问题，将其置于在线学习（online learning）框架下求解。方法不假设网络具有已知轨道面等结构先验，因此可应对卫星机动造成的拓扑变化。实验表明该问题建模在性能上可匹配离线最先进方法，并适用于带约束的在线学习，体现出每轮计算复杂度与最终策略收敛之间的权衡。
Motivation: 卫星网络需应对节点持续轨道运动和机动对网络拓扑的影响，而依赖已知轨道面等结构先验的方法可能被机动卫星破坏。作者将动态拓扑配置作为在线学习问题处理，以摆脱此类结构假设。
Method: 作者将动态网络拓扑配置形式化为在线学习问题，不假设网络具有已知轨道面等结构信息；同时说明该形式化兼容带约束的在线学习（constrained online learning），可在每轮计算复杂度与最终策略收敛之间进行权衡。
Result: 实验表明，该问题建模的性能可与离线最先进方法（state-of-the-art offline methods）相匹配；并展示其适用于约束在线学习，体现出每轮计算复杂度与策略收敛之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的在线学习形式化能应对卫星机动造成的拓扑变化，无需轨道面等结构假设，并兼具与离线方法相当的性能以及约束在线学习的灵活性。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: 2Xplat: Decoupling Geometry and Appearance Modeling for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has opened a new frontier for rapid 3D modeling, enabling high-quality Gaussian representations to be generated from uncalibrated multi-view images in a single forward pass. The dominant approach adopts unified monolithic architectures, often built on geometry-centric 3D foundation models, to jointly estimate camera poses and synthesize 3DGS representations within a single network, entangling geometric reasoning and appearance modeling within a shared representation. In this work, we introduce 2Xplat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework based on a two-experts design that explicitly separates geometry estimation from Gaussian generation: a dedicated geometry expert first predicts camera poses, which are then passed to an appearance expert that synthesizes 3D Gaussians. Despite its conceptual simplicity, and being largely underexplored in prior works, our two-experts pipeline outperforms prior pose-free feed-forward 3DGS approaches in fewer than 5K training iterations, achieving performance on par with state-of-the-art posed methods. These results challenge the prevailing unified paradigm and suggest the potential advantages of modular design for complex 3D geometric estimation and appearance synthesis tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 2Xplat，一种免姿态 (pose-free) 前馈 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 框架，采用双专家设计把几何估计与外观建模解耦。几何专家先预测相机位姿，外观专家再基于位姿生成 3D 高斯表示；在少于 5K 次训练迭代内超越此前免姿态前馈 3DGS 方法，并与有姿态监督的 SOTA 方法性能相当。作者认为这一结果挑战当前统一的单网络范式，暗示模块化设计在复杂三维几何估计与外观合成任务中可能更有优势。
Motivation: 现有免姿态前馈 3DGS 多采用统一单体架构，在单一网络中同时估计相机位姿并合成 3DGS，几何推理与外观建模被纠缠在共享表示中；作者认为这种耦合可能限制训练效率和最终性能，而显式分离两者的设计方案此前少有探索。
Method: 提出双专家流水线：专用几何专家先预测相机位姿，随后将位姿传给外观专家用于合成 3D 高斯；该方法概念上简单，将几何估计与高斯生成显式解耦。
Result: 摘要报告 2Xplat 在少于 5K 次训练迭代下优于既有免姿态前馈 3DGS 方法，并且性能与有姿态监督的 SOTA 方法相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该结果挑战了主流的统一范式，并暗示模块化设计对复杂的 3D 几何估计与外观合成任务可能具有潜在优势。

papers.title: SHANG++: Robust Stochastic Acceleration under Multiplicative Noise
papers.abstract_en: Under the multiplicative noise scaling (MNS) condition, original Nesterov acceleration is provably sensitive to noise and may diverge when gradient noise overwhelms the signal. In this paper, we develop two accelerated stochastic gradient descent methods by discretizing the Hessian-driven Nesterov accelerated gradient flow. We first derive SHANG, a direct semi-implicit discretization that already improves stability under MNS. We then introduce SHANG++, which adds a damping correction and achieves faster convergence with greater noise robustness. We establish convergence guarantees for both convex and strongly convex objectives under MNS, together with explicit parameter choices. In our experiments, SHANG++ performs consistently well across convex problems and applications in deep learning. In a dedicated noise experiment on ResNet-34, a single hyperparameter configuration maintains accuracy within one percentage point of the noise-free setting. Across all experiments, SHANG++ outperforms existing accelerated methods in robustness and efficiency, with minimal parameter sensitivity.
papers.journal_ref: Computers and Mathematics with Applications, 220 (2026), 386-402
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究乘性噪声缩放（multiplicative noise scaling, MNS）条件下 Nesterov 加速方法对噪声敏感、可能发散的问题，提出两种加速随机梯度下降方法 SHANG 与 SHANG++。SHANG 是 Hessian 驱动的 Nesterov 加速梯度流的直接半隐式离散化，SHANG++ 加入阻尼校正以实现更快收敛和更强噪声鲁棒性。作者给出凸与强凸目标下的收敛保证及显式参数选择，实验显示 SHANG++ 在凸问题和深度学习应用中表现稳定，ResNet-34 噪声实验中单一超参数配置可将精度维持在与无噪声设置相差一个百分点以内。
Motivation: 原始 Nesterov 加速在乘性噪声缩放条件下被证明对噪声敏感，当梯度噪声超过信号时甚至可能发散，因此需要更稳健的加速随机优化方法。
Method: 通过对 Hessian 驱动的 Nesterov 加速梯度流进行离散化来构造方法：先推导 SHANG 这一直接半隐式离散化，再引入阻尼校正得到 SHANG++，并分别为凸和强凸目标建立收敛保证并给出显式参数选择。
Result: 摘要报告 SHANG++ 在凸优化问题和深度学习应用中均表现稳定；在 ResNet-34 的专门噪声实验中，单一超参数配置即可保持准确率与无噪声设置相差在一个百分点以内；在所有实验中，SHANG++ 在鲁棒性和效率上优于现有加速方法，且参数敏感性最低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SHANG++ 在乘性噪声下兼顾了收敛速度与噪声稳健性，参数敏感度低；其适用范围为凸/强凸目标及深度学习优化实验。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 通过对 Hessian 驱动的 Nesterov 加速梯度流进行离散化来构造方法：先推导 SHANG 这一直接半隐式离散化，再引入阻尼校正得到 SHANG++，并分别为凸和强凸目标建立收敛保证并给出显式参数选择。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 SHANG++ 在凸优化问题和深度学习应用中均表现稳定；在 ResNet-34 的专门噪声实验中，单一超参数配置即可保持准确率与无噪声设置相差在一个百分点以内；在所有实验中，SHANG++ 在鲁棒性和效率上优于现有加速方法，且参数敏感性最低。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 SHANG++ 在乘性噪声下兼顾了收敛速度与噪声稳健性，参数敏感度低；其适用范围为凸/强凸目标及深度学习优化实验。

papers.title: Making Implicit Premises Explicit in Logical Understanding of Enthymemes
papers.abstract_en: Real-world arguments in text and dialogues are normally enthymemes (i.e. some of their premises and/or claims are implicit). Natural language processing (NLP) methods for handling enthymemes can potentially identify enthymemes in text but they do not decode their underlying logic, whereas logic-based approaches for handling them assume a knowledgebase with sufficient formulae that can be used to decode them via abduction. There is therefore a lack of a systematic method for translating textual components of an enthymeme into a logical argument and generating the logical formulae required for their decoding, and thereby showing logical entailment. To address this, we propose a pipeline that integrates: (1) a large language model (LLM) to generate intermediate implicit premises based on the explicit premise and claim; (2) another LLM to translate the natural language into logical formulas; and (3) a neuro-symbolic reasoner based on a SAT solver to determine entailment. We evaluate our pipeline on two enthymeme datasets, demonstrating promising performance in selecting the correct implicit premise, as measured by precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 17th International Conference on Scalable Uncertainty Management (SUM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本与对话中真实论据通常是不完整三段论 (enthymeme) 的问题，提出一个将 enthymeme 的文本成分显式化为逻辑论证的流水线：先用一个大型语言模型 (LLM) 基于显式前提和结论生成隐式中间前提，再用另一个 LLM 将自然语言翻译为逻辑公式，最后用基于 SAT 求解器的神经符号推理器判断逻辑蕴含。作者在两个 enthymeme 数据集上评估了流水线，在选出正确隐式前提方面取得有前景的精确率、召回率、F1 和准确率表现。
Motivation: 现有的 NLP 方法虽能识别文本中的 enthymeme，但不能解码其底层逻辑；而基于逻辑的方法又假设存在足够公式的知识库，可通过溯因 (abduction) 解码。因此缺少一种系统化方法，把 enthymeme 的文本成分翻译成逻辑论证并生成解码所需的逻辑公式，进而展示逻辑蕴含。
Method: 提出一个集成流水线，包含三个环节：(1) 一个 LLM 根据显式前提和主张生成中间隐式前提；(2) 另一个 LLM 将自然语言翻译成逻辑公式；(3) 基于 SAT 求解器的神经符号推理器用于判定蕴含关系。
Result: 在两个 enthymeme 数据集上的评估显示，流水线在选择正确隐式前提方面表现良好，评测指标包括精确率、召回率、F1 分数和准确率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一条将文本 enthymeme 系统转化为逻辑论证并验证蕴含的路径，弥补了 NLP 识别与逻辑解码之间的缺口。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Semantic Class Distribution Learning for Debiasing Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation is critical for computer-aided diagnosis. However, dense pixel-level annotation is time-consuming and costly, and medical datasets often exhibit severe class imbalance. Such an imbalance causes minority structures to be overwhelmed by dominant classes in feature representations, hindering the learning of discriminative features and making reliable segmentation particularly challenging. To address this, we propose the Semantic Class Distribution Learning (SCDL) framework, a plug-and-play module that mitigates supervision and representation biases by learning structured class-conditional feature distributions. SCDL integrates Class Distribution Bidirectional Alignment (CDBA) to align embeddings with learnable class proxies and leverages Semantic Anchor Constraints (SAC) to guide proxies using labeled data. Experiments on the Synapse and AMOS datasets demonstrate that SCDL largely improves segmentation performance across both overall and class-level metrics, with particularly notable gains for several low-frequency organs. Our anonymous code is released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SCDL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义类分布学习 (SCDL) 框架，用于缓解半监督医学图像分割中的类不平衡与标注稀缺问题。该框架作为即插即用模块，通过建模结构化的类条件特征分布来减轻监督偏差和表征偏差。在 Synapse 和 AMOS 数据集上的实验表明，SCDL 能提升整体与类别级分割指标，尤其对低频器官改进明显。
Motivation: 医学图像分割依赖密集的像素级标注，耗时且昂贵，同时医学数据常存在严重类不平衡；少数结构在特征表示中被主导类别淹没，妨碍判别性特征学习，使可靠分割更具挑战。
Method: 提出 SCDL 框架，包含类分布双向对齐 (CDBA)，将嵌入与可学习的类代理 (class proxies) 对齐；以及语义锚定约束 (SAC)，利用有标注数据指导类代理的学习，从而以即插即用方式建模类条件特征分布。
Result: 在 Synapse 与 AMOS 数据集上的实验显示，SCDL 在整体与类别级指标上大幅提升分割性能，多个低频器官上的增益尤为显著。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过学习结构化类条件分布来缓解监督偏差和表征偏差，SCDL 可作为通用即插即用模块用于半监督医学图像分割。

papers.title: Conformal Policy Control
papers.abstract_en: An agent must try new behaviors to explore and improve. In high-stakes environments, an agent that violates safety constraints may cause harm and must be taken offline, curtailing any future interaction. Imitating old behavior is safe, but excessive conservatism discourages exploration. How much behavior change is too much? We show how to use any safe reference policy as a probabilistic regulator for any optimized but untested policy. Conformal calibration on data from the safe policy determines how aggressively the new policy can act, while provably enforcing the user's declared risk tolerance. Unlike conservative optimization methods, we do not assume the user has identified the correct model class nor tuned any hyperparameters. Unlike previous conformal methods, our theory provides finite-sample guarantees even for non-monotonic bounded loss functions, and it introduces a new policy control setting. Our experiments on applications ranging from natural language question answering to biomolecular engineering show that safe exploration is not only possible from the first moment of deployment, but can also improve performance.
papers.comment: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026. v4: Revised CPC theory to (a) show enforced smoothness for likelihood-ratio control parameter and (b) for general control parameter, assume smoothness only of constrained policy $π_t^{(β)}$ w.r.t. $β$ (rather than of $(l_i - α)\cdotπ_t^{(β)}$ or of conformal weights)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Conformal Policy Control (CPC)，利用任意安全参考策略作为概率调节器，约束一个经过优化但未经测试的新策略。通过对安全策略收集的数据进行共形校准 (conformal calibration)，决定新策略可以多激进地行动，并在有限样本意义下强制执行用户声明的风险容差。与保守优化方法不同，该方法不要求用户预先确定正确的模型类或调整超参数；与以往共形方法不同，其理论对非单调有界损失函数也给出有限样本保证。实验覆盖自然语言问答和生物分子工程，显示安全探索从部署第一刻起即可实现并可能提升性能。
Motivation: 高风险环境中，违反安全约束的智能体会被下线并丧失后续交互机会，而过度模仿旧行为会抑制探索。论文要回答的问题是：多少行为变化算太多，以及如何在保证安全的前提下允许新策略探索。
Method: 将任意安全参考策略作为新策略的概率调节器，利用安全策略数据做共形校准来确定新策略可使用的激进程度，从而有限样本地保证用户声明的风险容差。理论部分对似然比控制参数证明了所需光滑性，并对一般控制参数仅假设受约束策略关于参数的平滑性。
Result: 在自然语言问答和生物分子工程等应用中，安全探索从部署一开始就是可行的，并且能够改善性能。
Conclusion: 论文强调该方法既不需要用户指定正确的模型类，也不需要手动调节超参数，并为非单调有界损失函数提供了与以往共形方法不同的有限样本保证。

papers.title: SkillNet: Create, Evaluate, and Connect AI Skills
papers.abstract_en: Current AI agents can flexibly invoke tools and execute complex tasks, yet their long-term advancement is hindered by the lack of systematic accumulation and transfer of skills. Without a unified mechanism for skill consolidation, agents frequently ``reinvent the wheel'', rediscovering solutions in isolated contexts without leveraging prior strategies. To address this challenge, we introduce SkillNet, an open infrastructure for creating, evaluating, and organizing AI skills at scale. SkillNet structures skills within a unified ontology that supports creating skills from heterogeneous sources, establishing rich relational connections, and performing multi-dimensional evaluation across Safety, Completeness, Executability, Maintainability, and Cost-awareness. Our infrastructure integrates a repository of over 600,000 skills, an interactive platform, and a versatile Python toolkit. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld show 40% higher average rewards and 30% fewer execution steps across multiple backbone models. Furthermore, SkillNet-Gym benchmarks skill retrieval, utilization, and composition, while SkillNet-Fabric enables task-specific skill routing through lightweight Wikis. By formalizing skills as evolving, composable assets, SkillNet provides a robust foundation for agents to move from transient experience to durable mastery.
papers.comment: http://skillnet.openkg.cn/; add SkillNet-Gym, a benchmark for evaluating skill retrieval, utilization, composition, and SkillNet-Fabric for task-specific skill routing through lightweight Wikis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillNet 是一个面向 AI 智能体的开放式技能基础设施，旨在统一技能的创建、评估与组织。它基于统一本体（unified ontology）整合异构来源的技能，提供多维度评估（安全性、完整性、可执行性、可维护性、成本感知），并包含超过 60 万技能的仓库、交互平台和 Python 工具包。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 等环境上的实验显示平均奖励提升 40%、执行步骤减少 30%。此外，SkillNet-Gym 用于评测技能检索、利用与组合，SkillNet-Fabric 通过轻量级 Wiki 实现任务特定的技能路由。
Motivation: 现有 AI 智能体虽能灵活调用工具并执行复杂任务，但缺乏系统化的技能积累与迁移机制，导致其经常在孤立场景中重复发现已有解决方案，长期发展受限。
Method: 提出 SkillNet 开放基础设施，通过统一本体从异构来源创建技能、建立丰富的技能间关系，并进行多维度评估；同时集成大型技能仓库、交互平台、Python 工具包，以及 SkillNet-Gym 基准和 SkillNet-Fabric 轻量级 Wiki 路由机制。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上，多个骨干模型下平均奖励提升 40%，执行步骤减少 30%。
Conclusion: SkillNet 将技能形式化为可演化、可组合的资产，为智能体从瞬时经验转向持久掌握提供基础。摘要未提及与天气或降水相关的任何内容。

papers.title: On the Power of Source Screening for Learning Shared Feature Extractors
papers.abstract_en: Learning with shared representation is widely recognized as an effective way to separate commonalities from heterogeneity across various heterogeneous sources. Most existing work includes all related data sources via simultaneously training a common feature extractor and source-specific heads. It is well understood that data sources with low relevance or poor quality may hinder representation learning. In this paper, we further dive into the question of which data sources should be learned jointly by focusing on the traditionally deemed ``good'' collection of sources, in which individual sources have similar relevance and qualities with respect to the true underlying common structure. Towards tractability, we focus on the linear setting where sources share a low-dimensional subspace. We find that source screening can play a central role in statistically optimal subspace estimation. We show that, for a broad class of problem instances, training on a carefully selected subset of sources suffices to achieve minimax optimality, even when a substantial portion of data is discarded. We formalize the notion of an informative subpopulation, develop algorithms and practical heuristics for identifying such subsets, and validate their effectiveness through both theoretical analysis and empirical evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多源共享表示学习中哪些数据源应被联合学习的问题，聚焦于传统上认为"好"的源集合（各源相对真实共享结构具有相似相关性与质量）。在线性设定下，作者证明在一类广泛的问题实例中，仅对精心挑选的源子集训练就足以达到 minimax 最优性，即使丢弃大量数据也能保持统计最优。文章形式化了信息性子群体（informative subpopulation）的概念，提出识别算法与实用启发式，并通过理论分析和合成/真实数据实验验证其有效性。
Motivation: 现有共享表示学习方法通常同时使用所有相关数据源训练共享特征提取器和各源特定头，但低相关或低质量源会阻碍表示学习。本文进一步追问：在单个源相对真实共享结构已较为一致的前提下，哪些源应该被选择出来联合学习，从而突破"全部纳入"的默认做法。
Method: 将问题置于线性设定中，假设所有源共享一个低维子空间，从而将源筛选转化为对共享子空间估计的统计最优性分析。作者形式化定义信息性子群体，并开发识别这类子集的算法与实际启发式，同时从理论上分析其最优性保证。
Result: 摘要报告，对一大类问题实例，在仔细选择的源子集上训练即可达到 minimax 最优的共享子空间估计，即使丢弃相当大比例的数据也不会损失统计最优性。
Conclusion: 作者认为源筛选（source screening）可在统计最优的共享子空间估计中发挥核心作用，并指出所提算法与启发式在合成和真实数据上均有效。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Diffusion-Attention Connection
papers.abstract_en: Softmax attention is the row-normalized operator of a diffusion map: both normalize a learned score into a Markov operator, and differ only in what the score is allowed to contain. Decomposing that score reveals three geometric sectors: a metric core with Witten-Laplacian continuum limit, an exact node-potential sector corresponding to a Markov--Witten change of measure, and a circulating sector realized as irreversible Markov--Girsanov transport or as a magnetic $U(1)$ phase. Attention thereby becomes auditable in familiar mathematics: every trained head carries measurable geometry, potential, and flux, while standard mechanisms acquire geometric addresses---Coifman--Lafon normalization as an exact density correction, rotary embeddings as pure gauge, and AdaLN as a Cauchy--Green deformation combined with an Witten deformation. Experiments on pretrained diffusion transformers and language models test this decomposition: enforcing positive-semi-definite geometry is nearly free, consistent with the identification, whereas removing circulation incurs a substantial cost, sharpest on induction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 softmax attention 与扩散映射 (diffusion map) 之间存在严格联系：两者都是把学习到的 score 归一化为 Markov 算子，仅 score 的允许形式不同。作者将 attention score 分解为三个几何扇区——具有 Witten-Laplacian 连续极限的度量核心、对应 Markov–Witten 测度变换的节点势扇区，以及可视为不可逆 Markov–Girsanov 输运或磁 U(1) 相位的循环扇区，并在预训练扩散 Transformer 和语言模型上验证该分解。
Motivation: 现有关注机制 (attention mechanism) 的内部结构缺少可审计的几何解释，论文旨在把每个训练好的注意力头转化为可测量的几何、势与通量 (flux)，使标准机制获得清晰的几何对应。
Method: 将 attention score 分解为三部分：度量核心 (metric core，具 Witten-Laplacian 连续极限)、节点势扇区 (node-potential sector，对应 Markov–Witten 测度变换)、循环扇区 (circulating sector，实现为不可逆 Markov–Girsanov 输运或磁 U(1) 相位)；并把 Coifman–Lafon 归一化、rotary embeddings、AdaLN 等标准机制分别映射为密度修正、纯规范场和 Cauchy–Green 变形加 Witten 变形。
Result: 在预训练扩散 Transformer 和语言模型上的实验表明：强制正半定几何几乎不损失性能，与该识别一致；而移除循环项则带来显著代价，且在 induction 任务上最为明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 attention 可以由成熟的几何数学进行审计，每个注意力头携带可测量的几何、势和通量；循环扇区对模型行为有实质作用，而几何识别与实验观测相符。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Escaping Local Minima Provably in Non-convex Matrix Sensing: A Deterministic Framework via Simulated Lifting
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank matrix sensing is a fundamental yet challenging nonconvex problem whose optimization landscape typically contains numerous spurious local minima, making it difficult for gradient-based optimizers to converge to the global optimum. Recent work has shown that over-parameterization via tensor lifting can convert such local minima into strict saddle points, an insight that also partially explains why massive scaling can improve generalization and performance in modern machine learning. Motivated by this observation, we propose a Simulated Oracle Direction (SOD) escape mechanism that simulates the landscape and escape direction of the over-parametrized space, without resorting to actually lifting the problem, since that would be computationally intractable. In essence, we designed a mathematical framework to project over-parametrized escape directions onto the original parameter space to guarantee a strict decrease of objective value from existing local minima. To the best of our knowledge, this represents the first deterministic framework that could escape spurious local minima with guarantee, especially without using random perturbations or heuristic estimates. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our framework reliably escapes local minima and facilitates convergence to global optima, while incurring minimal computational cost when compared to explicit tensor over-parameterization. We believe this framework has non-trivial implications for nonconvex optimization beyond matrix sensing, by showcasing how simulated over-parameterization can be leveraged to tame challenging optimization landscapes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低秩矩阵感知 (low-rank matrix sensing) 中梯度方法易陷入伪局部极小值的问题，提出一种确定性逃逸框架 Simulated Oracle Direction (SOD)。该机制在不显式进行张量提升 (tensor lifting) 的情况下，模拟过参数化空间的逃逸方向并将其投影回原始参数空间，从而保证从现有局部极小值出发目标值严格下降。数值实验表明该框架能可靠逃逸局部极小值并以极低计算代价收敛到全局最优。
Motivation: 低秩矩阵感知是典型的非凸问题，其优化地形包含大量伪局部极小值，使基于梯度的优化器难以达到全局最优。已有工作表明张量提升可将局部极小值转化为严格鞍点，但显式提升在计算上不可行；因此需要一种无需随机扰动或启发式估计的确定性逃逸机制。
Method: 提出 Simulated Oracle Direction (SOD) 逃逸机制：通过数学框架模拟过参数化空间中的逃逸方向和地形，将这些方向投影回原始参数空间，以保证目标值从当前局部极小值处严格下降。该方法避免了实际执行计算上不可行的张量提升。
Result: 数值实验显示，该方法能可靠地逃逸局部极小值并促进收敛到全局最优，且相比显式张量过参数化的计算成本极小。
Conclusion: 作者声称这是首个能够有保证地逃逸伪局部极小值的确定性框架，不依赖随机扰动或启发式估计；并认为该框架通过模拟过参数化来驯服困难优化地形，对矩阵感知之外的非凸优化也有潜在意义。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Structure-Informed Estimation for Pilot-Limited MIMO Channels via Tensor Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Accurate channel state information in wideband MIMO systems is constrained by pilot overhead, a challenge intensifying as bandwidths scale toward 6G. This paper proposes a structure-informed hybrid estimator formulating pilot-limited MIMO channel estimation as low-rank tensor completion from sparse pilot observations---an underdetermined inverse problem that prior approaches avoid by assuming fully observed tensors. Canonical polyadic~(CP) and Tucker decompositions are compared: CP excels for specular channels matching its rank-one parameterization exactly, while Tucker provides numerical stability at extreme pilot scarcity where CP exhibits heavy-tail divergence. A lightweight 3D U-Net learns residual components beyond the low-rank structure, compensating for diffuse scattering and hardware non-idealities. On synthetic specular channels, Tucker completion improves normalized mean-squared error (NMSE) by $10.88$~dB over least squares and $7.83$~dB over orthogonal matching pursuit at $10\%$ pilot density ($ρ$); CP outperforms Tucker by $13.11$~dB at SNR=20~dB. On DeepMIMO channels, the hybrid Tensor--NN estimator has two regimes: Tensor--NN(Tucker) remains stable at $ρ=2\%$ where CP diverges, while a CP-guided variant becomes best from $ρ\ge 4\%$, reaching $-16.44$~dB at $ρ=8\%$ and $-20.34$~dB at $ρ=20\%$. The Tucker-guided variant outperforms unconstrained deep learning across the full pilot range; the CP-guided variant widens this gap once stable. Empirical analysis confirms sample complexity scales with intrinsic channel dimensionality (dominant paths) rather than ambient tensor size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对导频受限的宽带 MIMO 信道估计问题，提出将估计建模为稀疏导频观测下的低秩张量补全（low-rank tensor completion），并比较 CP 与 Tucker 两种张量分解，再叠加轻量 3D U-Net 学习低秩结构之外的残差。摘要报告在合成镜面信道和 DeepMIMO 信道上相比最小二乘、正交匹配追踪和纯深度学习方法均有 NMSE 提升，且样本复杂度随信道内在维度而非环境张量大小增长。
Motivation: 宽带 MIMO 系统的信道状态信息精度受导频开销制约，带宽向 6G 扩展时该问题加剧；先前方法通常假设张量被完全观测，回避了稀疏导频导致的欠定逆问题。
Method: 提出结构信息驱动的混合估计器，将导频受限信道估计表述为稀疏观测下的低秩张量补全，对比 CP 与 Tucker 分解，并用轻量 3D U-Net 学习超出低秩结构的残差部分，以补偿漫散射（diffuse scattering）和硬件非理想性。
Result: 在合成镜面信道上，10% 导频密度下 Tucker 补全比最小二乘改善 NMSE 10.88 dB、比正交匹配追踪改善 7.83 dB，SNR=20 dB 时 CP 比 Tucker 再优 13.11 dB；在 DeepMIMO 上，Tensor–NN(Tucker) 在导频密度 ρ=2% 时保持稳定而 CP 发散，CP 引导变体在 ρ≥4% 时最佳，ρ=8% 达 −16.44 dB、ρ=20% 达 −20.34 dB，Tucker 引导变体在全导频范围内优于无约束深度学习。
Conclusion: 摘要认为混合 Tensor–NN 估计器能在极端导频稀缺下保持稳定，CP 与 Tucker 的选择取决于导频密度和信道结构；经验分析表明样本复杂度与信道内在维度（主导路径数）而非环境张量大小相关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Label Horizon Paradox: Rethinking Supervision Targets in Financial Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning has revolutionized financial forecasting through sophisticated architectures, the design of the supervision signal itself is rarely scrutinized. We challenge the canonical assumption that training labels must strictly mirror inference targets, uncovering the Label Horizon Paradox: the optimal supervision signal often deviates from the prediction goal, shifting across intermediate horizons governed by market dynamics. We theoretically ground this phenomenon in a dynamic signal-noise trade-off, demonstrating that generalization hinges on the competition between marginal signal realization and noise accumulation. To operationalize this insight, we propose a bi-level optimization framework that autonomously identifies the optimal proxy label within a single training run. Extensive experiments on large-scale financial datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional baselines, thereby opening new avenues for label-centric research in financial forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战金融预测中“训练标签必须严格对齐推理目标”的常规假设，提出标签视界悖论 (Label Horizon Paradox)：最优监督信号往往偏离预测目标，并随市场动态在中间视界 (intermediate horizons) 间移动。作者用动态信噪权衡 (signal-noise trade-off) 给出理论解释，并提出一个双层优化 (bi-level optimization) 框架，在单次训练中自动识别最优代理标签。在大规模金融数据集上的实验显示该方法持续优于常规基线。
Motivation: 深度学习金融预测研究大多关注网络架构，监督信号本身的设计很少被审视；作者挑战标签必须严格镜像推理目标的经典假设，因为该假设可能限制模型泛化。
Method: 提出双层优化框架，在单次训练运行中自主识别最优代理标签 (proxy label)；理论上将现象归因于边际信号实现与噪声累积之间的竞争，即动态信噪权衡。
Result: 在大规模金融数据集上的广泛实验显示，该方法相对常规基线取得一致的改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为最优监督信号常偏离预测目标，并借此为金融预测中标签中心 (label-centric) 的研究开辟新方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出双层优化框架，在单次训练运行中自主识别最优代理标签 (proxy label)；理论上将现象归因于边际信号实现与噪声累积之间的竞争，即动态信噪权衡。
summary_sections.result: 在大规模金融数据集上的广泛实验显示，该方法相对常规基线取得一致的改进。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为最优监督信号常偏离预测目标，并借此为金融预测中标签中心 (label-centric) 的研究开辟新方向。

papers.title: FiLoRA: Focus-and-Ignore LoRA for Controllable Feature Reliance
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal foundation models integrate heterogeneous signals across modalities, yet it remains unclear whether their predictions can be controlled by explicitly modulating reliance on different internal feature pathways. Existing approaches to shortcut and spurious behavior primarily rely on post hoc analysis or data-level interventions, offering limited ability to directly intervene on how models use information. We introduce FiLoRA (Focus-and-Ignore LoRA), an instruction-conditioned, parameter-efficient adaptation framework that enables controllable modulation of feature reliance while keeping the task and predictive objective fixed. FiLoRA decomposes adaptation into feature-aligned low-rank modules and applies instruction-conditioned gating, allowing natural language instructions to act as computation-level control signals over internal representations. We evaluate FiLoRA across both controlled classification settings and generative multimodal tasks, and under a range of instruction types, including natural and compositional instructions. Results show that FiLoRA induces consistent and interpretable shifts in feature reliance, selectively amplifying or suppressing different feature groups in accordance with the instruction, without altering task semantics. Our findings suggest that instruction-conditioned parameter adaptation can serve as a practical mechanism for intervening on internal model behavior, providing a new perspective on controllability and analysis of multimodal systems beyond output-level prompting or post hoc interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FiLoRA（Focus-and-Ignore LoRA），一种指令条件化的参数高效自适应框架，用于在多模态基础模型中可控地调节不同内部特征通路的依赖程度，同时保持任务与预测目标不变。FiLoRA 将自适应分解为与特征对齐的低秩模块，并通过指令条件化门控使自然语言指令成为内部表征上的计算级控制信号。在受控分类与生成式多模态任务上，FiLoRA 能按照指令一致且可解释地放大或抑制特定特征组，而不改变任务语义。
Motivation: 多模态基础模型如何利用内部特征通路尚不明确，现有处理捷径与虚假相关行为的方法主要依赖事后分析或数据级干预，难以直接干预模型的信息使用方式。
Method: FiLoRA 将参数自适应分解为与特征对齐的低秩模块，并采用指令条件化门控，让自然语言指令直接控制内部表征上的特征取舍，属于参数高效的自适应机制。
Result: 在受控分类和生成式多模态任务上，针对包括自然指令与组合指令在内的多种指令类型，FiLoRA 均能根据指令一致且可解释地改变特征依赖，选择性地放大或抑制不同特征组，且不改变任务语义。
Conclusion: 作者认为指令条件化的参数自适应可以作为干预模型内部行为的实用机制，为多模态系统的可控性与分析提供了超越输出级提示或事后解释的新视角。

papers.title: TrojanGYM: A Detector-in-the-Loop LLM for Adaptive RTL Hardware Trojan Insertion
papers.abstract_en: Hardware Trojans (HTs) remain a critical threat because learning-based detectors often overfit to narrow trigger/payload patterns and small, stylized benchmarks. We introduce TrojanGYM, an agentic, LLM-driven framework that automatically curates HT insertions to expose detector blind spots. Given high-level HT specifications, a suite of cooperating LLM agents (instantiated with GPT-4, LLaMA-3.3-70B, Gemini-2.5Pro, and Claude Opus 4.5) proposes and refines RTL modifications that realize diverse triggers and payloads without impacting functionality of both the HT and the design under attack. TrojanGYM implements an agentic loop co-designed with HT detectors, in which constraint-aware syntactic checking, testbench-based functional verification, and GNN-based HT detectors provide feedback that iteratively refines HT specifications and insertion strategies to better surface detector blind spots. We further propose Robust-GNN4TJ, a new implementation of GNN4TJ with improved graph extraction, training robustness, and prediction reliability, especially on LLM-generated HT designs. On the most challenging TrojanGYM-generated benchmarks, Robust-GNN4TJ raises HT detection rates from 0% to 60% relative to prior art. We instantiate TrojanGYM on SRAM, AES-128, UART, and RISC-V designs at RTL, and show that it systematically produces diverse, functionally correct HTs that reach up to 68.75% evasion rates against modern GNN-based detectors, revealing robustness gaps that are not apparent when these detectors are evaluated on existing TrustHub-style benchmarks. We release all codes and artifacts at https://github.com/DfX-NYUAD/TrojanGYM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrojanGYM，一个基于 LLM 的智能体框架，用于自动生成 RTL 硬件木马 (hardware Trojan, HT) 插入，以暴露现有学习型检测器的盲区。框架由协作的 LLM 智能体（GPT-4、LLaMA-3.3-70B、Gemini-2.5Pro、Claude Opus 4.5）提出并细化 RTL 修改，并通过与检测器协同设计的智能体循环（语法检查、testbench 功能验证、GNN 检测器反馈）迭代优化。本文还提出 Robust-GNN4TJ，一种改进的 GNN4TJ 实现，在最具挑战性的 TrojanGYM 生成基准上将检测率从 0% 提升到 60%，并在 SRAM、AES-128、UART、RISC-V 设计上展示高达 68.75% 的逃避率。
Motivation: 硬件木马仍是严重威胁，因为基于学习的检测器常常过拟合到狭窄的触发/负载模式和过小、风格化的基准上，无法暴露真实鲁棒性差距。
Method: TrojanGYM 采用多个 LLM 智能体合作生成多样且功能正确的 RTL 木马，并引入与 HT 检测器协同设计的智能体循环，利用约束感知语法检查、基于 testbench 的功能验证和 GNN 检测器反馈来迭代细化木马规格和插入策略；同时提出改进的 Robust-GNN4TJ 检测器。
Result: 在 TrojanGYM 生成的最具挑战性基准上，Robust-GNN4TJ 将检测率从 0% 提高到 60%；在 SRAM、AES-128、UART 和 RISC-V 的 RTL 设计上，生成的木马达到最高 68.75% 的检测器逃避率，揭示出现有 TrustHub 风格基准无法体现的鲁棒性缺口。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架能系统性地生成多样化、功能正确的硬件木马，并暴露现代 GNN 检测器的鲁棒性缺陷，代码和工件已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wildfire Suppression: Complexity, Models, and Instances
papers.abstract_en: Wildfires cause major losses worldwide, and the frequency of fire-weather conditions is likely to increase in many regions. We study the allocation of suppression resources over time on a graph-based representation of a landscape to slow down fire propagation. Our contributions are theoretical and methodological. First, we prove strong NP-completeness on planar graphs for this problem and two related variants, and on full weighted directed grids for two of the three problems. We also show that this problem remains strongly NP-complete when all resources are released simultaneously. Second, we propose a new mixed-integer programming (MIP) formulation that obtains state-of-the-art results, showing that MIP is a competitive approach contrary to earlier findings. Third, showing that existing benchmarks lack realism and difficulty, we introduce a physics-grounded instance generator based on Rothermel's surface fire spread model. We use these diverse instances to benchmark the literature, identifying the specific conditions where each algorithm succeeds or fails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在图表示的景观上随时间分配抑制资源以减缓野火蔓延的问题，贡献包括复杂性证明、新的混合整数规划（MIP）公式和一个基于物理的实例生成器。作者证明了该问题在平面图上的强NP完全性，并展示了MIP方法在现有基准上取得最优结果，同时指出旧基准缺乏真实性和难度。
Motivation: 野火造成全球重大损失，且火险天气频率可能在许多地区增加；现有基准缺乏真实性和难度，需要更严谨的复杂性分析、更有效的求解方法以及更真实的实例来评估算法。
Method: 理论上证明问题及其变体在平面图和全权有向网格上的强NP完全性；提出一个新的混合整数规划（MIP）公式；引入基于Rothermel地表火蔓延模型的物理驱动实例生成器。
Result: 摘要报告新MIP公式获得最先进结果，表明MIP是一种有竞争力的方法，与早期发现相反；并利用多样化实例基准测试文献中的算法，指出各算法成功或失败的具体条件。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该问题即使在同时释放所有资源时仍是强NP完全的，且新的实例生成器可用于更公平地评估抑制资源分配算法。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: VTONQA: A Multi-Dimensional Quality Assessment Dataset for Virtual Try-on
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid development of e-commerce and digital fashion, image-based virtual try-on (VTON) has attracted increasing attention. However, existing VTON models often suffer from artifacts such as garment distortion and body inconsistency, highlighting the need for reliable quality evaluation of VTON-generated images. To this end, we construct \textbf{VTONQA}, the first multi-dimensional quality assessment dataset specifically designed for VTON, which contains 8,132 images generated by 11 representative VTON models, along with 24,396 mean opinion scores (MOSs) across three evaluation dimensions (\textit{i.e.}, clothing fit, body compatibility, and overall quality). Based on VTONQA, we benchmark both VTON models and a diverse set of image quality assessment (IQA) metrics, revealing the limitations of existing methods and highlighting the value of the proposed dataset. We believe that the VTONQA dataset and corresponding benchmarks will provide a solid foundation for perceptually aligned evaluation, benefiting both the development of quality assessment methods and the advancement of VTON models. The dataset we proposed in this paper is publicly available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/weixiny0408/vtonqa.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VTONQA，一个面向虚拟试穿 (virtual try-on, VTON) 的首个多维度图像质量评估数据集。数据集包含 11 个代表性 VTON 模型生成的 8,132 张图像，以及针对服装合身度 (clothing fit)、身体兼容性 (body compatibility) 和整体质量 (overall quality) 三个维度的 24,396 个平均意见分 (MOS)。作者基于该数据集对 VTON 模型和多种图像质量评估 (IQA) 指标进行基准测试，揭示了现有方法的局限性。
Motivation: 现有 VTON 模型生成的图像常出现服装变形和身体不一致等伪影，而缺乏针对 VTON 生成图像的可靠质量评估，因此需要专门的多维度数据集来支撑感知对齐的评价。
Method: 构建 VTONQA 数据集，收集 11 个代表性 VTON 模型的生成图像，并在三个评估维度上采集 MOS；随后基于该数据集对 VTON 模型和多种 IQA 指标进行基准测试。
Result: 数据集包含 8,132 张图像与 24,396 个 MOS；基准测试结果揭示了现有 VTON 模型和 IQA 指标在 VTON 场景下的局限性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 VTONQA 及其基准可为感知对齐评估提供基础，有利于质量评估方法和 VTON 模型的进一步发展，并已将数据集公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GeCo: Evaluating Geometric Consistency for Video Generation via Motion and Structure
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GeCo, a geometry-grounded metric for jointly detecting geometric deformation and occlusion-inconsistency artifacts in static scenes. By fusing residual motion and depth priors, GeCo produces interpretable, dense consistency maps that reveal these artifacts. We use GeCo to systematically benchmark recent video generation models, uncovering common failure modes, and further employ it as a training-free guidance loss to reduce deformation artifacts during video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeCo 是一个面向静态场景视频生成的几何一致性评估指标，用于联合检测几何形变与遮挡不一致伪影。它融合残差运动与深度先验，生成可解释的密集一致性图，并用于系统评估近期视频生成模型，以及作为免训练引导损失来减少生成过程中的形变伪影。
Motivation: 视频生成模型在静态场景中常产生几何形变和遮挡不一致伪影，而现有评估指标难以同时定位这两类问题，缺乏可解释的密集度量。
Method: 提出 GeCo，通过融合残差运动 (residual motion) 和深度先验 (depth priors)，联合检测几何形变与遮挡不一致，输出密集的一致性图 (consistency maps)，并可作为训练无关的引导损失 (training-free guidance loss) 使用。
Result: 摘要报告 GeCo 能系统评估近期视频生成模型，揭示常见失败模式，并在作为引导损失时减少形变伪影。未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: GeCo 提供了一种可解释、密集的几何一致性度量，兼具评估与生成时引导的功能，但摘要未讨论其局限性或适用范围。
Relevance: 0
