papers.title: From Inference to Adaptation: A Unified Optimal Transport View of Vision Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot capabilities yet remain sensitive to real-world distribution shifts during inference. Although significant efforts are devoted to adapting VLMs at test time, they rely heavily on noisy pseudo-labels predicted directly from raw embedding similarities during inference, which are unreliable under distribution shift and mislead the adaptation. To avoid noise amplification, existing works craft coarse-grained surrogate objectives during adaptation, which fail to explicitly model sample-level relationships across different modalities, creating objective mismatch with inference, thus leading to marginal performance improvement. In this work, we aim to bridge the detached objectives of inference and adaptation for VLMs, and propose a principled VLM TTA method called \algname. For VLM inference, we formulate the zero-shot image classification task as a cross-modal alignment problem encoded via a Wasserstein OT formulation, providing robust pseudo-labels at the sample-level to effectively adapt VLMs. For VLM adaptation, we adopt a soft-label InfoNCE loss to adapt VLMs based on the OT-induced pseudo-labels, leveraging fine-grained supervisions to explicitly model relationships of individual image-text pairs via contrastive learning, which empowers accurate inference at the same granularity. Moreover, we theoretically reveal that the InfoNCE loss can be neatly reformulated as a Wasserstein OT formulation, thereby unifying the objectives of the inference and adaptation of VLMs to achieve their mutual benefits. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our methods, outperforming the best-performing methods by up to 7% with state-of-the-art efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的 Wasserstein 最优传输 (Optimal Transport) 视角来衔接视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的推理与测试时自适应 (TTA)。作者将零样本图像分类建模为跨模态对齐的 OT 问题，从而生成样本级鲁棒伪标签，并用软标签 InfoNCE 损失进行自适应；理论上证明 InfoNCE 可被重构为 Wasserstein OT 形式。实验宣称在多个基准上以最优效率超越最好方法最高达 7%。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 测试时自适应依赖从原始嵌入相似度直接得到的伪标签，在分布偏移下不可靠；为避免噪声放大，已有工作使用粗粒度代理目标，无法显式建模跨模态样本级关系，导致自适应目标与推理目标不匹配、性能提升有限。
Method: 将推理阶段建模为 Wasserstein OT 的跨模态对齐问题以获得样本级鲁棒伪标签；自适应阶段使用基于这些伪标签的软标签 InfoNCE 损失，借助对比学习显式建模单个图像-文本对的关系。作者还从理论上揭示 InfoNCE 可等价重写为 Wasserstein OT 形式，从而统一推理与自适应目标。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法在效果和效率上均表现优异：在最优方法基础上最高提升 7%，并取得当前最优效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过 OT 统一 VLM 推理与自适应目标可以实现两者的互惠，为测试时自适应提供了一种原则性框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring the Partial-Credit Gap: A Strict Benchmark on Vietnam's 2025 Convex Marking Scheme
papers.abstract_en: When evaluating language models on human exams, benchmarks typically score each response as right or wrong and report the overall accuracy. This approach assumes that partial knowledge is worth proportional credit, an assumption that fails when an examination uses a non-additive grading scheme. The 2025 reform of Vietnam's National High School Graduation Examination demonstrates the cost of this substitution. In Part II of the exam, candidates evaluate four true/false statements per question. The grading is convex: the number of correct statements earns 0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, or 1.00 points. Identifying three statements correctly pays 0.50 points, not the 0.75 points that standard accuracy metrics would award. Because Part II accounts for 4.00 of the exam's 10.00 points, reporting accuracy inflates the score by rewarding partial knowledge that the state explicitly penalizes. We introduce THPT-Ladder, a benchmark of 632 items from 21 official exams across 11 subjects, graded exactly as the ministry grades its students. The ministry publishes the marks of over a million candidates, allowing us to place models directly into the human cohort. Across eight models, the official rubric pays 0.020 to 0.159 points less per Part II question than proportional credit. This shortfall changes a model's apparent competence. For Qwen3.5-27B on the 2025 History exam, a 0.042-point shortfall drops its standing from the 90th to the 77th percentile among 481,293 candidates. A model's accuracy does not predict this penalty. At Claude Sonnet 5's accuracy level, different distributions of errors yield scores varying from 0.869 to 0.932 points per question. Official marks depend on how correct statements are grouped, meaning standard benchmarks report a competence the institution would not certify.

papers.title: When Does Dynamic Ensembling Pay Off? Diagnosing Regionwise Gains in Regression under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Whether input-dependent ("dynamic") combination of a regression model pool beats the best static blend depends on the shift and is rarely known before deployment. Can a small labeled target-domain probe tell us when reallocating trust across regions of the input space will pay off? We answer this with $\widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}}$, which estimates from the probe the cross-fitted gain of the regionwise convex combination over the best static convex blend: the realizable value of deciding, region by region, whom to trust. Across a frozen suite of 12 dataset-shift pairs (spatial, temporal, domain, feature-cluster), $\widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}}$ predicts realized regionwise test gains with dataset-level Spearman $+0.98$ (95% CI $[+0.83, +1.00]$; $p=5\times10^{-5}$), including two cases overturning preregistered expectations. The relationship holds in a 16-pair sensitivity analysis (Spearman $+0.83$), whereas alternative probe diagnostics reach at most $+0.66$. This contrast isolates regional trust reallocation: correlation is $+0.98$ for regionwise-convex gain, but $+0.01$ for smooth covariate-dependent stacking after affine correction. A controlled generator shows dynamic gains arise from the interaction of shift heterogeneity and local competence, increase with shift severity, and become realizable between 128 and 256 probe labels in the tested grid. The Probe-Validated Ensemble Selector chooses among a static affine stacker and dynamic realizers, deploying a candidate only when a held-out lower confidence bound clears the static-convex floor. In a preregistered prospective batch, it matched or improved the floor in all 12 runs; two deployments reduced test risk by 11% and 16%, while the gate rejected a candidate whose un-gated deployment incurred $>30\times$ the static loss. We release OpenRegShift, a reproducible evaluation harness for regression ensembles under distribution shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究回归模型池在分布偏移下，输入依赖（动态）组合何时能胜过最优静态混合。作者提出估计量 \widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}}，利用少量有标注目标域探针样本，交叉拟合估计区域级凸组合相对于最优静态凸混合的增益，从而判断按输入区域重分配信任是否值得。在冻结的12个数据集-偏移对上，该方法预测实测区域级测试增益的数据集级 Spearman 达到 +0.98，并发布了可复现的评估框架 OpenRegShift。
Motivation: 动态集成是否优于最优静态混合取决于具体的分布偏移，且部署前通常不可知。作者希望回答：小规模目标域探针能否提前告诉研究者，跨输入空间区域重新分配模型信任是否会带来收益。
Method: 提出 \widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}} 估计量，从探针样本用交叉拟合方式估计区域级凸组合相对于最优静态凸混合的增益；并提出 Probe-Validated Ensemble Selector，仅在保留集下置信界超过静态凸混合基线时才部署候选动态实现器。还使用受控生成器分析动态增益的来源与可实现性。
Result: 在12个数据集-偏移对上，\widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}} 预测实测区域级测试增益的 Spearman 为 +0.98（95% CI [+0.83, +1.00]，p=5×10^{-5}）；16对敏感性分析中为 +0.83，而替代探针诊断最高仅 +0.66。区域级凸增益相关为 +0.98，但仿射校正后平滑协变量相关 stacking 的相关仅为 +0.01。受控生成器显示动态增益随偏移严重度增加，并在测试网格上于128至256个探针标签之间变得可实现。预注册前瞻批次中12次运行全部达到或优于静态基线，两次部署分别降低测试风险11%和16%，门控拒绝了一个未门控部署会造成静态损失30倍以上损失的候选。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于探针的诊断能够有效判断动态集成在回归分布偏移下何时值得部署，并强调区域级信任重分配是增益来源的关键；同时发布 OpenRegShift 作为可复现的回归集成评估工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Governance Records as Supervision: Verifier-Selected Self-Training for Structured Workflow Repair
papers.abstract_en: Machine-verifiable workflows produce governance records linking a task contract, model attempt, verifier decision, accepted output, and target origin. We test whether these records can supervise bounded models, consolidating occasional or expensive capability into reliable one-shot execution. On fresh, structure-disjoint PlanBench replanning cases, Qwen3-14B thinking generated 24 plans admitted by the independently authored VAL verifier. Those plans trained the same checkpoint for non-thinking execution, without oracle targets or a stronger teacher. On 80 unopened cases, VAL-accepted plans increased from 1 to 57, with 56 paired gains and zero regressions; thinking reached 30. The adapter was schema-valid on all cases and used approximately 1/56 of thinking's mean latency. The separate paired interface-cure gate did not pass. A matched ablation fixed the source cases, 52-candidate pool, 24-target count, model, recipe, and seed while changing target selection. On 160 new cases, base, schema-selected, model-self-selected, and VAL-selected execution reached 1, 55, 69, and 102 accepted plans. VAL exceeded self-selection by paired net +33 (p=0.0000019647), with gains in both difficulty strata. Independent semantic selection is therefore load-bearing relative to matched alternatives within this band. A complementary Phi stronger-teacher arm raised base Phi-4 from 2 to 51 accepted plans and from 35 to 80 schema-valid outputs. Earlier synthetic experiments establish teachability, cumulative learning, construction robustness, and stopping boundaries. The results support verifier-selected supervision for bounded, machine-checkable capabilities, not arbitrary planning, enterprise validity, or unrestricted self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否用机器可验证工作流产生的治理记录（任务契约、模型尝试、验证器决策、接受输出与目标来源）作为监督信号，把偶发或昂贵的推理能力固化为可靠的一次性执行。作者在结构不相交的 PlanBench 重规划用例上，用 Qwen3-14B 的 thinking 模式生成 24 个被独立编写的 VAL 验证器接受的计划，再用这些计划训练同一 checkpoint 的非 thinking 执行模式，全程无需 oracle 目标或更强教师。摘要报告在 80 个未开封用例上 VAL 接受计划从 1 增至 57，56 个配对增益、零回退；配对接口校验门未通过。消融实验中，VAL 选择的目标训练效果显著优于基线和模型自选。
Motivation: 现有能力较强的模型在验证器辅助下可能偶尔生成正确输出，但难以稳定地一次性执行；作者想检验这类机器可验证能力能否通过治理记录监督被压缩到有界模型（bounded model）中，从而减少对昂贵 thinking 模式的依赖。
Method: 提出 verifier-selected self-training 流程：以独立编写的验证器（VAL）对候选计划的接受决定作为训练数据选择依据，用被接受的计划训练同一 checkpoint 的非 thinking 执行，属于无 oracle、无更强教师的自训练。论文还做了匹配消融，固定源用例、52 候选池、24 目标数、模型、配方与随机种子，仅改变目标选择方式（base、schema-selected、model-self-selected、VAL-selected），并另设一个 Phi 更强教师对照臂。
Result: 在 80 个未开封用例上，VAL 接受计划从 1 提升到 57，56 个配对增益且零回退，thinking 模式下为 30；adapter 在所有用例上 schema 合法，平均延迟约为 thinking 模式的 1/56。匹配消融在 160 个新用例上，base、schema-selected、model-self-selected、VAL-selected 分别达到 1、55、69、102 个接受计划，VAL 相对自选配对净增 33（p=0.0000019647）。Phi 更强教师臂将 Phi-4 的接受计划从 2 提升到 51，schema 合法输出从 35 提升到 80。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果支持验证器选择的监督信号适用于有界、机器可检查的能力，例如本实验中的计划修复；但明确指出这并不推广到任意规划、企业有效性或不受限的自我改进。摘要还强调，在此设置下独立语义选择相对于匹配对照是承重的（load-bearing）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SingularClip: Preventing Spectral Collapse to Maintain Plasticity in Continual and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks trained on nonstationary tasks frequently lose the ability to fit new targets, a phenomenon referred to as loss of plasticity. We identify a novel source of plasticity loss due to the growing anisotropy of weight matrices' singular values during training, and analyze this phenomenon both empirically and theoretically. To mitigate this issue, we introduce SingularClip, a procedure that periodically clips the singular values of all weight matrices. We show that SingularClip performs strongly against baselines across a range of tasks in both continual supervised learning and deep reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络在非平稳任务上训练时逐渐丧失拟合新目标能力的问题（即可塑性丧失，loss of plasticity），并识别出一个新的致因：训练过程中权重矩阵奇异值分布日益各向异性（spectral collapse）。作者提出 SingularClip 方法，周期性裁剪所有权重矩阵的奇异值以维持可塑性；在持续监督学习和深度强化学习的多项任务上，该方法相对基线表现优异。
Motivation: 网络在非平稳或持续学习场景中会逐渐失去适应新任务的能力，这一问题被称为可塑性丧失。作者发现训练期间权重矩阵奇异值趋于各向异性是此前未被充分认识的一个可塑性损失来源，并对其进行了经验与理论分析。
Method: 提出 SingularClip：周期性对所有权重矩阵的奇异值施加裁剪（clipping），以抑制谱坍缩并维持网络的持续可塑性。该方法在持续监督学习与深度强化学习两类设定下进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告 SingularClip 在一系列持续监督学习和深度强化学习任务上均优于基线方法，但未给出具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 摘要强调奇异值各向异性是导致可塑性丧失的一种新机制，定期裁剪奇异值可以有效缓解该问题；摘要未涉及方法的局限性或适用范围。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.method: 提出 SingularClip：周期性对所有权重矩阵的奇异值施加裁剪（clipping），以抑制谱坍缩并维持网络的持续可塑性。该方法在持续监督学习与深度强化学习两类设定下进行验证。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 SingularClip 在一系列持续监督学习和深度强化学习任务上均优于基线方法，但未给出具体数值或基准名称。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调奇异值各向异性是导致可塑性丧失的一种新机制，定期裁剪奇异值可以有效缓解该问题；摘要未涉及方法的局限性或适用范围。

papers.title: Reproducible Multimodal Affordance Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Affordance prediction is the identification of potential actions an agent can perform on a target object from multimodal inputs. Affordance prediction methods are difficult to evaluate and compare due to heterogeneous problem formulations, inconsistent dataset annotations, incomplete reporting of experimental protocols, and limited information about deployment conditions. These limitations challenge fair benchmarking and performance comparison. To promote transparency, we propose the Affordance Sheet, a documentation detailing task formulation with its input modalities, model architectures and training information, datasets, and experimental protocols. Affordance Sheets enable reproducible benchmarking and reliable evaluation of affordance models for real-world scenarios, including generalisation to novel conditions and human safety.
papers.comment: Paper accepted to Workshop on Human-Centered Multimodal Intelligence in the Wild (HCMIW) in European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026; 18 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Project webpage at https://apicis.github.io/aff-sheet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态可负担性预测 (affordance prediction) 评测与比较困难的问题，提出 Affordance Sheet 文档规范，用于记录任务定义、输入模态、模型架构、训练信息、数据集与实验协议。论文被 ECCV 2026 的 HCMIW Workshop 接收，主要贡献是评估层的标准化而非新的预测方法。
Motivation: 可负担性预测方法因问题表述异构、数据集标注不一致、实验协议报告不完整以及部署条件信息有限而难以公平评测和比较，这阻碍了可复现基准的建立。
Method: 提出 Affordance Sheet，一种系统化的文档模板，要求详细记录任务定义及其输入模态、模型架构与训练信息、数据集，以及实验协议，以此提升评测透明度。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验指标；其宣称的收益是使可负担性模型的基准评测可复现，并支持对真实世界场景（包括新条件泛化与人类安全）的可靠性评估。
Conclusion: 作者认为采用 Affordance Sheet 能够推动可复现基准和可靠评估，填补可负担性预测领域在评测规范上的空白。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Configurable Privacy-Preserving MRI Processing Workflow Using Deep Learning-Based Brain Extraction and Adaptive Anatomical Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is widely used in neuroimaging research and clinical practice, but structural MRI volumes may retain facial and cranial anatomical information that raises privacy concerns. Existing deep learning-based brain extraction methods generally produce a single fixed output, limiting flexibility when different applications require different balances between privacy and anatomical preservation. This paper presents a configurable privacy-preserving MRI processing workflow that extends deep learning-based brain extraction through adaptive anatomical preservation, interactive preservation selection, and integrated quality control. The workflow employs SynthStrip for automated brain extraction, followed by morphological mask expansion to generate configurable shell-based preservation levels. An Interactive Preservation Framework enables users to compare preservation configurations and select an appropriate output, while an integrated Quality Control Framework provides multi-plane visualisation and brain-mask overlay verification. The workflow was implemented in Python using open-source neuroimaging libraries within the Renku reproducible research environment and evaluated using structural T1-weighted MRI data from the publicly available IXI dataset. Experimental results demonstrate anatomically plausible brain extraction and configurable preservation outputs, supported by systematic visual verification. The principal contribution is a modular and reproducible MRI preprocessing framework that enhances deep learning-based brain extraction with configurable anatomical preservation, interactive user-guided processing, and integrated quality control. The workflow provides a practical foundation for privacy-oriented neuroimaging research and collaborative medical image analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对结构 MRI 中面部与颅骨信息带来的隐私问题，提出一个可配置的隐私保护 MRI 处理工作流。该工作流以 SynthStrip 自动脑提取为基础，结合形态学掩膜扩展生成可配置的壳状保留级别，并加入交互式保留选择与集成质量控制。作者使用公开 IXI 数据集的 T1-weighted MRI 数据在 Renku 可复现研究环境中实现并评估，结果显示脑提取解剖结构合理、保留输出可配置，并辅以系统化视觉验证。
Motivation: 结构 MRI 体积可能保留面部和颅骨解剖信息，带来隐私顾虑；而现有基于深度学习的脑提取方法通常只产生单一固定输出，难以在不同应用所需的隐私保护与解剖保留之间灵活权衡。
Method: 提出一个模块化工作流：用 SynthStrip 进行自动脑提取，然后通过形态学掩膜扩展生成可配置的壳状保留级别；引入交互式保留框架（Interactive Preservation Framework）让用户比较并选择保留配置；同时集成质量控制框架（Quality Control Framework）提供多平面可视化和脑掩膜叠加验证。实现基于 Python 与开源神经影像库，并部署在 Renku 可复现研究环境中。
Result: 在使用 IXI 数据集结构 T1-weighted MRI 的实验中，该方法产生解剖学上合理的脑提取结果和可配置的保留输出，并通过系统性视觉验证得到支持；摘要未报告定量指标。
Conclusion: 主要贡献是一个模块化且可复现的 MRI 预处理框架，为基于深度学习的脑提取增加可配置解剖保留、交互式用户引导处理与集成质量控制，为隐私导向的神经影像研究和协作式医学影像分析提供实用基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedCoRe: Target-Adaptive Completion for Missing Modalities in Healthcare Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated multimodal models often assume every site has every modality, although hospitals differ in access to EHRs, chest radiographs, and ECGs. We study this setting on a MIMIC-derived respiratory deterioration task with simulated FL clients and introduce FedCoRe (Federated Cross-Modal Representation Completion). FedCoRe learns representation- or logit-space corrections rather than generating synthetic ECGs or CXR images. When a client observes a modality that may be missing at deployment, it evaluates the same example with and without that modality to obtain paired supervision. Only clients with such pairs update the completion module, and validation may retain the unchanged prediction. We freeze the trained multimodal predictor during evaluation so that measured differences come only from completion. Hiding ECG reduced AUROC by about 0.085; paired-example FedAvg restored 0.0415 AUROC, or 49.0% of the lost performance. We therefore report two distinct effects: paired-example FedAvg partially recovers the missing-ECG gap, while validation-selected completion is a task-specific classifier-logit correction rather than literal ECG recovery. For CXR, effect-aware completion recovers 52.8% of the loss in a controlled test where CXR is hidden. Paired-example FedAvg transfers part of this effect, but validation keeps the no-completion baseline for deployment cases whose inputs lack CXR. Thus, FedCoRe should be read as a validation-gated completion/correction framework: it can recover missing-modality signal in supported settings, but it should be deployed only when paired examples and validation evidence support that modality.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 7th Workshop on Distributed, Collaborative & Federated Learning, DeCaF 2026, MICCAI, Strasbourg, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedCoRe（Federated Cross-Modal Representation Completion），用于医疗联邦学习中模态缺失场景下的跨模态补全。该方法不生成合成 ECG 或 CXR 图像，而是在表示空间或 logit 空间学习修正；在 MIMIC 派生的呼吸恶化任务上，隐藏 ECG 使 AUROC 下降约 0.085，paired-example FedAvg 恢复其中 49.0% 的性能，CXR 的受控测试中可恢复 52.8% 的损失。作者强调 FedCoRe 是一个验证门控（validation-gated）的补全/修正框架，仅在配对样本与验证证据支持的场景下部署。
Motivation: 联邦多模态模型通常假设每个站点拥有全部模态，但医院在 EHR、胸片（CXR）和心电图（ECG）等数据的可及性上存在差异；现有方法缺少针对联邦场景下模态缺失的适配机制。
Method: FedCoRe 学习表示级或 logit 级的修正而非生成缺失模态样本；当客户端在部署时观测到可能缺失的模态时，对同一示例分别做带与不带该模态的推理以获得配对监督。只有拥有这类配对的客户端更新补全模块，验证阶段可以保留未改变的原预测；评估时冻结训练好的多模态预测器，使测量差异仅来自补全模块。
Result: 在 MIMIC 派生的呼吸恶化任务模拟联邦客户端上，隐藏 ECG 使 AUROC 降低约 0.085，paired-example FedAvg 恢复 0.0415 AUROC（即 49.0% 的损失）；在隐藏 CXR 的受控测试中，effect-aware completion 恢复 52.8% 的损失，而验证阶段对缺少 CXR 的部署用例保留无补全基线。
Conclusion: FedCoRe 应被理解为验证门控的补全/修正框架：它能在受支持的设置中恢复缺失模态带来的性能损失，但只在配对样本和验证证据支持该模态时才应部署。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: XRF-to-Optical Field-of-View Localization with Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Registering images acquired with different microscopy modalities is essential for relating complementary measurements of the same specimen. In correlative X-ray fluorescence (XRF) and optical microscopy, the XRF map often covers only a small region of an optical image acquired from the same or an adjacent tissue section. Field-of-view (FOV) localization is necessary but can be difficult when appearance and structure differ across modalities. Here we evaluate training-free vision language model (VLM) localization on two datasets representing same-section high-correspondence and adjacent-section low-correspondence imaging. We test unconstrained and metadata-constrained search and compare VLMs with geometric controls, classical template matching, and two alternative training-free approaches (DINOv2 and multiGradICON). Direct VLM prompting produced content-dependent spatial signals but was not reliable alone. Classical matching was most accurate when cross-modal structure was preserved but failed in the low-correspondence collection. A proposal-and-verify workflow used repeated VLM predictions as candidates and image-based similarity to select the final location. This workflow recovered useful localization in the low-correspondence regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了无需训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）在X射线荧光（XRF）图像与光学显微镜图像之间进行视场（FOV）定位的能力，涉及同一切片的高对应和相邻切片的低对应两类数据集。作者测试了无约束与元数据约束的搜索，并与几何控制、经典模板匹配、DINOv2和multiGradICON等训练无关方法对比。直接VLM提示能产生与内容相关的空间信号但单独使用不可靠；经典匹配在跨模态结构保留时最准确，但在低对应集合中失效；提出的候选-验证流程能在低对应场景中恢复有用的定位。
Motivation: 关联不同显微镜模态的图像对理解同一标本的互补测量至关重要；在XRF与光学显微镜的关联成像中，XRF图通常只覆盖光学图像的一小部分区域，而跨模态的外观和结构差异使FOV定位困难。
Method: 提出一种候选-验证（proposal-and-verify）流程：重复使用VLM预测作为候选位置，并基于图像相似性选择最终位置；同时系统比较了无约束与元数据约束的VLM搜索以及多种训练无关基线。
Result: 摘要报告直接VLM提示能产生内容依赖的空间信号，但单独使用不可靠；经典模板匹配在结构保持时最准确，但在低对应数据集中失败；候选-验证流程在低对应场景中恢复了有用的定位结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调候选-验证工作流可以在XRF到光学图像的跨模态低对应场景下实现有效的FOV定位，而单一VLM提示或经典匹配均不足以应对全部情况。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ComponentBench: Diagnosing Component-Level Failures in Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Current evaluation of computer-use agents is split between long-horizon workflow benchmarks and atomic GUI-grounding tests. This leaves an under-instrumented middle layer: realistic component-centered interactions (e.g., toggle a button set) that are short enough to diagnose and rich enough to capture the burdens of modern interfaces. We present ComponentBench, a benchmark and diagnostic pipeline for component-level evaluation of computer-use agents on modern web UIs. ComponentBench is organized around a library-agnostic ontology of 97 canonical UI components instantiated as 2,910 programmatically verified tasks across widely used component libraries, paired with cleaned human reference trajectories that enable evaluation of both task success and interaction efficiency. Beyond task collection, we introduce a scalable pipeline for auditing realized structural difficulty after implementation and synthesizing structured failure analyses across tasks and component families. Evaluating seven models -- GPT-5.4, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-5.4 mini, GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, Qwen3-VL-235B, and UI-TARS-1.5-7B -- across four observation and action spaces, we show that these design choices critically impact performance. Within a single shared harness, changing only the observation and action space shifts task success by more than 30% for the same model: GPT-5 mini falls from 83.1% with accessibility-tree observations to 48.9% with coordinate-only Pixel control. Moreover, even the fastest configuration takes 3.7x as long as the matched human reference, and spatial manipulations that are trivial for humans continue to challenge current agents.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ComponentBench，一个面向现代 Web UI 上组件级（component-level）计算机使用智能体评测的基准与诊断流水线。基准围绕 97 个规范组件（canonical UI components）组织，生成 2910 个程序化验证的任务，并配有人类参考轨迹以同时评估任务成功率和交互效率。作者在七个模型和四种观察/动作空间上评测，发现仅改变观察与动作空间即可使同一模型的任务成功率变动超过 30%。
Motivation: 现有评测分为长时程工作流基准和原子级 GUI 接地测试，缺少既能诊断又足够贴近现代界面复杂性的中间层：组件为中心的交互（如切换按钮组）。
Method: 构建与组件库无关的本体（ontology），包含 97 个规范组件，实例化为面向多个常用组件库的 2910 个任务；同时提供清洗后的人类参考轨迹，并引入可扩展流水线来审计实现后的结构难度并跨任务/组件族合成失败分析。
Result: 在 GPT-5.4、Gemini 3 Flash、GPT-5 mini、Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite、Qwen3-VL-235B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B 等七个模型上的评测表明，仅将 GPT-5 mini 的观察从无障碍树（accessibility tree）改为纯坐标像素控制，任务成功率就从 83.1% 降到 48.9%；即使最快配置也比匹配的人类参考慢 3.7 倍，对人类简单的空间操作仍困扰当前智能体。
Conclusion: 作者强调观察与动作空间等设计选择对组件级性能影响巨大，组件级诊断能揭示工作流级评测掩盖的效率与结构失败。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High-Flux Count-Free Single-Photon 3D Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Single-photon cameras based on single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) technology are gaining popularity for 3D sensing, thanks to their extreme sensitivity and time resolution. There are two key challenges with single-photon cameras that limit their widespread use: (i) they suffer from non-linear distortions called ''pile-up'' when operated in high-photon-flux conditions, and (ii) they generate a large volume of raw photon data, creating a severe data bottleneck at each sensor pixel. In this work, we show that while compressive capture techniques successfully mitigate data transfer challenges, they exacerbate the effects of dead-time distortion because they fail to retain sufficient information about the photon detection history to allow post-processing pile-up correction via existing methods. We propose a new computational-imaging method that combines free-running capture with an analysis-by-synthesis software pipeline to mitigate pile-up distortions. Our results with hardware emulations and full-scene and single-pixel simulations show that our method can reliably capture scene distance and reflectance over a wide range of illumination conditions. Our work will enable high-resolution SPAD cameras that are severely bandwidth-constrained to operate in real-world high-flux scenarios.
papers.comment: Presented at IEEE ICCP 2026 (Best Paper Award Winner). To appear in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单光子相机（SPAD）在高通量条件下存在非线性 pile-up 失真和原始光子数据量过大的问题，提出一种结合自由运行采集（free-running capture）与 analysis-by-synthesis 软件流水线的计算成像方法。硬件仿真和全场景/单像素模拟表明，该方法能在宽照明范围内可靠恢复场景距离和反射率，使带宽受限的高分辨率 SPAD 相机可用于真实高通量场景。该论文获得 IEEE ICCP 2026 最佳论文奖，并被 TPAMI 接收。
Motivation: 单光子相机受 pile-up 非线性失真和高数据量瓶颈限制；压缩采集虽缓解传输压力，却因丢失光子检测历史而使现有 pile-up 后处理方法失效，阻碍其在真实高通量场景中的使用。
Method: 提出一种新计算成像方法：将自由运行采集与 analysis-by-synthesis 软件流水线结合，以保留足够的光子检测历史信息并对抗 pile-up 失真。
Result: 硬件仿真及全场景和单像素模拟表明，该方法能在宽范围光照条件下可靠捕获场景距离和反射率，适用于严重带宽受限的高分辨率 SPAD 相机。
Conclusion: 该方法使高分辨率、带宽受限的 SPAD 相机能够在真实高通量场景中运行，解决压缩采集加剧 dead-time 失真这一关键矛盾。

papers.title: Acquisition Geometry-Assisted Whole-Group Localization of X-ray Fluorescence Maps in Optical Microscopy Images
papers.abstract_en: X-ray fluorescence (XRF) microscopy maps elemental distributions, while optical microscopy can provide complementary morphological context. Localizing XRF fields of view (FOVs) in optical images is difficult because the two modalities differ in contrast mechanism and resolution. Most current workflows place each XRF tile independently, even when acquisition metadata already record the tiles' relative scan positions. This study formalizes XRF tile-group localization, in which one optical-frame placement is estimated for the whole group, constrained by acquisition geometry and quantified using group intersection-over-union (GroupIoU). In a controlled case study, independent localization failed with GroupIoU 0.000, whereas group localization achieved 0.931. Replacing the normalized cross-correlation (NCC) metric with mutual information (MI) gave nearly identical results, showing that the outcome is not specific to one local similarity metric. In another multiscale case study, using a coarse XRF survey scan to connect the fine-scale tile group to the optical image increased mean GroupIoU from 0.694 to 0.856. These case studies support using acquisition geometry as an explicit constraint when localizing related XRF tiles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于采集几何约束的X射线荧光（XRF）图组定位方法，将多个XRF视野（FOV）作为一个整体在光学显微镜图像中定位，并用组交并比（GroupIoU）量化。受控案例中独立定位GroupIoU为0.000，而组定位达到0.931；将归一化互相关（NCC）替换为互信息（MI）后结果几乎一致。另一多尺度案例中，利用粗XRF扫描将细尺度图组连接到光学图像，平均GroupIoU从0.694提升到0.856。
Motivation: XRF显微镜与光学显微镜因对比机制和分辨率不同，难以将XRF视野定位到光学图像中。现有工作通常独立放置每个XRF瓦片，忽略了采集元数据中已记录的相对扫描位置，导致定位失败。
Method: 将XRF图组定位形式化为对整个图组估计一个光学帧放置的问题，以采集几何作为显式约束，并用GroupIoU作为量化指标；同时通过替换相似度度量（NCC换成MI）检验结果对局部相似度度量的依赖性。
Result: 受控案例中独立定位的GroupIoU为0.000，组定位达到0.931；使用MI与NCC结果几乎相同。多尺度案例中，使用粗XRF调查扫描连接细尺度图组与光学图像，平均GroupIoU从0.694升至0.856。
Conclusion: 这些案例支持在定位相关XRF瓦片时将采集几何作为显式约束。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SESSE: Sketch, Expand, Sort, Summarize, Evaluate -- LLM-as-Judge Evaluation via Structured Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-judge evaluation reduces response quality assessment to a single holistic A/B preference choice, providing no mechanism to isolate which quality dimensions drove the preference or distinguish model errors from genuine label ambiguity. We propose SESSE (Sketch, Expand, Sort, Summarize, Evaluate), a training-free framework that decomposes holistic judgment into structured sub-questions mined directly from the judge's own error cases; requiring no oracle responses, task-specific rubrics, or fine-tuning. On RewardBench (n=1,000), SESSE achieves near-parity with the chain-of-thought baseline and is competitive with RISE-Judge-32B (92.7%), a fine-tuned specialist, while remaining fully training-free. Per-criterion vote evidence provides an interpretable audit trail for diagnosing label ambiguity and judge failure modes unavailable from a single holistic output token.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SESSE（Sketch, Expand, Sort, Summarize, Evaluate），一个无需训练的 LLM-as-judge 评估框架，将整体 A/B 偏好判断分解为从评判模型自身错误案例中挖掘的结构化子问题，不需要 oracle 答案、任务特定 rubric 或微调。在 RewardBench（n=1,000）上，SESSE 与 chain-of-thought 基线近乎持平，并与微调专家模型 RISE-Judge-32B（92.7%）竞争，同时保持完全无需训练。每个准则的投票证据提供了可解释的审计轨迹，可用于诊断标签歧义和评判模型的失败模式。
Motivation: 现有的 LLM-as-judge 评估将回答质量归结为单一的整体 A/B 偏好选择，无法隔离是哪个质量维度驱动了偏好，也难以区分模型错误与真实的标签歧义。
Method: 提出 SESSE 五阶段流程：Sketch、Expand、Sort、Summarize、Evaluate，即把整体判断分解为直接从评判模型自身错误案例中挖掘的结构化子问题，全程无需 oracle 响应、任务专用评分标准或微调。
Result: 在 RewardBench（n=1,000）上，SESSE 达到与 chain-of-thought 基线近乎持平的表现，并与微调专家 RISE-Judge-32B（92.7%）相当，同时保持训练无关性；每个准则的投票证据还提供了单一整体输出 token 所不具备的可解释审计轨迹。
Conclusion: 作者强调，无需训练的结构化分解既能维持具有竞争力的评估性能，又能提供可解释的审计轨迹，用于诊断标签歧义与评判模型失败模式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Lifecycle of LLM-as-a-Judge for Large-Scale Recommendation Explanations
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-Judge, which leverages a large language model to evaluate natural language generated by another AI application or model, has become a standard, scalable approach for accelerating and extending costly human evaluation. However, most work treats a judge as a static artifact, evaluating it once at construction or against a fixed benchmark. In contrast, we argue that an LLM judge running in a production system is better understood as having a lifecycle: it must be built, trained, deployed, and continuously maintained as the surrounding data evolves, and each phase poses distinct technical and operational challenges. We present such a lifecycle for the LLM judges that evaluate user-facing recommendation explanations at Netflix, where our pipeline generates and the judges assess hundreds of thousands of distinct show-level explanations per week, served across the mobile experience to millions of members. Our framework has four phases: (I) Birth, defining multiple evaluation criteria and building curated benchmark datasets with human labels and rationales; (II) Training, refining the judges' rubrics via Reasoning-Aligned Rubric Tuning (RART), a rubric-tuning procedure that uses a meta-judge over reasoning output as the learning signal; (III) Deployment, in which one judge serves two production roles: quality gating and reflective generation; and (IV) Monitoring, a continuous Human-in-the-Loop alignment process that detects drift and triggers re-tuning behind a human review gate. We report post-launch results from a five-week A/B test over tens of millions of members, in which the judge-aligned explanations shifted member viewing toward novel content (previously unwatched) and increased successful browse-to-play sessions relative to a no-explanation control, with no quality-related takedowns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证生产环境中的 LLM-as-a-Judge 不应被视为一次性构建的静态产物，而应理解为一个包含构建、训练、部署与持续维护的生命周期。作者以 Netflix 推荐解释场景为例，介绍了一个四阶段框架：Birth（定义评估标准并构建带人工标签与理由的基准数据集）、Training（通过 Reasoning-Aligned Rubric Tuning, RART 调整评分标准）、Deployment（同一 judge 承担质量门控与反思式生成两种角色）和 Monitoring（持续 Human-in-the-Loop 的漂移检测与重调）。摘要报告了持续五周、覆盖数千万会员的 A/B 测试结果，表明 judge 校准后的解释使会员观看转向新内容并提升浏览到播放的成功会话数，且没有出现与质量相关的下架。
Motivation: 现有研究大多把 LLM judge 当作静态组件，只在构建时或针对固定基准评估一次；而生产系统中的数据持续演化，每个阶段都有不同的技术与运维挑战，作者认为需要按生命周期来理解和管理 judge。
Method: 提出四阶段生命周期框架：Birth 阶段定义多条评估标准并构建带人工标签和理由的基准数据集；Training 阶段采用 Reasoning-Aligned Rubric Tuning（RART），以元 judge 对推理输出的评估作为学习信号来调整 rubric；Deployment 阶段让同一个 judge 同时服务质量门控（quality gating）与反思式生成（reflective generation）；Monitoring 阶段通过人工审核门控后的持续 Human-in-the-Loop 对齐流程检测漂移并触发重新调优。
Result: 摘要报告了持续五周的 A/B 测试（覆盖数千万会员）：与无解释对照组相比，judge 对齐后的推荐解释使会员观看行为转向此前未看过的新内容，并增加了成功的浏览到播放（browse-to-play）会话数，且没有发生与质量相关的下架事件。
Conclusion: 作者认为生产级 LLM judge 需要被当作有出生、训练、部署、监控的完整生命周期来治理，该框架在 Netflix 的大规模推荐解释流水线中运行，每周为移动端数百万会员评估数十万条剧集级解释。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出四阶段生命周期框架：Birth 阶段定义多条评估标准并构建带人工标签和理由的基准数据集；Training 阶段采用 Reasoning-Aligned Rubric Tuning（RART），以元 judge 对推理输出的评估作为学习信号来调整 rubric；Deployment 阶段让同一个 judge 同时服务质量门控（quality gating）与反思式生成（reflective generation）；Monitoring 阶段通过人工审核门控后的持续 Human-in-the-Loop 对齐流程检测漂移并触发重新调优。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告了持续五周的 A/B 测试（覆盖数千万会员）：与无解释对照组相比，judge 对齐后的推荐解释使会员观看行为转向此前未看过的新内容，并增加了成功的浏览到播放（browse-to-play）会话数，且没有发生与质量相关的下架事件。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为生产级 LLM judge 需要被当作有出生、训练、部署、监控的完整生命周期来治理，该框架在 Netflix 的大规模推荐解释流水线中运行，每周为移动端数百万会员评估数十万条剧集级解释。

papers.title: FairGlucose: A CGM Fairness Benchmark Reveals Subgroup Disparities Hidden in Population-Level Validation
papers.abstract_en: As CGM-based AI tools approach clinical deployment, whether their accuracy is equitable across patient demographics remains insufficiently tested. To enable this evaluation, we constructed FairGlucose, a 300-patient CGM cohort balanced across 12 demographic strata (age x gender x type 1/type 2 diabetes), with 132,480 forecasting samples and 3,945 unique behavioral events (meals, exercise, medication) logged by 81 patients. Benchmarking 33 models across four families on 2-hour glucose forecasting, we find that population-level external validation can conceal substantial subgroup disparities. Aggregate out-of-distribution metrics appear stable (approximately 1.0), yet subgroup-level ratios range from 0.8 to 1.4, with T1D patients showing 6 mg/dL higher prediction error than T2D (p < 0.001). This disparity persists across all 33 models, suggesting a property of the prediction task rather than any single architecture. Further analysis shows that subgroup performance gaps align with the proportion of clinically hard cases, and that input-length sensitivity varies across demographics, motivating personalized configurations. Frontier LLMs underperform specialized neural models by 1-6 mg/dL; behavioral events contribute negligibly (approximately 0.1 mg/dL) even under oracle event access. These findings establish that population-level validation alone is insufficient for equity assessment of digital health AI, motivating subgroup-disaggregated reporting as a default standard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个面向连续血糖监测（CGM）公平性评估的基准数据集 FairGlucose，包含 300 名患者、跨 12 个人口统计分层（年龄×性别×1/2 型糖尿病）的平衡队列，以及 132,480 个预测样本和 81 名患者记录的 3,945 个行为事件。作者对 4 个模型家族共 33 个模型进行 2 小时血糖预测基准测试，发现总体外部验证指标稳定但亚组间差异显著，表明人口层面的验证不足以揭示公平性问题。
Motivation: 基于 CGM 的 AI 工具接近临床部署，但其准确性是否在不同人口统计亚组之间公平尚无充分测试。现有研究通常只报告总体外部验证指标，可能掩盖亚组间的不平等。
Method: 构建 FairGlucose 数据集，按年龄、性别和糖尿病类型平衡抽样 300 名患者，记录 3,945 个行为事件；对 33 个模型（四个家族）进行 2 小时血糖预测基准测试，并分析总体与亚组层面的 OOD（out-of-distribution）误差、输入长度敏感性、LLM 与专用模型对比以及事件信息的贡献。
Result: 总体 OOD 指标看似稳定（约 1.0），但亚组比值波动在 0.8 到 1.4 之间；T1D 患者的预测误差比 T2D 高 6 mg/dL（p < 0.001），且这一差异在全部 33 个模型中一致存在。前沿 LLM 比专用神经模型差 1–6 mg/dL；行为事件即使在 oracle 访问下也仅贡献约 0.1 mg/dL。亚组性能差距与临床困难病例比例相关，输入长度敏感性随人群不同而不同。
Conclusion: 作者认为人口层面的验证不足以评估数字健康 AI 的公平性，主张将按亚组分层的报告作为默认标准。

papers.title: Debiased Inference for AI-Generated Data without Gold-Standard Labels: Identification via Multiple Imperfect Measurements
papers.abstract_en: An increasing number of scholars use AI to measure variables they subsequently include in downstream analyses. Although AI-measured variables are often analyzed as if observed without error, ignoring prediction errors in automated measurement leads to substantial bias and invalid confidence intervals in downstream analyses, even if AI measurement accuracy is high, e.g., above 90%. Existing solutions, such as design-based supervised learning and prediction-powered inference, combine error-prone AI-based measurements with gold-standard labels, which may be costly and difficult to obtain in some application areas. In this paper, we propose debiased inference with multiple imperfect measurements (DMM), a framework that combines multiple error-prone AI measurements to enable valid downstream inference without gold-standard labels. Building on the established results on CP decomposition, DMM assumes that these measurements are independent conditional on the latent true label and observed unit-level features, such as text features represented by embeddings. This framework allows for unknown misclassification rates to vary across annotation methods (e.g., large language models) and across units of annotation (e.g., texts). Under this assumption, we use semiparametric inference theory to prove that the DMM estimator is consistent and asymptotically normal, enabling valid inference for a wide range of downstream statistical analyses common in the social sciences. Our simulation results show that DMM yields valid inference and that adding accurate, though imperfect, measurements can improve efficiency. Focusing on common applications of large language model annotations, we also develop diagnostics to assess the conditional independence assumption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DMM (Debiased Inference with Multiple Imperfect Measurements) 框架，组合多个有误差的 AI 测量（如大语言模型标注）以在无金标准标签 (gold-standard labels) 的情况下实现有效的下游统计推断。基于 CP 分解，DMM 假设不同测量在给定潜在真实标签和单元级特征（如文本嵌入）时条件独立，并允许误分类率随标注方法和单元变化。作者用半参数推断理论证明估计量一致且渐近正态，模拟表明该方法能产生有效推断，且加入更准确但不完美的测量可提升效率，同时开发了检验条件独立性假设的诊断工具。
Motivation: AI 测量变量常被当作无误差使用，但预测误差即使准确率高于 90% 也会在下游分析中造成显著偏差和无效置信区间。现有方案（如设计式监督学习和预测驱动推断）依赖金标准标签，而后者在某些应用领域成本高昂或难以获得。
Method: 提出 DMM 框架，结合多个有误差的 AI 测量而不需要金标准标签。该框架建立在 CP 分解结果上，假设测量在潜在真实标签和观测单元特征条件下相互独立，并允许未知误分类率在不同标注方法和标注单元间变化；随后使用半参数推断理论推导估计量的渐近性质。
Result: 摘要中的模拟结果显示 DMM 能提供有效推断，并且增加准确但非完美的测量可以提高效率；针对大语言模型标注的常见应用，还开发了用于评估条件独立性假设的诊断方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在无需金标准标签的条件下，DMM 可为社会科学中常见的广泛下游统计分析提供有效推断；其有效性依赖测量间的条件独立性假设，因此配套诊断工具是必要的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GuideFetch: A Task Coordination Framework for Concurrent Navigation and Object Retrieval in Assistive Robot Dogs
papers.abstract_en: Consider a robot guide dog escorting a blind user to an available seat while a second assistive robot dog concurrently retrieves a cup of coffee and delivers it to the same seat. This setting motivates concurrent execution because navigation and object retrieval can overlap. A syntactically valid Large Language Model (LLM) plan may still violate embodiment constraints, and successful-looking controller motion does not by itself establish task completion. We introduce \textsc{GuideFetch}, a coordination framework for concurrent navigation and object retrieval by a heterogeneous guider and fetcher team. An LLM instantiates a schedule-conditioned four-action schema from a natural-language instruction. Before execution, robot, skill, and target aliases are normalized, and proposed actions are validated against registered targets, robot capabilities, and the selected schedule. Robot and object states then govern sequential and parallel execution. In a matched $2\times2$ study across 90 combinations of scene and seed (360 executions), all 180 online LLM responses validate without fallback or replay and match the corresponding scripted plans. For each planner source, sequential and parallel execution achieve $72/90$ and $71/90$ operational successes, respectively. Among the 56 cases completed by both schedules, parallel execution reduces mean makespan by 41.3\%. Within this controlled setting, role specialization and action overlap shorten completed missions, while state checks distinguish plan validity from verified mission completion. Source code will be available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GuideFetch，一个用于异构“引导者-取物者”辅助机器人狗团队的并发导航与目标取回协调框架。LLM 从自然语言指令实例化调度条件化的四动作架构，执行前对机器人、技能与目标别名进行规范化，并按注册目标、能力与调度验证动作；随后由机器人及物体状态驱动串行和并行执行。在 2×2 设计、90 种场景-种子组合共 360 次执行中，所有在线 LLM 响应均无回退或重放地通过验证并匹配脚本计划；并行执行在两个调度均完成的案例中平均 makespan 降低 41.3%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 生成的计划虽然语法有效，仍可能违背具身约束；控制器运动看起来成功也不能等同于任务完成。机器人导盲犬带路、另一机器人狗同时取咖啡并送达的场景需要显式的并发任务协调，而现有方法缺少对计划有效性与任务完成状态的区分。
Method: 提出 GuideFetch 框架：LLM 根据自然语言指令实例化调度条件化的四动作架构，执行前将机器人、技能和目标别名归一化，并对照注册目标、机器人能力及所选调度验证提议动作；执行阶段由机器人与物体状态控制串行和并行动作的执行。
Result: 在匹配的 2×2 研究（90 种场景-种子组合、360 次执行）中，180 个在线 LLM 响应全部通过验证且与脚本计划一致；串行与并行执行分别达到 72/90 和 71/90 的操作成功；在两种调度均完成的 56 个案例中，并行执行平均 makespan 降低 41.3%。
Conclusion: 在该受控场景下，角色分工与动作重叠能够缩短任务完成时间，状态检查用于区分计划有效性与已验证的任务完成；作者表示源代码将公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Evaluating Structured Information Extraction with Open Models in a High Risk Public Sector Application
papers.abstract_en: The extraction of structured information from unstructured documents represents a critical component of digital transformations in all sectors. While proprietary solutions dominate commercial applications, a rapidly growing ecosystem of open-source Optical Character Recognition (OCR) engines, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offers accessible alternatives. However, systematic evaluations on realistic, multi-step extraction pipelines remain scarce. Responsible usage of such extraction tools require comprehensive evaluations on realistic tasks, especially as these solutions will be key components of applications in the public sector that the EU AI act categorizes as high risk. To address this gap we present a comprehensive benchmark assessing the end-to-end performance of open-source systems on a complex real-world document processing task classified as high risk: Student applications for an international study program. We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation with state-of-the-art OCR engines, LLMs and VLMs. Our results reveal that while VLMs generally outperform OCR+LLM pipelines, even state-of-the-art open-source models struggle to handle such tasks reliably in zero-shot settings. Only 4 of 35 configurations achieved F1 scores above 0.5, with the best OCR+LLM pipeline matching top VLM performance, though most OCR+LLM combinations performed substantially worse. Roughly 75\% of all configurations scored below 0.25. Model scale influences performance, yet the relationship is non-linear: substantially larger models do not guarantee proportionally better results. Input quality, particularly the structural preservation of OCR output, emerges as a critical factor independent of downstream model capability.
papers.comment: Accepted at Workshop on Systems Over Models: What Actually Works in Industry (SOMI-2026) at ECML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高风险的公共部门文档处理场景，提出一个端到端基准，评估开源 OCR 引擎、LLM 与 VLM 在国际学生申请材料这类真实文档上的结构化信息提取性能。摘要报告，在 35 种配置中仅有 4 种 F1 超过 0.5，约 75% 的配置得分低于 0.25，VLM 总体优于 OCR+LLM 流水线，但最先进的零样本开源模型仍难以可靠完成此类任务。模型规模与性能呈非线性关系，OCR 输出的结构保真度是独立于下游模型能力的关键因素。
Motivation: 开源 OCR、LLM 与 VLM 生态快速增长，但对真实、多步骤提取流水线的系统性评估仍稀缺；公共部门应用被欧盟 AI 法案归类为高风险，负责任地使用这些工具需要基于现实任务的全面评估。
Method: 构建一个真实世界文档处理基准，任务为国际学习项目的学生申请材料提取，并对最先进的 OCR 引擎、LLM 和 VLM 进行端到端零样本 (zero-shot) 对比评估。
Result: VLM 总体上优于 OCR+LLM 流水线，但仅 4/35 的配置 F1 高于 0.5；最佳 OCR+LLM 组合可匹敌顶级 VLM，不过多数 OCR+LLM 组合表现明显更差，约 75% 的配置得分低于 0.25。模型规模影响性能但呈非线性关系，更大模型不保证成比例提升；OCR 输出的结构保真度是关键因素。
Conclusion: 即使是最先进的开源模型，在高风险公共部门任务的零样本设置下仍难以可靠完成结构化信息提取；输入质量（尤其是 OCR 输出结构保持）是独立于下游模型能力的重要决定因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QuARC-GS: Quantized Anchored Residual Coding for Compact Dynamic Scene Streaming with Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene representation techniques such as neural radiance fields (NeRFs) and Gaussian splatting have made substantial progress in novel view synthesis, achieving high-quality renderings from arbitrary view angles. More recently, such techniques have been extended to dynamic 3D scenes; however, achieving sustainable online free-viewpoint video (FVV) streaming remains challenging, especially for longer videos, due to significant storage demands of detailed scene representations and high reconstruction/rendering speed needs. To address these challenges, we propose Quantized Anchored Residual Coding Gaussian Streaming (QuARC-GS), a quantization-aware 4D scene optimization framework for online dynamic scene reconstruction that achieves ultra-high compression while maintaining reconstruction speed and quality. QuARC-GS represents a scene using a single canonical frame and highly compressed per-frame residuals. Specifically, we compress each residual through two complementary strategies targeting motion, appearance, and densification. We introduce quantization-aware anchor deformation, which suppresses insignificant motion updates while preserving meaningful deformations, maintaining reconstruction quality under low-storage streaming. Furthermore, we design a change-gated densification strategy that allocates new Gaussians only in regions exhibiting genuine temporal changes, effectively eliminating redundant appearance updates and reducing storage overhead. Extensive experiments on widely used datasets demonstrate that QuARC-GS enables competitive reconstruction quality and training speed while cutting per-frame storage by up to 11$\times$ compared to the state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuARC-GS，一种面向在线动态场景重建与流式传输的量化感知 4D 场景优化框架，用单一规范帧（canonical frame）加高压缩的逐帧残差表示动态场景。方法通过量化感知锚点变形（quantization-aware anchor deformation）和变化门控致密化（change-gated densification）分别压缩运动、外观与高斯致密化更新。实验表明在保持有竞争力重建质量与训练速度的同时，相比最先进方法将每帧存储降低最多 11 倍。
Motivation: NeRF 与 Gaussian splatting 等三维表示已被扩展到动态场景，但长视频的在线自由视点视频（FVV）流式传输仍受制于精细场景表示带来的巨大存储需求以及重建/渲染速度要求。
Method: 使用单一规范帧表示场景，并通过两种互补策略压缩每个残差：量化感知锚点变形抑制不显著的运动更新，同时保留有意义的形变；变化门控致密化仅在与真实时间变化对应的区域分配新高斯，从而消除冗余外观更新并降低存储开销。
Result: 在广泛使用的数据集上的大量实验表明，QuARC-GS 在保持有竞争力的重建质量和训练速度的同时，相对最先进方法将每帧存储降低最多 11 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能在低存储流式传输约束下维持重建质量，适用于较长视频的在线动态场景重建。

papers.title: Self-supervised In-context Operator Learning for Stochastic Mean-Field Control
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic mean-field control (MFC) provides a fundamental framework for coordinating large populations of interacting agents under uncertainty, with a wide range of applications. Existing numerical and deep-learning methods solve one MFC problem instance at a time and must be re-optimized whenever the task changes. In this work, we formulate stochastic MFC as an operator-learning problem and develop, to the best of our knowledge, the first mesh-free, self-supervised neural operator for stochastic MFC. The main challenge is that the diffusion term in the controlled Fokker--Planck equation precludes deterministic transport-map representations. We address this challenge by combining the probability-flow ODE with an invertible normalizing-flow-based transformer, which recasts the dynamics as a deterministic continuity equation and enables closed-form score evaluation through the exact inverse and analytical log-determinant of the normalizing flow, with $\mathcal{O}(d)$ cost per particle for networks of fixed size. Through transformer-based in-context learning, task prompts, represented by compact distribution parameters or raw particle clouds, condition the transport map, enabling a single pretrained operator to solve unseen tasks in one forward pass. The resulting \emph{Normalizing Flow Invertible Solution Transformer} (NFIST) is trained end-to-end by minimizing the stochastic control objective directly, requiring no precomputed numerical solutions for training. We further prove the consistency of the proposed operator-learning formulation with task-by-task optimization. Numerical experiments on stochastic optimal control, Schrödinger bridge, systemic-risk control, and obstacle-avoiding path planning demonstrate effective zero-shot generalization while substantially reducing the computational cost of solving large families of stochastic MFC problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个无网格、自监督的随机平均场控制（stochastic MFC）神经算子 NFIST。该方法将概率流 ODE 与基于可逆归一化流的 Transformer 结合，把动力学重写为确定性连续性方程，并通过归一化流的精确逆和分析对数行列式实现闭式得分评估，每粒子成本为 O(d)。基于 Transformer 的上下文学习用分布参数或原始粒子云作为任务提示，使单个预训练算子能在一次前向传播中解决未见任务，端到端训练直接最小化随机控制目标，无需预计算数值解。
Motivation: 现有数值和深度学习方法一次只能求解一个随机 MFC 实例，任务变化时必须重新优化，缺乏跨任务泛化的算子式求解框架；同时受控 Fokker-Planck 方程中的扩散项阻碍了确定性传输映射表示。
Method: 将随机 MFC 形式化为算子学习问题，结合概率流 ODE 与基于可逆归一化流的 Transformer（Normalizing Flow Invertible Solution Transformer, NFIST），利用精确逆和解析对数行列式得到闭式得分评估；通过 Transformer 上下文学习，以紧凑分布参数或原始粒子云作为任务提示调节传输映射，并直接以随机控制目标进行端到端训练。
Result: 在随机最优控制、Schrödinger 桥、系统性风险控制与避障路径规划等数值实验中，该方法展现了有效的零样本泛化，并大幅降低求解大型随机 MFC 问题族的计算成本；作者还证明了该算子学习形式化与逐任务优化的一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是首个无网格、自监督的随机 MFC 神经算子，训练不需要预计算的数值解，能一次性前向传播求解未见任务。

papers.title: What Makes Software Issue Resolution Tasks Difficult for Agents?
papers.abstract_en: Background. Advances in agentic systems are simultaneously, and rapidly, saturating benchmarks. Despite this often discussed phenomena, benchmark scores remain difficult to interpret due to the lack of control and characterization of task difficulty. More specifically, we currently have little understanding of what makes one task harder than another, and to what extent task difficulty is predictable from static task properties. Aims. We propose a measurement framework to investigate and systematically quantify what structural properties of software tasks correspond to agent success rates for issue resolution tasks. Method. We conducted a large scale empirical study on CoderForge-Preview, the largest open dataset of coding agent trajectories to date, by extracting features across task patch, repository and prompt. We evaluated the predictive power of each feature against task outcomes using ensemble methods, SHAP attribution, and effect size analysis. Results We found that task difficulty is substantially predictable from static features (AU C = 0.863) and is largely driven by patch fragmentation and repository scale. Prompt linguistic features become visible among top contributors for tasks in the mid-band, revealing a layered structure of difficulty. Conclusion. The difficulty of an issue resolution task is encoded in its structure. This enables static, pre-hoc difficulty estimation and lays the groundwork for difficulty-controlled benchmark construction for evaluation of agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体系统在软件问题解决基准上分数饱和但任务难度难以解释的问题，提出一个测量框架，系统量化软件任务的结构属性与智能体成功率之间的关系。作者在目前最大的编码智能体轨迹开放数据集 CoderForge-Preview 上进行大规模经验研究，从任务补丁、代码仓库和提示中提取特征，并结合集成方法、SHAP 归因和效应量分析评估各特征的预测力。摘要报告任务难度在很大程度上可由静态特征预测（AUC=0.863），主要由补丁碎片化程度和仓库规模驱动，提示语言特征在中间难度区间成为重要贡献者，揭示出难度的分层结构。
Motivation: 当前智能体系统快速刷新基准分数，但基准分数难以解释，因为缺乏对任务难度的控制和刻画；人们尚不清楚是什么让一个软件任务比另一个更难，以及任务难度在多大程度上可由静态任务属性预测。
Method: 提出一个测量框架，在 CoderForge-Preview 数据集上提取任务补丁、仓库和提示三类特征，使用集成方法、SHAP 归因和效应量分析来评估每个特征对任务结果（智能体成功率）的预测能力。
Result: 摘要报告任务难度可被静态特征显著预测（AUC=0.863），主要驱动因素是补丁碎片化和仓库规模；提示的语言特征在中等难度任务区间成为主要贡献者，显示难度具有分层结构。
Conclusion: 问题解决任务的难度编码在其结构之中，这支持静态的、事前（pre-hoc）难度估计，并为构建难度可控的智能体评估基准奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Comprehensive Review of Large Language Models for Nanophotonics: From Surrogate Modeling to Autonomous Design
papers.abstract_en: Metasurfaces have revolutionized the development of photonic devices by enabling unprecedented precision in light manipulation. However, their design processes are often constrained by computationally expensive simulations and complex high-dimensional design spaces. Although deep learning has accelerated the design process by serving as a surrogate model, it remains constrained by task-specific architectures and lacks universal reasoning capabilities. This review surveys how Large Language Models (LLMs) are adding semantic interfaces, code generation, and tool orchestration to established numerical nanophotonic workflows. We first outline the development from classical neural networks to transformer-based models and their applications in nanophotonic design. We then review the emergence of LLM-related methods in nanophotonics and organize them into two operational modes: surrogate models that treat structure-spectrum mapping as a language task, and agentic systems that have been demonstrated to generate code, orchestrate selected simulation steps, and support closed-loop optimization. Furthermore, to identify future cross-disciplinary opportunities, we briefly explore applications of LLMs in research fields such as materials science and wireless communications. This review concludes by looking ahead to the next generation of multimodal foundation models with physical perception capabilities. In this vision, artificial intelligence is evolving from passive tools into active collaborators, participating in autonomous scientific discovery.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Advanced Photonics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于大型语言模型 (LLM) 在纳米光子学中应用的综述，发表于 Advanced Photonics。文章梳理了从经典神经网络到 Transformer 模型的发展，并将 LLM 相关方法归纳为两种运行模式：将结构-光谱映射视为语言任务的代理模型 (surrogate models)，以及能生成代码、编排仿真步骤并支持闭环优化的智能体系统 (agentic systems)。综述还简要探讨了 LLM 在材料科学和无线通信等领域的跨学科应用，并展望了具备物理感知能力的多模态基础模型。
Motivation: 超表面的设计通常受限于计算昂贵的仿真和高维设计空间，而基于深度学习的代理模型又受限于任务专用架构，缺乏通用推理能力，因此需要引入 LLM 来为既有数值纳米光子学工作流增加语义接口、代码生成和工具编排能力。
Method: 这是一篇综述，作者将 LLM 相关方法组织为两种操作模式：一是把结构-光谱映射当作语言任务的代理模型，二是能够生成代码、编排选定仿真步骤并支持闭环优化的智能体系统；同时按时间线梳理从经典神经网络到基于 Transformer 的模型及其在纳米光子设计中的应用。
Result: 文章没有报告新的实验数字，而是综述了 LLM 方法在纳米光子设计中的现有进展，并指出这些方法覆盖代理建模、代码生成、仿真步骤编排与闭环优化；此外还介绍了材料科学和无线通信等领域的潜在跨学科机会。
Conclusion: 作者认为人工智能正从被动工具演变为主动协作者，并展望下一代具有物理感知能力的多模态基础模型参与自主科学发现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Model Card for OpenAI Privacy Filter
papers.abstract_en: OpenAI Privacy Filter is a compact, bidirectional token-classification model for detecting and redacting personally identifiable information (PII) and secrets in unstructured text. The model is derived from an autoregressively pretrained checkpoint and converted into a bidirectional, banded-attention classifier that labels an input sequence in a single forward pass. A constrained Viterbi decoder produces coherent spans across eight privacy categories and exposes configurable operating points for precision-recall tradeoffs. Privacy Filter has 1.5 billion total parameters, 50 million active parameters per token, and a 128,000-token context window. It is designed for efficient local deployment and domain-specific fine-tuning. Privacy Filter is intended as a configurable data-minimization component within layered privacy workflows, not as an anonymization or compliance guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenAI Privacy Filter 是一个紧凑的双向 token 分类模型，用于在非结构化文本中检测和脱敏个人身份信息 (PII) 与密钥。该模型从自回归预训练 checkpoint 转换而来，形成带带状注意力 (banded attention) 的双向分类器，可单次前向传播完成序列标注。受限 Viterbi 解码器在八个隐私类别上生成连贯片段，并提供可配置的精度-召回率权衡工作点。模型总参数量 1.5B，每个 token 激活 50M 参数，支持 128,000 token 的上下文窗口，面向高效本地部署和领域微调设计。
Motivation: 非结构化文本中的 PII 和密钥检测与脱敏需要高效、可本地部署且支持精度-召回率权衡的模型，以满足分层隐私工作流中的数据最小化需求。
Method: 从自回归预训练 checkpoint 出发，将其转换为双向带状注意力分类器，对输入序列进行单次前向标注；使用受限 Viterbi 解码器在八个隐私类别上生成连贯预测片段，并暴露可配置的操作点用于精度-召回率权衡。
Result: 摘要报告模型规格：总参数量 1.5B、每 token 激活 50M 参数、上下文窗口 128,000 token，并称其支持跨八个隐私类别的单遍标注与可配置精度-召回率权衡；未给出具体实验数值。
Conclusion: 作者明确表示该模型是分层隐私工作流中可配置的数据最小化组件，而非匿名化或合规性保证。

papers.title: SeisEvo: Evolution of Seismic Data Reconstruction Algorithms by Agents
papers.abstract_en: Classical seismic data reconstruction relies on manually designed structural priors and iterative operators, whose coupled design space is far larger than manual trial and error can explore systematically. Deep-learning methods encode the reconstruction rules in learned weights rather than in an explicit operator that can be inspected and modified. We propose SeisEvo (Seismic Algorithm Evolution), which does not optimize a single reconstruction result but searches for the algorithm that produces it. Starting from a classical reconstruction algorithm, an LLM-driven multi-agent search modifies only the components that the user has opened for editing, without prescribing the mechanism to be discovered. Candidates that violate the physical constraints of the task are rejected outright, and the remaining ones are scored by execution. The output is neither an agent system nor a neural network, but a standalone white-box algorithm that requires no agent or neural network at inference time. For interpolation without added noise, the search discovered a residual-gated, phase-aligned dip-consistency projection; Evo-POCS improves the SNR over classic POCS by 3.49 dB on average across missing ratios from 30% to 70%. For simultaneous interpolation and denoising, it discovered a reliability-grouped singular-value shrinkage; Evo-MSSA improves the average reconstruction SNR by more than 7 dB over classic MSSA and by more than 3 dB over a stronger rank-reduction baseline. Both operators retain their gains on data not used during the search. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to formulate the design of a seismic reconstruction operator as a constrained, LLM-driven program evolution task. Agentic algorithm evolution can thus complement deep learning in discovering explicit, inspectable, and deployable seismic processing algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SeisEvo（Seismic Algorithm Evolution），将地震数据重建算子的设计建模为受约束的、由 LLM 驱动的多智能体程序演化任务。该方法不直接优化单个重建结果，而是从经典重建算法出发，只修改用户开放编辑的组件，并用物理约束拒绝非法候选、以执行得分为其余候选排序。最终输出是可在推理时独立运行的白盒算子，而非智能体系统或神经网络。
Motivation: 经典地震数据重建依赖人工设计的结构先验和迭代算子，其耦合设计空间远超人手工尝试能系统探索的范围；而深度学习方法把重建规则编码进学习权重，缺乏可检查、可修改的显式算子。
Method: 提出 SeisEvo：以经典重建算法为起点，由 LLM 驱动的多智能体搜索只编辑用户开放修改的组件，不预设待发现的机制；先拒绝违反任务物理约束的候选，再按执行得分评估剩余候选。
Result: 在无噪声插值中，搜索发现残差门控、相位对齐的倾角一致性投影算子（Evo-POCS），在缺失率 30% 到 70% 上较经典 POCS 平均提升 SNR 3.49 dB；在同时插值和去噪中，发现按可靠性分组奇异值收缩算子（Evo-MSSA），较经典 MSSA 平均重建 SNR 提升超过 7 dB，较更强的秩缩减基线提升超过 3 dB，且两个算子在搜索未用数据上保持增益。
Conclusion: 这是首个将地震重建算子设计表述为受约束、LLM 驱动的程序演化任务的研究；作者认为智能体算法演化可补充深度学习，用于发现显式、可检查且可部署的地震处理算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Privileged Information in On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own responses using token-level supervision from the same model conditioned on privileged reference information. We investigate whether performance gains from OPSD show that the student learned the information in the reference or instead reflect recovery of reasoning behavior already present in the base model. We perform OPSD experiments on science and mathematics datasets using Qwen3 models ranging from 1.7B to 8B. Our analysis framework separates the supervision induced by the reference from the supervision provided by the teacher without the reference and measures how each aligns with changes in the student's predictions. The correct reference does not provide a consistent performance benefit across teacher generation modes, model sizes, and training datasets. Students can improve without the correct reference, and a solution from another problem can outperform the correct solution on several mathematical reasoning benchmarks. The student's predictions align more strongly with the base model's thinking behavior than with the supervision induced by the reference, but controls constructed from other problems reproduce much of both alignments. Moreover, stronger alignment attributable to the correct reference does not reliably coincide with a greater performance benefit from the reference. Performance gains and distributional alignment alone therefore cannot determine how privileged reference information contributes to student learning in OPSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视在线策略自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation, OPSD）中特权参考信息（privileged reference information）的作用：学生以自身响应为训练数据，并使用同一模型以参考信息为条件生成的 token 级监督。作者用 Qwen3 系列 1.7B–8B 模型在科学和数学数据集上实验，提出了一个分析框架来区分参考信息引起的监督与无参考教师监督，并测量二者与学生预测变化的对齐程度。结果表明正确参考并不带来一致的性能收益，学生预测与基础模型的思考行为对齐更强，因此性能提升和分布对齐不足以证明参考信息的学习贡献。
Motivation: OPSD 的性能提升是否真正说明学生学到了参考信息，还是仅仅恢复了基础模型已有的推理行为，这一问题尚不清晰；作者希望建立框架来分辨这两种解释。
Method: 提出一个分析框架，将参考信息引入的监督与无参考的教师监督分离，并度量各自与学生预测变化的对齐程度；在科学和数学数据集上跨多种教师生成模式、模型规模和训练数据集，并使用从其他问题构造的对照（controls）进行检验。
Result: 正确参考在教师生成模式、模型规模和数据集之间并不提供一致收益；没有正确参考时学生也能提升，且从另一个问题得到的解在若干数学推理基准上优于正确解；学生预测与基础模型思考行为的对齐强于与参考监督的对齐，但对其他问题构造的对照也复现了大部分对齐；更强的参考归因对齐并不稳定对应更大的性能收益。
Conclusion: 作者认为仅凭性能增益和分布对齐无法判断特权参考信息在 OPSD 中对学生学习的贡献方式，需要更细致的归因手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Global Crises and National Policies: A Large Scale Analysis of Political Content in German Language Online Media
papers.abstract_en: Today most media content is consumed based on algorithmic recommendations. Evidence suggests that this can lead to politically biased media consumption patterns. Automated extraction of political agendas from texts can reveal and analyze political biases in online media -- and thus help fostering politically unbiased media consumption. Here we employ modern political text analysis methods demonstrating the potential of automated fine-grained political bias analysis in online media. We conduct an analysis of political content in German language online media during the period 2019--2022, encompassing several million articles and tweets covering events with profound societal impact globally and nationally, the COVID-19 pandemic and the beginning of the war in Ukraine. Our analysis identifies thematic similarity between national (German and Swiss) reporting, particularly for categories driven by international events. We also find divergences emerging in domestically influenced categories, reflecting differences in national policies and institutional structures. A comparison of newspaper and Twitter discourse reveals that both media converge around a shared core during the pandemic, yet differ in intensity and temporal dynamics. Newspapers exhibit more stable political content, while Twitter reacts through short-lived event-driven spikes. These findings indicate that international crises act as a powerful synchronizing force on political content in classical media, temporarily overriding both national and media-form differences. Our automated political analysis empowers citizens by rendering political agendas in online media transparent. This transparency also enables media outlets to bridge the gap between algorithm-driven echo chambers and a more informed, balanced public discourse.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2nd International Workshop on Sustainable Artificial Intelligence for addressing Online Information Disorder (SAI4OID) at ECML-PKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用现代政治文本分析方法，对2019–2022年间德语在线媒体（包括报纸和Twitter）的数百万篇文章与推文进行细粒度政治内容分析，覆盖新冠疫情与俄乌战争爆发等重大事件。研究发现国际危机驱动下德国与瑞士报道的主题高度相似，而国内政策相关类别出现分歧；报纸与Twitter在疫情期间围绕共同核心议题趋同，但前者内容更稳定，后者以短期事件驱动型峰值波动为主。作者据此认为国际危机会暂时压过国家与媒介差异，成为传统媒体政治内容的强大同步力量。
Motivation: 算法推荐可能导致政治偏见性媒体消费模式，而自动化提取政治议程有助于揭示和分析在线媒体中的政治偏见，从而促进无偏见的媒体消费。
Method: 采用现代政治文本分析方法，对德语在线媒体大规模语料进行自动化的细粒度政治偏见分析，并比较跨国（德国与瑞士）以及跨媒介（报纸与Twitter）的政治内容动态。
Result: 分析识别出德国与瑞士报道在受国际事件驱动的类别上主题相似，在国内影响类别上出现分歧；报纸与Twitter在疫情期间围绕共享核心趋同，但报纸政治内容更稳定，Twitter则呈现短期事件驱动的峰值反应。
Conclusion: 国际危机对传统媒体政治内容具有强大的同步效应，暂时超越国家与媒介形式差异；自动化政治分析可提升在线媒体政治议程的透明度，帮助弥合算法驱动的回音室与更知情、均衡的公共话语之间的差距。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: How AI Prompts Can Teach Us About the Structure of Human Behavior
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a general, easy-to-implement AI-based method for studying the structure and complexity of human behavior. We assign a large language model a ``type vector'' and then prompt it to choose actions across settings in which we observe human choices. For instance, the type vector (2,4) becomes ``You are a player characterized by the following profile: 2 out of 5 in Altruism, 4 out of 5 in Risk Aversion,'' after which it is prompted to make choices. We vary the dimensions (e.g., Altruism, Fairness, Trust, $\dots$) and values (e.g., 1--5) to minimize distance to human choices. Applying the method to 119,147 decisions made by 78,657 subjects from more than 35 countries across 10 classic economic game roles, we find that human behavior can be closely matched using three dimensions: Risk Aversion, Strategic Sophistication, and Trust. Moreover, the types needed to fit individuals across games cluster into fewer than a dozen groups, and can predict behavior in held-out games with different rules and available actions. The results suggest that behavior across diverse settings can be approximated by a low-dimensional, portable representation, supporting the possibility of general yet parsimonious theories across the behavioral sciences. More broadly, the method can provide insights into the structure of many human behaviors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的通用易实现方法，通过给模型分配“类型向量”（type vector）并提示其在人类选择情境中行动，来探测人类行为的结构与复杂度。作者将方法应用于119,147个来自78,657名受试者（覆盖35+国家、10个经典经济博弈角色）的决策，发现人类行为可用风险厌恶、策略性思维和信任三个维度紧密近似，且类型聚类为不到十几组并能预测留出博弈中的行为。结果支持行为可用低维、可迁移的表征来近似，为简约的通用行为理论提供了证据。
Motivation: 行为科学面临的核心问题是不同情境下的人类行为是否具有低维、可迁移的结构；现有方法往往依赖特定实验设计，难以跨博弈比较与预测，也缺少通用且易于部署的探测工具。本文旨在提供一种基于AI提示的通用方法，以系统测绘人类行为空间。
Method: 核心手段是向LLM赋予类型向量后提示其做选择，例如类型向量(2,4)被转换为“你在利他主义上为5分制中的2分、在风险厌恶上为5分制中的4分”的提示词；然后对维度（如利他、公平、信任等）和取值（1–5）进行搜索，以最小化AI选择与人类选择的距离。该方法跨多个博弈角色实施，并用于聚类与留出预测。
Result: 在119,147个决策（78,657名来自35个以上国家的受试者，10个经典经济博弈角色）上，仅需风险厌恶、策略性思维和信任三个维度即可紧密匹配人类行为。用于拟合个体的类型可聚类为不到十几个群体，且这些类型能预测具有不同规则和可用行动的留出博弈中的行为。
Conclusion: 摘要认为结果支持行为科学中存在通用而简约的低维、可移植行为表征，并指出该方法可更广泛地用于理解多种人类行为的结构。摘要未提及方法在非博弈或真实场景中的适用范围等局限。

papers.title: SIGMA: Symmetry-aware, Intelligent, Geometric, Multi-objective Adaptive Control for Robust, Dependable Traffic Management
papers.abstract_en: Traffic signal control is a complex sequential decision-making problem requiring real-time adaptation and trade-offs among throughput, delay fairness, signal stability, and emergency vehicle priority. Existing RL methods often fix objectives, ignore dynamic priority changes, and fail to generalize across geometrically similar intersections.We propose SIGMA (Symmetry-aware, Intelligent, Geometric, Multi-objective Adaptive traffic control), an RL framework enhanced with a large language model (LLM) for adaptive objective tuning and orientation-invariant learning. SIGMA converts natural-language emergency commands into priority vectors for a multi-objective actor-critic controller, avoiding manual reward engineering. Rotational augmentation improves transferability across four-way intersections, while offline-to-online learning ensures stable initialization and gradual adaptation to changing traffic.We define reliability properties covering emergency service levels, graceful degradation under LLM failures, and demand sensitivity, validated via bootstrap statistics. Evaluated in SUMO on four Kolkata-based urban intersections against fixed-time, actuated, and DQN controllers, SIGMA reduces average/emergency waiting times and queue lengths, and boosts throughput. Ablation studies confirm robustness to component failures and geometric rotations. Overall, SIGMA offers a reliable, language-guided, multi-objective traffic control system with statistical reliability assurance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIGMA，一个结合大语言模型 (LLM) 的多目标强化学习交通信号控制框架。SIGMA 将自然语言紧急指令转化为优先级向量，供多目标 actor-critic 控制器使用，并通过旋转增广实现方向不变学习，以提升跨几何相似路口的泛化能力。在 SUMO 中对印度 Kolkata 四个城市路口进行仿真，相比 fixed-time、actuated 和 DQN 控制器，SIGMA 降低了平均/紧急等待时间和队列长度，并提高吞吐量；消融实验验证了对组件失效和几何旋转的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有交通信号控制的强化学习方法通常固定目标函数、忽略动态优先级变化，并且难以泛化到几何相似的路口，无法在吞吐量、延误公平性、信号稳定性和紧急车辆优先之间进行实时权衡。
Method: 提出 SIGMA 框架：利用 LLM 将自然语言紧急命令转换为多目标 actor-critic 控制器的优先级向量，避免人工奖励工程设计；采用旋转增广增强四路路口间的迁移性；通过离线到在线 (offline-to-online) 学习保证稳定初始化并逐步适应交通变化。
Result: 在 SUMO 上对四个 Kolkata 城市路口进行仿真评估，相比 fixed-time、actuated 和 DQN 控制器，SIGMA 降低了平均/紧急等待时间和队列长度，并提升吞吐量；通过 bootstrap 统计验证了紧急服务水平、LLM 失效下的优雅降级和需求敏感性等可靠性属性，消融实验确认对组件失效和几何旋转的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: SIGMA 提供了一个可靠的、语言引导的多目标交通控制系统，具有统计可靠性保证，适用于需要动态优先级调整和跨路口泛化的场景。

papers.title: Cacheable by Design? Training Mixture-of-Experts Routers for Locality Against the Edge Memory-Bandwidth Wall: A Pre-Registered Negative Result with a Systems Measurement Study
papers.abstract_en: Serving a 235B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model on a single 8 GB GPU is bottlenecked not by compute but by memory bandwidth: decode must stream each token's active experts from whichever tier holds them, and on consumer hardware most experts sit on an SSD far slower than RAM. We quantify this bandwidth wall on Qwen3-235B (Q4_K_M, 134 GB): measured decode is 0.44 tok/s warm, matching a bytes-per-token / bandwidth model, while a batching scheme that should amortize one disk sweep instead collapses at batch 32 from paging thrash. We build llama-moe-trace, a zero-surgery router-telemetry tool, and measure routing on Qwen3-30B: adjacent-token expert reuse is 2.0x chance, 95% of traffic uses 52.5% of experts, and an LRU cache of 13.4% of experts serves 66% of requests. We then ask whether cacheability is trainable: we pre-register training of 137M MoE language models with auxiliary locality and domain router losses, under joint criteria on cache-miss reduction and perplexity. The mechanism works (misses down up to 60%; a 99% static-pin hit rate) but every configuration fails the pre-registered <=1% perplexity gate -- miss reduction and quality are tightly coupled. Concurrent StickyMoE reports the same loss as near-free on single-domain sub-25M models; on multi-domain 137M we find the tax real. Our contribution is this pre-registered, stricter-criterion, multi-domain evaluation plus edge-serving measurements. A 340M rung shows the tax does not shrink with scale (it rises slightly). We further show training-free cache-aware rerouting stacks with trained locality -- together ~80% miss reduction at <=3.4% perplexity at both sizes, far cheaper than either alone -- while domain-primed prefetching does not help. All code, traces, and the pre-registration are released.
papers.comment: Pre-registered negative result plus a systems measurement study. Code, router-telemetry tool (llama-moe-trace), traces, data manifests, and the frozen pre-registration: https://github.com/Shriniwas410/cacheable-by-design
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对边缘设备上超大 MoE 模型的缓存友好性做了一次预注册的负结果研究并附带系统测量。作者先量化了内存带宽墙：在单张 8 GB GPU 上以 Q4_K_M 量化服务 Qwen3-235B（134 GB）时，解码速度仅 0.44 tok/s，且批处理方案在 batch 32 时因分页颠簸而崩溃。随后作者提出零侵入路由遥测工具 llama-moe-trace，测量 Qwen3-30B 的路由局部性，并预注册训练 137M MoE 语言模型，用辅助局部性与领域路由损失提升可缓存性；结果显示缓存未命中最多可降 60%，但所有配置都未通过预注册的 <=1% 困惑度门槛。作者还发现训练无关的缓存感知重路由可与训练得到的局部性叠加，在 <=3.4% 困惑度代价下实现约 80% 的未命中降低。
Motivation: 在消费级硬件上服务 235B 参数的 MoE 模型时，瓶颈不是算力而是内存带宽：解码必须从可能位于 SSD 的层级中流式读取每个 token 的活跃专家，导致吞吐极低。作者想检验这种可缓存性是否可以通过训练习得，并为这一假设提供严格的预注册证据。
Method: 作者先测量 Qwen3-235B 与 Qwen3-30B 的路由行为并构建无侵入工具 llama-moe-trace，然后预注册训练 137M 参数的多领域 MoE 语言模型，引入辅助局部性损失与领域路由损失，以缓存未命中减少和困惑度作为联合判据；此外测试了 340M 规模以及训练无关的缓存感知重路由、领域预热预取等方案。
Result: 测量显示相邻 token 的专家复用是随机水平的 2.0 倍，95% 的流量只使用 52.5% 的专家，13.4% 专家的 LRU 缓存可服务 66% 的请求。训练局部性损失可使未命中最多下降 60% 并达到 99% 的静态固定命中率，但所有配置都未通过 <=1% 困惑度门槛；340M 规模下困惑度代价不降反升；缓存感知重路由与训练局部性叠加后可在 <=3.4% 困惑度代价下实现约 80% 的未命中减少，而领域预热预取无帮助。
Conclusion: 作者强调缓存未命中减少与生成质量紧密耦合：在多领域 137M 规模上，StickyMoE 所称的近乎零代价并不成立，局部性损失带来的困惑度代价是真实的且随规模略有上升。本文的贡献是这一预注册、更严格判据、多领域的负结果评估及边缘服务测量，并已发布全部代码、轨迹与预注册。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Redakto - The Incognito Tab for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are being increasingly used in everyday applications. A major challenge in the context of LLMs or Artificial Intelligence (AI) in general is to ensure privacy when using them, meaning that personally identifiable information (PII) is removed from any text that enters an LLM. These challenges have become more urgent with novel EU legislation. Uncertainty around LLM usage with respect to privacy concerns in EU countries can be a major blocker for the speed of innovation and transfer from research to applications. Here we present \textbf{Redakto}, a tool that can be used for anonymizing text prior to feeding it to an LLM or other downstream text processing. We provide state-of-the-art functionalities for both redaction of PII but also when used for pseudonymization. These functionalities are exposed such that they can easily be used by end-users, through the Redakto web application, and by developers and researchers, via REST APIs and model context protocol (MCP) hooks. The implementation is fully open source, requires modest compute resources, and can be readily deployed on local hardware. In contrast to prior work and in order to better assess the quality of the anonymized texts, we conduct extensive empirical evaluations on textual data from legal and medical domain with respect to both privacy and utility of the redacted texts. Our empirical results demonstrate that the texts anonymized with different redaction strategies achieve utility scores on par with the original texts, suggesting that anonymization with Redakto can be used for LLM tasks without substantial negative impact for the tasks we explored.
papers.comment: Accepted at WIPE-OUT 2026, 2nd Workshop on Machine Unlearning and Privacy Preservation at ECML-PKDD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Redakto，一个面向 LLM 使用场景的开源文本匿名化工具，支持 PII 脱敏与假名化 (pseudonymization)，并通过 Web 应用、REST API 和模型上下文协议 (MCP) 接口提供给终端用户与开发者。作者在法律和医学领域的文本数据上进行了隐私与效用 (utility) 的实证评估，声称匿名化后文本的效用得分与原文本相当，表明该工具可用于 LLM 任务而不带来明显负面影响。
Motivation: LLM 在日常应用中的普及带来个人可识别信息 (PII) 泄露风险，EU 新立法使隐私合规更为紧迫，而隐私不确定性可能阻碍创新和研究成果向应用转化，因此需要易用的文本匿名化工具。
Method: Redakto 提供 PII 脱敏和假名化功能，支持通过 Web 应用面向终端用户，并通过 REST API 和 MCP hooks 供开发者和研究者集成；实现完全开源、计算资源需求低，可部署在本地硬件上。
Result: 对法律和医学领域的文本数据进行匿名化与效用评估，不同脱敏策略处理后的文本在效用得分上与原始文本持平。
Conclusion: 摘要强调匿名化文本可用于 LLM 任务而不显著损失效用，但结论仅限于所探索的任务域。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Visual-Prompt Guided Wildlife Instance-Level Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained wildlife re-identification remains a challenging area in research. Current state-of-the-art approaches apply a detection and re-identification pipeline. We propose a one-stage end-to-end detection and re-identification model that performs identity searching within the latent space. We adopt DINOv2 for robust spatial geometry and MegaDescriptor for wildlife re-identification. We enhance latent queries with prompt re-identification features. A detection decoder queries the scene latent space to establish object boundaries around the target identity. Preliminary findings reflect a competitive mean average precision score of 30.584% compared to the state-of-the-art two stage approach of 44.89%. Qualitative results depict effective bounding and identification of animal identities.

Motivation: 细粒度野生动物再识别仍具挑战性，现有最优方法普遍采用检测加再识别 (detection and re-identification) 的两阶段流程，流程复杂且效率受限。
Method: 提出单阶段端到端模型，在场景潜在空间内完成检测与身份搜索；采用 DINOv2 提取稳健空间几何信息，MegaDescriptor 用于野生动物再识别，并用提示再识别特征增强潜在查询，由检测解码器在潜在空间中建立目标身份的对象边界。
Result: 初步实验得到 30.584% 的 mAP，与两阶段 SOTA 方法的 44.89% 相比具有竞争力；定性结果显示能有效勾勒和识别动物身份。
Conclusion: 摘要将该工作定位为初步发现，表明单阶段潜在空间身份搜索方案在野生动物识别上可行，但精度仍有差距。

papers.title: Bidirectional representational alignment between biological and artificial neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that representational alignment between biological and artificial neural networks is asymmetric: model representations predict neural responses much better than neural responses predict model representations. This asymmetry raises the question of whether representational geometry contributes to bidirectional representational alignment. We hypothesized that steering representational geometry during training can systematically influence bidirectional alignment. To test this hypothesis, we developed a computational framework that integrates spectral regularization with bidirectional predictivity analyses. As an initial demonstration, we evaluated our framework using self-supervised contrastive vision models. Steering the spectral geometry of the learned representations substantially increased reverse predictivity with modest reductions in forward predictivity, yielding a 55% relative improvement in bidirectional predictivity. These improvements were accompanied by reduced effective dimensionality and a reorganization of the shared representational subspace, within which forward and reverse predictivity became approximately symmetric at intermediate spectral exponents. Overall, these findings demonstrate that representational geometry can be systematically steered to modulate bidirectional representational alignment between biological and artificial neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生物神经网络与人工神经网络之间表征对齐（representational alignment）的双向性问题。作者提出一个结合谱正则化（spectral regularization）与双向可预测性分析的框架，并在自监督对比视觉模型上验证：通过调控表征的谱几何，反向可预测性显著提升而前向可预测性仅适度下降，双向可预测性相对提升 55%。
Motivation: 现有研究表明生物-人工神经网络表征对齐具有不对称性：模型表征预测神经反应的效果远好于神经反应预测模型表征。作者假设训练过程中调控表征几何能够系统性地影响双向对齐，并对此进行检验。
Method: 提出一个计算框架，将谱正则化与双向可预测性分析（bidirectional predictivity analyses）相结合，在训练过程中调控表征的谱几何；作为初步演示，使用自监督对比视觉模型（self-supervised contrastive vision models）进行评估。
Result: 调控谱几何使反向可预测性大幅提升，前向可预测性仅有适度下降，双向可预测性相对提升 55%；同时伴随有效维度（effective dimensionality）降低，共享表征子空间发生重组，在中等谱指数（intermediate spectral exponents）下前向与反向可预测性近似对称。
Conclusion: 结果表明表征几何可以被系统性调控，以调节生物与人工神经网络之间的双向表征对齐。摘要未明确说明该框架在非视觉任务或更广范围的适用性与局限。

papers.title: ClosureBench: A Constructive Benchmark for Compositional Graph Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ClosureBench, a constructive benchmark for compositional graph-relational reasoning with programmatically verified ground truth. Unlike fixed-test-set benchmarks vulnerable to data contamination, ClosureBench generates instances on demand: each task's reference answer is computed by executing a program in the Ein tensor-logic language, ensuring machine-verified correctness. The benchmark spans 26 task categories at three compositional levels (L1-L3), with difficulty controlled along three independent axes: graph size, edge density, and query depth. We evaluate models from 1.5B open weights to frontier systems (o3, GPT-4.1, Gemini 2.5, Claude Sonnet 4) and report three findings. First, because the benchmark can always supply fresh instances, it measures memorisation directly: a model fine-tuned on a fixed test set shows a 19.3 percentage-point gap between its accuracy on seen and on fresh instances, which a static test set cannot reveal. We scope this to supervised fine-tuning on answer pairs, not pretraining contamination. Second, accuracy falls as graph size and query depth increase, and the two interact: models misread the graph from its natural-language description and then reason correctly over the wrong graph, so even the strongest frontier model degrades from atomic to compositional queries. This bottleneck is a property of the reasoning rather than the input format: it persists when the graph is given as a JSON edge list or an adjacency matrix instead of prose. Third, a 4B model fine-tuned to emit executable programs rather than answers stays nearly flat across compositional levels and approaches frontier accuracy (94.3% on held-out instances) at a fraction of the token cost. This holds for two program targets, Ein and Python+NetworkX, so it is a property of verified program synthesis rather than of one language.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/egolabs-ai/closurebench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ClosureBench，一个面向组合式图关系推理 (compositional graph reasoning) 的可构造基准，用 Ein tensor-logic 语言执行程序来计算参考答案，从而获得机器验证的真实标签。基准包含 26 个任务类别、三个组合层级 (L1-L3)，难度由图规模、边密度和查询深度三个独立轴控制。作者在 1.5B 开源模型到 o3、GPT-4.1、Gemini 2.5、Claude Sonnet 4 等前沿系统上评测，报告了三个主要发现。
Motivation: 固定测试集的基准易受数据污染 (data contamination) 影响，无法区分模型是真正具备组合推理能力还是记住了已有样本；可动态生成新实例的基准能够直接测量记忆效应。
Method: 基准按需生成实例，每个任务的参考答案通过执行 Ein 语言程序得到并机器验证；评测同时对比自然语言、JSON 边列表和邻接矩阵三种图输入格式，并测试让模型输出可执行程序而非直接答案的训练方式。
Result: 在固定测试集上微调的模型在已见实例与新实例上的准确率相差 19.3 个百分点；准确率随图规模和查询深度下降，且两者存在交互，即使最强前沿模型也从原子查询退化到组合查询，该瓶颈在 JSON 边列表和邻接矩阵输入下依然存在；一个 4B 模型经微调输出可执行程序后，在留出实例上达到 94.3% 的准确率且在各组合层级几乎保持平稳，该现象对 Ein 和 Python+NetworkX 两种程序目标都成立。
Conclusion: 作者认为瓶颈属于推理本身而非输入格式，而经过验证的程序合成 (verified program synthesis) 而非特定编程语言是保持组合推理能力的关键因素。
Relevance: 5
