papers.title: Zero-Shot Transfer of Force Map Estimation Across GelSight Mini Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Despite the rapid industrialization of the touch sensor manufacturing process, most of these sensors are still handmade in research laboratories. This complicates standardizing their performance, requiring the repetition of data collection and training models for each unit produced. To address this problem, this paper presents a method that can generalize the estimation of 3D force maps across different GelSight Mini sensor units, regardless of the sensor version. Specifically, the method consists of two stages: a domain adaptation stage, in which the input tactile image is reconstructed as a general tactile image using a UniT-based model; and a stage for estimating 3D force maps employing a U-Net network. Our proposal achieves promising results in both steps, such as an SSIM of 0.9338 +- 0.0358 in the image reconstruction phase and an MAE_F of 1.1294 +- 1.5934(N) in the force estimation phase.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Sensors Letter
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 GelSight Mini 触觉传感器单元间性能不一致的问题，提出一种跨传感器单元与版本的 3D 力图估计零样本迁移方法。方法分为两阶段：先用 UniT 模型将输入触觉图像重建为通用触觉图像，再用 U-Net 估计 3D 力图。摘要报告图像重建阶段 SSIM 为 0.9338 ± 0.0358，力估计阶段 MAE_F 为 1.1294 ± 1.5934 (N)。
Motivation: 尽管触觉传感器制造逐渐工业化，大多数传感器仍在实验室手工制作，导致各单元性能难以标准化，需要为每个单元重复采集数据并重新训练模型。
Method: 提出两阶段迁移框架：领域适配阶段使用基于 UniT 的模型将原始触觉图像重建为通用触觉图像，随后用 U-Net 网络从重建图像估计 3D 力图，从而在不同 GelisSight Mini 单元与版本间实现零样本泛化。
Result: 摘要报告图像重建阶段 SSIM 为 0.9338 ± 0.0358，力估计阶段 MAE_F 为 1.1294 ± 1.5934 (N)。
Conclusion: 该方法能够跨 GelSight Mini 传感器单元和版本泛化 3D 力图估计，减少逐单元重新训练的需求。

papers.title: GenEx: A Graph-Based Representational Paradigm for SARS-CoV-2 Variant Detection via Codon Co-occurrence Networks
papers.abstract_en: Genomic analysis on viruses such as SARS-CoV-2 variants: Beta, Gamma, Delta, and Omicron is heavily dominated by classical bioinformatics methods, including Sequence Alignment, Phylogenetic Analysis, and Mutation Frequency Statistics. These approaches use pairwise codon or nucleotide distance matrices to analyze gene sequences, treating them as linear strings rather than capturing their complex contextual interdependencies. We proposed GenEx, a pipeline that converts raw gene sequences into codon co-occurrence graphs and extracts more than 25 graph features. Our two most prominent techniques for graph generation and feature extraction are MSCG (Multi-Scale Codon Co-occurrence Graph) and LAPCG (Linear-time Adjacency PMI Codon Graph). Using these algorithms, we treated codon sequences as structured symbolic vocabularies interpretable to codon co-occurrence graph analysis, a representational paradigm borrowed from computational linguistics. Another major contribution includes implementing a spectral graph feature extraction using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), using the squared singular value ($σ^2$) instead of the traditionally used eigenvalue, which helped us to amplify the separation between dominant and subdominant spectral components, thereby enhancing inter-class separability in downstream classification. And to further demonstrate that our method works, we trained 23 benchmarked ML models against the latest SARS-CoV-2 variants, achieving remarkable results in detecting all SARS-CoV-2 variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenEx，一种基于图的表示范式，用于 SARS-CoV-2 变异检测。该流程将原始基因序列转换为密码子共现图（codon co-occurrence graph），提取 25 种以上图特征，并借助计算语言学的思路把密码子序列视为结构化符号词汇表。作者在 Beta、Gamma、Delta、Omicron 等变异株上训练了 23 个基准机器学习模型，报告检测所有变异株均取得显著结果。
Motivation: 传统生物信息学方法（序列比对、系统发育分析、突变频率统计）依赖成对的密码子或核苷酸距离矩阵，把基因序列当作线性字符串，无法捕捉密码子间复杂的上下文相互依赖关系。
Method: 提出 GenEx 流水线，核心包括两种图生成与特征提取技术：MSCG（Multi-Scale Codon Co-occurrence Graph）和 LAPCG（Linear-time Adjacency PMI Codon Graph）。此外，作者采用基于奇异值分解（SVD）的谱图特征提取，使用平方奇异值 σ² 替代传统特征值，以放大主成分与次成分之间的分离，增强下游分类的类间可分性。
Result: 在最新 SARS-CoV-2 变异株上训练 23 个基准机器学习模型，摘要称在检测所有 SARS-CoV-2 变异株方面取得了显著结果，但未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调密码子共现图分析作为一种新的表示范式可以有效完成 SARS-CoV-2 变异检测，并将收益归因于图结构表征与谱特征提取的组合；未提及明显的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sobolev Regularized Score Difference Estimation in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the difference of two Stein's score functions is a fundamental problem in generative modeling. In particular, score differences arise naturally in transfer learning, where the score difference provides the mechanism for adapting a pre-trained model to a new target distribution, and in diffusion model-based post-training methods such as discriminator guidance. Existing estimators for score differences in these settings either lack of statistical consistency or are difficult to scale up in high-dimensions. We propose a statistically consistent and scalable estimator for score differences based on Sobolev regularization, which plays a crucial role in ensuring consistency and stablizing the training in the small-sample regime. Mathematically, we establish a convergence rate of $O(n^{-\frac{s-1}{d+2s-2}})$ where $d$ is the dimension and $s$ denotes the smoothness of the underlying densities, and provide a minimax lower bound of $\tildeΩ(n^{-\frac{2(s-1)}{d+2s}})$ (in mean-squared error). Empirically, our estimator exhibits significantly improved stability in small-sample regimes compared to existing methods. We demonstrate its effectiveness on real-world tasks, including transfer learning for ECG signal generation, where it substantially outperforms non-regularized score difference estimators in downstream classification performance.

papers.title: Classifying Directional Trajectories Near Criticality in the Three-State Majority-Vote Model with Deep Belief Networks and Bidirectional GRUs
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we investigate whether the latent representations learned by a Deep Belief Network (DBN) and a Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU) can discriminate among four dynamically distinct trajectory types in the three-state majority vote model (MV3): approach from disorder, approach from order, departure to disorder, and departure to order. The DBN, pre-trained in an unsupervised manner on static equilibrium samples via a Gaussian-Bernoulli Restricted Boltzmann Machine input layer and architecture $784 \to 4096 \to 225 \to 81$, encodes each lattice snapshot into an 81-dimensional latent vector. A t-SNE analysis of the DBN latent space reveals only partial separation of the four trajectory types, reflecting the fact that a model trained on static configurations cannot fully resolve directional temporal structure. A two-layer Bi-GRU classifier, trained on sequences of DBN-encoded snapshots of length $T = 50$, achieves near-perfect separation of all four trajectory types in its hidden state space, as confirmed by t-SNE visualization on both training and test sets. Furthermore, a sliding-window application of the trained Bi-GRU to continuous MV3 dynamics demonstrates its ability to sense the system's current dynamical regime in real-time. These results establish a principled hierarchical architecture for detecting and classifying critical transitions in agent-based opinion dynamics models.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, to be published in AIxSET 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究三态多数投票模型（MV3）中四种方向性轨迹类型（从无序趋近、从有序趋近、离开到无序、离开到有序）能否被深度信念网络（DBN）和双向门控循环单元（Bi-GRU）的隐表示区分。DBN 在静态平衡样本上以高斯-伯努利受限玻尔兹曼机输入层无监督预训练，结构为 784→4096→225→81，将每个格点快照编码为 81 维潜向量；t-SNE 显示其潜空间仅能部分分离四类轨迹。基于 DBN 编码快照序列（T=50）训练的两层 Bi-GRU 分类器在隐状态空间实现近乎完美的四类分离，滑动窗口应用还能实时感知当前动力学机制。
Motivation: 需要判断静态配置训练出的表示能否分辨带方向性的动力学轨迹，以及能否为基于主体的舆论动力学模型中的临界转变检测提供分层架构。
Method: 先用高斯-伯努利受限玻尔兹曼机输入层在静态平衡样本上无监督预训练 DBN（784→4096→225→81），将快照压缩为 81 维潜向量；再训练两层 Bi-GRU 分类器处理长度为 T=50 的 DBN 编码序列，并对连续 MV3 动力学采用滑动窗口应用。
Result: DBN 潜空间的 t-SNE 只显示部分类别分离；Bi-GRU 隐状态空间在训练集和测试集上均实现四类轨迹的近乎完美分离，且滑动窗口 Bi-GRU 能实时感知系统当前动力学机制。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果建立了用于检测和分类基于主体舆论动力学模型中临界转变的分层架构，但其验证范围限于 MV3 模型。

papers.title: GigaBrain-WBC-0.5: A Behavior World Model for Robust Whole-Body Control with Environment Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Whole-body motion tracking policies turn a humanoid into a robust control interface: the teleoperator---or an upstream model---only supplies a coarse movement intent, while the low-level policy keeps the robot balanced and physically feasible. Existing trackers deliver this interface only on flat ground: trained in empty scenes, they never learn how contact with terrain and objects reshapes their dynamics, and they attempt to teach the policy to balance under any command by continually enlarging the reference-motion corpus, which stops working once feasible behaviors become environment-dependent. We present GigaBrain-WBC-0.5, the first Behavior World Model (BWM) for humanoid whole-body control. Rather than a purely reactive tracker, we train a causal Transformer to jointly predict its next action, next state, and the distribution over its next latent behavior command, so the network that acts also models how the environment shapes what it can do next. An automatic terrain-annotation pipeline recovers full 3D contact geometry from retargeted motion, enabling terrain annotation at the scale of existing motion datasets. The predicted distribution is reused at deployment to detect implausible commands online and retract them onto learned behaviors, so the robot attempts tasks in a "best-effort" manner. The result is a unified policy that takes real-time command, interacts with environment, and stays robust to implausible commands, falls, and disturbances. GigaBrain-WBC-0.5 achieves the highest success rate across all four regimes among three large-scale tracker baselines: 81.3% on terrain interaction (4.3x the strongest baseline), 83.1% under implausible commands, and 99.3% fall recovery (16.8x the strongest baseline). Hardware trials show robust interaction under missing supports and disturbances; the Unitree G1 checkpoint transfers to the Maker L01 robot with simple fine-tuning.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Technical report. Project page: https://shepherd1226.github.io/gigabrain-wbc-0.5/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GigaBrain-WBC-0.5，据称是首个用于人形机器人全身控制的行为世界模型 (Behavior World Model, BWM)。与纯反应式跟踪器不同，作者训练一个因果 Transformer 联合预测下一动作、下一状态以及下一潜在行为命令的分布，使执行动作的网络同时建模环境如何约束后续可行行为。部署时复用该预测分布在线检测不合理命令并将其拉回已学习行为，从而实现尽力而为的任务尝试。实验显示该方法在四个测试情景中均取得最高成功率，并在真实硬件上完成缺失支撑与扰动下的鲁棒交互。
Motivation: 现有全身运动跟踪策略只在平坦地面上有效，在空场景中训练，从未学习地形和物体接触如何改变机器人动力学；用不断扩大参考动作库的办法试图应对任意命令，一旦可行行为依赖于环境就不再奏效。
Method: 训练一个因果 Transformer，联合预测下一动作、下一状态和下一潜在行为命令的分布，使网络在行动的同时建模环境对可行行为的塑造。另设计自动地形标注流程，从重定向动作中恢复完整三维接触几何，使地形标注规模与现有动作数据集相当；部署时利用预测分布实时检测不合理命令并回退到学习到的行为。
Result: 在三个大规模跟踪基线的对比中，GigaBrain-WBC-0.5 在四个情景下均取得最高成功率：地形交互 81.3%（为最强基线的 4.3 倍）、不合理命令下 83.1%、摔倒恢复 99.3%（为最强基线的 16.8 倍）。硬件实验显示在缺失支撑和扰动下交互稳健，Unitree G1 的检查点经简单微调即可迁移到 Maker L01 机器人。
Conclusion: 作者总结该方法得到一个统一的策略，能够实时接收命令、与环境交互，并对不合理命令、摔倒和扰动保持鲁棒；同时展示了跨机器人平台迁移的能力。

papers.title: Allocating Recurrent Compute in Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models improve reasoning and knowledge manipulation by applying shared computation repeatedly. Existing systems usually repeat an entire layer stack, although a mixer and a dense feed-forward network (FFN) perform different operations and have different costs. We ask a narrower question: what should loop? We view recurrence as repeated composition of a state update and argue that an application is valuable when it exposes a new cross-position influence direction that remains observable at the task readout. Iterative Transport Rank (ITR) describes the cumulative influence trajectory; marginal ITR describes the nonredundant influence contributed by successive applications. This view motivates MixerLoop, which repeats each Gated DeltaNet mixer while applying its dense FFN once. We compare MixerLoop with no recurrence and full-block recurrence at 15M and 110M parameters under the same data, initialization, and architecture. A finite context-off intervention tests whether later mixer applications produce distinct, non-negligible, and beneficial changes at the final language-model readout. MixerLoop surpasses FullLoop on aggregate CORE at 15M and retains 41.5% of its CORE improvement at 110M while reducing recurrent-backbone projection FLOPs by 45.9%. These results show that the benefits of recurrent depth can be retained without repeatedly executing the dense FFN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究循环语言模型中应当重复执行哪些计算的问题，提出只需循环 mixer 层而不必重复整个层块的观点。作者引入迭代传输秩（ITR）与边际 ITR 来描述跨位置影响的累积与非冗余轨迹，并据此提出 MixerLoop：重复每个 Gated DeltaNet mixer，而密集 FFN 只执行一次。在 15M 与 110M 参数规模下，MixerLoop 在聚合 CORE 指标上表现优于无循环基线，并在 110M 时保留 FullLoop 改进的 41.5%，同时减少 45.9% 的循环骨干投影 FLOPs。
Motivation: 现有循环语言模型通常重复整个层堆栈，但 mixer 与密集 FFN 功能不同且计算成本不同；作者提出更窄的问题——到底什么应该被循环，以便在保留循环深度收益的同时避免不必要的重复计算。
Method: 将递归视为状态更新的重复组合，提出迭代传输秩（ITR）刻画累积影响轨迹、边际 ITR 刻画连续应用的非冗余影响，并据此设计 MixerLoop；在相同数据、初始化与架构下与无循环及全块循环（FullLoop）对比，并用有限上下文偏移干预检验后续 mixer 应用对最终语言模型读出的影响。
Result: 在 15M 参数下 MixerLoop 在聚合 CORE 上超过 FullLoop；在 110M 参数下保留 FullLoop 的 CORE 改进的 41.5%，同时将循环骨干投影 FLOPs 减少 45.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要结论认为，循环深度的收益可以保留而无需重复执行密集 FFN；需要根据影响轨迹来选择循环的具体计算单元。

papers.title: Think Shallow, Solve Deep: Controlling Recurrent Dynamics for Reliable Test-Time Depth
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent-depth reasoners aim to solve harder problems by iterating their update longer at test time, but additional iterations can improve, preserve, or degrade an answer. We show that a measurable property of the trained operator, its finite-time dynamical regime (estimated as settling, marginal, or drifting), indicates which of these occurs. We give a sufficient condition for depth-safety: once an operator's per-step displacement is small relative to the decoder margin, the decoded answer cannot change under further iterations. Empirically, on algorithmic tasks trained from $800$ unaugmented examples per difficulty tier, settling operators do not degrade with added depth, and on some tasks convert it into higher accuracy on harder unseen instances (Sudoku, $0.19$ to $0.34$ past the training horizon). A single terminal fixed-point objective moves the regime and the depth behavior together: removing it induces drift and removes the gains, and adding it to a generic recurrence yields depth-safe extrapolation on carry propagation. We give four operational criteria for useful test-time depth, use them to catalogue failure modes, and, as a consistency check, apply the same measurements to Huginn-3.5B, which falls in the non-settling family.
papers.comment: Submitted to the Thirty-Ninth AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-27)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究测试时深度（test-time depth）对循环深度推理器（recurrent-depth reasoners）可靠性的影响，提出通过测量已训练算子的有限时间动力学状态（settling、marginal、drifting）来预测额外迭代是改善、保持还是破坏答案。作者给出深度安全的充分条件：当算子的单步位移相对于解码器裕度（decoder margin）足够小时，进一步迭代不会改变解码答案。实验表明在未增强示例训练的算法任务上，settling 算子不会因加深而退化，并能在部分任务上提升训练时域之外的困难实例准确率。
Motivation: 循环深度推理器通过在测试时延长迭代次数来求解更难的问题，但额外迭代可能改善、保持或降低答案质量；现有方法缺少对何时加深是安全的预判依据。
Method: 作者将训练算子的有限时间动力学按 settling、marginal 或 drifting 分类，并给出深度安全的充分条件，即单步位移小于解码器裕度时答案在进一步迭代下不变。实验还对比了移除或添加单一终端不动点目标（fixed-point objective）对动力学状态与深度行为的影响，并用四个操作性准则对失败模式进行归类。
Result: 在每难度层级仅用 800 个未增强示例训练的算法任务上，settling 算子不会随深度增加而退化，部分任务在更难的未见实例上准确率提升（Sudoku 在训练时域之外从 0.19 提高到 0.34）。移除终端不动点目标会诱发 drift 并消除增益，而将其加入通用循环可在进位传播（carry propagation）上获得深度安全的外推。作为一致性检验，Huginn-3.5B 被归类到非 settling 家族。
Conclusion: 作者强调算子的有限时间动力学状态可用作可靠测试时深度的预测指标，并提供四个操作性准则来诊断失败模式；该框架也可用于评估现有模型（如 Huginn-3.5B）的深度行为属性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LumiTokens: 3D Relighting via Token-Space Lighting Transformation
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D relighting methods operate through either explicit material decomposition, diffusion-based view-space generation, or a combination of both, requiring full recomputation for each new lighting condition. We observe that recent latent scene representations, which encode multi-view images into a set of compact tokens with no fixed physical semantics, open up a novel design space for relighting. We present LumiTokens, a framework that formulates 3D relighting as a direct transformation on latent scene tokens, without explicit 3D representations, rendering equations, or physics-based decomposition. Our model introduces a Scene Token Editor that processes scene tokens jointly with light-ray tokens through self-attention, producing updated tokens that can be decoded into multi-view-consistent relit images. To support diverse lighting types through a unified interface, all lighting signals, including environment maps, point lights, and area lights, are parameterized as Plucker ray tokens, enabling native 3D user interaction with a representation that carries no explicit spatial structure. Crucially, this design supports progressive relighting: because the editor's output remains in the same latent space as its input, a user can incrementally build up illumination one light source at a time, with each edit composing in token space. Experiments demonstrate that LumiTokens achieves comparable or superior relighting quality to other methods and supports progressive, composable lighting edits. Project page: https://neu-vi.github.io/LumiTokens/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LumiTokens，将 3D 重光照问题形式化为对潜在场景 token 的直接变换，绕开显式 3D 表示、渲染方程和物理分解。模型使用场景 token 编辑器 (Scene Token Editor)，通过自注意力将场景 token 与光线 token 联合处理，输出可解码为多视图一致的重新照亮图像。所有光照信号（环境贴图、点光源、面光源）统一参数化为 Plucker 光线 token，且由于编辑器的输出与输入处于同一潜在空间，支持逐光源叠加的渐进式重光照。实验显示其重光照质量与现有方法相当或更优，并支持渐进、可组合的光照编辑。
Motivation: 现有 3D 重光照方法要么依赖显式材质分解，要么使用扩散式视图空间生成，且每种新光照条件都需要完整重新计算；作者观察到无固定物理语义的潜在场景表示可为重光照开辟新的设计空间。
Method: 将 3D 重光照建模为潜在场景 token 上的直接变换：Scene Token Editor 通过自注意力联合处理场景 token 与光线 token，所有光照条件统一参数化为 Plucker 光线 token，输出仍处于同一潜在空间从而支持渐进式编辑。
Result: 摘要报告 LumiTokens 在重光照质量上与现有方法相当或更优，并支持渐进式、可组合的光照编辑。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作表明无需显式 3D 表示或渲染方程，即可在 token 空间完成多视图一致且可逐步叠加的重光照。

papers.title: On the Triangle Inequality for the Jaccard Distance in Arbitrary Lattices
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents new theoretical results on generalizing the Jaccard distance for lattices and real valuations. We demonstrate that when the valuation is strictly positive, monotone, and modular, the Jaccard distance satisfies the triangle inequality on arbitrary lattices, effectively generalizing earlier results that depended heavily on distributivity. Moving to relatively complemented distributive lattices (which safely drop the requirement for the global bounds found in Boolean algebras), we prove the triangle inequality holds as long as the valuation is positive, monotone, supermodular, and $\log$-submodular. Additionally, we adapt the symmetric-difference Jaccard formulation for submodular valuations to sectionally complemented distributive lattices. Shifting to necessary conditions, we prove that supermodularity is a strict requirement for the standard generalized Jaccard distance to operate as a valid metric. Finally, we map the practical value of relaxing these structural constraints to computational fields like quantum information theory, formal concept analysis, and machine learning, closing with a brief look at open mathematical problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出关于 Jaccard 距离 (Jaccard distance) 在任意格 (lattices) 上推广的若干理论结果。作者证明当赋值 (valuation) 严格正、单调且模 (modular) 时，Jaccard 距离在任意格上满足三角不等式，从而推广了先前高度依赖分配性 (distributivity) 的结论；在相对补分配格上，只要赋值为正、单调、超模 (supermodular) 且 log-次模，三角不等式也成立。此外，文章将对称差形式的 Jaccard 公式适配到部分补分配格，并证明超模性是标准广义 Jaccard 距离成为有效度量的必要条件。
Motivation: 先前关于 Jaccard 距离满足三角不等式的结论主要依赖格结构的分配性以及布尔代数中的全局界，适用范围受限；作者希望把这些结构约束放宽，并同时厘清保证距离公理成立的必要条件。
Method: 采用公理化的理论证明方法：在任意格上，对严格正、单调、模的实赋值推导三角不等式；在相对补分配格上利用正、单调、超模且 log-次模的赋值条件；对次模赋值将对称差 Jaccard 距离适配到部分补分配格，并通过反例或推理建立超模性的必要性。
Result: 摘要报告的主要结果是三角不等式在两类推广条件下的成立性，以及超模性对标准广义 Jaccard 距离成为度量的严格要求；未提供数值实验。作者还将这些约束放宽的实际价值映射到量子信息论、形式概念分析 (formal concept analysis) 和机器学习等计算领域。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作表明可以安全地放宽分配性和全局界等结构限制来获得 Jaccard 距离的度量性质，并指出若干尚未解决的开放数学问题；论文为纯理论性质，未涉及具体应用实验。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bound-Aware Per-Organ Recall Risk Control for Multi-Organ CT Segmentation under Clinical Domain Shift
papers.abstract_en: Distribution-free risk control adds organ-specific recall guarantees to frozen segmentation. We calibrate per-organ thresholds for an AMOS-trained nnU-Net, audit transfer to RAOS, and estimate local re-certification cost using case-level voxel false-negative rate (FNR). The AMOS control passes, but $7/12$ organs exceed $α{=}0.10$ after transfer; smaller calibration sets can mask exceedances with conservative or vacuous thresholds. Risk-Controlling Prediction Sets (RCPS) give high-probability control of population-mean risk, whereas Conformal Risk Control (CRC) gives weaker expectation control. Both require exchangeability; fixed and global thresholds give no per-organ guarantee. The Waudby--Smith--Ramdas (WSR) betting bound re-certifies six Tier-1 organs with 25 local cases, versus 30--40 for Hoeffding--Bentkus (HB). CRC needs 10--15 but has a heavier individual-case tail. No Tier-2 organ meets our illustrative precision criterion with 25 cases.
papers.journal_ref: MICCAI-UNSURE 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多器官CT分割在临床域偏移下的无分布风险控制，针对AMOS训练的nnU-Net校准每器官阈值，并审计向RAOS数据迁移后的召回保证。摘要报告AMOS控制通过，但迁移后7/12器官超过α=0.10；较小的校准集可能通过保守或空泛阈值掩盖超标。作者比较了RCPS、CRC与WSR betting bound等方法的本地重新认证样本效率。
Motivation: 临床域偏移会破坏冻结分割模型的器官级召回保证，需要无分布风险控制方法为每器官提供可验证的召回约束，并估计本地重新认证的数据成本。
Method: 对AMOS训练的nnU-Net校准每器官阈值，使用病例级体素假阴性率(FNR)审计到RAOS的迁移，并比较Risk-Controlling Prediction Sets (RCPS)、Conformal Risk Control (CRC)以及Waudby–Smith–Ramdas (WSR) betting bound与Hoeffding–Bentkus (HB)不等式的重新认证表现。
Result: AMOS控制通过但迁移后7/12器官超过α=0.10；WSR betting bound用25个本地病例重新认证六个Tier-1器官，而HB需要30–40例，CRC需要10–15例但个体尾部更重；没有Tier-2器官在25例下达到示例性精度标准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调WSR betting bound在较小本地校准集下提供更高效的重新认证，同时指出RCPS提供种群均值风险的高概率控制、CRC提供较弱的期望控制，且两者都依赖交换性；固定全局阈值不提供每器官保证。

papers.title: ChiroEcho: extending automated bat vocalisation classification beyond the learned taxonomy
papers.abstract_en: Bats are key indicators of ecosystem health and are protected throughout Europe, making reliable population monitoring a conservation priority. Their cryptic nocturnal lifestyle makes passive acoustic monitoring essential, yet automated identification remains difficult as echolocation calls vary with behaviour and environment and overlap among species. We present a deep learning framework that jointly predicts species and genus and combines genus predictions with geographic species distributions at inference. When only one species of a predicted genus occurs in a region, the framework can resolve species absent from the learned taxonomy. This reframes geographic information as a means of extending, rather than constraining, a classifier's effective taxonomy. Using recordings spanning 35 European bat species, we evaluate closed-set classification, examine the instability of performance estimates for sparsely represented species, and conduct a controlled held-out proof-of-principle experiment. The rare-species analysis shows how limited evaluation data can obscure species-level performance, while the held-out experiment shows that genus predictions and location can recover labels unavailable to the species head. Geographic resolution extends operational coverage from 35 to 41 of the 48 native European bat species, increasing coverage from 73% to 85%. To our knowledge, this is the broadest operational coverage reported for automated European bat classification. More broadly, the bat framework provides proof of principle for resolving unseen fine-grained classes by combining coarse predictions with transparent external constraints.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the CV4E workshop, ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChiroEcho，一个深度学习框架，联合预测蝙蝠物种和属，并在推理时将属预测与地理物种分布结合，从而解析出训练分类学中不存在的物种。基于 35 种欧洲蝙蝠物种的录音评估了闭集分类、稀疏物种性能估计的不稳定性，并进行了受控留出实验。地理解析将运营覆盖从 35 种扩展到 41 种（覆盖率从 73% 提升至 85%），据作者称这是欧洲蝙蝠自动分类中最广的运营覆盖。
Motivation: 蝙蝠是生态系统健康的关键指标且在欧洲受保护，被动声学监测对种群监测至关重要，但回声定位叫声随行为和环境影响而变化、物种间重叠，自动识别困难。现有分类器受限于训练时学到的分类学集合，无法识别未见过的物种。
Method: 提出联合预测物种和属的深度学习框架，推理时将属预测与地理物种分布结合；仅当预测属在所在区域只对应一种物种时，可解析训练分类学之外的物种。评估包括闭集分类、稀疏物种性能估计稳定性分析，以及受控的留出实验。
Result: 在 35 种欧洲蝙蝠物种上评估；稀有物种分析显示有限的评估数据会掩盖物种级性能，留出实验表明属预测与位置信息可恢复物种头无法得到的标签。地理分辨率将覆盖物种数从 35 扩展到 41，覆盖率从 73% 增至 85%，据称是欧洲蝙蝠自动分类报告的最广运营覆盖。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架提供了原理验证：结合粗粒度预测与透明外部约束可以解析未见过的细粒度类别；同时指出稀疏物种的性能估计可能不稳定，需要谨慎解读。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ChiroEcho，一个深度学习框架，联合预测蝙蝠物种和属，并在推理时将属预测与地理物种分布结合，从而解析出训练分类学中不存在的物种。基于 35 种欧洲蝙蝠物种的录音评估了闭集分类、稀疏物种性能估计的不稳定性，并进行了受控留出实验。地理解析将运营覆盖从 35 种扩展到 41 种（覆盖率从 73% 提升至 85%），据作者称这是欧洲蝙蝠自动分类中最广的运营覆盖。

papers.title: Safe Domain Adaptation for Physics: Overcoming Nuisances, Label Shifts, and Simulation Priors
authors: Ivan Kharuk (1 and 2) ((1) Institute for Nuclear Research of the Russian Academy of Sciences
(2) Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology)
papers.abstract_en: Domain adaptation is widely used to make neural networks trained on simulations applicable to experimental data. Its premise is that the two domains differ only in nuisances, and that the quantity of interest is distributed identically in both. In physics neither assumption holds: simulations can be wrong about the physics, and the distribution of the target quantity - an energy spectrum, a redshift distribution - is often the measurement itself. We study the consequences of such mismatches on a toy air-shower benchmark in which a detector-response nuisance, a physical simulation shift, and an energy-spectrum shift can be switched on separately or together. Standard adversarial adaptation handles the conditional shifts, but once the two spectra differ it aligns them, replacing an uncontrolled bias by one anchored on the simulation prior. We present adaptive domain adaptation, which reweights the simulated events so as to focus domain adaptation on the genuine physical mismatch alone. Since the predicted spectrum depends on model training configuration, we provide a label-free model selection rule for selecting the near-the-best operation point.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究物理领域中模拟数据与实验数据之间的域适应问题，指出标准域适应假设在物理场景下不成立：模拟器可能存在物理错误，且目标量（如能谱、红移分布）的分布本身往往是待测量。作者在一个玩具空气簇射基准上切换探测器响应干扰、物理模拟偏移和能谱偏移三种失配，提出自适应域适应 (adaptive domain adaptation) 方法，通过对模拟事件重新加权，使域适应只聚焦于真实的物理失配，并提供无标签的模型选择规则。
Motivation: 标准域适应的前提是两个域仅存在干扰差异且目标量分布相同，但物理应用中模拟器可能对物理本身有误，目标量分布（如能谱）又常是测量对象本身，因此现有对抗式域适应会错配并锚定在模拟先验上。
Method: 提出自适应域适应方法：对模拟事件进行重新加权，使域适应只针对真实物理失配而非分布偏移；同时针对预测谱依赖训练配置的问题，提出无标签 (label-free) 模型选择规则来选择接近最优的工作点。
Result: 摘要报告在玩具空气簇射基准上，标准对抗式域适应能处理条件偏移，但一旦两个谱不同就会对齐它们，用锚定在模拟先验上的偏差替换无控偏差；自适应域适应则聚焦于真实物理失配。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调物理场景下域适应需要区分干扰与物理失配，并需要无标签模型选择以避免预测谱受训练配置影响。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: A systematic review of machine learning techniques to address diagnosis and treatment of autism: challenges and opportunities
papers.abstract_en: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a developmental disability characterized by challenges in social interaction and communication. As the causes of ASD remain unclear, identifying relevant features and hidden correlations is crucial for early diagnosis. This systematic review evaluates 55 studies from 2017 to 2023 on the application of machine learning (ML) techniques to ASD. The primary objective is to examine recent ML applications in ASD research, identifying trends, techniques, and datasets that enhance diagnosis and treatment. Supervised learning methods dominate, as they align well with ASD diagnostic needs; however, the role of deep learning is expanding with greater data availability. Emerging techniques based on hybrid methods, where unsupervised, deep learning, and fuzzy logic could be included, will be interesting to observe in the future. The review highlights key challenges and opportunities, particularly the need for models that can integrate complex data -such as genetic and clinical information- to improve diagnostic accuracy and treatment outcomes. Additionally, incorporating innovative data sources, like wearable devices and biometric sensors, could enable continuous and non-intrusive monitoring, providing a more holistic understanding of ASD. Findings emphasize that addressing current challenges requires interdisciplinary collaboration and expanded datasets tailored to ASD. Future ML models will benefit from broader multimodal data integration, enabling researchers to more comprehensively address the complexities of ASD.
papers.journal_ref: A systematic review of machine learning techniques to address diagnosis and treatment of autism: challenges and opportunitie. Heliyon 12(1), e44359, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对2017至2023年间55项将机器学习（ML）用于自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）诊断与治疗研究的系统综述。综述发现监督学习方法占主导，深度学习的作用随数据可用性增加而扩大，并指出结合无监督学习、深度学习和模糊逻辑的混合方法是值得关注的未来方向。作者强调需要整合遗传与临床等复杂数据，并借助可穿戴设备和生物传感器等新数据源实现持续、非侵入性的监测。
Motivation: ASD是一种病因尚不明确的发展性障碍，识别相关特征和隐藏关联对早期诊断至关重要；该领域ML研究分散，缺乏对现有技术、趋势和数据集的系统梳理。
Method: 对2017至2023年间55项研究进行系统综述，分析ML在ASD诊断与治疗中的应用趋势、所用技术及数据集，并总结当前挑战与机遇。
Result: 摘要报告监督学习方法在ASD相关ML应用中占主导地位，深度学习随数据可用性增加而持续扩展；未来具潜力的方向是融合无监督学习、深度学习和模糊逻辑的混合方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为提升诊断准确性和治疗效果需要能整合遗传与临床等复杂数据的模型，并纳入可穿戴设备与生物传感器等创新数据源，以实现连续非侵入监测；同时需要跨学科合作和面向ASD扩充的数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: What Can Artificial Intelligence Learn from Medicine? Generative Analogies and Reliable Machine Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: In the past few years, machine learning (ML) has been widely (and to an extent, successfully) implemented in medicine. However, uncertainties surrounding ML have made it difficult to establish the bases of its epistemic and methodological warrants. In the literature, a parallel has been drawn between medicine and ML, suggesting that we should model epistemic and methodological standards for ML on the standards of clinical translation. By developing tools from Hesse work, we characterise the nature of this parallel as a generative analogy between the process of clinical translation and the process of building ML systems. We identify more precisely the epistemic and methodological warrants of clinical translation that are typically only mentioned when appealing to the analogy, and we show in which sense such warrants apply analogically to the context of ML. In particular, we interpret warrants of clinical translation in reliabilist terms, and we show how this can inform a new form of ML reliabilism, which is distinct from (though compatible with) existing reliabilist accounts in philosophy of AI.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Studies in the History and Philosophy of Science (cite published version)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇哲学与方法论论文，借用Hesse的类比理论，将医学中临床转化（clinical translation）与机器学习系统构建之间的平行关系刻画为一种生成性类比（generative analogy）。作者识别了临床转化中通常只被提及而未明确表述的认识论与方法论保证，并用可靠主义（reliabilism）术语解释这些保证如何类比地适用于ML，进而提出一种有别于现有AI哲学可靠主义的新ML可靠主义形式。
Motivation: ML已在医学中得到广泛应用，但其认识论和方法论基础仍不确定，难以确立其认知依据；文献中常以临床转化的标准来类比ML标准，但这种类比往往只是被引述，其认识论保证并未被清晰阐明。
Method: 借助Hesse关于类比的工具，把临床转化过程与构建ML系统过程之间的平行关系理解为生成性类比，而不是简单的形式相似；具体分析临床转化的认识论和方法论保证，并以可靠主义框架解释其如何类推到ML语境，最终提出一种新的ML可靠主义。
Result: 摘要未报告实证实验或量化结果；论文的主要贡献在于概念性论证，即将临床转化保证解释为可靠主义意义上的保证，并据此形成一种与现有AI哲学中可靠主义不同但相容的ML可靠主义。
Conclusion: 作者认为，用临床翻译的可靠主义保证来类比ML系统构建，可以为ML的认知与方法论标准确立提供新思路，并强调这种ML可靠主义既能区别于现有可靠主义理论，又可以与之兼容。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: H$^2$EDL: Hyper Evidential Deep Learning for Hierarchical Classification
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained recognition often involves hierarchical label spaces, where a model may be confident about a coarse semantic concept while remaining uncertain among its descendant classes. Such structured ambiguity requires uncertainty representations that capture both fine-grained classes and intermediate concepts. However, existing tools each capture only half of it: flat evidential classifiers quantify total ignorance with a single vacuity on the leaf frame, and hierarchical classifiers propagate point probabilities with no notion of evidence. Hyper-opinions would unify the two, but their general form is exponential in the label count, and existing hyper-evidential networks either require composite labels to be supplied in the training data or read them off an unstructured weight pattern, with no principled notion of which composites deserve mass. We observe that the taxonomy itself is the missing hyperdomain. Its subtrees and leaf singletons form a linear-size focal family, and one local Dirichlet opinion per branching node induces every composite mass in closed form. The resulting model, H$^2$EDL, can be interpreted in two complementary ways using the same set of parameters. From a prediction perspective, it functions as a hierarchical classifier that preserves consistency across different levels of the label tree. From a probabilistic perspective, it defines a valid tree-structured hyper-opinion, where the mass assigned to each node represents the belief that reaches that node but does not provide sufficient confidence to further specialize into its descendants. On FGVC-Aircraft and DERM12345, H$^2$EDL reduces calibration error by approximately half compared with cross-entropy baselines, with the improvement becoming more pronounced at deeper hierarchy levels and under larger training budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对层次化标签空间下的细粒度识别，提出 H²EDL（Hyper Evidential Deep Learning for Hierarchical Classification）。核心观察是将分类学本身作为缺失的“超域”（hyperdomain），其子树和叶子单例构成线性大小的焦元族，每个分支节点上的一个局部 Dirichlet 意见即可闭式导出所有复合质量。模型既可理解为保持标签树层级一致性的层次分类器，也可理解为有效的树结构超意见（hyper-opinion）。在 FGVC-Aircraft 和 DERM12345 上，与交叉熵基线相比标定误差约减半，且在更深层级和更大训练预算下改进更显著。
Motivation: 细粒度识别常涉及层次化标签空间，模型可能对粗粒度概念有信心但对子类不确定。现有方法各只捕获一半：平坦证据分类器在叶子框架上用单一 vacuity 量化总体无知，层次分类器传播点概率而缺乏证据。超意见的一般形式随标签数指数增长，现有超证据网络要么需要训练数据提供复合标签，要么从非结构化权重模式中读取，缺乏哪些复合类应获得质量的原理性依据。
Method: 提出将分类学本身作为缺失的 hyperdomain，其子树和叶子单例构成线性大小的焦元族（focal family）；每个分支节点上的一个局部 Dirichlet 意见可以闭式形式诱导出所有复合质量。该模型可由同一组参数给出两种互补解释：预测视角下是保持标签树各层级一致性的层次分类器；概率视角下是有效的树结构超意见，每个节点上的质量表示信念到达该节点但尚无足够信心进一步特化到其后代。
Result: 在 FGVC-Aircraft 和 DERM12345 数据集上，H²EDL 相比交叉熵基线将标定误差（calibration error）降低约一半，且改进在更深的层次级别和更大的训练预算下更为明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用分类学本身构造超意见可同时获得层次分类一致性和概率解释，标定误差显著改善；摘要未讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 FGVC-Aircraft 和 DERM12345 数据集上，H²EDL 相比交叉熵基线将标定误差（calibration error）降低约一半，且改进在更深的层次级别和更大的训练预算下更为明显。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调利用分类学本身构造超意见可同时获得层次分类一致性和概率解释，标定误差显著改善；摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: Human-Centric Intelligence in the Era of Foundation Models: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Human-centric intelligence is evolving in the foundation-model era, with growing emphasis on scale, transferability, and general-purpose modeling. Yet it has not fully integrated with foundation models to achieve the comparable progress seen in them. More importantly, recent advances across this broad landscape remain fragmented across tasks, modalities, and research communities, leaving their intrinsic conceptual and methodological connections unclear. To bridge these divides and rethink human-centric intelligence in the foundation-model era, we introduce a full-spectrum human context taxonomy that integrates six interconnected levels by viewing humans as observable subjects through visual appearance and spatial geometry, as dynamic actors through kinematic dynamics and interaction modeling, and as situated agents through world simulation and embodied agency. We next present the methodological foundations of the field, covering human-centric data families, computational architecture paradigms, and representative training and inference optimization strategies. We then systematically review representative methods across these levels and organize the associated datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics. We further discuss open challenges and promising research directions toward human-centric intelligence that is scalable, trustworthy, physically grounded, and deployable, aiming to provide a coherent framework and practical reference for advancing the field. Finally, we provide a systematically organized and continuously updated collection of human-centric AI literature and resources on our project page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是基础模型时代以人为中心智能 (human-centric intelligence) 的综述。作者提出一个全谱人类上下文分类法，将人类视为可观测主体（视觉外观、空间几何）、动态参与者（运动学动力学、交互建模）和情境化智能体（世界模拟、具身智能）六个相互关联的层级，并系统梳理方法论基础、代表性方法、数据集、基准与评估指标，最后讨论开放挑战与未来方向。
Motivation: 人类中心智能在基础模型时代虽有规模、可迁移性和通用建模方面的发展，但尚未与基础模型充分整合以取得相当进展；同时相关进展分散在不同任务、模态和研究社区中，内在的概念与方法联系不清晰。
Method: 提出包含六个互联层级的人类上下文分类法，并综述人类中心数据族、计算架构范式以及代表性训练与推理优化策略；在此基础上组织各层级的代表性方法、数据集、基准和评估指标。
Result: 作为综述论文，摘要未报告具体实验数值；其主要产出是系统化的框架、对开放挑战与研究方向的讨论，以及持续更新的人类中心 AI 文献与资源集合。
Conclusion: 作者旨在提供一个连贯框架和实践参考，推动可扩展、可信、物理上有根据且可部署 (scalable, trustworthy, physically grounded, deployable) 的人类中心智能研究。

papers.title: Accelerating Visual On-Policy Distillation with Batched Speculative Jacobi Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: Visual on-policy distillation (OPD) improves the training of compact visual autoregressive models by learning from trajectories generated by the current student. However, these online rollouts are still produced token by token with autoregressive decoding, which adds substantial cost to every on-policy training step. Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD) provides an alternative because it can process multiple tokens in parallel without an auxiliary draft model, but the original method is designed for single-sequence inference. We introduce HB-SJD, a batched SJD rollout backend for visual OPD. HB-SJD allows each image to advance independently according to its own decoding progress, while images at different sequence positions are still verified in batched model forwards. As images finish, HB-SJD switches between Full and Compact execution to reduce the cost of later rollout rounds. HB-SJD only replaces the student rollout backend and leaves the teacher, distillation objective, and optimization procedure unchanged. Experiments with LlamaGen show that HB-SJD substantially reduces rollout and end-to-end training time while preserving the generation quality of the distilled student.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HB-SJD，一种用于视觉 on-policy distillation (OPD) 的批量投机雅可比解码 (batched speculative Jacobi decoding) rollout 后端，以加速紧凑视觉自回归模型的学生训练。HB-SJD 允许每个图像按自身解码进度独立推进，同时仍在批量模型前向中对不同序列位置的 token 进行验证；当图像完成解码后，在执行阶段从 Full 切换到 Compact 以降低后期 rollout 轮次开销。作者用 LlamaGen 实验表明，该方法在保持蒸馏学生生成质量的同时，显著减少 rollout 时间与端到端训练时间。
Motivation: 视觉 OPD 依赖当前学生生成的轨迹进行训练，但在线 rollout 仍逐 token 自回归解码，给每个 on-policy 训练步骤带来高昂成本。Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD) 虽可无需辅助草稿模型并行处理多个 token，但原始方法面向单序列推理，无法直接用于批量训练场景。
Method: 引入 HB-SJD 作为视觉 OPD 的批量 rollout 后端：每个图像按自身解码进度独立推进，模型前向仍以批处理形式验证不同序列位置的 token；随着图像逐条完成，后端在 Full 与 Compact 两种执行模式间切换以降低后续 rollout 轮次的计算开销。HB-SJD 仅替换学生 rollout 后端，教师网络、蒸馏目标和优化过程保持不变。
Result: 基于 LlamaGen 的实验显示，HB-SJD 大幅降低 rollout 时间和端到端训练时间，同时保持蒸馏学生的生成质量；摘要未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 HB-SJD 只替换学生 rollout 后端，不改变教师、蒸馏损失和优化流程，因此易于集成到现有视觉 OPD 训练中；实验验证仅限于 LlamaGen 模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fair Multi-View Determinantal Coresets via Adaptive NEPv
papers.abstract_en: Selecting a small, diverse subset from a large candidate pool often means balancing several incompatible notions of diversity. In trademark curation, for instance, a subset should cover both the language used to describe marks and the visual space of their logos. A single determinantal point process (\DPP) kernel can hide failure in one view, and averaging kernels replaces the multi-view relaxation by an ordinary single-kernel spectral problem. We formulate \emph{fair multi-view determinant selection}: maximize the weakest per-view log determinant of a size-$k$ subset. We smooth this nonsmooth objective and relax it to the Stiefel manifold. The relaxation embeds every discrete subset exactly, but unlike its single-view counterpart it has no closed-form spectral solution in general. Its stationarity condition is a gauge-invariant nonlinear eigenvalue problem with eigenvector-dependent, view-adaptive weights. We derive an adaptive self-consistent-field (\SCF) solver with damping and level shifting, and round the resulting subspace by leverage-score screening followed by fair local refinement. The solver needs only feature-map products for each view. We report conflicting-view synthetic experiments and specify a multimodal USPTO protocol; the real-data multimodal results require aligned logo embeddings and are not claimed in this version.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出公平多视角行列式选择 (fair multi-view determinant selection) 问题，目标是在候选池中选取大小为 k 的子集，使各视角的对数行列式中最弱者最大化。作者对非平滑目标做平滑处理并松弛到 Stiefel 流形，得到无法闭式求解的规范不变非线性特征值问题，并设计带阻尼和能级平移的自洽场 (SCF) 求解器，再通过 leverage-score 筛选加公平局部精化进行取整。摘要报告了冲突视角的合成实验，并给出多模态 USPTO 协议；真实数据多模态结果因需要对齐的 logo 嵌入而未在本版本中给出。
Motivation: 单一 DPP (determinantal point process) 核可能在某一个视角上完全失效，而简单平均各视角核会把多视角松弛退化为普通的单核谱问题，无法保证所有视角都被公平覆盖，例如商标整理场景中需要同时覆盖描述语言和 logo 视觉空间。
Method: 将最弱视角的 log-determinant 目标平滑化并松弛到 Stiefel 流形上，证明每个离散子集都能被精确嵌入；其驻点条件是一个带特征向量依赖、视角自适应权重的规范不变非线性特征值问题 (NEPv)。作者推导了带阻尼和 level shifting 的自适应自洽场 (SCF) 求解器，并用 leverage-score 筛选加公平局部精化完成子空间取整，求解仅需各视角的特征映射乘积。
Result: 摘要报告了冲突视角下的合成实验，并详细规定了多模态 USPTO 实验协议；真实数据多模态结果需要对齐的 logo 嵌入，因此本版本未声称这些结果。
Conclusion: 作者明确表示当前版本不包含真实多模态数据结果，真实数据验证仍有赖于对齐的 logo 嵌入；本文贡献集中在问题形式化、NEPv 求解器设计与合成实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trust as a Field: A Macroscopic Representation for Vehicular Networks
papers.abstract_en: Trust assessment is a fundamental component of cooperative and connected vehicle systems. However, existing approaches operate primarily at the level of individual vehicles, making it difficult to reason about trust evolution across road segments. In this paper, we propose a spatio-temporal trust-field framework that aggregates microscopic vehicle-level trust into a continuous representation over space and time. The trust field is formally defined on road segments. We conducted simulation-based experiments using synthetic trajectories generated under controlled conditions, enabling analysis of trust-field behavior in simple road scenarios. Beyond theoretical modeling, we study an implication of the trust-field concept: reconstructing the full trust field from sparse roadside-unit (RSU) measurements. We compare (i) a coordinate-based deep learning baseline that learns a generic trust field from sparse samples and (ii) a field-informed deep learning method that treats trust as a latent quantity carried by vehicles and enforces measurement consistency through the aggregation mechanism. The field-informed approach more accurately recovers trajectory-aligned low-trust patterns and yields improved reconstruction error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对车联网中信任评估仅停留在单车层面、难以刻画路段尺度信任演化的问题，提出一种时空信任场（trust field）框架，将微观车辆级信任聚合为道路段上的连续表示，并基于合成轨迹在简单道路场景中进行仿真验证。文章进一步研究从稀疏路侧单元（RSU）测量重建完整信任场的两种方法：坐标基深度学习和将信任视为车辆携带潜变量、通过聚合机制强制测量一致性的场感知深度学习。结果表明场感知方法能更准确恢复轨迹对齐的低信任模式，并改善重建误差。
Motivation: 现有信任评估方法主要针对单辆车运行，难以在道路段尺度上推理信任随空间和时间的演化，缺乏一种宏观的连续表示来支撑协作式网联车辆系统中的信任推理。
Method: 提出一个形式化定义在道路段上的时空信任场，将微观车辆级信任聚合成连续表示；并在稀疏RSU测量下比较两类重建方法：坐标基深度学习基线，以及把信任视为车辆携带的潜变量、通过聚合机制保证测量一致性的场感知深度学习方法。
Result: 基于受控条件下合成轨迹的仿真实验表明，场感知深度学习方法比坐标基基线更准确地恢复与轨迹对齐的低信任区域，并得到更优的重建误差。
Conclusion: 作者展示了信任场概念在车联网中的理论建模与重建可行性，但实验局限于简单道路场景和合成数据，尚未涉及真实交通环境下的验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Reversible Forgetting: Managing Obsolete Knowledge in Continual Enterprise AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning has traditionally treated forgetting as a failure, emphasizing preservation of previously acquired knowledge as environments evolve. We argue that this objective is incomplete for enterprise AI agents operating in non-stationary environments, where customers, policies, tools, workflows, regulations, and market conditions change over time. Indiscriminate retention can allow obsolete knowledge to influence decisions, creating negative transfer and operational risk. We therefore propose reversible forgetting: a conceptual framework with three operational memory states: active, dormant, and retired, and a reactivation transition that can restore dormant knowledge when its relevance returns. We instantiate the framework as a Hysteretic Reversible Memory Controller that accumulates relevance evidence, uses asymmetric thresholds to prevent state oscillation, tests reactivation in shadow mode, and gates retirement through policy. The framework reduces the influence of obsolete information without conflating temporary suppression with permanent erasure. Finance illustrates the idea: knowledge useful under one market regime may become harmful under another yet regain relevance when similar conditions recur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可逆遗忘 (reversible forgetting) 概念框架，针对企业 AI 智能体在非平稳环境中应管理过时知识而非一味保留的问题。框架定义 active、dormant、retired 三种记忆状态及 reactivation 转换，并实例化为 Hysteretic Reversible Memory Controller，通过不对称阈值、影子模式测试和政策门控来降低过时信息的影响。摘要以金融场景为例说明知识在不同市场制度下可能由有害恢复为有用。
Motivation: 传统持续学习把遗忘视为失败并强调保留旧知识，但对企业 AI 智能体而言，客户、政策、工具、法规和市场条件会变化，无差别保留会让过时知识产生负迁移和运营风险。
Method: 提出 Hysteretic Reversible Memory Controller：累积相关性证据，采用不对称阈值防止状态振荡，在影子模式 (shadow mode) 下测试知识能否重新激活，并通过策略门控决定是否彻底退休 (retire)。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验或基准结果，仅以金融场景说明该框架如何区分暂时抑制与永久擦除。
Conclusion: 该框架能在不混淆暂时抑制与永久擦除的前提下降低过时信息的影响，并支持需要时重新激活已休眠的知识。

papers.title: Breaking Planner Integrity Boundary: Enviroment State-Text Injection Attack on LLM-Driven Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-driven embodied agents rely on environment states to interpret scenes, generate high-level plans, and drive physical execution, making planner-visible state representations a critical security boundary. Existing attacks primarily manipulate user instructions, prompt contexts, model behavior, or perceptual inputs, while paying limited attention to whether environment-state text itself can serve as deceptive task evidence and propagate beyond planning to affect execution outcomes. Because embodied tasks are constrained by entity grounding, action preconditions, spatial relations, and environmental constraints, planning deviation alone does not guarantee adversarial execution. To address this gap, we investigate environment-state text as an independent attack surface and present the first closed-loop Environment State-Text Injection (ESTI) attack for LLM-driven embodied agents. Without modifying the original user instruction, model parameters, or executor, ESTI reformulates an adversarial objective as false state evidence compatible with the current environment and influences planning and execution through object properties, spatial relations, affordances, task-stage rules, and execution feedback. We further develop ESTI-Bench to evaluate attack propagation across the planning-to-execution closed loop and compare ESTI with Vanilla IPI, EIRAD, and BADROBOT across ProgPrompt/VirtualHome, VoxPoser/RLBench, and AI2-THOR/iTHOR. ESTI consistently outperforms existing baselines, improving planning-level and execution-level attack success rates by up to 89.32\% and 43.69\%, respectively. Further analysis shows that grounding, consistency, and executability jointly determine whether manipulated state evidence can propagate through the embodied closed loop and produce verifiable environmental changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究面向 LLM 驱动的具身智能体 (embodied agent) 的环境状态文本攻击，提出首个闭环环境状态文本注入 (Environment State-Text Injection, ESTI) 攻击。该方法在不修改用户指令、模型参数或执行器的前提下，把对抗目标重构为与当前环境兼容的虚假状态证据，影响规划与执行。作者还构建 ESTI-Bench 评估攻击在规划到执行闭环中的传播，并在 ProgPrompt/VirtualHome、VoxPoser/RLBench 和 AI2-THOR/iTHOR 上与多种基线对比，报告了显著的攻击成功率提升。
Motivation: 现有攻击主要操纵用户指令、提示上下文、模型行为或感知输入，较少关注环境状态文本本身能否作为欺骗性任务证据并跨越规划阶段影响实际执行。由于具身任务受实体锚定、动作前置条件、空间关系和环境约束限制，仅造成规划偏差并不保证对抗执行成功，因此需要把环境状态文本作为独立攻击面研究。
Method: 提出 ESTI 攻击，将对抗目标重写为与当前环境兼容的虚假状态证据，通过物体属性、空间关系、可供性 (affordance)、任务阶段规则和执行反馈同时影响规划与执行。配套提出 ESTI-Bench 基准，用于评估攻击在规划到执行闭环中的传播，并与 Vanilla IPI、EIRAD、BADROBOT 在多个具身平台和任务基准上进行比较。
Result: 摘要报告 ESTI 一致优于既有基线，规划级攻击成功率最高提升 89.32%，执行级攻击成功率最高提升 43.69%。进一步分析表明，grounding、一致性和可执行性共同决定被操纵的状态证据能否在具身闭环中传播并产生可验证的环境变化。
Conclusion: 摘要将环境状态文本认定为 LLM 驱动具身体的独立安全攻击面，并强调 grounding、一致性与可执行性是决定状态注入能否从规划传播到执行的关键因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language and vision-language models generate plausible embodied plans but do not guarantee executability, as their outputs can violate environment dynamics or act on incorrectly grounded entities. We present a neurosymbolic agent that factors long-horizon household tasks into task-directed visual exploration and constrained symbolic planning. In the first phase, a vision-language model and exploration harness acquire goal-relevant predicates and instance bindings from egocentric observations and grounded interactions, producing a symbolic initial state. In the second, a PDDL transition model restricts decoding to tokens that extend applicable actions. Monte Carlo tree search then evaluates executable continuations using a domain-independent planning heuristic. The resulting plans are executable by construction under the transition model, with transfer to the environment conditioned on correct visual grounding. On VirtualHome and ALFWorld, open 4B-27B models exceed 90% success in both environments, and our smallest agent substantially outperforms a 27B direct visual policy in each. Constraints and search prove complementary rather than interchangeable: in ALFWorld either alone solves under a third of tasks, whereas their combination solves over 95%. The method also uses several times fewer generated tokens than extended thinking and far fewer model-visible images than direct interaction, and residual failures localize to state acquisition rather than plan generation without any specialized training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号具身智能体，将长时程家庭任务分解为任务导向的视觉探索与约束符号规划。第一阶段用视觉语言模型和探索机制从第一视角观测中获取目标相关谓词与实例绑定，构建符号初始状态；第二阶段用PDDL转移模型约束解码，仅生成可扩展的适用动作，并由蒙特卡洛树搜索结合领域无关的规划启发式评估可执行延续。在VirtualHome和ALFWorld上，开放4B-27B模型均超过90%成功率，最小智能体在两个环境中都大幅优于27B直接视觉策略。
Motivation: 语言和视觉语言模型能生成看似合理的具身规划，但不保证可执行性，输出可能违反环境动态或作用于错误接地的实体，因此需要显式引入符号约束与规划来保证可执行性。
Method: 两阶段神经符号方法：第一阶段由视觉语言模型和探索机制从自我中心观测与接地交互中获取目标相关谓词和实例绑定，生成符号初始状态；第二阶段用PDDL转移模型限制解码只生成适用动作的token，并通过蒙特卡洛树搜索和领域无关规划启发式评估可执行延续。
Result: 在VirtualHome与ALFWorld上，开放的4B-27B模型在两个环境均超过90%成功率；最小的智能体在每个环境中明显优于27B直接视觉策略。在ALFWorld中，单独使用约束或搜索只能解决不到三分之一任务，而两者结合可解决超过95%的任务；该方法比扩展思考模式少用数倍生成token，比直接交互少用大量模型可见图像。
Conclusion: 约束与搜索互补而非可互换，残余失败主要定位于状态获取阶段而非规划生成阶段，且无需专门训练；方法在保证可执行性方面有效，但环境迁移仍取决于正确的视觉接地。

papers.title: A Cloud-Edge System for Multimodal Clinical Screening in Resource-Constrained Rural Settings
papers.abstract_en: Medical AI has demonstrated specialist-level diagnostic accuracy, yet these capabilities remain largely inaccessible in resource-constrained rural settings where bandwidth is scarce, compute is limited, and clinical decision-making requires integrating heterogeneous modalities. We introduce a cloud--edge collaborative architecture that addresses these constraints: lightweight, domain-specific models on the edge transform raw medical data into compact structured outputs, while a cloud LLM synthesizes these outputs into clinical summaries. An LLM-based orchestrator dynamically selects diagnostic tools based on patient context, promoting comprehensive modality coverage without processing irrelevant inputs. We evaluate on 20 multimodal clinical cases spanning cardiac, obstetric, trauma, and screening scenarios under three simulated network profiles (500,kbps--5,Mbps). The hybrid system achieves 98--99% diagnostic tool recall with 92--96% precision, matches or exceeds cloud-only baselines on clinical accuracy, and maintains bandwidth-invariant latency (25--35,s) at 4--15x lower token cost. These results highlight the role of architectural design in enabling efficient multimodal integration and improving factual grounding compared to cloud-only approaches under deployment constraints.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种云-边协作架构，用于资源受限的农村环境中的多模态临床筛查：边缘端轻量领域模型将原始医学数据转换为紧凑结构化输出，云端 LLM 综合这些输出生成临床摘要，并由基于 LLM 的编排器根据患者上下文动态选择诊断工具。在 20 个多模态临床案例和三种模拟网络配置（500 kbps–5 Mbps）下，混合系统达到 98–99% 的诊断工具召回率和 92–96% 的精确率，匹配或超过纯云基线的临床准确率，同时保持带宽无关的延迟（25–35 秒）并将 token 成本降低 4–15 倍。
Motivation: 医疗 AI 虽已达到专家级诊断精度，但在带宽稀缺、算力有限且临床决策需整合异质模态的农村场景中仍难以普及；该论文针对这类部署约束下的多模态临床筛查问题。
Method: 提出 cloud-edge 协同架构：边缘端运行轻量、领域专属模型，将原始医学数据转为紧凑结构化输出；云端 LLM 将输出综合为临床摘要；一个基于 LLM 的编排器根据患者上下文动态选择诊断工具，以覆盖必要模态并避免处理无关输入。
Result: 在 20 个涵盖心脏、产科、创伤和筛查场景的多模态临床案例、三种模拟网络（500 kbps–5 Mbps）下，系统实现 98–99% 的诊断工具召回率与 92–96% 的精确率，临床准确率不低于纯云基线，延迟保持带宽不变（25–35 秒），token 成本降低 4–15 倍，并相比纯云方法改善了事实依据（factual grounding）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调架构设计本身可在实际部署约束下实现高效的多模态整合，并指出云-边划分相比纯云方法能改善事实依据和成本效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EgoCITE: Context-Augmented Indexing and Time-Aware Retrieval for Long-Horizon Egocentric Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon egocentric memory transforms continuous first-person video and audio into a searchable record of past experiences. We demonstrate two bottlenecks in existing systems: indices built from context-poor captions are unreliable for agentic search, while retrieval ignores a question's temporal intent. To address both bottlenecks, we introduce EgoCITE (Egocentric Context-augmented Indexing and Time-aware Evidence retrieval), a long-horizon agentic memory framework for egocentric QA. EgoCITE comprises three components. EgoScheme uses local multimodal context to turn fragmentary video captions and speech transcripts into self-contained atomic memory indices. EgoIndex organizes complementary action, activity, utterance, and conversation representations into searchable multi-view memory indices at multiple granularities. EgoRetrv combines semantic search with question-conditioned temporal relevance scoring and curation of retrieved evidence. We evaluate EgoCITE on EgoLifeQA, EgoMem, and EgoR1-Bench in terms of answer accuracy and target-event retrieval alignment. EgoCITE improves accuracy over agentic memory baselines by at least 4.4--14.2% while achieving 36$\times$ lower cost than long-context LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长时间跨度第一视角记忆 (egocentric memory) 的问答任务提出 EgoCITE 框架，该框架由三个组件构成：EgoScheme 利用局部多模态上下文把碎片化视频字幕和语音转写整理为自包含的原子记忆索引；EgoIndex 将动作、活动、话语和对话等互补表示组织成多粒度、多视角的可检索记忆索引；EgoRetrv 将语义检索与问题条件化 (question-conditioned) 的时间相关性打分和证据筛选结合。在 EgoLifeQA、EgoMem 和 EgoR1-Bench 上，EgoCITE 相比 agentic memory 基线准确率提升 4.4%–14.2%，且比长上下文 LLM agent 的成本低 36 倍。
Motivation: 现有长时间跨度的第一视角记忆系统存在两个瓶颈：由缺乏上下文 (context-poor) 的字幕构建的索引对 agentic 搜索不可靠，而检索过程忽略了问题本身的时间意图。这两个瓶颈限制了把连续第一视角视频和音频转变成可搜索的过去经历记录。
Method: 提出 EgoCITE 这一长时程 agentic 记忆框架，包含三个组件：EgoScheme 用局部多模态上下文将碎片化的视频字幕和语音转写转化为自包含的原子记忆索引；EgoIndex 把动作、活动、话语和对话等互补表示组织成多粒度、多视角的记忆索引；EgoRetrv 结合语义检索与问题条件化的时间相关性打分，并整理检索到的证据。
Result: 在 EgoLifeQA、EgoMem 和 EgoR1-Bench 上，EgoCITE 在答案准确率和目标事件检索对齐 (target-event retrieval alignment) 两项指标上超过 agentic memory 基线至少 4.4%–14.2%，同时比长上下文 LLM agent 的推理成本低 36 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，同时解决索引上下文缺失和检索时间意图缺失这两个瓶颈，可以显著提升长时程第一视角记忆问答的表现，并大幅降低相比长上下文 LLM agent 的成本。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Remote Approach to Cashew Orchard Detection: Leveraging Active Learning with Satellite Imagery in Guinea-Bissau
papers.abstract_en: Cashew production is a widespread economic activity in Guinea-Bissau, as well as other countries in West Africa. However, unregulated cashew production can be directly associated with increasing regionwide deforestation rates, biodiversity losses, and a fragile economic structure. There is no nationwide database for listing or georeferencing cashew orchards, so there is a clear need to remotely map their locations. In recent years, multiple methods for detecting orchards have been developed, though they have only been applied on a regional level. This work expands regional analyses to a nationwide scale. It develops a scalable and cost-effective remote approach, based on Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, using Machine Learning techniques to detect cashew orchards automatically. Margin-based Active Learning techniques were employed to develop an optimal training set in terms of the number of points and their informativeness, leading to a cashew map with 94.0% balanced accuracy obtained entirely off-site. We created two datasets and a 2021 cashew map with 10m spatial resolution that are openly accessible through GitHub. The results demonstrate the possibility of a broader cashew orchard mapping, creating a new stepping stone for this environmental application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Sentinel-2 卫星影像和机器学习的大规模腰果果园检测方法，在几内亚比绍全国范围内实现自动制图。作者采用基于边距 (margin-based) 的主动学习 (Active Learning) 构建训练集，在完全离线的条件下取得 94.0% 的平衡准确率，并公开了 10m 分辨率的 2021 年腰果地图与两个数据集。
Motivation: 腰果生产是几内亚比绍等西非国家的重要经济活动，但缺乏全国性的腰果园清单或地理参考数据库，而失控的腰果种植与森林砍伐、生物多样性损失和经济脆弱性相关，因此需要远程绘制其位置；已有检测方法仅停留在区域尺度。
Method: 利用 Sentinel-2 卫星影像，采用机器学习技术自动检测腰果园，并结合基于边距的主动学习策略来挑选信息量最大且数量最优的训练样本点，从而在降低成本的同时保证模型性能。
Result: 方法在完全离线的条件下实现了 94.0% 的平衡准确率，并将分析从区域尺度扩展到全国尺度，创建了可公开访问的两个数据集和 10m 空间分辨率的 2021 年腰果地图。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该结果证明了更大范围腰果园制图的可行性，为该环境应用提供了新的基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Complete, Scalable, and Robust Prioritized Planning for Multi-Robot Ordered Storage and Retrieval at Maximum Capacity
papers.abstract_en: Automated warehouses face a fundamental trade-off between maximizing storage density and achieving high retrieval throughput. While puzzle-based storage (PBS) architectures increase capacity by eliminating aisles, coordinating multiple robots in these high-density spaces is computationally challenging. This paper formalizes the challenge through a novel multi-robot problem formulation for ordered storage and retrieval: We consider rectangular 2D grids, where uniform-sized loads are first stored, up to full capacity, and subsequently retrieved according to prescribed arrival and departure sequences. The main contribution of this work is an online prioritized multi-agent path planning algorithm for this problem. The algorithm builds on prior work that constructs arrangements supporting sequential storage and retrieval, i.e., of one load at a time, without relocating loads. By exploiting the structural invariants of such arrangements, we achieve the scalability of decoupled planning while guaranteeing complete, deadlock-free parallel execution even at full storage density. Experiments demonstrate that the algorithm achieves near-linear improvement in makespan with respect to the number of robots, up to $C$ robots, where $C$ is the width of the grid's open side. Furthermore, the algorithm supports robust storage arrangements that accommodate bounded uncertainty in the departure sequence, with negligible impact on execution makespan.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自动化仓库中多机器人有序存储与检索问题，提出一种在线优先级多智能体路径规划算法。该算法利用支持顺序存取的结构不变量，在完全存储密度下实现无死锁的并行执行，并在makespan上随机器人数量近线性改善。摘要还表明算法对出发序列的有界不确定性具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 自动化仓库需要在最大化存储密度与高检索吞吐量之间权衡；基于拼图的存储（PBS）架构通过消除通道提高容量，但高密度空间中多机器人协调在计算上困难。
Method: 将问题形式化为矩形2D网格上统一尺寸负载的有序存储与检索（按到达和离开序列）。算法基于先前工作构建支持一次一个负载顺序存取且无需重新定位的排列，利用其结构不变量实现解耦规划的可扩展性，同时保证完整、无死锁的并行执行。
Result: 实验表明算法在makespan上随机器人数量实现近线性改进，最多可达C个机器人（C为网格开放侧宽度）；同时支持有界出发序列不确定性的鲁棒存储排列，对执行makespan影响可忽略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该算法在完全存储密度下结合了解耦规划的可扩展性与完整性、无死锁保证，并具备对出发序列不确定性的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Residual Algebra for Representation-Preserving Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning from heterogeneous representations is often reduced to feature concatenation, erasing which representation produced each error. We propose residual algebra, in which each representation retains its coordinate system and owns its unresolved residual until an explicit aggregation boundary. Fold instantiates representations as point-in-time conditional-mean fields on 10x10 rank grids, and FPRC-PQ composes them through relax-aggregate-close: each field first fits a correction to its own residual, corrected fields then meet at a fixed mean, and a shared learner closes only the aggregate's fresh residual. We formalize aggregation as a quotient by the zero-sum redistribution kernel, characterizing legal post-aggregation operators as those constant on its cosets. The resulting composition separates representation, local residual estimation, and residual-of-residual estimation, with population variance reduction and first-order coupled-path mean orthogonality. Rumination-B and Rumination-H extend the algebra with quotient-legal finite correction and feedback. On 3.67M Chinese A-share stock-day observations (2023-2026) under a frozen point-in-time protocol, FPRC-PQ raises net-of-cost return from 13.52% to 19.10% and Sharpe from 1.42 to 2.09, outperforming matched-capacity, unified-residual, identity-free two-stage, and pairwise-only controls. The gain is thus attributable to explicit residual ownership and composition rather than additional features or trees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出残差代数 (residual algebra) 框架，用于避免异构表示学习中因特征拼接而丢失误差来源的问题。Fold 将表示实例化为 10x10 秩网格上的条件均值场，FPRC-PQ 通过 relax-aggregate-close 组合各表示：每个场先拟合自身残差，修正后的场在固定均值处汇合，再由共享学习器关闭聚合后的新残差。在 2023-2026 年 367 万条中国 A 股股票-日观测数据上，FPRC-PQ 将净收益从 13.52% 提升到 19.10%，Sharpe 从 1.42 提升到 2.09。
Motivation: 异质表示学习常被简化为特征拼接，这会抹掉每个误差究竟由哪个表示产生，从而限制后续学习器对误差来源的利用。
Method: 将聚合形式化为对零和再分布核 (zero-sum redistribution kernel) 的商，特征是定义在其余集上保持不变的合法聚合后算子；Fold 在 10x10 秩网格上实例化表示，FPRC-PQ 采用 relax-aggregate-close 流程，Rumination-B 与 Rumination-H 进一步引入商合法有限修正和反馈。
Result: 在冻结 point-in-time 协议下的 3.67M 中国 A 股股票-日观测中，FPRC-PQ 将净成本后收益从 13.52% 提高到 19.10%，Sharpe 从 1.42 提高到 2.09，并优于匹配容量、统一残差、无身份两阶段和仅成对控制的对照。
Conclusion: 摘要指出性能增益可归因于显式残差所有权 (residual ownership) 与组合方式，而非额外特征或更多树。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Hybrid LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agents for Complex Sequential Decision Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, and tool-use, enabling new forms of autonomous agents. However, LLM-based agents struggle with long-horizon sequential decision tasks that require precise action optimization and environment interaction. Reinforcement Learning (RL), while effective for sequential control, often lacks the high-level abstraction and task decomposition abilities needed for complex scenarios. This paper introduces an LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent that integrates LLM-driven planning with RL-based action optimization. The proposed architecture leverages the LLM to generate subgoals, structured plans, and contextual guidance, while the RL agent refines low-level actions through interaction with the environment. Experiments on sequential decision tasks demonstrate improved sample efficiency, higher success rates, and more coherent action trajectories compared to RL-only and LLM-only baselines. This hybrid paradigm highlights a promising direction for building more capable autonomous systems.
papers.comment: This submission is withdrawn because the uploaded manuscript does not accurately reflect the intended structure or results. Several components referenced in the text are incomplete or not represented in the PDF, and the current version may mislead readers. The work is therefore withdrawn to maintain clarity of the record
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 LLM 增强的强化学习智能体 (LLM-Augmented RL Agent)，用 LLM 生成子目标、结构化计划和上下文指导，再让 RL 智能体通过与环境的交互优化底层动作。摘要报告其在顺序决策任务上相比纯 RL 和纯 LLM 基线取得更好的样本效率、成功率和更连贯的动作轨迹。需要注意的是，该投稿已被撤回：arXiv 备注称上传稿件未能准确反映预期结构与结果，PDF 中多处组件不完整，可能误导读者。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在需要精确动作优化和持续环境交互的长时域顺序决策任务上表现不佳，而 RL 虽擅长顺序控制，但缺乏高层抽象和任务分解能力，两者单独使用均有局限。
Method: 提出混合架构：LLM 负责高层规划，包括生成子目标、结构化计划和情境化指导；RL 部分负责低层动作优化，通过环境交互精化策略。
Result: 摘要称在顺序决策任务上的实验表明，相比 RL-only 和 LLM-only 基线，该方法提升了样本效率、成功率，并产生更连贯的动作轨迹。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 规划与 RL 动作优化结合的混合范式是构建更强自主系统的有前景方向；但该论文已被撤回，因为上传稿件与预期结构与结果不符，读者应谨慎对待其中的描述。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpreadMark: Robust Image Watermarking via Spread-Spectrum Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Invisible image watermarks are increasingly used for deepfake detection and provenance tracking, where they must survive not only incidental distortions but also deliberate removal. We revisit spread-spectrum embedding, a classical watermarking principle, inside a modern neural post-hoc watermarking architecture. Our starting point is a measurement: in existing encoder-decoder schemes each message bit occupies only a small fraction of the image, a shared contributing factor to their fragility, since removal then need only disturb the region a bit occupies. SpreadMark instead spreads each bit as a dense pseudo-random codeword over the whole image and recovers it by matched-filtering a learned cover-suppressed chip representation, with a parallel convolutional decoding path and sparsification-aware training. A conditional chip-space analysis shows that, under a codeword-independent perturbation model, dense spreading increases the budget required to disrupt matched-filter recovery. Evaluated on COCO and DIV2K against nine schemes, SpreadMark is the only evaluated method retaining high detection under both the regeneration and the latent-space sparsification settings we test, with competitive JPEG and additive-noise robustness. It keeps the embedded watermark imperceptible, maintaining high perceptual quality on both COCO and DIV2K.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpreadMark 提出在神经后处理水印架构中重新引入扩频嵌入 (spread-spectrum embedding)：将每个消息比特扩展为铺满整幅图像的稠密伪随机码字，并通过对学习得到的 cover-suppressed chip 表示做匹配滤波 (matched filtering) 来恢复，同时配备并行卷积解码路径和稀疏化感知训练。在 COCO 和 DIV2K 上对比九种方案，SpreadMark 是唯一在重建 (regeneration) 与潜在空间稀疏化 (latent-space sparsification) 两种测试设置下都保持高检测率的方法，并在 JPEG 和加性噪声鲁棒性上与对比方法相当。
Motivation: 现有 encoder-decoder 不可见水印方案中，每个消息比特只占图像的一小部分区域，破坏该区域即可移除该比特，这是水印脆弱性的共同原因；文章希望让去除扰动难以针对单个比特所占据的局部区域。
Method: 采用扩频嵌入，使每个比特以稠密伪随机码字形式分布到整幅图像，再用匹配滤波恢复被覆盖抑制后的 chip 表示；网络结构包含并行卷积解码路径，并通过稀疏化感知训练增强鲁棒性。作者还给出条件 chip-space 分析，说明在码字无关扰动模型下，稠密扩频会提高破坏匹配滤波恢复所需的攻击预算。
Result: 在 COCO 和 DIV2K 上对比九种方案，SpreadMark 是唯一在再生与潜在空间稀疏化设置下都保持高检测率的方法，同时具备有竞争力的 JPEG 和加性噪声鲁棒性，且水印不可感知，两个数据集上的感知质量都保持较高。
Conclusion: 摘要认为稠密扩频嵌入可以显著提升水印对抗针对性局部扰动与去除攻击的鲁棒性，并强调该方法在深伪检测和来源追踪等场景下的适用性；其理论分析基于码字无关扰动模型，适用范围以该假设为边界。

papers.title: LLM-Driven AutoML for Cross-Lingual Handwritten OCR: Closed-Loop Neural Architecture Search with GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4
papers.abstract_en: We present a fully automated closed-loop AutoML framework that uses GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4 as autonomous neural architecture designers for cross-lingual handwritten optical character recognition. Each large language model independently generates, trains, evaluates, and iteratively refines neural network architectures using performance feedback from previous trials. The framework is evaluated on Arabic, Persian, and English handwriting datasets through 270 independent experiments. It consistently discovers accurate and computationally efficient models without manual architecture design, domain-specific preprocessing, or hyperparameter tuning. The generated models achieve mean test accuracies above 93 percent, a best accuracy of 98.1 percent, and inference latency between 41 and 44 milliseconds. The results demonstrate that large language models can function as effective AutoML agents for neural architecture search, enabling scalable, script-adaptive, and reproducible handwriting recognition across languages.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个全自动闭环 AutoML 框架，用 GPT-5、GPT-4o 和 Claude Sonnet 4 作为自主神经架构设计器，进行跨语言手写 OCR 的神经架构搜索。每个 LLM 独立生成、训练、评估并迭代改进网络架构，利用前次试验的性能反馈驱动优化，并在阿拉伯语、波斯语和英语手写数据集上通过 270 次独立实验验证。生成模型平均测试准确率超过 93%，最优准确率 98.1%，推理延迟 41-44 毫秒。
Motivation: 传统手写 OCR 依赖人工架构设计、领域特定预处理和超参数调优，跨语言泛化成本高。论文试图验证 LLM 能否作为 AutoML 代理自主完成神经架构搜索 (NAS)，实现无需人工干预的脚本自适应手写识别。
Method: 提出闭环 AutoML 流程：GPT-5、GPT-4o 和 Claude Sonnet 4 各自独立作为神经架构设计器，根据前一轮试验的准确率等性能反馈，迭代生成并精炼神经网络架构，覆盖从架构生成、训练、评估到反馈修正的完整回路。
Result: 在阿拉伯语、波斯语和英语手写数据集上的 270 次实验中，生成的模型平均测试准确率高于 93%，最优准确率 98.1%，推理延迟 41-44 毫秒，且无需人工架构设计、领域特定预处理或超参数调优。
Conclusion: 摘要认为大型语言模型可以充当有效的 AutoML 代理，支持可扩展、脚本自适应且可复现的跨语言手写识别；论文为会议短文，摘要未报告与基线方法的对比。

papers.title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models allow robots to predict the future consequences of candidate actions without additional physical interaction, supporting policy evaluation, planning, and data augmentation. We present Mask2Real-WM, a two-stage action-conditioned world model for dexterous manipulation that decouples pixel prediction into a dynamics model and a rendering model. The dynamics model predicts future segmentation masks from past masks and 23-DoF action sequences. The rendering model maps the predicted masks to photorealistic RGB using a ControlNet-augmented Stable Video Diffusion backbone. The smaller sim-to-real gap in segmentation space enables the dynamics model to benefit from large-scale pretraining on over 50 h of synthetic simulation data, followed by fine-tuning on fewer than 2.5 h of real demonstrations. Experiments on a dexterous pick-and-place benchmark show that mask conditioning and simulation pretraining are both required for per-DoF action controllability across all 23 degrees of freedom. In contrast, monolithic baselines capture broad hand and end-effector trajectories but do not reliably reflect fine-grained, per-joint action effects.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 24 figures, 4 tables. Preprint. Project page: https://srl-ethz.github.io/Mask2Real-WM/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mask2Real-WM，一个用于灵巧操作的两阶段动作条件世界模型，将像素预测解耦为动力学模型和渲染模型。动力学模型从过去的掩膜和 23-DoF 动作序列预测未来分割掩膜，渲染模型使用 ControlNet 增强的 Stable Video Diffusion 将预测掩膜映射为逼真 RGB。分割空间的 sim-to-real 差距较小，使动力学模型能在超过 50 小时合成模拟数据上预训练，并在少于 2.5 小时真实演示上微调。实验表明，掩膜条件与模拟预训练对全部 23 个自由度的逐自由度动作可控性都是必要的，而整体式基线只能捕捉整体轨迹。
Motivation: 灵巧操作中动作条件世界模型需要预测候选动作的未来后果，但现有整体式方法难以反映细粒度逐关节动作效果；分割空间具有更小的 sim-to-real 差距，可能缓解该问题。
Method: 采用两阶段架构：先由动力学模型从历史掩膜和 23-DoF 动作序列预测未来分割掩膜，再由 ControlNet 增强的 Stable Video Diffusion 渲染模型将预测掩膜转为逼真 RGB；动力学模型先在超过 50 小时的合成模拟数据上预训练，再在少于 2.5 小时的真实演示上微调。
Result: 在灵巧抓取放置基准上，掩膜条件和模拟预训练均为实现所有 23 个自由度的逐自由度动作可控性所必需；整体式基线仅能捕捉宽泛的手部和末端执行器轨迹，无法可靠反映细粒度逐关节动作效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将像素预测解耦为分割空间中的动力学模型与渲染模型，并结合合成模拟预训练，可以提升灵巧操作的细粒度动作可控性。

papers.title: Demystifying Training-Time Augmentation for Data-Constrained Language Model Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: As AI labs approach a data ceiling where compute capacity outpaces the rate of new high-quality text generation, language model pretraining is shifting toward a data-constrained, compute-abundant regime that demands productive multi-epoch training on fixed corpora. Standard autoregressive (AR) pretraining overfits severely in this setting, reaching its optimum early and then continuously deteriorating. We investigate training-time data augmentation as a regularizer to mitigate this overfitting and enable productive training for hundreds of epochs on the same data. We introduce three orthogonal categories of augmentation for AR pretraining: token-level noise (masking, random replacement), sequence permutations (right-to-left prediction, Fill-in-the-Middle), and target offset prediction ($x_{t+i}$ for $i > 1$). Through systematic ablations, we find that individual augmentations delay overfitting and lower validation loss relative to the baseline, with random token replacement achieving the best minimum loss among individual methods. Combining augmentation categories further lowers the minimum validation loss. Our experiments demonstrate that data augmentations mitigate AR pretraining's data inefficiency and offer a promising solution to the data-constrained regime~\footnote{All code and data are available at https://github.com/ michaelchen-lab/ data-augmentations-for-pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数据受限条件下的语言模型预训练中，训练时数据增强 (training-time data augmentation) 作为正则化手段，以缓解标准自回归 (AR) 预训练在固定语料上训练数百个 epoch 时出现的严重过拟合。作者提出三类正交增强：token 级噪声（掩码、随机替换）、序列置换（从右到左预测、Fill-in-the-Middle）以及目标偏移预测 ($x_{t+i}$ for $i>1$)。系统消融表明，单个增强能推迟过拟合并降低验证损失，组合不同类别增强可进一步降低最小验证损失。
Motivation: AI 实验室接近数据天花板，算力增速超过新高质量文本生成速率，预训练正转向数据受限而算力充裕的 regime，需要在固定语料上进行高效多 epoch 训练；标准自回归预训练在此设定下严重过拟合，先达到最优性能后持续恶化。
Method: 提出三类正交的训练时数据增强策略用于自回归预训练：token 级噪声（掩码、随机替换）、序列置换（right-to-left prediction、Fill-in-the-Middle）以及目标偏移预测 (target offset prediction，即预测 $x_{t+i}$, $i>1$)，并通过系统消融实验评估各方法与组合的效果。
Result: 摘要报告称，单个增强方法相对基线能推迟过拟合并降低验证损失，其中随机 token 替换 (random token replacement) 在单方法中取得最低最小损失；将不同增强类别组合可以进一步降低最小验证损失。
Conclusion: 摘要认为数据增强能够缓解自回归预训练的数据低效性，为数据受限的预训练 regime 提供了有前景的解决方案；代码和数据已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: REST3D: Reconstructing Physically Stable 3D Scenes from a Single Image
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing physically stable 3D scenes from a single RGB image enables casual images to be converted into simulation-ready digital assets for applications such as immersive interaction and content creation. However, existing single-image reconstruction methods fall short in capturing the physical structure of a scene. As a result, they often produce geometrically plausible but physically inconsistent results, including object floating and penetration, which lead to unstable behavior in physics simulations. Image-conditioned scene generation methods improve physical plausibility but often rely on strong scene priors, yielding plausible yet inaccurate object arrangements that fail to match the input image. We propose REST3D, a single-image reconstruction framework that can reconstruct physically stable 3D scenes by integrating physical scene understanding with physics-constrained refinement. We first introduce an agentic physical scene understanding technique that constructs a scene-tree representation capturing object physical states and inter-object relationships from a gravity-support perspective, providing a structural prior for reconstruction. Leveraging this structure, we initialize the scene using image-to-3D models, followed by scene-tree-guided alignment and physics-constrained optimization to resolve physical violations while preserving visual consistency with the input image. Experiments show that our method significantly reduces physical errors and improves simulation stability on both synthetic and real-world datasets while maintaining strong reconstruction quality. We further demonstrate the reconstructed scenes in VR-based human-object interaction, showing their potential for immersive applications.

TL;DR: 本文提出 REST3D，一个从单张 RGB 图像重建物理稳定 3D 场景的框架，将物理场景理解与物理约束优化相结合。方法先从重力支撑 (gravity-support) 视角构建场景树 (scene-tree) 表示，刻画物体物理状态与物体间关系，再借助 image-to-3D 模型初始化场景，并通过场景树引导的对齐与物理约束优化消除悬浮、穿透等物理违例。实验在合成与真实数据集上显著降低物理误差并提升仿真稳定性，同时保持重建质量，并在 VR 人-物交互场景中展示应用潜力。
Motivation: 现有单图像重建方法能生成几何上合理的结果，但常忽略场景的物理结构，产生物体悬浮与穿透等物理不一致，导致物理仿真不稳定；而图像条件下的场景生成方法虽改善物理合理性，却依赖较强的场景先验，结果可能无法匹配输入图像。
Method: 先提出一种代理式 (agentic) 物理场景理解技术，从重力支撑视角构建场景树表示，提供重建的结构先验；随后利用该结构以 image-to-3D 模型初始化场景，再进行场景树引导的对齐和物理约束优化，在保持与输入图像视觉一致性的同时消除物理违例。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在合成与真实数据集上显著减少物理错误并提高仿真稳定性，同时保持较强的重建质量；还通过基于 VR 的人-物交互演示了其在沉浸式应用中的潜力。
Conclusion: 作者认为将显式物理理解融入单图像重建可以获得仿真就绪的数字资产，为沉浸式交互等内容创作提供支撑；摘要未讨论超出单图像与物理约束优化范围的具体局限性。

papers.title: EgoMemReason: A Memory-Driven Reasoning Benchmark for Long-Horizon Egocentric Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Next-generation visual assistants, such as smart glasses, embodied agents, and always-on life-logging systems, must reason over an entire day or more of continuous visual experience. In ultra-long videos, relevant information is sparsely distributed across hours or days, making memory a fundamental challenge: models must accumulate information over time, recall prior states, track temporal order, and abstract recurring patterns. However, existing week-long video benchmarks are primarily designed for perception and recognition, such as moment localization or global summarization, rather than reasoning that requires integrating evidence across multiple days. To address this gap, we introduce EgoMemReason, a comprehensive benchmark for week-long egocentric video understanding through memory-driven reasoning. EgoMemReason evaluates three complementary memory types: entity memory, tracking how object states evolve and change across days; event memory, recalling and ordering activities separated by hours or days; and behavior memory, abstracting recurring patterns from sparse, repeated observations over the whole week period. EgoMemReason comprises 500 questions across three memory types and six core challenges, with an average of 5.1 video segments of evidence per question and 25.9 hours of memory backtracking. We evaluate EgoMemReason on 17 methods across MLLMs and agentic frameworks, revealing that even the best model achieves only 39.6% overall accuracy. Further analysis shows that the three memory types fail for distinct reasons and that performance degrades as evidence spans longer temporal horizons, revealing that long-horizon memory remains far from solved. We believe EgoMemReason establishes a strong foundation for evaluating and advancing long-context, memory-aware multimodal systems.
papers.comment: Accepted by COLM2026. The first two authors contributed equally. Project website: https://egomemreason.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoMemReason，一个面向周级第一人称（egocentric）视频理解的内存驱动推理基准。该基准评估三类互补记忆：实体记忆、事件记忆和行为记忆，包含 500 个问题，平均每个问题需整合 5.1 个视频片段证据，并涉及 25.9 小时的记忆回溯。作者在 17 个方法（涵盖多模态大模型与 agentic 框架）上评估，发现最佳模型准确率仅为 39.6%，说明长时记忆推理仍远未解决。
Motivation: 现有周级视频基准主要面向感知与识别任务（如时刻定位或全局摘要），缺乏需要跨多天整合证据的推理能力。而下一代视觉助手必须对连续数日的视觉经验进行记忆驱动的推理，因此需要专门针对这一能力缺口设计基准。
Method: 提出 EgoMemReason 基准，围绕实体记忆（追踪对象状态跨天演变）、事件记忆（回忆并排序相隔数小时或数天的活动）和行为记忆（从一周内稀疏重复观察中抽象规律）三个维度构建，覆盖六个核心挑战，并为每个问题提供平均 5.1 个视频片段作为证据。
Result: 在 17 种方法（包括 MLLMs 和 agentic 框架）上的评估显示，最佳模型总体准确率仅 39.6%。进一步分析表明，三类记忆各自的失败原因不同，且当证据时间跨度变长时性能明显下降，说明长时记忆能力尚未得到解决。
Conclusion: 作者认为 EgoMemReason 为评估和推进长上下文、记忆感知的多模态系统建立了基础，并强调长时记忆推理仍然是开放难题。

papers.title: When Audio-Language Models Fail to Leverage Multimodal Context for Dysarthric Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems remain brittle on dysarthric and other atypical speech. Recent audio-language models raise the possibility of improving performance by conditioning on additional clinical context at inference time, but it is unclear whether these models can make use of such information. We introduce a benchmark built on the Speech Accessibility Project (SAP) dataset that tests whether diagnosis labels, clinician-derived speech ratings, and progressively richer clinical descriptions improve transcription accuracy for dysarthric speech. Across matched comparisons on nine models, we find that current models do not meaningfully use this context: diagnosis-informed and clinically detailed prompts yield negligible improvements and often degrade word error rate. We complement the prompting analysis with context-dependent fine-tuning, showing that LoRA adaptation with a mixture of clinical prompt formats achieves a WER of 0.066, a 52% relative reduction over the frozen baseline, while preserving performance when context is unavailable. Subgroup analyses reveal significant gains for Down syndrome and mild-severity speakers. These results clarify where current models fall short and provide a testbed for measuring progress toward more inclusive ASR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究音频语言模型（audio-language model）在构音障碍语音识别中能否利用多模态临床上下文。作者基于 Speech Accessibility Project (SAP) 数据集构建基准，测试诊断标签、临床语音评分和逐步丰富的临床描述对转录准确率的影响；在九个模型的匹配对比中发现当前模型并未有效利用这些上下文，诊断提示常使词错误率劣化。随后采用上下文相关的 LoRA 微调，在混合临床提示格式下将 WER 降至 0.066，较冻结基线相对降低 52%，并保留无上下文时的性能；亚组分析显示对唐氏综合征和轻度构音障碍说话人收益显著。
Motivation: 构音障碍等非典型语音的 ASR 仍脆弱；音频语言模型有望在推理时通过附加临床上下文改善性能，但尚不清楚现有模型能否真正利用这类信息。
Method: 作者提出一个基于 SAP 数据集的基准，系统比较诊断标签、临床语音评分和逐渐详细的临床描述三类提示对九个模型的影响；并补充上下文相关的 LoRA 微调，使用混合临床提示格式进行适应。
Result: 匹配对比显示当前模型几乎不利用临床上下文，诊断提示和详细临床描述仅带来可忽略的提升甚至增加词错误率；LoRA 微调混合临床提示后达到 WER 0.066，比冻结基线相对降低 52%，且无上下文时性能保持。亚组分析表明唐氏综合征和轻度严重度说话人获得显著改善。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果明确了当前模型在利用多模态上下文方面的不足，并提供了一个衡量更包容 ASR 进展的测试基准。
Relevance: 0
