papers.title: Foveated Reasoning: Stateful, Action-based Visual Focusing for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models benefit from high-resolution images, but the increase in visual-token count incurs high compute overhead. Humans resolve this tension via foveation: a coarse view guides "where to look", while selectively acquired high-acuity evidence refines "what to think". We introduce Foveated Reasoner, an autoregressive vision-language framework that unifies foveation and reasoning within a single decoding trajectory. Starting from a low-resolution view, the model triggers foveation only when needed, retrieves high-resolution evidence from selected regions, and injects it back into the same decoding trajectory. We train the method with a two-stage pipeline: coldstart supervision to bootstrap foveation behavior, followed by reinforcement learning to jointly improve evidence acquisition and task accuracy while discouraging trivial "see-everything" solutions. Experiments show that the method learns effective foveation policies and achieves stronger accuracy under tight visual-token budgets across multiple vision-language benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Foveated Reasoner，一种自回归视觉-语言框架，将中央凹视觉 (foveation) 与推理统一在同一条解码轨迹中。模型从低分辨率视图出发，仅在需要时触发 foveation，从选定区域获取高分辨率证据并注入同一条解码轨迹。训练采用两阶段流程：先用冷启动监督 (coldstart supervision) 引导 foveation 行为，再用强化学习联合优化证据获取与任务准确率，同时抑制“看遍一切”的平凡解。实验表明该方法在多个视觉-语言基准上、严格的视觉 token 预算下取得更强的准确率。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型受益于高分辨率图像，但视觉 token 数量的增加带来高昂的计算开销。人类通过 foveation 解决这一矛盾：粗略视图引导“看哪里”，选择性获取的高精度证据细化“想什么”，本文旨在将这一机制引入 VLM。
Method: 提出 Foveated Reasoner，一种在单条解码轨迹中统一 foveation 与推理的自回归框架。训练采用两阶段流程：冷启动监督以引导 foveation 行为，随后使用强化学习联合改进证据获取与任务准确率，并避免退化为“看遍一切”的低效策略。
Result: 实验显示该方法能学习有效的 foveation 策略，并在多个视觉-语言基准上、严格的视觉 token 预算下取得更强的准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为在单条解码轨迹中统一 foveation 与推理能够在不增加视觉 token 预算的前提下提升准确率，是一种有效的 VLM 高效推理方向。

papers.title: A Framework and Prototype for a Navigable Map of Datasets in Engineering Design and Systems Engineering
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of data across the system lifecycle presents both a significant opportunity and a challenge for Engineering Design and Systems Engineering (EDSE). While this "digital thread" has the potential to drive innovation, the fragmented and inaccessible nature of existing datasets hinders method validation, limits reproducibility, and slows research progress. Unlike fields such as computer vision and natural language processing, which benefit from established benchmark ecosystems, engineering design research often relies on small, proprietary, or ad-hoc datasets. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing a systematic framework for a "Map of Datasets in EDSE." The framework is built upon a multi-dimensional taxonomy designed to classify engineering datasets by domain, lifecycle stage, data type, and format, enabling faceted discovery. An architecture for an interactive discovery tool is detailed and demonstrated through a working prototype, employing a knowledge graph data model to capture rich semantic relationships between datasets, tools, and publications. An analysis of the current data landscape reveals underrepresented areas ("data deserts") in early-stage design and system architecture, as well as relatively well-represented areas ("data oases") in predictive maintenance and autonomous systems. The paper identifies key challenges in curation and sustainability and proposes mitigation strategies, laying the groundwork for a dynamic, community-driven resource to accelerate data-centric engineering research.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, Accepted for ASME IDETC 2026-DAC-04-03
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工程设计及系统工程（EDSE）领域数据集碎片化、难以获取的问题，提出一个面向数据集导航的框架和原型工具。该框架基于多维分类法，借助知识图谱数据模型构建交互式发现工具，并分析当前数据版图，识别出早期设计与系统架构等数据稀缺区域以及预测性维护与自主系统等数据充足区域。
Motivation: EDSE 领域的数据虽在系统生命周期中大量涌现，但现有数据集往往小型、私有或临时拼凑，导致方法验证受阻、可复现性受限、研究进展缓慢；与计算机视觉和自然语言处理拥有成熟基准生态不同，该领域缺乏系统化的数据集基础设施。
Method: 提出一个用于 EDSE 数据集编目与导航的系统性框架，核心是多维分类法（按领域、生命周期阶段、数据类型和格式分类）以实现分面发现；同时设计并实现一个交互式发现工具原型，采用知识图谱（knowledge graph）数据模型来刻画数据集、工具与文献之间的语义关系。
Result: 对当前数据版图的分析显示，早期设计和系统架构等领域存在代表性不足的数据荒漠（data deserts），而预测性维护和自主系统等领域则拥有相对充足的数据绿洲（data oases）。
Conclusion: 作者指出数据策展与可持续性方面的关键挑战并提出缓解策略，期望为社区驱动的动态数据资源奠定基础，以加速数据驱动的工程研究。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对工程设计及系统工程（EDSE）领域数据集碎片化、难以获取的问题，提出一个面向数据集导航的框架和原型工具。该框架基于多维分类法，借助知识图谱数据模型构建交互式发现工具，并分析当前数据版图，识别出早期设计与系统架构等数据稀缺区域以及预测性维护与自主系统等数据充足区域。
summary_sections.motivation: EDSE 领域的数据虽在系统生命周期中大量涌现，但现有数据集往往小型、私有或临时拼凑，导致方法验证受阻、可复现性受限、研究进展缓慢；与计算机视觉和自然语言处理拥有成熟基准生态不同，该领域缺乏系统化的数据集基础设施。

papers.title: Bayesian Empirical Bayes: Simultaneous Inference from Probabilistic Symmetries
papers.abstract_en: Empirical Bayes (EB) improves the accuracy of simultaneous inference "by learning from the experience of others" (Efron, 2012). Classical EB theory focuses on latent variables that are iid draws from a fitted prior (Efron, 2019). Modern applications, however, feature complex structure, like arrays, spatial processes, or covariates. We propose a generalized approach to empirical Bayes based on probabilistic symmetry. Our method pairs a simultaneous inference problem with an unknown prior to a symmetry assumption on the joint distribution of the latent variables. Each symmetry implies an ergodic decomposition, which we use to derive a corresponding empirical Bayes method. We call this method Bayesian empirical Bayes (BEB). BEB recovers classical empirical Bayes methods, which implicitly assume exchangeability. We extend EB to other probabilistic symmetries: (i) EB matrix recovery for arrays and graphs; (ii) covariate-informed EB for conditional data; and (iii) EB spatial regression under shift invariance. We develop scalable algorithms based on variational inference and neural networks. In simulations, BEB outperforms existing denoising methods. On real data, we demonstrate BEB on cancer gene-expression and brain-connectivity matrices and NYC air-quality data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯经验贝叶斯（Bayesian empirical Bayes, BEB），将经典经验贝叶斯从潜在变量 iid 抽样的假设推广到一般的概率对称性（probabilistic symmetry）。作者利用每个对称性对应的遍历分解（ergodic decomposition）推导相应的经验贝叶斯方法，覆盖矩阵/图恢复、条件数据下的协变量信息经验贝叶斯以及平移不变空间回归，并基于变分推断和神经网络设计可扩展算法。模拟中 BEB 优于现有去噪方法，真实数据上应用于癌症基因表达、脑连接矩阵和纽约空气质量数据。
Motivation: 经典经验贝叶斯理论假设潜在变量是来自拟合先验的 iid 抽样，难以处理现代应用中数组、空间过程、协变量等复杂结构。作者希望用概率对称性框架统一经验贝叶斯，并将其扩展到更一般的联合推断问题。
Method: 将同时推断问题与未知先验配对为对潜在变量联合分布的一个对称性假设，每个对称性给出一个遍历分解，并据此构造对应的经验贝叶斯方法，即 BEB。论文将其扩展到三类对称性：数组和图上的矩阵恢复、条件数据下的协变量信息经验贝叶斯、以及平移不变下的空间回归，并使用变分推断和神经网络实现可扩展算法。
Result: 模拟实验中 BEB 优于现有去噪方法；在真实数据上，作者将其应用于癌症基因表达与脑连接矩阵，以及纽约空气质量数据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BEB 能够恢复隐含可交换性假设的经典经验贝叶斯方法，并将其推广到更复杂的概率对称性结构；论文并未涉及降水、临近预报或数据同化等气象应用。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Evaluating Music Context Preservation: A Multi-facet Framework for Music Editing Systems
papers.abstract_en: Music editing plays a vital role in modern music production, with applications in film, broadcasting, and game development. Recent advances in music editing systems have enabled diverse editing tasks such as timbre transfer, instrument substitution, and genre transformation. However, many existing works overlook evaluating their ability to preserve musical facets that should remain unchanged during editing, which we define as Music Context Preservation (MuseCP). While some studies do consider MuseCP, their evaluation protocols and metrics are not comprehensive. To address this, we introduce the first MuseCP evaluation framework, MuseCPEval, that covers four categories of music facets with fine-grained and well-tailored metrics to capture nuanced changes in music attributes. Objective validation and a human study demonstrate the effectiveness of these metrics. Moreover, the case studies on diverse music editing systems illustrate the practical utility of these metrics as a testbed and diagnostic tool, providing insights into the strengths and limitations of existing systems. We hope our metrics and findings can offer practical guidance for developing more effective and reliable music editing strategies with strong MuseCP capability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向音乐编辑系统的音乐上下文保持（Music Context Preservation, MuseCP）评估框架 MuseCPEval，覆盖四类音乐面貌（facets）并提供细粒度定制化指标，以捕捉编辑过程中音乐属性的细微变化。作者通过客观验证、人工研究以及针对多种音乐编辑系统的案例研究，展示该框架作为测试台和诊断工具的实用性，并为开发具备更强 MuseCP 能力的编辑策略提供指导。
Motivation: 现有音乐编辑系统（如音色迁移、乐器替换、风格转换）大多忽略了对编辑后应保持不变的音乐层面的评估；少数考虑该问题的研究，其评估协议和指标也不够全面。
Method: 提出 MuseCPEval 评估框架，定义四类音乐面貌并设计细粒度、针对性强的指标来量化编辑前后音乐上下文的保持程度，并通过客观验证和人工研究来确认指标有效性。
Result: 摘要报告客观验证与人工研究证明了指标的有效性；在多种音乐编辑系统上的案例研究揭示了现有系统的优势与局限，展示了框架作为测试台和诊断工具的实用价值。
Conclusion: 作者希望所提出的指标和发现能为开发更有效、可靠且具备强 MuseCP 能力的音乐编辑策略提供实际指导。

papers.title: Professional Software Developers Don't Vibe, They Control: AI Agent Use for Coding in 2025
papers.abstract_en: The rise of AI agents is transforming how software can be built. The promise of agents is that developers might write code quicker, delegate multiple tasks to different agents, and even write a full piece of software purely out of natural language. In reality, what roles agents play in professional software development remains in question. This paper investigates how experienced developers use agents in building software, including their motivations, strategies, task suitability, and sentiments. Through field observations (N=13) and qualitative surveys (N=99), we find that while experienced developers value agents as a productivity boost, they retain their agency in software design and implementation out of insistence on fundamental software quality attributes, employing strategies for controlling agent behavior leveraging their expertise. In addition, experienced developers enjoy working with agents as source of collaboration rather than complete delegation given their judgment for task suitability. Our results shed light on the value of software development best practices in effective use of agents, suggest the kinds of tasks for which agents may be suitable, and point towards future opportunities for better agentic interfaces and agentic use guidelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实地观察（N=13）和定性调查（N=99）研究经验丰富的软件开发者如何在2025年使用AI agent进行编码，关注其动机、策略、任务适配性和情感态度。研究发现，开发者虽然将agent视为生产力提升工具，但出于对软件质量属性的坚持，会在软件设计与实现中保留自身能动性，并利用专业知识采取策略来控制agent行为；他们更倾向于与agent协作而非完全委托。
Motivation: AI agent被寄望于让开发者更快编写代码、委派多任务甚至仅用自然语言构建完整软件，但agent在专业软件开发中实际扮演的角色仍不明确，需要实证研究加以厘清。
Method: 采用混合定性研究方法：对13名开发者进行现场观察（field observations），并对99名开发者进行定性调查（qualitative surveys），分析其使用agent的动机、策略、任务适合性判断与情感态度。
Result: 经验丰富的开发者认可agent带来的生产力提升，但不会完全放权；他们会基于软件质量属性保留设计决策权，并通过自身的领域专长采取策略以控制agent行为，同时依据任务适合性判断选择与agent协作而非完全委托。
Conclusion: 研究凸显了软件工程最佳实践在有效使用agent中的价值，指出了适合agent的任务类型，并为未来更优的agentic接口和使用指南提供了方向。

papers.title: Foundations of Diffusion Models in General State Spaces: A Self-Contained Introduction
papers.abstract_en: Although diffusion models now occupy a central place in generative modeling, introductory treatments commonly assume Euclidean data and seldom clarify their connection to discrete-state analogues. This article is a self-contained primer on diffusion over general state spaces, unifying continuous domains and discrete/categorical structures under one lens. We develop the discrete-time view (forward noising via Markov kernels and learned reverse dynamics) alongside its continuous-time limits -- stochastic differential equations (SDEs) in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and continuous-time Markov chains (CTMCs) on finite alphabets -- and derive the associated Fokker--Planck and master equations. A common variational treatment yields the ELBO that underpins standard training losses. We make explicit how forward corruption choices -- Gaussian processes in continuous spaces and structured categorical transition kernels (uniform, masking/absorbing and more) in discrete spaces -- shape reverse dynamics and the ELBO. The presentation is layered for three audiences: newcomers seeking a self-contained intuitive introduction; diffusion practitioners wanting a global theoretical synthesis; and continuous-diffusion experts looking for an analogy-first path into discrete diffusion. The result is a unified roadmap to modern diffusion methodology across continuous domains and discrete sequences, highlighting a compact set of reusable proofs, identities, and core theoretical principles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇面向扩散模型基础理论的入门性综述文章，旨在统一连续空间与离散/分类状态空间下的扩散建模。作者从离散时间的马尔可夫核前向加噪与学习逆向动态出发，引入连续时间极限（欧氏空间中的SDE和有限字母表上的CTMC），并推导对应的Fokker-Planck方程、主方程以及基于变分法的ELBO训练目标。文章还专门讨论了前向损坏核（连续空间的高斯过程、离散空间的结构化分类转移核）如何影响逆向动态与ELBO，并按三类读者分层组织内容。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型入门材料通常假设数据位于欧氏空间，且很少阐明其与离散状态扩散之间的联系，导致离散扩散（如分类或序列数据）缺乏统一的理论视角。
Method: 采用自包含的数学叙述，统一处理离散时间视角（前向加噪与可学习逆向动态）和连续时间极限（SDE与CTMC），推导Fokker-Planck方程和主方程，并通过共同的变分处理得到支撑标准训练损失的ELBO；同时刻画连续空间中高斯过程与离散空间中均匀/掩码吸收等结构化转移核对逆向动态和ELBO的影响。
Result: 该文作为理论综述，没有报告实验基准；其成果是给出一个融合连续域与离散序列的现代扩散方法统一路线图，并提炼出一组可复用的证明、恒等式和核心理论原理。
Conclusion: 文章按新手、扩散实践者、连续扩散专家三类读者分层呈现，最终强调以类比优先的路径贯通离散扩散，为现代扩散方法提供统一的理论框架。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: On the Robustness of Vision-Language Models in Zero-shot Privacy Classification
papers.abstract_en: Automatic systems for document understanding require multimodal models that accurately identify sensitive visual content, even in the presence of image degradations. Instruction-following large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are expected to generalise across domains and tasks without requiring any specific adaptation. In this work, we systematically analyse whether VLMs can be used reliably for image privacy classification in a zero-shot setup. We evaluate and compare the classification performance of three open-source VLMs against purposely built models on two public, standard benchmarks. We assess robustness to image degradations caused by perturbations such as compression, light variations, and random noise, and analyse inference speed and parameter count to deploy VLMs in privacy-aware document processing pipelines. Our results show that large VLMs are robust to input perturbations but are less accurate (and much slower) than smaller privacy models. Scaling alone is not sufficient, highlighting the advantages of models specifically designed for privacy classification.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Paper accepted at the TrustDOC Workshop at ICPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了指令跟随型大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）在零样本图像隐私分类任务中的可靠性，比较三个开源 VLM 与专用隐私分类模型在两个公开基准上的表现，并考察压缩、光照变化和随机噪声等扰动下的鲁棒性，同时分析推理速度与参数量。结果表明大型 VLM 对输入扰动具有鲁棒性，但准确率低于且推理速度远慢于小规模专用隐私模型，单纯扩大模型规模并不足够。
Motivation: 自动文档理解系统需要多模态模型在图像退化情况下准确识别敏感视觉内容，而大型 VLM 被期望无需特定适配即可跨领域泛化；该工作旨在验证 VLM 能否在零样本设置下可靠用于图像隐私分类。
Method: 在零样本设置下比较三个开源 VLM 与专门构建的隐私分类模型，使用两个公开标准基准；评估对压缩、光照变化和随机噪声等图像扰动的鲁棒性，并分析推理速度与参数量以考察其在隐私感知文档处理流水线中的部署可行性。
Result: 实验结果显示大型 VLM 对输入扰动具有鲁棒性，但准确率低于小规模专用隐私模型，且推理速度明显更慢；仅靠模型规模扩展不足以弥补任务专用模型的优势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在零样本隐私分类场景中，专门为隐私分类设计的模型仍具优势，VLM 的规模扩展并非充分条件。

papers.title: Eyes on the Image: Gaze Supervised Multimodal Learning for Chest X-ray Diagnosis and Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models still struggle to match radiologists' attention and to verbalize findings with explicit spatial grounding. We address this gap with a two-stage multimodal framework for chest X-ray interpretation built on the MIMIC-Eye dataset. In the first stage introduces a gaze-token classifier that fuses image patches, bounding-box masks, transcription embeddings, and radiologist fixations. A curriculum-scheduled, trust-calibrated composite loss supervises the gaze token, boosting both accuracy and spatial alignment. Adding fixation supervision raises AUC 4.4% and F1 13.3%, and Pearson correlation rises to 0.306, confirming clinically relevant focus. In stage 2, classifier predictions are translated into region-specific diagnostic sentences. Confidence-weighted keywords are extracted, mapped to 17 thoracic regions through an expert dictionary, and expanded with a prompted large language model, boosting clinical-term BERTScore and ROUGE scores over keyword baselines. All components are toggle-able for ablation, and the full pipeline is reproducible, offering a new benchmark for interpretable, gaze-aware chest-X-ray analysis. Integrating eye-tracking signals demonstrably enhances both diagnostic accuracy and the transparency of generated reports.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 MIMIC-Eye 数据集的两阶段多模态框架，用于胸部 X 光诊断与报告生成。第一阶段引入 gaze-token 分类器，融合图像块、边界框掩码、转录嵌入与放射科医师注视数据，并用课程调度、信任校准的复合损失监督；加入注视监督后 AUC 提升 4.4%、F1 提升 13.3%，Pearson 相关系数达到 0.306。第二阶段将分类预测转化为区域特定的诊断句子，通过专家字典映射到 17 个胸部区域并用大语言模型扩展，提升临床术语 BERTScore 与 ROUGE 分数。全文组件均可切换用于消融，管线可复现。
Motivation: 医学视觉语言模型仍难以匹配放射科医师的注意力，且在口头描述发现时缺乏明确的空间定位（spatial grounding），导致诊断与报告的可解释性不足。
Method: 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段为 gaze-token 分类器，融合图像块、边界框掩码、转录嵌入和放射科医师注视（fixation）信号，使用课程调度（curriculum scheduling）和信任校准（trust-calibrated）的复合损失进行监督；第二阶段将分类预测转换为区域级诊断句子，提取置信度加权关键词，通过专家词典映射到 17 个胸部区域，并由提示的大语言模型（LLM）扩展生成。
Result: 摘要报告加入注视监督使 AUC 提升 4.4%、F1 提升 13.3%，Pearson 相关性升至 0.306，表明关注区域具有临床相关性；第二阶段在临床术语 BERTScore 和 ROUGE 上均优于关键词基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调集成眼动追踪信号能同时提升诊断准确性和生成报告的可解释性；框架所有组件可独立开关以支持消融，且管线可复现，为凝视感知的胸部 X 光分析提供了新基准。

papers.title: Seasonal false alarms in customer churn and decline early-warning systems: adjacent-window labels confound seasonality with decline, and a year-over-year correction
papers.abstract_en: Customer decline early-warning systems feed account-manager action lists, and every flagged account consumes intervention capacity. In a deployed business-to-business marketplace system, one action-list slot in three went to flags that dissolve under a seasonally aligned label. The standard target in non-contractual churn prediction compares an entity's next k months of activity with its trailing k months. The two windows cover different calendar months, so for seasonal entities the threshold-ratio construction confounds seasonality with decline, and the event rate depends on the label's anchor calendar month. We formalize the mechanism and measure it on three public panels and the production panel (the public arms pre-specified). Of the adjacent-window decay events, 37--69% on the public panels and 28--50% in production have no counterpart under a seasonally aligned definition. Pooling anchors, the standard remedy, balances the training mixture but corrects no individual label. Measured alternatives repair the curve only partially or change the detection horizon. Aligning the baseline to the same k calendar months one year prior -- advice practitioners already state, here formalized, measured, and costed -- flattens the curve at the source. With the classifier held fixed, production holdout ROC-AUC rises from 0.767 to 0.864 for decline (different targets; the gap closes on synthetic ground truth and a production hindsight referee). The served action list shrinks by a third, 119 to 79 accounts. The measured price is extra history, a blind spot to decline-then-stabilization, and a stricter cut under sustained growth.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 4 figures. Replication package included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究客户流失与衰退预警系统中相邻窗口标签造成的季节性误报。标准非契约流失预测把实体未来 k 个月与过去 k 个月活动作比较，两个窗口覆盖不同日历月，对季节性实体而言阈值比率构造会混淆季节性与衰退。作者在三个公开面板和一个生产面板上测量发现，37–69%（公开）与 28–50%（生产）的相邻窗口衰退事件在季节对齐定义下没有对应；将基线对齐到一年前相同 k 个日历月可在源头拉平曲线。
Motivation: 部署的 B2B 市场中每三个行动列表槽位就有一个是季节对齐标签下会消失的误报，浪费有限的干预容量。标准标签因锚定日历月不同而事件率不同，将季节性与真实衰退混淆。
Method: 作者形式化相邻窗口标签的误报机制，在三个公开面板和生产面板上量化其影响；比较池化锚点、若干替代测量方案，并提出将基线对齐到一年前相同的 k 个日历月（同月同比校正）作为修正方法。
Result: 公开面板 37–69%、生产 28–50% 的相邻窗口衰退事件在季节对齐定义下无对应；分类器固定时，生产 holdout 上的 ROC-AUC 从 0.767 升至 0.864（衰退，目标不同），行动列表规模从 119 缩至 79 个账户。
Conclusion: 同比校正能修复曲线但代价是需要额外历史、对衰退后稳定（decline-then-stabilization）存在盲区，并在持续增长下采取更严格的截断。作者认为这是对实践者既有建议的形式化、测量与成本核算。

papers.title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models have shown promising results on reasoning benchmarks, yet their potential for agentic tool use remains largely unexplored. We study this question in compositional tool-calling settings, where models must coordinate multiple API calls, maintain intermediate state, and preserve dependencies across tool interactions. We evaluate native and retrofitted looped language models on API-Bank, BFCL, and NESTful, comparing looped and non-looped models trained under matched supervised fine-tuning recipes and varying recurrent depth at inference time. In controlled experiments, recurrent computation generally benefits compositional and dependency-aware tool use, while providing smaller and more model-dependent gains on isolated API invocation. Accuracy on multi-step tool use generally increases with recurrent depth; adaptive inference, however, achieves a more favorable compute-performance trade-off by allocating additional computation only when needed. Our results suggest that looped language models are a promising architecture for agentic systems that require reliable planning, coordination, and execution of compositional tool use workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究循环语言模型（looped language models）在组合式工具调用（compositional tool calling）中的表现，评估对象包括 API-Bank、BFCL 和 NESTful。受控实验显示，循环计算通常有利于多步、依赖感知的工具使用，而对单次 API 调用的增益较小且更依赖模型；多步工具使用准确率一般随循环深度增加而提高，自适应推理（adaptive inference）能以更优的计算-性能权衡分配额外计算。
Motivation: 智能体式工具调用需要协调多个 API 调用、维护中间状态并保留跨工具交互的依赖关系，而循环语言模型在此类智能体场景中的潜力尚未被充分探索。
Method: 作者在匹配的有监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）设置下比较原生与改造的循环语言模型以及非循环基线，并在推理时改变循环深度，还考察了自适应推理策略。
Result: 循环计算对组合式、依赖感知的工具使用普遍有益，对孤立 API 调用收益较小；多步工具使用准确率通常随循环深度增加而提升，自适应推理通过仅在需要时分配额外计算实现了更有利的计算-性能权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为循环语言模型是构建需要可靠规划、协调并执行组合式工具使用工作流的智能体系统的一类有前景的架构。

papers.title: Adversarial Review: Structured Disagreement for Grounded Agentic Code Review
papers.abstract_en: Early multi-agent LLM systems often used role-separated teams, yet scaling agent count yields diminishing returns on repository-level coding tasks. Recent alternatives treat agents as passive tools (subagents), yet this removes the benefits of agent interaction entirely. We study whether a subagent paradigm can support a middle ground: minimal agentic cooperation without the overhead of large multi-agent teams. We introduce Adversarial Review (AR), a minimal cooperative code-review protocol in which a main coding agent works with a reviewer and a critic agent. The reviewer evaluates code, while the critic audits the review through structured disagreement before the main agent edits. On LiveCodeBench, AR achieves the highest pass rate among tested methods, outperforming a five-agent baseline while using only three agents. On SWE-PRBench, naive AR exposes a false-consensus failure mode, where agents converge on agreement without sufficient evidence, but a single prompt iteration that adds disagreement explicitly achieves the highest F1 among tested methods. On SWE-bench Verified, AR also shows improvements over the baselines on repository-level coding tasks. Together, AR demonstrates that cooperative code review does not require many agents or complex communication structures: it requires that disagreement be minimal, structured, and evidence-grounded.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop on DL4C
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Adversarial Review (AR)，一种最小化协作的代码评审协议：主编码智能体与评审者 (reviewer) 和批评者 (critic) 两个智能体协作，批评者通过结构化分歧 (structured disagreement) 审计评审后再由主智能体修改代码。在 LiveCodeBench、SWE-PRBench 与 SWE-bench Verified 上，AR 以更少的智能体取得优于多智能体基线的结果。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统在仓库级编码任务上随智能体数量增加收益递减，而将智能体当作被动工具的子代理 (subagent) 范式又完全丧失了智能体交互的收益。作者想探索子代理范式中是否存在中间地带：只需极少量智能体合作，避免大型多智能体团队的开销。
Method: 提出 AR 协议，包含主编码智能体、评审者与批评者三个角色；评审者对代码打分，批评者通过结构化分歧审计评审，之后主智能体再编辑代码。作者还提到在 SWE-PRBench 上通过单次 prompt 迭代显式加入分歧来改进朴素 AR。
Result: 在 LiveCodeBench 上，AR 在测试方法中达到最高通过率，仅用三个智能体就胜过五智能体基线；在 SWE-PRBench 上，朴素 AR 暴露出假共识 (false-consensus) 失败模式，而显式加入分歧的版本在测试方法中达到最高 F1；在 SWE-bench Verified 的仓库级编码任务上，AR 也比基线有所改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为合作式代码评审并不需要很多智能体或复杂的通信结构，关键是让分歧保持最小化、结构化并且基于证据。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Adversarial Review (AR)，一种最小化协作的代码评审协议：主编码智能体与评审者 (reviewer) 和批评者 (critic) 两个智能体协作，批评者通过结构化分歧 (structured disagreement) 审计评审后再由主智能体修改代码。在 LiveCodeBench、SWE-PRBench 与 SWE-bench Verified 上，AR 以更少的智能体取得优于多智能体基线的结果。

summary_sections.method: 提出 AR 协议，包含主编码智能体、评审者与批评者三个角色；评审者对代码打分，批评者通过结构化分歧审计评审，之后主智能体再编辑代码。作者还提到在 SWE-PRBench 上通过单次 prompt 迭代显式加入分歧来改进朴素 AR。
summary_sections.result: 在 LiveCodeBench 上，AR 在测试方法中达到最高通过率，仅用三个智能体就胜过五智能体基线；在 SWE-PRBench 上，朴素 AR 暴露出假共识 (false-consensus) 失败模式，而显式加入分歧的版本在测试方法中达到最高 F1；在 SWE-bench Verified 的仓库级编码任务上，AR 也比基线有所改进。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为合作式代码评审并不需要很多智能体或复杂的通信结构，关键是让分歧保持最小化、结构化并且基于证据。

papers.title: TractoGraphVLM: A Unified Vision-Language Framework for White Matter Tractography
papers.abstract_en: Vision language models have transformed 2D medical imaging, yet extending them to 3D white matter tractography remains challenging due to the complex topology of fiber bundles. We introduce TractoGraphVLM, a unified framework for four tasks, bundle classification, text-to-tract retrieval, anatomical captioning, and visual question answering, built on a shared GPS architecture, training procedure, and read-out design. Fiber bundles are represented as streamline graphs whose nodes encode 3D position and tangent orientation. A General, Powerful, Scalable (GPS) graph transformer produces bundle embeddings aligned with a frozen BiomedBERT text encoder via contrastive learning, while a BioGPT decoder with visual prefix tokens generates captions and answers. A single shared encoder and decoder is trained jointly across all four tasks and evaluated from one checkpoint. Trained on HCP Young Adult subjects, TractoGraphVLM achieves 91.8% bundle classification accuracy, 84.7% retrieval R@1, BLEU-4=20.1, ROUGE-L=66.8, and 66.4% VQA accuracy on a held-out test set. The same checkpoints transfer zero-shot to HCP Aging subjects, with a modest drop on discriminative tasks and a larger drop on generative tasks, showing robustness to age and acquisition shift. Language supervision yields richer representations than label-only training, recovering structure like hemisphere and fiber family, carried by captions but never given as a label. Swapping only the visual encoder, graphs preserving fiber orientation outperform volumetric baselines, with GPS giving the best balance. Generative metrics measure consistency with a structured knowledge base rather than independent clinical text; even so, TractoGraphVLM shows that classifying, retrieving, describing, and answering questions about a white matter bundle can be served by one jointly trained model that learns transferable neuroanatomy from language alone.
papers.comment: Accepted as a Spotlight at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Artificial Intelligence for Medical 3D Vision (AI4M3D). Our codebase, including all training and evaluation pipelines, is publicly available at https://github.com/AS-Lab/Marthi-et-al-2026-TractoGraphVLM-Unified-Vision-Language-White-Matter-Tractography
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TractoGraphVLM，一个面向 3D 白质纤维束的统一直觉-语言框架，同时处理纤维束分类、文本到纤维束检索、解剖学描述和视觉问答四项任务。纤维束被表示为流线图，节点编码 3D 位置与切向方向，GPS 图 Transformer 通过对比学习与冻结的 BiomedBERT 对齐，并由带视觉前缀 token 的 BioGPT 解码器生成文本。在 HCP Young Adult 上训练后，该模型在留出测试集上取得 91.8% 分类准确率、84.7% 检索 R@1、BLEU-4=20.1、ROUGE-L=66.8 和 66.4% VQA 准确率，并能零样本迁移到 HCP Aging。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型已在 2D 医学影像中取得进展，但扩展到 3D 白质纤维束追踪仍具挑战，主要因为纤维束拓扑结构复杂。本文旨在填补这一空白，用统一框架同时支持判别与生成任务。
Method: 将纤维束表示为流线图，节点编码 3D 位置和切向方向；使用 General, Powerful, Scalable (GPS) 图 Transformer 生成束嵌入，并通过对比学习与冻结的 BiomedBERT 文本编码器对齐。BioGPT 解码器配合视觉前缀 token 生成描述和答案；四个任务共享同一编码器与解码器，从单个检查点联合训练并评估。
Result: 在留出测试集上，纤维束分类准确率为 91.8%，检索 R@1 为 84.7%，BLEU-4=20.1，ROUGE-L=66.8，VQA 准确率为 66.4%。相同检查点零样本迁移到 HCP Aging 时，判别任务下降较小、生成任务下降较大。语言监督比仅标签训练产生更丰富的表征，能恢复半球和纤维家族等从未作为标签给出的结构；只更换视觉编码器时，保留纤维方向的图表示优于体素基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为，分类、检索、描述和回答问题这四种纤维束任务可以由一个联合训练的模型统一完成，并能仅从语言中学习可迁移的神经解剖学知识。摘要也指出生成指标衡量的是与结构化知识库的一致性，而非独立临床文本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RDFdL: Integrating RDF with Differential Dynamic Logic
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs modeled in RDF are powerful for describing static knowledge, but they cannot capture or reason about the dynamic behavior of physical systems, e.g., systems described by differential equations, which is a critical gap for AI-driven cyber-physical systems. To solve this, we propose RDFdL, a framework that integrates RDF with Differential Dynamic Logic (dL) to represent and reason about both static knowledge and the continuous dynamics of physical systems. For the dynamic part, we syntactically represent differential equations and ranges in the state space in RDF and SHACL and provide semantics using a translation to dL. Linking RDF and dL through their shared foundation in first-order logic achieves a unique integration: verification results for safety and reachability properties in the dynamic logic domain become available as entailment to SPARQL queries over RDF data. We implement the pipeline using Apache Jena for ontology-driven RDF reasoning and KeYmaera X, the theorem prover for dL, and sketch its applicability in manufacturing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RDFdL 框架，将 RDF 知识图谱与微分动态逻辑 (dL) 集成，用于同时表示和推理静态知识与物理系统的连续动力学。作者通过一阶逻辑这一共同基础把 RDF 与 dL 联系起来，使 dL 中的安全性和可达性验证结果可转化为对 RDF 数据的 SPARQL 查询蕴含。实现采用 Apache Jena 进行 RDF 推理、用 KeYmaera X 作为 dL 定理证明器，并在制造业场景中示意其应用。
Motivation: RDF 知识图谱只能刻画静态知识，无法表达或推理由微分方程描述的物理系统动态行为，这对 AI 驱动的信息物理系统 (cyber-physical systems) 构成关键缺口。
Method: 提出 RDFdL 框架：在动态部分，将微分方程和状态空间范围以 RDF 和 SHACL 语法表示，并通过到 dL 的翻译给出语义；利用 RDF 与 dL 共享的一阶逻辑基础，使动态逻辑域中的验证结果以 SPARQL 查询蕴含的形式开放给 RDF 数据使用。
Result: 摘要描述了完整的实现管线：用 Apache Jena 做本体驱动的 RDF 推理，用 KeYmaera X 作为 dL 定理证明器，并以制造业应用为例说明其可行性；未给出定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RDFdL 实现了静态知识与连续动态的统一表示和推理，且验证结果可通过 SPARQL 访问；其适用范围以制造业为例，属于概念与框架层面的工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Whole-Piece Training for Symbolic Music Language Models via Full-Horizon Compressed Recurrence
papers.abstract_en: For computational efficiency, modern language models are typically trained on independently sampled fixed-length sequences. Symbolic music language models largely inherit this paradigm, despite musical structure naturally unfolding over complete compositions rather than isolated excerpts. Fragmenting compositions into independent training instances therefore prevents continuous conditioning over the complete work. We present a practical framework for whole-piece training of symbolic music language models via Full-Horizon Compressed Recurrence (FHCR). FHCR preserves the full temporal horizon of recurrent memory while reducing the dimensionality of its key-value (KV) representation, making continuous whole-piece training practical under limited GPU memory. To directly assess functional long-range dependence, we introduce KV-Reset Context Utilization (KRCU), an evaluation-time diagnostic. On the MAESTRO symbolic piano dataset, KRCU shows that full-horizon models utilize context far beyond the local segment window, whereas reducing the temporal extent of recurrent memory substantially weakens this measurable long-range dependence. FHCR preserves long-range context utilization while substantially reducing recurrent memory cost. These findings show that preserving the temporal extent of recurrent history is important for efficient whole-piece modeling, and that memory cost can instead be reduced through KV representation compression. The project demos and generated music samples are available at https://wholemusic.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向符号音乐语言模型，提出全曲训练框架 Full-Horizon Compressed Recurrence (FHCR)：在保留循环记忆完整时间跨度的前提下压缩其 KV 表示维度，使整曲连续训练在有限 GPU 内存下可行。作者还引入 KV-Reset Context Utilization (KRCU) 作为评估期诊断工具。在 MAESTRO 符号钢琴数据集上，KRCU 显示全水平模型能利用远超局部片段窗口的上下文，而缩短循环记忆的时间范围会显著削弱这种长程依赖。
Motivation: 现代语言模型通常以独立采样的固定长度序列训练，符号音乐模型也沿用此范式，但音乐结构在完整作品中展开，将作品切分为独立训练实例会阻断对完整作品的连续条件化。
Method: 提出 FHCR 框架，通过压缩循环记忆的键值 (KV) 表示维度来降低内存开销，同时保留完整时间水平 (full temporal horizon) 的循环记忆；并设计 KRCU 作为评估时诊断，直接度量模型对超出局部窗口上下文的功能性长程依赖。
Result: 在 MAESTRO 符号钢琴数据集上，KRCU 显示全水平模型利用上下文远超局部片段窗口；缩短循环记忆的时间范围会显著削弱可测的长程依赖，而 FHCR 在保持长程上下文利用的同时大幅降低循环记忆成本。
Conclusion: 作者认为保留循环历史的时间跨度对高效全曲建模至关重要，内存成本应通过与时间范围解耦的 KV 表示压缩来降低。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Are LLMs Safe Beyond Text: Do Emojis Expose Gaps in Safety Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Safety evaluations of large language models (LLMs) predominantly rely on text-based adversarial prompts, potentially overlooking vulnerabilities arising from alternative input representations. This work examines emoji-augmented prompts as a test case for this gap, evaluating 50 prompts across four open-source LLMs (Mistral 7B, Qwen 2 7B, Gemma 2 9B, Llama 3 8B). Results show substantial variation in robustness: Gemma 2 9B and Mistral 7B exhibit non-zero success rates (10%), Llama 3 8B 6%, while Qwen 2 7B shows complete resistance (0% success rate). A chi-square test ($χ^2 = 32.94, p < 0.001$) confirms significant differences in outcome distributions. These findings indicate that robustness is sensitive to input representation, and that evaluations restricted to standard text prompts may underrepresent model vulnerabilities.
papers.comment: 3 pages. Accepted at ACL 2026 Workshop on Evaluation in Practice: Methodological Rigor, Sociotechnical Perspectives, & Community Collaboration (EvalEval)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）安全评估主要依赖文本对抗性提示、可能忽略其他输入表示这一缺口，以表情符号增强的提示（emoji-augmented prompts）作为测试用例，在四个开源模型（Mistral 7B、Qwen 2 7B、Gemma 2 9B、Llama 3 8B）上评估了50条提示。结果显示鲁棒性差异显著：Gemma 2 9B 和 Mistral 7B 的非零成功率为10%，Llama 3 8B 为6%，而 Qwen 2 7B 完全抵抗（0%）；卡方检验（χ² = 32.94，p < 0.001）确认结果分布存在显著差异。作者由此指出，模型鲁棒性对输入表示敏感，仅用标准文本提示的评估可能低估模型漏洞。
Motivation: 现有LLM安全评估几乎完全依赖标准文本形式的对抗性提示，可能遗漏由替代输入表示（如表情符号）引发的安全漏洞，导致评估覆盖不全面。
Method: 该工作将表情符号增强的提示作为测试案例，构建50条提示，在四个开源LLM上比较其安全评估结果，并使用卡方检验（chi-square test）分析不同模型间结果分布的统计显著性。
Result: 摘要报告：Gemma 2 9B 和 Mistral 7B 的成功率达到10%，Llama 3 8B 为6%，Qwen 2 7B 为0%；卡方统计量 χ² = 32.94，p < 0.001，表明不同模型对表情符号增强提示的响应分布存在显著差异。
Conclusion: 作者认为模型鲁棒性对输入表示敏感，局限于标准文本提示的安全评估可能会低估模型的真实漏洞，提示未来评估需要纳入更多样的输入表示。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为模型鲁棒性对输入表示敏感，局限于标准文本提示的安全评估可能会低估模型的真实漏洞，提示未来评估需要纳入更多样的输入表示。

papers.title: MV2: Multi-View Multi-Vehicle Driving Dataset for Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable rendering has advanced novel view synthesis (NVS), yet applying it to real-world driving remains difficult due to sparse capture viewpoints, dynamic objects, and limited multi-trajectory data. We introduce the Multi-View Multi-Vehicle (MV2) dataset and benchmark for evaluating NVS models under large viewpoint changes in dynamic urban scenes. MV2 features synchronized captures from a car, scooter, and drone, each following distinct yet synchronized trajectories. Training NVS methods on one vehicle's camera stream and testing on another enables evaluation under substantially larger viewpoint variations than existing single-trajectory datasets. All sequences are registered via Structure-from-Motion and camera poses verified using manual pixel-level correspondence annotations, yielding 50 high-quality scenes with 12000 images. Benchmarking recent NVS and camera pose estimation methods shows that NVS performance degrades with increasing viewpoint disparity, and that feed-forward pose estimators notably lag behind optimization-based approaches, highlighting MV2 as a rigorous testbed for NVS in driving. The dataset, benchmark protocol, and project resources are available at https://mv2-dataset.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-View Multi-Vehicle (MV2) 数据集与基准，用于评估动态城市场景中大幅视角变化下的新视角合成 (NVS)。数据集包含来自汽车、踏板车和无人机的同步多轨迹影像，共 50 个高质量场景、12000 张图像，并基于 Structure-from-Motion 配准及人工像素级对应标注验证相机位姿。基准测试表明 NVS 性能随视角差异增大而下降，前馈位姿估计方法明显落后于优化方法。
Motivation: 可微分渲染推动了新视角合成，但应用于真实驾驶场景仍因采集视角稀疏、动态物体多以及缺乏多轨迹数据而困难。现有数据集多为单轨迹，难以评估大幅视角变化下的模型表现。
Method: 构建 MV2 数据集与评估基准：使用汽车、踏板车和无人机同步采集多轨迹视频，通过 Structure-from-Motion 注册所有序列，并用人工像素级对应标注验证相机位姿；训练时用一种车辆的相机流，在另一种车辆的相机流上测试，以模拟更大的视角变化。
Result: 基准测试显示，NVS 性能随视角差异增大而下降；前馈位姿估计方法在精度上明显落后于基于优化的方法，表明 MV2 是评估驾驶场景 NVS 的严格测试平台。
Conclusion: 作者强调 MV2 作为驾驶场景新视角合成基准的价值，并公开数据集、基准协议和项目资源。

papers.title: Large Language Model for Verilog Code Generation: Literature Review and the Road Ahead
papers.abstract_en: Code generation has emerged as a critical research area at the intersection of Software Engineering (SE) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), attracting significant attention from both academia and industry. Within this broader landscape, Verilog, as a representative hardware description language (HDL), plays a fundamental role in digital circuit design and verification, making its automated generation particularly significant for Electronic Design Automation (EDA). Consequently, recent research has increasingly focused on applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to Verilog code generation, particularly at the Register Transfer Level (RTL), exploring how these AI-driven techniques can be effectively integrated into hardware design workflows. Despite substantial research efforts have explored LLM applications in this domain, a comprehensive survey synthesizing these developments remains absent from the literature. This review fill addresses this gap by providing a systematic literature review of LLM-based methods for Verilog code generation, examining their effectiveness, limitations, and potential for advancing automated hardware design. The review encompasses research work from conferences and journals in the fields of SE, AI, and EDA, encompassing 70 papers published on venues, along with 32 high-quality preprint papers, bringing the total to 102 papers. By answering four key research questions, we aim to (1) identify the LLMs used for Verilog generation, (2) examine the datasets and metrics employed in evaluation, (3) categorize the techniques proposed for Verilog generation, and (4) analyze LLM alignment approaches for Verilog generation. Based on our findings, we have identified a series of limitations of existing studies. Finally, we have outlined a roadmap highlighting potential opportunities for future research endeavors in LLM-assisted hardware design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型（LLM）用于 Verilog 代码生成的系统性文献综述，覆盖了来自软件工程、AI 和 EDA 领域会议与期刊的 70 篇论文以及 32 篇高质量预印本，共 102 篇论文。综述围绕四个研究问题展开：识别用于 Verilog 生成的 LLM、考察评测所用的数据集与指标、归类 Verilog 生成技术、分析面向 Verilog 生成的 LLM 对齐方法，并基于发现指出现有研究的局限性，最后提出 LLM 辅助硬件设计的未来研究方向路线图。
Motivation: 尽管已有大量研究探索 LLM 在寄存器传输级（RTL）Verilog 代码生成中的应用，但缺乏一个综合性的综述来整合这些进展，该文献空白阻碍了研究者系统理解该领域的现状、局限与未来方向。
Method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，从 SE、AI 和 EDA 领域的会议与期刊中收集 102 篇论文，通过四个研究问题（所用 LLM、数据集与指标、生成技术分类、LLM 对齐方法）对文献进行结构化分析。
Result: 综述识别出用于 Verilog 生成的各类 LLM、评测数据集与指标，并对现有生成技术和 LLM 对齐方法进行了分类；同时总结了现有研究的一系列局限性。
Conclusion: 本文填补了 LLM 用于 Verilog 代码生成领域缺乏系统性综述的空白，并基于对 102 篇论文的分析提出了一条包含未来研究机会的路线图，旨在推动 LLM 辅助硬件设计的发展。

papers.title: ORV: 4D Occupancy-centric Robot Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent embodied intelligence suffers from data scarcity, while conventional simulators lack visual realism. Controllable video generation is emerging as a promising data engine, yet current action-conditioned methods still fall short: generated videos are limited in fidelity and temporal consistency, poorly aligned with controls, and often constrained to singleview settings. We attribute these issues to the representational gap between sparse control inputs and dense pixel outputs. Thus, we introduce ORV, a 4D occupancy-centric framework for robot video generation that couples action priors with occupancy-derived visual priors. Concretely, we align chunked 7-DoF actions with video latents via an Action-Expert AdaLN modulation, and inject 2D renderings of 4D semantic occupancy into the generation process as soft guidance. Meanwhile, a central obstacle is the lack of occupancy data for embodied scenarios; we therefore curate ORV-Data, a large-scale, high-quality 4D semantic occupancy dataset of robot manipulation. Across BridgeV2, DROID, and RT-1, ORV improves video generation quality and controllability, achieving 18.8% lower FVD than state of the art, +3.5% success rate on visual planning, and +6.4% success rate on policy learning. Beyond singleview generation, ORV natively supports multiview consistent synthesis and enables simulation-to-real transfer despite significant domain gaps. Code, models, and data are at: https://orangesodahub.github.io/ORV
papers.comment: CVPR 2026. Project page: https://orangesodahub.github.io/ORV/ Code: https://github.com/OrangeSodahub/ORV
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ORV，一个用于机器人视频生成的 4D 占据中心 (occupancy-centric) 框架，将动作先验与占据派生的视觉先验相结合。框架通过 Action-Expert AdaLN 对齐分块的 7-DoF 动作与视频隐变量，并将 4D 语义占据的 2D 渲染作为软引导注入生成过程；同时构建了大规模高质量 4D 语义占据数据集 ORV-Data。在 BridgeV2、DROID、RT-1 上，ORV 相比现有方法将 FVD 降低 18.8%，视觉规划成功率提高 3.5%，策略学习成功率提高 6.4%，并原生支持多视角一致合成与 sim-to-real 迁移。
Motivation: 具身智能面临数据稀缺，而传统仿真器缺乏视觉真实感；可控视频生成被视为有潜力的数据引擎，但现有动作条件生成方法在保真度、时间一致性、控制对齐上表现有限，且多局限于单视角。作者将这些不足归因于稀疏控制输入与稠密像素输出之间的表征鸿沟。
Method: 提出 ORV 框架：利用 Action-Expert AdaLN 将分块 7-DoF 动作与视频隐变量对齐，并把 4D 语义占据的 2D 渲染作为软引导注入视频生成；同时整理 ORV-Data，一个针对机器人操作的大规模高质量 4D 语义占据数据集。
Result: 在 BridgeV2、DROID 和 RT-1 基准上，ORV 提升了视频生成质量与可控性，FVD 比当前最优方法低 18.8%，视觉规划成功率提升 3.5%，策略学习成功率提升 6.4%；此外还支持多视角一致合成及跨领域 sim-to-real 迁移。
Conclusion: 作者认为 4D 占据表征能弥合稀疏控制输入与稠密像素输出之间的鸿沟，从而改善机器人视频的生成质量与下游可用性；实验范围集中在机器人操作场景及上述数据集的分布内。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Do LLMs Actually Help? Evaluating LLMs as Data Quality Annotators
papers.abstract_en: LLMs have been increasingly used to catch data quality issues automatically, but we know very little about how consistent these judgments actually are. This study tests an LLM on two e-commerce data quality tasks, entity matching and brand mislabeling, against rule based baselines and human verified ground truth, under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting. On entity matching while using the Abt Buy benchmark (2,194 labeled pairs), a simple rule based baseline (F1=0.950) performed about as well as LLM zero shot prompting (F1=0.948). Moreover, a few-shot prompt revision that looked effective on a small validation sample reduced full-scale performance to F1=0.914. This showed that small sample prompt evaluation can be misleading. On brand mislabeling detection, using 500 Amazon product listings with synthetically injected labeling errors, the LLM clearly outperformed a naive rule based baseline (F1=0.833 vs 0.721), because it could draw on background knowledge of brand product relationships that a simple rule could not access. Testing consistency across repeated runs (200 pairs, 5 runs at temperature 0.7) showed the model agreeing with itself 99.7% of the time on average, with 99% of pairs giving identical answers across all 5 runs. Using majority voting across these runs only improved F1 by 0.005, at 5 times the inference cost. These results suggest that the value of using an LLM over traditional methods depends heavily on the task. LLMs offer little advantage when strong lexical signals already exist, but a clear advantage when the task requires background knowledge, all while remaining highly consistent across repeated queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 LLM 在电商数据质量标注任务中的实际价值，围绕实体匹配 (entity matching) 与品牌误标检测 (brand mislabeling) 对比规则基线和人工标注真值。结果表明效果高度依赖任务：实体匹配中简单规则基线（F1=0.950）与 LLM zero-shot（F1=0.948）相当，而看似有效的小样本 few-shot 修订在全量上反而降至 F1=0.914；品牌误标检测中 LLM（F1=0.833）明显优于朴素规则基线（F1=0.721），且重复运行一致性很高。
Motivation: LLM 正被越来越多地用于自动发现数据质量问题，但对其判断一致性以及相比传统规则方法到底能带来多少增益，缺乏系统性认识。
Method: 在 Abt-Buy 基准（2,194 对标注数据）上测试实体匹配，在 500 条亚马逊商品列表上测试品牌误标检测（注入合成标签错误），采用 zero-shot 与 few-shot prompting 对比规则基线；另用 200 对样本、5 次运行（temperature=0.7）评估重复一致性，并测试多数投票 (majority voting) 的效果。
Result: 实体匹配中规则基线 F1=0.950，LLM zero-shot 为 F1=0.948，few-shot 修订后全量 F1 降至 0.914；品牌误标检测中 LLM 为 F1=0.833，规则基线为 F1=0.721。模型自一致性平均为 99.7%，99% 的样本对在 5 次运行中答案完全相同；多数投票仅提升 F1 0.005，却付出 5 倍推理成本。
Conclusion: LLM 相对传统方法的价值高度依赖任务：当强词面信号已足够时优势很小，而当任务需要背景知识（如品牌与产品关系）时优势明显，并且模型在重复查询下保持高度一致。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: How Quantum Is the Advantage? A Fair, Calibration- and Noise-Aware Benchmark and Attribution Audit of Quantum Machine Learning for Network Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning (QML) for network intrusion detection (NIDS) is routinely reported to reach near-perfect accuracy, yet the most rigorous studies find that well-tuned classical models remain competitive, and that apparent quantum gains may be artefacts of classical dimensionality reduction and implicit regularisation rather than genuine quantum effects. We ask not whether a quantum model can post a high accuracy, but how quantum the advantage really is. We present a unified, reproducible QML-IDS benchmark evaluating hybrid variational quantum circuits and quantum-kernel SVMs against five honestly-tuned classical baselines across four standard NIDS datasets (NSL-KDD, UNSW-NB15, CICIDS2017, NF-ToN-IoT-v2) under one leakage-controlled protocol, with an equal-budget feature view, imbalance- and calibration-aware metrics with significance testing, and a simulated NISQ noise sweep. We introduce a quantum-attribution audit (parameter-matched classical controls, a random-feature kernel, and a regularisation sweep) that quantifies how much of any gain is genuinely attributable to the quantum component. Tuned classical models (Random Forest, XGBoost) match or exceed the quantum models on aggregate detection on every dataset, and the audit attributes this to classical preprocessing and regularisation rather than quantum effects. Two advantages survive false-discovery-rate correction: the quantum-kernel SVM out-ranks its direct classical surrogate (a random-feature kernel) on AUPRC and ROC-AUC, and a small four-qubit hybrid out-detects the best classical baseline at the 1% false-positive operating point on the distribution-shifted NSL-KDD task (p = 0.005, BH q = 0.030). Code, seeds, and splits are released; our contribution stands whether quantum wins, ties, or loses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对量子机器学习（QML）用于网络入侵检测（NIDS）的优势进行公平、可复现的基准测试与归因审计。作者在统一协议下比较混合变分量子电路和量子核 SVM 与五个经典基线，覆盖四个数据集并加入噪声扫描与显著性检验；结果显示调优的经典模型（Random Forest、XGBoost）在每个数据集上匹配或超过量子模型，大部分增益被归因于经典预处理与正则化，而非量子效应。经 FDR 校正后仍存两个量子优势：量子核 SVM 在 AUPRC 与 ROC-AUC 上超过其经典替代（随机特征核），以及一个四比特混合模型在分布偏移的 NSL-KDD 任务 1% 假阳性率下优于最佳经典基线（p = 0.005, BH q = 0.030）。
Motivation: QML 用于 NIDS 的文献常报告接近完美的准确率，但更严格的研究发现调优的经典模型仍有竞争力，且看似量子带来的提升可能只是经典降维与隐式正则化的伪影。作者因此不追问量子模型能否取得高准确率，而是量化量子优势究竟有多大。
Method: 构建统一的 QML-IDS 基准：在四种数据集（NSL-KDD、UNSW-NB15、CICIDS2017、NF-ToN-IoT-v2）上，于单一防泄漏协议下比较混合变分量子电路与量子核 SVM 对五个诚实调优的经典基线，采用等预算特征视角、不平衡与校准感知指标、显著性检验以及模拟 NISQ 噪声扫描；并引入量子归因审计（参数匹配的经典对照、随机特征核、正则化扫描）来量化增益中真正归因于量子成分的部分。
Result: 调优的经典模型在每个数据集的总体检测上匹配或超过量子模型，审计将这些表现归因于经典预处理和正则化而不是量子效应。两个优势通过错误发现率（FDR）校正：量子核 SVM 在 AUPRC 与 ROC-AUC 上超过其直接经典代理（随机特征核），且一个小的四比特混合模型在分布偏移的 NSL-KDD 任务 1% 假阳性率工作点上优于最佳经典基线（p = 0.005, BH q = 0.030）。
Conclusion: 作者强调公平基准与归因审计的价值，并声明其贡献在量子模型胜、平或负的情况下都成立；代码、随机种子与数据划分已公开。

papers.title: TokenPowerSandbox: Evidence-Gated CPU-First Screening for Energy-Aware LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Energy-aware LLM serving requires comparing configurations under realistic request shapes, yet exhaustive target-GPU profiling is costly and a cheap predictor can be dangerously confident outside its measured scope. We present TokenPowerSandbox, an evidence-gated workflow that combines an interpretable CPU-resident projector, short target-GPU probes, full-workload verification, and tamper-evident freeze-before-measurement provenance. On one NVIDIA H100 80GB serving Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with vLLM, three anchor repeats and six development workloads calibrate workload transfer. The same frozen model is evaluated on a blind holdout and a separately predeclared no-refit confirmation totaling 51 post-freeze runs. Energy MAPE is 6.23% and 7.35%, with Spearman rank correlations of 0.976 and 0.933. However, a predeclared TTFT gate passes at concurrency four (9.27% MAPE) and triggers abstention below four (64.80%), showing why energy accuracy cannot certify latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TokenPowerSandbox，一个证据门控（evidence-gated）的能源感知 LLM 服务配置比较工作流，将可解释的 CPU 驻留投影器（CPU-resident projector）、短目标 GPU 探针、全工作负载验证与防篡改的冻结前测量来源（tamper-evident freeze-before-measurement provenance）相结合。在 NVIDIA H100 80GB 上服务 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with vLLM，经盲保留集和预声明无重拟合确认共 51 次冻结后运行，能量 MAPE 为 6.23% 和 7.35%，Spearman 秩相关为 0.976 和 0.933。但预声明 TTFT 门仅在并发四时通过，低于四则触发弃权，说明能量精度不能替代延迟验证。
Motivation: 能源感知的 LLM 服务需要在真实请求形态下比较配置，但穷举目标 GPU 剖析成本高，而廉价预测器在测量范围之外可能过度自信，缺乏可靠证据。
Method: 提出 TokenPowerSandbox 工作流，使用可解释的 CPU 驻留投影器估计能耗，配合短目标 GPU 探针校准、全工作负载验证以及冻结模型后再测量的来源追踪机制，并以锚重复与开发工作负载标定工作负载转移。
Result: 在单张 NVIDIA H100 80GB 上服务 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 且使用 vLLM 时，51 次冻结后运行的能量 MAPE 为 6.23% 和 7.35%，Spearman 秩相关为 0.976 和 0.933；预声明 TTFT 门在并发四时通过（9.27% MAPE），在并发低于四时触发弃权（64.80%）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调能量精度不能证明延迟满足；即使能耗预测准确，也需独立的延迟门控，必要时主动弃权以避免超出证据范围的预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flux-form spatiotemporal neural operators for coarse-grained dynamics of multiscale PDEs
papers.abstract_en: We study data-driven prediction of coarse-grained dynamics in multiscale PDE systems. Adopting a closure-free operator-learning viewpoint, we apply a linear coarse-graining map and learn a surrogate evolution operator for the resolved field directly from filtered high-fidelity trajectories. Motivated by the Mori-Zwanzig formalism, we propose a spatiotemporal neural operator mapping a resolved history slab on $Ω\times[-T_{\mathrm{in}},0]$ to a resolved future slab on $Ω\times[0,T_{\mathrm{out}}]$. Spatial mixing uses Fourier convolution, while temporal mixing uses a causal kernel operator with position-attention weights on time lags. This causal temporal operator encodes finite-memory effects in the resolved dynamics while preserving the directionality of the history-to-future map. To improve rollout robustness and suppress nonconservative artifacts, we embed a flux-form inductive bias by parameterizing the windowed update in explicit divergence form. We also provide a data-driven guideline for selecting the memory length $T_{\mathrm{in}}$ via the decorrelation time of a closure-injection diagnostic computed from filtered trajectories. We validate on the coarse-grained viscous Burgers' equation, the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation, and two-dimensional turbulent flows, obtaining stable autoregressive rollouts with improved long-horizon accuracy and statistical fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多尺度PDE系统粗粒化动力学的数据驱动预测。作者采用无闭包算子学习视角，应用线性粗粒化映射，直接从滤波后的高保真轨迹学习被解析场的替代演化算子；受Mori-Zwanzig形式启发的时空神经算子将已解析历史层映射到未来层，空间混合用傅里叶卷积，时间混合用带位置注意权的因果核算子，并将窗口更新参数化为显式散度形式以引入通量形式偏置。在粗粒化粘性Burgers方程、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程和二维湍流上验证，得到稳定的自回归展开与改进的长时程精度和统计保真度。
Motivation: 多尺度PDE的粗粒化动力学预测中，被滤除的小尺度场会引入记忆与非马尔可夫效应，传统闭包建模困难；论文希望在不显式构造闭包的情况下，仅用滤波轨迹学习已解析场的未来演化。
Method: 提出一个时空神经算子，将 Ω×[-T_in,0] 上的已解析历史层映射到 Ω×[0,T_out] 上的未来层；空间混合使用傅里叶卷积，时间混合采用带位置注意权的因果核算子以编码有限记忆效应并保持方向性。更新被参数化为显式散度形式（flux form），并给出基于滤波轨迹闭包注入诊断去相关时间来选取记忆长度 T_in 的数据驱动准则。
Result: 在粗粒化粘性Burgers方程、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程和二维湍流上，方法获得稳定的自回归展开，并提升长时程预测精度与统计保真度。
Conclusion: 论文指出因果时间算子与通量形式归纳偏置有助于抑制非守恒伪影并稳定粗粒化动力学的展开；同时提供数据驱动的记忆长度选择准则，但结论局限于文中测试的理想化PDE与湍流场景。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Entropy-Constrained Adaptive Stochastic Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive stochastic quantization (ASQ) is a recently introduced quantization approach that optimizes the Mean Squared Error (MSE) for a given input while preserving unbiasedness. It is designed to alleviate the communication and memory bottlenecks of modern data and machine learning workloads, including model, gradient, and KV-cache compression and nearest-neighbor search. Further, practical systems can then compress quantized data with a lossless entropy encoder. However, existing unbiased methods, including ASQ, choose their quantization values without considering this later encoding stage, leaving accuracy on the table. We formulate the Entropy Constrained Adaptive Stochastic Quantization (ECASQ) problem, which jointly selects adaptive quantization values to minimize MSE under an entropy budget and an unbiasedness constraint. We give an optimal dynamic program with $O(sd^2)$ time and $O(d^2)$ space for a length-d vector and at most s quantization values, and a GPU-friendly approximate dynamic program with $O(sd^2)$ time and $O(d)$ space. The approximation guarantees that the solution has an MSE no larger than the optimal solution that uses one fewer bit of entropy per entry. We also provide an iterative refinement procedure for the approximation solution that, in our experiments, yields near-optimal results while retaining a substantial speed advantage over our solver for the optimal solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自适应随机量化 (ASQ) 在后续无损熵编码阶段被忽视的问题，提出熵约束的自适应随机量化 (ECASQ) 问题，即在无偏约束和熵预算下联合选择量化值以最小化均方误差 (MSE)。作者给出一个最优动态规划算法，时间复杂度 O(sd^2)、空间复杂度 O(d^2)，以及一个 GPU 友好的近似动态规划算法，时间复杂度 O(sd^2)、空间复杂度 O(d)。近似解保证其 MSE 不超过使用每项少一比特熵的最优解，并附带迭代精化过程，在实验中接近最优且比最优求解器快得多。
Motivation: 现有的无偏量化方法（包括 ASQ）在选择量化值时没有考虑后续的无损熵编码阶段，因此留下精度提升空间；在模型、梯度和 KV-cache 压缩等现代机器学习负载中，联合考虑熵编码可以进一步缓解通信和内存瓶颈。
Method: 形式化 ECASQ 问题，在熵预算与无偏性约束下联合优化量化值以最小化 MSE；提出 O(sd^2) 时间、O(d^2) 空间的最优动态规划，以及 O(sd^2) 时间、O(d) 空间的 GPU 友好近似动态规划，并引入迭代精化过程改善近似解。
Result: 近似算法保证所得解的 MSE 不超过使用每项少一比特熵的最优解；实验显示迭代精化后的近似解接近最优，同时相比最优求解器保持显著的速度优势。
Conclusion: 作者强调联合考虑后续熵编码可以在不增加熵预算的前提下降低量化 MSE，并提供了兼具理论保证和实用效率的求解算法，适用于模型、梯度、KV-cache 压缩以及最近邻搜索等场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Deontic Gap: Large Language Models and the Modal Language of Obligation
papers.abstract_en: Modal auxiliaries such as must, should, and have to mark necessity and obligation within the contexts of speaker authority and interpersonal stance. We examine whether large language models (LLMs) reproduce contemporary human patterns of deontic modal usage. Across three primary corpora, an external benchmark, two controlled replications, and a naturalistic eleven-model replication, AI-generated text consistently underuses positive deontic modals (must, should, have to, had to) relative to contemporary humans. Historical comparison with the Google Books Ngram corpus (1920-2022), used as a heuristic calibration against the published-prose record, shows that AI modal frequencies fall within the range of formal published English, whereas contemporary human modal rates in informal digital contexts often exceed twentieth-century book baselines. Phrase-level decomposition shows that the AI-human modal gap is concentrated in constructions central to interpersonal stance (should, have to, had to), while AI matches or exceeds humans on need to in instructional and question-answering contexts but not in persuasive student writing, indicating that the modal profile is genre-conditional. The findings suggest that LLM modal usage reflects the formal written resources on which these models were trained, while underusing the modal constructions through which contemporary human writers mark immediate, interpersonal obligation.

papers.title: Efficient Adaptation of LLMs for Hate Speech Detection in Low-Resource Languages: A Comparative Study on Roman Urdu
papers.abstract_en: It is challenging to detect hate speech in Low Resource Languages (LRLs) because of the absence of annotated data, the informality of its language structure, and the lack of standardized grammar. A good example of such a challenge is Roman Urdu which is broadly used by South Asians on social media and has a high variation while lacking contextually consistent spellings. The objective of this paper is to conduct a comprehensive assessment of Large Language Models (LLMs) for Hate Speech Detection (HSD) in Roman Urdu script and fine-tune these models using the Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) method called Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). To evaluate zero-shot inference, we benchmarked it against PEFT on different transformer models, including Mistral, LLaMA, Falcon, and multilingual BERT. Experiments are conducted on the PURUTT (Parallel Urdu and Roman Urdu Corpus for Toxic Comments and Transliteration) dataset with over 72,000 annotated comments. The results suggest that zero shot models perform moderately (F1 = 0.56), but updating a small fraction of the model trainable parameters improves the classification performance significantly (F1 > 0.93). Our results have shown that PEFT delivers outstanding performance alongside excellent computational efficiency, making it highly suitable for low-resource language processing tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估大语言模型（LLM）在低资源语言罗马乌尔都语（Roman Urdu）仇恨言论检测（HSD）上的表现，并对比零样本推理与基于低秩适应（LoRA）的参数高效微调（PEFT）。实验在 PURUTT 数据集（超过 72,000 条标注评论）上进行，覆盖 Mistral、LLaMA、Falcon 和多语言 BERT 等 Transformer 模型。结果显示零样本推理的 F1 仅为 0.56，而只更新少量可训练参数的 PEFT 将 F1 提升至 0.93 以上，同时保持出色的计算效率。
Motivation: 低资源语言（LRL）因缺少标注数据、语言结构非正式且缺乏标准化语法，仇恨言论检测颇具挑战；罗马乌尔都语在社交媒体上使用广泛，但拼写变体多、缺乏上下文一致的规范化拼写，是此类困难的典型代表。
Method: 作者对不同 Transformer 模型（包括 Mistral、LLaMA、Falcon 和多语言 BERT）进行零样本推理基准测试，并使用参数高效微调方法 LoRA 对同一批模型进行微调，系统比较零样本推理与 PEFT 在罗马乌尔都语仇恨言论检测上的分类效果。
Result: 零样本模型表现中等（F1 = 0.56）；使用 LoRA 微调、仅更新少量可训练参数后，分类性能显著提升（F1 > 0.93），且计算效率优秀。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PEFT 能在低资源语言处理任务中同时达到高性能和出色的计算效率，适合此类场景；摘要未涉及具体局限性或对更广泛语言的推广声明。

papers.title: Mitigating Spectral Bias in Neural Operators for Underwater Transmission Loss Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting underwater acoustic transmission loss rapidly and accurately is crucial for real-time ocean acoustic applications. While Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) have emerged as powerful surrogate models due to their global receptive fields, they suffer from spectral bias. The frequency truncation mechanism in FNO filters out high-frequency components, resulting in over-smoothed predictions that fail to capture fine-grained interference patterns. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes a Spectral-Spatial Residual Learning (S2RL) framework. S2RL decomposes the prediction task into a coarse-to-fine process: a spectral Global Propagator first generates a globally consistent prediction, and a spatial Local Refiner subsequently recovers the high-frequency residuals. Experimental results on a South China Sea dataset show that the proposed method significantly outperforms FNO baselines while maintaining millisecond-level inference speeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对傅里叶神经算子 (Fourier Neural Operator, FNO) 在水下声学传输损失预测中的谱偏差问题，提出频谱-空间残差学习框架 S2RL。S2RL 将预测分解为粗到细两步：频谱全局传播器 (spectral Global Propagator) 先生成全局一致的预测，空间局部精化器 (spatial Local Refiner) 再恢复高频残差。在南中国海数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著优于 FNO 基线，同时保持毫秒级推理速度。
Motivation: 快速且准确的水下声学传输损失预测对实时海洋声学应用至关重要；现有 FNO 虽具有全局感受野，但其频率截断机制会过滤高频成分，导致预测过度平滑，无法捕捉精细干涉图样。
Method: 提出 Spectral-Spatial Residual Learning (S2RL) 框架，将任务分解为粗到细过程：先用频谱 Global Propagator 生成全局一致预测，再用空间 Local Refiner 恢复高频残差。
Result: 在南中国海数据集上的实验显示，该方法显著优于 FNO 基线，并保持毫秒级推理速度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过显式分离全局低频与局部高频残差，可以缓解神经算子的谱偏差并提升水下传输损失预测精度。

papers.title: Language Models for Portuguese: A Systematic Mapping Study
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, the rapid development of language models has transformed the field of Natural Language Processing through a wide range of applications. However, the development of language models has not progressed uniformly across all languages. In the case of the Portuguese language, there has recently been a growing effort by academia and companies to develop language models and create data resources for Portuguese. These efforts have resulted in the rise of an increasingly diverse ecosystem of language models for Portuguese. However, information on these models remains dispersed in scientific publications, technical reports, model repositories, and project documentation. This survey presents a systematic mapping study of language models developed for Portuguese, providing a comprehensive overview of the current state of the field. We map a total of 46 models, characterizing them by various aspects, including base model, architecture, computational resources, training datasets, licensing, code availability, data, and model weights. Furthermore, we analyzed the evolution and relationships among these models through a phylogenetic perspective, identified current research gaps and opportunities, and discussed future directions for the development of language models for Portuguese.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对葡萄牙语语言模型 (language models for Portuguese) 的系统映射研究 (systematic mapping study)，共梳理了 46 个模型，并按基础模型、架构、计算资源、训练数据集、许可、代码可用性、数据和模型权重等多个维度进行刻画。作者还从系统发育 (phylogenetic) 视角分析了模型之间的演化与关系，识别了当前的研究空白与机会，并讨论了未来发展方向。
Motivation: 葡萄牙语语言模型的信息分散在学术论文、技术报告、模型仓库和项目文档中，缺乏系统性整理，导致研究者难以掌握该领域的整体状态。
Method: 采用系统映射研究方法，对已开发的葡萄牙语语言模型进行综述与分类；除按多方面属性刻画模型外，还引入系统发育视角分析模型谱系关系，并据此总结研究空白。
Result: 共映射 46 个模型，给出了葡萄牙语语言模型生态的全面概览，并识别出若干研究空白与机遇。
Conclusion: 该综述认为葡萄牙语语言模型正形成日益多样化的生态，但信息分散问题突出；作者据此提出未来发展方向，面向的是自然语言处理领域而非天气相关应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FraudBench: Stress-Testing Policy-Grounded Banking Agents Against Adaptive Fraud
papers.abstract_en: Conversational agents now act for end users through tools while holding access to customer databases and internal policy documents that a caller can reach through dialogue alone. Banking is the clearest case: the same agent that answers a question can also change contact details, reset a PIN, or move money, so ordinary customer service is inseparable from authorization, fraud detection, and policy compliance. Existing financial-fraud benchmarks classify static transactions or messages, and general agent-safety benchmarks target prompt injection or generic harmful use; none test whether a policy-grounded banking agent safely acts when a caller manipulates identity, authorization, and trust over a conversation. We introduce FraudBench, an executable benchmark built on the $τ^2$-bench dual-control framework and the $τ$-Knowledge banking environment. Both the agent and the simulated caller act through tools over shared, mutable account state, and the agent may grant the caller access to selected tools; the environment exposes a 698-document internal policy corpus that the agent must retrieve from. FraudBench contains 150 authored adversarial scenarios; a frozen public set of 107 (90 across ten fraud mechanisms plus 17 chained adaptive attacks) is used for all reported runs, with 43 further chained attacks held out. Safety is history-dependent: single-control tasks satisfy every precondition but one, and adaptive attacks make a later, locally valid request unsafe because of an earlier probe, admission, or failed attempt. Each scenario is annotated with observable evidence, prohibited actions, safe dispositions, and intervention points. A preliminary single-trial evaluation of four agents on the 107 graded tasks yields attack-security between 49\% and 65\%, with money-mule and first-party fraud the most common cross-model weaknesses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FraudBench，一个基于 τ²-bench 双控框架与 τ-Knowledge 银行环境构建的可执行基准，用于检验策略约束型银行智能体在遭遇会话式身份、授权与信任操纵时的行为安全。基准包含 150 个手写对抗场景，其中冻结公开集 107 个（10 种欺诈机制下的 90 个单控任务加 17 个链式自适应攻击），另有 43 个链式攻击保留不公开。初步单次评估中，四个智能体在 107 个评分任务上的攻击安全性（attack-security）为 49% 至 65%，洗钱（money-mule）和一手欺诈（first-party fraud）是跨模型最常见的弱点。
Motivation: 现有金融欺诈基准只对静态交易或消息分类，通用智能体安全基准则针对提示注入或泛化有害用途；没有一个基准能检验策略型银行智能体在通话者通过对话操纵身份、授权和信任时是否安全行动。
Method: FraudBench 是一个可执行基准：智能体与模拟来电者都通过工具作用于共享、可变动的账户状态，智能体可授予来电者部分工具权限；环境提供 698 篇内部政策文档供智能体检索。场景分为单控任务与链式自适应攻击，并标注可观察证据、禁止行为、安全处置和干预点。
Result: 对四个智能体在 107 个评分任务上的初步单次评估显示攻击安全性为 49% 至 65%，其中 money-mule 和 first-party fraud 是跨模型最常见的失败模式。
Conclusion: 安全性具有历史依赖性：单控任务仅缺一个前置条件，而自适应攻击会因早前的探测、承认或失败尝试使后续局部合法请求变得不安全。摘要强调该基准填补了策略型智能体在欺诈对抗场景下的测试空白，但未给出更大规模或多次运行的结论。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有金融欺诈基准只对静态交易或消息分类，通用智能体安全基准则针对提示注入或泛化有害用途；没有一个基准能检验策略型银行智能体在通话者通过对话操纵身份、授权和信任时是否安全行动。
summary_sections.method: FraudBench 是一个可执行基准：智能体与模拟来电者都通过工具作用于共享、可变动的账户状态，智能体可授予来电者部分工具权限；环境提供 698 篇内部政策文档供智能体检索。场景分为单控任务与链式自适应攻击，并标注可观察证据、禁止行为、安全处置和干预点。
summary_sections.result: 对四个智能体在 107 个评分任务上的初步单次评估显示攻击安全性为 49% 至 65%，其中 money-mule 和 first-party fraud 是跨模型最常见的失败模式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 安全性具有历史依赖性：单控任务仅缺一个前置条件，而自适应攻击会因早前的探测、承认或失败尝试使后续局部合法请求变得不安全。摘要强调该基准填补了策略型智能体在欺诈对抗场景下的测试空白，但未给出更大规模或多次运行的结论。

papers.title: Improving Rural Medication Safety with AI: A Scoping Review
papers.abstract_en: Introduction: Medication errors (MEs) represent a significant threat to global healthcare systems, contributing to patient harm. Introducing artificial intelligence (AI) in rural healthcare enhances patient safety. The aim is to explore the applications and effectiveness of AI technologies in enhancing patient safety and reducing medication errors in rural health settings. Methods: A scoping review was conducted through a systematic literature search spanning 2012 to 2025 across multiple databases, including EBSCohost, Emcare (Ovid), MEDLINE, and the ProQuest Consumer Health Database. Twelve primary studies from nine different nations were examined. Data were analysed thematically to obtain insights on AI interventions across the medication process. Results: AI technologies have been integrated into every stage of medication management, right from prescribing and dispensing to administration and post-administration monitoring. Four key themes came to light: (1) the various types of AI being utilised (like Clinical Decision Support Systems, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and smart pumps); (2) the phases of the medication process that are affected; (3) how effective these technologies are in minimising errors and boosting workflow safety; and (4) rural-specific challenges including infrastructure, staff training, system integration, and alert fatigue. Several studies have demonstrated that machine learning-based surveillance improves incident detection and reduces prescribing and transcription errors by an impressive 34% to 80%. Barriers included lack of governance frameworks, financial limitations, and clinician resistance, which still present major obstacles. Conclusion: In rural healthcare, AI technologies hold great potential for enhancing pharmaceutical safety. They can allow data-driven monitoring, automate processes, and offer clinical decision assistance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇范围综述 (scoping review)，旨在探索人工智能技术在 rural 医疗环境中提升患者安全、减少用药错误 (medication errors) 的应用与效果。作者系统检索了 2012 至 2025 年多个数据库，纳入来自九个国家共 12 项原始研究，并按主题分析 AI 干预在用药流程中的作用。综述发现 AI 已覆盖处方、发药、给药及给药后监测各阶段，并总结了四类主题及若干实施障碍。
Motivation: 用药错误是威胁全球医疗系统患者安全的重要问题；在 rural 医疗中引入 AI 有望提升患者安全，但对其具体应用和有效性的系统性认识尚不充分，因此作者开展该范围综述进行梳理。
Method: 采用范围综述方法，对 EBSCohost、Emcare (Ovid)、MEDLINE 和 ProQuest Consumer Health Database 等数据库进行 2012 至 2025 年的系统文献检索，最终纳入来自九个国家的 12 项原始研究，并使用主题分析对 AI 干预措施进行归纳。
Result: 结果显示 AI 技术已整合到用药管理的每个阶段（处方、发药、给药与给药后监测），并提炼出四个主题：所用 AI 类型（如临床决策支持系统、机器学习、自然语言处理和智能泵）、受影响的用药流程阶段、技术在减少错误和提升流程安全方面的有效性，以及农村特有的挑战（基础设施、员工培训、系统整合和警报疲劳）。多项研究表明，基于机器学习的监测可改善事件检测，并将处方和转录错误降低 34% 至 80%；障碍包括治理框架缺失、资金限制和临床医生的抵触。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AI 技术在提升 rural 医疗中的用药安全方面潜力巨大，能够支持数据驱动的监测、流程自动化并提供临床决策辅助。

papers.title: Optimized Fuzzy Logic Approach with the IEEE Key Gas Method for Diagnosing Power Transformer Faults Using Dissolved Gas Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Reliable transformer fault diagnosis is essential for maintaining power system stability. The IEEE Key Gas Method (KGM), a widely utilized approach in Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA), exhibits limitations in addressing ambiguous data and ensuring high diagnostic accuracy. This study presents An enhanced model combining Fuzzy Logic with the IEEE Key Gas Method (FL-KGM) that introduces refined membership functions, optimized fuzzy rule sets, and a novel separation of CO and CO2 to eliminate diagnostic inconsistencies. By leveraging multidimensional gas ratio analysis and an adaptive classification framework, FL-KGM delivers superior fault identification and classification. Experimental validation utilizing real-world datasets demonstrates that FL-KGM achieves up to 98.6% accuracy, significantly outperforming KGM and other FL-based approaches. These findings elucidate the potential of FL-KGM in advancing transformer monitoring, enabling intelligent fault detection, and enhancing predictive maintenance strategies in modern power systems.
papers.comment: This paper was presented at 2025 10th International Conference on Applying New Technology in Green Buildings (ATiGB). Please cite the published version
papers.journal_ref: 2025 10th International Conference on Applying New Technology in Green Buildings (ATiGB), Danang, Vietnam, 2025, pp. 114-119
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FL-KGM，将模糊逻辑 (Fuzzy Logic) 与 IEEE 特征气体法 (Key Gas Method, KGM) 结合，用于基于溶解气体分析 (Dissolved Gas Analysis, DGA) 的电力变压器故障诊断。该方法通过精炼隶属函数、优化模糊规则集并新增 CO 与 CO2 的分离来消除诊断不一致，在真实数据集上达到最高 98.6% 的准确率，优于 KGM 及其他基于模糊逻辑的方法。
Motivation: IEEE KGM 是 DGA 中广泛使用的变压器故障诊断方法，但难以处理模糊/不确定数据，且诊断精度有限，不能满足现代电力系统对高可靠性状态监测与预测性维护的需求。
Method: 提出 FL-KGM 增强模型，将模糊逻辑与 IEEE KGM 结合，引入精炼的隶属函数 (membership functions) 和优化后的模糊规则集，并创新性地将 CO 与 CO2 分开处理以消除诊断不一致；同时利用多维气体比值分析和自适应分类框架提升故障识别与分类能力。
Result: 基于真实数据集的实验验证显示，FL-KGM 最高可实现 98.6% 的准确率，显著优于传统 KGM 和其他基于模糊逻辑的方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FL-KGM 有潜力推动变压器监测技术发展，支持智能故障检测并增强现代电力系统的预测性维护策略；摘要未提供详细的实验设置与对比基线清单。

papers.title: Safety Alignment Illusion: The Cross-Lingual Safety Gap in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Current safety alignment training for Large Language Models (LLMs) are heavily English-centric. When such safety filters fail for non-English languages, the consequences are immediate and user-facing: voice assistants and spoken dialogue systems may produce stereotype-reinforcing outputs, bypassing the standard English-focused safety alignments and propagating harmful bias to non-English speaking communities. For spoken language technologies deployed across India's linguistically diverse population, this represents a critical failure mode. To address this cross-lingual gap, we introduce INCLUDE (Indian Cultural Lens for Understanding and Detecting Embedded Biases), a multilingual evaluation benchmark designed to quantify Indian-centric socio-cultural biases. INCLUDE consists of 2,604 prompts spanning six prompt languages: English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, and Hinglish (Hindi-English code-mix). We evaluate ten open- and closed-source LLMs against this benchmark, analyzing 14,988 bias scores. Our statistical results reveal two key findings. First, Bengali yielded the highest average bias score in open-source models. Second, English demonstrated a notable reversal, producing the lowest bias in open-source models but the highest bias in closed-source models.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 8 figures, submitted to IEEE SLT (Spoken Language Technology) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前 LLM 的安全对齐训练以英语为中心，在非英语语言上可能失效，导致语音助手和口语对话系统输出强化刻板印象的内容。针对印度多语言场景，作者提出多语言评估基准 INCLUDE，包含 2,604 个提示、六种提示语言（英语、印地语、孟加拉语、马拉地语、泰米尔语和 Hinglish），并评测了十个开源与闭源 LLM，分析了 14,988 个偏见分数。统计结果显示孟加拉语在开源模型中平均偏见分数最高，而英语出现反转：在开源模型中偏见最低、在闭源模型中偏见最高。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 安全对齐训练高度以英语为中心，非英语语言的防护失效会直接造成面向用户的危害，尤其是印度等语言多样性地区的口语技术部署场景。
Method: 引入 INCLUDE（Indian Cultural Lens for Understanding and Detecting Embedded Biases），一个多语言评估基准，用于量化印度中心的社会文化偏见；基准包含 2,604 个提示，覆盖六种提示语言，并据此评测十个开源和闭源 LLM。
Result: 对 14,988 个偏见分数的统计分析显示：孟加拉语在开源模型中平均偏见分数最高；英语呈现反转现象，在开源模型中偏见最低而在闭源模型中偏见最高。
Conclusion: 摘要强调跨语言安全差距是口语语言技术中关键失效模式，并展示了 INCLUDE 基准在揭示不同语言和模型类型间偏见分布差异上的作用。

papers.title: Online Bipartite Matching with Reusable Capacity under Non-Stationary Rewards
papers.abstract_en: We study online bipartite matching with reusable server capacity and non-stationary rewards. Jobs arrive sequentially, reveal compatible servers, reward rates, and processing durations, and must be accepted or rejected irrevocably. An accepted job occupies one unit of server capacity only during its processing interval, so an assignment may displace an unknown sequence of future jobs. Existing guarantees are typically calibrated by a global reward range, which can become arbitrarily large when rewards drift over a long horizon. We instead impose a locally bounded reward condition: reward rates of jobs that can compete for the same server within a relevant time window differ by at most a factor $δ$. Under this condition, we develop two BALANCE-type algorithms with time-aware opportunity-cost losses. TS-BAL maximizes cumulative blocking losses over feasible reuse schedules and achieves a competitive ratio of $2\ln(δD)+\mathcal O(\ln\ln(δ\vee D))$. GR-BAL uses a greedy relaxation of this loss and achieves $\ln(δD)+\mathcal O(\ln\ln(δ\vee D))$, matching a lower bound of $\ln(δD)$ in the leading term. Numerical experiments demonstrate robust performance under substantial global reward drift and favorable finite-capacity performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可复用服务器容量下的在线二分图匹配问题，奖励随时间非平稳变化。任务顺序到达并披露兼容服务器、奖励速率和处理时长，接受与否不可撤销，且一个接受的任务只在处理区间内占用容量。作者提出局部有界奖励条件，并给出两个 B BALANCE 型算法 TS-BAL 和 GR-BAL，分别达到 2ln(δD)+O(ln ln(δ∨D)) 与 ln(δD)+O(ln ln(δ∨D)) 的竞争比。
Motivation: 已有的匹配算法保证通常依赖全局奖励范围来校准，而当奖励在长时间范围内漂移时该范围可能任意大，导致现有理论失效。作者希望在此类非平稳奖励下仍能给出有意义的竞争比保证。
Method: 引入局部有界奖励条件，即能在相关时间窗口内竞争同一服务器的任务，其奖励速率最多相差一个因子 δ。基于该条件，提出两种带时间感知机会成本损失的 BALANCE 型算法：TS-BAL 最大化可行复用调度上的累积阻塞损失，GR-BAL 使用该损失的贪心松弛。
Result: TS-BAL 达到 2ln(δD)+O(ln ln(δ∨D)) 的竞争比；GR-BAL 达到 ln(δD)+O(ln ln(δ∨D))，其首项与 ln(δD) 的下界匹配。数值实验表明在显著全局奖励漂移下依然稳健，并在有限容量下表现良好。
Conclusion: 作者认为在局部有界奖励条件下，基于时间感知机会成本损失的 BALANCE 型算法能在非平稳奖励环境中提供超越全局奖励范围的竞争比保证，且 GR-BAL 在首项意义上达到最优。

papers.title: Optimizing Energy Efficiency and Grid Stability via Public EV Charging Flexibility
papers.abstract_en: This study evaluates the potential of electric vehicle (EV) charging flexibility to enhance both energy efficiency and power grid stability. Using real-world data from public charging stations in Prague, we analyze individual and aggregated charging sessions to explore how optimizing charging times can reduce energy waste, minimize grid imbalances, and support the integration of renewable energy. By aligning EV charging with periods of lower grid demand and higher renewable generation, we demonstrate a significant improvement in energy efficiency, reduc ing the need for costly system support and ancillary services. Our findings suggest that cooperation between power distributors and transmission system operators can unlock new opportunities for maintaining grid stability while promoting sustainable energy use in an increasingly uncertain energy landscape.
papers.comment: Submitted to Young Energy Researchers Conference at World Sustainable Energy Days 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用布拉格公共充电站的真实数据，分析电动汽车充电灵活性对能源效率和电网稳定性的潜在影响。摘要表明，通过将充电时间与低电网需求和高可再生能源发电时段对齐，可以减少能源浪费、缓解电网失衡，并降低对昂贵系统支持和辅助服务的需求。
Motivation: 在可再生能源占比上升和电网不确定性增加的背景下，需要新的手段维持电网稳定并提高能源效率；电动汽车充电灵活性被视为一个潜在来源，但其实际潜力需要基于真实公共充电会话数据来量化。
Method: 使用布拉格公共充电站收集的真实世界数据，对个体和聚合的充电会话进行分析，并评估优化充电时间以对齐低电网需求和高可再生能源发电时段的效果。
Result: 摘要报告称，将电动汽车充电与较低电网需求及较高可再生能源发电时段对齐后，能源效率得到显著提升，同时减少了对昂贵系统支持和辅助服务的需求。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，配电系统运营商与输电系统运营商之间的合作可以在不断变化的能源格局中为维持电网稳定和促进可持续能源使用创造新的机会。

papers.title: Global Index on Responsible AI 2026 : Conceptual Framework and Methodology
papers.abstract_en: This report presents the methodology of the Global Index on Responsible AI (GIRAI), 2nd Edition. This edition refines the 1st Edition by strengthening the distinction between framework existence and implementation, restructuring dimensions from three to five thematic areas, introducing more granular variables for framework quality, and applying a multi-stage review and validation process. An independent statistical pre-audit was conducted to assess the coherence and robustness of the framework. GIRAI assesses responsible AI governance across five dimensions: Inclusion and Diversity, Ethics and Sustainability, Labour and Skills, Trust and Safety, and Use of AI in Public Service. Each dimension has a number of indicators (38 in total), organised into three pillars, namely AI Policy (17 indicators on government frameworks and implementation, assessed through primary data), CSO Engagement (5 indicators, primary data), and Enabling Conditions (15 indicators on the structural factors shaping responsible AI governance, assessed through secondary data), and a government Use of Unacceptable Risk AI (URAI) indicator (primary data), applied separately as an accountability penalty to the final score. Data was collected by 135 country-level researchers through a structured global survey, complemented by secondary datasets. The count, scope, enforceability, thematic coverage, and implementation levels of the data points are coded into numerical variables, normalised to a scale of 100, aggregated through pillar weights of 60% (AI policy), 10% (CSO Engagement), and 30% (Enabling conditions). A deduction penalty is applied for countries with evidence of URAI. This documentation enables systematic cross-national comparison, supporting policymakers, civil society, and AI developers to identify where commitments are translating into enforceable protections and where critical gaps remain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本报告介绍《全球负责任 AI 指数》(Global Index on Responsible AI, GIRAI) 第二版的概念框架与统计方法。该指数从五个维度、三大支柱共 38 个指标评估各国负责任 AI 治理，并把政府使用不可接受风险 AI 的情况作为独立扣分项。摘要说明了指标构建、数据收集、编码与加权聚合流程，旨在支持跨国比较。
Motivation: 第一版评估在区分“框架存在”与“实际执行”上不够清晰，维度结构也有待调整。第二版通过强化这一区分、细化框架质量变量并引入多阶段审查与验证，提升评估框架的连贯性和稳健性。
Method: 将评估维度重构为五个主题域（包容与多样性、伦理与可持续、劳动与技能、信任与安全、公共服务中的 AI），下设 AI 政策（17 个指标，一手数据）、公民社会组织参与（5 个指标，一手数据）和赋能条件（15 个指标，二手数据）三大支柱，另有独立的不可接受风险 AI 使用指标作为问责扣分项；数据由 135 个国家研究员通过结构化全球调查收集，并辅以二手数据集，经编码、标准化到 100 分制后按支柱权重 60%/10%/30% 聚合。
Result: 摘要未报告具体国家排名或实证结果，主要成果是完成了独立的统计预审计以检验框架的连贯性与稳健性，并提供可用于系统跨国比较的评估方法。
Conclusion: 该文档旨在帮助政策制定者、公民社会和 AI 开发者识别各国承诺是否转化为可执行的保护措施，以及关键缺口所在。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Tradable Itô Signatures: A Model-Free, Interpretable Framework for Dynamic Hedging
papers.abstract_en: We propose an interpretable machine-learning framework for dynamic hedging using the Itô signature transform, which turns asset-price paths into a set of linear features that universally represent nonlinear functions on time-series. We show that each discretized Itô signature component can be perfectly replicated by a simple self-financing strategy using only the underlying assets and cash, which turns Itô signature components into tradable and transparent hedging bases. This allows nonlinear derivative payoffs to be approximated by linear combinations of signature terms and hedged through the corresponding combination of trading strategies. We further establish a new approximation result for the Itô signature and derive theoretical bounds for both in-sample and out-of-sample hedging errors. Our method is computationally efficient, easy to implement, and avoids the estimation of future conditional expectations, which makes it attractive for real-world applications. In simulations, our method delivers strong sample efficiency at substantially lower computational cost than neural-network benchmarks. In an empirical study of S\&P 500 index options, it performs robustly across vanilla and path-dependent contracts, with the signature-kernel weighted version providing further gains by localizing estimation to similar historical market paths. Overall, the paper identifies the Itô signature as a practical, transparent, and model-agnostic implementation framework for dynamic hedging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于 Itô 签名变换的可解释机器学习框架用于动态对冲，将资产价格路径转化为一组线性特征，并证明每个离散化的 Itô 签名分量可由仅使用底层资产和现金的简单自融资策略完美复制，从而成为可交易且透明的对冲基。该方法无需估计未来条件期望，计算高效，在模拟中比神经网络基准有更强样本效率且成本大幅降低，在 S&P 500 指数期权实证中对普通和路径依赖合约表现稳健。
Motivation: 动态对冲通常依赖模型假设或对未来条件期望的估计，缺乏透明且模型无关的实现框架。作者希望利用 Itô 签名为非线性衍生品提供可解释、可交易的对冲基，降低实际应用中的计算与实现门槛。
Method: 使用 Itô 签名变换将资产价格路径映射为线性特征，证明每个离散化签名分量可由底层资产和现金的简单自融资策略复制，从而将非线性衍生品收益近似为签名项的线性组合，并通过对应交易策略组合进行对冲。文中还建立新的 Itô 签名近似结果，推导样本内与样本外对冲误差的理论界，并提出签名核加权版本以局部化估计。
Result: 模拟中该方法相比神经网络基准样本效率更高且计算成本显著降低；在 S&P 500 指数期权的实证中，它在普通和路径依赖合约上表现稳健，签名核加权版本通过将估计定位到相似历史市场路径进一步带来增益。
Conclusion: 摘要将 Itô 签名定位为实用、透明且模型无关的动态对冲实现框架，强调其计算高效、易于实现并避免了未来条件期望估计。
Relevance: 0
